articleTitle: Paybill Troubleshooting and Reversal Guidelines (Care Center & Retail)
markdownContent:
**Non-Functional Contact Update on G3**

**Frontline Contact Channels**

For non-functional, incomplete and or missing contact details or where customers say they cannot reach partners for reversals after being given the contacts, the CEE shall raise an SR under the following SR Category, Type, and Item for Paybill to be assisted with the reversal.

| CATEGORY | TYPE | ITEM |
| --- | --- | --- |
| LNM PAYBILL | Reversal Request | Non-Functional Contact |

For Buy Goods choose the relevant Category for the reversal.

The partner will be contacted to consent to the reversal and or otherwise and reversal will be done as per consent given (Completed or cancelled).

Follow up with the partner will also be done to share the new working contact by the analyst and or reversals Team and the new contact updated accordingly on G3 .

When raising for Merchants tills use, the associated till MSISDN (Mobile Number) to raise the SR ticket for change of contact to done.

Select appropriate item that needs to be updated. It will be handled by **LNM Support Team**.

When raising for Paybill, Use the nominated number for the Paybill whose contacts need to be updated. It will be handed by **LNM Support Team** ...

LNM Support Team will engage the partners to complete the attached KYC form and attach relevant documents then proceed to update the contacts as requested.

**Analysts / Reversal Team / Merchant Support Action:**

Kindly have the partner write an email from an official email address and attach letter request on a company letterhead that is stamped.

The request should include the new contact number or email address and Paybill / Buy Goods Number and must be signed by at least two authorized signatories for company or one signatory if it is individual proprietorship and stamped.

Additionally, they should provide a copy of the current CR12 within 90 days validity for Limited companies and or Copy of ID for sole proprietors.

**NOTE:** This Guide is for the update of contact numbers and email addresses only.

Always create a new SR using the partner details and attach the email communication, Letter / CR12 or ID copy on the SR.

**Use Buy Goods & PAYBILL Below Category and Type & Relevant Item as appropriate**:

| CATEGORY | TYPE |
| --- | --- |
| LNM BUY GOOD AND SERVICES | Change of KYC Details |
| LNM PAYBILL | Change of KYC Details |

Update the new contacts on G3 and close the SR only after receiving the written requests.

**NOTE:** KYC Details Change form is being worked on for change of all other details relevant and once it ready an updated guide will be share

For repeat callers, or upon customers request for Safaricom to follow up on their behalf, CEE will raise an SR (SLA 72hrs) and clearly state details on the SR notes, except for Airtime partners e.g. Pesapal where customers will still have to engage the partner by themselves for reversal to be done.

**Retail Center & Care Desk CEE Instructions**

The CEE will vet the customer to establish details of the transaction and confirm the merchant product type / details as pay bill.

CEE will validate that the date of transaction is not older than 30 days. Where transaction is older than 30 days, CEE will give the merchant/partner contacts to the customer to engage the partner for a refund and advise them about the reversal rule.

Where transaction is not older than 30 days, and the transaction type is merchant product type / details as Paybill the CEE will raise an SR.

For short term pay bill, CEE will contact the merchant for consent.

Where the consent is not given; the CEE will update the customer accordingly and issue the contacts for the partner/merchant for the customer to follow up with the partner/merchant.

Where consent is given CEE will raise an SR and indicate details of the approver and contact on the SR notes for RCSA to reverse the transaction and follow up on completion.

Where contact is not reached CEE will raise SR for subsequent follow up with merchant by the RCSA.

**Post-pay Paybill 200200 reversals vs. posting to account Scenarios**

**Wrong format e.g. put account as 168975879 instead of 1-6897587.**

Confirm that the account number (e.g. 1-68975879 is correct and on Post-pay, e.g. the customers did leave out any digit).

Educate customer on how to pay with correct details; advice the customer that this shall be posted in their account.

Postpaid reversals should be done through View360 as it is working ok. Do not raise SRs unless necessary.

You can reverse payments to 200200 unless there is an error.

In case of need to raise an SR (SLA 72HRS) with full details of the M-PESA transaction (Amount, Transaction ID, Date, Time, MSISDN/Account number) and state kindly post to correct account and quote it.

Do not ask the customer to make new payment.

Key in relevant interactions.

Escalate to Line 200 TM Escalation folder and copy CM PostPay TM and CM CCSPostPay with details of the transaction and MSISDN for follow up.

 Follow the steps below when reversal is requested.

i.         Query TID on M-PESA

ii.         Check account customer paid to under “Bill reference” on M-PESA.

iii.         Open the wrong postpaid account on CRM, even if is closed. You can also reverse when paid to short codes like 1000, 3000 etc.

iv.         Open AR actions and search for the M-PESA TID in question.

v.         Highlight the TID.

vi.         Click on “Payment Reversal”

vii.         Confirm on M-PESA that the payment has reversed and a reversal TID generated.

 [Screenshot] 

**Wrong format e.g. put account as 1\_68975879 instead of 1-68975879**

Confirm that the account number (e.g. 1-68975879 is correct and on PostPay, e.g. the customers did leave out any digit)

Educate customer on how to pay with correct details; advice the customer that this shall be posted in their account.

Raise an SR on this request with full details of the M-PESA transaction (Amount, Transaction ID, Date, Time, MSISDN/Account number) and state

kindly post to correct account and quote it.

Do not ask the customer to make new payment.

Key in relevant interactions.

Escalate to Line 200 TM Escalation folder and copy CM PostPay TM and CM CCSPostPay with details of the transaction and MSISDN for follow up.

**Wrong format e.g. put account as 1-68975879 instead of 1-6897587909 (Where also customer left out a digit of two.)**

Educate customer on how to pay with correct details; advice the customer that this shall be posted in their account.

Raise an SR on this request with full details of the M-PESA transaction (Amount, Transaction ID, Date, Time, MSISDN/Account number)

Do not ask the customer to make new payment as the transaction will be corrected and posted.

Key in relevant interactions.

Escalate to Line 200 TM Escalation folder and copy CM Post-pay TM and CM CCSPostpay with details of the transaction and MSISDN for follow up.

**Recipient details on MPESA transaction reading as SELF instead of 0722\*\*\*\*\*\***

Educate customer on how to pay with correct details; advice the customer that this shall be posted in their account.

Raise an SR on this request with full details of the M-PESA transaction (Amount, Transaction ID, Date, Time, MSISDN/Account number)

CEE may ask the customer to make new payment as they wait for the reversal to be done.

Key in relevant interactions.

Escalate to Line 200 TM Escalation folder and copy CM post-pay TM and CM CCSPostPay with details of the transaction and MSISDN for follow up.

**Paid to 07\*\*450450 (prepaid number) instead of 07\*\*450451(post-pay number)**

Educate customer on how to pay with correct details; advice the customer that this shall be reversed so that the customer can make correct payment.

Raise an SR on this request with full details of the M-PESA transaction (Amount, Transaction ID, Date, Time, MSISDN/Account number)

CEE may ask the customer to make new payment as they wait for the reversal to be done.

Key in relevant interactions. 
Escalate to Line 200 TM Escalation folder and copy CM PostPay TM and CM CCSPostPay with details of the transaction and MSISDN for follow up.

**Paid to 07\*\*45050 (paying number) instead of 07\*\*450450 (PostPay number)**

(Where also customer left out a digit of two and in close check the paying number and the quoted number have similarities)

Educate customer on how to pay with correct details; advice the customer that this shall be posted in their account.

Raise an SR on this request with full details of the M-PESA transaction (Amount, Transaction ID, Date, Time, MSISDN/Account number) and state kindly post to correct number and quote it.

Do not ask the customer to make new payment.

Key in relevant interactions.

Escalate to Line 200 TM Escalation folder and copy CM PostPay TM and CM CCSPostPay with details of the transaction and MSISDN for follow up.

**Paid to 07\*\*450450 (PostPay number) instead of 07\*\*450451(PostPay number)**

Educate customer on how to pay to correct number; advice the customer that this shall be reversed so that the customer pays to the correct account.

Raise an SR on this request with full details of the M-PESA transaction (Amount, Transaction ID, Date, Time, MSISDN/Account number)

CEE may ask the customer to make new payment as they wait for the reversal to be done.

Key in relevant interactions.

Escalate to Line 200 TM Escalation folder and copy CM PostPay TM and CM CCSPostPay with details of the transaction and MSISDN for follow up.

**Rule of thumb:**

If the customer misses out on a character or digit when paying to a number, the possibilities for posting payment to complete correct number that will be provided exist.

If the customer puts a complete incorrect number and state that the payment was to be posted to another complete correct number, reversal will be done.

Details of transaction to be provided must include: (Amount, Transaction ID, Date, Time, MSISDN/Account number).

## **Definition**

Corporate Postpaid Plans (CPP) are integrated communication plans (available to enterprises) that combine minutes, data and SMS.

## **New/Revamped CPP**

Our Corporate Postpaid plans have been revamped and the **NEW** Corporate Postpaid Plans offer a mix of minutes, data, and SMS available in two options, one for data heavy users (**BrowseMore**) and one for Voice and SMS heavy users (**TalkMore**).

## **Eligibility**

Corporate Postpaid plans Data packs are available for enterprises and their staff.

**All customers** (new & existing) will automatically enjoy the New corporate postpaid plans.

For the existing customers, the auto-renewal on the **1st of January 2025** & going forward will be on the new corporate postpaid plans.

For customers joining after the 1st of any month, they will receive prorated resources for the remaining days of the month. Full resources will be awarded each month thereafter.

## **Free Closed User Group (CUG) on CPP 5,000 & 10,000**

When mobile numbers are part of a CUG with either Corporate Postpaid TalkMore or BrowseMore plans (5000 or 10,000), members can make unlimited local calls to each other at no cost.

## **Onboarding**

The Enterprise customer will ﬁll in the Corporate Postpaid plans form and submit it to their relationship manager for internal activation of the service. The service will be active in 2 working days.

The Enterprise customer will need to provide:

·       The list of mobile numbers and the corresponding Corporate Postpaid plans to be added.

·       Normal KYC requirements accompanying the application form.

 **Validity**

The Corporate Postpaid Plans will expire at the end of each month with **NO Roll Over** of unused resources.

The product will recur every month and will be loaded every 1st of the month unless the customer has requested for termination in writing or instructions from credit control to terminate have been issued due to unpaid bills.

## **Upgrade/Downgrade and Change of Plan**

Staff can switch between plans( Talk More and Browse More) and Upgrade or Downgrade by making a formal request to their relationship manager. A prorate charge will apply if the switch is made within the billing cycle.

## **Billing**

The Enterprise customer will be billed at the end of the month for all employee numbers under their account.

Enterprise customers will be sent the bill to the registered email address by the 5th of each month.

The previous months bills is due for payment **by the 16th of the next  month**. Customers who do not pay their bills by then will be disconnected until full payment is done.

- The plans are designed with two billing models based on the end-user where:

- **EOEB (Employer Owned; Employer Billed):** The employer owns the line and is billed for the service on behalf of their staff.
- **SOEB (Staff Owned; Employer Billed):** The staff own the lines, but the employer is billed for the service.

- For both EOEB and SOEB:

- The employer is billed at the end of each month for all beneficiary MSISDNs under their account.
- All charges are inclusive of VAT and excise tax.

Customers can pay via EFT/bank transfer or Mpesa.

## **Will Enterprise customer need to pay a deposit?**

Deposit is subject to Credit Control approval. Deposit exempt customers will not pay deposit.

## **Does the Enterprise customer need to have credit limit/allowance?**

No. The customer can opt to either have a credit limit/allowance or not have one.

## **Other Features:**

You cannot sambaza Corporate Postpaid  plans

You cannot roam with Corporate Postpaid  plans

End users will receive an SMS prior to exhaustion of their resources(usage notifications).

To check balance, customers will dial: \*200#, select ʻMy Accountʼ then Corporate Postpaid  plans balanceʼ option.

Unutilized data bundles expire at the end of the billing cycle and do not roll over.

The end user that gets the Corporate Postpaid plans will be awarded Bonga Points equivalent to the value of the bundle upon bundle purchase and as per prevailing Bonga conversion rates.

Note: To earn the Bonga points, the customer must have enrolled prior via \*126#.

 **Priority in usage will be given in the following order:**

1.   Priority 1- Bundle with the shortest validity e.g daily, weekly etc.

2.   Priority 2- 30-day Postpay bundle e.g Corporate Postpaid  plans

3.   Priority 3- Bundle bought earlier e.g a bundle bought on 29/11/2024 will be consumed first before another bundle bought on 05/12/2024

## **What it is Easy Talk Plus Bundle?**

This is a new voice bundle plan that allows you a worry-free experience on Local Calls & International Calls.

## **Who is eligible to use the service?**

All Safaricom subscribers are eligible to use this service.

## **How do purchase Easy Talk Plus Bundle?**

Dial \*444#, \*100# or \*200# select option Easy Talk Monthly then Easy-Talk Plus which will display available plans for you.

## **What is the validity of the bundle?**

Bundles are valid for 30 days.

**Are these bundles reversible?**

Only those valid for 30 days can be reversed

## **Will purchase of another bundle extend Validity?**

No. The resources will not rollover.

## **Can I subscribe multiple times**

Yes, you can purchase the bundle as many times as you wish.

## **How do I check my balance?**

Balance check on USSD \*444# or send SMS to144 to show the balance of all the resources remaining Minutes.

## **Will I earn bonga when I Subscribe to Easy Talk Plus Bundle?**

Yes, you will earn Bonga when you subscribe to the bundle according to the bonga terms and condition.

## **Will I achieve Storo when I Subscribe to Easy Talk Plus Bundle?**

Yes. Once you purchase the bundle, you will accumulate Storo bonus points. Applies only to Pre-pay customers who have subscribed into the service.

## **Can I buy other Minutes & airtime bundles when Subscribed to the bundle?**

Yes, you can buy other bundles.

## **Can I use the minutes to call across networks?**

Yes, the local minutes can be used across networks.

## **Can I use the resources to make international calls?**

Yes, the bundle come with International Minutes for calling Zone A countries: USA, Canada, India & China and East Africa Countries: Uganda & South Sudan. The International Minutes are applicable to calling these countries ONLY.

## **Can I use the resources while roaming?**

No, the minutes are usable only while within Kenya.

articleTitle: Definition and features of Pochi la Biashara
markdownContent:
# **Definition**

Pochi la Biashara is a service that enables business owners to receive and separate business funds from personal funds using their M-PESA number.

The service is accessible via:

- USSD: Dial \*334#
- My OneApp (mini app)

**Eligibility**

Available to M-PESA registered customers, especially those operating informal businesses such as:

- Food vendors
- Kiosk owners
- Boda-boda operators
- Second-hand clothes dealers
- Other small-scale traders

**To qualify, customers must:**

- Be active M-PESA users
- Be registered on the **Pochi wallet**

**Charges**

- Standard **Send Money charges** apply when customers make payments
- The business owner receiving payments **incurs no charges**

**Fuliza on Business Wallet**

Funds received in the Pochi wallet are protected from Fuliza deductions

When transferring funds to M-PESA:

- Outstanding Fuliza balance is settled first
- Remaining balance is credited to the M-PESA wallet

# **How It Works**

**Opt-In to Pochi La Biashara**

Customers:

- Dial **\*334#**
- Select **Pochi La Biashara**
- Choose **Join Now**
- Accept Terms & Conditions
- Enter M-PESA PIN to confirm
- Customer receives confirmation and can start using their **Pochi wallet**

**Core Transactions Available**

**Send Money**

Customers can send funds directly from their Pochi wallet:

- Enter recipient number
- Enter amount
- Confirm with PIN
- Receive SMS confirmation showing updated Pochi balance Lipa na Pochi (Payments)

**Pochi To Pochi**

Pochi to Pochi Transfer is now available on the Pochi Mini App within My One App. Previously, the service was only accessible via USSD. This offers merchants a more convenient digital channel to transfer funds between Pochi accounts.

 [Screenshot] 

**Pochi to MMI Not Possible** 

**One cannot send money from Pochi  to  Mobile** **M****oney** **I****nteroperability(MMI) directly i.e. One cannot send from Pochi to Airtel or T- Kash directly.**

**Paybill Payments**

- Enter Paybill number
- Enter account number
- Enter amount
- Confirm using PIN

Enables direct settlement of bills (e.g., utilities bills) 

**NOTE:** **Currently,** **KPLC is not enabled to receive payment****s** **from Pochi Wallet.**

**Buy Goods / Till Payments**

- Enter Till number
- Enter amount
- Confirm with PIN

Supports merchant payments directly from Pochi wallet 

**Withdraw Cash from Agent**

- Enter agent/store number
- Enter amount
- Confirm using PIN
- Receive confirmation and updated balance

**Move Money**

Transfer funds between:

- Pochi wallet
- M-PESA wallet

**Sell Airtime**

Merchants can sell airtime and earn commissions

**Loans & Financial Services**

Access services such as:

- **Taasi / Pochi loans**
- Savings and financial products

**Mini Statements**

View transaction history via **My Account → Statements**

**Options include:**

- Mini statement
- Full statement
- Statement verification

# **Opt-Out Process**

- Accessible via **My Account → Leave Service**
- Requires confirmation and PIN
- User receives exit confirmation

**Key Features**

- Simple sign-up process (no paperwork)
- Accept cashless payments safely
- Secure transactions via M-PESA PIN authentication
- No reversals without merchant consent
- Separation of personal and business funds
- Builds transaction history for financing opportunities
- Airtime sales with commissions
- Access to mini statements

# **Additional Services**

**Haba Haba NSSF**

A retirement savings product tailored for informal sector business owners.

**How to Access:**

- Dial **\*334#**
- Select **Business Wallet**
- Select **Additional Services**
- Follow prompts

**Whats new**

**Ofa ya Pochi (Bundles & Minutes)**

- Purchase bundled offers combining:
- Data
- Voice minutes
- Available directly via USSD and mini app
- Flexible payment options (Airtime, M-PESA, or Pochi)

**Enhanced Pochi Payments**

- Paybill payments now available on mini app
- Seamless bill payment experience
- Reduced transaction friction for merchants

**Expense View (Mini App)**

Dedicated expense tracking dashboard

**Helps merchants:**

- Monitor spending
- Improve financial control
- Make informed decisions

**Enhanced Statements**

Detailed statements in mini app with:

- Monthly filters
- Daily transaction breakdown
- Supports reconciliation and cash flow monitoring

**Simplified Messaging**

- Improved clarity in transaction communication
- “Business Balance” renamed to **“Pochi Balance”**
- Easier recognition and reduced confusion

**Trading Wallet Limits**

- **Per transaction:** KES 250,000
- **Daily limit:** KES 500,000 (combined for personal + Pochi wallet)

**Important Note**

All Pochi La Biashara transactions require your M-PESA PIN.

**YOUR PIN. YOUR SECRET.**

**“Family Share” plans – Formerly Home Plus Bundles**

These are integrated Voice Minutes, mobile Data and SMS bundles, availed alongside your preferred HOME Fibre plans, and that allow you to choose a bundle that meets you and your loved ones’ needs.

The bundles also come with free access to WhatsApp after the data bundle is fully utilized and is within the validity period, so that you can continue keeping in touch.

**“Family Share” bundles**

| Price(Tax Incl.) | PreviousMYOB Data(GB) | CurrentMYOB Data(GB) | Minutes |
| 250 | - | 2.5 | - |
| 300 | 2 | - | 350 Minutes |
| 500 | 4 | 7 | 550 Minutes |
| 750 | 9 | 14 | 800 Minutes |
| 1,000 | 13 | 21 | 1100 Minutes |

**\* *All plans have a validity of 30 days and will not apply to the existing FTTH segmented prepositions i.e P2MP, Boma Yangu and Fibre Lite. Minutes shall be used for both on-net and off-net calls***

**How to purchase “Family Share” bundles**

Customers can purchase the revamped Family Share only when subscribed to the new DIY FTTH products via \*400# by selecting **Home Fibre**, then **Add-ons**. Customers on legacy FTTH plans must first migrate to the new plans before they can purchase the Family Share add-on. **App and Web journey coming soon**

New customers can only purchase the family share plans if they have an active Home Fibre plan.

**Mechanics**

**Will the bundles auto renew?**

The Family Share resources auto renew with the customer’s main FTTH plan.

**Will I be able to share the minutes, data and SMS resources with other mobile numbers?**

Currently, the revamped Family Share plans are not shareable; however, customers on the legacy Family Share plans can still share their resources.

Existing customers will be able to change plan from legacy Family Share to revamped Family Share but will not be able to revert to the legacy Family Share plan.

**Will the “Family Share” resources rollover?**

No, the revamped Family Share resources will not roll over.

**Do the “Family Share” resources expire?**

Yes, Unutilized resources will expire on the due date.

For legacy Family Share you can still add another number as a beneficiary. But new customers will not be able to purchase Family Share for another number on the revamped Family Share.

# **Overview**

The service enables merchants to repay outstanding Fuliza Biashara loan balances either for their own business till (Pay for Self) or on behalf of another merchant (Pay for Other).

The service supports repayments for both active and inactive till numbers, including closed, dormant, and recycled tills that have outstanding Fuliza Biashara balances. This ensures customers can conveniently settle loan obligations through an accessible USSD channel regardless of the status of the original till.

Manual Loan Repayment provides merchants with a flexible and secure way to manage Fuliza Biashara loan repayments while reducing the need for assisted support channels.

# **Fuliza Biashara Loan Definition**

Fuliza Biashara is a credit facility available under the **M-PESA Business Till** portfolio. The facility allows business owners to continue transacting by overdrawing their till accounts when available funds are insufficient to complete a transaction. This enables businesses to maintain operational continuity and meet payment obligations while managing short-term cash flow requirements. **[BOOO-0001:Fuliza Biashara Loan](https://sakahub.safaricom.co.ke/app/article/d327488f-41b5-4b8e-9f17-16bcc859cd75#:~:text=BOOO%2D0001%3AFuliza%20Biashara%20Loan)**

# **Key Features**

# **Pay for Self**

Merchants can repay their own Fuliza Biashara loan directly through USSD. The journey supports:

- Full loan repayment.
- Partial loan repayment.
- Real-time loan repayment confirmation.
- Secure authentication using Operator ID and Operator PIN.

# **Pay for Other**

A merchant can repay an outstanding Fuliza Biashara loan on behalf of another store or merchant via a nominated number. The merchant enters the target store number and repayment amount before confirming the transaction. This functionality is particularly useful for business owners managing multiple stores or supporting repayment of linked business entities.

# **Support for Inactive Tills**

Customers with closed, dormant, recycled, or otherwise inactive till numbers can repay outstanding Fuliza Biashara balances using the manual repayment process. This capability ensures that loan obligations can still be settled even when the original till is no longer operational.

# **USSD Customer Journey**

Merchants initiate the repayment journey by dialing:

\*234# → M-PESA Business Till → Fuliza Biashara → Pay Loan

# **Pay for Other Journey**

A merchant can repay another merchant's Fuliza Biashara balance through the following process:

- Dial \*234#.
- Select M-PESA Business Till.
- Enter the relevant HO/Store Number.
- Select Fuliza Biashara.
- Select Pay Loan.
- Choose Pay for Other.
- Enter the other Store Number.
- Enter the repayment amount.
- Review and confirm the payment details.
- Enter Operator ID and Operator PIN.
- Transaction is submitted and processed.

# **Pay for Self Journey**

A merchant can repay their own outstanding Fuliza Biashara facility by:

- Dialing \*234#.
- Selecting M-PESA Business Till.
- Entering the HO/Store Number.
- Selecting Fuliza Biashara.
- Selecting Pay Loan.
- Choosing Pay for Self.
- Selecting either: Full Payment, or Partial Payment.
- Entering the repayment amount (for partial payments).
- Reviewing and confirming the repayment details.
- Entering Operator ID and Operator PIN.
- Completing the transaction successfully.

articleTitle: Retail SIM Swap Journey – Fingerprint Authentication (View360)
markdownContent:
# **Overview**

Fingerprint authentication is a secure **verification security step** used during SIM swap to confirm that the person requesting the swap is the **legitimate owner** of the mobile number.

It enhances security by using a **unique fingerprint identifier** instead of relying solely on personal details.

Whereas the fingerprint authentication process is more secure, customer Original valid ID as per KYC, is still a requirement. Validation is by verification of ID details vs registration details on the system.

This SIM swap service will only be used for Individually registered lines

## **Acceptable KYC Documents:**

**1.**  **1. Kindly assist** **Original and valid ID as per acceptable KYC**. Vetting is by validation of ID details vs details on the system.

1\. **Adult Kenyan Citizen**

i.         Original and valid Kenyan National ID Card.

ii.         Original and valid Kenyan Passport (ordinary and diplomatic passports).

iii.         Original and valid Military ID

2\. **Individual foreigners**

i.         Original and valid Foreigners certificate (formerly known as Alien ID card)

ii.         Original and valid Refugee ID.

iii.         Original and valid passport (ordinary and diplomatic passports)

Diplomatic ID

3. **Minors**

Under law, minors have no capacity to enter a contract. As such minors’ lines shall be swapped upon obtaining the parental / guardian consent.

i.         The parent / guardian will present any of the acceptable KYC documents above for Adult Kenyan Citizen / Individual Foreigners

##  **Customer has lost ID**

Original waiting card (New version) (Issued within 2 months), clear copy of valid ID document (Optional) and police abstract (Issued within 3 months). Validation is by verification of ID details vs details on the system.

**OR**

Original waiting card (Old version), clear copy of valid ID document (Mandatory) and police abstract (Issued within 3 months). Validation is by verification of ID details vs details on the system.

##  **Lost Military ID**

Where a military customer has lost his/her military ID, he/she should present the following documents for them to be served:

- Introduction letter from his/her Unit duly signed and stamped
- Valid military ID in lieu Card (Temporary military ID)

In case of any further queries/verification:

- Agent will scan the card and emails it to Zachary Mburu ([ZMBURU@Safaricom.co.ke](mailto:ZMBURU@Safaricom.co.ke)) for verification, copying Martin Nyaga.
- Agent calls Zachary to expedite the verification.
- Verification process takes up to 15 minutes.
- Inform the customer that details have been sent for verification and ask for their patience

##  **Foreigner who has lost their passport**

The customer will present the following documents for assistance:

ii.         Police abstract

iii.         Copy of the lost passport

iv.         Letter/document from the respective embassy. (Valid for 3 months)

The letter/document should state the name, their passport number and confirmation that their citizen has informed them of the lost passport and they’re in the process of renewal

**Customer presents Passport but they registered with ID or Vice Versa**

- Team Leader/Manager will vet the customer using the document they registered with using the Subreg KYC system.
- TL/ Manager will use the below details to confirm the ownership of the line and capture the same on interaction.
- TL/Manager will authorize the CEE to proceed and assist the customer.

 **Vetting details by Team Leader**

1. 1. Full Names
 2. Image of the Customer
 3. Date Of Birth
 4. District/Place of Birth

## 

##  **When to Use the Retail SIM Swap Journey – Fingerprint Authentication**

Lost or stolen SIM 

Damaged SIM replacement 

SIM upgrade requests 

## **Effecting the SIM Swap (on View360 Portal)**

**1\. Initiate Request**

i.         Customer requests SIM swap 

ii.         Search customer number on the **View360 Portal** 

iii.         Inform customer of the available SIM swap options (Fingerprint/Secondary vetting), Allow the customer to make a choice on their preference.

**Note****:** You can use a variant of the following phrase as a guide when engaging the customer *“Hello! To make your SIM swap more secure, we offer optional fingerprint verification. You may also continue with the standard verification if you prefer. Would you like to use fingerprint verification today?”*

\[Refer to **Table 3: Where Customer Declines To Use Fingerprint Verification Service below** on how to process the SIM Swap\]

**2\. Navigate to Account Overview → Quick Actions → SIM Swap** 

**3\. Automated System Checks**

•        A pop-up displays **12 automated checks**: 

- ✅ **Green** = Pass: \[ Refer to the **Table 1 : ALL PRECHECKS PASSED below** on how to process the Finger Authentication SIM Swap\]
- ❌ **Red** = Requires investigation.: \[ Refer to T**able 2: FAILED PRECHECKS** **below** on how to process the Finger Authentication SIM Swap\]

***NOTE******: Line roaming on HLR but not on View 360: Rely*** *and use the checks contained in View 360 for decision making. Do not need to reference SAWA.*

**Fingerprint Authentication Process**

**Device Setup**

•        Ensure **fingerprint dongle is connected** 

•        If not detected → Error displayed is: *“No fingerprint scanner detected”* 

**Capture Fingerprint**

•        Click on **switch** tab to Select your dongle serial number.

·       Click **Start** to scan the customer’s fingerprint for verification. The system allows up to 5 fingerprint attempts per session. (There are 3 sessions allowed, hence a total of 15 attempts).

·        Guide the customer to place the correct fingers on the scanner as indicated on the on-screen instructions within the i-frame display.

**Important** **Indicators:**

•        Blinking **green light** = Ready to scan the finger.

•        Follow system prompt for the **registered finger**.

•        Maximum attempts: **Up to 15.** 

**System Verification**

•        Fingerprint is matched against official government records.

**Start key/M-PESA Start Key PIN Requests After Fingerprint Authentication SIM Swap**

·       The agent will send the start key after successful Fingerprint Authentication SIM swap where the M-PESA account was blocked, or customer does not remember their PIN.

·       The agent is required to advise the customer on the activation procedure, PIN change procedure and educate the customer on the importance of keeping their PIN a secret.

| Failed either of the below pre-checks  ·      Roaming·      High Alert·      Regulated·     Golden Numbers Must do Fingerprint authentication NOTE:Where line is roaming on HLR but not on View 360, rely on and use the checks contained in View 360 for decision making. | Customer declines to use the fingerprint verification service. | 1.    Validate KYC details on SubReg KYC Portal·       Team Leader/Manager will vet the customer using the document they registered with using the SubReg KYC system.·       TL/ Manager will ensure ALL the details below match the document presented and capture the same on interaction. NB: where ANY of the below Document details mismatches/ fails, escalate to AML via Analytica to validate current ID on IPRS - Do not Proceed with SWAP or below Secondary Vetting in step 2          Vetting details by Team Leader       i.         Full names     ii.         Document ID number    iii.         Image of the Customer   iv.         DOB as indicated on the Document ID    v.         District of Birth   vi.         ID Serial Number ·       Where the details match, the TL/Manager will authorize the CEE to proceed, assist the customer and do a KYC Update. 2.    Secondary vetting criteria (combination of 2 items below)       i.         2 FDN’s     ii.         GSM details (Airtime balance)    iii.         M-PESA details (M-PESA/FSI balances/KCB limit/M-Shwari limit/Fuliza limit/M-PESA registration date)   iv.         M-PESA transactions    v.         Postpay details 3.    Capture vetting details on the interaction & proceed to swap 4.    Upload KYC documents (Mandatory) |

If any other pre-checks (apart from the published above) fail, such as **line not prepaid, line on self-whitelist, line is inactive, line not on the network for 24 hours, fraud location, customer not IPRS verified, line is not on, or line not within vicinity**, use **Fingerprint Verification** to assist the customer.

If fingerprint verification fails, perform **secondary vetting** thoroughly before assisting the customer.

articleTitle: How to use Google & M-PESA Xpress Billing
markdownContent:
# **Signing Up for Gmail /Google Account**

- Go to www.gmail.com.
- Click Create account.
- The signup form will appear.
- Review Google’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy click the check box, then click Next step.
- Here, you'll have an opportunity to set up recovery options.
- Your account will be created, and the Google welcome page will appear.

# **Google play payment via M-PESA**

This is a service offered to M-PESA registered customers with android phones to be able to purchase applications and digital goods from the Google play store using M-PESA as a payment option.

# **Adding M-PESA as a payment method**

- Go to Google Playstore on your android device
- Click on the home icon
- Select “account”
- Go to “payments methods”
- Select “M-PESA Xpress billing”
- Register your personal details and save

# **Pairing mobile number to Google**

The first time the customer buys an app or game on Google play store they will be required to register a payment profile and their mobile number will be automatically linked.

The next time they buy an app or game, they will be able to use M-PESA payments option to pay for it.

# **Making an M-PESA payment**

- Customer will select the App to purchase and select M-PESA Xpress as the payment option.
- A confirmation window will appear indicating the amount of the app and payment option selected. The customer will proceed to click “BUY”.
- The customer will get a push notification to their phone requesting for input of the M-PESA PIN to complete the transaction
- Upon confirmation, funds will be deducted from the customers’ M-PESA account and transaction completed.
- The app will automatically start to install.

# **Refunding a purchased App/Game**

You will be able to refund an app or game within 1-4 days after purchase

- Customer to login to Google Playstore
- Customer selects profile on top right corner
- Customer selects help and feedback section
- Customer then selects 'request a refund on Google Play' and proceeds with the subsequent prompts
- Once completed, customer will receive an email from Google acknowledging receipt of the refund request and expected resolution time
- The app/game will be uninstalled
- You will receive a refund confirmation message from M-PESA.

**Note**: You can only return an app or game for a refund once. If you buy it again you will not be able to get a refund. If a refund is issued you will lose access to the item.

**NB:** Please raise a Service Request (SR) for reversal if customer has already requested the refund and B2C Refund transaction has failed.

There are scenarios why B2C refunds fail.

Insufficient funds on the B2C Google paybill account and,

“Failed to decrypt the PIN of the initiator” error

# **Google back up**

**Automatically back up data & settings**

- Open your phone's Settings app.
- Tap System Backup. If these steps don't match your phone's settings, try searching your settings app for backup.
- Turn on your backup service.

# **Preventing automatic back up**

Tap on Google+>select settings>select Auto Backup>Turn Auto Backup OFF

articleTitle: Data Bundle Reversal and Data Amnesty Mechanics
markdownContent:
**Reasons for reversal**

- Purchase of wrong bundle.
- Multiple purchase due to delayed system response or otherwise.
- Purchase of wrong bundle value. (Purchase 1000 rather than 100).

**Bundles to be reversed;**

- Daily
- Weekly
- Monthly
- 90 days
- ALL in one data bundle
- Tunukiwa data bundles.
- Data Bundle/Calls and SMS (WITHOUT EXPIRY)
- Facebook bundles

 **Bundles NOT to be reversed**

- Emergency Top-up and resources purchased from it.
- Bundles bought to 3rd parties. (for another number).
- Partially utilized Tunukiwa, hot-deal and Power bundles shall **NOT** be reversed.
- Make Your Bundle with 24 hr validity
- Bundles purchased from Commission Airtime.
- **Postpaid Credit Limit purchases**, **Zidisha** shall be reversed by Support Analysts, raise an **SR** or stop auto-renewal where applicable.

**Note:**

Confirm with the systems on data bundle the customer has purchased.

- For Retail, where part of the bundle has been utilized, the CEE will ask the customer to first **end any active data session**, top-up the difference before raising an SR
- At the call centre, where part of the bundle has been utilized, the CEE will ask the customer to first **end any active data session**, top-up then call back for reversal.
- For partially utilized Daily Data bundles, customer will top-up the difference with a daily data bundle.
- For partially utilized **Weekly, Monthly and 90-Days bundle**, customer will top-up the difference with **ANY** of the 3 data bundle types.

**How to reverse**

- Search the number on Siebel/CRM,
- Go to Transaction History highlight for the Bundle Purchase CDR.
- Drill down to Account Resources.
- Click on Reverse resources.
- This will automatically remove the awarded Data Bundles, SMS and Bonga Points from the customer’s account and trigger an automated interaction.
- Enter the Reversal details on the Data Reversals Link [Log In](https://cxintranet.safaricom.net/cm2/index.php/log-in) for Airtime to be refunded by the Folder CEE.
- Folder CEE will claw back appendant resources like Free WhatsApp Access.
- For Airtime purchased bundles, capture the reversal Interaction ID on the reversal link for ease of transaction reference by the completing team.
- Advise the customer they will be refunded via Airtime/M-PESA **in 2 hours.**

**Note:**

- Check on the transaction ID on MPESA G2 to know the Pay bill used to purchase the bundle.
- For Data Bundles bought through pay bill **244441** and Pay bill **999999999**
- These do not have reverse options in MPESA G2 and reversal is done through B2C payment via pay bill 295901- M-PESA Data payments.
- Raise an SR for support team to deal and give customer SLA.

**Data amnesty mechanics and how to do it on CRM/Siebel**

- This is a goodwill service that allows one to award a free data bundle to unsatisfied customers who still dispute their data bundle usage even after a logical and empathetic explanation on their usage.
- The aim of amnesty is to make the customer feel valued and appreciated for their loyalty to Safaricom and win back their trust. 

**Mechanics**

- All Prepay and Post-pay customers using data services within the country will be considered.
- A customer can only get an amnesty up to 50% of the data purchased.
- A customer will qualify for an amnesty once in a period of 60 days. Always check the amnesty history tab to confirm if the customer qualifies before starting the amnesty engagement with the customer.
- Any data billing issues arising from roaming will not be considered for amnesty.
- The amnesty data bundle will be valid for 7 days and validity cannot be extended by buying any other bundle.
- Sambaza of the amnesty bundle will not be possible.

**How to do it on CRM/Siebel;**

- Search subscriber
- Go to IN call history
- Go to Transaction history
- Select the data bundles purchased
- Click on Data Amnesty tab
- Select the amnesty to award
- Save.

**Note:**

- To check the data amnesty balance, access the IN-data tab, check **Sawazisha bundle balance** or check the balance under transaction history.
- An automatic interaction is created when the customer is awarded amnesty data bundles.
- The amount of the Amnesty awarded is added on the transaction comment field.

articleTitle: M-PESA Business App Definition and Features
markdownContent:
# **M-PESA for Business App**

**Definition**

The M-PESA for Business App is a powerful tool that gives M-PESA merchants greater visibility and control over their businesses. The app is an easy-to-use alternative to the USSD service \*234#, offering a seamless digital experience.

**Benefits Include**

**Improved Visibility:** View collections, payments, and full statements all in one place.

**Simplified Transactions:** Make payments, withdraw funds, check balances, and move funds directly from the app.

**Access Control:** Assign roles and manage permissions for different staff/operators.

**Anytime, Anywhere Access:** Manage business finances on the go.

**Business Loans:** Access Fuliza Biashara and Taasi till loans right from the app.

**Mini Apps:** Unlock third-party services to streamline operations and fuel growth.

**Features**

The additional features on the Business app give business owners more control of their tills and money, while also offering users with a faster and simpler experience than the \*234# channel.

To enhance experience while using the M-PESA Business App, we have added two new features on the app sign-in stage:

On the initial sign-in, the user will receive an OTP to the nominated number or agent till MSISDN SIM card which should be inserted in the phone.

Ability to make the first sign in while using Wi-Fi.

An OTP will be sent when a merchant/Agent signs in with the scenarios below: -

Single SIM on phone + Wi-Fi.

Dual SIM + Mobile Data.

Dual SIM + Wi-Fi.

A user signing in on handset with one SIM card and using mobile data will not receive an OTP and the user will be taken to the terms and conditions page.

The OTP will be auto populated and cannot be input manually. This means that if the SIM card is not in the phone where the sign in is taking place, it will not succeed.

**How It Works**

Merchants will download the M-PESA Business App on their nominated numbers, while M-PESA Agents will download the App to a smartphone phone which has the Till SIM card inserted, either from Google Play store or iOS app store.

First time log in must be done with mobile data switched on and Wi-Fi switched off. Thereafter, users can log in using Wi-Fi.

Users who continue to use mobile data will be required to have data bundles and switch on Mobile internet.

M-PESA Business App downloads are awarded incentive of 500MB on first download **ONLY** and **NOT** subsequent downloads. **NOTE:** **(This incentive was discontinued on 6th February 2025 until further notice)**

# **Roaming Customers**

Customers travelling abroad should be guided to download MPESA- APP within the country before travelling when on Safaricom network to be able to opt in successfully.

Once downloaded and signed in on Safaricom network, then the customer will be able to use M-PESA-APP successfully when roaming.

**NOTE:** Customers already abroad cannot be able to download M-PESA -APP

The M-PESA Business App cannot be installed while outside the country.  For the app to be used while roaming, the customer must install and sign in while in the country. 

**How to Install**

Download the app on handset fitted with nominated number or agent till SIM card.

Enter mobile number – The merchant will enter the nominated number, and the agents will enter till MSISDN.

OTP will be sent and auto populated.

User to accept terms and conditions.

App user to enter the Shortcode/till number.

Enter Operator ID

Enter PIN

Successful sign in.

**NOTE:**  If a customer denies the request for the app to read messages shown on the 3rd screen below 5 times, which allows for the OTP to be auto populated, then they will be locked for and will have to wait for 30 minutes. After which they will receive an OTP when they try to sign in again.

**OTP Failure Reasons**

Customer does not have active internet connection (mobile data bundles or Wi-Fi)

Customer has entered a mobile number that is not the nominated number or the agent till mobile number. (Error screen shot below)

Customer has entered a correct nominated number, but the SIM card is not in the phone. (Error screen shot below)

# **Available Products on M-PESA Business App**

Business Till Merchants with either of the following M-PESA Business Till active products can use the App.

Independent Merchant Store Product.

Small Merchants Product.

Merchant Head Office.

Medium Merchant Store Product. 

**Available merchant products**

Merchants will have access to the following active products on the M-PESA business app.

Must have a single store (Organizations with Hierarchy will be able to access the service in the next update next month).

Must be active on M-PESA.

Must have opted into the M-PESA business App via \*234# Option 2.

If a merchant under Safaricom HO requires the app and does not have the above listed products, raise a request for the LNM support teams to assign the product.

**Available M-PESA Agent active products**

M-PESA Agents will have access to the following active products on the M-PESA business app.

Agent head office product.

Independent store product.

Centrally owned store product.

Super Agents Product.

Super Agency head office.

**NOTE:**  For Agents with Independent and centrally owned store product below are the services that they can access

View and Export Statements.

View transaction status.

View the different accounts balances.

Reverse transactions on the App.

**Agent head office product will be able to perform the following on the app**

Perform float Administrations - Transfer of e-value within the different stores.

View all stores and balances.

View and Export Statement.

View transaction status

View the different accounts balances.

Manage operators (Add, remove, reset PIN.)

﻿**Know Your Customer (KYC)**

**KYC Sign in requirements for merchants**

Till Number/Store Number.

Operator ID and operator PIN.

Only the Nominated number (Business Owner) shall be able to install the app on their number.

 **KYC Sign In requirements for M-PESA Agents**

Agent ID.

Agent PIN.

Agents will only access the App if it is downloaded to a phone which has the **Till SIM card** inserted,

**Available Features for merchants on MPESA Business App**

Once a merchant logs in to the app, they can view:

**Home page** has; quick actions i.e. Withdraw, sell airtime, Pay, roll up (merchants with medium merchant head office and medium merchant store product), statements, scan QR option and Chart.

**Organization tab**: Primary assistant operator can access all the features i.e., cashier mode and operators. They can create assistant operators and view their activities.

**NOTE:** Assistant operator only has the cashier mode feature i.e., search sale and generate QR.

**Transact**: Features such as pay, withdraw and other operations such as export statements.

**Account**: Features manage Favorites, change Pin and contact support features.

**Available Features for M-PESA Agents on M-PESA Business App**

The Home Screen is the landing page after a successful sign in. Features available to users are subject to the role of the user.

**Account balances** – A view of the Working, Float & Commissions account balances. The till Operator will view the float account balances only.

**Money in/money out**

**Quick actions** – short cuts on the home page for transactions. This will change depending on the role.

**Statement** – Transactions displayed.

**Navigation bar** – at the bottom with various tab

**Agent QR Sticker -** Agents can now download and print QR stickers displaying their till number and shop details, making it easier for customers to make payments.

**Transactions**

**Transactions Merchant can perform on the App.**

Withdraw to owner.

Withdraw to bank.

Withdraw at Agent.

Pay to Pay bill.

Pay to Buy goods.

Pay customer.

Roll up from all stores/from one at head office.

Roll up from child account.

Sell airtime.

**Transactions M-PESA Agents can perform on the App.**

A Primary Operator will be able to perform the following transactions on the app.

Business withdrawal

Business deposit

Move money from working to float account and vice versa.

View & Export Statements

**Manage Operators:** Add/Create new operator, reset PIN, Remove Operator or suspend operator account.

Assistant store operator will only be able to perform the below transactions on the app.

Perform customer deposit.

Give cash.

Sell airtime.

Move money from working to float account.

View Transaction Statements for Money in and Money Out.

**Note:** Please note M-PESA registration services are not available from the stores Agent App. These will be included and communicated to you when ready at a later Phase of the project.

**Security**

A merchant’s credentials (Operator ID and Store number) are only applicable to their (nominated) phone number.

For first time logging in, the Agent/ **till SIM card** must be inserted in the smartphone where the App will be downloaded.

Once downloaded, ensure mobile data is enabled, to activate the app. After activation, one can switch to Wi-Fi to access the app.

**Note:** App activation and usage is **zero rated.**

Thereafter, the users’ accounts will be saved on the App and even if the till Sim card is removed and a different one inserted, the account owners can continue logging in as long as they have not ‘Removed’ their account from the App.

**Developer Options and App Security**

To enhance the security of the M-PESA Business App and protect merchant accounts, access to the app has been restricted on devices with **Developer Options** enabled. 

- The security check is an intentional measure designed to protect customer accounts and data.
- The Business App requires Developer Options to be turned off for normal functionality.
- Customers should disable Developer Options in their device settings before attempting to use the app.

**Profile/Account Management**

**Merchant account management**

Merchants can manage their M-PESA business APP accounts by tapping on their profiles on the top left-hand side to:

**Switch accounts**

Manage their Favorites (Add more numbers/buy goods tills/paybill accounts or delete some.

**Change PIN.**

Enable/disable transaction alerts.

Refer to more FAQs on the MPESA APP.

**Log out.**

Get support- make request, call support, Safaricom website, social media handles.

About the App-rate the app, Terms and conditions and Privacy policy.

M-PESA business app Version.

**M-PESA Agents account management**

M-PESA Agents can be able to manage their user accounts by;

Switch between user accounts

Change your App login PIN.

Log out of App

Contact Customer Support line.

View App frequently asked questions

Refer to Terms and conditions.

Review Privacy Policy

**Operate Multiple Stores**

The Switch Account capability enables a business owner to switch between their different stores on the app.

**Business App CRM Wipe Out.**

When a merchant/ Agent reports or complains about fraud, the CFT Team can now wipe out and log out the app on all the devices.

This will be done on CRM under the M-PESA VAS VBC then M-PESA App.

**M-PESA Business App - New Enhancements**

**\[Ni Push\] M-PESA Prompt for Merchant Primary Operators (Express checkout) -** This capability enables merchants to initiate payments directly from the Business App.  

The feature streamlines payment acceptance by triggering a quick, secure M-PESA STK pop-up on the customer’s phone for the customer to authorize the payment instantly by entering his/her M-PESA PIN.

To access the service, Merchants will log in to the App and click on the **Express Check Out** tab on the App landing page. Merchants can also click on **New Sale** option on the App >> click **Request Payment** then **Enter the customers’ phone number.**

The customer will receive a STK prompt indicating the name of the Business to receive the payment and the amount. The Merchant can also **generate a payment link and share with the customer** who will follow the link and authorize payment.

**Pay Bill Account Balances & Statement Fixes -** Ensures merchants view accurate account balances and statements improving transparency and reliability in financial reporting. This initiative resolves issues where Pay Bill account balances show **N/A or 0**, and ensures statements are **accurate and real-time**.

It fixes data delays, sync issues, and broken APIs so that merchants always access correct financial information inside the App.

**Working Account Balance** - The working account balance has been removed from the Pay Bills section. Merchants will be able to view all other balances **except** the working account balance.

**Addition of Merchant Account Information on the App \[Short code, Operator ID and till details\] -** Enhances transparency and operational efficiency by displaying key merchant identifiers (Short Code, Operator ID, and till details) within the app — enabling easier account management, faster issue resolution, and improved accuracy during transactions.

3.  **Integration of the new M-PESA Numbers on NMS:** Starting with (0119, 0118 and 0140) - This will allow Business continuity for the existing transactions done by the new numbers on the Business app.
4. **2FA (Header Enrichment + OTP -** This enhancement helps prevent fraud by ensuring only the rightful owner of a mobile number can onboard, using mobile network verification followed by an OTP confirmation, making it difficult for someone to register using another person's phone number.
5. **Simultaneous Login -**This limits the user to only active session across devices. Strengthens account protection by preventing unauthorized transactions across multiple devices, reducing fraud risks while maintaining a secure user experience.
6. **Local Login (Android)-** Enables faster and more reliable access to the app by allowing users to log in even when network connectivity is poor, reducing login delays and improving convenience.
7. **M-PESA Prompt Enhancements for Merchants -** It improves security and reduces misuse of M-PESA payment prompts, a new safeguard has been introduced for merchant transactions.

**How it works:**

If a customer receives an M-PESA payment prompt and cancels it or does not respond, it is counted as a failed attempt. After 4 consecutive failed attempts (for example, the customer cancels the prompt 4 times or ignores it 4 times), the system will temporarily restrict further payment prompts to that customer. The 5th payment prompt will be blocked. The block remains in place for 24 hours**.**

**Note:**  The customer will then be unable to receive further prompts from the merchant for 24 hours, after which prompting can resume normally.

9. **QR Till Sticker Download -** Allows merchants to generate and download QR Till stickers directly from the app, making it easier to accept digital payments and onboard customers quickly.
10. **Scan QR via Camera -** Provides a faster and more convenient payment experience by allowing users to scan QR codes directly with their phone camera to complete transactions.
11. **OTP on Login -** Adds an extra layer of protection during login by requiring a one-time password, ensuring that only authorized users can access the account.
12. **Nominated Number (Agents) -** Enables business owners to authorize designated agents to perform transactions on their behalf, improving operational efficiency while maintaining accountability.
13. **Withdraw to Bank (iOS) -** Allows merchants to seamlessly transfer funds directly from their business account to a bank account, providing greater flexibility and control over cash flow management.
14. **Business Deposit (iOS) -** Allows agents using iOS to conveniently deposit and withdraw funds into their M-PESA business account to a different agent through the app, simplifying account funding and day-to-day financial operations.
15. **Statements Fund Types Upgrade -** Improves transaction visibility by ensuring all transaction types, including reversals and adjustments, are accurately reflected in statements for easier reconciliation.
16. **Tap to Pay Enhancement-**Merchants will now see a confirmation success screen indicating that the customer's device has been successfully tapped, providing better transaction visibility and assurance.

**Merchants with the current App version will update their Apps to enjoy the new enhancements.**

See attached document for the full benefits of the M-PESA Prompt.

# **PATA MORE na Pochi La Biashara: More Value for Every Hustle**

PATA MORE na Pochi La Biashara is a customer-focused campaign designed to deliver greater value from everyday business transactions. The campaign enhances the Pochi La Biashara proposition by combining affordable payment services with access to solutions that support the growth, stability, and financial well-being of micro and small businesses.

Through the Pochi ecosystem, customers can access credit, savings opportunities, income protection, and tailored offers, making Pochi La Biashara more than just a platform for receiving payments.

The PATA MORE na Pochi La Biashara campaign runs from **1st August 2026 to 31st October 2026**.

The Pochi Kadogo limit has been increased from KES 100 to KES 200, enabling customers to make more qualifying small-value transactions at no cost.

Offers tailored data packages designed specifically for business customers.

*"Pochi La Biashara is more than a business wallet. It helps you keep your business money separate, receive M-PESA payments conveniently, transact affordably, and access solutions that can help your business save, grow and stay protected."*

The **PATA MORE na Pochi La Biashara** campaign reinforces Pochi La Biashara as a business solution that supports entrepreneurs beyond payments. By offering affordable transactions alongside access to credit, savings, protection, and tailored offers, the campaign provides customers with practical tools to manage their finances, support business growth, and protect their income.

**Definition**

It stands for Multiprotocol label switching - MPLS is a packet-forwarding technology which uses labels to make data forwarding decisions.

MPLS is just a protocol which allows us to have visibility of the transmission of client’s traffic and we can monitor both the branches and HQs.

This means the link maybe either on **FIBER or Microwave |Ceragon** so the normal troubleshooting for fiber or Microwave |Ceragon **MUST BE DONE FIRST.**

MPLS is denoted by **172.30.**

**Advantages of MPLS**

- MPLS is cheap to deploy and very easy for expansion.
- Network Redundancy/increased response time.
- Easy and Cost-effective Expansion.
- MPLS networks can carry any type of packets – be it IP, frame relay or ATM using the same infrastructure.

stands for variable (or VPN) routing and forwarding). VRF is a technology included in IP network routers that allows multiple instances of a routing table to exist in a router and work simultaneously.

**Troubleshooting MPLS CPE using putty/tacacs.**

In this case, we will use **Nairobi women hospital Kitengela** Branch.

The link is served by the Athi River switch i.e 172.17.22.111.

Proceed to confirm connectivity: using the command ping vrf (vrf carrier) default gateway. If the default is replying, then ping the router ip.

Make sure that that the mac address of the router is picking, and link CPE parameters are ok:

If Mac address is picking and there is no packet loss when pinging the router ip advise the client to check LAN and cabling.

If there is packet loss on pinging the router ip then raise service request for issue to be addressed by second line team.

- Categories: Fiber Active
- Type: Link Failure
- Sub Types: MAC Address Found| MAC Address Not Found

**Troubleshooting MPLS CPE using NPM**

In this case, we will use Maguna-Andu whoesales Muranga branch as an example.

Login to NPM using the link: [http://npm.safaricombusiness.co.ke](http://npm.safaricombusiness.co.ke/)

Enter the client’s link name or CI under find and click search. From NPM you can get the mpls IP |the Aggregated PE for the branch in question.

From the output below we can tell that the branch is up.

 [Screenshot] 

To get ip address login to the aggregating PE which is **NAKURU** and use the command “show interface description | include AAR” or CI

ping vrf AAR\_HEALTHCARE 172.30.17.209 (AAR\_HEALTHCARE is the Mpls name and 172.30.17.209 is the ip address for the branch in question)

 [Screenshot] 

But if you can reach the gateway and client’s ip, advise client to check on LAN.

If you are unable to reach the client ip i.e., 172.30.17.210 but you can reach our gateway i.e., 172.30.17.209, then Raise a service request for 2nd Level support.

- Categories: Fiber Active
- Type: Link Failure
- Sub Types: MAC Address Found| MAC Address Not Found

**Troubleshooting MPLS from the Switch**

From NPM, search for the link name - Maguna.

Login to MURANGA-MUKUYU Aggregation PE: 172.17.22.209

Use the command **“show run vrf”**

**NB:** This command will output all the links configured for MPLS, hence the need to use the output modifier Also, you need to make sure that you get the correct MPLS name.

Use the command **“show run vrf | include Maguna”** Where Maguna is the keywords for the MPLS name you are looking for.

 [Screenshot] 

**NB: Putty is case sensitive so if in the example above we wrote MAGUNA (UPPERCASE) no results would have been found**.

Look for the exact name of the MPLS link in question as it appears in the configuration.

articleTitle: Franchise SIM Swap Journey- Fingerprint Authentication (FPA on View360)
markdownContent:
# **1\. Overview**

Fingerprint Authentication (FPA) is a secure verification step used during the SIM swap process to confirm that the person requesting a SIM replacement is the legitimate owner of the mobile number.

The solution strengthens customer protection by using the customer’s unique fingerprint identifier as an additional authentication method, reducing reliance on personal information alone and mitigating the risk of identity-based fraud.

While fingerprint authentication provides an additional security layer, the customer should present an **original valid identification document as per KYC requirements**.

Verification is completed by validating the customer’s ID details against the registration details available in the system.

This initiative plays a critical role in reducing SIM swap fraud, protecting customers from identity theft and potential financial loss, and strengthening trust across our franchise touchpoints. Through FPA, customer fingerprints are securely validated in real time against the government database, helping eliminate vulnerabilities associated with manual verification processes and enabling a safer, more seamless customer experience.

# **2\. Value of Fingerprint Authentication (FPA)**

Fingerprint Authentication transforms the SIM replacement process by delivering:

Secure verification + Faster service + Enhanced customer experience + Reduced fraud risk

FPA strengthens the SIM swap journey by providing a secure and reliable method of confirming customer identity while improving operational efficiency and reducing exposure to fraud.

**Benefits**

- Strengthens SIM swap security through enhanced customer verification.
- Protects customer mobile numbers and associated services.
- Reduces fraud exposure and potential financial losses.
- Reduces operational demand through a simplified verification process.
- Improves customer experience through a faster, seamless, and trusted service.
- Reduces customer waiting time and increases confidence and loyalty.

# **3\. Franchise User Process Flow**

**Step 1: Customer Request Initiation**

- Customer visits the franchise requesting a SIM swap.
- Franchise user confirms the customer’s request and initiates the SIM swap process on **View360**.

**Step 2: Customer Identification & KYC Verification**

- Request the customer to provide their **original valid Identification document**.
- Verify customer details against the registration information available in the system.
- Confirm that the line is registered as an **individual line**.

**Note:** 
SIM swap through fingerprint authentication is only applicable to individually registered lines.

**Step 3: Access View360 Fingerprint Authentication Journey**

**3.1 Customer Search**

- Log in to the View360 portal.
-  Search for the customer mobile number.

**3.2 Customer Authentication Option**

Inform the customer of the available SIM swap verification options:

- Fingerprint Authentication
- Secondary Vetting (QR code journey)

Allow the customer to select their preferred option.

**Customer Engagement Guide:**

***"Hello! To make your SIM swap more secure, we offer optional fingerprint verification. You may also continue with the standard verification if you prefer. Would you like to use fingerprint verification today?"***

**3.3 Initiate SIM Swap**

- Select the SIM swap service from account overview under quick actions.
- The system performs automated SIM swap pre-checks and results displayed as below: -

✅ **Green – Pass**: Proceed with Fingerprint Authentication SIM Swap process: \[Refer to the **Table 1: ALL PRECHECKS PASSED below** on how to process the Finger Authentication SIM Swap\]

❌ **Red – Requires Investigation:** Follow failed pre-check handling process \[Refer to **Table 2: FAILED PRECHECKS below** on how to process the Finger Authentication SIM Swap\]

**Step 4: Fingerprint Authentication Process**

**4.1 Device Setup**

-  Ensure the fingerprint dongle is connected.
- Confirm the correct dongle serial number is detected on the device.

If the device is not detected, the system displays: **“No fingerprint scanner detected”**

**4.2 Capture Fingerprint**

Click **Start** to initiate fingerprint scanning.

Guide the customer to place the correct finger on the scanner as instructed on the screen.

The system allows:

- 5 fingerprint attempts per session
- 3 sessions allowed
- Total maximum attempts: 15

**4.3 Fingerprint Scan Indicators**

**Blinking green light:** Device ready for fingerprint capture.

Follow system prompts for the registered finger.

Ensure correct finger placement during scanning.

**4.4 System Verification**

- Captured fingerprint is matched against official government records.
- System provides authentication outcome.

**Step 5: Fingerprint Validation Outcomes**

Successful Authentication

**Definition:** 
Customer fingerprint successfully matches the registered record.

**Action:**

1. Proceed with SIM swap completion.
2. Capture customer interaction.
3. No document upload required.

**Successful Authentication:**

- Proceed with SIM swap completion.
- Confirm successful activation to the customer.

**Start key/M-PESA Start Key PIN Requests After Fingerprint Authentication SIM Swap**

·       The Franchise agent will send the start key after successful Fingerprint Authentication SIM swap where the M-PESA account was blocked, or customer does not remember their PIN.

·       The Franchise agent is required to advise the customer on the activation procedure, PIN change procedure and educate the customer on the importance of keeping their PIN a secret.

**NOTE**: You will no longer need to refer customer to retail for start key after doing a SIM swap using Fingerprint Authentication.

**Failed Authentication:**

- Validate fingerprint quality and retry where applicable.
- If authentication continues to fail, follow the approved exception process and request the required registered documents as per guidelines.

**Prechecks Outcomes, Fingerprint verification outcome Scenarios & Vetting criteria**

# **Table 1: ALL PRECHECKS PASSED**

| Scenario | Fingerprint verification Definition / Condition | Action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| All pre-checks passed   Fingerprint authentication required – Successful Match | Customer successfully authenticated through fingerprint verification. | 1. Proceed with SIM swap.2. Capture interaction.No document upload required. |
| All Prechecks passed Fingerprint authentication required– Fingerprint Mismatch | Fingerprint record exists, but the captured fingerprint does not match the customer’s fingerprint.ORCustomer declines to use fingerprint verification service. | Use the secondary vetting QR Code journey to verify and assist the customer. |
| All pre-checks passedFingerprint Authentication required – No Fingerprint Found | No fingerprint record exists for the customer | Use the secondary vetting QR code journey to vet and assist the customer |
| All pre-checks passedFingerprint Authentication required – Poor Fingerprint Quality | Fingerprint captured, but the quality is insufficient for successful matching | Use the secondary vetting QR Code journey for customer vetting. |
| All pre-checks passedFingerprint Authentication required – Expired Session | Session times out before fingerprint validation is completed. | Retry and restart fingerprint capture. |

# **Table 2: FAILED PRECHECKS****:**

| Scenario | Outcome | Action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| One or more SIM swap pre-checks fail | System identifies the following failed pre-check conditions: Line is not prepaid, and the credit limit is KES 10,000 or belowLine is not onLine has not been active on the network for at least 24 hours. | Where any of the three listed pre-checks fail, proceed with the Fingerprint Authentication (FPA) journey only. 1. If the fingerprint authentication matches, proceed with the SIM swap process. 2. Where fingerprint authentication does not proceed successfully due to any of the following:No MatchNo fingerprint existsWhere fingerprint authentication fails for any other reason- refer to retail |
| If one or more of the following SIM Swap pre-checks fail: | Customer Line is roaming.Customer Line is on High Alert.Customer's line is Golden.Customer's line is Regulated. | Refer the customer to the nearest Retail Shop for further assistance. |
| Customer document type is not National ID | SIM swap request cannot proceed | Advise the customer to visit a Retail shop for assistance. |
| Customer selects QR Code journey instead of Fingerprint Authentication | Customer prefers the alternative QR Code verification journey | Proceed with the QR Code journey on View360. |

# **NOTE: Franchise User Responsibilities**

Franchise users must:

✓ Verify customer identity before processing SIM swap✓ Ensure KYC requirements are met✓ Use View360 fingerprint authentication correctly✓ Protect customer information and maintain confidentiality✓ Escalate any system challenges through the approved support channels

**Definition**

This is a calling plan that allows customers to **Create** or **Join** a closed calling group and enjoy affordable calls within that group once the plan is active.

The plan supports Safaricom’s focus on in-bundle usage and improved customer value.

# **How it works**

A customer **Creates** or **Joins** a group, pays the applicable joining fee/plan fee, and then enjoys the Community Plan calling benefits with other active members of the group.

# **Opt In**

**\*444\*55# will be used on pilot and** \*444# will be used by all customers once the product is opened to all customers.

Dial **\*444#ok** and choose CUG to Create, Join, and Manage Groups (Admin Role) – see attached user journeys.

# **Charges and Plans**

Active members within the CUG **will call each other for free after subscribing to the respective plans.**

The plan will be available in below validity options:

Daily@20 Ksh.

Weekly@100Ksh, and

Monthly@350Ksh

A joining fee (equivalent to the selected plan) **must be paid by each member before you can start enjoying CUG calls**.

**NOTE:** **When joining a Weekly or Monthly Plan, the joining member may choose to join the Daily or Weekly plan without affecting how the main group works.**

Calls for active members within the groups are free.

For members in a Community Plan **with active subscriptions**, **on-net calls** made outside the group will be billed at **KSh.2 per minute**, while **off-net calls (to other networks)** will be billed at **Ksh 4.67**.

For Members in a Community Plan with **expired/inactive subscriptions**, on-net and off-net calls made outside the group will be billed at KSh4.67 per minute. 

# **Eligibility**

It will be available for all customers.

# **Unsubscribe and Delete Member**

Unsubscribe option is only availed to customers with an auto renew plan.

Once customer unsubscribes, plan deletes and customer is billed outside CUG rates.

A customer who has unsubscribed can also purchase another one-off plan to enjoy the CUG rates.

Delete Member is only availed to the group admin.

# **Business Rules**

Each group must have a minimum of at least two members.

A customer can join a maximum of five Community Plan groups once invited by the admin.

When a member is deleted/exited from a group, they can rejoin the group after midnight i.e if a member with an active plan exited, they can't rejoin the same group on the same day.

# **Active and Inactive Community**

The group can be maintained even when inactive.

When a group becomes inactive, making a payment activates it again. You don’t lose members. 

CRM Interactions and SRs will be logged under: ***CUG Community Plan*** Type and Category respectively.

myGroups enables members to do the following:
