markdownContent:
** [Screenshot] **

# **Definition**

M-PESA GlobalPay Virtual Visa Card is a card which is enabled through a partnership between M-PESA and VISA and will enable M-PESA Customers to obtain visa credentials for online payments globally at online merchant outlets.

M-PESA GlobalPay Virtual Visa Card takes out the need to have a bank account to have a card, and therefore make global payments.

**NOTE:** The VISA credentials are attached to their M-PESA wallet. 

#  **Eligibility**

This service will exclusively be offered to all M-PESA registered customers.

A customer will only be eligible for one card per ID.

The service will only be accessible through one registered mobile number. For a customer to change to a new mobile number they will be required to first cancel the card and opt out of the service and activate afresh.

# **How to Activate**

M-PESA GlobalPay card services are available and can be activated via My OneApp.

[https://bit.ly/4adsvBq](https://bit.ly/4adsvBq)

Log in to your My OneApp.

Select Pay Tab

Select M-PESA GlobalPay

**OR**

Log in to My OneAPP.

Select the Grow Tab.

Select the application tab, to activate your M-PESA GlobalPay service.

Select your card colour.

Enter PIN

You will receive your card details – PAN, Expiry & CVV. 

**Note**: The USSD journey for GlobalPay was discontinued and customers can only transact via My OneApp. Any customer that selects the GlobalPay menu on USSD (\*334\*6\*5#) will receive the SMS shown below:

**Dear Customer, for enhanced security, M-PESA GlobalPay card services are no longer available on \*334#. To access them, use M-PESA APP** [https://bit.ly/4adsvBq](https://bit.ly/4adsvBq "https://bit.ly/4adsvbq").

**Viewing of** **M-PESA GlobalPay details** **on** **My OneApp**

Log in to My One App.

From the Grow tab select M-PESA GlobalPay

Select show card details.

Enter M-PESA PIN

Your card details will be displayed on the screen in the Card Format. (PAN, Expiry & CVV)

# **How It Works**

**Note:** This is a virtual card that will be accessed through the One App only and thus a customer will **NOT** be issue with a physical card.

Customers will opt into the M-PESA GlobalPay Product and will be required to agree to the terms and conditions to view card details and access other available services.

There will be a one-to-one mapping of M-PESA GlobalPay to per M-PESA Customer’s MSISDN. The service will only be accessible through a customers’ unique MSISDN.

The PAN will comprise of a 6-digit BIN **498705** and 10 randomly generated digits within a pre-defined range.

The card includes a 16-digit card number, the expiry date (mm/yy) of the card, and the security code also referred to as CVV.

Card detail notifications will be through a Flash SMS

# **Maximum & Minimum Transaction**

The M-PESA customer limits will apply i.e., the minimum amount of Ksh 1/= and a maximum of Ksh 250,000 per transaction with a maximum transaction limit of Ksh 500,000 per day.

**NOTE:** The minimum amount will change based on the prevailing USD – KES rate.

# **Charge Services**

Safaricom will apply a markup of 3.5% on the transaction value at the prevailing forex rate for international payments.

This service charge will be based on the exchange rate of the billing currency (Ksh) to the currency used at the time of purchase e.g. (USD, GBP, etc.)

There will be no other charge such as the M-PESA transaction fee.

With the opening up of domestic payments, we have merchants who might route the transaction through a domestic gateway, hence no Forex markup. However, if they route the transaction through an international gateway, the markup will apply.

We are not however able to control how they route their transactions, therefore a customer may at times get two scenarios for the same payment as described below.

| Scenario | Sample SMS notification |
| --- | --- |
| Customer pays for SPOTIFY, and it's routed via an international gateway, the payment will be processed in with a forex markup. | Dear ANDREW, a transaction of Ksh. 350.87 (inclusive of Ksh. 11.87 forex charge) done at Spotify P3F9252194       Stockholm    SE has been approved on your card ****0098. If not yours suspend your card and call line 100 or 200 for assistance. |
| Customer pays for SPOTIFY, and it's routed via a domestic gateway, the payment will be processed in without a forex markup. | Dear ANDREW, a transaction UCLMRA3YSI of Ksh. 419.00 (inclusive of Ksh. 0.00 charge) done at Paystack-Ebake-Spotify   +254711577577KE has been approved on your card ****0098. If not yours, suspend your card and contact us for assistance via; X (Safaricom_Care, SafaricomPLC), Facebook (SafaricomPLC), or by calling 100 or 200. |

# **Online Merchant Sites payments**

A customer cannot pay using the M\-PESA GlobalPay Visa virtual card on any online merchant site but can pay using M-PESA GlobalPay to international online merchants such as Netflix, Amazon, AliExpress, etc.

For local merchants e.g., Jumia, customers will use the Lipa na M-PESA, Buy Goods option. For a transaction initiated by a local merchant, the M-PESA Customer will receive an appropriate message on the checkout option.

Some merchant categories are restricted on M-PESA GlobalPay Virtual Visa card e.g., gaming, gambling, money transfer services, and cryptocurrency.

#  **Receiving Money on M-PESA GlobalPay Visa virtual card**

A customer cannot receive money on the card as it does not hold money. It can only be used to make international payments.

The M-PESA Wallet is what holds the funds.

# **Fuliza** **Services**

Eligible M-PESA customers can use their Fuliza overdraft facility for card-based transactions made through the GlobalPay Virtual Visa Card. The service is designed to support customers when they have insufficient funds in their M-PESA wallet, enabling smoother and more convenient digital payments.

The service is accessible through the GlobalPay Mini App available on My OneApp.

# **Eligibility**

The service is only available to customers who meet the following conditions:

- Must already be opted in to the Fuliza service
- Have an approved Fuliza limit

# **Opt-In Process**

To activate the service, customers are required to opt in through the GlobalPay Mini App. During the process, customers must:

- Accept the applicable terms and conditions
- Validate the request using their M-PESA PIN

# **Service Availability and Usage**

The service supports:

- One-time card payments
- Recurring or repeat subscription payments

Once a customer has accepted the Fuliza on Card terms and conditions, no additional PIN or verification will be required for subsequent one-time or recurring card transactions that utilize the overdraft facility.

# **Transaction Charges**

For transactions processed using Fuliza on GlobalPay, the deducted amount from the customer wallet will include:

- The transaction amount
- A 3.5% forex markup
- Applicable Fuliza charges 

**Card Balances**

The M-PESA GlobalPay will not store balances but will mirror M-PESA account balances.

 **Card Dormancy**

A card will become dormant if it is not used for a period of 6 months. however, a customer can activate directly from the M-PESA App.

 **Expiry & Validity**

- The card validity is 3 years after which it will be cancelled/permanently deactivated in the system. Customers will need to activate a new card to continue making online payments.
- A customer will be informed at least 4 times before the card expires in intervals of   1 month, 7 days, 3 days and 1 day to expiry. 

**Card Reactivation**

Customers can reactivate a cancelled card 4 times in 12 months. Also, if a customer needs reactivation more than 4 times within 12 months, it can always reset on need basis through an SR.

NOTE: MPESA Global service has changed to International Transfers

# **Definition**

M-PESA Global is a service that enables M-PESA registered customers to send and receive money globally.

# **Eligibility**

The Service is open to all active M-PESA registered users.

# **M-PESA Global Service availability**

- M-PESA customers will be able to send funds.
- To East Africa: Rwanda, Tanzania, Uganda, Botswana and Burundi
- To millions of Bank accounts. For Banks service is currently available in 68 countries including Germany, China, and UAE.
- To over 500,000 Western Union locations globally. This service is available in all countries except sanctioned countries e.g., North Korea and Syria.

# **Minimum/Maximum amount to transfer**

The minimum amount to send is Kshs101 and maximum of Ksh 250,000 per transaction as per normal M-PESA limits.

# **Hakikisha Service Unavailability**

Since Recipient records are not in M-PESA data base, Hakikisha will not work.

**Knowing the amount to send:**

The Recipient will receive the amount the sender sent since the system will verify all charges and forex exchange real time.

Customer can use cost estimator on both My Safaricom App and the USSD view the charges.

**Country ISO.**

- Only used when sending to Western Union Location from the USSD.
- These are shortened names of the countries where Western Union operates.
- These are usually a 2-letter abbreviation for country names e.g., ZA for South Africa, TD for Chad, KE for Kenya, UG, TZ, etc. ISO may not always be the first two letters of the country name.
- List of ISO countries where Western Union Operates. ***List attached.***

# **M-PESA Global Sending charges**

Applicable Western Union Send to Bank and Location

| Min | Max | Charge Tariff (KES) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 101 | 5000 | 100 |
| 5001 | 15000 | 250 |
| 15001 | 35000 | 350 |
| 35001 | 250000 | 500 |

**NOTE:** The Recipients will be charged for withdrawal on their home network.

# **M-PESA Global Receiving mechanics**

**Funds availability**

- Funds sent to mobile and western union locations are available for collection within minutes of being sent.
- Funds sent to Banks are subject to timelines defined by the destination country & banking rules. Sender may ask the Recipient to enquire with their bank.
- Currency received**:** The recipient will receive funds in their country’s currency.

**M-PESA Global Failure to collect.**

- **Collection of funds If ID is lost****:** Recipient to enquire if alternative documents are allowed e.g. Abstract document. Where not allowed, the sender will request for a reversal.
- **When recipient fails to collect funds:** Sender can request for reversal to be done. M-PESA transaction fee is not refundable. If not collected after 9 months, it will automatically be handed over to Safaricom.

# **M-PESA Global Partnership.**

**Receiving funds from Abroad through M-PESA.**

Safaricom and several money transfers services have partnered to ensure that it will not cost customers a cent to receive money from US, UK, Europe, and UAE. These partners are:

- Western Union
- Homesend
- Thunes
- WorldRemit
- MFS.

# **Charges to receive funds.**

There is no charge to the recipient for receiving funds via M-PESA, but all normal M-PESA charges will subsequently apply i.e., to send money, withdraw cash etc.

# **Time taken for funds to reflect.**

The funds should reach Customer immediately once the money has been sent.

# **International Transfers (M-PESA Global) Reversal Process**

# **Western Union** (Sending to a Western Union agent or Bank account)

A customer/sender may request for a reversal for a Western Union transaction for below reasons.

- Receiver has left destination country
- Western Union are unable to amend the name details.
- Regulatory and compliance issues as advised by Western Union.
- Customer has already sent the amount again and needs current one reversed.

# **Process**

- Escalate via an SR to the support team indicating the transaction number and reason for reversal and advise the customer on 72hrs SLA.
- Support Analyst on receiving the SR shall confirm reversal via Western Union system or via call to Western Union or send an email to -emeaapac.agentsupport@westernunion.com and africaapnsupport@westernunion.com capturing details of M-PESA transaction I.D, MTCN number, date and reason for reversal.
- Only analysts who have been assigned agent IDs by Western Union will be able to send a query to western union. Those without, will have to raise an SR.
- The Support Analyst assigned the ticket shall track and follow up the progress of the reversal, once resolved, advise the customer as per resolution.

# **Funds availability**

- Funds sent to Mobile and Western Union locations are available for collection within minutes of being sent.
- Funds sent to Banks are subject to timelines defined by the destination country & banking rules. This ranges from 2-5 working days. Sender may ask the recipient to enquire with their bank.
- Currency received: The recipient will receive funds in their country’s currency.
- Funds withdrawn from a Vodacom agent in Tanzania by roaming customers (Roaming Pick-up) are available to be received within minutes

# **Reversals for transactions sent to a mobile number**

This service is supported by different partners.

- Onafriq (Uganda & Rwanda)
- Thunes (Tanzania,Burundi, Botswana, Congo, Malawi & Zambia)
- TerraPay (Pakistan & Bangladesh)
- Ethiopia (Not supported by a partner. We have a direct integration)

# **1st Line**

A customer/sender may request for a reversal for the below reasons.

- Sent money to a wrong number.
- Funds not received.
- Recipient unable to withdraw.

Confirm the transaction on G3 to confirm the transaction status and escalate the issue via an SR to the support team indicating.

- The transaction number.
- Date
- Paybill number used.
- Reason for the reversal.

The SR SLA is 72hrs.

# **2nd Line**

- The Support Analyst upon receiving the SR shall Log into the respective partner's portal to confirm the transaction status and if successful send the transaction number to the respective partner and advise them to reverse the transaction and update the notes on the SR.
- Where funds are not available, the partner will advise that funds have been withdrawn, the Support Analyst shall advise the customer and close the SR.
- Where funds are still available, the partner will initiate the refund and advise the Analyst to refund the sender. To process the refund, the Support Analyst will go to the partner's short code on G3 and initiate a reversal, a checker will complete the reversal.
- Where the transaction status is pending or failed in the partner portal, the Support Analyst shall send an Email to the IMT partner to advice on the action to be taken, whether to refund or not.
- Once feedback is given by the IMT partner, the Support Analyst will advise the customer as per resolution and close the SR.
- Once the reversal is done (for available funds or pending transaction) the Support Analyst will send the linked reversal transaction ID to the partner, advise the customer and close the SR.

# **IMT Partner contacts**

- Thunes: support@thunes.com
- Onafriq: support@onafriq.com
- Western Union: africaapnsupport@westernunion.com, emeaapac.agentsupport@westernunion.com
- Terrapay: operations@terrapay.com
- Ethiopia: m-pesacustomersopsteam@safaricom.et

articleTitle: Subscriber registration at Safaricom Shop/ Retail Outlets
markdownContent:
**Subscriber Registration, APP user creation at Safaricom shops**

- Applicable to Safaricom retail shop, care desks and franchise stores.
- Safaricom registration on the APP will be done by users created via a web portal managed by the dealer management team within RSO.
- Dealer management team will be given access by the IT team to manage onboarding of the managers or Team leaders.
- Dealer management team will use the portal for creation of Safaricom shop managers and Team leaders.
- The managers and TL’s will subsequently create users (CEE’s/ contract staff) within their respective shops / stores and /or care desks.
- The users (Manager / TL) requesting for creation will be required to send an email to the email folder subregescalations@safaricom.co.ke, with the following details:

Name as is on ID

ID number

Personal Mobile Number

M-PESA till number, under which the manager / TL is created

Phone IMEI to be whitelisted, this will also include the CEE devices to be used where applicable

Shop / Care desk name

Region

- Shop manager / TL will download the APP from Play store on the approved whitelisted device(s) for Subreg. Team will source for the devices in liaison with the inventory and financials team as per applicable processes.
- Once created, the manager / TL will receive an OTP code for use to log in to the Partner APP.
- The shop manager / TL will be required to log in within 5 minutes of receipt of the OTP, otherwise the same will expire.
- Where password expires, the users will then be required to reset their password on the APP to get a new OTP via SMS.
- Where users experience a challenge, they will escalate to subregescalations@safaricom.co.ke for resolution. They will share details including error noted.
- The manager / TL will log in with the OTP and create a 5-digit numeric password of their choice.
- Manager / TL will then proceed to create the users.
- The manager / TL will specify the user’s role. This will define the user’s permission, system accessibility and usability.
- Safaricom CEE’s will be created under the role Shop Agents with M-PESA.
- Authorized contractors will be created by the respective Safaricom manager / TL, under role Shop agents without M-PESA.
- Where user is granted access for M-PESA registration, creator will enter the shop till number where the user is created and their MSISDN.
- Where CEE is created for subscriber registration without M-PESA, the creator will enter the user MSISDN.
- Users will download the APP via play store on approved whitelisted devices for subscriber registration.
- Where device is not whitelisted, TL/manager will request via email to subregescalations@safaricom.co.ke for whitelist of the device. And will include details of the user i.e. full name, EK number, device IMEI, user personal MSISDN, staff business postpaid line (on the allocated tablet) and shop.
- User will log in to the whitelisted device using their mobile number and OTP received during creation. The user will then be prompted to change the PIN and proceed to log in.
- The user needs to ensure that they log into the device onto which they are mapped to.
- The OTP received will be valid for 5 min. If the OTP expires the CEE will click on reset PIN, enter the mobile number and national ID used to register to reset on the App.
- Where users experience a challenge in setting or resetting their PIN, they will escalate to subregescalations@safaricom.co.ke for resolution. They will share details including error noted.
- After successful creation and activation, CEE will register customers as per customer request and applicable guidelines.
- Where user changes shop, the team leader / manager will be required to share via email to sub reg team, via subregescalations@Safaricom.co.ke . They will include details of the user i.e. full name, EK number, device IMEI, user personal MSISDN, MP and new shop.

**M-PESA VALIDATION AFTER REGISTRATION**

customers will be allowed to access the GSM services having successfully submitted required KYC documentation for registration. Where validations are still ongoing, the agent will get a notification that the M-PESA registration is pending **validation** and will be activated **within 24hrs**. The customer will not be required to go back to the agent. The M-PESA registration will be progressed once validation is completed.

The message that will be displayed on Partner App for the registering agents is:

***Dear Agent, after successful Line Registration, the customer will access all the other services*** 

***except M-PESA which will be available within 24 hours.***

 Initial PIN for newly registered M-PESA for the very first time is **0000** and customer can change to preferred PIN immediately.

**Dormant accounts**

Dormant accounts will cease operation and for reactivation requests, the team leader / manager will be required to request for activation on email to sub reg team, via subregescalations@Safaricom.co.ke. They will include details of the user i.e. full name, EK number, device IMEI, user personal MSISDN, and shop.

**Subscriber registration at the Safaricom retail shop/care desks and F****ranchise stores**

Subscriber registration is mandatory for all SIM Cards on the Safaricom network.

To purchase and register a Safaricom SIM card, a customer must present valid registration documents. The user must authenticate the validity of document presented.

**Registration for Foreigners**

For foreigners presenting passports for registration. CEE will confirm entry stamps on the passport and that the visa is not expired.

The following documents will be applicable for subscriber registration. The customer will be required to present either of the below documents:

**Required Documentation**

**Individuals: Adult Kenyan Citizen**

- Original and valid Kenyan national ID Card. (1st and 2nd generation ID)
- Original and valid Kenyan passport (ordinary and diplomatic passports).
- Maisha card (3rd generation ID)
- Original and valid military ID (The national ID card number will be captured during registration) The above will be subjected to IPRS check and validation.

**Individual foreigners**

- Original and valid Foreigners certificate (formerly known as Alien ID card)
- Original and valid Refugee ID.
- Valid passport (ordinary and diplomatic passports) IPRS validation will be done for foreigner certificate and refugee ID’s. No IPRS validation will be done for foreign passport. Authentication of validity of applicable documents must be done by the agent doing the registration. 

**Note:** **The United Nations Laissez - Passer is not eligible for SIM Card Registration.**

Customers should be advised to avail a valid national passport as per regulations.

**Minors**

- Under law, minors have no capacity to enter into a contract. As such Minors are on boarded upon obtaining the parental / guardian consent.
- As such the minors’ line(s) are registered using the documentation of a parent / guardian.
- Parent / guardian will present any of the acceptable registration documents applicable for subscriber registration as above for adults.
- Minor’s original Birth certificate. Applicable registration process will apply.

**Note that a Minor’s passport (local or foreign) is not an acceptable document for registration.**

**Registration of Organizations Lines**

**Corporates**

Corporates will be required to present **One of the below (a legally certified COPY (stamped by commissioner of oath/Notary or Advocate)**

- Certificate of incorporation and a **copy** of original national identity card or passport of at least one director.
- Certificate of registration and **copy** of original national identity card or passport of the proprietor or at least one partner as the case may be.
- Enabling Legislation or Gazette Notice – for government ministries, parastatals, embassies, UN, and regional bodies.  
- Letter from the Ministry of foreign affairs confirming requesting embassy is approved/recognized in Kenya, for embassies. 
- Trust Deed.
- Act of parliament. 

For the **Mandatory** documents, the following are required:

1. CR12 (Not older than 3 months) with official stamp **or** the equivalent based on the details on the  registration document. 
2. KRA PIN Certificate (with official stamp)

And **ONE** from the two below;

1. A **signed** letter with an **official seal** from the company requesting registration on the company’s letterhead
2. A **signed** letter with an **official stamp** from the business requesting registration on the business’s letterhead

**For more details, refer to article** **[CKPL-0004: SUB REG KYC DOCUMENTS](../../app/article/4e8516ec-284f-4f53-8b92-d5f3a1dfb5fc)**  

**Safaricom owned lines**

Lines owned by Safaricom i.e. company lines, Staff business lines, Lipa na Mpesa tills etc. will be registered using the company details i.e. Certificate of Registration, document ID 8/2002 and company postal address i.e. 66827, 00800.

**Individual adult subscriber registration process at Safaricom Premises**

**This is applicable to Safaricom retail shops, care desks and franchise stores.**

- To be registered, customers will present acceptable original and valid registration documents.
- All foreigners will be registered at Safaricom Retail outlets, Care desks and Franchise shop.
- Registration will be done on the Partner App for all individual registrations with the exemption of corporate lines; to be registered either via the corporate DSA portal.
- Registration of pooled and deleted recreated lines for previous and new users, will be registered via the Jiandikishe portal by the Support analyst.
- For any other exemptions’ teams will request for approval by the AML team via Analytica.
- Registration with foreign passports is capped to 2 lines on GSM and M-PESA.
- CEE / Contracted staff will log in to the Partner APP. They will have 2 options. Either select the scan button as a short cut or select the presented document type. 
- For Military ID, the short cut button will not be applicable.
- The CEE /Contracted staff will scan the presented documents for the APP to automatically capture the customer details.
- The details should be captured accurately when registering, as per the applicable requirements on the APP.
- Where a customer has more than three names, the additional middle names will be captured in the middle name field. i.e. The system will capture customer’s “First Name” and the “Last Name” under their respective slots and put the other names under the “Middle Name” slot.
- In cases where the customer has an apostrophe on their names, the agent will need to add this manually once scanned.
- Where customer is registered with two names, the system will capture the two customer names under “First Name” and the “Last Name” slots and leave a space under the “Middle Name” slot.
- Where the ID DOB reads 00.00. YEAR or YEAR only – The agent will input 01.01. YEAR. Where the customer was born in the first half of the year (Jan-Jun) and 31.12. YEAR where the customer is born in the second half of the year (Jul-Dec).
- Where this fails IPRS validation, user will submit this to AML team via Analytica for validation and confirmation of customer details i.e. DOB, names, ID details etc.
- The names and ID will be subjected to IPRS check for verification for Kenyan documents, refugee ID and Foreigner Certificates.
- CEE will guide customers on number allocation and will select an MSISDN via the DSA on the Partner APP. Numbers will be availed in the system and agents will link the numbers with special SIMEX serials known as Your Number Choice – YNC. (DSA SIMEX)
- The agent will then pair the special DSA SIMEX with the number selected to trigger registration and activation.
- The MSISDN’s on DSA will be available for three minutes. In case this time elapses before selection, the CEE will click on refresh to get other MSISDNs.
- There will be no limit capped for local documents for registrations at the retail shops and care desks. However, for retail, care desks and franchise users to be able to register an ID that has been registered on the system more than 5 times, registration of military ID and foreign passports, the CEE must have the role - Shop Agent with M-PESA on the Partner App.
- Where any suspicious activities are noted, CEE will act as per the AML guidelines.
- Where during trouble shooting CEE identifies a fraudulently registered line, CEE will proceed to suspend as per existing irregular registration guidelines.
- During SIM registration, the CEE will have the option to select for M-PESA registration or not, based on applicable guidelines, access granted during creation and customer’s request.
- The subscriber consent procedure will apply. Upon submission, the system will check and confirm if the ID presented has another line registered under it. If so, the customer will get an SMS prompt requesting them to approve/reject the registration.
- Where approved, the registration will complete successfully. The customer will be advised to top up or activate a bundle. They will then receive a start key and proceed to activate M-PESA, where applicable.
- Where approval for registration is not granted, the user will receive a notification informing them that the registration has failed.
- The maximum number of lines that can be registered on M-PESA is five (5) for both Kenyan nationals and for foreign nationals.
- Where Merged registration option is chosen (GSM + M-PESA), customer will accept the terms and conditions and both agent and customer will sign on the App. No manual forms/ signatures will be required as both agent and customer will sign on the device.
- Where registration for M-PESA is done via M-PESA STK tool kit, customer will be required to fill in the applicable forms, as per the M-PESA procedures.
- Where customer requests for recreation of pooled or deleted numbers. CEE/SA will register customer on Jiandikishe portal after recreation of the line as per the number management procedure.
- CEE/SA will confirm registration on Jiandikishe, where customer details are not available, SA will confirm customer details as per the subscriber registration form and customer ID/ written request/ KYC on the recreation SR and register accordingly.
- CEE/SA will attach the applicable documents on the Jiandikishe portal and will advise customer on activation process. Where line is registered on Jiandikishe, SA will confirm Siebel CRM registration details and will update accordingly on Siebel CRM.
- SA will ensure they capture accurate customer details as per KYC presented and will advise customer accordingly.

**Minor registration**

**This is only applicable at retail outlets.**

- Under law, minors have no capacity to enter into a contract. As such Minors are on boarded upon obtaining the parental / guardian consent.
- The parent / guardian will present any of the acceptable registration documents applicable for subscriber registration for adults.
- To register, CEE will select the enter details tab on the Partner App.
- The CEE will accurately capture guardians / parents applicable ID details as per prompts on the App and capture registration as a minor.
- CEE will capture the details and photo of the guardian/parent as per the required fields.
- CEE will capture the details of the minor and capture a photo of the minor’s birth certificate.
- CEE will proceed to select the desired MSISDN via DSA and complete the registration process.
- MSISDN’s registered for minors will not be registered on M-PESA.
- Registration on Partner App portal will bear details of the guardian / parent, in addition to the minors’ names.

**Corporates registration via Partner App web portal**

This is applicable to registration of corporates, recreated numbers and any other as authorized by the AML team.

- For corporates, CEE will register line either on Partner App portal or corporate DSA web portal.
- CEE will validate customer KYC and confirm accuracy in application request i.e. subscriber application form or written request as per applicable KYC.
- CEE will manually enter the number to be registered and will ensure accuracy in capturing customer information.
- CEE will stamp, scan the applicable documents and will attach on the portal after successful registration.
- CEE will advise customer on activation process.
- CEE will file customer documents as per applicable process.

**Corporates DSA web portal**

This process is applicable for bulk or single registration of corporate customers, using the corporate DSA web portal.

- Creation of users will be done by digital IT team (DE).
- Application for access will be done via BMC by stock controller, TL, manager or CEE. Applicable access is the Jiandikishe corporate bulk.
- Subsequent approvals and granting of accesses will apply.
- User will validate customer KYC and confirm accuracy in application request i.e. subscriber application form or written request as per applicable KYC.
- User will check if the customer exists on CRM by querying the documents presented. Where customer exists user will proceed with registration on the portal.
- Where customer does not exist, user will create the customer in CRM and proceed to register on the portal.
- User will ensure the exact document, name and identification number is captured on the portal, as is in CRM for the details to sync.
- User will upload the scanned documents (PDF or JPG) on the web portal. User will scan DSA Simex or upload excel file containing Simexes in complete format.
- User will submit the request and will be enabled to export the report with lines and paired Simex.
- For any failed pairing, user will upload new Simex and resubmit to fulfil customer request.
- CEE / user will advise customer on activation process i.e. topping up the line.
- CEE / user will file customer documents as per applicable process.

articleTitle: Top Up Mechanics at the Contact Centre and Retail Centre
markdownContent:
**Authorized Airtime**

Authorized airtime on M-PESA system should **NOT** be Completed or Cancelled, regardless of whether it has interfaced on Siebel CRM or not.

Apologize to the customer and escalate the issue via SR as below.

·       Category: M-PESA Services

·       Type: Authorized Transactions

·       Item: Purchase Airtime.

·       SLA: 48 Hours

**Errors and Exemptions**

·       Money not deducted from airtime balance, but M-PESA is credited: Escalate via the M-PESA airtime reversal link, Advice on SLA of 2hrs.

·       Money deducted from Airtime, but M-PESA is not credited: Escalate via the M-PESA Airtime reversal link. Advice on SLA of 2hrs.

**CDRs not updated.**

·       **Airtime bought for self:** - CEE will advise the customer to forward SMS to 456 i.e. use DIY reversal option.

·       Airtime bought for other: - CEE will escalate via the M-PESA Airtime reversal link.

·       If a customer buys airtime via mobile banking from any bank/vendor/agency, we do not reverse neither does the bank/vendor/agency reverse.

·       The support team will run a report every hour of all airtime reversals done and manually remove all promotional resources.

**How to Handle Sambaza Airtime Failure**

·       Confirm if the following are correct.

·       The customer has used the correct format; you can provide alternative Sambaza methods.

·       The minimum amount of airtime balance on the senders account after transfer will be Ksh.5

·       The recipient number is a Prepay account or a Postpay hybrid line. A Prepay line cannot Sambaza to a Post Pay account.

·       Confirm the customer has not reached a maximum of Ksh10, 000 daily transfers.

·       Confirm if there is a system outage communicated from the escalation folders.

·       The recipient’s number must be either in active or expired Status

·       If everything is ok and customer cannot sambaza, Escalate for further investigation.

**Over scratched Procedure**

·   This procedure applies where voucher pin is not visible to the customer after having been scratched wrongly except for Pinless Vouchers and HR vouchers usually given to staff that do not require any physical scratching. Educate customers not to use Sharp objects when scratching the card.

·       CEE Call Centre will top-up the voucher on behalf of the customer where customer gives the correct serial number for the top up for amounts Less than or equal to 100 in value. Retail staff can top up all scratch- cards irrespective of the denominations as they can confirm physically the card is genuine by seeing the card before doing the top.

**Before doing an over scratched, Call Centre will do the following checks.**

·       Top up can only be made to the same number the customer has used to call us. Customers should not be guided to call with a different number. 

·       No other over\- scratched top-up is made within the last sixty (60) days to customer’s line. (CRM Embedded Rule)

·       That the customer’s line has been on Safaricom network for at least 30 days. (CRM Embedded Rule).

·       Confirm the number is not in a defined prison site or over \-scratched hotspot. Do not top up Lines in fraudster Location or over scratched hotspot.

·       There should be no two or more interactions for over\-scratched within the same month whether a card was topped up or not on the calling number.

·       Query the range of vouchers and if all of them from the range of ( -15 and + 15) to the one being reported as over scratched  are in active status or some serials in the range are missing, do not lock the card as over\- scratched; refer the customer to visit retail or care desk so that the card is validated before being topped up.

·       In the event customer provides wrong value of the card for over \-scratched, e.g., sub calls with card of say Ksh.10 but on CRM card reads Ksh.20 Customer should be referred to nearest retail and Care-desk with the physical card for validation.

·       If card is active and of the value Kshs.5 to Kshs.100 the CEE, proceeds to top up the card using the over \-scratched procedure.

·       For any of the scenarios above where the CEE is unable to top up for the customer a valid card, kindly refer the customer to visit retail or care desk with the physical card so that the card is validated before being topped up.

·       To top up a card, CEE accesses the over\- scratched under task button on Siebel. Customer must give number to be topped up, CEE must verify the number as given by the customer by verbalizing it before creating a task on Siebel. Upon authentication, CEE will initiate an over\- scratched task on Siebel so that an auto top-up of the same value of the over  scratch is made to the subscriber main account.

·       A text message will be received by the customer upon successful top up, CEE should advise the customer the voucher has been topped up, and retrying loading will red card the line.

·       Check the balance on the customer’s line before and after topping up and advice the customer to query their new balance which should now be X+Y (Initial amount +Over scratched card top-up value).

·       CEE then enters an interaction on Siebel for record purposes with serial number topped up on comments field and advises the customer.

·       Where the over\- scratched cannot go through because first call had not been updated on CRM in good time and line is on Idle Status, the customer should be referred to retail or care-desk for assistance.

·       M-PESA agents and dealers who call to assist a customer to top up an over\- scratched card should be advised to request the customer to call from their own line.

**Permanently Locked Voucher**

If the card the customer is calling regarding is in permanently locked status, advice the customer to return to point of purchase if they say they are not the ones who Locked it.

**Used Voucher**

If the card is Used, Inform the customer it is used and should return it to point of purchase if they are not the ones who used it.

**Over scratched Voucher on ISSUED Status**

·       In-case the customer calls and states that they have an over scratched issue when they read out the Serial number, you realize that the card is on "Issued" status raise an SR.

·       Indicate in SR notes the recharge voucher is an over scratched card.

·       It would be important to capture on the SR the card Serial Number on the SR short notes.

**Invalid, Expired, Issued and Used Top Up Vouchers**

This applies to vouchers that are not on active status.

Confirm from Siebel the serial number and check the status: -

**Expired Voucher**

Advise the customer to visit any Retail Shop for a replacement.

The retail staff will be allowed to replace a maximum of 10 cards per day, per customer. Any excess will be treated as bulk replacement.

**Bulk Expired Card Replacement**

This refers to expired cards that are presented in the shop for replacement which are more than 10 pieces with total value of Ksh 2,000 and above.

Retail staff will establish the source of the cards. Once confirmed they were sold via Safaricom channel the retail staff will advise the customer on 10% penalty of total value of cards presented.

If okay, retail staff will compile the cards on excel and compute the total value of compensation less 10% penalty fee that will be charged and share the same with the customer.

Replacement will be for cards that expired not more that 6 months ago.

**Used Voucher**

Advice the customer the date and time the voucher was used. You can give the Prefix and the last 3 digits of the MSISDN that used the voucher only.

Ensure that you indicate the Voucher Serial number and value in the Siebel Interaction key comments.

**Voucher on Issued Status**

Raise an SR and advice customer on SLA.

Ensure you capture the card Serial Number on the SR short notes. Advise the customer to retain the recharge voucher safely.

**Voucher Is on Active Status**

Confirm top-up procedure used and if correct PIN is used.

Give alternative methods.

If unable to recharge advise customer to return to point of purchase or visit any Safaricom Retail Shop.

**Permanently Locked Status**

Confirmed why it was locked under REASON, if locked due to: -

Stolen/lost – advice to return to point of purchase.

Over scratched - raise an interaction for Top up with sub-type as locked card, advice customer to return card to point of purchase.

**Voucher Recharge Outage**

Confirm if there is any outage communicated from the folder and advice.

If all the above are confirmed and the voucher is still invalid, raise an SR.

If the serial number is unavailable because the card is damaged or was disposed of, advise the customer that we are unable to query further.

**Missing Recharge Serial Number**

Voucher serial can be missing if it was used and is already archived.

It was permanently locked and is already archived.

Advise customer to return card to the point of purchase.

**Badly Printed/ Washed Virtual Voucher**

If customer has a badly printed virtual voucher, they should return it to the shop/outlet for a reprint.

If the voucher has been washed or is not usable due to the customer’s action, the customer can return to the shop/outlet for a reprint if the serial number is still visible and the voucher is not used.

**Red carded**

This is a condition where a prepaid customer account is **fraud voucher locked** after several failed airtime top-up attempts.

Customer's lines will be RED CARDED (Fraud locked) after 30 failed top up attempts. (The attempts have to be consecutive attempts in the same month).

**A lock is automatically placed on the account after the 30th erroneous attempt, by restricting airtime top up and airtime sambaza.**

The red card status auto-unbars after 24hrs. Where the auto-resume fails and customer calls, CEE shall confirm that the account has several failed top-up attempts.

1. Remove the customer account from the Fraud Voucher Lock (the **Fraud Voucher Unlock** option is available on CRM under IN DATA VBC).
2. Advise the customer on the importance of not guessing scratch card numbers.
3. If customer still has the card they were attempting to top-up, confirm the card status on Siebel and advise the customer on its status and correct procedure to top up if the card is active.
4. If it is over scratched, assist as per the over scratched procedure.

**Manual Airtime Top Ups**   

·       A customer will require a manual top up in the following instances:    

i.         Request due to system limitation i.e. postpaid lines receiving airtime and product configuration doesn’t allow Sambaza.   

ii.         Airtime Sambaza to pooled lines.   

iii.         Any other situation as per manager discretion and justification e.g. where a customer has sent airtime on Sambaza to a wrong number and the airtime has been retrieved and consent given by receiving customer to adjust.  

iv.         PIN- less top failures.   

·       Where any of the cases above occur, the CEE will fill in the manual adjustment form, raise an SR and attach all relevant documents, where pin-less has failed, CEE / RCSA will attach the POS receipt of the failed transaction and reconciliation used to identify failed transaction where necessary.   

·       The RCSA will confirm that all the details entered on the SR are correct and ensure approval for adjustment is done via by manager.   

·       The request will then be forwarded to the RCM/ROL for approval having confirmed validity of the request. The approval process for airtime adjustments will be as below:   

| Category | Max Amount | Approver |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Airtime | Kshs.1-10000 | RCM |
| | Kshs.10,001 -50000 | RCM /ROL |
| | Kshs.50,001-99,999 | RCM /ROL |
| Airtime    Top Up for Corporate    Multiple Numbers | Kshs. 100,000 and above | RCM HOD CFO |
| | <Kshs 500,000 | RCM |
| | >Kshs 500,000 | RCM HOD |

·       Once the request has been approved the RCSA will adjust customer’s airtime on Siebel, raise an SR for the same on Siebel and close the SR with the relevant resolution details and inform the customer of the same.

articleTitle: Prepay Sambaza and Dealer Airtime Sambaza
markdownContent:
**Prepay Sambaza**

# **Definition**

This is a service that enables Prepay subscribers to share airtime with their family and friends within the network.

# **Eligibility and Features**

It is eligible to prepay customers and Post pay individual hybrid customers.

They are only able to Sambaza to other active Prepay and Post pay hybrid customers.

You can Sambaza 30 times in a Month.

You can send any amount between Ksh.5 and Ksh.10,000. (For Prepay Customers) if the Minimum account balance in the senders account after transfer is Ksh.5.00 and above.

The recipient's number **MUST NOT** be on **idle** status on CRM.

# **Prepay Sambaza Channels**

**SMS Method:**

Send an SMS to **140** in the format:

Amount#PhoneNumber E.g *50#0722\*\*\*\*\*\**

*Sending SMS to 140 is free*

**USSD Method:**

**Dial \*140\*Amount\*PhoneNumber#ok**

**E.g \*140\*50\*0722\*\*\*\*\*\*#ok**

**MySafaricom/MyOne App**

Customers can also sambaza airtime via our Mobile Apps. On MySafaricom App: Click on Account then Sambaza and on MyOneApp: Click on My Airtime Balance, view Balance then Sambaza.

On MyOne App, the customer can also search for the Sambaza option from the search icon on MyOne App top right corner.

#  **Prepaid Sambaza Rules**

·    Minimum amount for every transfer: Ksh.5.00

·    Minimum balance on the transferring line before transfer: Ksh.10/=

·    Minimum account balance on the transferring line after transfer: Ksh.5/=

·    Maximum amount for every Sambaza transfer: Ksh. 10,000

·    Daily maximum amount transferable: Ksh.10,000.00 you can top up as many times for as long as the limit is not reached.

- Maximum Amount prepaid wallet can hold is **200,000**

# **Reversals of Sambaza Airtime or 3rd Party Top Ups**

·    When a customer requests for refund for airtime claiming that he 'Sambazad' money or via 3rd party top up to the wrong number.

·    The reversal available for now is for airtime purchased from M-PESA only.

·    Advise the customer to call the person they sent the funds to and ask them to send the funds back.

·    Advise the customer to be more careful when sending funds. Explain the Sambaza process to the customer.

**NOTE:** If the customer is not aware of the number, they Sambazad to; you can give the Prefix and the last 3 digits of the MSISDN of the third party, also advise the customer to confirm with their received Sambaza text notifications as well.

# **Top up Limits**

**Maximum Scratch Card Top-Up Limits**

The maximum amount set in billing is 200K, you can top up as many times for as long as the limit is not reached.

**Maximum M-PESA top-up one can I do at once.** 

The maximum amount a customer can top up is 200K.

**Maximum top-up done in a single day.**

A customer can top up as many times as long as the billing (Main account) wallet limit of 200k is not reached.

**Maximum scratch cards can top up in a single day.**

A customer can top up many times via as scratch cards if the billing (Main account) wallet limit of 200k is not reached.

**Maximum M-PESA top-ups in a single day**

A customer can do many top ups many times via M-PESA as long as the billing (Main account) wallet limit of 200k is not reached.

**Maximum to hold in Prepaid wallet.**

A customer can hold a maximum of Ksh.200,000 on the prepaid wallet.

**Balance Check via calling 144.**

To call 144 to check balance is Ksh 10 per Call

**Minimum M-PESA Airtime Top up.** 

The minimum M-PESA Airtime Top up one can top up via M-PESA is KSh.1.

**Validity**

Airtime purchased in the KSh 1 – 4 range shares the same validity period as the KSh 5 airtime.

**Channels of Access**

The KSh 1 top-up is now available via STK (Sim Toolkit) and USSD.

**NOTE:** We are also working on extending this functionality to the M-PESA App and Safaricom App to provide even more convenience.

# **Reversal**

Minimum airtime DIY reversal remains KSh. 5. We will advise once this changes.

**CVM Messages**

·    ***Kiswahili option 1****: Hata SHILINGI ni pesa! Sasa unaweza kununua Safaricom airtime ya shilingi MOJA na M-PESA. Kwenye M-PESA Chagua My Account>Check Balance, na ujaribu kununua leo.*

·    ***English Option 1****: Every 1 Bob counts! Did you know you can buy Safaricom airtime worth 1 bob using M-PESA? Go to M-PESA>My Account>Check Balance & then buy airtime today.*

·    ***English Option 2****: Every 1 Bob counts! You can now buy Safaricom airtime worth 1 Bob using M-PESA. Check your M-PESA balance, try it and keep your conversations going.*

# **Dealer Airtime Sambaza**

**Definition**

This is a tariff that gives dealers the ability to Sambaza larger amounts of airtime, than is allowed as per the current Sambaza limit i.e. a maximum of Ksh.200,000.

It will allow dealers to Sambaza minimum amount of Ksh.50.00 and a maximum amount of Ksh.200, 000 per day to its sub-dealers.

# **Eligibility**

It is only available to authorized Safaricom Dealers, upon making a successful application to Safaricom.

**How to Apply for Dealer Sambaza Tariff**

·    The Dealer will visit Safaricom HQ – Sales Distribution 6th Floor, or to any Safaricom Shop.

·    Fill in an application form to sign up for receipt of the Dealer Sambaza SIM card based on the Terms and Conditions for the service.

·    The Dealer will be advised of the risks associated with Sambaza as there is still no PIN restriction in place to prevent Sambaza of all the Ksh. 200,000 by an unauthorized person.

·    In the event of the loss or theft of the SIM Card, the Dealer will call Line 100 Dealer Enquiry Services, and give necessary information required to vet the Dealer. Vetting includes.

·    Numbers the MSISDN in question frequently sends SMS to

·    Date, time and amount of last Sambaza.

·    Original PIN and PUK of the SIM serial number for the MSISDN

articleTitle: VoLTE (Voice Over Long-Term Evolution) Information and Activation
markdownContent:
**VOLTE (Voice Over Long Term Evolution) Definition and Information**

# **Definition**

Voice over LTE (VoLTE) is an advanced technology that delivers high-quality life-like sound over voice and video calls across the 4G network.

# **Requirements**

Have a VoLTE enabled handset (check if handset is VoLTE enabled via www.safaricom.co.ke/volte).

Ensure that handset has been upgraded with the latest software provided by the handset manufacturer.

Customer should ensure that they are using a 4G SIM(Provisioned) and they are calling on 4G network.

Verify that the VoLTE voice calling feature has been enabled on their smartphone For Android: Settings -> Mobile networks -> Turn on VoLTE call.

# **Cost**

There are No additional charges on VoLTE, customer will call using airtime or minutes and normal charges will apply.

The existing plan that customers use for calls will support the VoLTE services this can be in terms of from customers airtime, from credit limit or minutes.

VoLTE calls will Not consume data. It will be charged as per normal calls rate i.e., Kshs. 4 per minute.

# **VOLTE Usage Tips**

If a customer moves from a 4G network coverage area to 3G coverage during a VoLTE call, the call will automatically switch to our standard voice service

Customers will enjoy VoLTE services when making On Net calls only.

Customers can make video calls on VoLTE without data resources. The video call will be charged as a normal call from the customers\` account at no additional cost.

All devices that are VoLTE enabled.

**ZIIDI BIASHARA MMF**

# **Definition**

ZiiDi Biashara is an investment product that allows M-PESA merchants to invest in Money Market Fund, from as low as KSH 500 and earn competitive daily interest. Funds can only be invested or withdrawn via M-PESA and invested funds are instantly accessible via provided channels.

# **Eligibility**

- It’s eligible for merchants **ONLY**.
- Must have an active M-PESA business account.
- Business KYC must be validated before opt-in (Operator / Business Operator credentials)

# **How to Access**

- It can be accessed via the following channels.
- ZiiDi Biashara Mini-App on the M-PESA Business app
- USSD on \*234#

# **How It works**

- The government charges a **15%** withholding tax on the interest earned by individual merchants which is withheld by the fund manager and return is net of taxes.
- ZiiDi Biashara is approved and regulated by Capital Markets Authority as a Money Market Fund.
- ZiiDi Biashara has no transactions costs to invest, withdraw or check balance.
- Merchant must receive SMS/in app notifications after every action.
- Merchant can have an active ZiiDi Biashara account linked to up-to 5 sub-accounts.
- M-PESA rules apply (1 wallet mapped to 1 nominated number/ short code)
- Each transaction must be validated.

# **Balance Query**

Merchant should be able to view their balance on the ZiiDi Biashara App or request on USSD or view on M-PESA Business portal.

# **ZiiDi Biashara Transaction limits**

- Merchants can invest a minimum of KES 500.00, while the minimum withdrawal amount is KES 100.00.
- All investment and withdrawal transactions are subject to the existing M-PESA merchant transaction limits.
- Instant withdrawals are allowed up to KES 500,000.00. For withdrawal requests above KES 500,000.00, the funds will be processed within 48 hours.
- No charges apply for transfers between ZiiDi Biashara and the M-PESA wallet.

# **What is a Money Market Fund (MMF)**

- It is a type of unit trust under the Collective investment scheme umbrella. Collective Investment Scheme pools funds from multiple investors and invest them in diversified portfolio of assets. An MMF is considered a low-risk investment with the aim of giving a fair return.
- An MMF mainly invests the funds in interest bearing assets approved within the CIS regulations 2023, such as fixed deposits, call deposits and government papers.

# **Investing with Fuliza Biashara**

Merchants are currently not allowed to invest using their Fuliza Biashara overdraft facility.

# **Business tax exemption**

If a business is exempted from tax, the merchant will be required to share their tax exemption certificate with Safaricom.

# **Account closure with funds**

- If attempting to close an account with funds, the merchant will receive a prompt that advises them to withdraw all the funds before closing their ZiiDi Biashara account.
- If they choose to withdraw funds and close the account, the funds will be automatically transferred to your M-PESA account.

**Note:**  When the merchant’s M-PESA account is closed, all ZiiDi Biashara wallets linked to that account are automatically closed. Any remaining balance will be accessed through the current claim process.

# **Documentation required for next of Kin or closed account claims**

- Next of Kin is the person whose details are nominated on ZiiDi Biashara by the account owner or is the legally designated heir and in the event of incapacities such as sickness, mental instability, and death they can have access to your funds. On condition of.
- The merchant’s (Next of Kin) will visit the nearest Safaricom retail shop or care desks and provide the following documents:

**For Lipa na M-PESA accounts holding up to Ksh.35,000/= the claimant should present all the following documents.**

- Death certificate
- Letter from Chief or Provincial Administration confirming claimant as next of kin.
- Affidavit administered by a Commissioner for Oaths/Magistrate confirming claimant as next of kin for deceased customer.
- ID copies of the Beneficiary/Claimant.
- Claimant written request for change of nominated number and /or change of bank details depending on the existing mode of settlement captured on M-PESA G2.

**For Lipa na M-PESA accounts holding Ksh.35,000/= and above, the claimant will present all the following documents.**

- Death certificate
- Confirmed Grant of Probate
- Authorization letter from the Administrator/s appointed in the Grant of Probate
- ID copies of the Beneficiary/Administrator
- Claimant requests for change of nominated number and /or change of bank details depending on the existing mode of settlement captured on M-PESA G2

Once the documents are submitted, the merchant will follow the current claim process.

# **Customer Support**

For support and inquiry, merchants should contact Safaricom Call Center or visit Safaricom Retail Center.

articleTitle: National Youth Opportunities Towards Advancement (NYOTA) Project
markdownContent:
# **Definition**

NYOTA is a project that is being implemented by the Government of Kenya with the aim of increasing employment opportunities and earnings through apprenticeship and business support, as well as promoting savings through auto-enrolment into the NSSF Haba Haba Scheme among the youth aged **18 to 29 years** and **18 to 34 years** (for youth with disability).

# **The 3 Key NYOTA Components**

**Business Support (6 months)**

Helps youth start or grow small businesses through a 6-month program. Participants go through an Enterprise Assessment/Aptitude Test(EAT) during selection, and receive training, mentorship, and grant support.

**Please refer to the attached FAQs and Customer Journey for more details on the NYOTA Business Support Savings Deposit that are being disbursed to eligible beneficiaries.**

For details on the Assessment see **[GOOG-0016](../../app/article/b47a930a-bf82-4615-9d9d-c60afa21d471)**

**Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL)**

Certifies skills gained through informal work or experience. Youth are assessed and, if successful, awarded a nationally recognized certificate.

**On-the-Job Experience (OJE) – 6 months**

Provides 6 months of real workplace training where youth gain practical skills, earn a stipend, and receive a certificate to boost employability.

# **Application**

NYOTA applications are invited from interested youth in all 47 counties. The timeline for application for all components will be confirmed and communicated in due course.

Once the government announces the application opportunity within the 3 tracks, the interested applicant will use one of the below: 

Dial USSD Code 254# and select the NYOTA Project option.

If you need assistance - visit SDYACE (**State Department for Youth Affairs and Creative Economy**) County/Sub-County Offices or MSEA (Micro Small Enterprise Authority)/County Offices near you.

Youth from vulnerable and marginalized groups (VMGs) and youth with disability are highly encouraged to apply.

# **Requirements:**

Applicants **MUST**:

Be a Kenyan citizen.

Be a youth between the ages of 18 and 29 years.

Be 18 and 35 years for youth with disability (**MUST** be registered by National Council for Persons with Disability -NCPWD).

Not have gone beyond Form 4 level of education.

Have a national identity card.

Have a SIM card registered in their name and National Id Card.

Not have been a beneficiary of Kenya Youth Employment and Opportunities Project (KYEOP).

**N/B:** In Cycle 1, refugees will **NOT** be able to participate in the NYOTA project. However, in subsequent Cycles, eligible refugees within the gazetted refugee camps in Kenya, will be included, provided they meet the set criteria.

**NOTE: BENEFICIARIES WILL NOT PAY FOR ANY OF THE ACTIVITIES UNDER NYOTA PROJECT**

# **Support:**

For more information on the National Youth Opportunities Towards Advancement (NYOTA) Project:

Log in to [www.nyotaproject.go.ke](http://www.nyotaproject.go.ke) or [www.msea.go.ke/nyotaproject/](http://www.msea.go.ke/nyotaproject/)

Visit any offices of the State Department for Youth Affairs and Creative Economy at the Sub-County and County or MSEA County offices countrywide.

**NYOTA Benefits and Contributions to the National Economy**

 **Benefits to Participants:**

·       Enhanced employability through hands-on training and certification.

·       Provides start-up capital and mentorship for young entrepreneurs.

·       Encourages financial independence through the NSSF Haba Haba savings plan.

·       Improves income generation by equipping youth with marketable skills.

**Contribution to the National Economy:**

·       Boosts job creation by developing skilled workers and entrepreneurs.

·       Supports youth enterprises, leading to increased economic activity.

·       Promotes financial inclusion through structured savings programs.

·       Reduces unemployment and poverty, fostering long-term economic growth.

# **Definition**

The **Entrepreneurship Assessment Test (EAT)** is a key step in the NYOTA Program **Business Support** selection process.

It is designed to identify applicants with strong entrepreneurial potential and readiness to benefit from the program’s training, mentorship, and financial support.

For information on NYOTA Click [GOOG-0015](../../app/article/7f7deb1d-c8ca-4b82-8ddb-a3805b6a737d)

# **Who Takes the Test (EAT)**

- Only **whitelisted applicants** who have been shortlisted/selected are eligible to take the test.
- These applicants will receive an **SMS notification** with instructions, including the **start and end dates** of the test period.

# **How the Test Works**

- The EAT is a **Question-and-Answer (Q&A)** assessment delivered via **SMS**.
- Applicants must text **“EAT”** to **40270** to begin.
- The test contains multiple-choice questions covering entrepreneurship knowledge, business decision-making, and basic financial literacy.
- **No charges** apply for participating.

# **Testing Rules**

- The **timeframe** for the test will be clearly stated in the SMS notification.
- **Completion is mandatory** within the specified period. Applicants who do not complete the test will be **disqualified**.
- If the test is paused midway, it can be resumed within the same testing window.

# **Scoring & Selection**

- The system automatically scores all responses.
- Final selection to fill the **100% target** is based on top scores.
- In case of a tie at the cutoff point, random selection will determine the final slots.
- Successful applicants will be placed into **three intake cycles**, each starting on different dates.

**Next Steps**

Selected applicants will proceed to:

- **Business Development Support (BDS)** training.
- Mentorship programs.
- Access to relevant financial and operational support under NYOTA.

**Purpose of EAT**

The EAT ensures:

- **Fair and objective selection** from the shortlisted pool of applicants.
- Identification of individuals best prepared to start or grow a business.
- Early engagement of beneficiaries in the program process.

**K24 PLUS BUNDLES**

# **Definition**

We partnering with **K24** as they relaunch their streaming platform - **K24 Plus**.

To support this partnership, we have introduced **two K24 Plus bundles** based on our existing **B-LIVE offers**. Go **Live Date:** **10th July 2026**.

# **Available Bundles**

- **K24 Plus Bundle @ KES 30** – Browse for **1.5 Hours**

# **How the Bundles Work**

- K24 Plus bundles work the same way as **B-LIVE bundles** and all B-LIVE terms and conditions apply.

# **Payment Options**

Customers can pay using:

# **Important to Note**

- When customers dial **\*544\*24#**, they will only see **one of the two available bundle options**.

# **Customer Journey**

**Objectives**

# **Fuliza Biashara Loan**

**Definition**

Fuliza Biashara is a credit facility available under the M-PESA Business till. The facility will allow business owners to complete transactions, by overdrawing their accounts, when they have insufficient funds in their tills.

**Eligibility**

- All business owners using the M-PESA business till can access the service.
- The business owner must have been active on M-PESA for over 6 months.
- Overdraft limit is assigned based on the transaction history of the till.
- A change of nominated number does not affect the overdraft limit of the short code.
- Customers only on pochi la biashara will not be able to opt into the overdraft.
- The overdraft will be assigned per till. One customer document ID with more than one short code will get an overdraft assigned to each short code.
- A Merchant can still do a top up of Fuliza Biashara as long as it is within their limit.

**NOTE:** If a customer has 3 tills and all have limit for Fuliza Biashara, if they happen to have an overdue loan of more than 90 days on one of the tills, the other tills will have zero limit. If they try to borrow, they will get a message of **“*Failed. Your loan request could not be processed due to an overdue loan with this product. Kindly avail funds in your till.***

**Services available on the Business Overdraft**

A business owner will be able to complete the below transactions using the business overdraft

- Pay to another Buy Goods till
- Pay to a mobile number/customer.
- Pay to a utility (Pay bill) till
- Withdraw to nominated number
- Withdraw to M-PESA agent

The below transactions will not be possible using business overdraft.

- Withdraw to Bank

A business owner can overdraw multiple times for different transactions until they reach their limit.

The overdraft can be used on all transaction amounts as long as it falls within the overdraft limits assigned and M-PESA transaction limits.

# **Charges**

A Business owner will be charged a one off 2% access fee and a daily maintenance fee per band as below.

 [Screenshot] 

A customer who accesses the overdraft and pays within the day before midnight or 00.00hrs of the next day will only be charged the one-off access fee.

Any outstanding amount after the 00.00hrs of the next day will attract the daily maintenance fees.

**DIY Procedures for Fuliza Biashara**

- The service is currently accessible via USSD and Business app.

**Business overdraft activation**

- Dial \*234# from nominated number
- Select option 2 – M-PESA Business Till
- Enter Store Number
- Select Option 3 – Business Loans
- Select option 1 – Fuliza Biashara
- Accept Terms & Conditions
- Enter Operator ID
- Enter Operator PIN
- Merchant will receive a message confirming that they have successfully opted in and the Fuliza Biashara limit assigned.

**NOTE:** Fuliza Biashara limit will be awarded during Opt-in process and customer will be notified via SMS. Every time they transact using the overdraft, they will receive an SMS with the outstanding Overdraft amount.

**Fuliza Biashara Status check**

One will be able to check limit, check mini statement, check balance and query charges by following the below steps.

- Dial \*234# from nominated number
- Select option 2 – M-PESA Business Till
- Enter Store Number
- Select Option 3 – Business Loans
- Select option 1 – Fuliza Biashara
- Select either

- Check limit
- Check Mini statement
- Check Balance
- Query charges
- Enter Operator ID
- Enter Operator PIN
- Merchant will receive a flash message confirming the response to their query.

 **Business Overdraft opt Out**

- Dial \*234#
- Select option 2 – M-PESA Business Till
- Enter store number
- Select Option 3 – Business Loans
- Select option 1 – Fuliza Biashara
- Select opt Out

**Note:** One will not be able to opt out of Fuliza Biashara as long as they have an outstanding overdraft balance. 

**Business Overdraft CRM View**

** [Screenshot] **

** [Screenshot] **

**NOTE:**  Searching the transactions with the organization shortcode is available by clicking the Search button on Fuliza For organization. Illustrated below: 

 [Screenshot] 

**How Fuliza Biashara overdraft works**

- **Loan recovery will now be 40%** of all inflows coming into the till. This is a change from the current 100%.
- For any overdue (>30 days) overdraft, the loan overdraft **repayment will be at 100%.**
- **For any overdue loan (older than 30 days), loan repayment will take precedence** for any inflow that will come into the till until the overdraft is fully paid. i.e., The customer will not be able to withdraw until the loan is fully paid off.
- Any merchant applying for another till while they have an overdue balance on another till **will be notified of the existing overdraft loan balance in the other till.**

**Merchants with current loans (Loans 0-30 days)**

- Fuliza Biashara overdraft recovery will be at 40% of all inflows coming into the till not 100% as was previously running. (This applies to current loans only, with the 30-day overdraft period).

**Merchants with overdue loans (older than 30 days)**

- For any overdue (>30 days) overdraft the loan overdraft repayment will be recovered at 100% of all funds received in the till until the overdraft is fully paid.
- During this period, the till will have a state tag known as ‘**Debtor\_Organization’**. That will prevent the merchant from withdrawing their funds to enable recovery towards overdraft repayment.
- Once the overdraft is fully paid, the state tag will be automatically removed, and the till will resume normal functions. In case of any challenge of the state tag, please escalate via SR. Please do not remove the state tag manually.
- For any merchant applying for another till while they have an overdue balance on existing till, they will be notified of the existing overdraft loan balance in the other till. However, we will allow the new creation to proceed.

articleTitle: M-PESA B2B Whitelist Ticketing - Open & Closed Loops
markdownContent:
The M-PESA B2B service enables organizations to make payments directly from their business shortcode to another organization's Paybill, Business Till, One Account, or Bulk Payment shortcode.

To improve customer experience and drive adoption of the B2B service, we have introduced a ticketing service for application for B2B whitelisting. Customers will therefore need to raise B2B whitelist tickets directly from M-PESA Business Hub.

Organizations will have the following options when raising a ticket:

**Open Loop B2B (New):** Open Loop B2B allows organizations to make payments from a Paybill, One Account, Buy Goods and Bulk Payment shortcodes  to any eligible business shortcode without the need for recipient whitelisting. This provides greater flexibility, reduces onboarding time, and streamlines business transactions.

**Closed Loop B2B:** Closed Loop B2B continues to support organizations that prefer to restrict payments to a predefined list of recipient shortcodes approved by their signatories.

To activate both services service, the organization must:

Complete the attached B2B Authorization Form and Terms and Conditions

Submit a request through a ticket on the M-PESA Business Hub, while also attaching KYC documents as listed on Page-2 of the form

# **B2B Tariff**

Refer to B2B tariff attached, for payments originating from Paybill, Buy Goods, One Account, or Bulk Payment shortcode

B2B payments made from Business Till continue to be open loop with Mauzo tariff applied.

# **NOTE**

Please note the following service limitations and requirements:

B2B payments are currently not supported to Kenya Power shortcodes.

Government shortcodes are excluded from B2B payments, with the exception of eCitizen

B2B payments to banks will require whitelisting. Applications must include an authorization letter from the receiving bank.

B2B payments to gaming, digital lenders and IMT/GlobalPay are also supported through whitelisting

Some organizations may be blacklisted from B2B. Merchants will get relevant notifications if they try to whitelist them.

Attached are MBH User Guide on how to raise a B2B ticket, the Application Forms and T&Cs.

# **Bloom Sub-Agent Term Loan**

**Definition**

- Bloom Sub-Agent is a financing option providing float financing to M-PESA.
- The service offers minimum of KSh. 5,000 up to KSh. 300,000 as the loan credit limit

**What is Nominated Number for M-PESA Agents**

- This is the personal mobile number of an M-PESA agency head office or store business owner. Sub-agents who have not updated should contact their respective head offices for assistance.

**Eligibility**

All M-PESA Sub-Agents will be able to access the loan based on the credit scoring to determine qualification except for blacklisted agents.

**NOTE:** Agent Head Offices and Super Agents are NOT eligible for Bloom Sub-Agent

**Benefits**

Safaricom M-PESA Sub-Agents will be able to access credit as float to help them to make transactions when they are low on float

**How To Register/ Opt in for Sub-Agent Term Loan Service**

From the Agent nominated number, Dial \*234#, select M-PESA Agent Services > select Business Loans > select Sub-Agent Bloom > accept Terms and Conditions > enter your Primary Assistant Operator ID > enter Operator PIN to opt into Sub-Agent term loan.

**Opt in conditions**

- Till must be operational for at least180days.
- Number of same ID that can opt in is 5 times.
- Opt in must be from the Nominated number.

**Access Channels**

To access the loan, the sub-agent nominated number will dial \*234# and select the M-PESA Agent Services menu. App channels will be available later.

**How the lender makes a lending decision**

 A loan is approved or rejected based on:

| Average activity rate period | 6 months activity |
| --- | --- |
| Activity rate | >300 transactions a month |
| Average level of float | >Kes 20,000 a month |

**How To apply for Sub-Agent term Loan**

- Once you have successfully registered/opted in to Sub-Agent Service:
- Dial \*234# from the nominated number
- Select M-PESA Agent Services
- Select Business Loans
- Select Sub-Agent Bloom
- Select the loan required
- Authenticate the request using operator credentials

Agent will receive funding for your business shortly after making the Loan request and disbursements will be made from the financiers’ agent MMF account to the agent float account.

**Agent Store has no nominated number**

The Sub-Agent store owner (Primary Assistant) should liaise with their respective Head Office to update the nominated number on dealer portal.

**How To Access the funds**

The funds will then be processed Disbursements will be made from the financiers’ agent MMF account to the agent float account and the agent will get confirmation message of the same.

**Considerations for loan limit increase**

The agent commission history for the last 6 months

**Your CRB credit listing and score**: How well you repay and perform on all your loans affects your CRB listing and score. The better your score better your chances of a loan limit increase

**Loan Performance:** How you perform, that is, early repayments on all your loans.

**How to know how much I qualify for & how to check my credit limit**

An agent can check their loan qualification from the nominated number by dialling \*234#, select M-PESA Agent services> Select Business Loans > Select Sub-Agent Bloom> Select Check Limit

**Loan Fee Charges**

The service is currently available only for a 7-day loan charged at 2% fees for the Seven days of the loan period.

**Reasons declining the loan request**

- If the Loan amount requested is higher than your Loan Limit. The Loan request **MUST** be made within your Loan Limit.
- If one has been blacklisted by the Credit Reference Bureau.
- If you have an existing Loan, one will be required to fully repay for an existing loan before requesting for another. One can only request one Loan.
- Dialling from an incorrect nominated number, or where no nominated number exists

**Reasons for NOT receiving the loan amount requested**

This might be because of:

**Making a loan request as the first one is still being processed:** Wait 5 minutes before making another loan request if the first one has not been processed.

**Agent store account status:** Account should be in active status.

**Primary operator status:** Primary operator must be active.

**The M-PESA system being slow or is down**: Once MPESA services are back up, the amount borrowed will reflect in your account shortly

# **Loan Repayment**

**How To repay loan**

Dial \*234# from the nominated number > Select M-PESA Agent service> Select Business Loans > select Sub Agent Bloom>Select Pay Loan

**Partial Settlement** **–** One can pay in instalments before the Loan due date.

**Full Settlement –** One can pay the entire Loan amount at once. The amount should reflect in your account immediately after successful repayment

**Loan Repayment Mechanics**

- Agent Head Office will **NOT** be held liable for loans defaulted by their sub-agents
- Sub-agent till will **NOT** be attached for non-repayment as he nominated number will take responsibility
- If the loan has been repaid and the payment has not reflected in 24 hours, The Agent shall call Safaricom Customer Care Line 100 for assistance.
- If one has been charged an additional fee due to the repayment **NOT** reflecting on time, they are eligible for a refund.
- The Agent shall call Safaricom Customer Care Line 100 to initiate the refund request. The refund should reflect your float account in less than 48hours after it is requested.

**Early loan repayment**

Early loan repayment is highly encouraged as this can result in one accessing a higher loan limit faster by improving your CRB score.

**Late Loan Repayment**

Once a loan is past its due date the outstanding amount will be rolled over for an additional 7 days. Rollover interest will be charged at 2% of the outstanding amount.

**Number of times a roll-over be applied**

Three times of 7 days each, after the lapse of the initial 7-day tenure.
