**Definition.**

Go-Play is a Safaricom-powered online gaming platform giving subscribers instant access to 30+ browser-based HTML5 games — no downloads, no installs. Play Arcade, Puzzle, Sports, Word, Trivia, Card, and Board games directly on your phone or tablet.

**Eligibility.**

Go-Play is available exclusively to Safaricom subscribers in Kenya, above 18 years old (or have parental/guardian consent) and have sufficient airtime or M-PESA balance to cover the bundle price (KES 10 or KES 20).

**How to subscribe/unsubscribe**

A customer can subscribe by dialing \*544\*47# on their Safaricom number and select the preferred bundle (KES 10 or KES 20)

Visit go-play.co.ke on your Safaricom data connection and follow the on-screen subscription prompt to choose a bundle.

To unsubscribe dial \*544\*73# and follow the prompts.

**Charges.**

• KES 10 Bundle — 24 hours of access plus 50 MB of data.

• KES 20 Bundle — 24 hours of access plus 100 MB of data.

**Games available**

Go-Play offers 30+ HTML5 games across multiple genres: 
   • Arcade: Slice the Fruitz, Birdify, Gravity Jump, Neon Hockey 
   • Puzzle: Candy Rush, Magic Cup, Cube Count 
   • Sports: 8 Ball Pool, Arcade Golf, Air Hockey 
   • Word: Word Search, Word Master 
   • Trivia: Quiz Game, IQ Challenge 
   • Card: Solitaire   •   Board: Play Chess 
New games are added periodically.

**Tournaments & Leaderboard**

Every two weeks, Go-Play launches a new biweekly Tournament on a featured game. Players accumulate points over the two-week period. At the end of each tournament, the Top 10 players win airtime and data bundle rewards.

**Leaderboard.**

There is a leaderboard that ranks all participants by total accumulated tournament points, updating in real time. The Top 3 are shown on a Gold, Silver, and Bronze podium; positions 4–10 appear in a scrollable list. Your own rank is always highlighted.

**How to earn tournament points**

Play the featured Tournament game. Your score from each session is automatically added to your total points. The more you play and the higher you score, the higher you climb.

**When does the tournament end?**

Each tournament runs for two weeks. Standings lock at 23:59 EAT on the final day. Results after that time are final.

**Can I play the tournament game without a subscription?**

No. An active Go-Play subscription — either a current KES 10 or KES 20 bundle is required to play all games, including the Tournament game.

**Biweekly Rewards Programme**

**Rewards to be won.**

The Top 10 players in each biweekly tournament win:

| Position | Tier | Airtime | Data Bundle |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 🥇 1st Place | Champion | KES 5,500 | 5 GB |
| 🥈 2nd Place | Runner-Up | KES 5,000 | 5 GB |
| 🥉 3rd Place | 3rd Place | KES 4,500 | 5 GB |
| 4th Place | 4th Place | KES 4,000 | 5 GB |
| 5th Place | 5th Place | KES 3,500 | 5 GB |
| 6th Place | 6th Place | KES 3,000 | 2 GB |
| 7th Place | 7th Place | KES 2,500 | 2 GB |
| 8th Place | 8th Place | KES 2,000 | 2 GB |
| 9th Place | 9th Place | KES 1,500 | 2 GB |
| 10th Place | 10th Place | KES 1,000 | 2 GB |

**How to receive my reward won.**

If you finish in the Top 10, your airtime and data bundle are credited directly to your Safaricom number — no action required. Rewards are distributed within 7 business days of the tournament closing.

**Qualifications.**

You must hold an active Go-Play subscription (bundle or SDP) for the majority of days during the tournament period, finish in the Top 10 on the official leaderboard at the close of the final day and be a verified Safaricom subscriber so the reward can be credited to your registered number.

**Do top and bottom 5 get different rewards.**

Yes. Players finishing 1st–5th each receive KES 5,500–3,500 in airtime plus a 5 GB data bundle. Players finishing 6th–10th receive KES 3,000–1,000 in airtime plus a 2 GB data bundle.

**Can rewards be exchanged for cash**

No. Airtime and data bundle rewards have no cash equivalent and cannot be transferred or refunded.

**What if someone is cheating on the leaderboard?**

Go-Play monitors for cheating including bots, scripts, and score manipulation. Cheating players are disqualified and may be permanently banned. Report concerns to support@go-play.co.ke.

**Privacy & Data**

**What personal data does Go-Play collect?**

Your Safaricom phone number (for authentication, billing, and reward delivery), game scores and tournament points, subscription/payment status, and click/tracking IDs from marketing links.

**Is my phone number visible to other players?**

No. Your phone number is always masked. Only your display username is visible on the leaderboard.

**Does Go-Play sell my data?**

No. Go-Play does not sell your personal data to third parties.

**How can I delete my data?**

Email support@go-play.co.ke to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data. Note that deletion will permanently remove all your accumulated points and leaderboard history. Go-Play handles data in line with the Kenya Data Protection Act 2019.

**Mechanics.**

No account creation is required. Go-Play automatically recognizes you by your Safaricom phone number. You can optionally set a display username for the leaderboard.

You can browse on Wi-Fi, but automatic login (via Safaricom Header Enrichment) only works on a live Safaricom mobile data connection. Switch to your Safaricom data connection for the best experience.

For bundle subscribers, the bundle price (KES 10 or KES 20) is deducted from your Safaricom airtime balance at the time of purchase, and access lasts 24 hours from e time of purchase.

No refunds are issued for partially used bundle or subscription periods.

All games run directly in your browser — zero downloads, zero installs.

Go-Play works on mobile phones, tablets, and desktop browsers. Optimized for mobile on the Safaricom network.

Active subscribers enjoy a completely ad-free experience.

Scores auto-sync to the Go-Play backend as you play, updating the leaderboard in real time — even after you close the game window.

Scores sync in real time but may take a minute or two. Ensure you have a stable Safaricom data connection during gameplay. Contact support if the score is still missing after a few minutes.

**Contact & Support**

Email support@go-play.co.ke with your Safaricom number and a description of your issue. We aim to respond within 2 business days.

**Definition**

The Hustler Fund is a digital financial inclusion initiative designed to improve financial access for personal (individuals), micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) in Kenya.

- The fund brings you credit to where you are – transforms credit into “credit on the go.”
- The first instalment of this fund is the Personal Finance product, which was launched on **November 30, 2022**.

# **Eligibility**

- Must be a Kenyan citizen of 18 years of age and above
- Must have a valid national Identification Card (ID)
- Must have a registered mobile number from a recognized Mobile Network Operator in Kenya i.e., either Airtel, Safaricom or Telkom.
- Have a mobile money account i.e., Airtel Money/M-PESA/T-Kash
- The SIM card in question can/will only be eligible if it has been in use for more than 90 days
- The registered customer **MUST** have a positive credit score rating
- The customer MUST reside and conduct economic activities in Kenya
- Provide the location of residence during the onboarding process (where applicable)

# **Access**

The Hustler fund is accessible through USSD (\*254#) and on mobile APP platforms of any of the Mobile Network Operators in Kenya.

The Hustler Fund **Mobile Mini-App is embedded on the OneApp for Safaricom customers.**

# **How to register an account**

The customer is required to:

- Sign up for the Hustler Fund platform by dialing **\*254#** or through the mobile app >> Accept Terms and Conditions to join the Fund >> Enter Mobile Money PIN.
- Upon fulfillment of the steps above, an SMS will be sent to notify them of their successful registration and the limit assignment.
- In the event of a failed registration, the borrower will be notified via SMS.

# **How it works**

- The **loan repayment** period is **14 days**, and the **interest rate** is capped at **8% per annum computed** on a pro-rated basis.
- If the loan is not cleared within the 14 days, the loan interest will be **adjusted to 9.5% per annum** as from **day 15.**

- Approved loan will be disbursed to your Mobile Money account.
- Out of the total approved loan amount, **95% is disbursed** i.e., deposited to your Mobile Money wallet, and the remaining **5% is saved** i.e., deposited to your savings account scheme of the fund.
- **The savings scheme** will split savings into 70% long-term and 30% short term savings(**70:30**) i.e., **70% of the 5%** will go into long term (Pension) and **30% of the 5%** will go into short-term savings.

***Example: Customer borrows KSh 1,000*** - KSh.50 (5% \*1,000) will go into their Savings account as below:

*KSh.35 (70% \*50) - Will go to Pension account (Long Term saving).*

*KSh.15 (30% \* 50) – Will go to short term savings account.*

# **Features**

- The loan has no processing fee.
- If the beneficiary has a Fuliza loan, Fuliza will be suspended for 24hrs to allow beneficiaries to access and use the received funds.
- You can only register **one MSISDN** into the Hustler Fund i.e., the customer can only opt-in once with the unique identifier as National ID.

- In case he/she attempts while already registered, the customer will get a notification that “*You are already registered with another Mobile Number 254722\*\*\*456*.”
- Customers who wish to change the registered mobile number will need to clear any existing Hustler Fund personal loan, then visit a nearby Safaricom shop with their National ID Card for delink of current number (MSISDN).
- If a customer calls, disputing ownership of a line, please note as below.

- Request the customer to dial **\*106#** and report all the lines that are not theirs.
- Capture interactions under Fraud category, type **Fraud barring** sub type **\*106#.**

- In cases of change of ownership, we shall handle it same as change of ownership for KCB-MPESA and M-Shwari account holders.
- Sim swaps for lines with Hustler Funds are carried out as usual; no further precautions are required because the monies are secured by the Mobile Money PIN.

# **How To Check Loan Balance**

**USSD**

- Via USSD dial **\*254#** >> Select Loans >> Check Loan Status >> Select Loan balance >> Enter Mobile Money PIN
- You will receive an SMS message with your Loan balance.

**On App**

- This will be displayed on the Hustler Fund Mini-app with an option to hide or unhide.

# **Repayment & Notifications**

- The borrower will be notified, via SMS, of the due date and outstanding amount 5 days prior.
- The customer can pay the loan in part or in full as long as  it’s fully settled by the 14th day of borrowing.
- On the fourteenth day, the borrower is notified that the facility is now overdue.
- After the due date, the borrower shall not be eligible to apply for any other facility with the Fund until the outstanding loan is fully paid.
- The loan interest will be **adjusted to 9.5% per annum** as from **day15.**
- Overdue reminders shall be sent every 5 days up to a maximum of 30 days.
- On the thirtieth day of the facility, the customer is again notified that the facility is due.
- Customers whose MSISDNs are recycled can repay using the Pay for other option available on \*254#ok and Mini-App.

# **Penalties In Case of Loan Default**

- 15 days after the date of default, the interest rate will be **adjusted to 9.5% per annum**.
- Thereafter, persistent default spanning 30 days and over will see you lose your existing credit score and your account frozen.
- Savings cannot be used to repay the loan; they will however be held until the customer pays the outstanding debts.
- Interest continues to accrue pegged on the in-duplum (double the amount) rule and recovery methods will be initiated.

# **How To Increase Loan Limit**

- Continue using Hustler Fund and repay your loan on time.
- Assessment of credit history on subsequent loan applications and repayment shall apply to determine subsequent qualifications for the facility.

# **Benefits of saving in the Hustler Fund**

- Customers will earn interest of up to 9% p.a. on their short-term savings balance.
- Government Matching: There is a one-time matching of 2:1 that was promised to all Kenyans who borrowed and saved within the fund. The GoK matching is capped at Ksh. 3,000. 

**Note:** Government matching is one-off and applies if the customer **long-term saving is at least Ksh.6,000.**

**How to save in Hustler Fund**

Two ways of savings:

- When you request a loan.
- Deposit /sending directly to your savings from your Mobile Money wallet. There is no limit to the number of deposits one can make and the limit is based on the mobile network limits.

# **Withdrawal/access to savings**

- Customers can access short-term savings any time after clearing their loan.
- The Minimum age that Pension (long term savings) can be accessed is 60 years.
- Customers who have attained 60 years or older will need to clear any outstanding loan first, then visit a Safaricom shop/Franchise/Caredesk with their original ID for claim of the long-term savings.
- A Service Request will be raised for 60+ years customers with ID attached to the ticket.
- Care Support Analyst teams will share the attached customer KYC details to PSDT Support who will liaise with our partners to facilitate transfer of Long-term savings to the Short-Term account.
- Customers will then be notified to access the transferred savings via the normal short-term savings journey.
- The Kenya National Entrepreneurs Savings Trust (KNEST) is the Pension Scheme ‘hustler’ customers will be put in.

**New Services Available**

With the Hustler Fund anniversary, we are introducing new functionalities to customers to better their experience and access to their funds.

Customers can use USSD \*254# or Hustler Fund Mini-App on M-PESA App to.

View Savings Balance-Both Long-term and Short-term savings.

Withdraw Short-Term Savings

Check Credit Limit.

**Statements**

- You will get a mini statement that shows the last 5 transactions.
- You can access this either through the **App** or **USSD** **(\*254#ok)** under savings.

**Reversals**

Reversals are not possible on the Hustler Fund Product for both saving and loan product.

**OPT OUT**

A customer cannot opt-out of Hustler Fund, however, after clearing their loan they can visit a Safaricom shop for the delinking of their current number.

Customers whose MSISDNs were recycled can repay using the Pay for other option available on \*254#ok and Mini-App(OneApp).

**Customer Support**

The customer can be assisted on matters arising by calling **line 100, 200 or 234, or other Safaricom Digital Care Channels.**

# **Monthly Booster Bundle**

The booster is designed to give customers extended value and flexibility when using their All in One and Data Only bundles.

# **Availability**

The booster will be accessible to all customers subscribed to **All in One** and **Data Only** products. It becomes available **before the expiry** of these main bundles, allowing users to top up their data without waiting for their current plan to end.

# **Purchase Requirements**

Customers can only buy the booster **after purchasing the main bundle**. This ensures that the booster functions as an add-on and not a standalone product.

# **Validity**

Once purchased, the booster **inherits the validity period** of the customer’s original All in One or Data Only bundle. This alignment ensures smooth and uninterrupted usage.

# **Multiple Purchases**

There is **no limit** to the number of times a customer can buy the booster. Users may purchase it as many times as needed, depending on their data consumption.

# **Non-Shareable**

The booster **cannot be shared or sambazad**. It is strictly for the use of the individual who purchased it.

# **Applicable Rules**

All existing rules governing **All in One**, **Data Only**, and general **mobile data services** will continue to apply to the booster. This ensures consistency across all data products.

articleTitle: M-PESA Activation Service After Sim swap
markdownContent:
**M-PESA Activation Service After SIM swap**

To safeguard our customers against fraud for SIM swap and start key requests, you will be required to check previous interaction at both Subscriber and customer level.

CEE should always check to ensure no interaction has been captured about the customer cautioning against performing sim swap or issuing start key within the last 30 days if there’s caution refer the customer to retail.

**How to Activate**

i.         Select activate on M-PESA menu

ii.         Enter their existing M-PESA PIN as the M-PESA PIN

iii.         Choose a new PIN \[which can be the same PIN they had before\]

iv.         Confirm their PIN

v.         Enter their Date of Birth (DOB) or ID No (same as ID used for registration).

**Sending the request to M-PESA**

The M-PESA system sends a menu to the new SIM with a welcome message indicating the customer's current balance.

**Customers can get the start key via the following channels**

IVR - if they are enrolled to Level II of Jitambulishe,

Calling 100/200 after 24hours from the time of replacement.

Visiting RC

**Suspended M-PESA Accounts**

For Customers whose account have been suspended, customers are required to visit Safaricom Retail Shop or Customer Care Desk to have the service resumed before the 24hrs are over.

The account will automatically be resumed after 24hrs, If still suspended after 24hrs the CEE shall raise a Service Request (SR) for support team to action SLA is 48hrs.

**NOTE**: Do not refer customer to Franchise shops as they do not have rights to unsuspend.

**M-PESA Activation with 7 digits ID** 

If the customer is not able to reactivate the account using the 7 digits ID number, then the DOB information can be given on call for the special cases where the date of birth on M-PESA system is indicated as below:

**DDMM2014:** We shall issue the DDMMYY since the details were edited because of data clean up on the system by default.

**0101YY:** If the customer gets the YY (year) right, the CEE will give the DD (Date) and MM (Month) and advise on activation. If the customer does not get the YY (Year) then escalate via the SR for the customer to be enabled to activate with the 7 digits ID **(****where the owner is the one calling).**

**3112YY:** If the customer gets the YY (year) right, the CEE will give the DD (Date) and MM (month) and advice the customer on activation. If the customer does not get the YY (year) then escalate via the SR for the customer to be enabled to activate with the 7 digits ID **(****where the owner is the one calling).**

If the customer has provided the correct 7-digit ID number but the DOB given is wrong and does not fall under the special cases listed above, **DO NOT** give the DOB on the system but raise an SR for the customer to be enabled to activate with the 7 digits ID.

**Note****:** After a SIM swap, the CEE shall proactively check on the DOB and ID number then advise on activation/Raise an SR in line with the tips above.

**Different Serial number**

If the serial number on G3 is different from the one on CRM check if the customer has done a SIM replacement and has not yet activated M-PESA. Guide the customer to first restart phone then activate M-PESA using the usual old M-PESA PIN and the new SIM serial will pick on G3.

If it fails to change, send the STK menu to sub through G3.

**Please Note**; Send the STK menu only if customer has already tried the activation of M-PESA first on his/her end.

# **Definition**

Roam Like Home bundles are mobile data resources that allow Safaricom outbound roaming customers to browse on data bundle when roaming in the **defined countries and networks**.

# **Purchase**

Customers will purchase either the 7 days, 14 days or 30 days bundles via Global Connect menu on \*444#ok, \*100#, or \*200#.

The bundles can be purchased/renewed/accessed at any time of the day.

# **Usage Rules**

To utilize the bundle, a Safaricom customer will need to be:

Outbound Roaming in a defined (eligible) country where the bundles are applicable (22 destinations across the world are currently eligible)

Be roaming on an eligible partner network in their destination country.

**Refer to the attached Destinations & Operators file to view the eligible destinations/countries and the eligible network operators****.**

# **Available Packages**

| Ksh2,000 | 3GB | 7 days |

 **Other Business Rules**

The bundles will not be usable **when NOT roaming**

A customer cannot use the bundles **when roaming on operators on default rates i.e. A14** or when roaming outside the eligible countries and operators (Please refer to the attached list of the eligible 22 destinations and networks).

# **EVA Personal Assistant**

EVA is your AI-powered personal assistant that answers calls on your behalf when;

When you are BUSY on another call

When you do not answer within the ring time

When your phone is UNREACHABLE (switched off, no network, or flight mode)

EVA talks to your callers in a natural, human-like voice, takes their message, and sends you an instant summary via SMS so you never miss important information.

# **How is EVA different from traditional voicemail?**

Unlike voicemail, EVA has a real two-way conversation with your callers! EVA uses a natural human-like voice, engages with callers, takes their message, and sends you a simple text summary. No need to dial in and listen to voice recordings.

# **Subscribe/unsubscribe** **to/from EVA**

Dial/Call 21000 from your Safaricom line and follow the voice prompts to select your preferred subscription pack. 

To unsubscribe, dial \*456\*20# from your Safaricom line or dial 21000 and follow the unsubscription flow by selecting the option to deactivate the service when prompted.

# **Definition**

- The SKIZA Tunes service is a personalized ring back tone service.
- The tune under Normal Skiza will be played to and heard by your callers (both Safaricom subscribers and callers on other local and international networks) from the time when the connection to your line is made until when you pick up or disconnect the call.
- The tune under my Skiza will allow the user to listen to their choice of tune when initiating a call.

**Eligibility**

- The SKIZA Tunes Service is available for both Post, Prepay and Cooperate customers (under Business tune) on Safaricom’s network.
- There shall be no registration for the SKIZA Tunes Service.
- SKIZA Tunes Service is not valid when a subscriber is out of the county or is on Safaricom’s roaming service.
- SKIZA Tunes Service is not valid for diverted calls, secondary lines for subscribers with dual SIM cards.

# **Types of Skiza**

# **Skiza tune**

This is set by the caller to entertain the calling subscriber.

# **My Skiza**

It allows the user to listen to their choice of tune when initiating a call.

# **My Skiza shuffle/Mix**

It’s a combination of a variety of Skiza tunes downloaded by the caller. It’s shuffled between the tunes. Well explained in the below questions.

**Question 1**: If I have both My Skiza and Skiza shuffle, which one takes precedence? They are all shuffled up. E.g. if you call someone, you will hear a My Skiza shuffle i.e. breaking news, then next time you make a call you hear Myskiza local song, then next time My Skiza international song. etc.

**Question 2**. How many tunes make the Skiza shuffle bundle? The only categories we have of My Skiza shuffle are Breaking news, sports news, bible verses, jokes of the day & inspirational and they can be subscribed all at once.

# **Skiza Business Tune**

- These are personalized tunes used to promote business.
- The tune will turn every call made to your business into an automated sales pitch, delivering a concise promotional message to customers.

# **Name tune**

- Name Tunes is a ring back tone service offering pre-recorded vocal definition of names, with a musical background tune to the subscribers.
- It works by way of customer subscribing to the Name Tune by simply dialing \*811#, selects Skiza Top Genres then My Name tune. Once a caller calls e.g. Mary, they will be entertained by a tune that accompanies the name and meaning of Mary as they wait for Mary’s response.

# **Skiza Billing/Charges**

 [Screenshot] 

**N/B:** The tune will be suspended if there is no enough airtime to enable renewal.

# **Micro-billing of Skiza tunes.**

Micro billing is a feature that will enable our active skiza customers to renew a skiza tune even when they have less than kes 1.00 balance in their accounts. it was first launched in 2019 but had to be discontinued due to lack of micro-billing reports leading to partner complaints.

# **How it works**

If a customer doesn’t have the full amount to renew a Skiza tune i.e. if a customer has KES. 0.9 Which is less than the kshs 1 subscription amount, we will charge the full KES 0.9 cts. We shall then attempt to recover the balance of kshs 0.1 cts during the next day. If the subscriber does not recharge during the day, we will suspend the tune the next night and write off the debt.

**Scenarios.**

 [Screenshot] 

# **Business Rules**

- When CBS charges CRBT daily renewal and the subscriber has insufficient funds, it will check what’s available and charge what the customer has and give the Skiza tune.
- When the subscriber recharges/gets airtime transfer, CBS will automatically trigger the CRBT balance payment to recover the debt that was not paid the previous day.
- CBS will try and recover the debt the next day therefore if customer tops up and had a debt of kes 0.1, we will therefore recover the debt then normal billing cycle will continue**( Refer to the table above).**
- If customer doesn’t top up we will suspend the tune during the next billing cycle i.e. midnight and write off the debt.
- For a customer with multiple tunes, the system renews the tones on a random basis.
- The Skiza service will be offered to all Safaricom Prepaid & Postpay customers.

# **Definition**

Ziidi Lock funds is setting aside a portion or all your funds on Ziidi to prevent unplanned spending. It adds a layer of control over your funds.

# **Benefits of locking funds in ZiiDi**

Helps to one protect their funds from unplanned spending.

Helps one to stay focused on their goals.

# **Channels available for Locking Funds on ZiiDi**

A customer can lock their investments via.

- The Ziidi mini-App on the M-PESA super app/ My OneApp
- USSD \*334#

# **How It Works**

- There is no transaction limit to how much can be locked or unlocked. However, the amount being locked or unlocked must be less than or equal to the amount in the Ziidi wallet.
- One can access locked funds whenever they need to, however, the unlocked funds will only be available/accessible **after 72 hours** from the time of unlocking.
- There is **NO** fees charged on locking and unlocking of invested fund on MALI.
- A customer can only lock less than or equal to the funds invested in their Ziidi wallet and **NOT** exceeding.
- One can only unlock less than or equal to the funds already locked.
- A customer can top up locked funds by adding more funds to the already locked funds without having to unlock.
- A customer cannot initiate new lock funds before the previous unlock is completed. For one to initiate a new lock funds request, any previous unlock transactions must be completed and funds disbursed successfully, or customer can cancel previous request.
- One can top up without locking the additional funds and these do not need to be locked.

# **Partial Unlock**

Partial unlock is a feature that allows ZIIDI Lock Funds customers to access part of their locked funds without needing to unlock all the locked funds.

# **Benefits**

Customers are able to access only the funds they need from the lock funds feature without needing to unlock all the funds.

# **Eligibility**

All active ZIIDI Lock Funds customers are eligible to use this feature.

# **Mechanics**

- The customer will be able to unlock to up to 70% of their current lock funds balance.
- The customer is also able to cancel a pending unlock request, both partial and full unlock requests
- When a customer cancels a request, they will need to initiate a new request to unlock their funds which means the unlock count down to maturity will commence afresh. So they will not be able to piggy back on the cancelled request remaining period. For example, if the cancelled request had 2 hours pending to maturity, the new request will not unlock in 2hrs but will start afresh at 72 hrs to maturity at the point of initiating the request
- The partial unlock feature is the same as the full unlock where, locking does not debit your Ziidi wallet and neither does unlocking credit the Ziidi wallet.

articleTitle: VIEW 360 – SIM SWAP for Call Center
markdownContent:
**Call Centre CEE – Step-by-Step SIM Swap Process on View360**

**Login**

CEE logs into View360 using SSO credentials.

**Customer Number & Search**

- Request for the MSISDN to be swapped from the caller.
- Search the MSISDN on View360.

**Customer Validation (Primary Vetting)**

- Request details from the customer’s valid ID.
- Validate (vet) using primary vetting details on View360.

**Mandatory Fields:**

- Full Names
- ID Number
- Year of Birth

**Outcome:**

- If vetting passes → Proceed.
- If vetting fails → Refer customer to Retail shop with original documents for further assistance.

**Initiate SIM Swap**

Navigate to: **Account Overview > Quick Actions > SIM Swap**

**Whitelisted Lines**

If MSISDN is on the SIM Swap whitelist (\**100\**100#):

- System will display an error that the customer is self whitelisted.
- Refer customer to Retail for assistance. Advise them to carry their original Registration Document.

**Non-Whitelisted Lines**

- System prompts for the calling number- enter the calling number.
- System performs checks on the calling number and displays the results as pass or fail.

**Checks on Calling Number**

**Swap History**

If number has been swapped in the last 72 hours:

- Decline the request.
- Refer customer to Retail OR advise them to call using an agent line.

**Age on Network**

If calling number is less than 30 days on the network:

- Decline and refer customer to Retail or nearest M-PESA agent.

**Line Status**

Calling number must be active on IN data.

**Calling Number on High Alert**Where the calling number is flagged as high alert, CEE should proceed with all other applicable verification checks and continue with the SIM swap journey in line with the approved process and controls.

**NOTE**: Do not advice customer to call from a different customer line or agent line.

**Agent Line on High Alert**Where the agent line used to contact the call centre is also flagged as high alert, CEE should proceed with all other required verification checks and, where the customer successfully passes the validations, proceed with the SIM swap request as per the approved process.

**Fraud Location**

If flagged as fraud location:

- Do NOT swap.
- Bar line.
- Refer to Retail for further validation.

**Frequency of SIM Swap Requests**

- The number calling will be allowed a maximum of two (2) SIM swap requests for other numbers in 24hrs. Where the calling number has two (2) other sim swap requests within the last 24hr, decline the request and refer the customer to retail or advise them to call from the agent.

**Merchant Till Handling**

- Treat merchant tills like ordinary lines:

- Up to two (2) requests in 24 hours.

- If more than two (2) requests:

- Caller must be on M-PESA Agent Tariff (Till MSISDN), OR
- Caller must be an M-PESA agent calling with their personal line.

**Important Note:**

- No interaction is logged on the calling number since it is not searched, and no data is exposed.

**Review Pre-Checks on Number to Be Swapped**

- System displays automated pre-check outcomes.
- CEE reviews outcomes and determines whether to proceed.

**Checks on Number to Be Swapped**

**Line Status (CBS)**

- Line must be active.
- If pooled/deleted, the system displays an error.

**Self-Whitelisted**

If line shows self-whitelist (\**100\**100#).  System will display an error that the customer is self whitelisted.

- For this, refer customer to Retail (Advise them to carry their original Registration Document).

**Line “On” or “Off”**

**If Off:**

- Proceed with vetting.

**If On:**

- If the caller is using the same MSISDN to reach us, advise the customer that the call will drop once the SIM swap is completed (e.g. for SIM upgrade).
- Vet thoroughly, confirm ownership and swap request, and decide whether to proceed.

**Lines to Refer Directly to Retail**

- Golden/Platinum numbers.
- Corporate postpaid lines.
- Roaming lines.
- Account is regulated.
- Line is in fraud location
- Line is on high alert
- Line is whitelisted

**Age on Network**

If line is less than two (2) days on the network:

- Refer customer to Retail.

**IPRS Check**

- Where verified → proceed.
- If not verified → refer to Retail.
- If pre-checks pass, click **Proceed**.

**Secondary Vetting**

If the agent proceeds, View360 displays Secondary Vetting details, which may include:

- FDNs
- GSM details
- M-PESA details
- M-PESA transactions
- Post-pay details

**How many secondary vetting details do i need to vet on?**

- A minimum of two categories must pass for successful vetting.
- Two correct Frequently Dialled Numbers (FDN’s) will count as one successful pass, and one additional pass must come from any of the remaining categories.

**Requirement:**

At least two (2) of the secondary checks must pass to proceed.

Other Categories for Vetting include:

·       GSM Details

·       M-PESA Details

·       M-PESA Transactions

·       Post pay Details

See screenshot below:

 [Screenshot] 

**If secondary vetting fails:**

- Journey ends, agent advises the customer accordingly
- Auto interaction logged.

**SIM Swap Execution**

If secondary vetting passes:

- Enter new SIMEX serial number.
- Click **Submit** to implement the SIM swap.

**Confirmation & Closure**

If swap succeeds:

- System displays a confirmation notification.

If swap fails:

- System displays the failure reason.

**Interaction Capture**

System logs auto interaction.

CEE must manually document:

- Customer primary and secondary vetting details.
- Swap outcome.
- Any relevant notes.

articleTitle: FINTECH 2.0 G3 Organization Reverse Refund Feature
markdownContent:
# **G3 Organization Reverse Refund Feature**

**Overview**

The **Organization Reverse Refund Feature** is a functionality introduced on the **M-PESA G3 Portal** to enable organizations to process refunds for transactions that were initiated and completed **before 1st July 2025**.

During the transition from G2 to G3, earlier transaction records were archived and not migrated into the new system. As a result, standard reversal mechanisms could not be applied to these transactions. This feature provides a controlled workaround for refunding such transactions.

**NOTE:**

- This feature is a **temporary workaround** for archived transactions
- Standard reversal channels should still be used for newer transactions

The G3 Organization Reverse Refund Feature is a critical capability bridging system migration gaps while maintaining strict governance. Proper role assignment, adherence to process, and emphasis on audit documentation are essential for its effective and secure use.

Please Find attached detailed SP and Org Guides

**Definition**

This is applicable where Enterprise Fiber customers experiences loss of service (LOS). The enterprise customer is automatically notified of service outages and restorations through their registered Technical Contacts via email and SMS reducing the need for inbound outage confirmation calls.

**Objective**:

- Support customers in planning their Business Continuity Plans (BCP)
- Reduce inbound demand to frontline teams during outages
- Improve overall customer experience through timely, proactive communication

**Mechanics**

1. Enterprise customer Fiber link goes down (Loss of Service).
2.  After 10 minutes of downtime, the customer automatically receives:

Email notification via Technical Contact.

SMS notification informing them of the service interruption.

3. Technical issue is resolved and service is restored.
4. Customer receives a resolution email confirming that services are back up.

**Business Rules**

The automated notifications apply to Fiber customers with either single or multiple passive connections

**Email Notifications**

Pre-requisites to sending the email notification include:

i.         That the link is active when the outage occurs

ii.         That outage has been caused by one of the following factors:

Fiber cut

Power failure

Installation hardware/software malfunction

SFC planned maintenance

Service degradation

The link/connection is active at the point of outage

The router is powered on

The contact email address will receive 2 emails:

i.         In the event of an outage/system downtime

Affecting only one customer

Affecting a certain region or entire Fiber customer base

ii.         In the event the issue causing the outage/system downtime has been resolved and the service is back up

The email will be automatically sent 10 minutes after the issue has been identified- this is to accommodate for situations where the outage is for a short period of time and auto-resolve in a few minutes

The email sent will have an unsubscribe option- If the customer selects the unsubscribe option, their email address will be automatically removed from the mailing list for the automated outage notifications

**SMS Notifications**

An SMS will be sent (to the technical contact person’s number captured during onboarding) in the event of the outage affecting only one customer and will contain the following information

i.         Contact person’s first name

ii.         That there is a connection issue affecting the specified customer

iii.         Opt-out option (Subject to Feedback)

**Email & SMS notifications**

**One link affected**

An automated email will be sent to the contact email address shared during onboarding

An automated SMS will be sent to the technical contact person’s number shared during onboarding

Both the email and SMS will be automatically sent 10 minutes after the issue has been identified- this is to accommodate for situations where the outage is for a short period of time and auto-resolves in a few minutes

**Multiple links affected**

Automated emails will be sent to the contact email addresses shared during onboarding

Automated messages will be sent to the technical contact person’s numbers shared during onboarding for each link

In the event the customer has a primary and secondary(redundancy) connection the automated emails will only be sent if both the links are down. This implies that email outage notifications will be suppressed if either one of the links is functioning/active

Both the email and SMS will be automatically sent 10 minutes after the issue has been identified- this is to accommodate for situations where the outage is for a short period of time and auto-resolves in a few minutes

articleTitle: SIM SWAP Process for 2nd Line Support (For Care Centre and Retail CEEs only)
markdownContent:
**Care Centre CEE will raise an SR if they encounter the following scenarios:**

i.         CRM/View 360 System outages

ii.         Status mismatch between Subscriber portal and IN Data

iii.         Backend error

**Retail CEE will raise an SR if they encounter the following scenarios:**

i.         Status mismatch between Subscriber portal and IN Data

ii.         Backend error

**What CEEs should include on the SR Notes:**  

i.         Vetting details

ii.         SIM serial

iii.         IMSI

iv.         Alternative contact number

v.         All the necessary scanned and stamped documents as per process

**NOTE: CEE should ensure that all the captured vetting details are correct.**

For customers on whitelist, Care Centre CEE should not swap but refer customer to main Retail Safaricom shop (not franchise).

**STEP BY STEP PROCESS FOR ANALYST**

i.         Confirm all the vetting details have been included and necessary documents attached.

ii.         Check that line is **NOT** on **fraud** location.

iii.         Confirm line is **NOT roaming.**

iv.         Check that line is not whitelisted.

v.         Check if line is on **M-KOPA**. For this, liaise with the relationship manager before proceeding with swap.

                 Once all these checks have been done.

vi.         Analyst will proceed with the swap.

vii.         Inform the customer on successful swap.

**NOTE**: **Analyst to** **Call the customer where some of the vetting details are missing.**

**P2P REVERSAL COMPLETION BY REVERSALS TEAM**

To complete the reversal transaction, the reversals admin team will call the recipient to get consent and for the P2P Cancelled, they will call the sender. The outbound call attempts will be in an interval of 20 minutes.

·       For amount below Ksh.1000 - call once

·       For amount between Ksh.1001-5000 - call twice

·       For amounts between Ksh.5001-20000 - call thrice

·       Amounts above Ksh.20000 - call five times.

**NOTE:** **This process applies for manual handling of reversals as well.**

**If the recipient is unreachable with the first attempt, CEE will send the message below**

*Dear customer, we are trying to reach you via 0722000000 regarding reversal of Ksh (amount). We will call you back, kindly pick. Thankyou.*

**NOTE****:** If the recipient is unreachable after the stipulated attempts, the CEE will COMPLETE the reversal. For P2P cancelled, if the sender is unreachable after the stipulated attempts, the CEE will CANCEL the reversal. 

**REVERSALS CANCELLED CAMPAIGN ON IVR AND ABOVE KSHS 1,000**

**Reversals - between Ksh 1,001 and Ksh 5,000:**

1\. ‎The sender will be called at least twice to get consent, and the calls will be at 20-minute intervals.

2.  If the sender is unreachable, CEE will send the message below:

***“Dear customer, we are trying to reach you via 0722000000 in regard to reversal of Ksh (amount). We will call you back, kindly answer. Thank you.”***

3\. The responsibility of sending the customer the message lies with the 1st CEE. **However, when handling 2nd to 5th attempts or on manual, the CEE will confirm that the SMS was sent on CRM. If none was sent, they will do so.**

4\. The auto dialer system will redial the customer after 20 minutes, the reversal transaction will be indicated as 2nd attempt.

5\. The second CEE will call the customer and if still unreachable, cancel the reversal transaction.

**Reversals between Ksh 5,001 and Ksh 20,000**

1.  The Sender will be called at least 3 times at intervals of 20 minutes to get consent.

2\.  The CEE will make the 1st call and if the sender is unreachable, the CEE will send the message below to the sender;

***“Dear customer, we are trying to reach you via 0722000000 in regards to reversal of Ksh (amount). We will call you back, kindly answer. Thank you.”***

3\.  The reversal transaction will be marked 2nd attempt on the auto dialer and offered to the next available CEE. The CEE will call the sender to get consent, if the sender is not reachable, the CEE will dispose the reversal transaction as ‘No Answer’, and the transaction will be re-queued to auto dialer.

4\.  After 20 minutes, the reversal request will be routed to the next available CEE (3rd attempt). If the sender is still not reachable, the CEE will cancel the reversal.

**Reversal of Funds above Ksh 20,000**

1. Sender will be called at least 5 times at 20-minute interval to get consent. If still not reachable on the 5th attempt, the reversal will be cancelled.

2\. The CEE will make the 1st call and if the sender is unreachable, the CEE will send the message below to the sender;

***“Dear customer, we are trying to reach you via 0722000000 in regards to reversal of Ksh (amount).We will call you back, kindly answer. Thank you.”***

3\. The reversal transaction will be updated as 2nd attempt and offered to the CEE on the outbound queue on the auto dialer.

4\.  If the customer is not reachable, the reversal transaction will be disposed accordingly i.e. 3rd attempt, 4th attempt, and 5th attempt.

5\. If after the 2nd, 3rd, 4th and 5th calls the sender is still not reachable, the CEE will cancel the reversal.

**DISPUTE MANAGEMENT PROCESS FOR THE REVERSAL ADMIN TEAM ONLY**

**Definition of dispute**

A dispute is any instance where the recipient declines a reversal request.

1.  CEE to engage hold and call the sender to establish the reason for the reversal.

**Where sender is unreachable:**

1\. ‎Check initiator notes for web-initiated reversals.

2\. Check status of sender’s line on CRM- could be barred, check key comment and interactions. Look out for lost/stolen line, fraud and robbery.

 **Where the sender is reachable**:

Do further troubleshooting as below:

1.  What was the intended name and MSISDN? These two should match on G3 and the sender must know both.

**NOTE:** Please note that it is possible for a customer to get these details using Hakikisha therefore use it in conjunction to other details.

2.      Where the sender has funds, there should be a transaction to the intended number.

**NOTE****:** Ensure that the amount sent to the correct number is the same as the one sent to the wrong number. Customers can send a smaller amount to the purported correct number so that they can defraud the recipient.

3.  Check G3 transaction history for a previous transaction to the correct number.

4.   What were the funds intended for? Specifics of the goods/services must be given including type, amount, frequency of transaction etc.

5. Both parties should give their location at the time of the transaction so that the CEE can confirm using logs.

**NOTE:** CEE MUST NOT disclose the location of either party to the other. The CEE can quote the distance to get consent, but not the name of the location.

6.    Is the recipient known to the sender? (Establish if there is any relation between the two parties by checking on CRM and/or M-PESA records).

 Where there is a relationship (family, business) cancel the reversal and advise them to resolve the issue.

7.     Should either party request for time to resolve the dispute, kindly allow the parties to resolve the dispute, inform them that we will call after 20 minutes. Where they mention the specific time, reschedule the call to that time. The CEE should NOT ask the parties to contact each other as a resolution. 

 **NOTE**: If the reversal admin CEE is unable to determine the ownership of the funds using the information availed and the recipient does not give consent, the reversal admin CEE will cancel the reversal, funds to remain with the recipient. The recipient will be advised to follow up with the sender or report the matter to the police.

**LNM (CBU/EBU/SMALL MERCHANTS REVERSAL COMPLETION)**

Reversal Admin team will receive the reversal via Autodialer. The calls will be made at 6hrs intervals.

1\. The COPS Reversal team will be required to call the finance contact / till / nominated number to seek consent before finalizing the reversal.

2.  Where consent is given, the CEE will complete the transaction.

3\. For unresponsive merchants on the 1st attempt, the CEE will send the below message to the till number.

***“Dear partner, we are trying to reach you via 0722000000 in regards to reversal of Ksh (amount). We will call you back, kindly answer. Thank you.”***

4\. Where consent is not granted the CEE will use the dispute process stipulated above and action the transaction accordingly.

In case the customer is unreachable and the merchant has disputed the transaction and there is no evidence to support the reversal, the CEE will cancel the reversal and advise the customer via SMS to report to the police.

***“Dear customer, your reversal request for TXN XXXXX was declined by the merchant. Kindly report to the police for further guidance. Thank you.”***

5. On instances where the merchant requests the CEE for an email while on the dialer; The COPS reversal team CEE will send the request to the manual allocations lead of the day who will in turn send the email to the merchant and follow up to closure. Details to capture include:

- Transaction ID:

- Merchant Name

- Contacts

- Email Contact

- Comment

6\.  Where the merchant does not give consent or is unreachable in the 2nd, and 3rd attempt, the CEE will dispose the call as ‘**No Answer’**

7\. On the 4th call attempt, (after 48 hours have elapsed) and the merchant is still unresponsive to calls, the merchant account of the affected store will be suspended and SMS sent to the merchant.

·       The suspension notes to be captured on Mpesa are; *Merchant suspended due to a pending reversal transaction XXXXXXXX.*

·        SMS to be sent will be as below;

***“Dear partner, your account has been suspended in regards to reversal of Ksh (amount). We will call you back, kindly answer. Thank you.”***

8\. On instances where the COPS reversal team is not able to get in touch with the merchant within 72hrs (5th Call attempt), The CEE will complete the reversal as per the guideline and mark the call as “Answer” and unsuspend the merchant.

 **WITHDRAWAL REVERSAL DISPUTES BY REVERSALS TEAM**

This is the process by which an M-PESA agent requests a CEE to cancel a reversal initiated from his till. This occurs where consent is not given i.e. the agent claims to have issued cash to the customer.

1. The reversal team will request for ID as recorded by the agent.
2. Confirm the location logs using the location register to determine whether the customer was within the same location as the agent at the time of the transaction.
3. If the two were within the same range, the reversal will be cancelled and advise the customer via call or SMS if unreachable.
4.  If the two were not in the same location, the reversal team will advise the agent and if the agent still insists cash was given, cancel the reversal and advise the customer.
5.  If there are no logs or logs are inconclusive, the reversal team will cancel the reversal as the money is considered safe with agent.

6.  Raise an SR for support team to probe further. The SLA will be 48 hrs. Capture the details below on the SR;

- Transaction ID.

- The name of the agent.

- The contact numbers.

- Indicate the customer’s documentation given. (Whether it is the correct ID or Wrong).

- Location logs: indicate whether location is the same or not, if inconclusive/unavailable indicate as such.

**NOTE:** Capture clear notes on the reason for cancellation.

**Agent not answering call: Amount above Ksh. 1001**

**Attempt 1**: Call the till the first time and if not answered, call the administrator/ the principal or the Head office primary till to get consent. If you do not reach any of the parties:

·       Confirm if the agent has been transacting (deposits) within the day, and if transacting, send the SMS with the transaction ID as below.

*“**Dear agent we are trying to reach you in regard to reversal of withdrawal transaction XXXXXXX, kindly answer your calls. Thank you’’***

**Attempt 2:** The dialer will present the transaction again after 2hrs. The CEE will call the till, if the call is not answered and the agent is still transacting (deposit), **FREEZE** the till.

**Attempt 3:** The dialer will present the transaction again after 2hrs. The CEE will call the till, if consent is given complete the reversal and unfreeze the till. Where the agent is still not reachable, the CEE will try to reach the administrator or head office. If all the contacts are unreachable, ensure the till remains frozen as you dispose the call as “No Answer “.

**Attempt 4:** The dialer will present the transaction again after 2hrs. The CEE will call the till, if consent is given complete the reversal and unfreeze the till. Where the agent is still not reachable, the CEE will try to reach the administrator or head office. If all the contacts are unreachable, ensure the till remains frozen as you dispose the call as “No Answer ".

**Attempt 5:** In cases where the agent is still not reachable at attempt 5, call the administrator / the principal or the head office primary till to get consent, if all unreachable, ensure the till remains frozen as you dispose the call as “No Answer ".

·       Where the agent has not been transacting, the reversal admin will attempt to reach the administrator and the head office on the contacts on M-PESA and complete the reversal if consent is given.

·       Where consent is not given i.e. the agent claims to have issued cash to the customer, the reversal team will request for the customers identification document as recorded by the agent, if the document ID is correct, The CEE will cancel the transaction and inform the customer on call. Where the customer is unavailable, The CEE will send a message through CRM.

***“Dear customer, your reversal request for TXN  XXXXX was declined by the Agent. Kindly report to the police for further guidance. Thank you.”***

·       Where the document ID is wrong or unavailable, the CEE will confirm the location logs using the location register to determine if the customer was within the same location as the agent at the time of the transaction.

·       If the two were within the same range, the reversal will be cancelled, if the customer still disputes the reversal, the customer will be advised to lodge a complaint with the police to handle the matter.

·       If they are not in the same location, complete the reversal and advise the agent to lodge a complaint with the police to handle the matter.

·       If there are no logs or the logs are inconclusive, the reversal team will cancel the reversal as the money is safe with agent, then proceed to raise an SR for the support team to probe further. The SLA will be 48 hrs. Capture the details below on the SR;

- Transaction ID

- The name of the agent

- The contact number

- Indicate the customer’s documentation given. (Whether it is the correct ID or Wrong)

- Location logs; indicate whether location is the same or not, if inconclusive/unavailable indicate as such.

markdownContent:
**M-PESA Services Improvements on ServiceNow Platform**

# **Overview**

Enhancements have been introduced to strengthen access controls, improve system efficiency, and reduce fraud exposure. These updates affect both user management and system access requests.

# **M-PESA User Management**

**Key Changes**

- Requests now categorized as **Service Provider (SP)** or **Organization (Org)**.
- Contractor access requires submission of a **pre-approved contract or supporting document**.
- Clear mapping of request types and actions by SP and Org classifications.
- Enforcement of **Maker-Checker approval process** by LNM Support for new Organization Business Administrator requests.
- Support for **single and bulk creation** of Business Administrator requests.
- Addition of a **complete list of nationalities** for user creation, aligned with document ID requirements.

# **M-PESA System Access Requests**

*(Exclusive for SP Users/Internal Org Short Codes)*

**Key Changes**

- Renaming of **M-PESA Requests** to **M-PESA System Access Requests**.
- Requests categorized as **Service Provider (SP)** or **Organization (Org)**.
- Clear mapping of request types/actions for access requests to internal shortcodes.
- Introduction of a **Division field** for role mapping.
- Contractor access requires pre-approved contract or supporting document.
- Addition of missing roles: **M-PESA G3, Statement Portal, Business Portal**.
- Integration of linked roles: **ZiiDi, UFAA, Term Loan, Payment Aggregator**.
- Role selection in G3 now includes existing roles when choosing “Change Role” or “Add Role.”
- Introduction of **Access Periods** in G3 for temporary roles.
- Requirement to attach relevant approval documents where applicable.
- Movement of **M-PESA Service Requests** to a new landing page for improved navigation.

# **Impact**

These changes streamline access request handling, improve governance, and enhance security by ensuring proper documentation, categorization, and automated role retirement.

**Pamoja Play.**

Pamoja Play is a casual gaming platform that allows customers to play games and win prizes.

**Eligibility.**

Pamoja Play is available exclusively to Safaricom subscribers within Kenya who are 18 years of age or older. Tiland Limited may request proof of age and identity before awarding any prizes.

**How to subscribe to Pamoja Play.**

This platform can be accessed through \*499#, \*544\*36# or [https://pamojaplay.co.ke](https://pamojaplay.co.ke). To unsubscribe dial \*456\*20#

**Charges.**

Pamoja Play costs KES 15 per day, deducted directly from your Safaricom airtime or post-paid account. You can also access the service using Safaricom data bundles.

**How to access.**

After subscription, click on the Game of the week or Game of the month on the web homepage while connected to the Safaricom network or dial the USSD code. Your subscription fee will be automatically deducted from your airtime.

**How to earn points.**

You earn points through active gameplay, frequent visits, and time spent on the platform. You get 50 points for every 5 minutes of active session time. Your leaderboard ranking also contributes to your rewards.

**Prizes to be won.**

Currently only airtime is available. Other prizes weekly and monthly prizes will be available later (***Data bundles. At the end of the 90-day campaign, the top-ranked eligible user wins a grand cash prize of KES 300,000. Smartphones are also up for grabs).***

Leaderboards are updated automatically and reset on weekly and monthly cycles. The overall campaign runs for 90 days, after which the grand prize winner is determined.

Pamoja Play is operated by Tiland Limited and is conducted under a license from the Betting Control and Licensing Board (BCLB) of Kenya. All promotions comply with Kenyan regulations.

All prizes are subject to withholding tax as per the Laws of Kenya. Prizes are also non-transferable and cannot be exchanged for other items unless specified by Tiland Limited.

Reach out to Tiland Limited at 0791 615 176 or email info@tiland.co.ke for any queries, disputes, or support requests.

**Definition**

This is an all-in-one digital platform for managing every M-PESA business service with speed, ease, and confidence.

bring all M-PESA business services currently spread across multiple platforms such as the Business Portal, Bill Manager, SurePay, and others, into one unified portal. This single, streamlined platform will give customers seamless access to all services with just one login, eliminating the complexity of managing multiple accounts and delivering simpler, more efficient experience.

**What does the M-PESA for Business Hub Offer?**

a)   Paybill, Business Till and B2C business to consumer **shortcodes application** for limited liability companies  

b)   **Transactions & account management** - Create and manage user accounts, Initiate and approve transactions, including disbursements, reversals, bank settlements, and View/download statements and other reports.

c)   Support ticketing service – **Raise support tickets** directly from the portal, with trackable timelines.

d)    **Discover other M-PESA business produc ts** and services through a well-designed catalogue.

 **Benefits of the M-PESA for Business Hub****?**

The M-PESA Business Hub puts everything an organization needs in one secure place, to enable them to work faster, smarter, and more efficiently, including:

a)   Instant digital onboarding – Get Paybill, Buy Goods and B2C business to consumer short codes online and go live faster

b)   One powerful portal – Run all M-PESA business services from a single, seamless platform

c)   Smart automation, lower costs – Eliminate manual processes with zero portal access fees

d)   Real-time financial intelligence – Track transactions and cash flow instantly to stay in control

e)   Enterprise-grade security – Protect business with robust controls and flexible approvals

f)     24/7 dedicated business support – Always-on support to keep operations running without interruption

 **How customers can get started in minutes:**

1. Visit [https://hub.m-pesaforbusiness.co.ke](https://hub.m-pesaforbusiness.co.ke)
2. Click ‘Create Account’ to get started with name, email, and phone number
3. Check activation email sent to confirm to set a password
4. Go back to homepage and log in
5. Click ‘Add Entity’ and enter the short code to start powering payments

**Organization Training**All customers requiring training are kindly requested to send an email to [M-PESATraining@safaricom.co.ke](mailto:M-PESATraining@safaricom.co.ke) . Alternatively, you may submit the request on their behalf, ensuring you include the organization short code, email address, and telephone number to support effective planning and coordination. 

The **Voice, SMS & Data Bundles** purchase feature for M-PESA shortcodes directly from the M-PESA Business Hub has been newly added

This feature on will enable organizations/merchants to purchase GSM resources for MSISDNs in bulk. This will allow organizations recycle E-value collected in their shortcodes.

This feature is available to Paybills(C2B), Bulk payment (B2C), One Account and Buy Goods shortcodes.

**How it works:**

- A user with Business Manager or Web Operator role logs in to M-PESA Business Hub(MBH).
- The user selects Voice, SMS & Data Bundles tab and proceeds to select the desired bundle.
- User downloads an excel template and populates it with employees’ details and re-uploads the file for processing. The template contains the following fields: -

\-        Mobile number

\-        Name

\-        Document type and Document number (optional for validation)

- User specifies the shortcode to deduct the total amount from and submits the request.
- Upon submission, the amount is deducted and resources awarded to the uploaded mobile numbers.

**Issuing PUK for Individual Customers**

**Prepaid**

- When customers call requesting for PUK, query customer MSISDN on Siebel
- For all customers who come through and request a PUK, ensure you resolve the PUK issue first then educate on the DIY.

The process is as follows:

- Customer gets through to an agent and requests a PUK.
- Perform the required vetting to ascertain ownership.
- Provide the customer with the PUK and advise on how to use it.
- Advise the customer on the DIY solution.
- Send the customer the DIY SMS

**“****To get PUK for the blocked line, dial \*100# from a different** **line, select Get PUK number or click** [**https://safaricomapp.page.link/get-puk.**](https://safaricomapp.page.link/get-puk.%C2%A0) **“**

**Repeat caller procedure for PUK not working:**

- CEE will **confirm from the interactions /the customer**, the last time he/she called for a PUK or if customer has the PUK.
- The CEE will probe the **customer to confirm the PUK the customer is using** and confirm **sim is not already damaged.**
- If the PUK is the same as what we have on Siebel, **request for the SIM Serial and use it to confirm if the customer is using the correct MSISDN.** If the Serial do not match, the CEE will advise customer on sim replacement.
- **If the customer is using the wrong PUK** then the agent will **VET** the customer and if successful will give the correct PUK.
- If the **MSISDN Matches** with the SIM Serial, **advise the customer to try on a different handset and if unsuccessful, to do a SIM Swap** should resolve the issue.

**N.B.**

- After successful vetting and issuance of the PUK, **CEE will be required to send an SMS with the Customers PUK to the calling number via the CRM SMS tool** at the end of the call. This is to minimize on the error the customer may make in writing down the number or remembering to unblock PUK steps resulting in a repeat call.
- Ensure you **get customer consent before sending PUK**. One can also advice customer to delete SMS after reading, as PUK is a security number.
- The template already exists on CRM SMS hence minimal editing will be required.

**Postpaid Individual and Platinum Influencers**

- **VET** customer as per the current vetting procedure and issue PUK.
- **Seek consent to also send the PUK via SMS** to the calling number.
- Advise customer on DIY procedure.
- **Where the customer’s ID was erroneously captured during registration** i.e. a zero was added at the beginning or the end of the ID number, vet the customer then issue the PUK. Advise the customer to visit retail/care desk to rectify the ID error.
- If a **customer does not know their number**:

- Request for the **Serial Number** of the blocked SIM Card.
- **Query the Serial Number in Siebel** under Number Management to access the customer’s MSISDN.
- **Vet** the customer as per set guidelines and issue PUK.
- Advise the customer on **USSD of how to confirm their number**, by dialing \*456#> select Find>"My Account" >My Number to know their MSISDN.

**Issuing PUK to Corporate Clients**

**Corporate line Registered on M-PESA**

- When a customer calls on a corporate line which is **Registered on M-PESA you can VET and issue PUK.**
- **VET** customer on the below details:

Full names as per the M-PESA system

Kenyan National ID card/ Valid Kenyan Passport/ Military ID/ Alien ID/ Diplomatic ID as per the M-PESA system

Current MPESA Balance

- If customer gets all these vetting details, **issue PUK verbally** and Seek consent to also send the PUK via SMS to the calling number.

**Corporate line NOT Registered on M-PESA**

- If line is **NOT registered on M-PESA**, request the customer to let the contact person contact us.
- The contact person sends us an email from the **registered billing email** **address** authorizing issuing of PUK through **advantage@safaricom.co.ke/customercare@safaricom.co.ke**.
- On successful confirmation that the email used is the registered billing email on CRM **issue PUK** and indicate the notes on interactions on Siebel.
- **NB**: For a request made from any other address apart from the billing Email address **(Applicable to prepaid numbers with no billing address)** Advice the contact person/ customer to sends us a stamped letter with company letter head via email authorizing issuing of PUK through [advantage@safaricom.co.ke/customercare@safaricom.co.ke](mailto:advantage@safaricom.co.ke/customercare@safaricom.co.ke).

**Issuing PUK for a Safaricom Staff Line**

Safaricom Staff Line Main Product/ Tariff Plan include:

- Staff Business Tariff for Postpaid,
- Staff Business Hybrid Tariff or
- SFC Staff Prepay Tariff on prepay
- Primary Contact: includes Staff/ EK Number
- Customer: Safaricom Limited

When a Safaricom member of staff requests for PUK they shall be vetted on:

Original Staff ID and National ID

CEE shall verify ownership and validity of employment on internal systems such as outlook and/or Staff Directory. Vet the customer on:

Full names as per the M-PESA system

Current M-PESA Balance

After successful verification, CEE issues PUK and advises on usage.

**Jitambulishe Verified Call**

 [Screenshot] 

**Call NOT Verified on Jitambulishe:**

If Staff provides any four of the below vetting details, the CEE will proceed to issue the PUK, and advice on DIY.

- Staff’s Name (Mandatory)
- EK / Staff Number (Mandatory)
- Official Email Address
- Office Extension
- FDN
- M-PESA Details: National ID| DoB |M-PESA Balance | last self-initiated transaction

**If the Staff cannot provide vetting details, ask them to send their request on email** to **CMCCSPostpaid@Safaricom.co.ke**, from their business (outlook) email, or **visit Safaricom Retail shop**, or to raise the request through their Departmental PA.

Ensure you enter the vetting details on Siebel Interactions. All vetting information should be displayed on the interaction comments field, under the number whose PUK Access/ Replacement action was done.

Gives alternative channels of getting the PUK, such as **USSD \*456#, IVR, Selfcare, Safaricom App, Zuri.**

**Definition**

Reseller Product is a FTTH proposition targeting customers who are hitting their FUP on both Diamond and Platinum plans and have been whitelisted as resellers. It is also referred to as **Diamond Promax** with **speeds of 500mbps** and **FUP** capped at **70TB**

**Eligibility**

Selected customers on **Diamond** and **Platinum** FTTH plans who have been identified as resellers are **whitelisted** to access the service. Customers on Bronze, Silver, Gold, Fiber lite 7mbps and Fiber lite 5mbps FTTH plans do not qualify.

**Onboarding**

For diamond or platinum FTTH customers with no product (have failed to renew their current plans) The product can be purchased by dialling **\*400#ok>Home Fibre>Pay>Fibre> Diamond Pro Max 500Mbps**. For customers on Diamond or Platinum plans, they will have to change the plan by dialling **\*400#ok>Home Fibre>Change Plan>Confirm change plan>Fibre>Diamond Promax 500mbps.**

**NB:**

·       Reseller Customers with no product can only subscribe **to Diamond, Platinum and Diamond Promax plans.**

·       If a reseller customer has a **Diamond plan** and they wish to change plan, they can only subscribe to **Platinum** **or Diamond Promax** plans.

·       For a reseller customer on **Platinum plan**, and they wish to change plan, they can only subscribe to **Diamond** **Promax plan.**

·       A customer on **Diamond Promax Plan** cannot change plan i.e. **cannot** **downgrade** to any other product/plan

**Mechanics**

**What happens if I am on Diamond or Platinum plans and I want to upgrade to Diamond Promax?**

 For whitelisted customers on Diamond or Platinum plans, proration takes place when they are upgrading to Diamond Promax plan mid cycle. This means depending on the balance left for their existing plan, it will be credited back to their CI and then pay the difference to total **sh 42,000**. However, proration does not take place for customers who had paid for the initial plan either Diamond/Platinum via post pay limit.

**If I have subscribed to the Diamond Promax plan, will I be able to downgrade/change plan?**

No. Once a customer is on the Diamond Promax plan, they cannot downgrade or change a plan.

**FUP Cap on Platinum & Diamond Customers**

In line with the Business needs and to continue providing our customers with best internet experience, we have updated our Fair Usage Policy (FUP) for Diamond and Platinum FTTH customers

The FUP has been implemented for FTTH Platinum and FTTH Diamond customers whose usage has been capped at 70TB each per monthly cycle

3. Affected customers will be able change plan to start a New cycle.
4. FUP will be implemented for both existing and New customers

**Definition**

Is new digital onboarding platform that guides customers on the connection process from checking coverage, purchase of plan, to installation and feedback.          

 **How to check if fiber internet is available at my location and request for connection**

You can check coverage using our interactive website [](https://neo-internet.safaricom.co.ke/)[https://neo](https://neo-internet.safaricom.co.ke/)[\-](https://neo-internet.safaricom.co.ke/)[internet.safaricom.co.ke](https://neo-internet.safaricom.co.ke/)[.](https://neo-internet.safaricom.co.ke/) Simply enter your address or drop a pin on the map to confirm availability, if covered you can then proceed to select your preferred plan and continue with the next steps of the order

 **If my location is not covered yet**

We will give you alternative conventionality options on 5G or 4G Wi-Fi fulfilled via our e-commerce platform here [](https://www.masoko.com/routers)[https://www.masoko.com/routers](https://www.masoko.com/routers)

**Do I need to register an account to get connected?**

Yes. For new customers, registration is required before selecting a plan. Existing customers can use their stored profile.

**What information do I need to register as a new Customer?** 

New customers will need to provide:

•        Full Name

•        National ID / Alien No or Passport Number

•        Phone Number

•        Email Address

A One Time Password (OTP) will be sent to your phone number for verification.

**I’m an existing customer. Do I need to register again?**

No. If you’ve used our services before, your data will auto-populate when you log in with your verified number. We will send you a One Time Password on your registered line for confirmation.

 **Do I get a router when I subscribe?** 

Yes. All fiber plans include a free router

 **Is payment required before installation?**

 Yes. Payment must be completed before you can book your installation slot.

**Will I be charged again if I reschedule installation?** 

No extra charges apply for rescheduling, but preferred will be based on availability, we will offer the list of available slots then you select what best works for you.

**How do I book an installation?** 

After payment, you’ll be prompted to select a preferred date and time for installation through the website. Availability of slots are based on Service Level Agreements.

**How long does it take to get installed?**

Installation is typically completed within 48HRs of booking. You will be able to view the status of your order on your dashboard. the Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) to your home

**How will I know when the technician is arriving?**

Once the technician picks the ticket you will be able to view your ticket showing:

•                 Technician’s live location

•                 Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA)

•                 Technician’s name and contact info

**What if I miss the technician's visit?**

You’ll need to reschedule from the dashboard, subject to available slots.

**What can I do from my customer dashboard?**

From your dashboard you will be able to view:

•                 Your plan details

•                 Track installation

•                 Reschedule appointments

•                 Monitor technician arrival

Provide feedback post-installation

**What happens after installation?**

Once the technician completes installation, the ticket will be closed in the system, and your internet service will be activated immediately. You will receive your username and password, log in and conduct a speed test with the technician to confirm your Fibre link up time.

**What is my account number?**

Your account number will be issued upon payment and communicated to you via SMS and will also be visible on your dashboard.

**How can I change my username or Password?**

Go to My Safaricom App > Home Internet > Home Fibre > Manage account to change your default username and password. If you encounter any challenges, Call 400 for assistance from one of our support team members.

**Is my personal information safe?**

Yes. We follow strict data protection protocols in line with national regulations to keep your information secure.

**How will I know my subscription is due for renewal?**

We will send you SMS notifications for your due date. Additionally, you can view your account status on My Safaricom Home App under the Home internet tab.

**How to Upgrade or Downgrade plan**

You can change your package on the day of renewal. You will be able to change your subscription by going to mySafaricom App > Home Internet > change plan or by dialling \*400# and following the prompts. NOTE: When you change your subscription before your renewal date new, package will take effect and you will forgo the remaining days on the current subscription

# **Definition**

M-Pesa Ratiba is a standing order service that allows automatic deduction of a fixed amount from your M-PESA account to pay your Postpay bill. It is designed to simplify bill payments by ensuring they are made consistently over a selected duration of 3, 6, or 12 months.

# **How It Works**

Once activated, M-Pesa Ratiba deducts an agreed fixed amount from your M-PESA account at regular intervals to settle your Postpay bill. The amount is usually aligned with your Postpay plan, ensuring seamless payments without the need for manual intervention.

# **Activation Process**

To activate M-Pesa Ratiba:

- Dial \*200#
- Select **Option 8: M-Pesa Ratiba (NEW)**
- Choose **Opt In**
- Select your preferred duration (3, 6, or 12 months)
- Confirm and enter your M-PESA PIN

You will receive a confirmation SMS once the setup is successful.

You can also activate it while subscribing to an Emerald Postpay plan by selecting **M-PESA (Standing Order)** as your payment method. An STK Push will be sent to authorize the setup.

# **Eligibility**

M-Pesa Ratiba is available to customers using:

- PostPay plans 

This service is **zero-rated for Postpay payments**.

**NOTE:**

- You cannot activate M-Pesa Ratiba during Emerald Postpay subscription
- The first payment must be made via M-PESA
- After that, you can set up Ratiba for future payments

# **Account Management**

You can check your standing order status at any time:

- Dial \*200#
- Select **M-Pesa Ratiba (Option 8)**
- Choose **Account Status**

This will display details such as the deducted amount and validity period.

# **Duration and Validity**

The standing order remains active for the selected period:

- 3 months
- 6 months
- 12 months

You will receive a notification showing the start and end dates after activation.

# **Opting Out (Cancellation)**

To cancel M-Pesa Ratiba:

- Dial \*200#
- Select **Option 8: M-Pesa Ratiba**
- Choose **Opt Out**
- Enter your M-PESA PIN to confirm

A notification will be sent once the cancellation is successful.

# **Impact on Your Postpay Plan**

Opting out of M-Pesa Ratiba only cancels the automatic payments. Your Postpay plan remains active, meaning you will need to pay your bills manually each month.

# **Plan Termination**

You can terminate your Postpay plan while on M-Pesa Ratiba, but you must:

- Clear any outstanding bill
- Acknowledge that the standing order will be automatically cancelled

After termination, your line will revert to the Uwezo Tariff.

# **Handling Bill Variations**

If your Postpay bill exceeds the standing order amount:

- The system will deduct only the fixed agreed amount
- You will need to pay the remaining balance manually via Paybill 200200
- Alternatively, you can adjust your standing order by changing your Postpay plan

# **Manual Bill Payment**

If you do not have a standing order, you can still pay your Postpay bill:

- Dial \*200#
- Select **Bill Payment**
- Choose your preferred payment option (M-PESA or Standing Order)

# **Changing Your Postpay Plan**

To upgrade or downgrade your plan:

- Dial \*200#
- Select **Change Your Plan**
- Follow the prompts

Note: Any existing bill must be cleared before changing your plan.

# **Multiple Postpay Plans**

Customers with more than one Postpay plan will be required to:

- Combine all plans into a single standing order amount
- Confirm the total amount during setup

This ensures all plans are covered under one Ratiba arrangement.

# **Default Standing Order Amount**

For Postpay users, the default M-Pesa Ratiba amount automatically matches the value of their selected Postpay plan.

# **Applicable Rules and Conditions**

All existing post paid rules remain unchanged.
