# **Change of notification number**

Where customer makes request to change the router MSISDN mapped to their account / router, the CEE shall advise the Customer that only the registered number can make the request.

Where request is made by the current receiving notification MSISDN and the same is not the owner of the account or where account owner requests for change of notification number.

Where the customer contacts other channels other than L400 within call center i.e. L200/100, social media etc., the CEE will send a request via SR to L400 and assign D\_FTTH\_USER for line 400 support team to action, and will advise the registered customer available channels i.e. email or call via L400. SLA is 24 Hrs.

# **Device returns**

Where the customers return a faulty device within warranty, the CEE shall book the device for repair and advise on 7days SLA. 

**Change of ownership**

Where customer requests for transfer of account from one individual to another, the CEE shall confirm as below.

**Request presented by previous owner and new owner**

Where the previous owner (donor) and the recipient have visited the retail center, the CEE will request the customer(s) to: -

Fill the FTTH transfer of ownership request form or provide a written request, clearly indicating details of the requested change. The letter should entail: -

·       Customers full name. (For New and previous owner)

·       Mobile number / account being transferred.

·       ID numbers. (For New and previous owner)

·       Signature of both parties, agreeing to the terms of the change.

Present their original valid ID.

Present original and valid ID of new owner.

The CEE will vet customer to validate ownership, by vetting customer request against Siebel CRM / Partner App, as per the vetting procedure.

Where customers i.e., donor and recipient present request at different retail outlets, the request shall be honored and only completed upon filling relevant forms and presenting the applicable KYC by both customers.

CEE will effect changes by doing a pre to pre, once validation is done.

CEE will attach customer request and both IDs on Siebel CRM, create an interaction and order relate the attachments and file as per the filling procedure.

1. CEE will send an email to [safaricomhome@safaricom.co.ke](mailto:safaricomhomeretention@safaricom.co.ke) and indicate the customer’s name, ID, mobile number, and email.

1. The Team on Safaricom Home email will update customer details on the applicable sales portal, whitelist the new contact to line 400, and raise a request to map the new contact for notification to Home customer support Team.

**Request presented by intended recipient of account**

 Where the new owner presents request on behalf of the registered customer, CEE will request customer for:

A duly filled FTTH change of ownership form or a written request by the previous owner detailing the need to change ownership of the line from him/herself to the new owner. The letter should entail: -

·       Customer full names. (For New and previous owner)

·       Mobile number / Account being transferred.

·       ID numbers. (For New and previous owner)

·       Signature of both parties, agreeing to the terms of the change.

Present their original valid ID.

Present original and valid ID of registered customer.

Provide an alternative Safaricom contact number of the previous owner (donor).

The CEE will confirm the validity of the request by contacting the previous owner on the contact number provided for vetting and will apply secondary vetting.

The mobile account used to validate request for the donor, must be a Safaricom account, registered to the same customer as registered on the FTTH 4G account. CEE will validate the document ID provided, registered names etc.

The contact number should not have been replaced within the last 48hrs and shall be registered and used in the network for at least one month.

CEE will notify the previous owner that the change discharges Safaricom from any liability relating to transfer.

The CEE will vet by screening customer request against customer account details.

CEE will effect changes by doing a pre to pre, once validation is done.

Where customer fails vetting CEE will politely advice accordingly.

CEE will attach customer request and both ID’s on Siebel CRM, create an interaction and order relate the attachments and file as per the filling procedure 

1. CEE will send an email to [safaricomhome@safaricom.co.ke](mailto:safaricomhomeretention@safaricom.co.ke) and indicate the customer’s name, ID, mobile number, and email.

1. The Team on Safaricom Home email will update customer details on the applicable sales portal, whitelist the new contact to line 400, and raise a request to map the new contact for notification to Home customer support Team.

# **Definition**

The **Kenya National Entrepreneurs Savings Trust (KNEST)** is a government-backed **Savings and Pensions scheme** regulated by the Retirement Benefits Authority (RBA).

It was created to provide **structured savings, investment, and retirement solutions** for all Kenyans, especially informal sector workers, micro-entrepreneurs, and hustlers who are often excluded from formal financial & pensions systems.

# **KNEST and Hustler Fund**

KNEST complements the **Hustler Fund** by managing the **long-term savings component** of Hustler Fund loans (70%).

When you borrow from Hustler Fund, 5% of the loan is set aside for savings. 70% of the savings amount (long-term savings) is automatically sent to KNEST.

All existing long-term hustler fund savings balances will move to KNEST, and all future loan-linked savings are credited directly to KNEST.

KNEST ensures these savings are **secure, invested, and growing with interest** — giving you a reliable safety net for the future.

# **How It Works**

1. **Opt-in:**

Hustler Fund customers are automatically onboarded to KNEST.

New customers join by dialing \*254# and selecting KNEST.

2. **Save/Deposit:** Savings can be done voluntarily via \*254#ok or saved automatically through Hustler Fund during loan request.

For every amount you voluntarily save through KNEST: 70% is allocated to your long-term savings account while 30% is allocated to your short-term savings account.

# **Interests**

Long-term savings will earn interest at 7.4% per annum compounded daily. Customers can track interest earned via mini statement on \*254#.

# **Withdrawals:**

I.         KNEST Short-term savings: Can be withdrawn anytime but first deposit is locked for 30 days.

II.         Long-term savings (**KNEST and Hustler Fund**): Withdrawals are allowed after 5 years or upon reaching age 50.

# **Opt Out:**

Once a user withdraws both their long-term and short-term savings, they can opt out of KNEST. The opt-out journey is being integrated on USSD.

# **Other Features**

- **One account per customer** (linked to your ID and mobile number).
- **70/30 savings split** on all KNEST voluntary savings

- **70% Long-Term Savings (KNEST):** Locked until you turn 50 or locked for 5 years if you join at the age above 45 years.
- **30% Short-Term Savings:** There is a 30-day lock-in period after your first deposit, after which you can withdraw anytime through USSD for all subsequent withdrawals.

- **Integration with Hustler Fund:** When you borrow from Hustler Fund, 5% of the loan is set aside for savings. 3.5% of this amount (long-term savings) is automatically sent to KNEST. All existing long-term savings balances move to KNEST, and all future loan-linked savings are credited directly to KNEST.
- **Transaction Limits:** You can save from a minimum of Ksh.50 up to a maximum of Ksh.250,000 per single transaction. Maximum you can save within a day is Ksh.500,000.
- **Easy access:** Dial \*254# to opt-in, deposit, withdraw, beneficiary management and check balances.

**Note:** **KNEST manages only Hustler Fund long-term savings. Hustler Fund short-term savings remain under Hustler Fund and are managed directly there.**

# **Key Benefits**

- **Government-backed & regulated** – Regulated and licensed by the RBA.
- **Savings growth** – Earn attractive interest on both long-term and short-term savings.
- **Flexibility** – Short-term savings are accessible anytime via USSD \*254# (after 30-day lock period).
- **Transparency** – Track balances and interest growth instantly through USSD or statements.

KNEST is more than just a savings account — it is a **pathway to financial freedom, retirement security, and a dignified future.**

articleTitle: Bridge Loan Definition, Features and Mechanics
markdownContent:
# **Definition**

Bridge Loan is a Hustler Fund product designed for reliable Hustler Fund borrowers who have a proven track record of timely repayments.

It offers **enhanced loan limits**, **longer repayment period** and structured savings opportunities to **reward good repayment behavior**.

# **Who qualifies for Bridge Loan?**

Good repeat borrowers with a favorable Hustler rating are eligible for the Bridge Loan.

# **Accessing**

All eligible customers can access the Bridge Loan by dialing \*254# or through the Hustler Fund mini app on the mobile money app.

# **Loan Term**

The loan term is 30 days, meaning the loan must be repaid within 30 days from the disbursement date.

# **Bridge Loan interest rate**

8% per annum for the first 30 days.

From day 31 onwards, the interest rate is 9.5% per annum.

# **What happens if a borrower defaults on a Bridge Loan?**

Borrowers who fail to repay within the 30-day term will incur an additional 1.5% interest per annum in the outstanding balance. They may also need to improve their repayment habits to regain eligibility for future loans.

# **How do I know my Bridge Loan limit?**

After opting in, you will receive an SMS confirming your successful registration and your new loan limit.

Alternatively, you can check your limit by:

i.         Dialing \*254# and selecting Check Limit under Bridge.

ii.         Viewing it on the Hustler Fund mini-app.

# **Disbursement**

When a loan is approved, 95% of the loan amount is sent directly to the borrower’s M-PESA account, while the remaining 5% is allocated to savings.

# **Savings**

Upon disbursement, 5% of the loan amount is deducted upfront and allocated as follows:

1.5% to short-term savings.

3.5% to long-term savings.

# **Checking Savings**

·       Via USSD: Dial \*254#, select Hustler Fund, then choose Savings to check your balance.

·       On the App: Access the Hustler Fund mini app to view your balance, with an option to hide or unhide it.

# **Benefits of the savings allocation**

Encourages financial discipline, helps build an emergency fund, and supports long-term financial planning and security.

**Can I borrow or opt into the Bridge Loan if I have an outstanding personal loan?**

No, you must first repay any outstanding Hustler Fund personal loan to access the Bridge loan.

**Can I request for Hustler Fund personal loan if I have an outstanding Bridge Loan?**

No, you must first repay any outstanding Bridge loan before being eligible to request for a personal loan.

**Can I request a Bridge Loan if I have not repaid an outstanding loan but have not utilized my full limit?**

No, you must repay any outstanding loan in full before requesting another loan, regardless of whether you have utilized your entire limit or not

# **Repayment & Repay for other**

The following customers can now repay a Bridge Loan for someone else:

1. Bridge Loan customers
2. Hustler Fund but non-Bridge Loan Customers
3. Non–Hustler Fund customers

The repayment journey is available on \*254# under Hustler Fund (see attached for more details).

articleTitle: Till Self SIM Swap (Lipa na M PESA)
markdownContent:
**Overview**

**Till Self SIM Swap** is a self-service functionality that allows **M‑PESA merchants** to replace the SIM card used for receiving **Till notification messages (MSISDN)** without visiting a Safaricom shop or contacting support—provided they remain within the allowed limits.

This service applies **only to the Till notification SIM** and does **not affect other Lipa na M‑PESA processes**, which remain unchanged.

**Reasons for Till SIM Swap**

A merchant may need to perform a Till SIM Swap for the following reasons:

- Lost or stolen till SIM
- Damaged SIM card
- Inactive sub-agent tills
- Upgrade to a new generation SIM

**Available Self-Service Channels**

Merchants can perform a Till SIM Swap through:

1. **USSD**
2. **M‑PESA Business App**

**USSD Self-Service SIM Swap Process**

**Preconditions**

- Merchant must purchase a **replacement SIM card** from an **M‑PESA agent or Safaricom shop**
- Cost of SIM: **KSh 100**
- Merchant must have access to the **Nominated Number**

**Step-by-Step USSD Journey**

1. Dial **\*234#** from the **Nominated Number**
2. Select **M‑PESA Business Till**
3. Enter the **Head Office / Store Number**
4. Select **Account Services**
5. Select **SIM Swap**
6. Enter the **Till Number**
7. Enter the **IMSI number** from the new SIM 
 *(IMSI is the unique identifier printed on the SIM pack)*
8. Enter **Operator ID**
9. Enter **Operator PIN**

The merchant will receive a **confirmation message** indicating that the SIM swap/activation process has been initiated.

**M‑PESA Business App SIM Swap**

Merchants can also initiate the Till SIM Swap via the **M‑PESA Business App** by following the in-app SIM Swap flow.

All validation rules and limits applied on USSD **also apply** on the App.

**What Is Changing (Important for Advisors)**

**Previous Capability**

Merchants could perform **multiple self SIM swaps** without enforced frequency controls.

**Current Enhancement (Abuse Prevention)**

To prevent abuse of the self-service channel, the **DIY Lipa na M‑PESA Till SIM Swap** has been enhanced with limits per merchant till:

- **Maximum 2 self-service swaps per day**
- **Maximum 4 self-service swaps per calendar month**

These limits apply **per merchant till**, not per SIM or per user.

**Error Message at Self-Service Limit**

When a merchant or DSA attempts a SIM swap beyond the allowed limits, they will receive the following system message:

**"*Dear merchant you have exceeded your daily/monthly sim swap requests. Please try again later"***

**How Internal Teams Should Assist After Limits Are Reached**

If a merchant has reached their **self-service limit**, they **can still be assisted** through existing supported channels:

**Approved Assisted Channels**

- **Safaricom Retail Shops**
- **Contact Centre**
- **Established manual escalation processes**

**Do NOT advise merchants to retry self-service until limits reset** if the error message has already appeared.

**Key Support Talking Points**

- The limit applies **only to self-service swaps**
- The enhancement does **not block legitimate merchant assistance**
- No changes have been made to:

- Lipa na M‑PESA settlement processes
- Till ownership or configuration
- Transaction processing

- Limits reset:

- **Daily**: After 24 hours
- **Monthly**: At the start of a new calendar month

**Summary for Quick Reference**

| Item | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| Purpose | Replace Till notification SIM |
| Channels | USSD, M‑PESA Business App |
| Cost | KSh 100 (SIM purchase) |
| Daily Limit | 2 self swaps per till |
| Monthly Limit | 4 self swaps per till |
| After Limit | Assist via retail shop or contact centre |
| Other LNM Processes | Unchanged |

**Internal Reminder**

Ensure merchants clearly understand:

- **The reason for limits**
- **That assistance remains available**
- **That the restriction is temporary and resets automatically**

**Attached FAQs**

articleTitle: PUK DIY procedure and CRM View
markdownContent:
**DIY SERVICES**

**USSD options:**

\*456#ok> Get PUK> Enter mobile no. >Enter ID no.

\*100#ok> Get PUK>Enter mobile no. >Enter ID no.

\*200#ok>98 More> Get your PUK no.> Enter mobile no. >Enter ID no.

**IVR:**

Call 100/200 and follow prompts

**Safaricom App:**

i.          Launch My Safaricom APP

ii.         Select Account

iii.         Select PUK

iv.         For Self: PUK for self is displayed

v.         For Other:

Choose “Other Number”

Enter the MSISDN

Enter ID Number

Select Request PUK

**Selfcare:** Once you log into Selfcare, click on Display PUK.

**Safaricom Zuri:** There are 4 main ways of accessing Zuri as detailed below:

i.         **Facebook Messenger:** Send a message to Safaricom Zuri starting with the word PUK and follow prompts

ii.         **Telegram:** On Telegram, search for, @Safaricom Chatbot or Safaricom Zuri> Send a message with the word PUK

iii.         **Blaze Facebook page:** Send a message with the word PUK and wait for a response

iv.         **WhatsApp:** Save number +254722000100 in your contacts> Send a message with the word PUK

**NOTE**: Exemptions that would require CEE to vet and issue PUK without DIY:

- USSD and IVR DIYs are only available to customers registered with their national ID
- USSD and IVR DIYs are not available to roaming customers

**USSD Enhancements - PUK flash Message**

A flash message has been added to the \*100# and \*456# PUK retrieval journey. The objective of this enhancement is to provide customers with immediate on-screen confirmation after successful identity verification.

Customers who complete PUK retrieval will now receive a flash message:

i.         Either, confirming that their PUK SMS is on the way.

ii.         Advising those with a SIM Blocked status to visit a nearby Safaricom shop for SIM replacement.

**Customer Journey**

 [Screenshot] 

**HOW TO ISSUE PUK IF SIEBEL IS UNAVAILABLE**

**Scenario 1: Siebel is completely unavailable**

- The CEE will apologize to the customer.
- Confirm that the customer is registered with their national ID and advise on **how to obtain the PUK through USSD \*456#, IVR, Selfcare, Safaricom App, Zuri.**
- Advise customers registered with different document IDs, or on behalf to call back later for assistance.

**Scenario 2: Siebel not displaying PUK for specified number**

- There could be a problem with synchronization of the IMSIs hence the CEE will need to escalate via SR for support to align and issue PUK.
- Capture an alternative contact for call back.

**PROCEDURE OF VIEWING PUK UNDER NUMBER MANAGEMENT IN SIEBEL**

- On Siebel go to **Site Map** \> select **Number Management**
- Go to **Query** and select **MSISDN SP** and paste customers MSISDN
- Select **Serial Number** from the **paired MSISDN**
- Select **SIM Card** and Query serial number by pasting on the "**From**" and "**To**" fields and click GO
- Click on the **hyperlinked Serial** under the "SIM Card" field to view PUK

**NB:**

- If you are still unable to view the PUK after so doing, raise an SR and the customers will be contacted accordingly.
- Only escalate the requests that are past SLA to the folder for additional follow up and resolution.

articleTitle: SIM Swap Procedure at the Contact Center
markdownContent:
**Basic Requirements and checks before SIM Replacement**

**Reasons for SIM replacement**

- Lost SIM card
- Damaged SIM card
- SIM card Upgrade
- Fraudulently swapped line (to be performed at Retail/Care desk)
- SIM card Rejected (The SIM will be rejected if the customer enters the PUK No. 10 times incorrectly)

# **Requirements**

Original document registered document ID number e.g.

- National ID
- Valid Passport
- Military ID
- Diplomatic ID etc

New SIM replacement card retailing at Ksh. 100.

If a customer says their phone was stolen, the CEE should wipe all the APPs on CRM and advise the customer to reinstall the apps on their phone after SIM replacement.

# **NB: Pre checks to manage SIM swap requests:**

- Request the customer to share the number to be replaced and confirm if it is valid for replacement.
- Check if the line is on **SIM Swap whitelist**. If the line is on SIM swap whitelist, refer customer to retail with original ID/ registration Document for SIM swap.
- When you refer customers to retail for SIM swap who have a police abstract, remind them to carry the following documents when going to the shop:

- Original waiting card (New version) (Issued within 2 months)
- clear copy of valid ID document (Optional)
- police abstract (Issued within 3 months). Vetting is by validation of ID details vs registration details on the system. 

**OR**

- - Original waiting card (Old version),
 - clear copy of valid ID document (Mandatory) and
 - police abstract (Issued within 3 months). Vetting is by validation of ID details vs registration details on the system.

**They cannot be served with a police abstract only**

For more information refer to **[RSEN-0001: Retail Centre/Care Desk SIM Swap Procedure](../../app/article/88019821-c898-4fe3-9e23-fbcc3db3650a)**

- **Outbound Call:** Make an outbound call to the line to be swapped.

- If the caller is using the same MSISDN to reach us, advice the customer that the call will drop once the SIM Swap is completed. Ensure you advise on the M-PESA activation process before submitting the SIM Swap order.
- If the number is unreachable. Proceed with vetting.
- If the call is answered, confirm ownership and swap request.
- If the call is unanswered in the first attempt, make one more attempt to try and contact the customer. If the call is not picked refer the customer to the Retail Center or Care desk for SIM Swap.

**NOTE:** To make an outbound call, type the number/paste it on the IWS softphone after placing the active call on hold.

- Ask the customer if he/she bought replacement card before you proceed to do further checks.
- In case the customer had not purchased the replacement, card advise them to purchase then contact us.
- Enter interactions as per the Contact Centre Interaction Guidelines including the calling number.
- If the customer had purchased replacement card, and has passed the other pre- checks, proceed with the Checks to facilitate the replacement. 

# **Checks on the calling number**

**Line Status:** Any line calling for a SIM Swap should be active on **IN DATA.**

Proceed only if the calling number is a Safaricom number. This also includes the M-PESA agent number if customer is calling from agent.

Non-Safaricom number callers should be advised to visit the nearest Safaricom shop(RC,Franchise) or the nearest M-PESA agent. If calling number is international, Kindly guide caller to send an email to [Customercare@Safaricom.co.ke](mailto:Customercare@Safaricom.co.ke)  or [advantage@safaricom.coke](mailto:advantage@safaricom.coke)

**Last swap:** If the number calling has been swapped in the last 72 hrs (Unless its the M-PESA agent line calling), Decline the swap and refer the customer to retail or advise to call via an agent line for assistance.

**Proceed with swap if the number calling is for an M-PESA agent.**

**Age on Network:** If the number calling is less than 30 days on network, decline the swap and refer the customer to Retail or nearest M-Pesa agent to call via an agent line.

**Fraud Location Check:** Check on HLR/WDE If the calling number is in Fraud Location site proceed to bar.

Kindly be checking on SAWA if a number is roaming before doing any SIM swap.  If the VLR shows a number not starting with 254, then customer is roaming .

VLR ID is shown on SAWA as below

 [Screenshot] 

**HOW IT WORKS**

The roaming customer will be required to make a written request to [customercare@Safaricom.co.ke](mailto:customercare@Safaricom.co.ke) or [advantage@safaricom.co.ke](mailto:advantage@safaricom.co.ke) or to respective and authorized shop email addresses for SIM swap request .

When they write to us, further vetting is done as per article number [**ROIE-001**](../../app/article/e82f2b9b-a4ee-42b2-9f73-a984de3c4606) to avoid swapping roaming customers’ lines erroneously.

# **Number of SIM swap requests:**

- The number calling will be allowed a maximum of two (2) SIM swap requests for other numbers in 24hrs. Where the calling number has two (2) other SIM swap requests within the last 24hr, decline the request and refer the customer to retail or advise them to call from the agent.
- If the calling number is a Merchant Till, it should be treated like a normal line where only two requests are allowed within 24hrs.
- Where there are more than 2 requests then the number must be on M-PESA Agent tariff (Till MSISDN) or the person calling to swap must be an M-PESA agent calling with their personal line.

To verify the person is an M-PESA agent, the caller will be vetted on agent details below;

- Assistant ID
- Agent Number
- Agent name and agent document ID Number.

**NOTE:** **The agent details should match both on G2 and Siebel. If the details given are correct on G2 but different on Siebel, the caller will be treated like any other customer calling for other.**

**Previous Interactions**: CEE will check previous interactions at the customer and subscriber levels to ensure no interaction was captured and to get more insight about the customer cautioning against performing SIM swap on the line and to avoid issuing customers details.

**Failed vetting**:

Where customer’s names on View 360 do not completely tally with the names on M-PESA, or fails the primary vetting/personal details (Full names, ID and YoB) kindly refer them to retail Centre or Care Desk for assistance.

If the customer had previously failed secondary vetting, the 2nd time they call you will vet and if they fail vetting again, do not request them to call back, instead advise him/her to visit Retail Center or Care Desk with their original ID for assistance and **for those with police abstract** refer to above guideline on required documents as they will not be assisted at retail with police abstract only. The 3rd time the customer is calling for SIM-swap should not be vetted but referred to retail as previously advised on the 2nd call.

**Note:**

- Where any of the above checks fail, capture this on the interactions with reason why SIM swap could not be done.

# **Checks on the number to be swapped**

- Check for Key comment cautioning SIM swap.
- **Golden/Special Numbers check:** Check/confirm the number to be swapped is not a Golden, Platinum or Super Platinum number if the number is Golden, Platinum or Super Platinum refer the customer to our Safaricom Retail Shop.

Follow below steps to check Golden number via Siebel:

**Search a specific number:**

- Log in to CRM (Siebel)
- Go to “Site Map”
- Go to “Number Management”
- Select “Number Management Query”
- Fill in the search parameters:
- select MSISDN.
- From: enter the MSISDN number to search
- To: enter the last MSISDN number if searching a range to search (or the same number as entered under “From” if searching for a single number
- SUBMIT: Query results will display the number Availability Status as well as Classification (whether Normal, Golden, Platinum or Super Platinum)

**Search by number Category:**

- Log in to CRM (Siebel)
- Go to “Site Map”
- Go to “Number Management”
- Select “Number Management Query”
- Fill in the search parameters:
- Type: select MSISDN
- Status: select “Available”
- MSISDN Type: select category, either “Golden”, “Platinum” or “Super Platinum”
- SUBMIT: Query results will display a list of the categorized numbers under available status.

**IN Status Check:** The status of the line under the IN-DATA tab of the number calling should not be on Idle except for Agent/Dealer lines. Refer customer to the nearest Retail Shop or Care Desk if the number calling is on IDLE Status.

**Location check:** Check the location of the caller's mobile number and the line being swapped on ‘fraudster location’ on SAWA system. If the caller is confirmed to be in a prison site, the CEE shall proceed as follows:

- First verify the tariff, if it indicates ‘M-PESA agent tariff’, ‘SYJ tariff’, ‘dealer tariff’, do not suspend the line. Refer the customer to a different dealer/care desk/retail shop as SIM Swap isn’t possible in a prison site.
- If the tariff is not as above, display the fraudster's account on Siebel and suspend both incoming and outgoing calls, Refer the customer Care desk/Retail shop as SIM Swap isn’t possible in a prison site.

**NOTE:** 

Over scratched sites does not affect the outcome of a swap. Only fraud hot sites/prison site.

**Barring’s and Diverts:** Confirm if the line has any active call barring or active diverts to another MSISDN. Except for Voicemail, Missed Call Alert or Caller Notify.

- If there is any active call barring or call diverts to another MSISDN, seek consent to cancel them.
- If consent is granted and vetting successful, cancel the barring or divert using HLR.
- If consent is denied, advise on the risk and refer customer to the nearest retail center/care desk for further assistance.
- If there are no any active divert or barring, proceed with step below.

**Vetting:** Proceed to comprehensively vet the customers for proof of ownership

# **SIM Swap Individual Prepaid lines**

- Confirm If customer has the new SIMex/SIMreplacement card before progressing.
- CEE will do the Fraud checks as per Call Centre process indicated above.
-  Vet as per vetting Procedure under 

 [Contact Center Vetting Matrix](../../app/article/ddd2cae5-427b-4338-9b32-f7af24ac304c)

**Note**: Where customer’s names and Document ID details on View 360/M-PESA differ, and its not a corporate line  advise the customer to visit any retail shop or Care Desk for assistance and to correct their registration details.

**Effecting the SIM swap**

If customer passes vetting and Fraud checks the CEE will go ahead with the SIM SWAP Process on CRM/Sibel as indicated below:

- Open Siebel and enter customers MSISDN.
- Under Subscriber Portal, click "Modify" then "Customize".
- Select the tab "MSISDN & SIM Card".
- Enter the SIM serial under the tab "SIM Number".
- Click "Done" and submit the order.
- An automated SMS shall be sent to the customer to educate them on how to re-activate the M-PESA account.
- Ensure to capture the vetting details on the Siebel Interactions.
- Advice on re-activation of call barring and diverts, where applicable.
- Advice the customer that the new SIM card will be active on the network within 20 minutes.
- Educate the customer on how to activate their M-PESA account after a SIM Swap.

- **If customer fails vetting refer to Retail shop/Care desk/Dealer (with their ID) or call back with correct details.** **For those with police abstract** **refer to above mentioned guideline on required documents as they will not be assisted at retail with police abstract only.**

**NOTE**: 

**(1) If the calling number and number to be swapped fails the prechecks**, **do not inform customer on the reason for declining a SIM replacement e.g.** “*your line (calling number) has been swapped in the last 72 hours” or “age on network is less than 30 days**”.*** **Only capture the reason on interaction comment.**

**(2) After successfully swapping the line, kindly wipe all the apps for the customer to reinstall them afresh.**

**Resuming an expired line to enable swap**

- An expired line cannot be manually swapped. The modify button will be grayed out and only after the line has been resumed can the button be active to allow for a manual SIM replacement.
- Expired lines can only be swapped while still in expiry via USSD only.
- Resume with action reason Life cycle Resume and proceed to swap for the customer.
- Educate the customers to top up after assisting them to extend validity of the line on the same day.

# **SIM Upgrade (Where calling number is the number to be swapped)**

**Parameters to confirm**

- Confirm If customer has the new SIMex/SIM replacement card before progressing.
- Vet as per vetting Procedure

**Note**: Where customer’s names and Document ID details on View 360/M-PESA differ, and its not a corporate line  advise the customer to visit any retail shop or Care Desk for assistance and to correct their registration details.

**Vetting to be applied**

SIM Upgrade (Where calling number is the number to be swapped) is under the basic vetting category as per article

[Contact Center Vetting Matrix](../../app/article/ddd2cae5-427b-4338-9b32-f7af24ac304c)

. Vetting details should therefore be

- Full Names as Registered 
- ID Document Number
- Year of Birth 

# **Effecting the SIM swap**

- If customer passes vetting, the CEE will go ahead with the SIM SWAP Process on CRM/Sibel as indicated below:
- Open Siebel and enter customers MSISDN.
- On Subscriber Portal, click "SIM Swap".
- Enter the SIM serial in the field " New SIM Card Number".
- Add comments and Click “Submit” to effect the SIM swap order.
- An automated SMS shall be sent to the customer to educate them on how to re-activate the M-PESA account.
- Ensure to capture the vetting details on the Siebel Interactions under the “SIM Card Issues-SIM SWAP” Interaction Type.
- Advice the customer that the new SIM card will be active on the network within 20 minutes.
- Educate the customer on how to activate their M-PESA account after a SIM Swap.

- **If customer fails vetting refer to Retail shop/Care desk/Dealer (with their ID) or call back with correct details.**
- **For those with police abstract** **refer to above mentioned guideline on required documents as they will not be assisted at retail with police abstract only.**

**NOTE:** 

**(1) If the calling number and number to be swapped fails the prechecks, do not inform customer on the reason for declining a SIM replacement e.g. “***your line (calling number) has been swapped in the last 72 hours****” or “****age on network is less than 30 days****”.* Only capture the reason on interaction comment.**

**SIM  Swap for Data Lines**

- Confirm If customer has the new SIMex/SIM replacement card before progressing.
- CEE will do the Fraud checks as per Call Centre process.
- Vet as per vetting Procedure. 

 [Contact Center Vetting Matrix](../../app/article/ddd2cae5-427b-4338-9b32-f7af24ac304c)

 **Note****:** If customers name on Siebel and Jiandikishe differ, Jiandikishe details takes precedence.

 **Effecting the SIM Swap**

After successful vetting proceed complete the swap on Siebel as per below process:  

- Open Siebel and enter customers MSISDN
- Under Subscriber Portal, click "Modify" then "Customize"
- Select the tab "MSISDN & SIM Card"
- Enter the SIM serial under the tab "SIM Number".
- Click "Done" and submit the order.
- An automated SMS shall be sent to the customer to educate them on how to re-activate the M-PESA account.
- Ensure to capture the vetting details on the Siebel Interactions.
- Advice on re-activation of call barring and diverts, where applicable.
- Advice the customer that the new SIM card will be active on the network within 20 minutes.
- Educate the customer on how to activate their M-PESA account after a SIM Swap.

- **If customer fails vetting refer to Retail shop/Care desk/Dealer (with their ID) or call back with correct details.**
- **For those with police abstract** **refer to above mentioned guideline on required documents as they will not be assisted at retail with police abstract only**

**NOTE: If the calling number and number to be swapped fails the prechecks, do not inform customer on the reason for declining a SIM replacement e.g. “***your line (calling number) has been swapped in the last 72 hours****” or “****age on network is less than 30 days****”.* Only capture the reason on interaction comment.**

 **SIM Swap for Karibu Postpaid/ Advantage Plus Bundles.**

**Checks before vetting**

- Confirm customer has a SIMEX.
- Do fraud- check, confirm the location of the caller's mobile number and the line being swapped on ‘fraudster location’ on SAWA system. If the caller is confirmed to be in a prison site proceed to bar.
- Confirm on M-PESA that the name and ID number match those on Siebel. If the details on M-PESA and Siebel do not match, the customer should visit the retail shop for assistance.
- Confirm there are no diverts/barring on the line to be swapped
- Call the Post-pay number to be swapped. If the call is answered by the same person calling for a SIM Swap or unreachable, go ahead and replace the line.
- Should the phone ring and is not picked, dial a second time. If not answered for the second time, request the customer to send an email with the request or visit the nearest Retail Centre.
- Lines barred for collection/ bill related issues or fraud should not be resumed/unbarred. Advise the customer to clear the bills first, or liaise with Fraud for the latter, then call for a SIM Swap.
- Lines barred under the action reason as lost or customer request will be resumed to facilitate SIM swap.

**Action Required by CEE**

- CEE will do the Fraud checks as per Call Centre process under Post-pay.
- Vet as per vetting Procedure [Contact Center Vetting Matrix](../../app/article/ddd2cae5-427b-4338-9b32-f7af24ac304c)

**Effecting the SIM Swap**

If customer passes vetting the CEE will go ahead with the SIM SWAP Process.

- Open Siebel and enter customers MSISDN.
- Under Subscriber Portal, click "Modify" then "Customize".
- Select the tab "MSISDN & SIM Card".
- Enter the SIM serial under the tab "SIM Number".

- An automated SMS shall be sent to the customer to educate them on how to re-activate the M-PESA account.
- Ensure to capture the vetting details on the Siebel Interactions.
- Advice on re-activation of call barring and diverts, where applicable.
- Enter interaction on Siebel with both Customer's and Agent's (where applicable) Vetting details.
- Advice the customer that the new SIM card will be active on the network within 20 minutes.
- Educate the customer on how to activate their M-PESA account after a SIM Swap.

- **If customer fails vetting refer to Retail shop/Care desk/Dealer (with their ID) or call back with correct details.**
- **For those with police abstract** **refer to above mentioned guideline on required documents as they will not be assisted at retail with police abstract only**

**NOTE:** 

**(1) If the calling number and number to be swapped fails the prechecks, do not inform customer on the reason for declining a SIM replacement e.g. “***your line (calling number) has been swapped in the last 72 hours****” or “****age on network is less than 30 days****”.* Only capture the reason on interaction comment.**

**(2) After successfully swapping the line, kindly wipe all the apps for the customer to reinstall them afresh.**

# **Zidisha and CVP customers**

- SIM swap requests for MSISDNs on company names will be received at retail centers or via email to customercare@safaricom.co.ke

- Indicating the MSISDN to be swapped & Serial of the new SIMEX.

**SIM swap for an individual Line** **registered under the company, with personal M-PESA account****​** **(Prepay and Postpaid)**

For an individual line that is under the name of a company, **no letter** **will be needed**. However, M-PESA account should be registered under the individual’s details. 

i.         Customer will be vetted as per the SIM swap vetting procedures on CRM, M-PESA & Subreg

ii.         CEE will proceed to swap the line

**NOTE**: If customer requires any further action e.g. line to be unbarred or reconnected for payment, they will be advised to present the above documents from the company.

# **Safaricom Staff Tariff SIM Swap**

Staff will relay their SIM Replacement requests to the Call Center by sending an email to Safaricom Advantage from their official Business emails or calling channels.

**Effecting the SIM swap**

- If the customer cannot provide vetting details, ask them to send their requests on email from their official Outlook address to CMCCSPostpaid@Safaricom.co.ke , Departmental PA or refer them to Safaricom Retail Shop.

# **Definition**

M-PESA Ratiba is a feature that allows M-PESA registered customers to set up recurring (standing order) payments from their M-PESA account to other M-PESA customers or a Lipa na M-PESA short code.

It can be used for services such as paying rent, utility bills, or school fees, among others.

# **Eligibility**

This service is available to all M-PESA registered customers through their personal M-PESA accounts and will apply when they send money to other users’ personal M-PESA accounts or make Lipa na M-PESA payments to M-PESA Buy Goods, Business tills, and Paybills.

# **Benefits of M-PESA Ratiba Service**

M-PESA Ratiba service offers the following benefits:

- Fairly easy, quick, and transparent set up process.
- Automate as many recurring transfers and payments as you wish, and free up time in your day and space in your lists of obligations to remember.
- Make timely payments and avoid penalties and embarrassments from delinquent payments.
- Service is available from all types of handsets, whether it is a feature or smartphone.
- Incur no penalties for cancelled or failed standing order transfers that may occur due to insufficient balance.
- Set how long the standing order is in place for, and pause/revoke the order, whenever you wish at no extra fee.

# **How to Opt In**

The customer must opt in and accept the Terms and Conditions, before being allowed to create standing orders or schedule payments.

**Via USSD \*334#**

- Dial USSD \*334#
- Select M-PESA Ratiba
- Select Standing Order Opt In.
- Accept Terms and Conditions
- Enter M-PESA PIN

# **How to Access M-PESA Ratiba**

M-PESA Ratiba will be available via the below channels.

1. **USSD \*334# > Select Option 9**.  – This channel will allow the automatic model only.
2. **M-PESA Ratiba Mini-App on M-PESA Super App** – This channel will allow both automatic and reminder subscriptions

# **How to opt out/Delete M-PESA Ratiba Subscription**

Customers who have replaced their SIM cards and report that M-Pesa Ratiba subscriptions were activated without their consent, that they can **DELETE** the standing orders by either dialing \*334#OK or using the M-PESA Mini App as follows.

**USSD**:

Dial \*334# > Select Option 9 (M-PESA Ratiba) > Manage Standing Order > Delete Standing Order.

**M-PESA App**: 
Go to Financial Services > Mini App > M-PESA RATIBA > My Subscriptions > Delete.

# **How to Edit M-PESA Ratiba Subscription**

Customers who have an active M-PESA Ratiba Subscription can be able to edit the Standing Order.

The Edit feature is currently available on the M-PESA Ratiba Mini App. You will only be able to Edit the Amount and the End Date.

 [Screenshot] 

# **How to Suspend / Unsuspend M-PESA Ratiba Subscription**

On the M-PESA Ratiba Mini App you can be able to Suspend/ Unsuspend an active Standing Order.

Once Suspended the M-PESA Ratiba will not be effected and to continue with the same Standing Order you will be required to Unsuspend the Standing Order

 [Screenshot] 

**Creating a standing order on M-PESA Ratiba**

One must have opted in and accepted the terms and conditions above, to set up standing orders.

**Via USSD**

- Dial USSD \*334#
- Select M-PESA Ratiba
- Select Standing Order.
- Select Create a Standing Order.
- Select the type of transaction.
- Enter Mobile Number/ Buy goods/ business number.
- Enter Amount (Maximum is 250,000)
- Enter the name of the standing order.
- Enter the first date of the standing order payment.
- Enter the last date of the standing order payment.
- Select Frequency.
- Confirm details.
- Enter your M-PESA PIN.

**Via the APP**

Customer Selects M-PESA Ratiba MiniApp within M-PESA App

The Customer selects Create Ratiba.

The customer selects either send money, Till or Paybill Option.

Customer then enters recipient’s MSISDN, Till Number, Paybill Number.  

The Customer enters preferred name for the M-PESA Ratiba and amount

The customer then selects the frequency e.g., daily, weekly and the last date of M-PESA Ratiba

Customers is prompted to confirm the details and enter the M-PESA pin for validation.

A M-PESA Ratiba creating notification is sent to the customer

 [Screenshot] 

# **How It Works**

- The customer will be required to enter their M-PESA PIN at the time of opting in and accepting the terms and conditions of the service. One will also require their M-PESA PIN when setting up the automatic standing orders.
- The customer will not be required to enter M-PESA PIN each time a scheduled payment is due as once the setup is complete, the transfer of funds will be effected without the need to enter M-PESA PIN each time.
- The customer will incur extra costs to use this service as there will be a standard M-PESA Ratiba charge of KSh 5 per transaction (send money, Paybill, Lipa na M-PESA) above the normal M-PESA transaction charges.
- The customer will only need to set the start and end date of the disbursement. The time (HH:MM) of disbursement will be set automatically as the time the customer completed each standing order creation process.
- On the day of disbursement, the transfer will be done exactly 5 minutes after the set HH: MM.
- Where a transaction fails for one reason or another, there will be no automatic system retries for another transfer once the date and time have passed, no transaction shall be processed. However, the customer will still be able to make the payments manually.
- Failed payment will not attract any penalties or charges. The customer will not be penalized for failed standing orders occurring because of insufficient funds in their M-PESA wallets.
- A customer cannot use Fuliza as they are required to have sufficient funds to complete the transaction when they have insufficient funds on M-PESA. The transaction will fail where one has insufficient balance in their M-PESA.
- Regular M-PESA transaction limits of KSh. 250,000 per transaction and KSh.500,000 per day shall apply. These limits do not include the transaction fees.
- A customer cannot modify a standing order once it has been created. However, the customer can, delete it and create a new one.
- A customer can schedule as many requests as possible as there is currently no limit for how many standing orders that one can schedule.
- The customer will be notified of upcoming disbursement whether they have sufficient balance or not on the mini-App, as one can schedule reminders (for manually initiated transactions) or schedule auto-debit transfers.

**NOTE****:** The \*334# USSD channel only supports the auto debit model which does not send reminders prior to the transfer being effected.

# **Transactions Reversal**

The usual transaction reversal procedure will apply where funds have been sent out. However, the customer is responsible for managing their scheduled orders and cancelling any that they do not wish to complete before the funds are sent out.

**Support for Recurring Payments for Services like Netflix**

Not now. For these, kindly use the M-PESA GlobalPay card service available on our M-PESA Super App and on the Financial Services menu of \*334#.

**Priority of payment when multiple orders have identical dates.**

The system will queue the payments depending on the order in which they were set up, based on first come first served.

**Expiration of Scheduled Standing Orders**

The standing order will only be executed between the start and end dates as set by the customer. Expired standing orders will automatedly be deleted after the end date scheduled by the customer.

**Difference between deleting a standing order and opting out of M-PESA Ratiba service.**

Deleting a standing order only cancels the payment that was scheduled, whereas opting out removes the customer from the M-PESA Ratiba service after they have deleted all scheduled standing orders.

Once opted out, the customer will have to accept the Terms and Conditions to opt back in and use the service.

**Compensation for Penalties Due to Fund Disbursement Failures**

Safaricom will do all that is within its power to ensure all services are optimally available. However, the customer needs to monitor and ensure the funds are manually sent in case of delays to the M-PESA systems.

Please refer to the Terms and Conditions of this service for further details.

**How to use the service**

The service is suitable where one needs to make recurring payments such as:

- Sending upkeep to your loved ones
- Payment of workers’ wages
- Payment of rent, service fee and mortgages
- Payment of constant utility bills
- Loans repayments
- Payment of insurance premiums
- Payment of tithes
- Monthly charity donations; ETC

# **M-PESA Ratiba offer.**

**Create Ratiba:** pre-authenticated by the customer on bill creation. Transfers will be effected automatically if one has sufficient funds in their M-PESA wallet.

 [Screenshot] 

# **Features of M-PESA Ratiba**

- Opting into the M-PESA Ratiba service
- Creating diverse types of recurring payment transactions by defining the transaction type (Paybill / Buy Goods / Send money), amount, due date, time of payment, recurrence (daily, monthly, weekly)
- Confirming the created subscription/bill before committing to save it.
- Authenticating using the M-PESA PIN to save the details of the created subscription/bill.
- On the M-PESA Ratiba Mini App the Customer can choose to Edit, Suspend or Unsuspend an active Subscription. On the Edit Option, you can only Edit the Amount and the End Date.
- Deleting existing subscriptions.
- A view of the total set budget amount against M-PESA balance, all existing subscriptions and their due dates and transactions history on the mini-app.

# **M-PESA transaction not supported by M-PESA Ratiba**

The following transaction types are not supported, but will be availed in future:

- Purchase of airtime,
- Payments to and from Pochi la Biashara
- International money transfers
- Withdrawal of funds at agent outlets
- Interoperability services such as sending funds to Airtel and Telkom subscribers.

# **Customer support**

In case of any queries and more information, customers can reach us via the below channels.

- Call 100 or 200.
- Visit Safaricom Shop
- Twitter: @Safaricom\_Care and @SafaricomPLC
- Facebook: @SafaricomPLC
- Email: [customercare@safaricom.co.ke](mailto:customercare@safaricom.co.ke)

**Reversals for Newly Acquired Customers Post-Connection** 

If you receive a request for reversal of a newly connected customer, do not initiate the reversal, instead raise SR to the folder Team

using the category below.

**Category**: FTTH

**Type**: Reversal

**Item**: Onboarding

The folder Team will escalate to **[fixeddatagovernance@safaricom.co.ke](mailto:fixeddatagovernance@safaricom.co.ke)** for approval before reversal

**Payment Reversal Requests.**

  The CEE shall advise the customer that the reversal is only applicable for below scenarios:

o   Payment to wrong account.

o   Wrong amount / Wrong plan purchase.

o   Customer request or change of mind. i.e. due to system failures etc.

·       In case of a reversal request, customer will be assisted by the L400/ retail /call center CEE.

·    Where customer contacts other channels than L400 within call center i.e. L200/100, social media etc. CEE will send a request via email to L400 copsftth@safaricom.co.ke for line 400 support team to action, and will advise the registered customer available channels i.e. email or call via L400. SLA is 2 Hrs.

·       Retail CEE will raise an SR and advise on 24hrs SLA.

·       L400 CEE will confirm resources are available not utilized and where the resources are utilized, CEE will advise customer accordingly.

·       Where request is valid and resources available in full, CEE will delete the product on provisioning tab on Siebel CRM and proceed to refund the customer based on the payment mode used and/or purchase a new plan as per customers request as below;

**Airtime purchase Reversal.**

·   Where transaction was done via airtime purchase, L400 or retail CEE will validate on CRM – Siebel plan resource availability.

- L400 or retail CEE will delete the product from the provisioning tab on CRM – Siebel on the 4G FOR HOME number.
- The CEE will manually adjust airtime on CRM – Siebel on the correct 4G FOR Home number with the applicable airtime.
- Where the product is on rental suspend i.e. the product is expired and due for renewal, product will auto renew, CEE will confirm and advice customer accordingly.
- Where auto renew does not effect, CEE will manually purchase the plan on behalf on the customer on CRM- Siebel and will advise customer accordingly.
- Where expiry of the plan is not due the CEE will manually purchase the plan on behalf of the customer and will advise customer accordingly.
- Where customer does not wish to have the service, CEE will manually adjust the airtime on the correct number and advice customer accordingly.
- Where request is due to a wrong account, CEE will adjust the correct account with applicable airtime and / or will purchase the applicable plan on Siebel CRM provisioning tab as per customer request.

**M-PESA purchase.**

 Where request is valid L400/Retail CEE will validate on CRM – Siebel resources are available and will validate successful deduction of funds on M-PESA.

- The CEE and will validate reason for reversal and delete product plan on the account from the provisioning tab on CRM – Siebel.
- The CEE will confirm transaction on Paybill 522006 and will proceed to reverse the transaction on M-PESA G2.
- Process is marker checker; approver will complete transaction and will advise customer accordingly.
- Where CEE has no access to the 4G for Home Paybill reversal, they will apply for the access.
- Access will be applied via BMC, Role business manager.
- Access request> request for M-PESA G2 portal access > Request now. Indicate justification i.e. for use of L400 support 522006 org M-PESA access.

**Postpaid credit limit purchase.**

Where request is valid the CEE will validate on CRM – Siebel resources are available and will validate successful adjustment on customer postpaid limit.

- The CEE and will validate reason for reversal and delete product plan on the account from the provisioning tab on CRM – Siebel.
- This will automatically adjust customer limits accordingly.
- L400 CEE will confirm transaction successful adjustment of customer credit limit.
- Where failure is noted in adjustment of customer credit limit, postpaid credit note process will apply.

# ** [Screenshot] **

**Definition**

This is a VISA virtual card that connects to the customer's M-PESA wallet. The M-PESA GlobalPay virtual card allows customers to pay international online merchants for products and services using their card credentials. 
The card includes a 16-digit card number, the card's expiry date (mm/yy), and the security code, also known as CVV.

**Requirements of acquiring** **an M-PESA Virtual Card**

To open an M-PESA Virtual Card, one must first register for an M-PESA account.

**Payment Charges**

Customers will not be charged to make payments for online purchases from global merchant sites. However, a 3.5% forex markup applies to the billing currency's current forex rate at the time of purchase.

**Charges for the service**

Safaricom will charge a 3.5% markup on the transaction value at the current FX rate for international payments. This will be dependent on the billing currency's (KSh) exchange rate to the currency used at the time of purchase, such as USD, GBP, etc. There will be no additional charges, such as the M-PESA transaction cost.

With the opening up of domestic payments, we have merchants who might route the transaction through a domestic gateway, hence no Forex markup. However, if they route the transaction through an international gateway, the markup will apply. We are not however able to control how they route their transactions, therefore a customer may at times get two scenarios for the same payment as described below.

| Scenario | Sample SMS notification |
| --- | --- |
| Customer pays for SPOTIFY, and it's routed via an international gateway, the payment will be processed in with a forex markup. | Dear ANDREW, a transaction of Ksh. 350.87 (inclusive of Ksh. 11.87 forex charge) done at Spotify P3F9252194       Stockholm    SE has been approved on your card ****0098. If not yours suspend your card and call line 100 or 200 for assistance. |
| Customer pays for SPOTIFY, and it's routed via a domestic gateway, the payment will be processed in without a forex markup. | Dear ANDREW, a transaction UCLMRA3YSI of Ksh. 419.00 (inclusive of Ksh. 0.00 charge) done at Paystack-Ebake-Spotify   +254711577577KE has been approved on your card ****0098. If not yours, suspend your card and contact us for assistance via; X (Safaricom_Care, SafaricomPLC), Facebook (SafaricomPLC), or by calling 100 or 200. |

# **How to access the service**

M-PESA registered customer can join the GlobalPay service via GlobalPay Mini-App on M-PESA App.

**On M-PESA APP:**

Go to M-PESA App

Select Global Payments

Select the *GlobalPay Virtual card tab*, to activate your M-PESA GlobalPay

Select your card colour

Enter PIN

You will receive an SMS confirming successful registration

**Issuance of Physical Cards to Customers**

Customers will **NOT** be issued with a physical card as this is a virtual card that will be accessed through the GlobalPay Mini-App on M-PESA App.

**Card Eligibility Limit per Customer**

M-PESA customers are only eligible for one card per ID.

The service will only be available through the user's registered mobile phone.

To convert to a new mobile number, the consumer must first deactivate the card and opt out of service before reactivating.

**Number of M-PESA Virtual Card Applications Allowed per Customer**

After activating the first Card Credentials, one cannot apply for another new Card Credentials in a single year. Therefore, you can apply for only one (1) card within a 12-month period.

**Minimum/Maximum** **Amount paid** **via M-PESA GlobalPay**

M-PESA customer M-PESA limits will apply, ranging from KSh 1 to KSh 250,000 per transaction, with a maximum limit of KSh 500,000. The minimum amount will vary depending on the current USD-KES exchange. **(Note: *The minimum amount is dynamic and equal to $1 to facilitate settlement procedures.)***

# **Reversals**

In the event of a reversal, Customers will not be refunded the full amount paid as the total amount returned to the consumer does not include the 3.5% forex markup fee.

**Expiration of GlobalPay** **Card**

The Card expires after **three years**. One will be alerted at least **four times** before the card expires, at the following intervals: - One month, seven days, three days, and one day to expiration.

When the card expires, the cardholder can renew it using the M-PESA App.

The M-PESA statement on the renewed card account will continue to provide past transaction details.

**How It works**

A card will become dormant if it is not used for three months. Once it becomes inactive, you will wait for expiry of the 12-month period before activating a new one

If the virtual card is cancelled, the cardholder shall not lose their M-PESA account as the M-PESA account will continue. However, the user will not be able to use the Virtual Card service until it is activated using the M-PESA App.

Cancelled M-PESA Virtual Card cards cannot be renewed/reactivated. However, once the current Virtual Card has been terminated, one can apply for a new one after the 12-month period has elapsed.

A customer can have only one (1) new Card credential within one (1) year from activating the first card credential.

To avoid Card cancellation due to inactivity, make sure to use it at least once every 3 months to complete any successful transaction.

Customers cannot use Fuliza to make payments as Fuliza will not be available for M-PESA GlobalPay Payments.

**Note:** The M-PESA GlobalPay Visa Virtual **cannot** receive funds and is only used to make online payments. It utilizes the funds in the customer’s M-PESA account.

**Where You can use the M-PESA Global Pay Virtual Card Online**

The M-PESA GlobalPay Visa virtual card cannot be used to pay for purchases on any online merchant website as payment can only be made to international online merchants that accept VISA cards such as Netflix, Amazon, AliExpress, etc.

For a transaction initiated to a local online merchant e.g., Jumia, the M-PESA Customer will receive an appropriate message on the checkout option advising them to use the Lipa na M-PESA option.

**Merchant exceptions**

Some merchant categories are restricted on M-PESA GlobalPay Virtual Visa card, including gaming, gambling, money transfer services, and cryptocurrency.

# **What is a CVV (Card Verification Value)**

This is a three-digit security number that appears on the card and is used for online payments to prevent fraudulent transactions. M-PESA GlobalPay CVV numbers are only valid for 30 minutes. Customers are encouraged to keep ALL of their card information private, including the CVV number.

**NOTE:** One cannot use an expired CVV Number as every time a payment is to be made, a CVV number will be generated, and it will be valid for only 30 minutes.

**Sharing of Private Card Details, Expiry Date, and CVV**

Private Card Details, Expiry Date and CVV cannot be shared with third parties as these are confidential numbers that should not be shared with anyone, including Safaricom employees.

Card details should not be disclosed to third parties since they could result in unauthorized or fraudulent transactions.

**Flash SMS**

This is a form of SMS that appears on the phone's main screen rather than being automatically put in the message inbox.

The M-PESA GlobalPay service uses Flash SMS communications to protect the VISA Credentials.

**Definition of a** **repeat** **payment**

A repeat payment occurs when a client approves or permits a business to automatically debit the cardholder's M-PESA wallet for recurrent purchases, such as NETFLIX subscriptions.

**Cost Estimator Feature**

The cost estimator feature that shows the customer an estimate of the total cost. The actual cost is influenced by the dynamic fluctuations in foreign exchange rates.

# **M-PESA PIN Requirement for Repeat Payment Processing**

The cardholder will not be required to enter an M-PESA PIN for repeat payments to be processed as once the card credentials are entered into a merchant website for any subscription services and the repeat payment functionality is enabled, the payments will not require the user to enter their M-PESA PIN in the following billing cycle. The funds will be automatically taken from your M-PESA account.

Customers are urged to maintain their card number, validity period, and CVV details secret and private to prevent others from utilizing their card details for subscription services, since they will be deducted without their authorization.

**Ac****How to Activate Repeat Payments**

The **Repeat Payments** button will no longer be available on the GlobalPay Mini-App. Customers will need to go to the merchant site to be able to activate.

**NOTE:** Customers cannot activate repeat payments directly on the card. To enable repeat payments, they must complete the setup through the merchant’s website.

**How to deactivate repeat payments or auto renewing subscription charges on the card**

To deactivate repeat payments or auto renewal subscription charges on the card the customer should visit the vendor website from where the subscription was activated and cancel it, **NOT** cancelling from the vendor website will result to continued deductions on the card.

# **Disputing a Payment or Handling Payment Disagreements**

Payment disagreement happens when the cardholder is unable to reach an equitable solution with the participating retailer.

All disputes must first be addressed with the Merchant in accordance with their respective dispute and refund policies.

Customers can [raise a dispute](https://www.safaricom.co.ke/globalpaydispute/) by using the M-PESA App, contacting Safaricom Customer Care, visiting our retail outlets, or accessing the dispute resolution form on the Safaricom website.

Upon receipt of a completed [dispute form](https://www.safaricom.co.ke/globalpaydispute/), we will contact Visa for settlement. The projected timelines for resolving a dispute vary on the case, as decided by Safaricom and Visa.

Safaricom will handle disputes involving transaction authorization errors within 72 hours. However, if the dispute is between the cardholder and a participating retailer, the maximum settlement time is forty-five working days. [Start a dispute process.](https://www.safaricom.co.ke/globalpaydispute/)

**Resolving Duplicate Transactions on the Virtual Card**

When duplicate deductions occur, the merchant normally refunds the amount within 72 HRS. However, if the customer does not receive a refund in M-PESA within 72 hours, they should contact the retailer directly using the link/email address provided on their website.

If no support is received after 7 days, one can file a disagreement with Safaricom using the disagreement Form for additional assistance.

**Follow-Up Process for Pending Reversals**

Before filing a dispute, the customer is expected to comply with the merchant's cancellation and refund policy. All pending reversals should be followed up with the Merchant to which the payment was made.

The customer should complete the escalation form that the merchant has supplied on their web platform.

**NOTE:** Please keep in mind that escalations made through merchants have a shorter SLA (Service Level Agreement) than those made through Safaricom, which can take up to 45 days, according to VISA standards.

**Call Divert Definition and Mechanics**

# **Definition**

Call divert is a feature that enables the user to forward or redirect their incoming calls to an alternate number.

Users can also choose to divert incoming calls directly to voicemail.

How it works (mechanics)

When call divert is enabled, the phone does not ring at the original number of the incoming call, but rather only at the alternate number the call has been diverted to.

Subscribers can forward calls to any number within Kenya.

# **Cost**

The diverted number is charged depending on tariff and on the call duration of the diverted call to the second party.

For example, Consider Party A who calls Party B, but Party B has diverted calls to Party C (Number in a different network). Party A will be charged normal on-net rates as though calling B. Party B’s line will be charged at off-net rates depending on the call duration to Party C. Party C will not be charged.

**Different voicemail diverts**

Diverting to 0722122122 (or 0722212) forwards calls to Voice Mail.

0722188188 is the “Caller Notifier’’, this notifies caller that the recipient they had tried to call is now available. It also notifies the recipient of the callers attempted to reach them while they were out of reach (Activated by dialling \*\*62\*0722188188#ok, and ##62#ok to deactivate)

0722199199 this is the “Missed Call Alert”, notifies the recipient only that one tried calling them while they were unreachable (Activated by dialing \*\*62\*0722199199#ok, and ##62#ok to deactivate)

# **Call Divert USSD Activation & Deactivation**

When unreachable

Activation: \*\*62\*number #ok

Deactivation: ##62#ok

When busy

Activation: \*\*67\*number #ok

Deactivation: ##67#ok

No Reply

Activation: \*\*61\*number #ok

Deactivation: ##61#ok

**Note:**

The default ring duration is 20sec. meaning the call rings for 20sec, if no reply it diverts

One can customize the “no reply” duration (between 5 and 30 seconds), by dialing \*\*61\*number\*10\*duration# OK. e.g. \*\*61\*0722122122\*10\*15#OK, means the calls will divert to Voice mail after ringing for 15 seconds with no answer.

# **Conditional Divert**

Activation: \*\*004\*number# ok

Deactivatation: ##004# ok

# **Unconditional Divert**

Activation: \*\*21\*number #ok

Deactivation: ##21#ok

**Call Diverts Troubleshooting Guide**

When customers call with call diverts queries, enquire the nature of diverts the customer intends to activate or deactivate, whether the customer has attempted DIY and the response/error received.

**Deactivation**

Where customer has not used the correct procedure, guide them on the correct deactivation DIY procedure.

If customer is the recipient of diverts and wishes to have them deactivated, ask them for the number that has diverted to them (they can get it by asking the diverted callers for the number they had dialed), query it on HLR and deactivate the diverts – select Supplementary Services > clear Call Diverts.

**Activation**

Where customer has not used the correct activation procedure, give them the correct procedure.

In case customer has used the correct procedure, confirm the Call Diverts status on HLR:

CFU PROV TS10-telephony: Call Forwarding Unconditional

CFBUSY PROV TS10-telephony: Call Forwarding when busy

CFNREPLY PROV TS10-telephony: Call Forwarding when no reply

CFNREACH PROV TS10-telephony: Call Forwarding when not Reachable

**Note:**

If PROV is replaced by ACT it means that the diverts is activated.

All can be cancelled by clearing Diverts under ‘Supplementary Services” \- Expand and Click on “Suppl Services” > Enter MSISDN Prefix under ‘NDC’ & the rest of the number under ‘SN’ > Select “Cancel Diverts” under Service> Enter Comments (reason for the action) 

If **NOT** active, confirm whether customer has Call Barring (Barings are Mutually Exclusive to Divert), and advise accordingly;

If a customer has barring’s on his line, he cannot activate diverts.

If a customer has active diverts (including missed call alert), he cannot activate barring’s on his line. If he/she tries to activate barring’s and he has diverted, it will only bar incoming SMSs.

In short, Barring’s and Diverts cannot work together for calls. i.e., with active calls diverts, cannot activate calls barring’s but can activate SMS barring’s.

**Call Divert active on HLR but giving below Errors**

**Triple tone when calling a number.**

This can be because the called recipient may have diverted his/her calls to more than one number.

Diverts can only be activated from party A to B and not A to B to C to D etc.

“The subscriber is not available, try later" or "Sorry we are not able to complete your call at the moment, please try later."

The customer who has diverted calls has insufficient airtime for the call to be diverted to the second party.

“We cannot complete your call as dialled, please check the number and dial again’’

They have diverted to an incomplete number. e.g., diverted to 07225555, intending to divert to 0722555555

“The number dialled is not in service please call 991 for assistance’’

Number has been diverted to a landline number that is no longer in service

“Number is temporarily out of service’’

Calls have been diverted to a number that has been barred by admin, or the owner has activated incoming call barring.

# **Escalations**

If all is confirmed to be okay and still diverts not working

Confirm whether there is any reported network fault.

Customer can also try another handset (since some old models may not accept network procedure given)

Raise SR (SLA 14hours) if still unable to (de)activate divert.

Any funds received or deposited into your M-PESA account will automatically be used to clear your outstanding Kilimo Float balance. Repayment between normal Fuliza and Kilimo float will be on first borrow first repay basis.

**Delayed repayment Sanctions**

You will not have access to your Kilimo Float Limit if you have any unpaid balance after 30 days. Access will be restored upon full repayment of the outstanding balance.

**Reversals**

Reversals of money sent to wrong till or Paybill using Kilimo Float will follow the standard Lipa na M-PESA reversal process, provided the merchant has not utilized the funds. 

Note: Transactional charges are non-refundable.

**Is Kilimo Float a loan product?**

No. Kilimo Float is a continuous overdraft service that allows you to complete purchases when you have insufficient funds in your M-PESA account.

**Growing my Kilimo Float**

Continue using Safaricom and M-PESA services frequently and ensure timely repayment by topping up your M-PESA account.

**Customer Support & CRM Interactions/SRs**

All customer queries will be handled at Safaricom Care touch points & captured under Interaction Type: **Fuliza M-PESA** and the relevant Kilimo Float Sub-type.

articleTitle: Guidelines for SIM Replacement/SIM Swap of a Lipa Na M-PESA Buy Goods Merchant Till
markdownContent:
The merchant should call using the nominated number or finance contact number, which is presented on WDE, and the CEE confirms using G3 if the number is correct. 

# **Checks Required**

- Customer cannot call with a line from another network but only **nominated number/finance contact number**. If not calling from nominated number/finance contact number, advise customer to call with nominated number/finance contact number or to visit care desk/retail shop.
- SIM Replacement requests will be handled with reference to the acquirer/aggregator.
- Check the previous interactions to get more insight on the level of interaction with the customer to avoid issuing customers details.
- Confirm with the merchant that they have the SIM replacement SIMEX for SIM swap.
- Refer Merchants calling for the 3rd time of failed vetting to the nearest retail shop or care desk and advise that they need to carry an ID.
- Check the location of the caller's mobile number and the line being swapped on ‘fraudster location’ on SAWA system. If the caller is confirmed to be in a prison site, proceed as follows: -
- First verify the tariff, if it indicates ‘M-PESA agent tariff’, ‘SYJ tariff’, ‘dealer tariff’, do not suspend the line. Refer the customer to a different dealer/care desk/retail shop as SIM Swap isn’t possible in a prison site.
- If the tariff is not as above, display the fraudster's account on Siebel and suspend both incoming and outgoing calls, refer the customer to a Care desk/Retail shop as SIM Swap isn’t possible in a prison site.
- If the line is not located in a prison site, proceed to vet the partner.

**NOTE:** 

Over scratched sites does not affect the outcome of a swap. Only fraud hot sites/prison site.

# **Vetting for Safaricom Acquired stores**

- Organization name
- Store/Merchant till number
- Any contact on the organization contacts details on G3
- New serial number

# **Vetting for: Independent Merchant Product, Small Merchant Product or Medium Merchant Product**

- Business/Organization Name.
- Till or Store number.
- Store Balance or Last Transaction (incoming/Outgoing).
- Primary Operator (PO) details as indicated on G3 on the till/Store:
- Primary Operator ID.
- Primary Operator name (first and Surname).
- Registered Document ID.
- Date of Birth.

**NOTE:** To confirm the product assigned the Store on M-PESA G3; search the store on M-PESA G3 \> Click on Info Tab (under Overview) > then Click on Product.

# **Vetting for Aggregated/Acquired Merchants (by Bank and Non-Banks)**

Vet the finance contact person available on M-PESA G3, by confirming:

Names as per finance contact details on G3.

ID number of the finance contact.

Email address/mobile number where available.

Store/till number.

**NOTE:** Where finance contact details are not available, the merchant will be referred to their respective aggregator/acquirer for a SIM replacement.

# **SIM SWAP Requests for Standalone Merchants**

- Requests for standalone organizations will be accompanied by a written request; on official letter head, stamped or with the company seal or via an authenticated email address (email matching the one on G3).
- These requests will be done at the Retail or via email to EBU CARE email teams.
- The requester will present a written request (present to retail/email to M-PESA Business [M-PESABusiness@Safaricom.co.ke](mailto:M-PESABusiness@Safaricom.co.ke) [/Lipanampesa@Safaricom.co.ke](mailto:/Lipanampesa@Safaricom.co.ke))
- Original ID of the person requesting must be presented if the request is presented at the Retail

**Note:** ID presented must match the details of the finance contact/nominated number available on M-PESA G3 as indicated on the letter.

# **Effecting SIM swap after vetting.**

- If the Merchant passes vetting the CEE will go ahead to effect the SIM swap of the notification receiving MSISDN.
- Advise the Partner that the new SIM card will be active on the network within 20 minutes.
- **There will be no activation of the M-PESA Menu after SIM Swap of LNM till notification MSISDNs as the LNM notification SIMs do not require the M-PESA Menu.**
- Ensure to capture the vetting details on Siebel Interactions.
- If the Merchant cannot provide the required vetting details, refer them to Retail shop/Care desk (with their ID) or call back with correct details.

# **NOTE FOR ALL TILL MSISDNS AFTER SWAP**

- For the till MSISDN, merchant does not need to activate M-PESA menu after swap since the MSISDN is specifically used for payment notifications and does not require the M-PESA Menu on STK.
- After swap, the merchant can use the swapped SIMEX to receive payment notifications. Do NOT Advise merchants on M-PESA Menu reactivation for the till MSISDN.
