The Jiandikishe App will have the below features:

The App can only be accessed using Safaricom mobile data which is zero-rated, with the exemption of downloads from play store.

The App only allows one login at a time. One agent would need to log out for the other to login.

Each user is mapped to a specific IMEI. Users are unable to log in on an IMEI in which they are not mapped.

The application offers the customer a choice to register M-PESA as they register for GSM activation, or GSM activation only. This is however defined at creation of users’ level.

The APP can be accessed via whitelisted devices on Sub Reg App.

The APP will also be available on approved MobiGo devices.

**NOTE:** The Partners will NOT be allowed to register minors, corporates, foreigners or any customer presenting any registration document other than a Kenyan ID, Kenyan Valid Passport.

# **Subscriber Registration modes at Safaricom outlets**

Subscriber registration is done at Safaricom shops, Care desks, and franchise shops as per applicable guidelines.

Subscriber registration is done solely via:

The Safaricom Jiandikishe APP. This is the primary registration tool at all Safaricom outlets for registration of individual lines.

# **Uses of** **The Jiandikishe Web system.**

As a BCP when the Subscriber Registration APP is unavailable due to system downtime / failures, upon approval by AML team. Communication will be shared via email advising teams to use the same.

For registration of corporate lines.

Registration of recreated lines i.e. pooled and deleted lines by the AS.

Corporate registration web portal. For DSA bulk registration for corporate customers.

# **LTE Definition**

LTE stands for long term evolution – it’s a technology that is set to deliver very high data speeds.

LTE Fixed internet is a dedicated fixed internet link delivered via the 4G LTE GSM network.

It is a fast and affordable internet connection for small to medium sized businesses.

This will offer EBU SME customers fixed internet connection via 4G and will be sold to customers in areas/buildings with no fiber connection.

It has a wider coverage and can be installed anywhere with 4G connection.

# **Benefits for the Internet for Business**

- High speed and reliable internet connectivity.
- Competitive packages giving you value for your money.
- Simple and quick process from order to connection.
- Transparent billing process.
- A range of packages to suite your business requirements.

# **Requirements for signing up**

You will be required to visit a Safaricom Shop with the following documents/details:

| Company Type | KYC Requirements | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Category A | Private/ PublicCompany | Certified copy of Certificate ofIncorporation |
| Sponsor’s Valid National ID, Passport, military service card or alien card | | |
| Dully filled in & signed LTE ApplicationForm | | |
| Category B | Other Business Establishments not falling under the category of registeredprivate or public companies | Certified copy of Certificate ofRegistration |
| Sponsor’s Valid National ID, Passport, military service card or alien card | | |
| Dully filled in & signed LTE ApplicationForm | | |
| Category C | Any other business entity not possessingany one of the above documents | Sponsor’s Valid National ID, Passport,Military service card or Alien card |
| Valid Business Permit (at least 1 month to expiry) | | |
| Business Owners' KRA PIN certificate | | |
| Dully filled in & signed LTE ApplicationForm | | |

# **Installation**

You will not be expected to pay any additional fees for installation. However, installation will not cover any internal LAN office cabling at the customer premise.

Service installation will start immediately after payment with the intention to complete installation within the shortest time possible.

The customer will receive the following equipment on installation:

- An external antenna/access terminal
- A free Wi-Fi enabled router

This equipment is to be used exclusively for provision of this service and will remain the property of Safaricom to be re-possessed when a customer chooses to unsubscribe from the service.

**N.B:** For 4G Coverage MAP for areas covered by 4G/LTE advance network, open with Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox Browsers, by copy-pasting the full link below- [http://intranet.safaricom.co.ke/sites/Technology/maps/SitePages/4G%20Map.aspx](http://intranet.safaricom.co.ke/sites/Technology/maps/SitePages/4G%20Map.aspx)

# **Product Mechanics**

The product will ride on the existing Safaricom 4G network.

The product is configured as unlimited data bundle in CBS to allow dedicated speed and thus at no time will customers be exposed to low data balance as is the case for mobile data.

The product is only available on Postpay.

Customers subscribed to the service will have:

# **Sponsor MSISDN**

This is the Contact number provided at sign up which will be whitelisted on USSD \*485# and to call 2222 for support.

This is the number which will be used to manage the service.

It will be used to activate the service after installation.

# **Beneficiary MSISDN**

Number on Postpay tariff (Data Global Tariff) number will be in the equipment. The number has a static IP and Fixedlte APN.

The Beneficiary line is on Postpay and follows the current Postpay billing cycle.

Beneficiary MSISDN is the identifier for the account and this number will be used to view account details on CRM.

# **LTE Billing**

**LTE Packages**

Find Prices below that will apply inclusive on VAT and Excise duty:

| Bandwidth | Price (Kshs) |
| --- | --- |
| LTE Fixed Internet 3Mbps | 5,749 |
| LTE Fixed Internet 4Mbps | 11,499 |
| LTE Fixed Internet 5Mbps | 17,249 |
| LTE Fixed Internet 6Mbps | 22,999 |
| LTE Fixed Internet 7Mbps | 28,749 |

# **LTE Payment options**

Bill payment can be done in the following ways:

- Payments will be made using Paybill number 200200 and using MSISDN as the account number.
- Payments can also be made at Retail centers using the beneficiary MSISDNs/account **like any other Postpay payment. They could pay cash or via Bank deposits.**

# **Billing Mechanics**

The following Postpay billing mechanics will apply:

- Postpay monthly calendar billing apply.
- Bill Proration will automatically be done during onboarding where creations are done within the month.
- Service will renew every 1st of the month if the previous month’s bill is settled. The current month’s bill will be due date on 16th. Disconnections will be communicated progressively every month for unpaid links.
- During onboarding customers will pay a deposit only (equivalent to the price of the package). For example, a customer interested in the 1Mbps package will pay Deposit: 4999/- only.
- For deposit exempt customer they will not require to pay any amount during sign up.
- The deposit is refundable after terminating the service if all the bills are cleared.

# **LTE billing cycle**

Depending on the date of activation the first month will be prorated.

The billing cycle begins on 1st of the month and runs on a calendar month just like any other Postpay line.

The service will renew every 1st of the month and payment for the month will be due on 16th day of the billing month.

If payment is not made, disconnections will be done as per the current Postpay dunning milestones.

Reconnections will be done once the payment is made in full. Reconnections will be automated after payment of the bill.

If a bill for a certain month is not paid as at 1st of the following month, renewal of the service will be done only when the outstanding bill is cleared.

LTE customers do not qualify for payments plans.

# **Deposit Management**

**Customer with an Existing Deposit**

**On upgrade:**

This is only available to M-PESA registered customers. In the meantime, the non-M-PESA registered customers will continue using the current manual process.

The customer will get an STK Push request to pay the difference between the new package and the deposit paid for the previous one from M-PESA.

**On downgrade:**

This is available to both M-PESA and non-MPESA registered customers.

Customers will receive difference between the new package and the deposit paid for the previous one as a prepayment for following month’s bill.

# **Deposit Exempt Customers**

These customers have already received deposit exemption from credit control and thus an upgrade or downgrade will not trigger deposit management.

LTE Advanced is an upgrade of LTE. It achieves higher internet browsing speeds as compared to those offered by LTE.

To enjoy the superior service, customers will need:

4G capable Devices (phone/tablet/modem).

4G enabled SIM card.

Be in an area covered by the 4G service.

# **Confirming 4G handset connection**

Check under network settings to activate or deactivate 4G. Depending on the model of your phone, you will see LTE/4G in addition to other mobile network settings as below:

iPhone: Settings> Mobile/Cellular> Voice & Data

Android: Settings> More Networks> Mobile Networks> Network mode> Change to LTE/4G.

# **MPLS Over LTE**

MPLS over LTE is a fixed bandwidth non-internet link provided via the 4G LTE network.

The service is availed via a private APN with a static IP

5 Bandwidths are available from 1Mbps to 5Mbps

Service is offered subject to availability of a strong Safaricom 4G network (>-100dBM)

Service supports MPLS & Point to Point connections

**I have an existing internet link; will I be eligible to join this new package?**

Yes. You can apply for a service change through our sales teams.

KIFARUNET service is offered all over Kenya in areas covered by Safaricom Fibre. You can subscribe to more than one connection.

articleTitle: Identification on Siebel Definition and Mechanics

# **DEFINITION**

This refers to the procedure where a CEE edits a customer’s registration details on CRM to change their details from Dummy Dummy to their names as registered on Jiandikishe.

# 

# **REASONS FOR IDENTIFICATION ON SIEBEL**

- For orders to be raised on new lines, First Call activation has to be done and CEE can only do First Call activation after line is identified on CRM.
- For customers to access web-selfcare, and other self-service options e.g. advantage plus activation, PUK, Service PIN, Bonga PIN.
- To perform a Sim Swap.

# 

# **CUSTOMER IDENTIFICATION PROCEDURE ON** **CRM**

- The CEE must ensure that there are customer’s details on Jiandikishe before identifying the line on CRM
- The details on Jiandikishe should match with details on M-PESA. If they are not matching, the CEE should refer the customer to the nearest retail center for identification.
- At the retail center, the CEE will vet the customer and identify the line.
- Where the person registered on Jiandikishe is different from the one registered on M-PESA, a change of ownership will be done.
- The identification procedure is as follows:

- - Query the number on CRM
 - Click on tasks
 - Click on identify subscriber
 - Fill in the customer details as seen on Jiandikishe i.e., ID and name, address and street to be provided by customer.
 - Click on next.
 - Enter the customer’s document ID and select the appropriate document type then click next. The line is now identified

articleTitle: Definition, eligibility and mechanics of US EMBASSY SAFARICOM
markdownContent:
# **Definition**

This is a partnership program between Safaricom and US Embassy that allows customers to apply for US Visa Electronically and pay using M-PESA Services.

# **Eligibility**

It’s Eligible to all Immigrants and Non-Immigrants with a valid Passport.

# **How it works:**

a) Non-immigrant visa applicants will register on the American Embassy web portal.

b) Pays the non-immigrant visa application processing fee through the Machine-Readable Visa (MRV) system prior to scheduling an appointment.

c) Complete the Nonimmigrant Visa Electronic Application by visiting [https://ceac.state.gov/genniv](https://ceac.state.gov/genniv) and print out the DS-160 confirmation (barcode) number for each applicant.

d) Pay the Visa Application (MRV) fee for each applicant.

e) Schedule an appointment at the Consular Section through the service.

**NB:** Advice enquiring customers that before making payment for fees one is required to register on the American Embassy web portal [http://usvisa-info.com](http://usvisa-info.com/).

# **Customer service**

a) A customer can access the U.S Visa Information by visiting the U.S Website listed below;

[http://usvisa-info.com](http://usvisa-info.com/).

b) They can also contact the US Embassy while in Kenya or in the U.S by the below availed contact numbers available Monday through to Friday 8a.m to 6p.m.

**+254 020 363 6622** and **+254 020 500 6655/56** Local time. (Normal Calling Charges Apply).

**Paybill Customer Payment Mechanics.**

# **Payment by Customers**

Companies that wish to accept payment via M-PESA need to first open a business account with M-PESA.

On meeting the requirements, the company signs a contract with Safaricom and is then configured on the system and issued with a unique number called the ‘business number”.

This is the number that the customer keys in under Business number when paying for their bills.

To do the payment or use Paybill Service the customer will follow below Mechanics:

# **Via Safaricom Tool Kit**

Select M-PESA from the Safaricom Kiosk/Toolkit

Select "Lipa Na M-PESA"

Select ‘Pay Bill’ from their M-PESA menu.

Enter the ‘business number’ of the company they are paying to’

Enter the ‘account number’ of the bill they wish to pay.

Enter the amount they wish to pay (between KShs. 1 – 70,000).

Enter their M-PESA PIN and confirm Payment

# **Via Safaricom app:**

Select Lipa Na M-PESA

Select Paybill

Enter Paybill number

Enter account number

Enter amount

Confirm Hakikisha and

Enter M-PESA PIN then OK.

# **Settlement of Funds by Partners**

**Via USSD \*234#ok:** The partner will be whitelisted to access the partners USSD service to initiate the roll up.

**Via Web:** The partner will initiate the roll up via the current defined portal(s) after they are given access rights, they login and follow prompts to do the settlement and incase the portal is inaccessible; they can send email to [M-PESAbusiness@safaricom.co.ke](mailto:M-PESAbusiness@safaricom.co.ke)

# **Settlement Mode (By Partners)**

The settlement mode can be:

To M-PESA account,

To a bank account

Or to both

# **Bulk Payment (B2C) Partial Reversal**

**Banks and other Organizations are now enabled to make partial reversal of funds sent to mobile money wallets via B2C**.

The banks will now be able to reverse where funds are partially utilised by the recipient.

# **How it Works.**

**Recipient has Full Amount to be Reversed.**

- Normal reversal journey will take place.
- The Business Web Operator will initiate the reversal on G2 system and be approved by the Business Manager.

**Recipient M-PESA Balance = KSh 0.00**

- The Business Web Operator will get the pop up as shown below.
- No further action will be possible as funds will have been used.

**The Recipient has Funds but is Less than the Amount to be Reversed.**

- The Business Web Operator will proceed to initiate the reversal as per procedure.
- The reversal will display the amount available.
- The Business Web Operator will proceed if they want to reverse the displayed amount and have it approved by the Business Manager
- Once the first reversal is done, the matter will be taken as closed and no further reversals of the same transaction will be possible in future.

Find the guide attached.

# HUSTLER FUND GROUP LOANS

**Introduction**

The Hustler fund is a digital financial inclusion initiative designed to improve financial access to responsible finance for personal, micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) in Kenya. With over ***KSh. 17B*** disbursed to over ***18M customers,*** the Government in collaboration with the Mobile Network Operators extended the product to individual businesses and Women Enterprises Fund Groups.

The credit facility has been opened to other groups but restricted to persons registered on M-PESA and other networks only, through the availing of the Hustler Funds Group Loan product. Anyone, with an unregistered line either on M-PESA or other networks, will not be able to access this service.

**What Is Hustler Funds Group Loan**

This is a product that offers affordable credit facilities to registered groups to achieve their business agenda and boost the savings culture while creating momentum for sustainable development.

**Objectives**

- Drive financial inclusion through access to financial assistance.
- Provide affordable credit to allow growth in their businesses, thus fostering economic development.
- Promote a savings culture to take individuals’ entrepreneurial journeys to new heights.

**Key Highlights**

- This is available to only persons registered on Mobile Money transfer either on Safaricom network or other networks. This service is not available for persons who have not registered their line on any mobile network.
- The group must have a minimum of 10 members and a max of 100 members.
- A member MUST be registered on M-PESA, using their National ID.
- The limit depends on each member scoring, but a group can qualify for up to KSh 1,000,000.
- Funds requested are awarded in two parts: 95% to groups account, and 5% to the Groups Savings account.
- Loan charged at an interest rate of 7% P.A.
- Loan tenure is 1 and 3 months.

**Access Channels**

Customers can access Hustler Funds via

- USSD: \*254#
- Hustler Fund Mini-App on the M-PESA App will be availed later.

**Eligibility**

The product is only available to persons who have registered their line on any Mobile Money network. Any registered line will be enabled to be onboarded in any group. During opt-in registered groups will select M-PESA. Please note; that lines not registered on any mobile network will not be able to create a group. They must first be registered to be able to create a group.

**Creating a group**

The person creating the group will have to select their role from the three roles available: Chairperson, Secretary, or Treasurer. So, it is only an official who can create the group and invite group members.

**Requirements to join the group**

- Member must be a Kenyan citizen of 18 years of age and above.
- Member must be registered on M-PESA mobile money using a National ID card.
- Member must have had an active SIM card with at least 90 days age on network.
- Members must accept the Terms and Conditions and the group invitations to opt-in.

**Main difference between the Hustler Fund group loan and the other Hustler Fund products**

articleTitle: Call Centre/Retail Guideline on B2C Reversal/Failed Settlement
markdownContent:
# **CEE Action Required for B2C reversal**

1. The CEE will vet the customer to establish details of the transaction and confirm the transaction product type as B2C.
2. The CEE will advise the customer as follows:

1. 1. The Customer will contact the organization disbursing the funds
 2. For wrong mobile banking reversals request the customer to directly contact the bank.
 3. Where the organization contact person contacts us, advise them to send an email to M-PESABusiness@Safaricom.co.ke or the respective shop’s email address with their request or call 0722002222 /2222 from the contact number whitelisted to call the service line.

3. Once received M-PESA Business/RCSA/CCSA will initiate the reversal and follow up on completion and advise the organization.

# **Bulk Reversal Process**

# **Initiating the Bulk Reversal**

1. Login to M-PESA G2 and Go to my functions, Select Bulk, select Bulk Task Template, Download and then select Bulk Transaction reversal.
2. Download Template, paste the transaction IDs on the field under #Receipt Number, remove the 100000 that appears on the template
3. Save the file in CSV (comma delimited) format
4. click yes to keeping it in that format
5. Go to Create Bulk task plan, then select add
6. Select the blue folder to begin your upload process, it will allow you to browse, search for where the template was saved, select the file you saved, then select the green arrow to upload.
7. On the description copy the sender of the e-mail request.
8. Select next available slot and submit, then select yes when prompted on whether you want to submit the task.
9. To view the completed task, go to Bulk Task Plan History. Your file should be on the page, select the operation ICON.
10. You should be able to view the Bulk Task Plan; it will show you the successful and failed items.
11. Click on the Report and download the file in CSV format
12. A similar report will be generated showing the total amount recovered, you can share the excel with the customer on the initiated transactions.

# **Completing the bulk reversal**

1. A different user must log in to M-PESA G2; it’s important to note the time stamp when the transactions were done.
2. Go to the transactions tab and select confirm transaction
3. On the initiation time, select the time frame
4. On the reason type select, the reason based on the request e.g. B2C Reversal for B2C reversal request, or pay utility for C2B reversal requests etc.
5. Click the receipt no to select all the transaction, action should be approved and, on the reason, copy the e-mail.
6. Then select submit and confirm
7. The completed reversal transaction report can be obtained from the organization’s short code.

# **Failed Settlement/B2C Resubmission**

# **CEE Action Required**

1. Confirm the withdrawal of funds from the LNM Account and a subsequent deposit of the funds on the Nominated number mobile account.
2. Where the transaction fails to reverse, and the nominated number does not receive funds; CEE will raise an SR (SLA 72 HRS).

# **Support Analyst Action required**

RCSA/M-PESA Corporate/CCSA will initiate a B2B reversal back to the merchant’s account and advise the merchant to initiate the withdrawal.
Refer to attachment for FAQs on Gearing for Growth.

articleTitle: Fibre To The Home (FTTH) Change of Ownership Service
markdownContent:
# **FTTH Change of ownership.**

This procedure is applicable where customer requests for transfer of account from one individual to another, where a previous owner wishes to handover FTTH account ownership to a new owner.

Request for transfer of ownership can either be done by the previous owner or the new owner.

# **Request presented by previous owner.**

Where the previous owner has visited the retail center, the CEE will request the customer to: -

Fill the FTTH transfer of ownership request form or provide a written request, clearly indicating details of change. The letter should entail:

Customers full name. (For New and previous owner)

- CI number being transferred.
- ID numbers. (For New and previous owner)
- Signature of both parties, agreeing to the terms of the change.
- Current estate and house number (where applicable)
- Customer valid email address
- Present their original valid ID.
- Present original and valid ID of new owner.

The CEE will vet customer to validate ownership, by vetting customer request against Siebel CRM / Jiandikishe and FTTH sales portal, as per the vetting procedure.

CEE will effect changes by doing a pre to pre, once validation is done.

CEE will select tariff as Fiber to the home.

# **Request presented by intended recipient of account.**

Where the new owner presents request on behalf of the registered customer, CEE will request customer for:

A duly filled change of ownership form or a written request by the previous owner detailing the need to change ownership of the line from him/herself to the new owner. The letter should entail: -

Customer full names. (For New and previous owner)

CI number being transferred.

- ID numbers. (For New and previous owner)
- Signature of both parties, agreeing to the terms of the change.
- Present their original valid ID.
- Present original and valid ID of registered customer.
- Provide an alternative Safaricom contact number of the previous owner (donor)

The CEE will confirm the validity of the request by contacting the previous owner on the contact number provided for vetting and will apply secondary vetting.

CEE will notify the previous owner that the change discharges Safaricom from any liability relating to transfer.

The CEE will vet by screening customer request against customer account details.

CEE will effect changes by doing a pre to pre, once validation is done. And will select tariff as Fiber to the home.

Where customer fails vetting CEE will politely advice accordingly.

CEE will attach customer request and both ID’s on Siebel CRM, create an interaction and order relate the attachments and file as per the filling procedure.

CEE will send an email safaricomhomeretention@safaricom.co.ke .

CEE will indicate the customer’s name, ID, mobile no, email.

Home team will update customer details on the applicable portal, and this will trigger customer MSISDN whitelist for notifications etc. and L400 access.

# **Request presented by next of kin**

Where the new owner presents request on account registered to a deceased registered customer. CEE will request customer for:

Letter of administration/grant of probate.

- Death Certificate.
- Claimants ID.
- Present their original valid ID.
- Written request.

The CEE will vet by screening customer request against customer account details.

CEE will effect changes by doing a pre to pre, once validation is done. And will select tariff as Fiber to the home.

Where customer fails vetting CEE will politely advice accordingly.

CEE will attach customer request and ID’s on Siebel CRM, create an interaction and order relate the attachments and file as per the filling procedure.

CEE will send an email safaricomhomeretention@safaricom.co.ke .

CEE will indicate the customer’s name, ID, mobile no, email.

Home team will update customer details on the applicable portal, and this will trigger customer MSISDN whitelist for notifications etc. and L400 access.

articleTitle: Service Change, Account Management, Customer Support and Termination of ONE CONNECT by support staff
markdownContent:
**Service Change, Account Management, Customer Support and Termination of ONE CONNECT by support staff.**

# **Service Change & Account Management:**

Service change requests will come from customers during in-life phase of the customer journey via their respective account managers or visiting Safaricom shop.

All customers shall be required to fill in a Service Change Form and share it back by emailing business.support@Safaricom.co.ke.

# **Upgrade/Downgrade**

1. A Customer requesting for capacity adjustment will be provided with a change of service form. i.e. Upgrade or Downgrade and be advised to fill it and share it back to business.Support@safaricom.co.ke.
2. Once the CEE receives the email with the filled form, from the business support email activity, s/he will raise an SR and attach the filled form for the demand desk/MSO to action on the same request.

**NB:** CEE needs to ensure customer has filled CI, Current speed uplink and downlink and new speeds needs to be captured on the customer form (indicating uplink and downlink as well).

# **Link Relocation**

1. For Link relocations the customer will make a call to our support team on 0722002222 from their whitelisted number.
2. The CEE will then send the customer a sample email from business.support@safaricom.co.ke. and attach relocation survey form in MS word and change of service form in PDF.
3. Once the CEE receives the service change form, they will confirm that the customer has filled all the details and then raise SR attaching the relocation survey details.

# **Customer Support**

1. Customers can reach us via:

1. By calling us on 0722002222 from the designated number. The calling number will be whitelisted to access the service.
2. Email us at business.support@safaricom.co.ke.
3. Through their respective Account Managers.

2. The CEE receiving the call will query and probe the customer, to determine possible diagnosis and resolve the issue raised.
3. The CEE needs to check if the Internet is ok. If the Internet is ok and the customer cannot still, make/receive calls, proceed with below troubleshooting:
4. Confirm if the customer has resources.
5. Confirm if the customer has exceeded their credit limit.
6. For troubleshooting use INFLEX AFRICA TECHNOLOGIES-UC Link. The number is 0205100035. Remove the zero in front when searching the number on Siebel.
7. Check the customer’s account on Siebel to confirm the account is active and it’s not in arrears. If the account is closed and or is in arrears, clients link could have been disconnected.
8. Check to confirm the status of the clients’ link using available systems. If the link is up, and client’s router is reachable after troubleshooting, advised client to check on LAN.
9. Check to confirm the status of the main switch on which the client link is connected and using the available systems.
10. NB: The main switch (UC switch) is normally placed within the building in which the client is being housed.
11. Check possibility of general network outage, if not the case that is if its client specific.
12. Check to confirm the calls not being made/received are prefix specific or not. Whether it’s the case or otherwise. If not, the case that is if its client specific.
13. In a scenario the issue cannot be resolved, the CEE will escalate the same via SR for Support team to deal. SLA is 24hrs.

# **Termination**

A client requesting for link termination will be provided with a link termination form and be advised to fill it and share it back via business.support@safaricom.co.ke.

1. The Customer will fill in the termination form and have it signed and stamped as appropriate. Scan and attach it on email and send it back via the mentioned email address.
2. Upon receipt of the customer’s email with the termination attachment, the CEE will reply to the customers email clearly informing the customer that in case they change their mind they cannot reactivate the same account, but they will have to apply for a new one.
3. CEE will then raise an SR for the Termination request to be done.

# **Application Process /Requirements**

1. The customer must fill the application form. These forms can be acquired from the Safaricom retail shops, or via email request sent to M-PESA Business M-PESABusiness@Safaricom.co.ke or via our Website [https://www.safaricom.co.ke/images/Bulkpayment-Application-Forms-and-TermsConditions.pdf](https://www.safaricom.co.ke/images/Bulkpayment-Application-Forms-and-TermsConditions.pdf)
2. Once the forms are filled; the customer will be required to bring them to Safaricom Limited, Safaricom House HQ2, Waiyaki Way for receipt by the M-PESA Merchant Support Team, give them to the Safaricom sales team, drop them at any retail center or email scanned copies to M-PESA Business M-PESABusiness@Safaricom.co.ke
3. Customers can also check requirements and apply on Lipa Na M-PESA Self Onboarding Portal [https://selfservice.m-pesaforbusiness.co.ke/LNM/](https://selfservice.m-pesaforbusiness.co.ke/LNM/)
4. Client to produce all KYC documentation founder via our Website [https://www.safaricom.co.ke/images/Downloads/Resources\_Downloads/Bulk\_payment\_Requirements.pdf](https://www.safaricom.co.ke/images/Downloads/Resources_Downloads/Bulk_payment_Requirements.pdf)

# **Portal Payment Process**

1. The system will check the registration status of the receiving MSISDNs on G2 and automatically select an appropriate transaction type.
2. Transaction types set and configured on the portal are:

1. Business payments to customers with withdrawal charges
2. Business Payments to customers

3. For the transaction to be initiated:

1. The accounts must have enough funds i.e. short code on G2 must have sufficient funds.
2. The transaction cost plus the amount to transfer must be equal or less than account balance. If this is not met the transaction will cancel the transaction will fail

4. The organization will be responsible for ensuring that the utility account has sufficient float.
5. Funding will be done as per the current LNM Short codes funding procedures.
6. The Current M-PESA transaction limits apply.
7. The portal will send the request to M-PESA G2 via API. This will:

1. Initiate a balance query on the respective Short Code’s utility account on M-PESA G2
2. Where the balance is sufficient in the Utility account the B2C payment will be processed as per request.
3. Where the balance is insufficient a balance query will be done on the MFF account.
4. If the balance is sufficient in the MFF account; funds will move from MFF to Utility and the B2C payment will be processed as per request.
5. The funds are insufficient in the MFF account the B2C payment will fail.

# **Special Rule Band**

The API MFF balance query will only be possible for short codes will the Special Rule band on M-PESA G2. Where the organization Short Code does not have the Special Rule Band and the organization has M-PESA web access;

1. They will be advised to move the cash manually from MMF to Utility account and the team will escalate these as indicated below.
2. Call Center CEE will escalate via SR to LNM Support to change the Rule Band
3. M-PESA Corporate will change the Short Code’s Rule Band
4. Retail Center/Care Desk CEE will escalate via SR to the RCSA to effect the change.
5. SR’s SLA is 24 hours.
6. Where the organization does not have web access change of Rule Band will be escalated as above.

# **Usage of M-Tiba wallet**

The M-TIBA wallet can be used at all participating M-TIBA healthcare providers. These will be recognizable through signs carrying the M-TIBA logo. One can search for the participating hospitals by:

1. Asking M-TIBA agent for a list of healthcare facilities
2. Calling the Toll-Free line on 0800 721253
3. Visiting www.mtiba.co.ke to see a list of healthcare facilities
4. Dialing \*253# and choose FIND CLINIC in the main menu

**M-TIBA agent and functions**

An M-TIBA agent is an authorized person who can provide information on M-TIBA and help a customer with the following activities:

1. Registration on M-TIBA
2. Transfer funds from their (customers) M-PESA to their (customers) M-TIBA
3. Provide a list of healthcare facilities participating in M-TIBA in the area.
4. Provide information about promotional offerings on M-TIBA.

**N/B:** Users are advised not to give cash to M-TIBA Agents.

# **Funds Transfer Limit**

1. A customer can transfer funds into their M-TIBA as often as they wish. There is no limit to the number of times they can transfer funds from their M-PESA to your M-TIBA.
2. Funds stored in M-TIBA do not expire.
3. M-PESA daily and transaction limits apply.
4. The minimum amount to transfer from M-PESA to M-TIBA is 10 Ksh.
5. There is no set minimum balance for M-TIBA.
6. There is no maximum limit of funds to store on M-TIBA
7. Transferring funds to a facility that is not participating in M-TIBA, the customer will get an error message and will not be able to make a payment.

# **Billing/overbilling on M-TIBA**

1. The healthcare facility uses a pre-agreed price list to bill Patients.
2. Users are advised to confirm the cost of a service with the healthcare provider before opening their M-TIBA.
3. For any further inquiries, users should call the Toll-Free line on 0800 721253.

# **Confirming Payment status on M-TIBA**

1. A customer will receive an SMS notification when they have opened their M-TIBA before getting treated, and another SMS when the healthcare facility has billed their M-TIBA.
2. The SMS sent after M-TIBA has been billed will indicate the cost of the services and medication and new M-TIBA balance.
3. Paying for others using M-TIBA is possible if they are added as a dependent. To add:

Dial \*253#, Login select Settings then “Add Dependent”; follow instructions to add dependents. Once the dependent is added then pay for his/ her treatment and medication.

4. A patient can only use M-TIBA to pay bills up to the value of funds they have stored. They can transfer additional funds to your M-TIBA directly from your M-PESA following instructions provided under item “How do I transfer funds to my M-TIBA?”

# **Lost Phone**

1. The customer will need to call Safaricom customer care and get their SIM card blocked.
2. Then they need to get a replacement for the SIM card at the nearest Safaricom shop.
3. After getting their new SIM card, they can continue using their M-TIBA by dialing \*235#.

# **Management of Funds upon death**

## Upon notification of death, by a next of kin by availing of a copy of the death certificate, the M-TIBA account will be in-activated and the remaining funds sent to their M-PESA account within 5 working days.

# **Relative or friend withdrawing the funds from M-TIBA**

1. The recipient can only use your funds to pay for healthcare at M-TIBA facilities.
2. If the relative or friend decides to exit their M-TIBA account, we will pay any remaining funds that you remitted back to you (withholding transaction charges).

# **Customer Care Support**

1. M-TIBA customer care service which is toll free and available 24 hours per day is 0800721253
2. Alternatively, one can visit www.mtiba.co.ke or email customercare@mtiba.co.ke

**M-PESA Agents Registration & Activations**

 **M-PESA Registration Process**

- New customers will visit M-PESA agent outlet with their identification document.
- The agent assistant will be required to capture the customer details **exactly** as they appear on the **ID.** Special characters will be captured as they appear on registration documents (e.g. Ng’ang’a, Wang’ombe e.tc.), failure to which validation fails and generate the error; ***Failed to register customer. Kindly enter the correct customer details as they appear on identification document.***
- The three fields i.e., FIRST NAME, MIDDLE NAME and SURNAME are mandatory:

- For Customers with only two names in their registration document, a space (NOT a character) should be entered in place of the middle name. In case the agent enters a character instead of a space, validation will fail and generate an error; Failed to register customer. Kindly enter the correct customer details as they appear on identification document.
- For Customers with more than three names in their registration document, the First Name and the Surname must be entered as they are. All other names should be entered in the field for middle name and separated with a single space. Failure to which validation fails and generate the error; Failed to register customer. Kindly enter the correct customer details as they appear on identification document.

- Registration will succeed even when IPRS is down and validate once the system is back. Any erroneously registered customers during the downtime gets a barred (with a notification) as soon as the system is back on
- Upon completing the registration, the details shall be compared with the **Government database** for accuracy.
- If the data is correct, then the agent shall receive a notification on the successful registration.
-  If the details are not correct, then the agent shall receive a message that the details should be entered exactly as they are on the original **ID**.

 **Registration For M-PESA Exclusive at Retail Centre’s**

-  Registration that can only be done at the Retail centre:

- Foreign passport,
- Military ID and Alien/foreigner certificate
- Ported line M-PESA registration

- The document ID should not be altered. It should be registered as follows:

- Where the ID DOB reads **00.00. YEAR** – The agent will input **01.01. YEAR**
- Where the ID DOB reads **YEAR ONLY** – The agent will input **31.12. YEAR**

**Note:** After registration, a start key will be sent to the customer's account and the CEE will assist the customer to activate their M-PESA account and advise the customer on safeguarding their pin.

# **M-PESA Registration by Agents / Retail**

-  **On confirmation** of the individual against the ID document presented, the M-PESA Agent/RCA will then proceed to fill details in the M-PESA registration form.
- **Registration Forms:** The customer must fill/complete and sign the registration form and the CEE /agent registering the customer must also sign the registration form.
- **Customers** that hold a document with a validity date (Alien certificate or Passport) must visit retail centre or care desk with the new document to have the document ID updated on document expiry and renewal
- **Steps to register a customer****:**

- To register for M-PESA, a customer will need a SIM card with the M-PESA menu. Then:
- From the M-PESA agent menu, select “Customer Services”.
- Choose “New Customer”
- Enter the following details:
- New first name – enter the customer’s first name.
- New second name – enter customer’s middle name (optional)
- New last name – enter customer’s surname New national ID – enter their ID or passport number.

**M-PESA Registration for Minors**

-  For requests on registration of minors, inform the customers that M-PESA service only recognizes persons above the age of 18 years. This is as per the M-PESA terms and conditions section 3.2 which states ‘You must be at least 18 years old and of sound mind to use the M-PESA Service.
- Minors can transact on M-PESA via M-PESA Go. M-PESA Go is a product designed for children between the ages of 10 to 17 years. The product allows them to use M-PESA services under the supervision of their parents/guardians. Advise the parents, guardians, or the under-age (below 17 years), who would like to receive money via M-PESA, to register for M-PESA GO through M-PESA GO sub-website. This is the is link to the website [https://myaccount.safaricom.co.ke/mpesa-go](https://myaccount.safaricom.co.ke/mpesa-go)

**NOTE: It will not be possible to send money to any unregistered line in any mobile network.**

  **M-PESA Multiple Registrations**

- If you receive a call from a subscriber who has more than 5 M-PESA accounts registered with the same ID number and names; advice the customer, as per the M-PESA policy one cannot register more than five accounts with the same details (ID number and name).
- They can choose to have the other accounts deactivated by visiting Safaricom retail canters/care desks and apply for deactivation; if there are funds in the account/s; for them to transfer the funds to the account(s) that they wish to remain with on the M-PESA service.

#  **Change of Ownership Registration Procedure**

- Change of ownership is done by both parties. The registered owner and the new person should visit any Safaricom retail centre with original identification documents or present a letter of consent from the registered person and attach a copy of their identification documents together with your original documents.

 **M-PESA Registration Scenarios**

- There are two scenarios under which an agent should check.

- Handle erroneous/irregular registration of customers M-PESA registration.
- Fraudulent subscriber registration

- If you receive a customer who is correctly registered on CRM, but M-PESA has different customer details, proceed as explained below.

#  **Lines Registered in Other Names On CRM**

- For lines registered in other names and the customer claims the line is theirs and they would like to continue using it, refer the customer to retail centre/ care desk for verification and proof of ownership.

 **The customer should carry:**

Identification document

The SIM certificate (plate that contains the PIN/PUK) to prove ownership of the Safaricom line since the line is registered in another name.

**Bulk Registration on SubReg Portal**

**Bulk Registration on SubReg Portal**

This is the registration of multiple lines at a time for corporate customers on the SubReg portal.

Corporate lines can only be registered through the SubReg portal and not on jiandikishe App.

A maximum of 100 lines can be registered for every single submission.

Corporate registration will be performed by Customer Experience Executives at the retail center.

**How to access SubReg portal**

Agents will be given access by the SubReg Admin team and then access the portal via 
[https://subreg-portal.safaricom.co.ke](https://subreg-portal.safaricom.co.ke/)

**Steps to follow on SubReg portal**

1. Log into the portal
2. Select bulk registration,
3. Fill in customer details: company name, document type, document id, date of registration, postal address, physical address, alternative phone number, landmark, attach certificate of registration, authorization letter, and simex file,
4. Submit company details,
5. Export csv (to view a list of the numbers registered) 

**Where the Corporate registration on SubReg portal fails the agent will:**

Raise a BMC ticket and forward to subregescalation@safaricom.co.ke

articleTitle: DigiFarm Definition, Features and Services Offered
markdownContent:
# **Definition and Eligibility**

**Summary**

DigiFarm Kenya Ltd., a fully owned subsidiary of Safaricom PLC, has been active in the Digitalization for Agriculture (D4Ag) space in Kenya since 2017, providing bundled services to farmers. DigiFarm mission is to bring smart agriculture to smallholder farmers to transform their lives and enhance food security. We provide an end-to-end agriculture platform that leverages technology, data and partnerships to sustainably connect smallholder farmers to the best products, services and markets.

**Definition**

DigiFarm offers comprehensive services to farmers, including input loan facilities, access to quality farm inputs through input distributors partnerships, insurance services, and farming advisory services. DigiFarm supports farmers in various value chains such as tea, coffee, sorghum, and other cash crops and livestock.

# **DigiFarm Ecosystem Players**

**Farmers**

Farmers are the primary players in the DigiFarm ecosystem. All product innovations and services are cantered around improving their farming practices, providing access to quality inputs, financial services, and markets, and ultimately transforming their lives.

**Financial Partners/Banks**

Financial partners and banks finance our loan product portfolios. They provide the necessary capital to support farm input loans and cash loans, enabling farmers to access the resources they need for successful farming.

**DigiFarm Service providers**

A DigiFarm service provider is a local distributor who has a relationship with the farmers they serve in their area. They act as a DigiFarm service center where the farmers can redeem their loan limits to receive inputs, mechanization services, soil testing services, irrigation services.

# **Features** **and Benefits of DigiFarm**

**Features**

- Farming Practices: Registered farmers will be able to access learning information on livestock and crops to educate them on best farming practices that will help them maximize their yield.
- Loan: Registered farmers will have access to a farm inputs loans which they can redeem to receive farm inputs such as feeds, seeds and fertilizers from the DigiFarm service providers. Registered farmers can also access cash loans. Farmers will only be able to view the loans available in their region, and for their crops.
- My Account: This feature enables registered farmers to view their details including farms, farming activities, loans, learning in progress and insurance options.

**Benefits**

DigiFarm’s vision is to make the small holder farmer wealthier from the same piece of land by addressing the following gaps;

- Quality inputs - Farmers on the platform will have access to quality farm inputs on credit from farm depots within the DigiFarm platform.
- Access to financial services – credit & insurance yield cover
- Access to markets - Registered farmers will have access to buyers within their region where they can receive payments through the DigiFarm payments platform.
- Access to Information - Knowledge on weather and best farming practices.
- Managing their accounts - This feature enables registered farmers to create a profile, view their details and edit their information.
- The farmer can check available services available for them by dialling \*944#.

# **Services Provided Under Digifarm**

**Accessing Farm Inputs** **on credit**

Visit any of your closest DigiFarm service providers to access inputs on credit. In order to transact, you will be requested to present your DigiFarm Farmer Number. This feature is only available for qualified farmers with a loan limit.

**Types of Inputs**

Inputs will differ according to the farming activity the farmer is engaged in:

- Mineral supplements (livestock & dairy)
- Feeds
- Fertilizer
- Crop protection
- Seeds
- Veterinary Products
- Equipment e.g. tarpaulins

**Digifarm** **Learning Content/Topics**

The farmer will be able to get learning any of the topics below:

**Crop training**

Learn how to increase your yield with farming best practices.

Learn about safe and proper use of herbicides, pesticides and fungicides.

**Dairy Farming**

Learn how to reduce costs and increase milk production by following best practices in Health management, Breeding, Milk handling, Housing, Record Keeping, Feeding and milk production.

**Poultry Farming**

Learn how to farm improved Kienyeji poultry for business best practices like Chick rearing, Feeding, Breeding, Farmer groups, Improved Kienyeji chicken, Housing, Pests and diseases, Health and vaccination.

# **Financial Education**

Learn how to manage your money learning about best practices in saving and borrowing.

**DigiFarm Loan Training**

Learn about DigiFarm loans and how to qualify and access them.

 **DigiFarm Loans**

DigiFarm offers value-chain based farm input loans and cash loans.

The farm input loan is currently for farm inputs and services and allows you to get farming inputs during the season, and then pay it back little by little during the season to ensure it is cleared once you have harvested and sold your produce. The loan balance can also be automatically deducted through the check-off as you sell your produce through the DigiFarm payments platform. The farm input loan limit is determined through a credit score card and input package required per farming activity. It includes a DigiFarm platform fee and an interest fee with a MANDATORY insurance cover for crops. (See insurance section below for details).

**Loan insurance Features**

The insurance bundled with the farm input loan covers:

Yield impacting natural calamities i.e. drought (excluding irrigated crops), excess rainfall, hail damage, frost damage, flooding, fire and lightning, windstorm, uncontrollable pests and diseases.

# **DigiFarm Loan Qualification**

DigiFarm loan qualifications and limits are determined through a credit score card to determine credit worthiness, farming activities and input package required per farming activity 

**DigiFarm** **Loan Approval**

DigiFarm loan approval and limit allocation is done once the farmer opts in to the loan product available in their region and accepts the terms and conditions. The farmer will be subjected to the credit scoring nd a notification sent to the farmer within the 15 minutes with the qualification status and the allocated limit.

**Redeeming DigiFarm Loan**

For the farm input loan, the amount is issued with respect to the required farming activity bundle e.g., during planting, the farmer can collect inputs needed for that planting milestone, e.g seeds and fertilizer from the service provide in their region. For the cash loan, the amount is disbursed the farmer M-PESA wallet less all applicable fees.

**Loan Check-off Process**

This is the process by which Digifarm automatically deducts the loan value the farmer owes through the DigiFarm payments platform once the farmer sells the produce to the buyers.

# **DigiFarm Loan Repayment**

The DigiFarm loan durations are tied to the duration of the different farming activities. i.e.

- Dairy input loan – 30 days
- Sorghum Input loan – 180 days
- Potato Input loan – 180 days
- Tea/Coffee cash loans – 30 days

 The farmer can repay partially within the loan term using M-PESA and ensure full payment at the end of the season.

**Delayed Loan Repayments**

A late repayment fee on the outstanding balance will be applied for any amount past due date. Late and irregular repayments will also lead to a lower loan limit in future.

# **Defaulted DigiFarm Loan Repayment**

Defaulting on the loan or non-repayment of DigiFarm loans, will lead to blacklisting by DigiFarm and also the Credit Reference Bureau (CRB).

When you are blacklisted with DigiFarm, you will not be able to apply for another loan until you repay your loan in full.

When you are blacklisted with the Credit Reference Bureau (CRB), you cannot borrow from most lenders, including banks, SACCOs and M-Shwari.

**DigiFarm Contacts**

To get help on DigiFarm:

Call line 100 to speak to for enquiries or support for FREE.

# **DigiFarm Registration**

The below are the options to register and access DigiFarm services which is free of charge.

**Via USSD**

Dial \*944#.

Accept the Terms and Conditions.

Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the registration process.

To register you will need your ID Number, County, Sub-county, Ward, farming activity and your Size of land. Once registered, you will receive an SMS confirming the registration and your DigiFarm Farmer Number.

To access DigiFarm services after registration dial \*944# and select the service you would like to access from the menu.

# **Confirming DigiFarm Farmer Number**

**Via USSD**

Dial \*944#.

Select ‘My Account.

Select ‘My details’.

Your details will be displayed.

# **Accessing DigiFarm Learning Content**

**Via USSD**

Dial\*944#

Select ‘Farming Practices’

Opt in

The learning content will be sent to you via SMS. All learning content and messages are free.

# **DigiFarm Loan Application**

**Farm Inputs Loan**

Dial \*944#

Select ‘Loans’

Select ‘Farm inputs loan’

Select ‘opt in’

Review the duration, applicable fees and accept terms and conditions

Loan limit will be sent via SMS

A list of service providers within your area will be sent via SMS

Visit the service providers to redeem for farm inputs and services.

**Cash Loan**

Dial \*944#

Select ‘Loans’

Select ‘Cash loans’

Select ‘opt in’

Review the duration, applicable fees and accept terms and conditions

Loan limit will be sent via SMS

Dial \*944# to apply for an amount within your loan limit.

Funds disbursement to M-PESA less applicable fees.

# **DigiFarm Loan Repayment Process**

Once you collect your inputs, you will receive an SMS with the loan amount and repayment details.

**Option 1**

Dial \*944#

Select ‘loans’

Select ‘repay loan’

Your loan balance will be displayed, enter amount to repay

Enter M-PESA pin

DigiFarm acknowledgement SMS with the remaining loan balance.

**Note:** Remember you can pay any amount at any time during the season.

DigiFarm will deduct the loan amount and facilitation fee through an automatic check-off process when paying the farmers who have sold their produce to DigiFarm through the DigiFarm payments platform. Farmers are encouraged to sell through DigiFarm payments platform to maintain good a credit record and increase their chances of qualifying for higher loan amounts in the future.

# **Definition**

This is a product specifically designed for children/teens (10-17 years) to enable them to use specific M-PESA services independently. Parents/Guardians will lead the registration of their teens to M-PESA GO.

# **Benefits**

Teens learn financial independence by managing their own M-PESA accounts.

Teens learning how to budget their funds.

M-PESA GO is a customized suite of services for minors by restricting access to some services over and beyond the parent’s control e.g FULIZA, Mshwari, KCB M-PESA

Allow parents to restrict the services accessible by minors through the guardian/parent-child relationship.

Guardian/parent will use available features and capabilities to specify:

The kind of products and services they want minors to access/not access,

Define the amounts to be spent

Have visibility of the minors account through access to statements and account balances.

# **Registration**

Parents/Guardians will lead this registration process.

Parents must have the minor’s birth certificate/passport.

**M-PESA APP**: log in to M-PESA APP > Financial Services/Services > M-PESA GO > Opt in> Proceed to Register Teen.

**Onboarding Portal:** [https://safaricom.com/mpesa-go/onboarding](https://safaricom.com/mpesa-go/onboarding) (For parents with lines already being used by their children).

**Introducing M-PESA GO Registration through Partner App**

**At Safaricom Shop** \- buy a new line and get directly registered on M-PESA GO.

All Safaricom Shops and Caredesk, and Selected M-PESA dealers can now register new M-PESA GO users directly through the Partner App. (Release Aug 2025)

This provides even more flexibility for parents who have no/limited access to the internet or Safaricom Shops.

However, for all requests about the M-PESA GO account – e.g., reversal, sim swaps, etc. – the parent must give consent.

# **Credit team troubleshooting Guide**

Before escalating any of the highlighted issues, please ensure you have done troubleshooting as guided.

- **Payments and Account Verification**

- Verify transactions, credited accounts, and validate proof of payment documents for accuracy.

- **Reconnection and Disconnection Cases**

- Review account status and confirm payments before escalating for reconnection or disconnection.

- **Billing Disputes and Tax Updates**

- Investigate billing disputes by checking invoices, prorated charges, and system validations (e.g., A/R tab).
- Tax inquiries focus on updating customer PINs through the official tax link.

- **Refunds**

- Validate closed accounts and deposit details before processing refunds.

- **Terminations and Detail Changes**

- Ensure terminations and customer detail updates are routed correctly to the Business Support team.

# **Payments Handling Procedures**

**Payment Validation Steps**

- Confirm customer account numbers and require proof of payment to ensure traceability and accuracy.

**Cross-Checking Payment Posting**

- Review the A/R tab in CRM to confirm payments are posted correctly.
- Escalate discrepancies using the shared Credit Manager link.

**Handling Payment Reversals**

- EFT reversals: Route to the Credit Manager.
- M-Pesa reversals: Escalate to the CCS Postpaid team.

**Shop Payment Verification**

- Verify in-shop payments; share bill payments with the Credit Manager.
- Return LPO receipts to shops for correction as needed.

# **Tax Management & PIN Updates**

**Validating Customer PINs**

- Update and validate customer PINs using the KRA PIN link.
- Inform customers to expect updated invoices in the following month.

**Handling PIN Discrepancies**

- Escalate unresolved issues to Credit Managers or CBS teams for verification.

**Parent and Child Account Verification**

- Confirm the customer PIN appears under child accounts to maintain compliance with billing standards.

# **Account Status & Billing**

**Resume and Connect Processes**

- Verify payment status on the A/R tab before reconnecting services.
- Confirm account suspensions in both IN DATA and CBS systems.
- Escalate validated cases to CCS Postpaid or CBS teams for reconnection.

**Benefits of Proper Handling**

- Accurate payment and account validation reduces repeat disconnections and improves customer satisfaction.

# **Invoice Retrieval & Troubleshooting**

**Invoice Sharing**

- Frontline teams can share invoices directly with customers. Escalate only if challenges arise.

**Customer Email Verification**

- Confirm that the customer email in CRM matches the request email.
- For email updates, ensure authorization via the old email or a company letterhead signed and stamped.

**Generating Detailed Invoices**

- Produce itemized, tax-compliant invoices with QR codes at the child account level.

**Troubleshooting Invoice Delivery**

- Verify invoice delivery settings in CRM.
- Advise customers to check junk/spam folders and whitelist ebill@safaricom.co.ke.

# **Financial Adjustments & Disputes**

**Identify Dispute Nature**

- Clarify the type of dispute (charges, prorated billing, service disruptions).

**Invoice and Payment Review**

- Confirm invoices and missing payments using the A/R tab.
- Request disputed period details and proof of payment from the customer.

**Escalation for Technical Issues**

- Escalate disputes involving system downtime, delayed terminations, or suspensions to Business Support and copy the Credit Manager.

**Prorated Charges & Outstanding Bills**

- Review prorated charges at the child account level.
- Confirm any outstanding bills and validate against the current invoice.

**Account Validation for Refunds**

- Ensure the refund account is fully closed.
- Verify deposits and prepayments, confirm no outstanding bills, and obtain customer consent before raising an SR.

**Special Cases for Group Accounts**

- For business accounts, provide contact details via registered emails or company letters.
- Ensure parent account closure where applicable.

# **Escalation Rules**

**Items Not Escalated to the Credit Team (Business Support Escalation Only):**

- Account terminations
- Customer name or contact number changes
- Account separations or mergers
- Service suspension/resumption requests
- Link downtime, delayed installations, or technical issues

articleTitle: Birthday Offer and Anniversary Offer Criteria and Trouble Shooting
markdownContent:
# **Definition**

**Birthday & Anniversary Offer**

This is a special promotional offer granted to eligible customers on their **birthday** and **anniversary**.

On their birthday, eligible customers receive:

1. **Free 1GB data bundle**

     2. **Special calling rate of KES 1 per minute**

The offer is valid **until midnight on the day of award**.

# **Anniversary Offer**

This is a special offer granted to:

Customers whose Date of Birth (DOB) on Jiandikishe is recorded as **01/01 or 31/12**, and

Customers who have been on the network for **5 years or more**

Eligible customers receive:

**Free 1GB data bundle**

**Special calling rate of KES 1 per minute**

The offer is valid **until midnight on the day of award**.

# **Eligibility Criteria**

Available to **all Prepay and Postpay customers**.

Customers must have been on the network for:

**2+ years** to qualify for Birthday Offers

**5+ years** to qualify for Anniversary Offers

Birthday offers are granted based on DOB captured on the Partner App, **except customers whose DOB is recorded as 01/01 or 31/12**.

Customers whose DOB is recorded as **01/01 or 31/12 are not eligible for Birthday Offers**. They are compensated with Anniversary Offers from **1 year after joining the network**.

# **Note:** Customers with Blacklisted/overdue Okoa Jahazi  balances will still receive birthday offers/incentives. Other loans also do not affect the awarding of birthday bundles.

# **Offer Mechanics (How It Works)**

**Birthday Offer Awarding**

On the customer’s birthday, they receive an **SMS notification** informing them of:

(i) The **KES 1 per minute call rate**

(ii) The **free 1GB data bundle**

# Instructions on how to redeem the data bundle

**KES 1 call rate**:

Automatically awarded upon receiving the birthday SMS

Valid until midnight on the birthday

**Free 1GB data bundle**:

Customer dials **\*544\*19#** to redeem

Valid until midnight 

# **USSD Redemption Rules**

Customers who dial the USSD when **not eligible** (not their birthday) will receive the pop-up:

*“Dear Customer, the Birthday bundle is only available for eligible customers on their birthday. Dial \*544# to buy existing bundle offers.”*

The bundle can **only be redeemed once**.

Any subsequent redemption attempt will return the pop-up:

*“Dear Customer, you have already redeemed the offer. Safaricom For You.”*

# **Usage**

The data bundle can be used for **all browsing activities**.

Usage notifications will be provided.

Customers can make calls **across all networks at KES 1 per minute** during the validity period.

# **Troubleshooting Guide**

If a customer reports not receiving the birthday or anniversary bundle, the CEE should perform the following checks:

**Confirm Eligibility**

Verify the customer’s DOB on Jiandikishe against registration details.

**Check DND Status**

If DND is active, advise the customer that they will not receive promotional SMSs or bundles while DND is active.

**Check SMS Delivery Issues**

If DND is not active, advise on possible SMS delivery issues such as spam filtering, blocking, or blacklisting.

markdownContent:
# **Definition**

The Anniversary and Birthday service seeks to reward SAFARICOM customers with a special offer on their Birthday and/**or dates of Joining Safaricom network.**

# **Anniversary offer criteria/ eligibility**

Customers who have been on the network for 10+ years will receive the offer every subsequent year on their anniversary date

Customers who have been on the network for 5+ years and their date of birth is captured as 01/01/or 31/12. They will receive the offer every subsequent year on their anniversary date.

# **Anniversary offer details**

Customers will be able to make calls all day across all networks within Kenya for Ksh. 1/= per minute until midnight (Prepay and Post-pay)

The FREE 1GB Birthday/Sherekea bundle will be awarded at 8am and will be valid till midnight(Prepay and Post-pay)

# **Mechanics**

- The eligible subscribers will receive a notification with **either birthday wishe**s, **or anniversary wishes** as well as the offer details.
- A customer can have two offers: If their Birthdays and Anniversaries fall on different days, then they will receive the two offers on the respective days as long as they meet the above criteria. However, if the two days fall on the same day, they will only enjoy the offer once a year.
- The anniversary service contributes to Stori Ibambe target achievement. When you call at Ksh 1/-, the spend will contribute to Stori Ibambe target achievement however the FREE MBs will not be considered since it’s FREE.
- The Offers are permanent. It will run throughout the year **apart from the following two dates for Birthday 01/01/ and 31/12**.

# **Balance Query for Birthday & Anniversary Balance Query**

Dial \*544# to check your balance

or

Send the word Balance to 144.

# **DEFINITION**

This is a service that allows Safaricom Prepay subscribers to request an advance of mobile data bundles.

- Bundles are available in **10MB, 30MB, 90MB, 270MB** and **675MB** which shall be credited to the Subscriber’s Prepay data account upon request.
- Safaricom charges an advance fee of 10% for each request.

# **ELIGIBILITY**

The Okoa Bundles Service is open to **all** Safaricom Prepay subscribers who have been on the network for more than 30days **apart from** those who are roaming.

# **MECHANICS**

- The mobile number must have been active on Safaricom network for at least one (1) month continuously.
- It must be an active line, meaning the line has not gone into expiry.
- The amount requested must be equivalent to the airtime spent for the last seven (7) days prior to the date of the request for the Credit Advance.
- This service is available to customers who are not blacklisted from the service.
- Okoa bundles are only valid for 24 hours. An added 1hr validity bundle is currently available.
- A customer can purchase the Okoa Data Bundle with Expiry bundle as many times as they wish (multiple times**).**
- The customer must have fully repaid any previous Credit Advanced on both Okoa Jahazi and Okoa Bundles.
- The Okoa Bundles Credit Advance can only be used to browse the internet thus the customer **cannot** make calls or send text with Okoa Bundles.
- **In order of priority**, Daily Bundles will be exhausted first followed by Okoa Bundles and then Volume Bundles.
- A customer **will not** be able to Sambaza the Okoa Bundles Credit Advance to another subscriber.
- This will however not affect the customer’s right to access other Safaricom services provided the customer is compliant with the terms and conditions of that service.
- Terms and conditions will be available on the Safaricom website [www.safaricom.co.ke](http://www.safaricom.co.ke/).

# **BUNDLES AVAILABLE UNDER OKOA BUNDLES**

The table below highlights the service fee for each request and Airtime spent that qualifies a customer.

| Okoa Bundles (MB) | Total Amount (Repayment) (Ksh.) | Airtime Spend for the Previous Week (Ksh.) | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 675MB | 99 | 100 | 24 Hours |
| 270MB | 50 | 50 | 24 Hours |
| 90MB | 20 | 20 | 24 Hours |
| 900MB | 20 | 20 | 1Hour |
| 30MB | 10 | 10 | 24Hours |
| 10MB | 5 | 5 | 24 Hours |

# **HOW TO REQUEST FOR OKOA BUNDLES**

**USSD;**

- Dial **\*131#.**
- Select Okoa internet.
- Select your preferred Bundles.
- Accept/Decline

The customer will receive a purchase message upon successful request e.g. “You have successfully received \*\*MB valid for 24hrs @KSH 100”

**OR**

- Dial **\*456#**
- Select Okoa
- Select Okoa bundles.
- Select preferred bundle.
- Accept/decline.

The customer will receive a purchase message upon successful request e.g. “You have successfully received \*\*MB valid for 24hrs @KSH 100”

- Dial **\*544#**
- Select Okoa data.
- Select preferred bundle.
- Accept/decline.

The customer will receive a purchase message upon successful request e.g. “You have successfully received \*\*MB valid for 24hrs @KSH 100”

# **Log onto www.safaricom.com/Bundles**

- Click on “Okoa Bundles” button.
- Select the Bundles you wish to get credit advance on Okoa.
- Select your preferred Bundles and you will receive the following message upon successful request: “You have successfully purchased \*\*MB @Sh100 valid for 24hrs”

# **CHECKING BALANCE ON OKOA INTERNET**

**Via \*544#**

- Dial \*544#.
- Select balance and tips.

A message will be sent with the balances.

**Via \*131#**

- Dial \*131#
- Check balance.
- Select Okoa jahazi account balance.

A message will be sent with the balances.

# **REPAYMENT OF THE CREDIT ADVANCE**

- The Credit Advance will be deducted from the customer’s subsequent top up(s) until fully recovered.
- The customer will be required to repay the Credit Advance within a period of 120 hours(5days) from when the Credit Advance amount was credited to his account.
- If the customer does not repay the Credit Advance within the said period, he will not be entitled to utilize the Okoa Jahazi or Okoa Bundles Service until the payment is made.

# **The following top up methods will be valid for the purpose of repaying the Credit Advance:**

- Scratch cards top ups
- M-PESA top ups

# MyCounty Solution

 **myCounty**

myCounty is a solution that allows citizens of various counties to access their respective county services such as parking and business permits and pay for the services through availed customer access channels such as USSD(Code) and mobile apps.

**Eligibility**

The service is available to only M-PESA registered customers. Customers will need to download myCounty App from Play Store or App Store and register to access the services.

**How to access myCounty**

You can access myCounty through different channels i.e.

- - - USSD-which is specific to a county.
 - Mini-app within the M-PESA Super App
 - Native App from Play Store
 - Native App from iOS App Store (Coming soon)
 - Web Portal (Coming soon)

**Benefits of myCounty products?**

- - You can pay for respective county services.
 - Ability to consume/pay for other county services. i.e., another county of choice when moving around the country.
 - Citizen engagement such as Sema na Governor i.e., you can chat with the governor and give feedback on the services offered or arising incidences.
 - Access to county emergency services such as calling for fire, police, or ambulance by just dialing via the app.

**Do I get charged when I use the USSD code?**

No. To access the USSD is FREE.

**Services available in myCounty**

- - - Parking services
 - Single business permit renewal
 - Property rates
 - Market CESS

**Other services**

- - - Reporting
 - Sema na Governor
 - Emergency contacts  

**Mechanics**

- You can access myCounty services from anywhere. You don’t have to be within the county
- You can make payments via myCounty services for another number using the provided channels.
- USSD can be accessed from other mobile networks Safaricom, Airtel, and Telkom.
- If not registered, a customer can access reporting, Sema na Governor, and emergency services.
- Currently myCounty services is not available on web, but will be availed later
- USSD service will not be charged but normal paybill transaction charges will applyYou can access myCounty services with multiple lines. But it will be availed later.
- Only PNG files can be uploaded on myCounty App. Another format of files will fail to upload.

8. **Selecting my resident county on the myCounty app**
 - Launch myCounty app either on the mini-app on the M-PESA App or through an individual app from Play Store or App Store.
 - Click *Get Started.*
 - Click on the *Select County drop-down* to select your resident county.

9. **Paying for other county services**

You can switch counties on the App when moving around the country.

For USSD, you need to dial the specific USSD code for the county.

*Log in to the myCounty app and select the county you wish to pay services for*.

10. **Reversal Requests**

Payments will be done through a pop-up push that indicates the amount of money to pay. However, in case of an overpayment and other erroneous payments, you should contact the county contact center support for assistance.

# PARKING

11. **Daily parking**

Daily parking is the one-day parking for a vehicle within the town.

You can pay for Parking via USSD and myCounty App.

## To pay via the App

- On myCounty App *Click Pay*
- Choose the *Parking Service*
- Choose y*our Parking Type* (Daily, and Reserved parking)
- Enter *Vehicle Number plate.*
- Choose the *Vehicle Type.*
- Select *Parking Zone.*
- Confirm parking details and *click Proceed to Payment*.
- Enter M-PESA PIN

*On successful payment, you will receive a payment notification via SMS from M-PESA, and from the county*.

## Pay through USSD Code

- Dial *Respective County USSD code.*
- Select *Parking Services*
- Choose your *Parking Type* i.e., seasonal parking.
- Select *Parking Zone*
- Enter *Vehicle License Plate.*
- An M-PESA payment request shall be displayed on your phone.
- Enter your M-PESA PIN and click OK.
- On successful payment, you will receive a payment notification via SMS from M-PESA.

*Pay through Web Portal-Coming soon.*

12. **Seasonal parking**

This is the parking for your vehicle for a specific duration i.e., 1 month, 3 months, 6 months, etc.

You can pay via App or USSD

## Via App

- On myCounty App *Click Pay*
- Select the *Parking service.*
- Choose *your Parking Type* *as seasonal parking.*
- Enter *Vehicle Number plate.*
- Select *Vehicle Type*
- Select the *Parking Zone.*
- Enter the *Start Date and Duration.*
- Confirm parking details and *Click Proceed to Payment*.
- Enter M-PESA PIN
- You will receive a confirmation message of successful parking payment from M-PESA and the county.

## Via USSD

- Dial *Respective County USSD code.*
- Select *Parking Services*
- Choose your *Parking Type* i.e., Seasonal parking.
- Select *Parking Zone*
- Enter *Vehicle License Plate.*
- An M-PESA payment request shall be displayed on your phone.
- Enter your M-PESA PIN and click OK.

13. **What to do when my vehicle is clamped**

Follow the payment instructions contained in the “Parking charge Notice” placed on the car windscreen or call the phone number (for the applicable zone) for guidance.

Failure to pay your parking fee will lead to the clamping and towing of the vehicle.

# SINGLE BUSINESS PERMIT RENEWAL

14. **Business permit**

A business permit is a legal document issued by the county government that authorizes a business to operate within a specific area. The permit is renewed annually.

15. **How to pay for my business permit**

You can pay for your business permit via USSD and myCounty App.

## To pay via the App

- On myCounty App *Click Pay*
- Choose the *Single Business Permit Service*
- Enter your *Business Permit Number*
- Confirm details and Click *Proceed to Payment*.
- Enter M-PESA PIN

On successful payment, you will receive a payment notification via SMS from M-PESA, and from the county.

*Pay through Web Portal-Coming soon.*

card Rejected (The SIM will be rejected if the customer enters the PUK No. 10 times incorrectly).

SIP connects your private telephone system (IP-PBX) to the international Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN) via your IP network allowing you to utilize your data bandwidth instead of costly traditional telephone lines.

As businesses focus on long-term transformation and continuity plans, the integration of voice and data networks for improved efficiency, flexibility and cost-effectiveness becomes increasingly important.
