articleTitle: Post pay Individual and Corporate Advantage Tariff and Mechanics
markdownContent:
**Post pay Individual and Corporate Advantage Tariff and Mechanics**

# **Individual** **Advantage Tariff**

This is a tariff for individual customers.

The registration can only be done at a Safaricom Shop.

It is categorized into;

Advantage Hybrid Tariff.

Advantage Tariff.

They are further categorized into different accounts depending on billing process.

For individual account they are under Standard Account.

# **Requirements For Onboarding**

Fill the individual advantage forms and attach.

Copy of ID/ Passport/ Alien ID or Certificate.

Copy of PIN Certificate.

Two referees (individuals).

Deposit (depending on nature of contract or equivalent to the credit limit being set min Ksh.2000).

Email addresses, Postal Address and Physical address.

Bank Details:

Name of the bank

Branch

Account number

# **Billing**

Different accounts can be billed differently depending on credit limits.

Some accounts have active credit limits while others have no active credit limits.

A customer can choose to have the account with No Active Credit Limit or have Active Credit Limit.

With No Active Credit Limit The accounts do not have a limit and the system does not bar the line.

With Active Credit Limits, The accounts have a credit limit and system automatically bars the line once it hits the limit set. They include;

Individual Autobar

Express Autobar.

**Individual Autobar service**

This is a service where a certain amount is set as the limit on the usage for a customer’s line.

Once the customer hits the limit, the line is automatically barred from making outgoing calls/SMS/data.

This enables the customer to control their usage.

The customer will indicate the desired/projected monthly usage, and this will be used as a benchmark for the credit limit.

The customer needs to make full payment in full for the billed and unbilled amount to allow more usage.

**Express Autobar**

This is a service where the customers set limit on the usage is equivalent to the deposit made.

The customer will make a deposit that will be used as the credit limit.

Once the customer hits the limit the line is automatically barred, and the customer can make any payment to allow more usage.

# **Billing cycle for Individual Autobar and Express Autobar.**

Bill run on the 1st of every month

Balance SMS notification – 2nd of every month to alert customers on the previous month bill.

1st, 2nd & final email reminder letter – sent out 2nd week of every month

1st SMS reminder – Sent out on 15th of every month – to remind customers that 16th is the due date of the outstanding bill for previous month

2nd SMS reminder - Sent out on 22nd of every month – to reminder customers the due date was on 16th

Deactivation notice – Sent out on 4th week of every month - for customers with more than three outstanding bills.

3rd SMS reminder – Sent out on 29th of every month

27th / 28th of the month – Soft bar the customers who have not paid their bills for the previous month

4th / 5th of the following month – Full bar the customers who have not paid their bill for the previous month

**NOTE:** These dates are subject to change, especially when they fall on weekend/public holidays. However, such changes are normally communicated to stakeholders internally.

# **Customer support on the Autobar Service**

Sending Threshold SMS reminders: SMS reminders are generated and sent upon specified thresholds i.e.-when you have spent 75% and 90% of your current limit.

Customer Care service for 24 hours on Line 200.

Account payment slip for current bills and E-bill service for previous invoices 
Safaricom Shops and Care Desks.

To know the limit the customer can call 200, check on the Safaricom App or send a request to [advantage@safaricom.co.ke](mailto:advantage@safaricom.co.ke)

# **How to Increase or decrease Credit Limit for Autobar and/or Hybrid Accounts**

**Express Autobar and Hybrid Accounts**

For postpay DIY and karibu postpay. Customer needs to increase limit via \*200# and selects change limit. For postpay DIY, the limit should be equal or more than the plan cost. To change plan for postpay DIY, customer dials \*200# and selects buy or change plan to activate the plan of their choice

To downgrade, the customer dials \*200# and selects change limit. They can only downgrade to a minimum of ksh 1000. To downgrade to a limit lower than ksh 1000, customer writes an email request to advantage@safaricom.co.ke

To increase for the other customers, they need to visit the shop to do an additional deposit and have the credit limit increased.

 **Individual Autobar Accounts:**

The customer to submit a written request for the adjustment.

The customer needs to have been on the Postpaid service for at least three months before the limit can be increased, this is subject to credit control's approval.

Customer does a written request and Tops up the deposit with an amount directly proportional to the requested credit limit.

To decrease, the Customer does a written request and brings to the Retail Shops or sends on email to advantage@safaricom.co.ke , indicating the desired Limit amount.

**NOTE:**  

If the customer insists they are not in a position to follow the due process due to unavoidable circumstances.

CEE to confirm if customer has a hybrid account. If they do, advise them to top up in the meantime then follow the credit limit increase process.

If customer has no hybrid account, CEE to Send an email to Line200 TM Escalations Line2002@Safaricom.co.ke and copy CC Postpay TLs CCPostpayTLs@Safaricom.co.ke for the TL to do follow up with credit team for guidance. CEE to inform customer that their request has been forwarded for consideration and they will be called back with a response.

If it is past 8PM on a Weekend, CEEs on Line 200 folder can still call the Postpay TL who was on duty to handle the issue.

All parties will enter interactions clearly indicating action taken and response given. Include any emails as attachments where needed.

For Corporate Accounts under Z Account insisting they are not in a position to follow the due process due to unavoidable circumstances.

Confirm if they have a hybrid account, if yes advise them to top up in the meantime, then follow the credit limit increase process.

If it does not have a hybrid account and is an individual account, follow the procedure in (a) above.

If it’s a corporate account under a company , follow the procedure in (a) above.

**A Repeat Caller on Credit Limit Increase Request**

CEE to Send mail to Line200 TM Escalations Line2002@Safaricom.co.ke and copy CC Postpay TLs CCPostpayTLs@Safaricom.co.ke for the TL to do follow up with credit team for them to guide on the issue.

If it is past 8PM on a Weekend, CEEs on Line 200 folder can still call the Postpay TL who was on duty to handle the issue.

All parties will enter interactions clearly indicating action taken and response given. Include any emails as attachments where needed.

 **Corporate Advantage Tariff**

This is a tariff for Corporate customers.

The registration can only be done at a Safaricom Shop.

It is categorized into;

Corporate Advantage Hybrid Tariff.

Corporate Advantage Tariff.

They are further categorized into different accounts depending on billing process.

For corporate account they are under Aggregated Account.

# **Requirements** **For Onboarding**

Fill in the Corporate Advantage Forms.

Copy of Certificate of Registration.

Copy of PIN Certificate (New generation Cert Combined: PIN and VAT Certificate).

Bank Statements (where applicable).

Bank Details.

Name of the bank.

Branch.

Account number.

Letter of Undertaking for Government.

VAT Exemption Certificate (where applicable).

Bank Statements (where applicable).

Application form should be signed by the contact person and should bear the company rubber stamp.

Two referees who must be companies that offer the company credit facilities or are suppliers. Referees must not be sister companies or individuals or their creditors.

Deposit (depending on nature of contract or equivalent to the credit limit being set min Ksh.2000).

# **Billing**

Different accounts can be billed differently depending on credit limits.

Some accounts have active credit limits while others have no active credit limits.

An organization can choose to have the account with No Active Credit Limit or have Active Credit Limit.

Corporate Autobar is the account that have Active Credit Limits under Corporate Tariff.

The accounts have a credit limit and system automatically bars the line once it hits the limit set.

With No Active Credit Limit The accounts do not have a limit and the system does not bar the line. They include.

VIP Corporate.

Corporate.

Government.

Small businesses.

E1

**Billing cycle for Corporates and Corporate Autobar Accounts**

Monthly bill run as per bill cycle done on 1st of the month.

Bill includes Access fee for the following month

Due dates for bill payment is 16th of every month.

On the 17th, an SMS is sent to the contact person for confirming receipt of bills.

On the 26th, we make a telephone call for follow up on the outstanding amount (Automatically output report of all customers not paid up) customer is advised via SMS on the outstanding bill that is due.

# **Billing cycle for VIP Corporate Accounts**

Monthly bill run as per bill cycle currently 1st of the month.

Bill includes Access fee for the following month (cycle forward fee-billed but unearned amounts) and any prorate for the current month in case connection took place within previous bill cycle and usage for the month.

articleTitle: Suspension by Fraud team for fraudulent activities and impersonation
markdownContent:
# Suspension by Fraud team for fraudulent activities

Fraud team SUSPENDS lines of customers involved in fraudulent activities, mostly such suspension in indicated on Siebel Key comment.

The following requests may come in relation to suspended lines:

- Owner of line calling inquiring after realizing he can’t transact.
- Reversal request for money sent to suspended line.
- Reversal request for money deposited in a suspended line.

### Action Required by CEE

- If the owner of a suspended line calls DO NOT Resume /Unsuspend the line, don’t do a reversal but refer the customer to fraud team at Safaricom HQ1 along waiyaki way.
- If the reversal request is from the sender or dealer who has deposited money, DO NOT Resume /Unsuspend the line, don’t do a reversal but send the request via email to the person who suspended the line (available in M-PESA G2 audit logs) and copy *NetworkFraudMPesaSection@Safaricom.co.ke*
- The fraud team will evaluate the scenario and advise if a reversal should be done or not.

# Impersonation /Record access cases

This Cases are majorly reported by customers via call or in Person at our Retail Shops/Care Desks where customers complain that Safaricom Staff are accessing their records. Impersonation and Record Access cases should be escalated via Service Request, for investigation.

- Category: Fraud Escalation
- Type: Pick appropriate
- Item: Pick appropriate

# **M-PESA account suspended by M-PESA\\fraudapiuser (under audit log on M-PESA)**

Customers complaining that they cannot use M-PESA and upon checking their M-PESA account, you find that their account is suspended by **M-PESA\\fraudapiuser** (under audit log as per sample below). **Do Not Refer the customer to the bank. Instead escalate to:** *NetworkFraudMPesaSection@Safaricom.co.ke,* Capturing customers number, name and reason indicated on the audit log for customer to be assisted.

**SLA:24Hrs**

This will only apply to cases where Customers M-PESA account has been suspended by M-PESA\\fraudapiuser, for cases where a customer is suspended with a key comment on CRM follow the existing process.

# **Dealer line Process**

# **Using Safaricom Dealer lines, dealers will proceed as follows when the customer has the original PIN.**

# **With original PIN** 
**\*180\*1\*MSISDN\*original PIN\*new IMSI# Ok**

The document used to register the number will be used during the SIM swap. i.e.; 
•National ID 
•Passport 
•Military ID 
•Alien ID 
•Diplomatic ID

Individual **Post-pay** and **hybrid numbers** cannot be swapped by a dealer or agent.

Dealers will refer the customer to a Retail Centre or Care Desk for assistance.

Call Center SIM swap process applies for queries presented at the call center. For Corporate postpaid line the process remains the same.

Failed Requests Message: Dealers will receive a message informing them of the reason why the swap failed.

**NB:** Please note that the customer’s line will be blocked from performing a swap after 3

Failed attempts using incorrect details for 24 hours.

They will therefore be required to present themselves at any retail shop or care desk

With ID for assistance.

Dealers will contact their head office for assistance where they are unable to perform SIM Swaps.

The dealer or MPESA agent is unable to perform a SIM swap, if one doesn’t have the original SIM PIN 1and thus one replacing will visit the Safaricom retail shop with proof of ownership or call Safaricom customer care with new Sim replacement card for help.

New Sim replacement card retailing at Ksh. 50

# **SIM swap procedure and guidelines**

If a dealer calls in requesting to swap customer line, request to speak to the customer and vet as per the SIM swap procedure and guidelines that is:

As a control measure to deter fraud; check the location of the caller's mobile number and the line being swapped on the 'fraudster location/subscriber locate tool' on the SAWA system.

**Line in a prison site:** If the caller is confirmed to be in a prison site, the agent shall proceed as follows: -

- First verify the tariff, if it indicates ‘**M-PESA agent tariff’**,

‘**SYJ tariff’**, “**dealer** **tariff’**, please do not suspend the line.

- Refer the agent to their head office and customer to the different dealer/Care desk/Retail shop as SIM Swap isn’t possible in a prison site.

#  

# **Fraudster’s account on Siebel**: If the tariff is not as above and display the fraudster's account on Siebel suspend both incoming and outgoing calls, Refer the customer Care desk/Retail shop as SIM Swap isn’t possible in a prison site.

**Line not in a prison site;** If the line is not located in a prison site, proceed with step (3) below.

- Proceed to comprehensively vet the customers for proof of ownership.
- To increase the probability of reaching the rightful owner confirm if the line has any active call barring or active diverts to another MSISDN.
- If there is any active call barring or call diverts to another MSISDN, with successful vetting seek consent to cancel them.
- If consent is granted and vetting successful, cancel the barring or divert using HLR and proceed with below step.
- If consent is denied, advise on the risk and kindly refer customer to the nearest retail center/care desk for further assistance.
- If there are no any active divert or barring, proceed with below.

- Make an outbound call to the line to be swapped. This is a form of confirming ownership of the line.
- If the caller is using the same MSISDN to reach us, proceed with below

**NOTE:** Make an outbound call on IWS. For you to make an outbound call, type the number/paste it on the IWS softphone after placing the active call on hold

- If the call is unreachable/unanswered in the first attempt, please make one more attempt to try and contact the customer.
- If the call is not picked do not proceed with SIM Swap and refer the customer to the Retail Center or Care desk.
- If the call is answered, please confirm ownership and swap request. Once the customer confirms Proceed to swap the line and advice on re-activation of call barring’s and diverts, where applicable.
- After performing the SIM replacement, ensure you enter the vetted details on Siebel system Interactions. All vetting information should be displayed on the interaction comments field.

# **Siebel system (Mandatory) Vetting**

The subscriber should provide the following two mandatory and any two optional vetting details for the SIM swap to be affected: -

- Full names as per Siebel. NB: The CEE can also accept if the customer gives 2 correct names. e.g. the first and last name **(Mandatory)**
- Kenyan National ID card/ Valid Kenyan Passport/ Military ID/ Alien ID/ Diplomatic ID **(Mandatory)**
- Three frequently dialed numbers. (Each number should be recorded as a mobile originating (MO) call at least four times within the most recent three-months period)
- The current account balance as shown on Siebel.
- The last top-up amount and date

**NOTE:** For ease in vetting use the Siebel vetting tool.

If the customer is not registered on the Siebel system or can’t recall the required two optional Siebel vetting details, use the following two mandatory and any two optional M-PESA vetting details

- Full names as per the M-PESA system. NB: The CEE can also accept if the
- Customer gives 2 correct names. e.g. the first and last name **(Mandatory)**
- Kenyan National ID card/ Valid Kenyan Passport/ Military ID/ Alien ID/ Diplomatic ID **(Mandatory)**
- Current M-PESA Balance (Exact figure is not required – a close figure is ok for any customer who has not transacted for two weeks)
- Month or year of registration.
- M-PESA agency that registered them.

If the customer is not registered in Siebel or M-PESA system, the subscriber should provide the following two mandatory and any two optional vetting details for the SIM swap to be affected: -

- Full names as per Jiandikishe. NB: The CEE can also accept if the customer gives 2 correct names. e.g. the first and last name **(Mandatory)**
- Kenyan National ID card/ Valid Kenyan Passport/ Military ID/ Alien ID/ Diplomatic ID as per Jiandikishe. **(Mandatory)**
- Three frequently dialed numbers. (Each number should be recorded as a mobile originating (MO) call at least four times within the most recent one-month period)
- The last top-up amount and date
- The current account balance as shown on Siebel.

If the vetting details above are provided the CEE will proceed to swap the customer's SIM card

If the customer provides incorrect details on the above vetted details, please advise the customer to visit any Safaricom Retail Center or Care desk for further verification of the ownership of the line/account.

If the line is not registered in Siebel, Jiandikishe or M-Pesa refer the customer to the nearest Retail Shop or Care desk.

If M-Pesa and Siebel/Jiandikishe details do not tally refer the customer to the nearest Retail Shop or Care desk to proof ownership.

# **SIM Swap for Data Line**

If it is a prepay data line, vet the customer using the following mandatory and two optional details: -

- Full names as per Siebel (**Mandatory**), M-PESA or Jiandikishe. NB: The CEE can also accept if the customer gives 2 correct names. e.g. the first and last name **(Mandatory)**
- Kenyan National ID card/ Valid Kenyan Passport/ Military ID/ Alien ID/ Diplomatic ID **(Mandatory)**
- Current Airtime Balance or Bundle Balance
- Amount of the last data bundle purchased
- You can further vet the customer using previous Service requests after vetting on the Siebel and MPESA system using the following checks;
- Check the service requests on Siebel system to corroborate the following details. This is done only when there are SR tickets available for the line in question.
- Type of previous escalation request on the line (e.g. over scratched, MPESA PIN, unbarring line
- Date of the customer escalation request which should be accurate to 2-3 days either before or after the actual date of customer escalation request.

If incorrect refer the customer to the nearest Retail Center or Care desk for further verification of the ownership of the line/account.

# **Performing the SIM replacement**

- After a successful SIM replacement, the subscriber is advised that activation of the new SIM card onto the network will be completed within 20 minutes.
- Educate the customer on how to activate their M-PESA account after a SIM Swap. 'When you perform a SIM replacement on your Safaricom line, to re-activate your M-PESA account, enter your previous M-PESA PIN as the start key' and send a text message via Siebel

#  **NOTE:** SIM Swap request received by CEE’s without M-PESA system due to certification/roaming profile issues

- If a customer calls, vet to confirm ownership and escalate via SR for the line 300 dealer support team to resolve.
- Include the new serial number and a contact number for follow up.
- This is done because the CEE does not have the M-PESA system required to complete the vetting process before performing the SIM replacement.

articleTitle: Lipa Karo na M-PESA Definition and Mechanics
markdownContent:
# Definition

This is an M- PESA Paybill service for school fees collection.

We also have School fees accounts that are operated by:

Selected banks: they offer the service to a number of schools who bank with them. These banks are:

1. Co-operative Bank of Kenya
2. Kenya Commercial Bank
3. CFC Stanbic Contact Center

# **PesaPal**:

It provides schools with management information systems. PesaPal for schools is built on a simple Web-based interface that enables any school to receive and track payments for special activities such as school trips, activity fees, fund raisers etc.

# How to get Lipa Karo payment details

Not all schools are on board. Therefore, customers will have to confirm and get the correct code of the school and student by:

1. Getting in touch with the school’s accounts or administrative office to confirm what your school business number is and how the student is identified.
2. Getting in touch with the intermediary organization i.e. Pesapal, Kenya Commercial Bank, Co-operative Bank and CFC Stanbic bank branch.
3. By dialing \*234# and follow instructions to get your business number; Enter school name as the key word.

# Lipa Karo na M-PESA payment options

Each school running its own M-PESA Pay Bill account will advise the parents on the school’s Pay Bill Number and how to identify the students they are paying fees for, e.g. using student registration numbers.

# Direct M-PESA Paybill procedure

In this case, there are no intermediaries between the M-Pesa and the school. The payment procedure is as follows:

1. On the mobile phone, go to the M-PESA menu and select Pay Bill.
2. In the Business Number field enter school’s Pay Bill Number.
3. For Account Number, enter student’s identification as advised by the school.
4. Enter required amount and input M-PESA PIN.
5. Confirm the transaction.
6. You will receive a confirmation message from M-PESA that payment has been made to the school’s Pay Bill account.

# Payment via PesaPal Lipa Karo service

PesaPal for Schools is an easy to use service developed to enable schools to request and manage school fees payments from parents.

With PesaPal for Schools, a school enrolls parents and students once and then the school can post payment requests to the parents automatically.

For each payment, PesaPal for Schools sends out a notification via SMS or email to parents and also automates repetitive tasks such as “account overdue” reminders freeing administrative staff to work on other tasks.

The Pesa Pal Business number: 220123

# Payment via KCB Lipa Karo service

To make payment via KCB Lipa Karo service, your school needs to be registered with KCB.

1. On the mobile phone, go to the M-PESA Menu and select Pay Bill.
2. In the Business Number field enter 522123.
3. In the account number, enter your school code as provided by KCB, then a K followed by student admission number without leaving a space: {School code} {K}{Student admin no.}, e.g., 123KTK123. The school code is for identifying the school and students will be advised by KCB or the school.
4. Enter required amount and input M-PESA PIN.
5. Confirm the transaction
6. You will receive a confirmation message from M-PESA and another confirmation from KCB once money is credited to the school’s account.

# Payment confirmation notification

M-PESA will send the standard Pay Bill confirmation SMS immediately after carrying out the transaction. This notification will confirm that funds have been transferred to the bank.

The bank will then send an SMS to the customer, notifying them that funds have been applied to the school’s bank account.

Parents whose schools have Pesapal school management software can view their payments via web free of charge on the website [www.pesapal.com](http://www.pesapal.com/)

# **Okoa Hourly Bundles Product**

**Okoa Hourly Data Bundles with hourly validity**

**Bundles availble**

| | | NEW | Remain as is | Remain as is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Total Okoa Amount for Hourly (Repayment) (kshs.) | Current Offering Normal Bundle (MB) | Proposed Okoa Bundle Offering (MB) | Service Fee in (kshs.) | Bundle Charge (kshs.) |
| 20 | 1GB | 900 | 2 | 18 |

**When:**

3rd of Feb 2023

**How to purchase**

Prepaid customers will dial \*544#, \*131# select Okoa data

Use Exisiting Interactions and SR's

# **B2C (Business-to-Consumer)**

**Definition.**

**B2C** stands for **Business-to-Consumer.**

This is the Bulk Payments service that enables an organization to make payments/disbursements from a given M-PESA short code to mobile phones of individuals in real time at the click of a button.

**Eligibility**

This service is open to all organizations and institutions both public and private intending to make M-PESA payments to individuals.

# **Available Services on B2C**

- Pay workers (salaries, wages etc.)
- Business Payments: Payment of small supplies, petty cash
- Micro Finance Institutions and SACCOs for loan disbursement, withdrawal of money from bank account directly to M-PESA account.
- Insurance: Claims settlement.
- Promotional payments: Payment of cash prizes for winners
- Dividend Payments: Annual dividend payments for publicly listed companies
- Government & NGOs: Disbursement of various project and workshop funds, relief funds, development funds, per diems and wages to field staff.

# **B2C charges**

The customer receiving the funds is not charged. The charges are applied to the organization short code as below;

 [Screenshot] 

 [Screenshot]  

# **Channels used to make payments on B2C**

**M-PESA G2 system**

Requires installation of M-PESA certificate on a computer running windows OS.

The client Sends a blank email to M-PESAcertpassword@safaricom.co.ke to get guide on certificate application and installation

**APIs - API stands for Application Programming Interface.**

1. API enables communication and exchange of data between two systems by providing an interface for one system to easily plug in to the other system.
2. With API an organization does not have to use our M-PESA system directly. They will continue to use their in-house system to disburse funds through M-PESA system.

**Payment Portal**

This is web based and does not require installation of certificate

# **Failed Settlement/B2C Resubmission**

**Process on Failed (settlement)/ B2C resubmission**

- In case the receiving account (Mobile/nominated number/phone number) is not able to receive the withdrawn/Settlement amount due to limits or system outages and the funds are deducted from the LNM Account (withdrawal is successful on the LNM Account on G2.)
- The system will initiate an auto reversal of the funds back to the LNM account and the merchant will be required to re-initiate the withdrawal.
- Re-submission do not apply since the failed transaction will auto reverse.

# **B2C Service Requirements**

- The organization must be existing and active in MPESA
- B2C account must active in M-PESA the system
- The process will only start if the account balance is sufficient for completion of payment of all the listed accounts.

# **B2C Reversal Process**

- This is applicable for requests from customers who visit retail centers / care desks/ call or email the call center and with B2C reversal request(s).
- B2C reversals can be initiated as a single transaction or in bulk.

# **Bulk Reversal Mechanics**

- The Bulk reversal role was created to enable reverse multiple transactions where erroneous pay outs are done, double payments are made, fraud has been committed e.g. for Mobile banking transactions or any other human/system errors that could have led to wrong payments.
- The role currently allows for reversals for Pay bill transactions (Pay Utility), Bulk transactions (B2C transactions) and B2B transactions
- The Role is performed by M-PESA Corporate CEE’s or Support analysts.

# **Requirements for the reversals**

- Request from organization this could be internal requests e.g. requests by our Fraud Team or external partners currently using our B2C, C2B or B2B products
- The request must include the transaction ID / Receipt Number as appears on M-PESA G2
- The requesting party should share the file in excel format
- The reversals will be initiated from the M-PESA G2 system.
- The reversals require an initiator and approver**.**

# **The transaction view on the portal**

- **Transactions Summary**

It displays all the transactions that were done, including their status.

To access the statement Login to the system >Reports > B2C Transactions.

- **B2C Transactions**

The B2C Transaction statement allows the user to have a detailed view of all the transactions done via B2C.

- **Balance Enquiry**

The B2C Transaction statement allows the user to have a detailed view of all the transactions done via B2C.

- **All withdrawals**

The statement allows the user to have a detailed view of all the Withdrawals done by the organizations.

**Customer Support**

- Call: 2222 (free) or 0722 002222 from the contact number whitelisted to call the service line.
- Email: M-PESAbusiness@safaricom.co.ke
- Social media channels via twitter @SafaricomPLC, @Safaricom\_Care facebook Safaricom PLC and egain chat on our website [www.safaricom.co.ke](http://www.safaricom.co.ke/)

articleTitle: Discontinuation for P2P M-PESA Vouchers to Unregistered Users
markdownContent:
# **Discontinuation for P2P M-PESA Vouchers to Unregistered Users** 

M-PESA transfer and disbursement to unregistered lines has for a long time enabled those with Safaricom, Airtel and Telkom SIM cards who are not registered to mobile money services to receive funds through a unique voucher code.

# **The Change.**

To provide better experience to the customers, interoperability was introduced to enable transfer of funds between M-PESA and other mobile money providers.

We shall therefore proceed to implement the following **with effect from 5th February 2024**:

Discontinue the Person-to-Person service that allows transfer of funds from M-PESA registered customers to any unregistered mobile money customers.

Discontinue B2C service for sending funds from organizations to customers not registered on M-PESA Withdrawing/sending of funds from bank accounts to M-PESA.

Any other organization using B2C to send funds M-PESA.

All APIs that process transfers to unregistered users shall be deactivated.

Remove the ‘Send to Other Network’ option from M-PESA channels \*334#, M-PESA STK, M-PESA App and MySafaricom APP.

# **What is the way Forward?**

M-PESA registered users will only send funds to users who are registered on M-PESA, Airtel Money or T-Kash

Customers from other providers will withdraw funds from their providers.

**The unified journey(Send Money) will be implemented on STK, USSD, Apps - This will allow the customer to send money to any mobile network as long as the recipient is registered by their respective service provider.**

M-PESA users who attempt to send funds to unregistered customers will receive the notification.

The recipient 07\*\*\*\*\*\*\* you are sending Ksh.\*\*\* to is not registered for mobile money services.

Customers who will have active vouchers on or before 5th will have their vouchers valid until they expire.

# **Benefits**

With this change we will be able to:

Give better experience to customers as no voucher will expire and no funds will be returned to sender

Have proper AML checks and keep our M-PESA network safe from illegal activities and fraudsters.

Reduce demand from customers requesting for voucher-resend.

All other knowledge points such as the website and Egain shall be updated to reflect this new change.

# M-Pesa Business One Account

**Definition**

**M-PESA Business One Account** is a service, which combines the C2B (PayBill) and B2C products in one short code enabling organizations to use one Lipa na M-PESA short code to collect and disburse funds.

Organizations can receive C2B payments on their utility account and make B2C payments from the same.

**Eligibility**

All organizations and institutions that use or intend to use C2B and B2C services.

**Benefits**

- Organizations can now access both C2B and B2C services from a single short code.
- Organizations can use the funds on C2B account as float for B2C disbursements without need to make a B2B transfer or bank float deposit.
- Organizations can view all C2B and B2C reports on a single statement.
- It’s a super M-PESA shortcode that allows both collection and disbursement of funds from one shortcode
- It has a simplified onboarding process

**How to apply for the Business One Account solution**

A special application form will be provided. Kindly contact us through the support line below, or through the organization account manager for further assistance.

**Charges for the service**

The PayBill Tariffs (Business Bouquet, Customer Bouquet, and Mgao Tariffs) remain the same.

Similarly, B2C tariffs remain unchanged.

**Application KYC Requirement**

| Organization Type | KYC Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| Customers with existing C2B and B2C products | Share authorization form filled by at least two company directors or authorized signatoriesTariff guide signed by at least two company directors or authorized signatoriesA letter with narrative stating the existing short codes and which short code to migrate to. |
| Customers with one product (Either C2B or B2C). | Share authorization form filled by at least two company directors or authorized signatoriesTariff guide signed by at least two company directors or authorized signatoriesFill application formA letter with narrative stating the existing short codes where the other product and Tariff will be added |
| New Customers (With no existing C2B or B2C shortcodes) | Share authorization form filled by at least two company directors or authorized signatoriesTariff guide signed by at least two company directors or authorized signatoriesFill application formProvide relevant KYC documents as required for short code application |

**Note**: All documents must be signed and stamped by authorized signatories

We are working on availing the application process on our LNM self-registration portal [https://m-pesaforbusiness.co.ke/](https://m-pesaforbusiness.co.ke/) and Falcon portal used by the SME sales teams. We shall advise once this is completed.

**Mechanics**

- This is an optional service for those who want to use it. Organizations can still choose to have separate shortcodes for C2B and B2C.
- There is no new product. Instead, organizations will have two products, Paybill Product and B2C Product in one shortcode
- On the Business One Account service, the Business Web Operator who is assigned to the Paybill product will now be able to disburse funds. However, any disbursement initiated must be approved by another operator with a Business Manager role.
- This change applies only to the organizations that will use this Business One Account.

**Distinct roles in the M-PESA Business One Account on the M-PESA Portal**

The user roles do not change from the current assignments.

- The Business Administrator will create and manage other organization user accounts
- The Business Web Operator will initiate the disbursement of funds, view statements, and initiate reversals for both C2B and B2C.
- The Business Manager will approve transactions, view statements, and withdraw funds from MPESA to the bank
- The business auditor will continue having read-only access.

**Downloading statements**

On the M-PESA portal select Review Transaction>Account Type>Set Desired Start and End Date>Search>Export

**Support contacts;**

- - Email: M-PESABusiness@Safaricom.co.ke or
 - Call: 0722002222 or 2222, 100 or 200
 - Twitter: @SafaricomPLC or @Safaricom\_Care.
 - Facebook: SafaricomPLC

articleTitle: Call Center Action Points, L300 Admin Team and Fraud key comments
markdownContent:
# **Call Center Action Points**

Where a customer calls to report that they have been called by fraudsters and have given out their details, advice the customer on the need to suspend the account and if consent is given, proceed as below;

1. Vet the customer (name and ID)
2. Suspend the line on CRM using action reason SUSPEND ALL-CUSTOMER REQUEST. **Enter key comment** "Do not unbar, details given to fraudster".
3. Log in to G2 and suspend the M-PESA account under account info tab as below. In the comment box, enter "Customer gave details to Fraudsters".
4. If consent is not given, advice customer to visit an Agent/Retail Centre/care desk to do a sim swap in order to obtain a new PIN.
5. Educate customer on fraud and advise them not to share their details with 3rd parties.
6. Capture an interaction for future reference

# **L300 Admin Team Key Comments**

On investigations, L300 Admin Team will capture the following Key comments:

DO NOT UNBAR. LINE IN A DEFINED PRISON SITE

DO NOT UNBAR. NUMBER SENDING FRAUD SMS IN A SEQUENTIAL ORDER

DO NOT UNBAR. NUMBER ESTABLISHED TO BE INVOLVED IN MPESA FRAUD.

Subscriber calling for assistance in unbarring with the listed flags will be assisted by the CEE through SR (SLA 24Hrs) escalation as shown below.

# **Definition**

Business Fiber is a fast and affordable connection targeted for business customers. This will be sold as a single bundled product with customer getting a single invoice. The product will not allow opting out from Secure Net security product.

# **Eligibility**.

Safaricom IFB HighBand will be offered on postpaid billing for now. We will communicate in the future if we avail it on prepaid billing.

# **Availability.**

Business Fiber service is offered all over Kenya in areas covered by Safaricom Business Fibre. You can subscribe to more than one connection each delivered on its own based on location as per your needs.

# **Packages**

Safaricom IFB HighBand will be offered on below packages.

| Product Name | Business Fiber 15 | Business Fiber 50 | Business Fiber 100 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Price | 2,999 | 5,000 | 6,299 |
| Bandwidth | 15 Mbps | 50 Mbps | 100 Mbps |
| Contention | 1:4 | 1:10 | 1:10 |
| Minimum Speed | 3.5 Mbps | 5 Mbps | 10 Mbps |

# **Onboarding**

Existing customers can apply for a service change through our sales teams for migration to the new products via an email request from the registered service email address. You can also talk to our sales representatives.

Established businesses require.

A duly filled Business Connectivity application form provided by Sales agent or at a Safaricom shop,

Certificate of Incorporation/Registration, or business permit of the business,

KRA Pin Certificate,

national identification of Contact Person.

Small and upcoming businesses require to present national identification of Contact Person.

Safaricom does not charge for installation. Equipment offered for connection will be free. Equipment however remains the property of Safaricom and will be recovered if you terminate your connection. Installation will not cover any internal LAN office cabling at the customer premise.

# **Service Installation**

Service installation process will commence immediately upon payment with the intention to complete installation within the shortest time possible. Out installation partners will be in touch once order processing and payment is closed to arrange for installation.

# **Billing**

Business Fiber will be offered on postpaid advanced billing with customer receiving invoice after bill run on the 1st of every month. The bill will be due on the 16th of the bill month. The first bill will comprise of the prorated charges for the month of onboarding and the next month’s full bill.

# **Payment and Speeds.**

When joining the service, a deposit payment shall be done through paybill 140140 or from our shops by cheque or cash.

Monthly subscription renewals shall be paid through paybill 200200 using your service account as the account number or from our shops. Bill due date is the 16th day of the invoice month. A 10-day grace period from the due date may be allowed at the discretion of Safaricom before you are disconnected.

If you will not have paid the full bill 90 days after disconnection, your subscription will be terminated, and the service deposit used to offset the outstanding bill. Other credit collection actions may be applied to recover any outstanding bill amounts after termination.

Business Fiber service is a shared provision. The advertised package speed is the maximum internet speed you may achieve on your subscribed package. The minimum speed is dependent on contention applied on your subscribed package.

markdownContent:
**Postpay Corporate and Contract Bundles Service and Mechanics.**

**Post-pay Corporate Bundles**

**Definition** 
These are data bundles account under a corporate PostPay account.

Activation.

To join, present a letter on company letter head duly signed and stamped at any retail shop, or scanned and emailed to advantage@safaricom.co.ke

The customer will also be required to sign a corporate bundle consent form that states that they understand that once they exhaust the awarded bundle, they will be charged an out-of-bundle rate of Kshs.4 per MB.

# **Charges.**

A deposit equivalent to the worth of the bundle subscribed to is paid upon sign up together with the value of the bundle for the first month.

if a company wants to sign up for 1.5GB which is worth 1000/- the amount of money to be paid initially is 2000/- i.e. 1000 as deposit and 1000 for the bundle to be awarded for the first month.

# **Bundles Available**. 

| BUNDLE | PRICE |
| --- | --- |
| 500MB | Ksh.500.00 |
| 1.5GB | Ksh.1000.00 |
| 3GB | Ksh.1999.00 |
| 8GB | Ksh.3999.00 |
| 25GB | Ksh.11499.00 |

# **Post-pay Contract Bundles**

**Definition** 
These are data bundles account under a corporate PostPay account.

The accounts are only created for data access only.

This account operates on anniversary billing.

This means that the date of joining becomes the anniversary date.

# **Onboarding**

Considering it is only for corporates, a letter on company letter head duly signed and stamped can be presented at any retail shop or scanned and emailed to advantage@safaricom.co.ke

Sign a corporate bundle consent form that states that they understand that once they exhaust the awarded bundle, they will be charged an out-of-bundle rate of Kshs.4 per MB.

# **Charges**

A Customer will pay for the initial bundle to be awarded plus a minimum deposit of 500/-.

If a customer exhausts PostPay contract bundles before the end of the month, they will need to buy the data bundles Via \*200# ok and follow prompts.

**Bundles Available**

| Bundle | Price (Ksh.) |
| --- | --- |
| 500MB | 500 |
| 1.5GB | 1000 |
| 3GB | 1999 |
| 8GB | 3999 |
| 25GB | 11499 |
| | |

# **Postpay Contract Bundle Line Go Into Collection**

The account goes into collection 7 Days after the anniversary date and the lines are barred if payment is not done.

If the bill is still not cleared by the next anniversary date, they are charged a penalty fee of Ksh. 255 and no bundle is awarded.

If the customer pays, they will able to use the resources that were in the account before it was barred. 

# **Terminating** **A Postpay Contract Bundle Account.**

The termination request will be done in writing.

Clear all the outstanding bills before the contract can be terminated.

Any unutilized resources are carried forwarded once the line has been migrated to prepaid.

# **Deposit Refund After Termination.**

When customers terminate their postpaid accounts, account deposits are refunded as follows:

Basic Deposit: Refunded via M-PESA within 24HRS of Termination.

# **Roaming Deposit**

If roamed in the last 30 days but ONLY terminating Roaming service- Refund via M-PESA within 24HRS of Termination.

If not roamed in the last 30 days - Refund via M-PESA within 24HRS of Termination.

If roamed in the last 30 days & terminating the post pay service with us - Refund via M-PESA within 30 days of Termination, to ensure all roaming calls have been billed.

**NOTE**: Kindly encourage customers to opt into the refund via M-PESA option in order to receive the refund within the stipulated SLA. For airtime, EFT, transfer of deposits, etc., the refund process remains the same i.e. 14 days.

# **Is telemedicine the same as telehealth.**

- Telehealth is a broad technology category that encompasses using digital tools like a smartphone or laptop to see a doctor. Within this framework are a number of subsets with names like telemedicine, e-health, or m-health.

# Network Reserved Numbers

**Network Reserved Numbers**

1. **Definition**

These are numbers that Safaricom has reserved for company use internally. These numbers are not to be used by customers.

2. **Eligibility**

This applies to customers who are holding Network Reserved numbers only. Some of the reserved numbers have been sold out to customers erroneously and are in use.

3. **How it works**

1. These customers are not aware that the numbers are reserved and may call contact center or visits retail center for a SIM replacement or upgrade.
2. For a reserved line the SIM swap will generate a backend error and will require escalation for the error to be cleared.
3. Customers will be given an option to get a golden number in exchange of the reserved line. This will be actioned by the Support team.
4. **Golden Number Packages available and Charges**

| CATEGORY | PRICE (KSH) |
| --- | --- |
| Golden | 5,000 |
| Platinum | 10, 000 |
| Super platinum | 15, 000 |

0. 1. **Call Center procedure**
1. A customer will call contact center with the request for a SIM Swap or a SIM upgrade.
2. The CEE shall vet the customer as per the current Vetting procedure via various systems as below;

1. Full names as per the M-PESA/Siebel CRM/Jiandikishe system (Mandatory). The CEE can also accept if the customer gives 2 correct names. e.g., the first and last name.
2. ID number (Mandatory)
3. Any 2 secondary details **(Refer to Contact Center Vetting Matrix on ESAKA)**

3. If the customer fails vetting, refer them to Retail center for assistance.
4. Where vetting is successful, and the SIM swap order generates an error, the Call Center CEE will raise an SR for SIM replacement due to backend error. The CEE will also indicate the Serial number of the SIMEX, and Customer’s alternative contact number.
5. The CEE shall advise the customer that they will be contacted within 72hrs for assistance.

 **Support Analyst Procedure**

The Support Analyst (SA) will check to confirm if number is network reserved, call the customer, and advise on the available options below:

1. **Scenario 1**

- Customer is offered a special (Golden) number, agrees to pay for it and return the Network Reserved number.
- **Action:** SA refers customer to the nearest Retail center. 

2. **Scenario 2**

- Customer is offered a special (Golden) number and declines to pay for it but accepts at company’s cost.
- Action**:** SA refers customer to the nearest Retail center. 

3. **Scenario 3**

- Customer declines the special (Golden) number option and insists they want to retain the line.
- Action: SA escalates issue to Network team to allow customer swap and retain the line.

6. For Scenarios 1 & 2 above, if customer agrees SA will refer the customer to the nearest Retail center for assistance and close activity.
7. For Scenario 3, SA will raise a request to NMS Support to swap the line from the backend.
8. NMS support will seek approval from Risk. One approval is received, raise CRQ for backend sim swap and proceed to swap once the CRQ is approved.
9. Once the swap is completed, NMS support will inform the SA to advise the customer that the line is ready for use and close the ticket within a 72hr SLA. 

1. 3. **Retail Center Procedure**

1. A customer will visit Retail center with the request for a SIM Swap or a SIM upgrade.
2. The CEE shall vet the customer as per the current Vetting procedure via various systems as below;

1. Full names as per the M-PESA/Siebel CRM/Jiandikishe system (Mandatory).

The CEE can also accept if the customer gives 2 correct names. e.g., the first and last name.

2. ID number (Mandatory)
3. Any 2 secondary details **(Refer to Retail Vetting Matrix on ESAKA)** 
4. Where vetting is successful, the CEE will complete the SIM replacement request.
5. In case the SIM swap process generates a backend error, the Retail CEE will confirm whether the number is network reserved from the attached list. The Retail CEE will advise the customer as per below:
6. **Scenario 1**

- Customer is offered a special (Golden) number, agrees to pay for it and return the Network Reserved number.

- **Action:** Retail CEE issues customer with preferred special number (refer to Golden number process)

2. **Scenario 2**

- Customer is offered a special (Golden) number and declines to pay for it but accepts at company’s cost.
- Action: Retail CEE issues preferred special (Golden) number to customer at company’s cost upon approval by Retail center manager (refer to Golden number process).

3. **Scenario 3**

- Customer declines the special (Golden) number option and insists they want to retain the line.
- Action: Retail CEE escalates issue to Network team to allow customer swap or upgrade and retain the line.

articleTitle: M-PESA Agent Self reversal via USSD - Business Rules
markdownContent:
# M-PESA Agent Self reversal via USSD - Business Rules

## **The M-PESA agent reversal functionality provides the following business rules**:

- Enables the M-PESA agent to initiate ‘Deposit’ reversal requests via SMS
- The requests will be logged as deposit reversal interactions on CRM system.
- Service Mode: Request made via short code 2530
- The normal process by Customer Care team of contacting the recipient (B-Party) before confirming the reversal, request will not be done as this process is an end to end reversal request (automated reversal).
- M-PESA will notify both parties once the reversal is completed via SMS.
- The service will only be available to M-PESA agent’s tills. The solution is not available to M-PESA super agents.
- The service will accept only M-PESA agent-initiated transactions that are deposits, (Deposit transaction reversal requests).
- The requesting agent will be required to enter the Transaction ID Number for the amount sent in error.
- The Recipient (B-Party) must have the full amount (or more) in M-PESA in order for a reversal to be initiated.
- The transaction status in M-PESA must be in ‘Completed’ Status.
- The service will initiate a reversal request for transactions not older than 60 minutes from the time the transaction was done by the agent. The time limit is a configurable parameter.
- The service will attempt to initiate a reversal request only if the MSISDN that has done the request matches both the Sender MSISDN and transaction Number in M-PESA system.
- Only one transaction ID number can be reversed per each 2530 SMS request.

**Where Agent is getting an error or is not getting response from 2530**

Raise an SR indicating the Agent Till number and Till MSISDN under:

Category: M-PESA Services

Type: Mpesa Agent Account

Item: 2530 Activation

**Support Analyst:**

- Check if white-listed on Dealer Portal.
- Whitelist the Till where it is not yet white-listed and inform the agent.
- If already white-listed, the Support Analyst will escalate to the ‘Analyst - Enterprise Systems Support’ who supports Dealer Portal.

**M-PESA CONSUMER APP - FAQS**

# **Definition**

This is a new transaction channel for M-PESA customers that will allow them to perform their transactions, and access third party services easily and conveniently. Customers will enjoy an enhanced user experience while using the M-PESA consumer APP.

# **Eligibility**

All M-PESA customers with smart phones will be able to download the M-PESA consumer app to enjoy its convenience. Android version – 4.4 and iOS version - 9, whose handsets are not rooted.

# **Advantages**

1. Improve the user experience of existing M-PESA products and services.
2. Increase customer engagement and the number of M-PESA products consumed per customer.
3. Digitally expose new M-PESA products and services.
4. User Strategic partnerships across the customer lifestyle by use of the mini apps
5. Easy access to FAQs, website, and support channels.

# **How to download the MPESA Consumer APP**

M-PESA customers will be able to download the M-PESA Consumer app, on iOS (Apple App Store) and Android (Google Play Store) devices. Key steps below:

- On first sign-in -customers will be required to **turn on their mobile data.**
- For dual sim devices, M-PESA simcard must be the active simcard/ sim1 and turn on data for that sim card.
- Subsequent sign-in attempts can be done over a WI-FI connection.
- Accept terms and conditions.
- Enter a valid M-PESA PIN for authentication.
- The customer can add a profile photo either by taking a photo directly via the camera or by accessing their phone gallery.
- Customers can allow M-PESA to access their already enabled handset biometrics (Face recognition / Fingerprint).

**N/B:** The customer will be awarded 500Mbs of data when they download the M-PESA APP for the first time and perform a 1st chargeable transaction on the app. Note the awarded data is valid till midnight of the same day. Check on M-PESA App VBC if the customer qualifies for the data award.

Customers travelling abroad should be guided to download MPESA- APP within the country before travelling when on Safaricom network to be able to opt in successfully.

Once downloaded and signed in on Safaricom network, then the customer will be able to use MPESA-APP successfully when roaming . Customers already abroad cannot be able to download MPESA -APP

# **How to sign in**

Consumers will be required to:

- Key in their M-PESA PIN for authentication.
- Optional feature: Take a picture (that can be updated in the future) as an added identity feature.
- Optional Feature: Register their fingerprints, or Facial recognition to use in authenticating their transactions (For customers whose handsets have biometric features).

# **New features available for customers on the M-PESA consumer APP**

Customers will be able to access:

- Biometrics - Sign in and authenticate transactions using fingerprint or Facial recognition.
- Hide Balance- The customer can hide/unhide M-PESA and Fuliza balance.
- Frequents list - automatically saved transaction list to enhance transaction experience, so one doesn’t have to type a recipient’s MSISDN.
- Favourites list – customize a list of frequently used MSISDNs, pay bills, or Buy goods numbers to ease the transaction process.
- PFM (MySpend) - Personal Finance manager – enables one to track monthly spending and give a graphical snapshot of one’s transactions.
- **Scrollable**, real-time statements on the homepage. These can be downloaded and shared on various channels, including social channels e. g. WhatsApp.
- Statement down-load- customers can download, export, or filter statements based on the transaction type.
- Popular pay bills – save these to conveniently transact without having to type or remember Paybill numbers or Buy Goods Number.
- Pochi la Biashara – customers will be able to use the APP to pay Pochi la Biashara merchants.
- Scan QR – customers can pay Lipa na M-PESA using the QR functionality or receive.
- Notification bell – This feature shows a list of notifications received on the M-PESA App.
- Fast log-in - This enables you to log in without a PIN. This will hide balance and spending until you insert the PIN.
- payment through the “My QR” Option.
- Request Money – You can request money from other M-PESA App users
- Share App link – Spread the word about the M-PESA App by sharing a link with friends and family.
- Send Money with description – Add context when sending money by adding a payment description
- Block Business- You can block a business from requesting payments from you.
- Send to many- You can send money to a maximum number of 5 recipients.
- Global – This feature enables you to;

1. Send money to mobile numbers in different countries.
2. Send to banks in other countries
3. Send to Western Union
4. Link your Paypal Account
5. Cost Estimator -This helps calculate the different transactions to other countries.
6. Withdraw or Top Up on PayPal
7. Roaming Pickup

- Global Pay – This feature gives you a virtual card that can be used to make online transactions.

# **Transactions available on the M-PESA APP**

Customers can:

- Send money to other customers on Safaricom and other networks.
- Request money from other customers.
- Carry out M-PESA Global transactions including – Roaming pickup, Paypal withdraw, send to western union, etc.
- Lipa na M-PESA – paybill, buy goods, and Pochi la biashara accounts.
- Withdraw from M-PESA Agents and from various ATMs.
- Buy Airtime or data bundles for their numbers and other numbers.
- Perform Fuliza transactions, view their Fuliza limits, check their Fuliza due amount from the APP, view Fuliza amounts spent on various transaction types, and opt out of Fuliza.
- Access/use Safaricom credit and saving services- KCB M-PESA, M-Shwari, Faraja, Hustler fund, Mali.
- Pochi la Biashara wallet- open Pochi la Biashara wallet, view balance, view statement, Pay (buy goods, paybill and mobile number), move money to Pochi or back to M-PESA wallet. The Pochi wallet can be accessed via the transact tab or by switching the account using the icon on the top left side of the App.

# **My Spend on the M-PESA APP**

This is the Personal Finance manager which tracks a customers monthly spend to give a pictorial view of one’s transactions per month. From this tab, customers:

- Can view the value of one’s monthly spend.
- Have a categorized view of their expenditure.
- Can download statements based on the transaction type.
- Extract sharable receipts for specific transactions.

# **Grow Tab**

This tab currently has the credit and savings propositions such as M-Shwari, KCB M-PESA, Hustler Fund, Faraja, MALI and Global Pay where customers can save money, take loans, and save for a specific period.

# **Mini App**

These are third party services that expose external services that can be access via the M-PESA consumer app on the homepage or the services tab.

On the Home screen, the mini apps are categorized according to different verticals such as financial services, transport and travel, events and experiences, education, insurance, health and wellness, my Safaricom, public sector, shop and gift.

Examples of the mini apps are:

- Buupass – Customers can book bus travel to different counties within Kenya and pay by M- PESA.

- CPF – Customers can register and/or continue paying for their pension under this function.
- Progas – Customers can order for and refill their Progas cylinders under this mini app.
- Madaraka Express – Customers can book their train tickets on the Madaraka express mini app.
- GiftPesa – Customers will be able to register to send Gift vouchers to other customers to redeem. Vouchers will be from various Lipa na M-PESA merchants.
- E-Bima – This is a digital insurance program offered to Boda-boda riders via the M-PESA APP (we have attached the product FAQs).
- Mtickets - Customers can buy tickets for all event on the M-PESA APP

# **Offline Mode**

This is a functionality that will allow customers using Android Devices to carry out core M-PESA transactions while offline/where data coverage is limited.

**N/B**: The customers need to enable offline mode under the account settings.

The core transactions are:

- Send Money
- Withdrawals.
- Lipa na M-PESA (Buy Goods and paybill)
- Buy Airtime.

# **How to manage M-PESA APP accounts**

Yes. Customers can tap on their profiles on the top left-hand side to:

- Add/remove/change a Profile picture to their M-PESA APP profile for identity purposes.
- Manage their Favorites (Add more numbers/buy goods tills/paybill accounts or delete some.
- Disable or enable the biometrics feature.
- Disable or enable the Offline mode.
- Change their M-PESA PIN.
- Contact customer care teams on various channels e.g. on Call support and social media.
- Refer to more FAQs on the MPESA APP.
- Log out.
- Get support- make requests, call support, Safaricom website, social media handles.
- About the App-rate the app, Terms and conditions and Privacy policy.

# **M-PESA App Devices Blocked**

The message says devices blocked but it means tokens blocked. **One device can have multiple tokens**.

When you go through an onboarding journey, you are given a new token each time. So, if you do multiple onboarding’s **for the same MSISDN**, you will end up having multiple tokens. So, when you wipe the MSISDN, you get multiple devices blocked but it is multiple tokens blocked.

**NOTE:** A device can have multiple tokens attached to it **but only one is in use for a device at a time** and this is **always the token created during the latest onboarding for a device.**

# **Definition**

The M-PESA App is the newest, revolutionary, and most convenient way to access M-PESA services. The App is a lifestyle digital channel that addresses daily customer use cases by exposing M-PESA customers to new M-PESA products and services. **My Spend** \- Personal Finance manager – enables users to track their monthly spend and gives a graphical snapshot of one’s transactions.

**Get & share transaction Receipts.** – Access scrollable**,** real**\-**time statements on the home page which can be downloaded and shared on various channels, including social channels e. g. WhatsApp. Once a user ends a Send Money, Buy Goods or PayBill Transaction, they can click on the Receipt icon on Success Screen (Top Right Corner), or open Statement by tapping on the transaction and then use phone options to share or save receipt to device.

**Export Statement** **–** Customers can export and/or download their M-PESA statements based on transaction type, and date.

**Favorite** – Save and add Favorites to conveniently transact without having to type or remember phone numbers PayBill numbers or Buy Goods Numbers.

Pay Pochi la Biashara merchants.

Access Pochi la Biashara account.

Move money from Pochi la Biashara to M-PESA and from M-PESA to Pochi la Biashara account.

**Scan QR** – Use the QR functionality to

Make Lipa Na M-PESA payments to Buy goods and PayBills by scanning merchants QR code.

Receive payment through the “My QR” Option.

Make Person-to-persona payments by scanning the recipient QR that the recipient must generate using the My QR option.

**Offline mode** \- Use the M-PESA Super App to complete transactions e.g., send and receive money, Lipa Na M-PESA payments, Buy Airtime, and Withdraw cash even without data bundles or when offline.

For access to mini-Apps (third-party services), users must have internet access.

**Dark Mode** **–** Switch to Dark mode by selecting Account at the top left corner of the App, then choose Appearance and select dark mode.

Improves customers’ experience with M-PESA products and services.

Exposes users to new M-PESA products and services.

Customers can easily access FAQs, websites, and support channels.

markdownContent:
**POSTPAY SERVICES for Contact Centre and Retail.**

# **Postpay Application Process Errors**

If the customer subscribes for the PostPay service and the line is inactive.

First check on the order raised on Siebel If the order is on submitted or has a back-end error and the customer has made payment for deposit escalate the issue via SR with the following categories;

Category: Service Change.

Type: Account Migration.

Item: Pre to post.

If there is no order raised for a pre to post migration, Capture the details from the customer i.e. the amount paid, the shop where the migration was requested at and escalate the issue to the shop and copy LINE 200 ESCALATIONS.

# **Delayed PostPay Tariff Migration**

The agent (CEE) will raise a service request on Siebel with the following fields.

Category- Tariff change.

Type- select original Tariff.

Item- select requested Tariff.

# **How To Change E-Mail or Postal Address Details**

PostPay Corporate and Individual customers will make a written request which should have the details below;

Customer name

Physical address

Postal and e-mail address

Correct contact number

The customer can either drop the letter at any of the retail shops or send the scanned copy of the letter to [advantage@safaricom.co.ke](mailto:advantage@safaricom.co.ke)  or via post to Box 66827 00800 Westland’s.

Change of details will be done by The Support Centre on approval by credit

A request that has delayed will be escalated using Service Request on Siebel;

Category: Contact management

Type: Select appropriate type

Item: Siebel.

SLA 24 hrs.

In case the email address on Siebel is misspelt by a letter or missing a dot or a very minimal change, this can be adjusted while on call after vetting and confirming on the attached document that the change to be done, will not change the entire mailing address.

The PostPay individual customers can also request for change of e-mail /Postal address without a written letter.

The customer will call 200 for assistance.

The agent will then escalate the issue to support via SR for the details to be changed;

• Category: Contact details management. 
• Type: Select appropriate type (Email address or Mailing address) 
• Item: Siebel.

SLA is 24 hrs.

# **Postpay Termination** **Service**

The customer can terminate services by:

Visiting the Retail Center or

sending an Email to advantage@safaricom.co.ke

A termination Order will be raised on Siebel.

A hard copy is also delivered to credit control for filing.

CEE advises the customer that they will be advised on the final invoice that needs to be settled.

# **Refund calculation**

Refund = (Deposit + Prepayment) - (Bill in progress + Outstanding bill).

Basic Deposit Refund is done via M-PESA and Refund done within 24hrs.

# **Roaming deposit**

If roamed in the last 30 days but ONLY terminating Roaming service- Refund via M-PESA within 24HRS of Termination.

If not roamed in the last 30 days - Refund via M-PESA within 24HRS of Termination.

If roamed in the last 30 days & terminating the post pay service - Refund via M-PESA within 3 Weeks from Termination (to ensure all roaming calls have been billed).

**Note:**

Termination done between Monday and Thursday, refund via M-PESA is effected within 24 working hours.

Terminations done between Friday and Sunday, M-PESA refunds are processed from Monday morning.

Encourage customers to opt into the refund via M-PESA option and provide an M-PESA registered number in order to receive the refund within the stipulated SLA.

For airtime, EFT, transfer of deposits, etc., the refund SLA remain within 3 weeks of termination.

# **Post-pay Paybill 200200 Reversals or Posting To Account.**

Reversal can be done due to the following scenarios;

Wrong format e.g. put account as 168975879 instead of 1-68975879

Omitting a number while entering account or mobile number.

Entering a wrong number.

# **Wrong format/Omitting a number.**

Confirm that the account number (e.g. 1-68975879 is correct and on PostPay, e.g. the customers did leave out any digit)

Educate customer on how to pay with correct details; advice the customer that this shall be posted in their account.

Raise an SR on this request with full details of the M-PESA transaction (Amount, Transaction ID, Date, Time, MSISDN/Account number) and state kindly post to correct account and quote it.

Do not ask the customer to make new payment.

Key in relevant interactions.

Escalate to Line 200 TM Escalation folder and copy CM PostPay TM and CM CCSPostPay with details of the transaction and MSISDN for follow up.

**Entering a Wrong Number:**

Educate customer on how to pay to correct number; advice the customer that this shall be reversed so that the customer pays to the correct account.

Raise an SR on this request with full details of the M-PESA transaction (Amount, Transaction ID, Date, Time, MSISDN/Account number)

You may ask the customer to make new payment as they wait for the reversal to be done. 
Key in relevant interactions.

Escalate to Line 200 TM Escalation folder and copy CM PostPay TM and CM CCSPostPay with details of the transaction and MSISDN for follow up

**NOTE:**

If the customer misses out on a character or digit when paying to a number, the possibilities for posting payment to complete correct number that will be provided exist.

If the customer puts a complete incorrect number and state that the payment was to be posted to another complete correct number, reversal will be done. 
Details of transaction to be provided must include: (Amount, Transaction ID, Date, Time, MSISDN/Account number).

# **Barring Date Extension**

Extending barring date means you are telling the system not to bar account until the specified date at 00:00:00hrs.

This is a Credit Control responsibility which has been extended to the COPs Postpaid Team Leaders and CCS Postpaid Support Analysts.

Such adjustments are requested via a written request for Corporate by their account managers through their contact persons.

For standard accounts this can be done via call on need basis.

In cases where the customer insists on being unbarred briefly to allow do mobile banking or extension of the barring date when they have a pending bill;

The CEE will consult with the Post Pay Team Leader on via email duty and copy Line200 TM Escalations <<Line2002@Safaricom.co.ke>> without necessarily overpromising the customer.

The TL will then look at the credit history of the customer, among other items and make decision on the customer's ask.

The TL will make sure the customer is given feedback within 1 hour.

The financial implication is that customer may:

Exceed their limit, and with no evidence of agreement, dispute the amount.

Not be charged late payment fee if adjustment is done within the date.

# **Eligible Accounts**

Below are the account types who’s barring dates can be extended on customer’s request:

Express Autobar.

Individual Autobar.

Postpaid Bundles.

# **Reasons for Extension**

Barring date extension may arise from different reasons;

Failed/delayed posting due to system issues or defined SLAs –e.g. 24hours for SCB or 72 hours if done on Friday – customer needs to provided evidence/details of payment.

Confirmed erroneous billing issues, such as wrong thresholds.

Failure to run valid customer’s Card (Debit/Credit).

Awaiting posting of an approved credit note that will offset the outstanding amount.

Payments needs to be voided and posted again where it was done erroneously.

Challenges with our payment’s platforms e.g. M-PESA unavailable and customer has funds.

# **Credit Limit Adjustment**

Credit Limit is a capping that is set on an account to ensure customer’s usage does not go beyond a certain amount.

Roaming customers requesting for barring date extensions ought to be given a credit limit adjustment instead.

This is to avoid the data billing accumulating to disputable amounts within the adjustment window.

# **How to Handle Customers’ Requests.**

The CEE advises the customer to make a formal request for increase/ decrease of credit limit from their registered email address (individual customers).

Corporates should make requests through their account managers/contact persons.

Once the email request is received the Support analyst will raise a credit increase order which goes to credit for vetting and approval.

The limit is adjusted accordingly upon order completion.

The email feedback SLA 2hrs.

# **Increasing Credit Limit.**

Make a written request from the Safaricom RC and make additional deposit payment equivalent to the requested difference.

The RC team will raise a credit increase Order which goes to credit for vetting and approval.

The limit is adjusted accordingly upon order completion.

SLA 2hrs.

**NOTE:** 
Advantage postpaid account customers may choose to have their limit increased beyond their deposit amount. Such requests will be done either from the RC or sending email to advantage@safaricom.co.ke. The receiving team will forward the request to credit team for approval after vetting.

# **Credit Limit Decrease**

Customers wishing to lower their credit limit will bring their written request to the RC or send an email to advantage@safaricom.co.ke

On the request, the customer will indicate how their difference in deposit will be treated where applicable:

To be posted as a payment on the account or a different account.

To be retained on the account (refundable upon total service termination).

Refunded via M-PESA/EFT.

The receiving team will raise a credit limit reduction order and attach the customer request on the account for reference.

The limit is adjusted accordingly once the order is complete.

SLA 2hrs.

Credit team will then process the deposit as per customer’s request, and where refund is applicable, below refund SLA will apply:

M-PESA Option: 24 hrs.

EFT option: 14 Days

# **Related CRM Interactions:**

| Profile | Type | Sub Type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CSR Post-paid | Barring Date Adjustment | Payment posting failed/ delays.Erroneous billing issues.System issues.Debit/Credit Card Not Run.To facilitate Mobile banking payment.To facilitate M-PESA paymentTo pay bill later. |
| CSR Post-paid | Credit Limit Adjustment | Payment posting failed/ delays.Erroneous billing issues.System issues.Debit/Credit Card Not Run.To pay bill at a later date. |
