markdownContent:
# **M-PESA PIN Contextual Unlock Service**

**Definition**

**M-PESA PIN Contextual Unlock Service** is a solution that enables real-time, self-service PIN unlocking through an **NI Push**, allowing users to verify their identity using their ID and securely unlock their PIN without having to go to the MPESA PIN unlock USSD menu.

The revamp of the service will enhance the customer experience across USSD transactions by automating the PIN unlock process.

**Eligibility**

Customer must be a registered Safaricom subscriber.

Customer must be a registered M-PESA customer.

Customer’s ID registered in G3 shall be a mandatory vetting detail and the customer shall be required to enter the correct details to be able to proceed.

·Must be a registered customer in active or pending active state on G3.

# **How It Works:**

- On the **5th incorrect PIN attempt**, the customer will receive a prompt **(NI push)** requesting them to enter their ID **number**.
- If the ID number entered is correct, the account will be **unlocked instantly**.
- The customer shall receive an **SMS notification** confirming the successful unlock of their M-PESA account.

 **Objective**

- Demand Reduction in all customer touchpoints.
- Give customers a better experience on **Do It Yourself** and reduce reliance on Customer Care.
- Ensure that M-PESA remains the Mobile Money ecosystem of choice.
- Easy to use and accessible to all customers.
- Reduced cost to serve.
- Provide M-PESA customers with a service that meets their needs.

# **Customer Journey**

** [Screenshot] 
**

**Definition**

This is a journey on the Partner App platform that will be used to measure sales force productivity and provide a framework for salesforce effectiveness through the tracking and measurement of trade activities.

**Use**

Initially, Territory Development Representatives (TDRs) and Territory Business Leads (TBLs) will have access to the SFE journey. This will be scaled up to other roles in the future.

**Modules**

Currently we have 2 modules in production, i.e Outlet Census and Outlet Visit but will include the rest in the coming iterations

Outlet census

Outlet visits

Journey planning

Coaching

POSM management

Performance and Reporting

**Difference between outlet census and outlet visit**

Outlet census is an exercise aimed at collecting new partner information whilst outlet visit is aimed at updating outlet information, training, supporting and collecting strategic feedback from already censured Partners.

**Mechanics**

**I cannot see the routes in my cluster. What should I do?**

Ensure you have been mapped correctly to the correct cluster, territory and region. Send an email to subregescalations@safaricom.co.ke to have these details updated.

**Why can’t I select my cluster details when I am onboarding outlets?**

Region, territory and cluster will not be entered manually. The app will pick these details automatically depending on TDR Mapping.

**I am not able to attach a photo of an outlet from my gallery. What should I do?**

The TDR will not be able to pick images from the gallery. A live photo capture is required. Photo should be clear and capture the name board where available. The photo of the outlet should enable one to identify an outlet in future and should be updated if the appearance of the outlet changes.

**Will I be able to collect contact details of the primary contact who is not physically at the outlet?**

No. The TDR and Primary contact must both be in the outlet during the outlet census.

**Why are we sending an OTP to the primary contact?**

The primary contact will receive an OTP message as witness to onboarding of the outlet before it is active in the route. The OTP message indicates this: “Dear Agent, share the One Time Pin: xxxxxx with the TDR to consent and progress with the collection of your outlet information. Thank you.”

**Support**

| Issue Description | Responsibility | Escalation Timeframe | Escalation Contact |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Work instructions and Performance tracking | Governance team​ | Daily | Pauline Wanene |
| Log in, cluster mapping, device mapping | Subregescalations@safaricom.co.ke | Within 24hrs | Subregescalations Team |
| App errors | Report an Issue via Partner App | Within 24 hours | DealerOperationsITSupport@safaricom.co.ke |
| UI, feature Enhancements and suggestions | subreg@safaricom.co.ke | TBC | Product Owner |

**What is IPRS Automation?**

It is a controlled process that allows SIM registration to continue when the IPRS system is unavailable or congested, with post-validation completed within 24–48 hours.

 **When is IPRS Automation activated?**

The process is automatically triggered when IPRS global failures exceed 40% within a 5minute window, or when IPRS experiences downtime, port congestion, or missing Maisha ID data.

**What services can a customer access during the validation period?**

**GSM services** (Voice, Data, SMS) are available for 24 hours (or up to 72 hours for Maisha ID cases).

**M-PESA services** remain inactive until successful KYC validation.

**How will frontline teams identify registrations pending validation?**

Such lines will be flagged as **“IPRS Status – Pending Validation”** on Siebel, Single View, and SubReg Portal, with document images visible for review

**How many lines can a customer register under pending validation?**

Only **one line per ID** can be registered while IPRS validation is pending

**What happens after successful validation?**

Once validated by the AML team, the system automatically updates the customer KYC status and activates **M-PESA (G3)** services for full use

**What if the customer KYC is rejected after registration?**

The AML team will initiate the compliance process and update CRM and SVC with remarks in the **“Key Comments”** section for follow-up and resolution

**Can a customer perform a SIM swap while under IPRS pending status?**

No. **SIM swaps** are restricted until full IPRS validation is completed.

**Who manages and monitors validation exceptions?**

The **Corporate Security team** oversees exception management, while the **AML team** maintains a daily tracker of validations and customer resolutions

**What support systems are in place for validation accuracy?**

The **Compliance team**, in partnership with **Big Data**, will leverage **AI models** to enhance ID validation both before and after registration

Forcible Okoa Recovery is an automatic Okoa recovery payment method to offset delayed Okoa loans and transition from blacklist.

# **Objective**

- To settle outstanding ETU debt and opening the limit for borrowings to customers.
- To reduce unutilized resources liabilities and support revenue realization.

# **How It Works**

- Customer must have an Okoa Loan
- CBS status must be active.
- Customer must have existing unused resources either Voice minutes/airtime, SMS or Data bundles to be used for recovery of debt
- The customers loan should be unpaid on the 15th day after ETU borrowing.
- The unit price at the point of purchase will apply for the conversion rate.

# **Conversion Rate**

# **CRM Views**

**Sample: -**Data bundles recovered equivalent to loan amount Ksh 20> The converted amount is recharged> Then Okoa Loan is repaid.

** [Screenshot] 
**

 [Screenshot]

# **Redemption for Individual customers** 

The procedure is initiated by the customer and begins when s/he visits the retail centre.   

Where customer requests for redemption of non merchandise, CEE will advise customer on various available options to redeem i.e. via SMS, USSD, Safaricom APP or Selfcare. 

Subscribers with an Okoa balance will not be able to redeem any other resources except free money. This will be used to repay the ETU debt first. Customers should first clear the Okoa debt to allow them redeem their Bonga for other resources.   

Where the customer requests for redemption of merchandise, CEE will proceed to vet the customer as per the Retail Vetting Procedure. The agent needs to verify the vetting details in the system i.e. full names and document ID.   

After vetting, if customer is registered and passes the vetting, the CEE will confirm the available bonga balance on customers account and will give available options for redemptions i.e. full bonga, partial bonga or flexi bonga. 

CEE will check the redemption history on CRM/LMS system to validate the number of times single MSSIDN has redeemed in a single day for merchandise. 

Maximum number allowed for merchandise redemption for one MSSDN is five times, for any running promotion and customer is requesting to redeem for more than five times CEE should advise the customer on promotion terms & conditions. 

After validation the agent will assist customer generate password from their phone and will proceed to tender and issue receipt. 

An interaction must be raised on Siebel capturing details of the transaction.   

# **Redemption for company lines**

For Bonga request by companies or organizations, the Company will be required to prepare an authorization letter to be presented to a Safaricom Shop. The letter must have the following details:     

Be on the company original letter head.   

Must state that the bearer has been authorized to do a redemption on behalf of the company, indicating in the letter their full name, and ID number. Where the same is not indicated, CEE must call the contact person and also use available contacts on Siebel to verify approval for Bonga redemption.   

Party sent must have original ID and have it scanned and attached   

The letter should preferably be stamped using the company rubber stamp. In exceptional cases where company claims to have no stamp, CEE will verify from previous correspondence / account managers.   

The letter must be signed by the company contact person.   

The agent must call the contact person to verify before redemption. Once vetting is done satisfactorily, redemption will follow.     

The Agent should attach a scanned copy of all the above documents on CRM and capture a Service Interaction including all the vetting details / approvals in the notes.   

These letters should be stamped with the Retail Shop rubber stamp showing the current date, Service Interaction or Service Request number indicated clearly on the letter. The staff performing the redemption should then file this.   

# **Bonga Points Redemption on Safaricom lines** 

This applies to redemption of bonga points on Safaricom owned lines i.e. Safaricom owned Test lines, data lines, Retail Shop lines etc.   

Points accumulated for lines belonging to Safaricom, specific departments or shops are not redeemed at the retail shops.   

Staff lines are exempt, where staff requests to redeem merchandise from their account i.e. lines registered under the company with the staff as the primary contact and used by the staff. CEE will request the staff to present their staff ID or national ID.   

CEE upon vetting will assist customer to redeem as per their request and enter an interaction and will attach ID seen on the account.   

Where a third party is sent, third party process will apply.   

# **Changa Na Bonga and Bonga PIN** 

This service allows customers to transfer their bonga points to other Safaricom subscribers this is based on set product configuration.   

**1 Pre-paid**   

Where customer visits retail in scenarios where they have not been able to set their Bonga PIN or have forgotten the same.   

CEE will vet and trouble shoot to confirm customer’s tariff and configuration to allow transfer of points and will advise customer accordingly.   

Where customer’s tariff allows transfer i.e. pre-paid lines, CEE will vet customer and request to see their original ID as per vetting procedure.   

CEE will then proceed to log into the bonga PIN system and (re)set customer Bonga PIN once customer passes the vetting process.   

CEE will then proceed to guide customer on changing the PIN on their device.   

Third party Requests for PIN will not be honoured.   

**2          Post -paid**   

For post –paid individual lines, the customer will present ID and CEE will proceed to log into the bonga PIN system and reset customer Bonga PIN once customer passes the vetting process and will assist customer set their bonga PIN. CEE will raise an interaction.   

Where the system-based business rules don’t allow Changa Na Bonga i.e.  Corporate post- paid customers, manual process will apply.   

CEE will raise a Service Request on Siebel and attach the following   documents.    

Original ID (Party sent must have original ID and have it scanned and attached on Siebel.)   

Duly filled and signed manual adjustment form.   

Customer’s written request to transfer points, should be on the company original letter head, preferably stamped and signed by the contact person.   

SA will ensure manual adjustment form is dully signed by the manager.   

SA will ensure the numbers are registered under the requesting customer on Siebel and sends an email to EBU account manager to confirm and approve request.   

Once approval is done consolidates points and will proceed to notify the customer via mail, SMS or phone call.   

SA will close SR with action taken.   

# **Manual Adjustment Procedure**

The procedure is applicable to all cases where a customer’s bonga points need to be adjusted either upwards or downwards. It also applies to cases where a customer’s airtime needs to be adjusted or topped up to the customer manually on the system.   

**Subscriber Bonga points adjustment**

When a customer visits the shop to redeem their Bonga points, there are instances where due to system issues the customers’ points may need to be adjusted. Case in point as below:   

a) Customer’s points are deducted on Siebel/ LMS but the merchandise is not released from POS.   

b) Merchandise is released from POS but customer points are not deducted on Siebel/LMS    

c) Any other situation as per manager discretion and justification.   

Where any of the cases above occur, CEE will fill the manual adjustment form.   

The CEE will raise an SR and attach relevant documents.   

The SA will confirm that all the details entered on the SR are correct and will ensure manual adjustment form is signed by manager as approval.   

The request will then be forwarded to the RCM for approval after having verified validity of the adjustment. The following approval limits will apply:-   

| Category | Max Amount | Approver |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Bonga | 1-29999 | RCM |
| | 30000-49999 | RCM |
| | 50000+ | RCM |

 Once the request has been approved the SA or Team Leader will then adjust the points on Siebel for the same and close the SR with the necessary resolution details and inform the customer of the same.

# **Customer requesting for call records to be used in court at Retail**

Customer to get the police investigator to write a formal request (not an abstract) and deliver the same to their respective directorate of criminal investigation within their region.

Any request for call data outside the above scope will be handled on a case by case basis by the shop manager / team leader by liaising with either legal team or law enforcement liaison team.   

The letter from law enforcement agencies will then be mailed from the respective county commander’s office after it is vetted; the letter should be scanned and mailed to lawenforcementliaison@Safaricom.co.ke.   

Once the data request has been received by law enforcement liaison office, feedback will be provided within five days from the date the request is received.   

Emergency cases e.g.  Kidnapping, murder, sexual offences and reported missing persons, are given immediate attention upon receipt of the same from the concerned station (this is inclusive of weekends and holidays)   

Any request that does not satisfy these requirements will be rejected.  A mail is sent to the requesting station giving reasons as to why its request cannot be acted upon, for example where the authorizing letter is not signed or is improperly signed or does not disclose an offence gets rejected immediately.

markdownContent:
# **Law Enforcement Agencies Requests- Court Documents presented at the retail outlets**     

Any law enforcement officer or any other person who visits a retail shop with court orders requesting for subscriber information should be directed to have physical orders submitted to Legal and Secretarial Services Department, Safaricom Headquarters.   

Any law enforcement agency, or anyone visiting retail shop with a warrant (police bond or a witness summon) for court appearance should not be received under any circumstance, the individual serving the same should be directed to Legal and Secretarial Services Department.   

Any court document to be served upon Safaricom must not be received at any other location but Safaricom HQ, Legal. Shop staff must not accept any court papers. They should advise the third parties to serve the papers at Safaricom HQ Legal.   

Any court papers thrown or abandoned in the Shops must immediately be forwarded to Legal.  A forward e-mail of the documents should be sent to

LegalServicesDept@Safaricom.co.ke.  

Safaricom will only provide call data for a period of 90 days preceding the current date.

**Subscriber Registration KYC Collection**

# **Definition**

This a process where Safaricom customers are required to verify their SIM Registration documents by clicking on [https://bit.ly/37RIJFG](https://bit.ly/37RIJFG) or visiting any Safaricom outlets countrywide. This is in line with Communication Authority guidelines.

The following two services are used.

·       A USSD based Number Query Solution that enables customers to query all phone numbers registered under their document IDs - This service is only accessible through the customer’s Primary number.

·       An enhancement on the Subscriber Registration App which allows Retail Agents/ Dealers and Agent Points to collect customer KYC data.

# **Eligibility**

It is eligible to all Safaricom customers with registered lines.

# **SIM Registration Update Requirements**

The following will be required.

·       Identification Document used during Registration (Original)

·       Customer’s signature

**Journey**

Customers will receive a CVM message from Safaricom guiding them on how to query the numbers registered under their IDs through a USSD Service (\*106#) or through the Safaricom online assistant, Zuri. This SMS blasts will be sent to the customers in a phased approach.

**Call Centre**

Where a customer calls for assistance:

·       Guide the customer through the USSD (\*106) service or Safaricom Zuri so that they can do it for themselves.

·       If the customer has attempted to self-serve but still gets an error, kindly direct the customer to the nearest Shop or Care desk.

**Retail**

Where a customer visits for assistance:

·       Guide the customer through the USSD (\*106) service so that they can do it for themselves.

·       Where the customer would like to change their primary number - Confirm line ownership on Partner App, CRM and MPESA G2 and use the current process for change of Primary number (excerpt below from Subscriber Registration & Management Procedure).

·       Please note all Retail CEEs have been granted access to complete Primary Number Change requests going forward.

·       Proceed to upload the customer details on the Sub Reg App under the Existing Customer button (For KYC Collection)

**Safaricom Zuri**

Customer initiates a chat with Zuri & selects option 8“Sim Registration Update.”

·       They’re then requested to enter their number or select it if they’re already authenticated on Zuri.

·       Once they enter or select their number, if compliant Zuri informs them that their registration details are in line with government regulations but if not, they’re offered the “Find a Shop menu” to find the nearest Care desk/Safaricom Shop to have their details updated.

**Note:**

·       As per the direction provided by the regulator regarding the requirements for SIM Registration, going forward the agents will **NOT** be required to collect the customer photo as part of the SIM Registration process.

·       The agent will be required to update the Sub Reg App to get the new functionality that allows the update of customer’s details for an existing customer. Kindly advise the enquiring agents/dealers to update their Sub-Reg App as follows.

o   **Those using Play-store** to go to Play store and update.

o   **Those using Mobi-go** will be prompted to update.

**Email Team**

·       When a customer Emails to request for an update.

·       Any change on document type, document number or names should be effected via a Pre2Pre or Post2Post order so that it updates on Partner App.

·       Attach on Siebel the customer’s email and all documentation shared for each modification done.

·       All escalations to M-PESA AML must have customer’s number and all necessary attachments.

Below are some of the issues and their guidelines.

| ISSUE | GUIDE |
| --- | --- |
| Change of ID to passport/passport to ID | Proceed and change the document as per the customers preference then request customer to self-update. |
| Change from Alien ID to passport | Proceed and change the document as per the customers preference then request customer to self-update. |
| Customer with expired documents i.e alien ID or passport but do not have new one | In case the customer has a copy of the expired ID/Passport the customer can use the same to self-update. If not, request customer to share the expired doc and waiting slip/card. The team will attach the expired document and the waiting card/slip on Partner App. They will then share the same details with M-PESAAML team via email for validation. |
| Customer who has lost the document used to register the line but wants to update to a new document e.g., passport. | The team will confirm that the names match then proceed and change the document. Then request customer to self-update. |
| Change from Expired Alien ID to foreigner ID. This only applies to East Africa community | The team will attach the expired document and Foreigners ID on Partner App then share the details with M-PESAAML team for validation and approval. |
| Customer with dual citizenship - wants to change from Kenyan passport to foreigner passport | The team to proceed and change the document as per the customers preference then request customer to self-update. |
| Where a customer is holding a waiting card/document for ID/Passport but has no copy of previous ID/Passport | Team will attach waiting card/slip on Partner App and share the details with Mpesa AML team for validation. |
| Where registered document is defaced hence customer is not able to update while roaming | The team will attach waiting card/slip on Partner App and share the details with Mpesa AML team for validation. |
| Mismatched names on the previous document with what the customer wants us to update to e.g., maiden/sir name | The team will vet and confirm that the details are those of the same customer then update the names via a CRM order. Customer will then be advised to self-update.NB: Use SIM swap vetting |
| KYC update where registered owner is deceased | Customer can update if they still hold deceased person’s ID. If not, the team will attach the death certificate on Partner App then share the details with Mpesa AML team for validation. |
| Customer roaming but line is in the country (Kenya) and wants documents details to be updated | Customer can request a 3rd party to update on their behalf. with the current registered document. |
| Customer that are roaming in countries without roaming partnership hence cannot receive OTP | The team will attach the documents on Partner App and share the details with Mpesa AML team for validation.NB: The team will be empowered with KYC app access to be able to update for the customers. Meanwhile we will escalate to M-PESA AML. |
| M-PESA registered numbers where we have effected a change in document ID during KYC update. | Update both Siebel and M-PESA to avoid details mismatch. |
| Customer has corrected document but still getting error on updating | The team will do all necessary checks to confirm that on Partner App the order of names is correct, document type and number are correct, no spaces before or after the details. If all ok escalate to M-PESA AML. |

# **How it works**

·       The customer will know that they need to update details by dialing \*106# and select option number1 to check Registration status. Alternatively, the customer can log onto My Safaricom App and check the registration status under My Account.

·       For the customer to know the numbers registered under his/her ID, Dial \*106# and access option 1: Check Registration Status, to get a view of status and numbers registered under the ID.

·       Once a customer dials \*106# and confirms they are compliant, they do not need to visit the shop.

·       If not compliant, the customer needs to carry an original ID for scanning at Safaricom agent or Safaricom Shop or upload Original ID photo by clicking on [https://www.safaricom.com/account/kyc-upload](https://www.safaricom.com/account/kyc-upload) and follow the simple steps.

·       The update process takes about 3 minutes to complete at the Safaricom Outlet. The agent will scan the original Identification document used during registration which will be captured in the system together with customer’s signature to complete SIM registration process.

·       If mobile numbers are not identified during the sim registration process, they will be retained, and their registration verified. If not claimed within the next 30 days, the lines will be recycled.

·       If a customer did not register line using National ID but a different registration document, update will be done based on the registration document used for registration of the line. This includes Alien ID, Military ID, or Passports.

·       Where the line was registered using another person’s ID, the registered subscriber can verify their Original ID details by clicking on [https://www.safaricom.com/account/kyc-upload](https://www.safaricom.com/account/kyc-upload) and follow the simple steps.

o   Should the customer wish to have the Registration details under his/her ID, the old and the new customer can visit the nearest shop with their original IDs and request ownership of the line to be transferred.

·       An agent will only be able capture customer’s details once. Once the agent or Self Sim verification link has collected all customer’s details, the system will forward the details to Safaricom for checks and validations. The customer can Dial \*106# to check the status of the registration at any time.

·       In case wrong details are captured (mobile number and ID) during the registration update process, The agent will get a prompt from the system requesting them to capture the correct details.

·       The customer can know that the captured details are okay by dialing \*106# and select option 1.

·       In cases where the customer is out of the country, they can contact customercare@safaricom.co.ke for further assistance or use our online portal to self-update their sim registration using Original ID details by clicking on [https://www.safaricom.com/account/kyc-upload](https://www.safaricom.com/account/kyc-upload) and follow the simple steps.

·       If the customer’s line is blocked, he/she will not be able to use the line until verification of registration status is done by submitting the Identification Document used during Registration (Original) in a retail shop.

·       This can be done at a Safaricom outlet or on the online portal by clicking on [https://www.safaricom.com/account/kyc-upload](https://www.safaricom.com/account/kyc-upload) and follow the simple steps.

# **Change of customer name (Prepaid lines)**   

This process refers to guidelines for change of customer names for either individuals or companies. This would apply for various reasons i.e. change in marital status, change of religion, etc. for individuals or change of company name for corporates / companies.   

CEE’s will request customer for a written request as per vetting process, indicating the new names.   

For Individuals CEE will request customer to represent the following: -   

i.         Affidavit

ii.         Original ID 

iii.         Copy of old ID (where available)   

For corporates will request customer to represent the following: -   

i.         Certificate of change of names 

ii.         Original or copy of PIN certificate

iii.         Original ID of the person submitting request  

iv.         Letter from the company requesting for change in names.   

CEE will proceed to change to the customer names upon validation of documents presented and vetting of customer as per the vetting procedure.   

CEE must raise an interaction indicating action taken and attach customers request and other relevant documents and order relate attachment to the interaction raised.   

The hard copies of the customer request are filed as per the filing procedures.

[Screenshot] 

**See attachment for more details**

**Change of Ownership Process**

All change of ownership requests will be processed at the Retail Center/care desks. The request is presented by either:

      i.         The Registered Owner (donor) together with the Beneficiary (New owner),

or

     ii.         The Beneficiary (New Owner) alone.

**NOTE:**

- All requests will be channeled to Retail shops/care desks.
- If the customer already visited Retail and made the request but M-Shwari and/or KCB M-PESA account details still belong to the previous owner, CEE will raise an SR and quote the previous SR that was used to change M-PESA details. Before raising the SR ensure the customer has no account/loan balances.

# **i.     The Registered Owner (donor) together with the Beneficiary (New owner)**

·       The currently registered owner must be accompanied by new owner.

·       The CEE will advise the current owner that this change discharges Safaricom from any liability relating to transfer.

·       Where the request includes line change of ownership, the Subscriber change of ownership process will apply, followed by the M-PESA change of details.

·       The current owner must present: -

# **Zidisha Plus Beneficiaries FAQ’s**

**Who is a beneficiary?**

A beneficiary is an individual who receives resources provided by another person, referred to as the

sponsor. The sponsor in this case directly purchases Zidisha resources to the beneficiary’s designated

number.

**How do I add a beneficiary?**

To add a beneficiary, follow these steps:

·       Dial \*485#.

·       Select Zidisha Plus.

·       Choose Add Beneficiary.

·       Enter the beneficiary's phone number and name, then press Send.

Once completed, you will receive a confirmation message confirming the successful addition of the beneficiary's name and number to your list.

**How do I remove a beneficiary**

To remove a beneficiary, follow these steps:

·       Dial \*485#.

·       Select Zidisha Plus.

·       Choose Remove Beneficiary.

·       Select the beneficiary then press Send.

After completing these steps, you will receive a confirmation message confirming the successful removal of the beneficiary's name and number from your list.

**What is the maximum number of beneficiaries I can have?**

As a donor, you can have a maximum of 15 beneficiaries.

**As a beneficiary, can I sambaza my resources?**

No, you will not be able to Sambaza your resources.

**What is the validity period of beneficiary resources, Do the resources expire?**

The validity period is 7 days for the weekly bundles and 30 days for the monthly bundles. The resources

will then expire if not used within their respective validity periods.

**As a beneficiary, can I top up Zidisha resources once I exhaust them?**

Yes, to purchase resources, simply dial \*485# and select Zidisha Plus. Follow the prompts to confirm

your purchase by making the payment. Once completed, you will immediately receive your allocated

resources.

**How will I pay for resources once I’ve exhausted my beneficiary resources?**

You can pay for additional resources using either Airtime or M-PESA**.**

**What happens if I do not use my bundles before the validity period ends?**

Unused resources will not roll over. Both voice and data bundles will expire after the validity period: 30

days for monthly plans and 7 days for weekly plans.

**As a beneficiary, will I still get access to support services?**

Yes, you can access support through the following channels:

• For prepaid services, dial 100.

• For postpaid services, dial 200.

You can also send an email to [**business@safaricom.co.ke**](mailto:business@safaricom.co.ke)**.**

A CEE receiving a call from a customer requesting for a reversal to funds sent to Airtel will confirm the transaction status as below.

The transaction is not more than 28 days old. If the transaction is older than 28 days, they will advise the customer that is not possible to reverse such a transaction.

If the transaction failed or is completed by checking under the M-PESA Interoperability VBC as below.

**For a successful transaction****,** the Receiver Receipt Number column will have a numeric value, and the transaction comments status will indicate “Success” as below:

 [Screenshot]  

**For failed transactions,** the Receiver Receipt Number column will be empty or have an invalid number and the status under transaction comments will indicate “**Fail**” or **'Remote host terminated the handshake**' as shown in the samples below:

 [Screenshot] 

 [Screenshot] 

 [Screenshot] 

If transaction failed - advise the customer that the transaction will be reversed by the **end of the following day**.  **DO NOT** raise an SR.

If transaction was successful –raise a reversal request SR and advise customer on the 72hrs SLA.

- Upon receiving the SR, the Analyst will query transaction ID on M-PESA to confirm it is an Airtel Money transaction and transaction date.
- Analyst will then query the M-PESA transaction ID on the Airtel interop statement of corresponding date and capture the Receiver ID/Receiver Receipt.
- Analyst will then query the Receiver ID on the Airtel Portal. This will allow analyst to initiate the reversal when funds are sufficient. In case of insufficient funds, the system response will indicate as such. There are also other responses populated for the scenarios below: - **when the recipient account is suspended/recycled, when the transaction is over 28 days old & when the transaction has already been initiated/reversed.**
- Once the reversal has been successfully initiated on the Airtel portal, analyst will capture Amount, M-PESA transaction ID, Sender MSISDN, Receiver MSISDN, Receiver ID and send this information to Airtel.
- Airtel will reverse the funds where funds are available and send back a list with the reversed transactions.

- The Analyst will share the reversed transactions to Airtel finance for the M-PESA TIDs to be attached.

- The Call Centre Support Analyst will reverse the transactions on M-PESA system and have another Call Centre Support Analyst complete the transactions.

# **Deposit Reversal Process.**

This is the process by which an M-PESA agent requests for a reversal of a deposit transaction done on their Till.

Deposit Reversals will only be initiated within **24 hours** of the Deposit. Once the 24 hours have lapsed, the agent will be requested to follow up with the customer and / or report to Police.

# **Deposit Reversal Mechanics.**

All reversed transactions will be completed within 2hrs.

All deposit reversals will go through maker checker process where Reversal Admin team will call back the two parties to confirm.

All transactions initiated after 4pm, will be completed the following day from 9am.

# **Agents can request reversal via:**

Self Reversal via 2530 (ref Article DSMP-0008: Partner Support - DEALER REVERSALS).

Contacting the call centre through the available channels.

Visiting the RC for assistance.

# **Reasons for reversal:**

Wrong amount.

Wrong number (not reversible).

Customer line (Recipient) is Suspended.

Fraud Occurrence.

# **Wrong Amount.**

Confirm the transaction has been done within the last **24 hours.**

For all Customer Deposit Transactions older than **24 hours**, the CEE will advise the agent to liaise with recipient or report to Police to resolve any dispute.

If the deposit reversal is requested within 24hrs, the CEE shall proceed to initiate the reversal and advise the agent to wait for 2hrs.

The SLA for all Deposit reversals is **2hrs.** For reversals initiated past 4PM the 2hrs SLA runs from 9AM the next day. 

If the reversal was initiated before and cancelled due to a dispute, **DO NOT** reinitiate it, advise the agent as per notes and to follow up with recipient or Police.

Where funds have been utilized, **CEE shall NOT disclose to Party A how Party B has utilized the funds received.**

**Do NOT suspend or add a state tag** on customers account due to insufficient funds but advise the agent to follow up with the recipient or report to the Police for assistance.

# **Wrong Number.**

Multi factor authentication prevents wrong number deposits. An M-PESA Agent must enter the Customer’s correct ID number to deposit funds.

Hence deposit reversals to wrong numbers **will not be permitted**. The CEE will advise agent advised to follow up with customer if they have their contacts or report to Police. Please not we do not issue customers number due to Data privacy.

# **Fraud Occurrence.**

Fraud Cases (for example, where the Agent was drugged, robbed at gunpoint, deposit done under duress, etc.)

Agents can report fraud cases freely (even after the 24-hour limit for deposit reversals has lapsed). The CEE shall initiate the reversal if funds still available and capture an interaction under **Fraud Money Lost** and raise a Fraud Escalations SR as per article:

**FDCO-0002:** [**CUSTOMER REPORTING FRAUD GUIDELINES**](https://sakahub.safaricom.co.ke/app/article/2fdb42ca-7f98-431d-98f3-d5893bef41e7)

# **Customer line (Recipient) is Suspended.**

Where **M-PESA account is suspended/frozen,** unsuspend, initiate the reversal, return the suspension, except for Fraud Tag / reasons and Court cases where we don’t touch the funds.  

The **CEE shall NOT** disclose to the agent the reason for suspension. 

# **Vetting – Agent Calling:**

When an agent calls for assistance, vet on the following parameters:

- Full names of the Till Operator
- Operator ID of the Till Operator
- National ID number of the Till Operator

Upon successful vetting,

The CEE shall query the customer number on M-PESA G3.

Confirm the transaction to be reversed.

Confirm the transaction has been done within the last **24 hours**. For all transactions older than 24 hours the CEE will advise agent advised to follow up with customer if they have their contacts or report to Police. Please not we do not issue customers number due to Data privacy.

# **Vetting – Recipient (Customer) Calling:**

CEE will query the customer number on M-PESA G3.

Confirm ownership of the line using the Customer Name as per M-PESA system. The CEE can accept if the customer gives 2 correct names.

Confirm the transaction to be reversed.

Confirm the transaction has been done within the last **24 hours** the CEE shall advise the customer they can withdraw the funds from the agent.

# **Deposit Reversal Completion**

The reversal admin team shall then call the customer to confirm (**P2P reversal process applies, with most reversals being done by auto-dialer. Ref Articles:**

If the customer consents, the reversal shall be completed, both agent and customer shall be notified via the automated SMS.

articleTitle: Customer Support for Reversals at Retail
markdownContent:
# **Reversal Request at Retail**

**P2P Reversals**

If a customer walks into a Retail Shop requesting for a reversal.

CEE will query the customer number on M-PESA G3

Confirm the transaction to be reversed.

Confirm the transaction has been done within the last **30 days**. For all transactions older than **30 days** the CEE will advise the customer to liaise with recipient or police to resolve any dispute.

CEE will query the recipient’s mobile number from [**LIPA FARE Na M-PESA Link**](http://172.29.127.27:14000/). Where the mobile number exists on the link, it will indicate; **Reversal** **not allowed: 07XXXXXXXX - is in conductor's list** the CEE will decline the reversal and advise the customer to contact the recipient. This is to safeguard the matatu conductors (Lipa Fare na M-PESA) against the possibility of malicious reversals once the fares have been paid. Alternatively, advice customer to use Pochi La Biashara.

CEE will initiate the reversal and call the recipient to seek consent.

Where consent is given the CEE will complete the reversal and capture on notes that recipient gave consent and quote the recipient’s number.

If the recipient disputes, is unreachable or does not pick the call, the CEE will initiate the reversal and advise the customer on 2hrs SLA.

The above transactions will be picked by dialer for more checks by the reversal admin team at the call center for actioning.

Where part of the funds is used by the recipient, the CEE will do partial reversal of the available funds and advise the customer accordingly. This can only be done once per transaction.

If a reversal transaction is past SLA, the CEE will reference to the email sent from Retail Leadership team, giving the Reversal Folder Lead to be contacted.

The CEE shall advise the customer as per the feedback received from the reversals team.

# **Funds** **transferred** **to M-Shwari or KCB M-PESA.**

If the amount received was transferred within our ecosystem i.e. M-Shwari or KCB M-PESA, the CEE shall do as below;

Call the customer and advise them to transfer the funds back to M-PESA to facilitate the reversal.

If the customer does not pick, send message below;

***Jambo***, ***we are trying to reach you regarding the reversal request for transaction XXXXXXX that was transferred to M-Shwari/KCB M-PESA. Kindly answer. Thank you.’’***

Call the customer again after 5 minutes.

If the customer does not pick, Tag the account, put clear notes on the interactions with the reason for tagging and notify the customer via a message as below;

***Jambo***, ***your account is suspended due to a reversal request for transaction XXXXXXX that was transferred to M-Shwari. Visit any Safaricom shop for assistance.***

***Jambo***, ***your account is suspended due to a reversal request for transaction XXXXXXX that was transferred to KCB M-PESA. Visit any Safaricom shop for assistance.***

CEE will educate the customer on Hakikisha, Safaricom app and MPESA app.

**NOTE:** Where funds have been utilized, CEE shall **NOT** disclose to Party A how party B has utilized the funds received.

If the amount is available for reversal, initiate a reversal and Do **NOT** put a state Tag on the customer’s account.

# **Withdrawal Past SLA at** **The Retail:**

Query the number seeking assistance on CRM.

Confirm whether the line has key comment forbidding a withdrawal reversal if so, **Do not initiate a reversal.**

Confirm if the customer has more than 2 previous reversal disagreement SRs if so, **Do not initiate a reversal.**

Query the customer number on M-PESA G3 and confirm ownership of the line using the Customer Names as per M-PESA system. The CEE can accept if the customer gives 2 correct names.

Confirm the transaction to be reversed has been done within the last **30 days**. For all transactions older than **30 days** the CEE will advise the customer to liaise with the agent or police to resolve any dispute.

**Check for cancelled transaction.** Drill down to the linked transaction where the same transaction has been cancelled before, confirm the reason for cancellation and advise the customer as per the reason given in the notes/comments field.

***DO NOT re-initiate a reversal for an already cancelled transaction.***

Initiate the reversal and advise on the 12 hours SLA.

In case the reversal declines because of insufficient funds at the agent till, kindly raise an SR indicating the receipt number as below and advice the customer on the SLA of 24 hrs.

**SR**

**Category:** M-PESA SERVICES

**Item:** Reversal Transaction

**Type:** No funds at M-PESA agent dealer

# **Reversal Disagreement at The Retail:**

Query the transaction on MPESA G3

Refer to the notes captured when the reversal was cancelled.

Where the reversal was cancelled because the customer and agent were at the same location or agent insists that customer was given cash, advise the customer to report to police for follow up.

Confirm the status of the **SR:**

Closed SR; advise as per resolution.

Within SLA, advise customer on SLA.

Past SLA; escalate via email to SR owner and copy ccsmpesa@Safaricom.co.ke

Educate the customer on Hakikisha, Safaricom app and Mpesa app.

# **Wrong Deposits and Direct Deposit at the retail**

Query the MPESA agent on G3 using Agent number and agent assistant ID and vet as below:

Agent name

Agent national id

Confirm the transaction to be reversed is not older than 30days.If older than 30days advise the agent to liaise with the customer or report to the police.

Initiate the reversal and advise the agent the funds will be available immediately.

In case the reversal fails because of insufficient funds, check the available balance on the wrong recipient account and initiate a partial reversal and advise accordingly.

If the money is already withdrawn, apologize and advise the MPESA agent to follow up with the customer or report to the police.

Guide the MPESA agent on 2530 reversal DIY. If the agent has any challenge with it kindly **raise an SR** indicating the store number (given by the admin) and the agent code.

**Definition**

Vybcall is a unique service that allows Safaricom customers to set a **video** as their ringback tone, replacing the standard ringing sound with engaging visual content. This means that instead of hearing a tone, callers will see a video while waiting for their call to be answered.

# **How It Works**

Customers can access the service through the **Vybcall platform** at [vybcall.safaricom.com](http://vybcall.safaricom.com). 
To enjoy all features, users must have a **smartphone that supports VoLTE** and is compatible with the Vybcall service.

Once subscribed, users can:

- Choose videos to entertain callers.
- Enjoy video playback even when calling non-Vybcall users, through the “My Vybcall” feature.

# **Supported Devices**

Currently, Vybcall works on select **Android smartphones**, including:

- Samsung Galaxy S24
- Tecno Spark 20 Pro+
- Neon Ray Ultra
- Neon Smarta / Smarta 137E
- Neon Ultra2
- Infinix Hot 50
- Redmi Note 14 Pro / Note 13 Pro
- Tecno Spark GO

*More devices will be added soon. iOS devices are not supported at this time.*

# **Subscription and Pricing**

The service costs **Ksh 3 per day** and **auto-renews daily**. 
Payment is made conveniently through airtime.

# **My Vybcall Feature**

The **My Vybcall** feature lets you enjoy your selected or system-recommended videos even when the person you’re calling:

- Is not a Vybcall user, or
- Has a device that doesn’t support the service.

This ensures you can still experience Vybcall’s visual entertainment.

**Eligibility**

The service is available to **all Safaricom customers** with compatible devices.

**How to Unsubscribe**

Customers can unsubscribe at any time using any of the following options:

- Through the **Vybcall platform**
- By sending **‘UNSUB’** to **860**
- By dialing \***860#**

# **Data Charges**

Using the Vybcall service does **not incur any data charges**. Enjoy the videos without worrying about data consumption.

# **Default Tune**

When you first join Vybcall, you’ll receive **default video content** for free. This allows you to experience the service before selecting your preferred videos. 
Once you subscribe or set your chosen content, the default video will be automatically replaced.

- **Transfer:** The bundle resources are not transferable
- **Usage:** The outgoing voice minutes can be used when calling back home and when calling any of the partner networks
- **Destination:** SMS resources can be used to send text messages to any destination
- **Renewable:** The bundles are not auto renewable.

# **USSD ROAMING CALL BACK (UCB) SERVICE**

USSD Roaming Callback is a revolutionary new product that allows customers to make calls at highly discounted rates while roaming. This service is currently on a soft launch.

**ELIGIBILIT****Y**

The service is the first of its kind in the market and is open to both Prepay and Post-pay customers.

# **Eligible** **countries:**

The product has also been limited to US/Canada, Italy, UK, Saudi Arabia, South Sudan, Somalia, UAE, China, Djibouti, Thailand, and Ethiopia during this period. The service is only available for Post-pay customers in China, Djibouti, Thailand, and Ethiopia

**Roaming cost:** This service allows subscribers access to the roaming voice service at a fraction of the existing roaming costs.

# **Benefits of** **USSD Roaming Call back (UCB)**

- Provide a cheaper calling option for outbound roamers
- Increasing outbound roaming revenues
- Reduce bill shock – perceived inflated roaming bills
- Increase customer delight especially with our roaming proposition
- Position Safaricom as the Roaming services provider of choice.

# **The UCB (USSD Roaming Call back) vs normal roaming rate comparison**

 [Screenshot] 

# **VODAFONE GROUP DISCOUNTED ROAMING RATES**

Telecom operators are continuously exploring ways of making roaming affordable. One such effort is through offering discounts on the IOT’s (Inter Operator Tariffs) chargeable.

**BENEFITS**

The benefits of the discounted low IOT’s are then passed over to the customers through reduced roaming retail tariffs.

**ELIGIBILITY**

The preferential tariff will be applicable to Post-pay roaming and Prepay roaming, where applicable. The discount on voice is limited to.

- Calls within the visited network
- Calls within the country visited.
- Calls back home (Kenya)

**The key features of the product**

- The preferential Voice, SMS and Internet roaming proposition will only be applicable to the 16 countries covered by the Vodafone group of networks.
- The charging currency will be in KSh.
- Charging for telephony (voice) will be per MINUTE, SMS will be billed per event and GPRS/Internet Usage per MB with charging increments of 10KB.
- All other business rules for Prepay and Post-Pay roaming shall apply.

# **Definition**

Safaricom Zuri Voice Bot is an innovative solution that allows customer to use their natural voice to get assisted by a digital assistant \[Voice Bot\]

The solution uses customer utterances to understand customer intent and resolve their issue without speaking to an agent. Its is a self-service channel.

# **Eligibility**

Only Tech savvy customers are whitelisted to access the solution.

Later Zuri Voice Bot will be rolled out to other Safaricom customer segments.

# **How to access Safaricom Zuri Voice Bot**

To access Safaricom Voice Bot, a customer will dial 100 and speak to the Zuri Voice Bot, they will be required to say any issue they need assistance on and this will direct the customer to the journey that provides an answer to the query.

# **Languages available on Safaricom Zuri Voice Bot**

Currently Zuri is only available in English. Sheng is not available at the moment. Kiswahili language will be provided later.

# **Services accessible on Safaricom Zuri Voice Bot**

- M-Shwari services
- Fuliza services
- Stop Premium Messages
- Stop promotional Messages.
- Get M-PESA PIN

# **Benefits of Safaricom Zuri Voice Bot to the customer**

Safaricom Zuri Voice Bot enables a customer to access Self services anytime without having to speak to an agent. The Voice Bot is readily available intelligent and friendly thus improving customer experience.

# **Security**

Zuri Voice Bot is secure just like any other Safaricom services. On a need basis, some services will be validated using ID or M-PESA PIN to ensure we safeguard our customers against Fraud.

articleTitle: DIY procedures of using Facebook and Facebook Free Mode
markdownContent:
# **Uploading Photos on Facebook**

- At the top of your Facebook news feed or profile page, click the **Photo/Video** option below "Create Post".
- click the **Upload Photos/Video** option
- Select the photos you want to upload and click Open.
- Tag people, if desired, by hovering over the photo, selecting **Tag** and then typing their names. The photo appears on their news feed and appears to their friends or only your mutual friends, depending on the privacy preferences you each selected.
- Edit the photo, if desired, by hovering over the photo and clicking the Edit button.
- Click the Story option if you want to check in at a specific location.
- Choose your audience and click **Share**
- Select **Public** if you want anyone to see the photo. Otherwise, you can select **Friends** or specific people to see the photo or select people who cannot see the photo.

# **Viewing Photos on Facebook**

- Click in the top right of Facebook. Select Settings & Privacy > Activity Log.
- In the top left of your activity log, click Filter.
- Scroll to Photos & Videos and click the circle to select.

# **Making Photos Private**

- Go to your profile. Click your name in the top-right side of the **Facebook** page.
- Click the **Photos** tab. You'll find this below the cover **photo** that's at the top of your **Facebook** page.
- Select a **photo** category
- Select a **photo**.
- Click the "Privacy" icon. ...
- Click More.
- Click Only Me.

# **Writing on a Wall of Facebook**

- Type your **Facebook** post in the “What's on Your Mind” box that appears at the top of any page.
- Include the name of the member whose **wall** you wish to **write** on, preceded by the “@” key. Select the friend from the resulting drop-down list.
- Click the “Post” button.

# **Updating Status**

- Click in the What’s on Your Mind field of the Share box.
- Type your comment/thought/status.
- (Optional) Click the person icon in the bottom gray bar of the Share box to add tags to your post.
- (Optional) Click the location pin icon to add a location.
- (Optional) Click the smiley face icon to add info about what you’re doing, interacting with, or feeling.
- (Optional) Click the audience menu in the bottom-right corner to change who can see this post.
- Click Post.

# **Viewing Inbox on Facebook Messenger**

- Open your **Facebook** home page in your browser so that you can **see** the newsfeed
- Click Messenger in the list on the left of the page, just below your name and profile image.
- This opens your main Facebook Messenger inbox.

# **Writing a Note on Facebook**

- Go to your Profile.
- In the left side menu, click the header entitled Apps. ...
- Click the Write a Note button at the upper right of the page. ...
- In the Title field, type the title of your Note.
- In the Body field, start writing about whatever interests you.
- Tag friends who appear in your note by typing their names into the Tags field
- Click the Add a Photo link to add photos.
- Choose who can see your note using the Privacy drop-down menu.
- After you finish writing, click Preview to view what your note will look like when published. Or click Save Draft if you want to come back to the Note later.
- When you’re happy with your Note, click Publish.

# **Facebook SMS**

**Facebook** has adopted **SMS** to allow users to receive and respond to notifications they receive through status updates, comments, private messages or changes with a profile in real-time..

**Activating Facebook SMS**

Go to your device settings. Tap Notifications > Applications > Facebook > Notifications. Turn on or off notifications from Facebook.

**Deactivating Facebook SMS**

- Open Facebook Messenger.
- Tap profile icon in the top right corner.
- Tap SMS.
- Tap On.
- Tap TURN OFF SMS.
- Change SMS app to Android Messages.

# **Facebook Code**

- Code Generator is a security feature for your Facebook app used with two-factor authentication.
- When you turn it on, your phone will generate a special security code that you can use to verify it's you when you log in from a new device or browser.
- If you're receiving a text message with a code of numbers, it could mean someone is trying to access your account. We send confirmation codes when someone has login approvals turned on.
- If you've turned on two-factor authentication, there are several ways you can get your security code or approve your login attempt:

You can use a six-digit text message (SMS) code sent to your mobile phone.

With a security code from your Code Generator.

By tapping your security key on a compatible device.

# **Unable to receive Facebook Code**

- Common internet errors (e.g. the use of "www" in an email address) or even entering the incorrect email address may be the cause of this issue.
- If this is the case, **Facebook** provides a form for users to submit to fix the issue.
- Once submitted, **Facebook** will resend your **code** to the correct address.

# **Retrieving Facebook two factor authentication**

- Go to Settings > Security and Login.
- Under the Two-Factor Authentication section, click Use two-factor authentication. You may need to re-enter your password.
- Next to Recovery Codes, click Setup then Get Codes. If you’ve already set up recovery codes, you can click Show Codes

# **Recovering Facebook without two-factor authentication**

- You may be able to get back into your Facebook account by using an alternate email or mobile phone number listed on your account.
- Reset Facebook account password. One of the simplest ways to bypass Facebook account authentication is by simply resetting the account password.
- Using third-party to login Facebook.
- Access Facebook account from recognized locations.

# **Unauthorized Facebook Login**

You may get some clue from the Activity Log.

- Go to Settings | Your Facebook Information.
- Click on Activity Log section.
- From the activity log you may be able to guess who the perpetrator might have been.
- The log off all the unauthorized logins.

# **How to use Facebook free mode** **(A\*\*\*\*)**

# **Accessing Facebook Free mode**

To access Facebook Free Mode, customers can go to facebook.com using a mobile browser or alternatively, customers can access Facebook Free Mode through the Facebook Android app.

# **Viewing the full Facebook experience**

- A customer can view the full Facebook experience with photos and videos by clicking on “See Photos” button, which switches you to Data Mode. Keep in mind that standard data charges will apply.
- A customer can go back to Free Mode anytime by clicking the “Go to Free” button.
- When switching between Free mode to Data mode, customers have the opportunity of purchasing data bundles while browsing.

# **Bundles to purchase on Facebook**

| Amount (ksh) | Expiry Bundles | Non Expiry Bundles |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 5 | None | 10MB |
| 10 | Daily 15MB +15SMS | 20MB |
| 15 | None | 52MB |
| 20 | Daily 50MB +50SMS | 70MB |
| 50 | Daily 150MB+150SMS | None |

# **Data Bundle Purchase Journey**

- Go to Data Mode click Buy Data
- Click on Get data pack
- Confirm Purchase
- Select Payment Mode and follow prompts

# **Payment Options**

**Customers can purchase the data bundles via Airtime, M-PESA and Okoa as an alternative mode of payment**

# **Opting out of Facebook Free Mode**

- On the initial screen that invites you to participate, simply click “No Thanks” instead of “Continue.
- To opt-out of Facebook Free Mode: When in Data Mode, click on the “?” next to “Data Mode.”
- Visit your Facebook bookmarks (if using the Facebook Android app) or Facebook menu (if using facebook.com) to opt-out.

While on Facebook App, Tap on **Settings & Privacy**\> **Mobile Center- Safaricom PLC> Safaricom Settings**\> **Opt Out of Basic Mode** **Plus**

**Pictural guide:**

- **Tap on Settings**

 **[Screenshot]**

- **Mobile Center- Safaricom PLC**

 [Screenshot]

- **Safaricom Settings**** [Screenshot] 
 **

- **Opt Out of Basic Mode Plus**

** [Screenshot] 
**

# **Opting back in on Facebook Free Mode**

- If using the Facebook Android app, visit bookmarks within the Facebook app and click “Facebook Free Mode” under Favorites.
- If using facebook.com, go to your Facebook menu and click “Facebook Free Mode” under Favorites.

Restart the Facebook Android App or refresh Facebook on mobile browser. Facebook Free Mode should appear.

markdownContent:
**FINTECH 2.0- M-PESA SYSTEM UPGRADE** **{Call** **Centre Reversals} Manual Guide**

**Description:**

This manual provides step-by-step guidance for {Call Centre CEE} to navigate through M-PESA Reversals on the **Newly Redesigned M-PESA System** (G3).

It is intended to support customer-facing teams in executing accurate and efficient operational standards.

Please refer to the attached guide during the cutover period and going Forward.

**Pesalink**

**Definition**

Pesalink is a service that allows M-PESA registered users to easily send money in real-time from their M-PESA account to bank accounts within Kenya. You can access this service through the Pesalink Mini-App on M-PESA App.

**Eligibility**

Pesalink is available to all M-PESA registered customers who have downloaded the M-PESA App.

**Benefits of Pesalink**

**Seamless experience**: Enter the recipient's bank and account number without needing to remember any Paybill numbers.

**Hakikisha**: Pesalink displays the recipient’s account name for verification, ensuring you send money to the correct person.

**Higher transaction limits**: Send up to KSh 500,000 in one simple transaction.

**Save Beneficiaries List**: Save the bank details of your frequent recipients to make future transfers faster and easier.

**How to Activate Pesalink on M-PESA**

Pesalink is automatically available to all M-PESA users. There is no need for additional registration or activation.  However, the recipient of funds must have an active bank account in Kenya to receive the transfer.

**Can Pesalink be used to send funds between two M-PESA accounts**

Pesalink cannot be used to send funds between two M-PESA accounts as it can only be used for M-PESA to Bank transfers.

For M-PESA to M-PESA please use the M-PESA Send Money service available on your M-PESA App, Sim Toolkit or \*334#

**Transaction limits for Pesalink**

A customer can send between KSh 250,000 and KSh 500,000 through Pesalink. Transactions below KSh 250,000 or above KSh 500,000 cannot be processed.

Please use the regular mobile banking service on your M-PESA App for values less than Ksh 250,000

**Charges & fees for Pesalink transactions**

A flat fee of KSh 216 applies to transactions between KSh 250,000 and KSh 500,000.

**Increase of M-PESA transaction limit from KSh 250,000 to KSh 500,000**

The Regular MPESA transaction limit remains at KSh 250,000 per transaction.

The KSh 500,000 limit per transaction only applies to Pesalink service.

**Exhaustion of M-PESA daily limit of KSh 500,000**

The M-PESA daily limit remains. Once the customer sends KSh 500,000 from Pesalink, their daily limit will be exhausted and cannot perform any debit transaction until the following day from midnight.

**NOTE:** This limit does not prevent the customer from receiving funds in their M-PESA.

**Channels for accessing Pesalink**

Pesalink is available exclusively through the M-PESA App.

**How It works**

Customers cannot use Fuliza for Pesalink transactions. The customer should make sure they have sufficient M-PESA balance to complete their transfer and pay the transaction fee.

One cannot schedule payments on Pesalink through Ratiba. This service is currently **NOT** available on Pesalink.

For a customer to transfer funds through Pesalink, they must have the recipient Bank Account Number.

**NOTE:** The ability to send using Pesalink ID and recipient phone number will come later.  

**Banks included in the Pesalink rail**

Pesalink currently has 38 banks using the service. You however will not need to memorise the banks, since the list will be provided to you to choose from, when sending funds through the M-PESA or One App.  

**Funds Transfer from Bank to M-PESA using Pesalink**

A customer cannot transfer money from their bank to M-PESA using Pesalink as Pesalink only supports C2B transfers from M-PESA to a bank account.  For Bank to M-PESA please use the mobile banking service offered by your bank.

**How to ensure sure funds are sent to the correct bank account**

After entering the recipient’s bank account details, the name of the account holder will be displayed for your confirmation. Be sure to double-check this before completing the transfer.

To ensure privacy of your account information, no more details will be displayed to the sender beyond this.

**Reversal of funds If sent to wrong bank account or wrong amount**

If funds are sent to the wrong account or wrong amount is sent, the customer shall contact us through the available customer care channels for M-PESA reversals.  Reversal will be possible for the principal amount. The transaction charges will **NOT** be reversed.

**NOTE:** Reversal is possible only where the funds have not been utilized by the recipient. To ensure security of your funds, please confirm the recipient account details and amount before completing the transaction.

For any reversal requests, please raise a Service Request (SR) and inform the customer that the resolution will be provided within 72 hours (SLA).

**Saving of frequent recipient details**

A customer can save the bank account details of their regular recipients, so they don’t have to enter them each time they make a transfer.

**How to contact us for support or more information**

For any queries or support, customers can reach out to Safaricom customer care:

Call: 100 (Prepaid) or 200 (Postpaid)

Email: [customercare@safaricom.co.ke](mailto:customercare@safaricom.co.ke)

Social media: @SafaricomPLC on X and Facebook (Safaricom PLC)

# **Data Plus Bundle**

Data PLUS are data offers that will come bundled with a free additional service of your choice.

We have introduced an additional benefit dubbed Afya cover that allows any one with an active bundle in the event their hospitalized to receive daily case benefits amounting to ksh 500 daily.

# **Free services are available**

- Britam personal accident insurance
- Britam travel insurance
- Britam Afya cover
- TikTok bundle
- YouTube bundle
- Google Maps bundle
- Free games
- 12 hour Boomplay subscription

**Eligibility**

The Data Plus Bundle is available for all prepay, Individual hybrid and Individual post-pay customers. Corporate customers can only buy and use the bundle but will not be eligible to claim reimbursement as the lines are registered under the company name. 

# **Mechanics**

# The Data plus offer will be available on;

- USSD \*544#, customer will select Daily Bundles, Buy for Self then Data Plus Bundles.
- The offers will also be available on the APP and WEB.
- Customers can purchase via airtime for now, but M-PESA option will soon be available.
- Customer can only purchase for self, the data plus offer is not available on “buy for other” data bundle offers.
- The bundle resources are not transferable

Customers can purchase the Data plus offer as many times in a day, but the accident cover will only allow customers to claim once in the event of an accident. 

# **Validity**

The Data plus bundles will have a validity of 24hours, but customers have the option of auto renewing on a daily basis in addition to the one off.

If you select data Afya cover as your benefit you will be insured for 7 days starting from the day of purchase. If you select accident cover or travel insurance the offers are valid for  24-hour and customers will be covered for 36 hours starting from midnight on the day of purchase.

**Customer will have the below options on the Data plus offers**

In addition to the **Free Britam Accident cover**, we have also introduced more free offerings for customers to choose from as per the below table:

 [Screenshot] 

All bundles come with a Free additional benefit valid for 24hours

# **Frequency of Purchase**

A Customer can purchase the Data plus offer as many times in a day, but the accident cover will only allow customers to claim once in the event of an accident.

# **Insurance policy**

**Britam Travel & Personal Accident Cover**

The cover will be activated for 24hours starting midnight of the day of purchase.

| Britam Travel Insurance will have 3 cover benefits namely:Personal Cover In case a customer gets involved in an accident.Loss of checked-in Luggage in case a customer loses baggage that was checked in by a flight operator.Phone liquid damage in case a customer’s phone is damaged because of liquid spillage or immersion into a liquid. |
| --- |

For now, customers will access the Free Britam Travel Insurance benefit under the **Ksh150 =1,800MB** data plus product

See attached Britam Individual Travel FAQ's for more details

**Transfer of the free bundles for google maps**

- The Free google maps bundle will not be transferable and the Free bundle will have highest consumption when customer accesses Google maps.
- The Free bundle can only be used on Google Maps

# **Data Sharing**

Data sharing is a service that allows customers to share their data bundle with their family or friends.

Current shareable bundle accounts are:

**No Expiry** (Neo bundles)

**Monthly/Limited** bundles

**Post-pay** Bundles-Only available from previous accumulation as its no longer available for new purchasers.

One can only add 3 beneficiaries per account selected. A sponsor can therefore add a maximum of 9 beneficiaries; 3 under bundle with expiry, 3 under Monthly and 3 under Post-pay bundle accounts.

# **Eligibility:**

Data Sharing is available to both prepay and post-pay customers.

# **Bundles currently not shareable:**

Go Monthly Post-Pay Data (formerly Post-pay data Revamp)

Emerald Postpay

Corporate Bundles e.g. CVP

Deal of the Day/Month Bundles

All bundles with 24hrs validity

All bundles with Weekly validity

All CVM Bundles (Tunukiwa, Data Deals, 5G bundles, night bundles etc)

Make Ur Bundle data

Data Sambaza Bundles

Daily Allocation Bundles

All Free/Bonus data bundles

All Content bundles e.g. Youtube, TikTok etc.

Easy data bundles

Data Plus bundles

# **To Confirm that data sharing has been successful:**

The Sponsor and the beneficiary will receive a SMS notification when they have successfully been set up.

# **Minimum data bundle that one can share:**

10MB is the minimum amount of data that a sponsor can share but the sponsor must remain with at least 5MBs balance.

# **Maximum data bundle that one can share:**

The maximum amount of data bundle one can share is 5GB per beneficiary per transaction.

# **Validity of the bundle shared:**

The bundle validity is based on the data bundle shared, this can either be a non-expiry data or expiry. The shared bundle maintains the validity as is on the sponsor ac.

# **Mechanics:**

The Sponsor or Recipient can terminate the relationship by selecting the ‘Data sharing’ tab on App or Web then select ‘Remove Beneficiary’- from the Sponsor side and ‘Delete Sponsor’- from the beneficiary side.

# **A Sponsor and beneficiary can view their shared data by:**

By opening the Data Sharing tab on Web/App, the Sponsor/beneficiary will see:

The allocated data bundle shared.

The beneficiary’s data bundle balance for the shared bundle.

# **Priority of data usage:**

The shared data bundle will take priority when the beneficiary is browsing. Once exhausted the beneficiary will receive a notification to browse affordably by buying a bundle.

**Note:**

One can be a beneficiary and still share data that they have purchased.

You cannot share data that has been shared from another sponsor.

A beneficiary can have only one sponsor at a time.

Data sharing is only available to on-net customers.

# **TROUBLESHOOTING GUIDE**

**To Check which bundle type a sponsor has:**

Check under Account Balance on CRM IN DATA

**Recipient has successfully been added on Data Sharing but cannot utilize the resources:**

Confirm that the sponsor has active shareable resources from eligible accounts.

Confirm that the recipient has been added correctly. Search recipient on CRM> click on Data Sharing VBC tab (beneficiary MSISDN is visible under Sponsor view).

Guide the sub accordingly based on the findings, such as to remove the beneficiary and add again correctly.

**Billing and Usage CDRs:**

CDRs are available on the Sponsor’s account on CRM

articleTitle: M-PESA Agent Operators, Registration, Customer Registration
markdownContent:
**Different functions of the M-PESA Agent Primary and Assistant till Operator**

| Assistant Till Operator Rights | Primary Till Operator Rights |
| --- | --- |
| Register M-PESA customer | Activate the till menu |
| Deposit to customer | Create an agent till operator |
| Buy airtime for the customer | Move funds between Working and Float accounts |
| Move funds from Float to Working account | Withdrawal of funds from super agency |
| View store Float account balance | View store Commission, Working and Float account balances |

**Step-by-Step process to confirm the role of an agent assistant**

Query the agent till Under Organization on G2 and Expand.

Select Operator to view all Operator ID and their roles.

A list of all Operator IDs and respective role will be displayed.

**M-PESA Agent Operator Registration**

**NOTE:** The Primary Assistant (Agent Primary till Operator) is the only one who can perform functions such as registering and removing another assistant.

To register a new assistant, the Primary Assistant will do the following:

Go to M-PESA agent menu and select ‘Agent Account’

Choose ‘New Assistant’

New first name – enter the assistant’s first name

New second name – enter the assistant’s middle name if they have one

New last name – enter the assistant’s surname.

New national ID – enter their ID or passport number

New Assistant ID – enter their initial, e.g., JM. If someone with those initials has already been registered to use the same agent phone, then choose another or letter.

Agent ID and PIN – primary assistant enters their own Agent ID and PIN

Await confirmation screen that will display a ‘start key’ and a ‘secret word’ for the new assistant.

**Activating New Assistant on the Agent account**

The assistant will not be able to perform M-PESA transactions until they have changed their PIN.

From M-PESA menu, select ‘Agent Account’.

Select ‘Change PIN’

Enter new agent ID – enter initials.

Enter old PIN – enter the ‘start key’ given in the registration SMS.

Enter new PIN – choose a new -digit PIN.

Confirm new PIN – enter the new PIN again·      

Await confirmation message that reads “Your new PIN has been confirmed.”

**M-PESA Agent Customer Registration**

articleTitle: Fuliza M-PESA Definition, Features and Mechanics
markdownContent:
**Definition**

Fuliza M-PESA is a facility that allows M-PESA customers to complete their M-PESA transactions when they do not have sufficient funds in their M-PESA account.

It is a continuous overdraft service that allows them to complete M-PESA transactions that are within your allocated limit when they have insufficient funds

**Eligibility**

M-PESA customers registered using their national ID/Kenyan passport/Military ID can activate Fuliza but not all are eligible for a loan limit upon activation.

Foreign passport holders cannot successfully opt in to Fuliza.

Recycled lines that previously had Fuliza will be able to opt in after Fuliza recycling is done .Refer to article for opt in errors

A customer may be unable to opt in due to KYC failure if the names on M-PESA are not the same as on the ID. Refer to retail.

When a change of ownership is done, the old customer should be requested to opt out after which the retail CEE should raise an Sr for Fuliza recycling to be done.

Opt in error when a customer does not have the correct provisioning product. Cee should NOT RAISE SR buy add product as per attached document.

**Services Available on Fuliza**

A customer can request Fuliza as many times as long as it is within the allocated limit.

The services that can be transacted using Fuliza are:

Send Money to registered M-PESA customers.

Lipa Na M-PESA: Buy goods and Paybill.

Buy airtime for yourself and others via USSD and STK channels (M-PESA APP and My Safaricom App will be introduced soon)

Buy Bundles - Bundles that can be purchased using Fuliza: All daily, weekly, and monthly data-only plan bundles.

Fuliza limit can be withdrawn or used for withdrawal transactions.

# **Below services can be accessed using FULIZA**

**Bundles Exempted from Fuliza**

Integrated monthly plan bundles.

Tunukiwa bundles and all discounted data deals bundles.

Bundles WITH NO EXPIRY (NEO bundles)

**Customer Journey**

The prepay bundle purchase journey remains unchanged.

**The services that cannot be transacted on Fuliza are.**

Pay loans.

**NOTE:** All M-PESA transaction amounts apply (i.e., minimum, or maximum) if it is within the M-PESA limits and Fuliza limit.

# **Fuliza Charges**

A customer will be charged a one-off 1% access fee for every Fuliza drawn.

Daily maintenance fee (that includes 20% excise duty) is applied the next day at midnight based on the outstanding Fuliza balance. Check below table for the daily charges. 

Customers with outstanding FULIZA balances of Ksh 1000 and below enjoy 48 hrs grace period . During this grace period, the daily maintenance fee does not apply. The waiver is only on daily maintenance fee and no access fee.

A customer who uses Fuliza and repays before the next day at 00.00hrs will only pay the 1% access fee.

Fuliza Menu is available on \*334# OK > 00 . Select Query Charges to validate the amounts customers will pay daily based on their outstanding balance.
