**Fuliza transactions of Ksh 100 and below cancelling**

**NOTE:** Fuliza transactions of Ksh 100 and below are limited to 3 transactions in a day, this is because they do not accrue daily interests and are considered to be free transactions. Please advise any enquiring customers that they can only do a maximum of 3 transactions a day as per the terms and conditions. If the customer attempts to do any amount above 100, the transaction will go through.

**Fuliza limit**

Fuliza limit will be allocated upon activation by a customer who has been active on the network for at least 6 Months based on their line activity. Customers on our network for less than 6 months will have a ZERO LIMIT.

To grow Fuliza limit, you need to continue using Safaricom and M-PESA services and repay your Fuliza M-PESA facility on time by topping up your M-PESA account.

The parameters include.

GSM Usage on the network which includes usage on GSM with regards to SMS usage, Data usage, calls, and top-up frequency among others.

M-PESA usage which includes frequency of transactions, withdrawals, deposits, P2P transactions, amounts transacted, M-Shwari disbursements, and repayments among others.

**NOTE:** Fuliza limit will be refreshed (upwards or downwards) every time a customer opts out. This is why most customers get a lower limit when they opt out and then opt back in.

**Number of activations per ID**

Fuliza can be activated on more than one line.

Every M-PESA registered line is treated as a different account.

Each number/ MSISDN qualifies for Fuliza M-PESA depending on the awarded limit.

# **FULIZA Limit Refresh**

For limit refresh customers shall.

Dial \*334#

Select option 00

Enter M-PESA PIN to authorize the request.

articleTitle: M-PESA GlobalPay Virtual Visa Card Product Information
markdownContent:
## **M-PESA GLOBALPAY VIRTUAL VISA CARD**

 [Screenshot]

## **DEFINITION**

In line with our mission to deliver more value and great experience to our M-PESA customers, we are pleased to introduce the M-PESA GlobalPay Virtual Visa Card. 

The card which has been enabled through a partnership between M-PESA and VISA will enable M-PESA Customers to make payments globally at online merchant outlets using VISA credentials attached to their M-PESA wallet as well as send money internationally using VISA credentials.

It completely takes out the need to have a bank account to have a card, and therefore make global payments easier.

## **ACTIVATION ON M-PESA APP:**

Log in to your M-PESA APP-- User will download M-PESA app on [http://bit.ly/mpesappsm](http://bit.ly/mpesappsm)

Select Pay Tab

Select M-PESA GlobalPay

**OR**

Log in to your M-PESA APP.

Select Grow tab

Select M-PESA GlobalPay to activate your M-PESA GlobalPay.

Select your card color.

Enter PIN

You will receive your card details - PAN, Expiry & CVV.

**Note**: The M-PESA GlobalPay service is **NOT** accessible via \*334# USSD **ONLY** on the M-PESA App **for activation and making payments**

## **VIRTUAL CARD EXPIRY**

The Card expires after 3 years. You will be informed at least 4 times before your card expires in the following intervals: - 1month, 7days, 3days and 1day to expiry.

## **M-PESA GLOBALPAY VIRTUAL VISA CARD BUSINESS RULES**

- This service will exclusively be offered to all M-PESA registered customers
- This service will enable M-PESA Customers to obtain VISA Credentials for Online Payments 

- Customers will opt into the M-PESA GlobalPay virtual visa card Product and will be required to agree to the terms and conditions to view card details and access other available services.

- There will be a one to one mapping of M-PESA GlobalPay to per M-PESA Customer’s MSISDN. The service will only be accessible through a customers’ unique MSISDN

- An M-Pesa customer will only be eligible for one card per ID. The service will only be accessible through one registered mobile number. 
- After activating the first Card Credentials, you can only apply for up to four (4) new Card Credentials in a single year, i.e. 12 months.
- Inactive cards will be disabled - To avoid Card cancellation due to inactivity, customers need to ensure that they use it at least once every 3 months to complete any successful transaction.

To change to a new mobile number the customer will need to cancel card and opt out of service first and activate afresh.

- M-PESA GlobalPay virtual visa card will be **valid for a period of 3 Years** after which it will be cancelled/permanently deactivated in the system. Customers will need to activate a new card in order to continue making online payments.

- The M-PESA GlobalPay will not store balances but will mirror M-PESA account balances

- Virtual card does not hold money. It can only be used to make international payments. **The M-PESA Wallet is what holds the funds.**

M-PESA customer limits will apply i.e., the minimum amount of KSh 1/= and a maximum of KSh 150,000 per transaction with a maximum transaction limit of KSh 300,000. The minimum amount will change based on the prevailing USD – KES rate.

For the charges, Safaricom will apply a markup of 3.5% on the transaction value at the prevailing forex rate for international payments. This will be based on the exchange rate of the billing currency (KSh) to the currency used at the time of purchase e.g. (USD, GBP, etc.)

**There will be no other charge such as the M-PESA transaction fee.**

A customer can pay using M-PESA GlobalPay to international online merchants such as Netflix, Amazon, AliExpress, etc. 

For local merchants e.g., Jumia, customers will use the Lipa na M-PESA, Buy Goods option. For a transaction initiated by a local merchant, the M-PESA Customer will receive an appropriate message on the checkout option.

**NB:** **Some merchant categories are restricted on M-PESA GlobalPay Virtual Visa card e.g., gaming, gambling, money transfer services, and cryptocurrency.**

- Fuliza will **not be available** for M-PESA GlobalPay Payments
- The PAN will comprise of a 6-digit PIN **498705** and 10 randomly generated digits within a pre-defined range. 
- Card detail notifications will be through a Flash SMS-- This is a type of SMS that appears directly on your main screen and is not automatically stored in the message inbox. The M-PESA GlobalPay service utilizes Flash SMS messaging to further secure the VISA Credentials.
- A customer can suspend or opt out to global virtual card service on the mpesa app and on the ussd as follows:

## **Suspend Card**

**ON M-PESA APP:**

Log in to your M-PESA APP.

Select Grow Tab

select M-PESA GlobalPay

Select Suspend Card.

Provide reason for suspending card.

Enter M-PESA PIN.

You will receive a successful notification indicating the suspension of the card.

## **Unsuspend Card**

**ON M-PESA APP:**

Log in to your M-PESA APP.

From Grow Tab select M-PESA GlobalPay

Select your Unsuspend Card.

Enter M-PESA PIN.

You will receive a notification indicating the successful unsuspension of the card from M-PESA GlobalPay

## **Opt Out**

**ON M-PESA APP:**

Log in to your M-PESA APP.

From the Grow Tab select M-PESA GlobalPay

Select M-PESA GlobalPay

Enter PIN

Select the 3 dots just above your card.

Select Opt-out and confirm.

Enter PIN

You will receive an SMS notification with a notification of successful opt-out

**M-SHWARI OPT-IN FAILURE**

# **Scenarios for failure**

- The customer has a Small SIM 1000 bytes.

- Advise customer to upgrade the SIM Card via SIM-swap.

 **Missing FSI link on M-PESA**

- The account should have the FSI link on M-PESA which is created once the customer opts in successfully.
- In case they are missing, and the customer is registered on M-Shwari (check Siebel profile), then an SR is raised for the FSI link to be created. (This happens when a line is recycled erroneously on M-PESA, therefore there is no link between M-PESA and their existing M-Shwari a/c).

**Missing M-Shwari Menu**

- Confirm if the customer had subscribed to the M-Shwari product.
- A customer who has not opted in for M-Shwari will not have M-Shwari menu on their phone, the Siebel M-Shwari page will be blank and on M-PESA the FSI link is empty.
- Confirm if the customer has done change of ownership:
- The customer (new owner) must do a sim replacement to opt into M-Shwari afresh since the FSI product is removed from the MPESA G2 account.
- A customer who has done change of ownership but has not done a sim card replacement while the previous owner had M-Shwari will have a sim card that has the M-Shwari menu, but the customer details will be missing on Siebel and G2 will be missing the FSI link.
- If account is activated on FSI and on CRM: Check if the line is identified and proceed to update menu for customer. If unidentified, vet and identify update menu for customer and then advice on activation.
- If name on M-PESA has abbreviation or special characters - Refer customer to retail to update M-PESA registration.

**K****YC** **Levels On M-Shwari -Siebel Tab and Their Tiers**

KYC means Know Your Customer.

- It is used to rate a customer using the documents provided and determines what an account can do.
- It has different levels depending on documents given.

 **KYC Level 0**

- When a customer is registered for M-Shwari, they are automatically defaulted to this KYC level as NCBA check their MPESA registration details.
- KYC Status will be PENDING.
- Customers can make deposits to their accounts. Maximum Deposit Balance is Kshs.0-100, 000 and specific credit limit.
- Customers cannot request for a loan.
- KYC-M-PESA Subscriber Data adequate

**KYC Level 1**

- This level indicates that the bank has successfully conducted its independent KYC check with government database (IPRS) and the result will be **KYC Status PASSED or FAILED.**

- **Passed:** Customer can save or request for a loan if they have a limit**,** make deposits up to a maximum Deposit Balance Kshs 500,000  and Specific Credit Limit KYC Can upgrade to KYC level 2 and 3.

- KYC Level 0 requirements above plus the following

- IPRS: Pass minimum banking threshold.

- **Failed:** Customers can make deposits to their accounts. Deposit Balance Kshs 500,000 and Specific Credit Limit and cannot request for a loan.

**KYC Level 2**

- This level indicates that the bank has successfully conducted its independent KYC check with government database after the customer has submitted a copy of their registration document/national ID or passport to the bank through the Safaricom Retail Center.
- Customers on KYC level 2 can save up to Ksh250,000 - 500, 000 in their M-Shwari Saving Account.

**KYC Level 1** requirements above plus the following:

- KYC- subscriber submits copy of ID.
- M-Shwari subscriber for at least 3 Months
- IPRS: no exemptions

 [Screenshot: Anchor] 

**How** **It** **Works**

- Once opted in, the MSISDN is automatically allocated the KYC Level 0 IPRS Status Pending. IPRS validation will results to either of the following status.

- KYC Level 1 IPRS Status: **FAILED.**
- KYC Level 1 IPRS Status: **PASS.**

- The KYC IPRS check will be done during M-Shwari account opt in using the captured M-PESA customer registration details.
- Internal Safaricom teams can confirm the M-Shwari KYC status on CRM’s M-Shwari tab.

- For New lines in the Market whose M-Shwari A/C is active with a previous owner,

- The Call Center CEE will raise an SR.

# **IPRS STATUS**

**IPRS Pending**

- When a customer opts into M-Shwari, the system will automatically award them this KYC level as NCBA validates the customer’s MPESA registration details.
- If pending for more than 24Hrs - must be re-submitted on CRM. Refer customer to retail shop or care desk.
- Once the validation is done the customer status will change to Failed or Passed.

**IPRS KYC Passed**

- These are customers whose registration details validation against the government database passes.
- These customers will be awarded KYC level 1 and have an option to upgrade to KYC level 2 and/or 3.

**IPRS KYC Failed**

- These are customers whose registration details validation against the government database does not pass.
- They are not eligible for M-Shwari loans.
- They can only save up to Ksh.100,000 in their savings account.
- The Customer details must be re-submitted on CRM. Refer customer to retail shop or care desk. Explain that for them to enjoy all the M-Shwari services e.g., getting a loan, we require their correct details.

# **IPRS Customers Journey**

**The M-Shwari Customer OPT-IN Process Simplified**

- Account activation request is sent from customer’s handset to M-PESA system.
- Account activation request is sent from M-PESA system to the banking system.
- The Banking system creates a customer record/account with the following status:

- KYC Status: Level 0
- IPRS Status: Pending
- Credit Limit: 0 (zero)

- The banking system sends an ‘IPRS Validation’ request to the government database (IPRS); to confirm validity of the customer ID details.
- Existence and validity of the ID details is validated.
- The government database responds with ID validity status.

**PLEASE NOTE**: During M-Shwari Account Activation delays, the processes of IPRS Validation will be performed within 24 hours from the time the request is received in the government database (IPRS).

- Customer record/account is updated with the ‘IPRS Status’, as follows.

**Passed:**

- IPRS Status changes from ‘Pending’ to ‘Passed’.
- KYC Level changes from KYC 0 to KYC 1.
- Credit Limit remains 0 (zero) – awaiting credit limit scoring.
- The enrolment process proceeds to step below.

**Failed:**

- KYC Level remains 0 (zero).
- Credit limit remains 0 (zero).
- The activation process does not proceed further.
- The manual process of verifying customer ID details kicks in.

- This step occurs ONLY if IPRS has passed. Here, a request is sent to the bank’s credit scoring system to calculate the customer’s credit limit.
- The bank’s credit scoring system calculates the customer’s credit limit.
- The bank’s credit scoring system sends the credit limit score back to T24.
- The bank’s system updates customer record with credit limit amount received from credit scoring system.

 **M-SHWARI - LOAN STATUS**

**Loan Not Allowed-M**

**Definition**

This is a lock on a customer’s loan account by NCBA. The customer with this status cannot borrow a loan.

**The lock is caused by any of the following reasons:**

- When money is deposited on a customer’s M-Shwari savings account but the M-PESA transaction for the same was cancelled.
- When a loan repayment transaction is successful on M-Shwari but the M-PESA transaction for the same was cancelled.
- The cancelled transaction (deposit or loan repayment) will indicate a debit and credit of the same amount with the same receipt number (though this may happen on different dates depending on when the bank reconciled the accounts).
- Use the link [https://cxintranet.safaricom.net/cm2/E\_fsMShwari\_insert.php](https://cxintranet.safaricom.net/cm2/E_fsMShwari_insert.php) to confirm if customer owes M-Shwari.

- Advice customer to deposit the indicated amount into M-Shwari savings, the bank will reconcile the amount within 48 hours.
- Kindly raise an SR where the funds are not recovered within 48 hours after deposit.
- The support Analyst upon getting the SR shall escalate via BMC to the NCBA Bank Team.
- The support Analyst shall track the BMC activity and once resolved shall advise the customer as per resolution and close the SR.

**Loan Not Allowed**

- Customer has never made any deposit into M-Shwari savings account.
- This will change once a deposit of any amount is made.

**Loan Restrict**

- This appears if customer had defaulted in loan repayment as per the loan management process.
- The accounts for these customers will remain on the “Loan Restrict” status for 30 days from the date of fully settling the debt and will therefore not be able to borrow any loan even if they qualify for one.
- This happens if a customer takes more than 60 days to repay.
- A customer can find out their loan restrict end date by checking their loan limit. On checking loan limit, a customer will get a notification that informs them of the loan restrict end date.
- The loan restricts ends at midnight of the date displayed, thus the customer can make loan request the following day.

# **Loan Repayment Troubleshooting Tips**

- When the customer repays from M-Shwari savings, the transaction type will be “FI Organization Savings Client Loan Repayment from Savings” on CRM.
- When the customer repays from M-PESA account, the transaction type will be ‘Organization Savings Client Loan Repayment” on CRM.
- To confirm the size of the sim card the customer has in G2, "go to customer info", "select device and security” the size of the sim is shown on the bottom right, the big sim is 3500 bytes, the small sim is 1000 bytes.

**M-Shwari Error Messages**

- Some M-Shwari transactions will cancel because of different reasons hence different error codes will be indicated on the transaction receipt numbers.
- Confirm the error code on the transaction receipt then check the possible troubleshooting/ solution from the attached document.

**NOTE:** For the cancelled transactions with no error codes, kindly confirm that customer has enough funds in the account before escalating via a service request.

# **M-Shwari lock account errors and resolutions**

Below are the various lock-account errors visible on G2:

| Error Response Code | High-Level Description | Description | Comment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| LB01 | The customer is not an M-Shwari customer. | Happens when a customer does not have an M-Shwari account, may be having a menu on their end which happens due to incomplete recycling process. | Confirm that the customer has Opted to M-Shwari service |
| LB02 | The customer doesn’t have LSA. (lock savings account) | Happens when a customer has not activated a lock box account. | Customer should activate Lock box account. |
| LB03 | The customer has insufficient funds on M-Shwari Savings Account. | Happens when amount being withdrawn is higher than the account balance. | Confirm the amount requested in the withdrawal transaction.Customer to fund the account. |
| LB04 | The customer’s status is ‘Blacklisted’ | Bank will send this response code when the Customer’s Withdrawal request is rejected because some funds of customer account is locked. | Escalate via an SR |
| LB05 | The customer’s KYC status is ‘Failed’ | These are customers whose registration details validation against the government database does not pass. | Mismatch of KYC details, kindly referThe customer to the retail shop. |
| LB06 | The customer’s KYC status is ‘Pending’ | These are customers whose registration details validation against the government database does not pass. | Mismatch of KYC details, kindly referThe customer to the retail shop. |
| LB07 | The customer has not been M-Shwari customer for more than 6 months | | Advise customer to continue using the service. |
| LB08 | The customer has not made a first deposit on M-Shwari Savings Account. | The customer has not made a first deposit on M-Shwari Savings Account. | Advise the customer to make an initial deposit into the savings account. |
| LB09 | The customer’s LSA balance is less than requested amount | Happens when amount being withdrawn is higher than the account balance. | Customer to fund the account. |
| LB10 | The customer’s break lock date exceeds maturity date | Happens when a customer tries to break lock, yet the account is set to mature | Advise the customer on the maturity date in the system |
| LB11 | The customer already has an existing LSA (Lock savings account) | Happens when a customer tries to activate more than 1 LSA account. | Customers can only activate one account at a time |
| LB12 | Not being used | Happens when a customer does not have an M-Shwari account, may be having a menu on their end which happens due to incomplete recycling process. | |
| LB13 | The customer is not an M-Shwari customer. | Happens when a customer has not activated a lock box account. | |
| LB14 | The customer doesn’t have LSA. | -------- | Escalate via SR |
| LB15 | The request is missing Funding Source | Technical error. | Confirm that the customer has Opted to M-Shwari service |
| LB16 | Duplicate Receipt Number | When a transaction gets duplicated – either a debit or a credit that happens more than once with the same transaction ID. | Customer should activate Lock box account. |

 **Cancelled Posted Lock Account Deposit Transactions**

**These occurs due to the following reasons**

- A cancelled deposit transaction.
- Cancelled posted lock deposit occurs when an M-SHWARI lock deposit is successful and funds credited into the M-SHWARI lock account, but on the M-PESA G2 the transaction is cancelled, and funds remain in M-PESA.
- You may come across customers who are complaining that their funds are missing on their lock or saving account.

- When this happens, the bank recovers the funds from the customer’s M-SHWARI account. Where these funds have been utilized and not available, the M-SHWARI account is manually locked, and the Account will display the status **LOAN NOT ALLOWED-M.**

 **Solution**

- Take customer through the M-PESA and M-SHWARI balance movement so they can understand where there is unexplained increase in their balances.
- Customer should be advised to deposit funds into his/her M-SHWARI Account in cases where they used the extra funds that were credited into their M-SHWARI accounts.
- No M-PESA transaction SMS was received on the respective dates for the cancelled transactions since they were not completed on M-PESA G2 system.

In such a case, where a customer keeps their M-PESA SMS, one can be advised to put their phone on loudspeaker to enable them to access their SMS. They will notice a gap or unexplained increase in their balance.

# **FTTH Support Work Instruction & Escalation Matrix**

# **FTTH Onboarding and sales leads management.**

Defines the procedure to be followed when engaging and onboarding of potential FTTH clients on the different customer engagement touchpoints.

# **FTTH Onboarding at retail /Franchise/Care desk.**

A potential customer will make a request through a walk in at retail shops and care desks.

Customer can also dial USSD 400 or send SMS with the word Fiber / Fibre to 400, free of charge to request for service.

The request is channeled to the FTTH sales team and responded to within 24 hours.

CEE will check on whether customer is in a fiber ready area using a portal - [https://ftth.safaricom.co.ke/ftth](https://ftth.safaricom.co.ke/ftth).

Portal requires access. Application is via BMC Request - CCS Service Request Issues, under incident management.

Portal is accessed via office email address and windows password.

Where the location is not fiber ready, the CEE will inform the customer and advise on roll out plans if any and will educate customer on available alternatives.

Once confirmed area is fiber ready area or where customer indicates area of residence is fiber ready, CEE will advise the customer on product mechanics, available packages and payment options.

CEE will inform customer on available DIY to submit request via the USSD \*400# websites [https://www.safaricom.co.ke/home/home-fibre/](https://www.safaricom.co.ke/home/home-fibre/) and / or SMS from their phone.

Alternatively, CEE will submit sales lead on the FTTH sales leads link. Access to the FTTH sales lead portal is via link available on intranet - [https://cxintranet.safaricom.net/cm2/S\_FTTHSales\_Index.php](https://cxintranet.safaricom.net/cm2/S_FTTHSales_Index.php)

 [Screenshot]

# **THIBITISHA SERVICE (VICINITY CHECK)**

**Definition**

This is a solution aimed at dealing with erroneous deposits and withdrawals.

The transaction (Deposit or withdrawal) will only be completed if the agent and the customer are in same location.

**Eligibility**

It is eligible to all Safaricom subscribers using M-PESA and M-PESA agents. 

**Benefits**

Address customer pain points by eliminating erroneous deposits and withdrawals.

- Improve customer NPS by eliminating losses arising from erroneous deposits.
- Optimization of Customer Operations by eliminating demand arising from erroneous withdrawals and deposits.
- KYC and Regulatory compliance by ensuring that the agent and customer are at the same location during withdrawals and deposits.
- KYC and Regulatory compliance by ensuring that the customer’s identification is verified during transaction.

**How It Works**

**Deposits**

- Thibitisha will be used to check that deposits are made to the correct customer number.
- If the customer’s handset is not physically close to the agent taking the deposit, then the deposit could be rejected.
- It will also help to ensure that the deposit was not part of a “direct deposit” that is used by customers to avoid Send Money charges.
- Response if an agent deposits to customer in different location.

**English:**

Failed. Please ensure the customer is at your shop and you have verified their document of registration before attempting to deposit.

**Swahili:**

- Imefeli. Hakikisha mteja yuko kwa duka lako na umethibitisha maelezo kwa hati ya kitambulisho kabla ya kuweka pesa.

# **Withdrawals**

Withdrawals can fail due to the following scenarios

- If the customer is not at the shop where they are doing the withdrawal, then the transactions will fail.
- If it is established that the agent and customer location at the time of transacting is not the same, the transaction will not take place.
- Response if a customer withdraws at a different location from agent.

**English:**

- Failed. Kindly ensure you are at the M-PESA Agent shop before attempting to withdraw.

**Swahili:**

- Imefeli. Hakikisha uko kwa duka la ajenti wa M-PESA kabla ya kujaribu kutoa pesa. 

**HAKIKISHA SERVICE**

**Definition**

This is a service that enables M-PESA customers to confirm the name of the person/ organization / merchant that they are they are transferring money to/withdrawing from and gives them an option to cancel the transaction.

The service is also active for Super Agency Transactions (Business Deposit and Business withdrawal).

The transacting MSISDN must have the CNS Flag “Yes” on G2 for Hakikisha to work.

**Eligibility**

Hakikisha service is eligible to all M-PESA registered customers and is **NOT** eligible to M-PESA Global transactions since the Recipient records are not in M-PESA data base.

**Difference between transacting on My Safaricom App and Transacting on the current M-PESA Menu (STK Menu)**

**On my Safaricom App**

- The Hakikisha confirmation step comes before entering the M-PESA PIN.
- You may receive a notification pop up (STK Push) to enter your M-PESA PIN.
- Needs internet connection to open the App.

**On M-PESA menu (STK)**

- The Hakikisha confirmation comes after entering M-PESA PIN.
- It gives 25 seconds to cancel the transaction.
- Does not need data connection to open.

# **Customer Education on Hakikisha**

When a customer calls for a reversal, assist them as per their request then proceed to cross-sell Hakikisha service by sending an educational SMS via Siebel as below.

**English SMS:**

- Jambo, M-PESA now indicates the name of the person or organization to whom you are sending money. To STOP a wrong transaction, type any letter and send. Thanks.

**Swahili SMS:**

- Jambo, M-PESA itakuonyesha jina la mtu au kampuni unayotaka kutuma pesa. Kukatisha shughuli iwapo jina sio sahihi bonyeza nambari yoyote kisha tuma. Asante.

# **Hakikisha Status & Customer Education for All M-PESA Reversal Queries**

There are two statuses of a customer account regarding the Hakikisha service.

**Normal**

- One can get the USSD Pop up when initiating a transaction.
- Names of the person or organization receiving funds will be displayed.

**Suspended**

To confirm when or what time Hakikisha was suspended:

- Go to M-PESA G2.
- Customer Info.
- Overview-Audit log.
- Select ALL and enter time.
- Under events look for CHANGE CUSTOMER CNS FLAG, under TIME you will see the time the account CNS status was changed to suspended.

**NOTE:**

- Hakikisha will be suspended for a period of 48 hours when a customer cancels any transaction 5 times.
- When Hakikisha is on the suspended status, the customer will be able to send money but will not be able to validate the recipient’s or organization’s name.
- This number of times do not have to be concurrent, and the counter is not reset even after a successful transaction.
- If the counter reaches 5 regardless of the duration it took to get to the 5 cancellations. e.g. if you cancel once today and cancel twice in another month and twice in yet another month to bring the total to 5, it will suspend your Hakikisha for 48 hours.

# **M-PESA Transactions**

Below are the different types of transactions that can be done on M-PESA

M-PESA Deposits.

M-PESA Withdrawals.

M-PESA ATM Withdrawals.

**Eligibility**

M-PESA transactions are available to all M-PESA registered customers.

# **M-PESA Deposits**

M-PESA deposits is a process of changing **Cash** money to **E-money,** which is done by an authorized M-PESA agent. 

# **M-PESA Withdrawals**

M-PESA Withdrawals is the process of changing E-money to Cash money and can only be done from an authorized M-PESA Agent. A customer is required to visit an M-PESA agent with the original ID to do the withdrawal.

# **M-PESA ATM Withdrawals**

M-PESA Withdrawals is a service that allows withdrawals from M-PESA Accounts via Selected Bank ATMs. Customers can withdraw a minimum of Ksh.200 and a maximum of KSH250,000.

Once the customer completes the withdrawal and gets a confirmation message, the agent will also get a message on their M-PESA agent transacting till. The customer will present the original ID for the agent to record and disburse funds.

# **Where to perform ATM Withdrawals**

M-PESA ATM withdraw can be done form the below selected ATMs.

- Pesa Point ATM’s – Agent Code 555555
- Diamond Trust bank ATM’s – Agent code 555555
- KCB- Agent code 555555
- Family Bank-Agent code 555555
- NIC-Agent code 555555
- Fina Bank- Agent Code 555555
- Equity ATM’s – Agent code 286286
- CO-OP Bank-Agent code 472472 

# **Funds deducted from M-PESA but not dispensed from the ATM**

Contact the bank you have withdrawn from via their customer care number.

The customer care contact is provided in the ATM lobby which is a chargeable line as per the prevailing calling rates.

If there is no contact, contact M-PESA customer care on 234 from your Safaricom line for assistance with the bank’s contact number. 

# **How to Cancel a Transaction**

- Type any letter and **SEND** within 25 seconds to STOP the transaction.
- Pressing cancel/dismiss or close will only remove the pop-up message but will NOT stop the transaction from completing.
- Different phones have different screen message commands.
- The service will work on most handsets, however, there may be few phones that may have challenges accepting the service, in such a case customer can use a different phone.
- Hakikisha is available in countries where a Safaricom customers can roam however, you will only be able to cash in/cash out your M-PESA balance at M-PESA Agent outlets in Kenya and as provided by M-PESA Global.

# **M-PESA Transaction Statuses**

This refers to different status of a transaction after it is initiated and not completed.

- Authorized status.
- Cancelled status.
- Declined status.
- Expired status.

# **Authorized Transactions**

Transaction is said to be in authorized state if the following occurs:

- A transaction that has been initiated in the M-PESA system and is pending completion.
- A transaction that occurs when the recipient/initiator of the transaction has not received the confirmation message.
- When the communication between the Safaricom SMS system and the M-PESA system is not completed.
- Funds in authorized status will be viewed when checking account balance but can only be available and active once the transaction is completed.

# **Cancelled Transactions**

**Agent Deposit**

Advise them to visit the same agent to repeat the transaction afresh as currently on the system, the transaction requests sent earlier have been declined or cancelled.

**Customer to Customer**

Advise the customer to request the sender to resend the cash or should resend the cash if he/she was the sender. 

**Declined Transactions**

This is a transaction that has **NOT** gone through for any number of reasons. The reasons can be:

When the subscriber’s account does not have enough funds.

If the account rules have been broken, for example, the maximum daily transfer amount of Kshs.500,000 has been reached or during M-PESA system outages.

There are no balance changes in the account statement. Funds are not transferred at all.

Check on transaction for the system reason for declining. If the reason is because the receiving account will exceed the maximum limit, advise the customer(sender) to request the recipient to contact us for guidance.

If the reason is that the senders account has exceeded the daily limit of Ksh.500,000 advice the customer that he can only send again after midnight.

If the reason is insufficient funds, check on M-PESA system if there is any authorized transaction then proceed to assist as per guidelines above.

If not advice customer that he does not have funds to send the transaction.

# **Expired Transaction Status**

These are transactions timed out on the system after remaining on authorized status for a certain period without getting completed either manually or automatically.

For expired transactions advice the customer the money is reversed back to the sender’s account.

For Initiated reversal it expires within 14 days, funds remain with recipient.

# **Checking M-PESA Authorized Transaction On M-PESA G2**

# **Authorized Customer to Customer Transactions**

**Sender calling:**

Search the transaction on G2

Confirm Name and MSISDN of the Recipient. The CEE can also accept if the customer gives 2 correct names. E.g. the first and last name.

Confirm the amount transacted.

Confirm Date and time of the transaction.

If the details are correct on M-PESA system open the authorized transaction, then click “confirm” button to complete transaction.

Enter the vetting details in the M-PESA system comment field as per the transactional details confirmed. (Full names and amount).

**Recipient calling:**

Search the transaction on G2

Confirm Name and MSISDN of the Sender. The CEE can also accept if the customer gives 2 correct names. E.g. the first and last name.

Confirm the amount transacted.

Confirm Date and time of the transaction.

If the details are correct on M-PESA system open the authorized transaction, then click “confirm” button to complete transaction.

Enter the vetting details in the M-PESA system comment field as per the transactional details confirmed. (Full names and amount)

 **NOTE:**

- If the recipient calls and fails, the vetting or not sure of sender details you can.
- Seek their consent to cancel the transaction and advise them to ask sender to resend the funds again to them.
- Advise them to request the sender to call for completion of their M-PESA transaction (since it’s the sender who initiated the transaction).

# **Authorized Agents Deposit Transactions**

**Agent Calling:**

- Confirm with MPESA agent if he/she received cash from the customer,
- if so, then complete the transaction after vetting the MPESA agent. Customer calling: -
- Advise them to go back to the agent and request the agent to call for confirmation.
- Where customer is not in a position to go back, raise an SR for MPESA support team to deal.
- The Support Analyst on receiving the SR shall seek consent from the M-PESA Agent and if consent given deposit on behalf of the customer on G2 and close the SR.

# **Authorized Agent withdrawal Transactions**

**Agent Calling**

- If an M-PESA agent confirms he/she did not issue cash, then the CEE can cancel the transaction
- Then advise the agent.

**Customer Calling**

- If customer confirms that he/she has received money from the agent, then the transaction can be completed.
- For authorized withdrawals where customer claims not to have been given cash, advise them to go back to the agent and request the agent to call for confirmation or cancellation of the transaction.
- Where customer is not able to go back to the agency, raise an SR for MPESA support team to deal.
- The Support Analyst on receiving the SR shall call the agent and seek consent to complete the transaction.
- If consent is not given, the Support Analyst shall contact the customer and advise as per the M-PESA Agent comments.

**Authorized Airtime Purchase Transactions**

When a customer calls regarding an authorized airtime purchase transaction, please apologize to them for all inconveniences caused.

Authorized airtime on M-PESA system should NOT be Completed or Cancelled, regardless of whether it has interfaced on Siebel CRM or not. Escalate the issue via SR as below.

**Category:** M-PESA Services

**Type:** Authorized Transactions

**Item:** Purchase Airtime

**SLA:** 48 Hours

**Authorized Super-Agent Transactions**

For authorized withdrawal.

- Capture the details of agent and escalate via mail to ccs MPESA folder.

**Authorized Utility (Paybill) Transactions**

- For the customer calling on their Paybill transaction that is in authorized status advise the customer to contact the Utility Provider.
- For any transaction to be completed/cancelled; advise the MPESA utility (Multichoice, KPLC, Uchumi, Naivas) to contact their account manager or call M-PESA Corporate on 2222 or send mail to M-PESABusiness@Safaricom.co.ke with the transaction ID details for the transaction to be completed/cancelled.

**M-PESA Cancelled Transaction**

**M-PESA Agent Calling.**

Any transaction status that is either declined or cancelled, advise as below:

- For any transaction to be completed, kindly advise the M-PESA agents, there has to be an SMS confirmation message for both parties. (Subscriber and M-PESA agent).
- Advise the M-PESA agent that for deposits they will need to initiate a new transaction for subscriber initial request.
- For cancelled withdrawals where the agent confirms that cash was given to the customer, initiate a via web withdrawal transaction from the customer’s account. Remember to indicate the original withdrawal TID as the reason for the via web withdrawal transaction. Via web is not done on the floor.

**Merchant Calling**

- If a merchant confirms goods were issued, but the transaction cancelled, the CEE should raise an SR for a “Pay Merchant via Web” transaction to be done.
- The Support Analyst upon receiving the SR will send an Email to LNM support for them to do via web.
- The Support Analyst will track the progress, advise the customer as per resolution and close the SR.

**Dealer Calling**

- If they confirm cash already given to subscriber and thus have no SMS confirmation on their phones and the system does not indicate the transaction.

**Features of CVP**

- The product is like Zidisha plus but is targeted to bigger corporates with more than 30 employees.
- The proposition is available on the pre-pay and post pay payment options. It’s a proposition that can be taken up in place of Zidisha plus.
- This is an appendant product, which rides on an existing tariff.
- Corporate Value Packs are available for either new or existing Post Pay and Hybrid Customers.
- Customers will have a billing line (account) which is a Post pay MSISDN they pay to. Customers use the normal Post pay payments to pay to the billing line.
- Multiple bundle subscriptions will not be allowed. Customers will have to unsubscribe from their existing bundle to subscribe to a new one.
- Existing customers who are already on contracts will be allowed to subscribe to the service. The Corporate Value Packs will be provisioned as an appendant product
- Customers will be able to upgrade and downgrade their bundles through written communication to Safaricom through the relationship manager or account manager as well as letter through the retail shop.
- Any outstanding fees would need to be settled before moving to another bundle. CVP prepay can request for any bundle so long as they have paid enough.
- Upon deactivation of service, customer will be allowed to move with their unutilized resources which will be expired at the end of their validity period.
- Hybrid customers will be allowed to top up their accounts using airtime on full utilization of the resources. Out of bundle rates will apply for all Voice, SMS and Data sessions charged from airtime.
- Unused Voice and DATA resources DO NOT roll over. All resources expire on the last day of the month. For CVP PostPay, new resources are awarded on the 1st of each month.
- Customers on CVP may use their Voice resources to make international calls to any country. However, the preferential rate will only apply for calls to Zone A. For calls to other Zones prevailing call rates will apply.
- When a customer Exhaust their bundles on CVP: Prevailing Safaricom Post Pay out of bundle charges are applicable for all International Calls, International SMS and any Roaming usage. If on a Hybrid tariff, customer should be able to purchase other resources on \*544#, after expiry of their resources or alternatively, go out of bundle
- Customers disconnected or barred due to lack of bill payment: Customers will not be able to use the resources until the outstanding bill is paid and Resources will be expired at the end of their expiry period.
- Bonga Points: Customers will be awarded Bonga Points equivalent to the value of the bundle upon bundle purchase and as per prevailing Bonga conversion rates.
- Sambaza while on CVP will not be applicable. However, Hybrid customers should be able to sambaza their Pre-Pay airtime, resources purchased out of bundle, and Bonga Points under the prevailing sambaza rules.

**Updates to Corporate Postpay Plans and Corporate Value Packs (CVP)**

We recently revamped our Corporate Value Packs (CVP) Data and Corporate Postpaid plans to enhance market competitiveness. Further to the revamp, we have now implemented key enhancements to address customer pain points and improve service delivery.

Below is a summary of the changes:

Multiple Subscriptions for CPP or CVP Bundles

Issue: Customers couldn't subscribe to another CVP/CPP bundle after exhausting resources until the validity period ended, limiting access to in-bundle benefits.

Solution: Allow multiple one-off subscriptions of the same or different CPP/CVP plans at any time.

Prorated First Month's Bill (No Advance Payment)

Issue: Initial bills included prorated charges plus an advance payment, which contradicted the postpay model.

Solution: Charge only prorated amounts in the first bill, excluding advance payments for bundle costs, to align with our standard model.

Eligibility for Hybrid Tariffs

Issue: Customers on hybrid tariffs couldn't access the revamped postpay plans.

Solution: Enable eligibility for the following hybrid tariffs: Staff Business Hybrid, NO EXPIRY Hybrid, and Corporate Hybrid.

Block Overdrafts (Enforce Credit Limits)

Issue: The system allowed overdrafts, enabling usage beyond set credit limits.

Solution: Ensure requested package costs fit within the assigned credit limit. Note: A CRM prompt stating “Credit Limit quota is not enough” indicates insufficient allowance (i.e., package cost exceeds available limit).

markdownContent:
# **Definition**

This is an integrated circuit that securely stores the international mobile subscriber identity (IMSI) used to identify and authenticate subscribers on mobile devices.

# **Storage**

The new Sim cards can save up to 250 contacts.

# **Key Features**

The new Safaricom SIM cards integrates the SIM contacts with the Safaricom KIOSK and M-PESA menu (Phonebook look-up).

- It enables the customer to pick the mobile numbers directly on the M-PESA menu while carrying out M-PESA transactions and avoid being defrauded and sending money to the wrong number.
- The new Safaricom Sim Cards is available in Safaricom retail shops, dealer outlets and M-PESA agents’ outlets countrywide.
- It costs Ksh.100 to purchase a SIM replacement card.
- A new line is Ksh.100, but customer will get 50/- worth of airtime.

# **Half SIM cards**

We shall be rolling out the new Half Sim Card on **1st March 2019.**

Below are the changes effected:

| Previous | New |
| --- | --- |
| Full Size Sim card | Half Size Simcard |
| Z fold printed full color and folded to size | Z-Fold Combined with T&C’s on A5 Form |
| A4 printed Terms & conditions form full color and folded | A5 printed Terms & conditions form in full color and folded |
| A4 printed KYC form in full color and folded | A5 printed KYC form in full color and folded |
| Full Pouch Printed full color | Half Pouch Printed full color. |

# **SIM CARD LIFECYCLE** **Definition and Features**

**Definition**

- This refers to stages a line can go through before it is deactivated if not in use.
- The line will remain active status if the customer is topping up, if the customer does not top up it will move to Expiry Status.

# **Key Features**

- Numbers will be selected from Free Pool (NMS) based on the aging i.e. oldest numbers to be selected first. Minimum aging prior to selection will be 1 month.
- Once numbers have been provisioned on CBS with status idle, numbers will move to Active state upon successful registration on Jiandikishe
- For a newly activated number the number will be on Active state for 7 days inclusive of activation day prior to changing to Expired state if no airtime recharge / top up is made via normal scratch card purchase or via 3rd party top up.
- A number can move to expired state if it meets the conditions below:

Line immediately after registration fails to top up within 7 days

Line has had airtime expired after last recharge AND

No chargeable M-PESA transaction in last 30 days

No Bonga redemption in last 30 days

No Data bundle purchase in last 30 days

No MT in last 30 days

No Data bundle receipt in last 30 days

Expiry period based on receipt of airtime via Sambaza has elapsed

**NOTE:** For customers to keep their lines active (not recycled ) , they should use lines to do **Outbound** **Calls**,  **Outgoing SMS, USSD**, **Data (Browse internet)** **,  Chargeable MPESA transactions** etc. . I.e., Encourage customers to do chargeable activities with their lines, that is to use their lines. Top up alone does not guarantee lines being active

 If a line is in dormant state (not used at all) with no revenue generating activity and no usage over **120 days** . It can be recycled.

- Prior to moving from Active to expired state, a number should receive notifications to inform subscriber of approaching blocking of OG calls and SMS on becoming expired on CBS

For a line whose age on network is less than 30 days and expiry is less than or equal to 7days, notifications to be sent every 48 Hrs

For a line whose age on network is greater than 30 days and expiry is less than or equal to 45 days then send notifications on Day-45, Day-30, Day-20, Day-15, Day-10, Day-5 & Day-1.

Message: *Dear customer, please recharge your line before DD-MM-YYYY to continue enjoying calls, SMS or browsing.*

A number can move to Active state from expired state, if it meets the conditions below:

**Topped up / recharged via**

Direct airtime top up e.g. \*141\*XXXXXX#

Direct bundle purchase e.g. \*544\*XXXXXX#

M-PESA {airtime/bundle)

3rd Party e.g. Sambaza

**Calling 141 {IVR reloading option}**

Received Data bundle via 3rd party / from other line

Made a chargeable M-PESA transaction

Redeemed Bonga points

Purchased a data bundle

Purchased of Expiry Extension period

- A number will be in Expired state for 120 days if none of the reactivations triggers highlighted in point (f) above are met during this duration. While in this state subscriber cannot make calls, SMS or browse.
- On day 121 the number will move to Pooled state and is ready for deletion across the systems mapped in the recycling process. A number in Pooled state will be barred from making or receiving calls or browsing. Numbers should be maintained in Pooled state for 10 days, meaning they should be deleted after the 10 days lapse.
- On successful deletion and reconciliation by the reconciliation tool, the number will be placed in the free pool (NMS).
- Numbers placed in the free pool will have an aging that will be used for selection during the provisioning process to idle state.
- Numbers that have been recycled need to have a minimum 1 month cooling off period prior to being available for selection from the Free pool (NMS). However, this rule can be relaxed if there is market shortage.

# **POOLED LINE ESCALATION PROCESS**

**Contact Center Procedure:**

Customer lines on pool status can be recreated for the owner, **except** for Pooled GOLDEN Numbers, which should be logged at the Retail Center.

To confirm whether number is golden, refer to ESAKA article **A0286**

The CEE will check the status of the line on CRM to ensure it is **pooled on IN DATA**. If status is pooled the CEE will vet the customer to confirm ownership: 

**Pooled lines (Individual)**

Any number in POOLED status, whether **IN Data is available or not,** can be recreated**.**

If they are not the registered owner, customer is advised that it is not available for them.

**Category****:** SIM Card Issues 
**Type:** Number On Pool 
**Item:** Number On Pool

Description: Capture the Customer’s Request, Vetting details and an Alternative Contact number 
**SLA:** 72 Hour

**Pooled lines (Corporate)** 
For Corporate customers, they need to bring an official letter to the retail shop, with a corporate letter head advising on number recreation.

Once pool status is verified and vetting is done to establish ownership of the line, an SR will be raised

**Category****:** SIM Card Issues 
**Type:** Number On Pool 
**Item:** Number On Pool 
Description: Capture the Customer’s Request, Vetting details and an Alternative Contact number

**SLA****:** 72 Hour

# **Action point for the CEE**

After vetting the customer and establishing that indeed he/she is the true owner, escalate to Support Centre via an SR. 
Where a customer fails in the vetting to determine ownership or where there is no proof of ownership, advice the customer to purchase a new line. **DO NOT** raise an SR.

If there is proof of ownership either on M-PESA or CRM but details are not available on Jiandikishe, advise the customer to visit Retail shop with original documents for recreation.

**Action point for the Support Analyst once customer passes vetting and is the true owner – (Normal number Line is for Previous Owner:**

Support will check that the person requesting for recreation is the owner. This can be confirmed by checking the Names on Pooled account on Siebel where SR has been created.

In the event the name is not seen on Siebel and Jiandikishe, Checks will be done on 1st Call activation date of the pooled account and M-PESA registration date. If they tally, then M-PESA details can be used as vetting as that is the previous owner of the line. If ownership cannot be ascertained, customer will be told to get a new line

- Support will have the line, recreated
- Support will also identify the line on CRM with the previous owner details available and advise the customer to activate line via topping up or calling 212. In the event customer has lost the simcard, they will be informed to get a sim replacement.

If the customer is outside the country, the analyst will do first call activation on CRM and advise the customer to top up the line within 24hrs.       

When closing SR, Notes will   clearly indicate line was recreated for previous owner (Include name of Customer) and indicate whether customer will be getting a sim replacement.

**Pooled lines with no previous owners** 
If a customer requests for a number which does not belong to anyone (i.e. was not activated and registered before being POOLED) 
Action point: 
Advise the sub that the line is not available. Advise customer to purchase a new line. 
**Please do NOT raise an SR**.

**Status Pooled on Subscriber Portal, but line not Pooled on IN**

If the number is Pooled on CRM under the Subscriber Portal, but Not pooled on IN, raise SR as below:

**Category**: SIM Card Issues

**Type**: Number On Pool

**Item**: Pooled On Subscriber Portal

To which Support Analyst will escalate via BMC

# **Embedded SIM (e-SIM)**

# **Definition**

Embedded e-SIM is an embedded SIM inside your device. With e-SIM, there's no physical SIM card that you need to insert.

Like a traditional SIM card, the e-SIM stores data that is needed for your device to connect to and use the Safaricom network.

Embedded SIM (e-SIM) is the next step in the evolution of Subscriber Identity Modules (SIM cards).

The e-SIM is designed to deliver freedom and convenience. Unlike the physical SIM, you do not need to insert an e-SIM into your phone as it is already built into your smartphone, device, or wearable.

# **Benefits of e-Sim**

Dual SIM with an e-SIM opens many possibilities that were previously unavailable with only a physical SIM. For example:

Having more than one phone number tied to a single device without swapping SIMs

The freedom to switch operators without having to change your device if using a single SIM device

Reduced risk of SIM Card damage since the SIM card is embedded in the phone.

Frequent travelers can easily switch providers as they travel

# **Requirements For Activation**

SIM card registration

Internet connectivity

e-SIM enabled device.

Selected Retail shop

**How It Works.**

**Checking device & eSIM compatibility.**

Devices that currently support Dual SIM with an e-SIM on the Safaricom network are:

Enabled Apple devices: iPhone XR, XS, XS Max, iPhone 11, iPhone 12, iPhone 13, iPhone 14, iPhone 15, iPhone 16, iPhone 16e and iPhone SE 2020, 2022.

Enabled Samsung Devices: S21, S22, S23, S24 Ultra, S25, Z Fold 1-6, Flip 1-6 & Fold and Note 20.

     e-SIM only devices are eSIM-only and do not have a physical SIM card; instead, all the information needed to connect your device to use on the Safaricom network is stored on the eSIM inside the device.

**To check if the device is compatible one will dial \*#06# on the device. It should display an EID Number directly on the screen.**

At the moment Safaricom does not have any devices that are currently eSIM only on the Safaricom Network.

One can use both physical and eSIM on the same handset with different phone numbers. If you have both SIMs active, it means that you have two different phone numbers.

eSIM profiles is dependent on a specific device because of different manufacturer specifications and capabilities.

A customer can have the same eSIM and physical SIM active. If it’s the same number, **NO**. If it’s a different number, **YES**. An eSIM is treated by the network like a normal SIM card. It does not see a difference between eSIM and physical SIM card.

Devices that have Dual SIM with an e-SIM have both a physical **[SIM card](https://www.verizon.com/support/glossary/) and an [eSIM](https://www.verizon.com/support/glossary/).** This allows you the option to have two different phone numbers on the same device.

# **How to purchase and download an eSIM QR Code**

To get and purchase an eSIM QR code one must visit selected Safaricom Shops.

A customer must be connected to a WI-FI or cellular network to download the QR code.

An e-SIM QR code currently active on one device can be rescanned on a new device, though you must first delete it from the first device while connected to Wi-Fi (so that the systems are informed that the eSIM is no longer in use) before scanning it on the second device.

# **Charges**

Below are the current prices of the eSIM QR code at Safaricom Shops:

| 1 | New Line Activation | Ksh.250 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 | Prepaid Sim Swap | Ksh.150 |
| 3 | Postpay Sim Swap | Free |

**Port in/Port out -** **This service is temporarily unavailable until further notice.**

A customer can port in/port out with an eSIM from another carrier to Safaricom or vice versa.

# **eSIM activation on Safaricom service**

A customer cannot activate eSIM by contacting the call center, but they will be required to visit the Safaricom Shop to purchase an e-SIM however you can activate it from anywhere you have a data connection.

# **Connectivity**

With the eSIM one can connect to 2G, 3G, 4G and 5G as the experience will be like a physical SIM where you can switch between networks

A customer can make and receive calls and messages from both phone numbers you have. However, if you're on a call with one of your phone numbers, calls to your other phone number will go to voicemail. You will also receive a notification for the missed call.

Call Waiting will work if you receive a call to the same number that you are currently using.

# **Lost eSIM/Voucher.**

If already downloaded and active on one’s phone, it cannot be rescanned a second time. If **NOT** downloaded on your phone, it can be rescanned on another phone

# **M-PESA Activation.**

M-PESA activation remains the same after SIM swap as it does not auto activate. One still has to go to your STK menu to activate.

# **SIM Swap process for the Email team.**

The CEE shall advise the customer to send an email to customercare@safaricom.co.ke or advantage@safaricom.co.ke where the customer requires an eSim upgrade or SIM swap.

If the customer is **not** roaming.

confirm if their number is in the attached file, if the number is not on the list, advise the customer to visit Retail Shop.

If the customer's number is on the list, Vet as per normal SIM swap process

If customer passes vetting, share JKIA till number for payment.

Share the vetting and payment details with JKIA shop for them to complete the process.

If a customer is roaming, the CEE shall vet the customer as per existing Roaming SIM Swap vetting process as per article number [ROIE-0010](../../app/article/e82f2b9b-a4ee-42b2-9f73-a984de3c4606)

If the customer passes vetting, the Email CEE shall give the M-PESA till number to the customer to make payment to JKIA shop and advise the customer to share back the payment details.

**NOTE:** The Postpay SIM swap process remains the same as the customer will still get the eSIM Swap for **free**. However, the SIM Swap KYC checks still apply.

Customer can make the payment using their number or a different number.

Once the customer has shared the payment details on email, the CEE shall Share the customer’s request, vetting details and payment details to the JKIA shop to; jkiaretailescalationfolder@safaricom.co.ke.

The CEE shall advise the customer the SIM swap will be done within 2hrs and guide the customer on activating M-PESA after replacement.

The JKIA team upon receiving the request and the payment details shall Process the sim swap.

After the SIM swap the Retail team shall generate a separate Email to share QR code with the customer ONLY.

The QR code sent to the customer from the Retail MUST be encrypted to mitigate any risk and customer advised on the password to use which could be e.g. DOB, ID/Passport number etc.

The JKIA team upon completing SIM Swap shall reply to the customer care email folders with the resolution given to the customer.

If payment is done after 11pm Kenyan time, the request will be actioned the following day.

One can swap back to Physical SIM upon changing devices. If you have PIN 1, you can visit any Dealer, M-PESA Agent or Safaricom Shop for a SIM Swap

One can change from one eSIM device to another eSIM device if they still have your QR code, you can delete it from the old device and rescan it into the new device. If the QR code is not available, the normal SIM replacement process applies where you will get a new QR code for your new device.

# **Golden Number Process.**

The experience will be similar to a physical SIM where the customer makes a payment and gets a golden number. The customer is not charged any extra amount for the e-SIM Card

# **Bulk/Corporate eSIM purchase.**

Corporate customers can purchase eSIM in bulk. The current purchase process still applies.

# **New E-Sim Activation Journey Activities.**

Customer visits retail shop for an e-SIM activation if they have an e-SIM enabled phone. They can buy a phone if they do not have.

Customer purchases a SIM card or replaces his existing SIM card. Once the SIM Swap is successful, remove the physical SIM card from the device.

SIM card is registered as per current SIM card registration guidelines using either USSD or Jiandikishe.

For a brand-new line – customer can choose to register on M-PESA or not as per SIM Registration guidelines i.e., 2 lines on M-PESA and two lines per week.

New connection (new line) - customer will enter PIN to access the SIM and will dial 212 to activate the line

New connection (new line) vetting – customer visits retail shop, buys / chooses a new line, has it registered, during DSA registration CEE uses eSIM serial number, after registration CEE/ customer scans the eSIM plate to device to connect to network

New connection (new line) - customer to top up the line just like the current process with the physical SIM

**Definition**

This is a feature that allows parents self-registering their children to M-PESA GO to do so without uploading the required KYC (birth certificate/passport) at the point of registration. This documentation is added at a later point, within 30 days. 

# **How it works**

**On the M-PESA GO miniapp:**

| SCENARIO | RESOLUTION |
| --- | --- |
| Parent is on the onboarding link but has no birth certificate /passport for their child. | Guide parent to use the “Upload Later” tab to complete the registration process.Advise parent the parent they have 30 days to provide the required KYC. |
| Parent is unaware of required child KYC | Guide parent to upload either a PDF/JPG version of the child’s passport or birth certificate. |
| Parent is unaware of how to upload the required KYC after selecting the “Upload Later Feature” | Advise parent to use the same onboarding link and follow the same registration steps, select the same number (M-PESA GO Account converted without KYC)Guide parent to use the Self Onboarding Link - https://safaricom.com/mpesa-go and upload the birth certificate or passport. |
| Parent does not remember the number earlier selected | The number converted will have a label alongside it – Awaiting Child Document Upload, Birth certificate or Passport.The parent can select Upload Passport/Upload Birth Certificate to complete. |
| Child cannot transact on M-PESA | Check if state tag exists on G2.Upload later tag – M-PESA GO Pending Cert Validation.If the state tag exists, it means that the M-PESA GO account has no KYC attached and can therefore not transact. |
| Parent is unable to send funds to M-PESA GO account registered using the “Upload Later” feature | Advise parent to complete the registration process by logging onto the self-onboarding link, - https://safaricom.com/mpesa-go to upload either the birth certificate or passport.Once KYC is provided, both parent and child will be notified |
| M-PESA GO account is frozen. | Check the date on the M-PESA GO account state tag.If the date is past 30 days, the M-PESA GO account has been frozen due to a lack of child KYC.Advise parent to repeat the registration process – self registration/ Safaricom shop. |
| Parent does not know how to upload KYC (birth certificate/passport) in the portal. | The RCEE/RA will ask to the parent to confirm the MSISDN registered using the Upload later functionality.The MSISDN must have a State Tag on G2.The parent must present the physical/soft copy of the passport/birth certificate.The RCEE/RA will validate the KYC and delete the State tag on G2 |

# **SHOWMAX for 4G for HOME and FTTH ( FAQs)**

**Q1. What is Showmax for Home Customers?**

This is a Safaricom Partnership with Showmax to offer entertainment and content to Safaricom Home Customers.

**Q2. Which plan can a customer subscribe to?**

The customers can subscribe to **Showmax Pro** (Sports, Movies &Series) and **Showmax GE** (General Content)

**Q3. How does a customer sign up to a Home Showmax Plan?**

Dialing \*400#>Entertainment & Security>Showmax

The first-time customers will be redirected to the Showmax website for account creation

**Q4: How much does the Showmax plan cost?**

**1500** Ksh Showmax Pro

**650** Ksh Showmax GE

**Q5. How do I renew my Showmax Plan?**

To renew the Showmax plan, dial \*400#> More Home Services>Select Home Entertainment >Showmax >Renew Plan

**OR**

\*400#> Pay

The product will automatically renew when account is recharged

**Q6. Can I pay before my plan expires?**

Yes.

**Q7. Can I opt out from my Fibre + Showmax plan to a Fibre only plan?**

Yes, by dialing \*400#>Change Plan

**Q8. What is the validity of my Showmax Plan?**

The Showmax plan will be valid for 30days

The customer will be sent notification for service expiry date: 10 days to, 5 days to, 2 days to and on the anniversary date itself. Customers will also receive messages when service is suspended or renewed.

**Q10. What happens if I don’t pay for my plan?**

The customer will be suspended on anniversary date on both Showmax and Home Internet if no payment has been done.

**Q11.** **As a front-line agent, can I view a customer’s Showmax plan on CRM?**

Yes, you can view the Customers plan on CRM IN Data, also the agent can see the Voucher Purchased by the customer on an autogenerated interaction.

**Q12.** **Can a plan purchased erroneously be reversed?**

Yes, reversal is possible if resources are not used. The customer calls 400 and plan will be expired, then funds reversed back to the customer.

Reversal is also allowed for cases where customer did not receive the link on time and no longer wish it to be resent.

**Q13.** **Is the Showmax product available for all Customers?**

No, It’s only available for Home Customers

**Q13**.**Can I access Showmax via My Safaricom app and Website**

***No, but will be availed in the*** ***next Phase of Development***

**Q14.** **What are the escalation levels for Showmax unresolved queries by Front Line? See below**

| --- | --- |
| 2nd Line | Front Line SR Escalation(D_FTTH_ESC) |
| 3rd Line | Home Base Growth Squad: via BMC Resolution Groups;servicedev@Safaricom.co.keCBSSupport@Safaricom.co.ke |
| Showmaxservicedev@Safaricom.co.keCBSSupport@Safaricom.co.ke | |

**Q15.What are the available payment channels?**

1. USSD: dial \*400# > More Home Services>Select Home Entertainment >Showmax and after selecting your preferred bundle, follow the prompts to make an Mpesa Payment

***Note: Post pay, Bonga and Airtime will be availed in the next Phase of Development***

| Category | Type | Item | SLA |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Home Entertainment | Showmax | SubscriptionRegistrationPayments | 24 Hours |

**Q17.What happens when a customer pays for Showmax?**

- They receive a link on the number they have used to pay.
- They click on the link that will lead to the Showmax site, register account using a working email address and redeem the Showmax Voucher
- They will click on the tab to redeem the code shared and the account will be active.

**Q18.How does the customer watch the World cup?**

The customer will proceed to their computer/TV/phone and select Showmax app then login to the app using the email and password the provided to watch.

**Q19.Customer says they have not received Voucher Code?**

- Check whether they had tried registering/redeeming the code using a different email account.

No, the activation code cannot be invalidated.

Yes, a customer who is not in active state can opt out by dialling \*400\*7#>Select Showmax>Select account>Select Showmax Plan> Select opt out

articleTitle: Fuliza M-PESA Issues, Resolution and Escalations
markdownContent:
# **ZERO LIMITS**

A customer may get zero limit because of any of the following reasons:

- Customer opted out then opted back in may be rescored to zero. When a customer opts out and then opts back in, Fuliza system presumes that this is a new subscription to the service and then subjects it to a fresh credit scoring. This is likely to award the line a zero limit (because it is considered as new). Based on this refreshed analysis a customer may also be given a lower limit than before, the same limit as before or even a higher credit limit depending on how they score on such parameters as (Fuliza repayments, airtime usage, M-Pesa usage, Mshwari savings and repayments patterns) etc. Kindly therefore encourage customers to continue using the service consistently and avoid opting out in order to enhance their limit.
- Customer may have defaulted on other loan services and may be listed on CRB. Advice customer to check with CRB.
- Confirm that customer CRB status on Fuliza CRM view is GOOD, any other status will mean that a customer gets a zero limit.
- Customer is less than 6 months on M-PESA.
- Customer has unpaid M-Shwari loan that is older than 60 days.

If above parameters are ok, encourage the customers to continue using our services for a review of the limit.

When limits are scored downwards, or upwards no manual adjustment can be done to reinstate preferred limit.

NB. Do not raise SR requesting for limit upgrade or downgrade.

# **Fuliza Access for iPhone Users**

- iPhone users trying to use Fuliza via the M-PESA STK Menu will not get the STK push prompt to enter their PIN, hence guide them as below:
- Advise customers that Fuliza is now available on the Safaricom APP and that they should download the app from their Apple Store.
- As a temporary work around customers who wish to use the M-PESA STK Menu should downgrade the network to 2G to be able to get the STK Push Prompt. To downgrade the network to 2G, go to: Settings> Mobile Data>Mobile Data Options>Voice & Data >Select 2G

# **CRM VIEW**

- For a customer who has used Fuliza M-PESA, the third column contains the fees charged and amount borrowed.
- The principle amount refers to the amount borrowed.
- Access fee is the one-time fee the customer is charged on day one of taking the loan.
- Accrued maintenance fee is the sum of the daily fees charged while the loan is active.
- Total due amount is a sum of the amount borrowed and the fees charged.

# **M-PESA G2 VIEWS**

---

 [Screenshot] 

 [Screenshot]

# **INSUFFICIENT FUNDS ERROR MESSAGE**

Reasons for insufficient funds error message on trying to send funds.

- When the customer does not respond to the Fuliza prompt (To complete transaction using Fuliza) and the prompt times out.
- If the customer does not accept to use Fuliza and erroneously responds with **2** to **Decline**: (on the Fuliza prompt).
- Fuliza is not enough to cater for transaction amount and Transaction charges where applicable.

**N/B** IOs users should be encouraged to use the app as opposed to STK to enhance their experience.

The transaction type does not allow Fuliza for instance MMI paybill transactions i.e send money to other networks like Airtel, Telkom and IMT transactions.

# **FULIZA ACTIVATION ERRORS**

Customers may be unable to opt into Fuliza due to the following reasons:

**Due to KYC failure**

- A customer unable to opt-in due to KYC failure gets a notification requesting them to visit retail for customer details to be verified.
- KYC failure could happen if the names in M-PESA are not in the same sequence as on the ID and Partner App. There must be match on ID, Partner App & M-PESA
- To confirm the error in M-PESA G2:

i.    Go to customer account in G2.

ii.     Go to audit log; if customer names arrangement is different from the customer names as on the ID, refer the customer to Retail, advice the customer to carry their original document ID.

iii.    Retail will confirm and amend customer name in M-PESA system.

Some customers have KYC error on G2 yet their details match on G2, Partner App and M-PESA. These need to be verified against a list shared by the bank for customers who have been frozen due to Fuliza fraud or default on any of their lines. For KYC error with a match raise SR for analyst to verify on list. The list will be shared via a link to first line once approvals are complete.

**Pending Task (Profile Update)**

The CEE will check Audit log “Identity Management” on G2 if customer has pending task error or Activate Failed, escalate via SR and advise the customer on 72hrs SLA.

The Support Analyst Shall Escalate the issue to FS IT team (3rd line Support) via BMC to clear the pending task.

FS IT team liaises with the NCBA Bank to confirm the status of the virtual account, clear the pending task.

Once resolved the FS IT team shall Update resolution on the BMC activity.

The Support Analyst shall confirm the resolution from the BMC, advise the customer as per resolution notes and close the SR.

# **Recycled line that had previously opted into Fuliza.**

When customer facing teams receive call, chat, DM or walk in customer who is unable to **Opt in FULIZA,** below guide will greatly assist:

**ON SIEBEL**

Confirm line affected is not **POOLED.**

Select **FULIZA VBC** on **Siebel** to view OD status.

\***CRM** will display either **Previous Users Details** or **Current User Details**\* \*Previous user details will display if: **The line was recreated for the same user** or **if the current user opted out.**\*

**NB: \*Previous User Details currently remain on CRM until New User has successfully opted in\***

**ON M-PESA G2**

Open **M-Pesa** \> Search the **Number** > Select **Audit Log** > Filter **Identity Management** then Select latest log for **Activate Customer OD Product** to view logs.

**M-Pesa G2 Portal** error message will guide you on the Action or Response to the customer as below:

| | ERROR MESSAGE | RESPONSE or ACTION |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | The account has been activated.Error Code: BCS50351 | Recycle FULIZA accountRaise Service Request for support team to recycle accountFULIZA > Activation > Recycled line |
| 2 | The activation failed.Error Code: IC70001 | Recycle FULIZA accountRaise Service Request for support team to recycle accountFULIZA > Activation > Recycled line |
| 3 | The activation failed.Error Code: IC70002 | Customer should be recycled on M-PESA and register afresh .This is because Fuliza was recycled after sim recycling. |
| 4. | Activation failed. The message is repeated.Error Code BCS50356 | Raise Service Request for support team to confirm KYC and submit for recycling .FULIZA > Activation > Activation failure |
| 5 | Activate Failed.Customer does not have correct provisioning product.Error Code: BCS50314 | CEE to add provisioning product on M-PESA G2select>Product>Edit>add>Fuliza provisioning product and select ok, enter reason and submit. (See attached guide on steps for provisioning customer products. |
| 6 | Pending task error.There is an ongoing task when the task is initiated.Error Code TP40266 | Raise Service Request for support team to Clear taskFULIZA > Activation > Activation failure |
| 7 | KYC verification failed for the customerError Code: BCS50352 | Refer the customer to retail shop/care desk with Original ID for details on Partner App & G2 to be matched |
| 8 | NO logs for Activate Customer OD Product | Advise the customer to accept terms & conditions (usually on 98 for MORE) |
| 9. | Customer wants Fuliza deactivated. | Advise customer to opt out. Incase customer wants permanent deactivation. Raise SR for analyst to suspend the product. |
| | | |

**KEY POINTERS**

- Some customers will be required to **update their KYC details after they opt out**. This is because they opted in before IPRS check was introduced in November 2020.
- **\*KYC details are exclusively updated from retail shops & care desks when the customers visit. Original ID will be required.** \*
- If M-Pesa G2 has **No audit logs** for **Activate Customer OD Product**, it means the customer failed to complete the activation process by declining T&Cs. They need to **access and accept terms & conditions** under 98: MORE
- Once FULIZA account is recycled, **check the NEW Error Message the customer is getting while activating** (if any) to resolve the issue better. For instance, new error message could be *KYC verification failed for the customer*
- When raising Service Requests, please include **Previous SRs raised,** also add **Mpesa G2 audit log error capturing the time and event** – **Mandatory.**
- **FULIZA VBC tab will display Previous owner Details on CRM after recycling until New owner has successfully opted in**. In case the New owner Opts out, CRM reverts to Previous owner Details. Communication will be shared when this is fixed.
- The default Credit Limit for new customers opting in who are **under 6 months on M-Pesa is NIL.**
- The customer must **Dial \*334# OK to opt in to FULIZA.** Handset change may be helpful for customers using basic phones who are unable to complete activation process.
- In the event the customer claims he has tried to opt in several times and was not able to see the terms and conditions, advise them to try on different handset.
- Additional troubleshooting tips, M-pesa audit log error messages and how to check M-Pesa audit log attached.
- If the recycling process Fails, the CEE will raise a request via an SR with the category below.

| Category | FULIZA |
