| Type | Activation |
| Item | Recycled line |

# **BACKEND / SUPPORT PROCESS**

1. The support analyst will receive a batch file at 3pm of the MSISDNS where recycling has been initiated.
2. The Analyst will raise a BMC ticket to NCBA for recycling on their end.
3. Once completed NCBA will share back the file via email.
4. The analyst will send the SMS to the customer as below to advise them to opt in

*Dear customer, you can now activate your Fuliza. Kindly Dial \*334# OK to opt in FULIZA . Apologies for inconveniences. Thank you, stay safe*

The SLA for actioning of Fuliza recycling ticket is **96 hours.**

# **FULIZA RECYCLED LINES FOR CUSTOMERS LISTED ON CRB**

- This is a guideline to assist us manage cases of **customers listed with CRB due to unpaid Fuliza overdrafts on recycled lines.**
- Below is a step By Step Guide in Confirming Outstanding Fuliza on Recycled Lines.

**View of Outstanding Fuliza on** **CRM view**

- The first call event on CRM is later than the Fuliza Opt-In Date as well as the Due Date. However, the line may be registered to the same person or under a completely different owner.
- Where the line is registered to a new owner, the details of names and ID on Fuliza will be different from those of the new owner. To confirm this;

i.         Query the number on CRM and verify the details of the owner from the contact tab

ii.         Go to IN Data to confirm to confirm the first call event

iii.         Click on the Fuliza Tab to confirm Details (Details of the previous owner, Opt-In date, Outstanding Fuliza amount and Due Date). These must be older than the First call event

- Where the line is in use by the same person, the names and ID details will remain the same to confirm this, repeat steps B I, II & III
- Although the line was recycled, it was again registered and in use by the same previous owner.

**View of Outstanding Fuliza on M-PESA G2**

- The date of M-PESA registration is later than the Fuliza Opt-In Date (confirmed on CRM) as well as the Due Date. However, the line may be registered to the same person or under a completely different owner.
- Where the line is registered to a new owner, the details of names and ID on Fuliza will be different from those of the new owner. To confirm this;

i.         Query the MSISDN on G2 and check the date of M-PESA registration as well as the KYC details.

ii.         Click on the Review OD transaction.

iii.         This will open OD account on a new window (where you’ll confirm the Name, Contract status, Fuliza contract as well as the outstanding Fuliza amount.

**NB:** Where the previous owner is the one using the line, the KYC details remain the same. However, the date of M-PESA Registration will be later than the Fuliza Opt-In date and Due date.

# **Guideline for escalation of Fuliza recycled line repayment**

**Fuliza Repayment process for recycled lines via ussd \*234#**

For customer who want to pay loan for recycled, recreated lines the ussd process is as below. The ussd is done from a different line.

- **“Dial \*334#OK, Select FULIZA, Select Pay FULIZA loan on Old Line > enter Mobile Number > enter ID No> Accept Payment”**.
- That the repayment should from a different line that has enough funds in M-Pesa equal to cater for the fuliza debt.

**Ussd \*334# repayment interventions apply as below** 

**3rd party loan repayment i.e.**

1. Paying a loan on behalf of another customer such as for persons abroad.
2. Loan payment for a pooled line.>Line must be recreated and also recycled on G2 to allow payment
3. Loan repayment for a recycled line that has changed ownership.
4. Loan repayment for a line recreated for the same customer.
5. Loan repayment for a line erroneously recycled on M-Pesa.

**For complains of customers who are unable to repay via ussd, the cee should enquire the error message from the customer and handle as below.** Where customer has availed crb report at retail or email ,kindly attach on SR .

- When raising Fuliza SR kindly add **Mpesa G2 audit log capturing the time and event as below** – **Mandatory.**
- Confirm the error on the log if it shows **KYC verification failed** Refer customer to retail with id for assistance.
- In the event the customers claim he has tried to opt in several times and was not able to see the terms and conditions, advise them to try on different handset.

**Fuliza Reversals.**

Kindly refer to Esaka article FUMI-0006

**CRB Listing and Batch Number.**

- If the customer has no outstanding Fuliza loan but claims is listed with CRB, the CEE shall advise the customer to contact CRB for a CRB report and submit the report at our retail shop together with their ID for further analysis .
- Where the customer confirms they have already contacted CRB but have been requested to get the Batch number for clearance, the CEE will check on the provided batch number link on the CM intranet to get the number and issue it to the customer. (Missing batch on link should be raised on SR as per part d below.)
- If the customer has an outstanding loan, the CEE shall advise the customer to clear the loan. Batch for clearance by CRB will be issued within 48hrs after repayment.
- If the batch number is missing on the link 48hrs (working days) after repayment, the CEE shall escalate via an SR and advise the customer on the 72hrs SLA.The SR Categories are as below.

- Once escalated, the Support Analyst shall validate the issue and escalate via BMC to NCBA Bank.
- NCBA Bank will action within two days and respond on the BMC with feedback.

**Account closure/Opt-out.**

- When a customer requests to opt out of Fuliza M-PESA account, the CEE shall guide the customer on Opt-out mechanics via M-PESA USSD and My Safaricom App.

**Showmax Premier League and Entertainment**

**Troubleshooting;**

If the customer did not receive a voucher, then the CEE will send one from CRM and confirm receipt from customer(Under Showmax VBC TAB)

- In the event that customer has purchased Showmax, and the voucher/transaction is not visible on CRM VBC(Showmax) then the CEE will raise an SR-The support team will escalate the issue to **Digital services via Remedy.**

Mobile DATA  Not Awarded.

NB: For the cases where the customer is unable to watch content and has an active subscription the CEE will raise an SR for further investigation/action. Ensure that the error being experienced is captured to enable further analysis.

articleTitle: M-PESA Holding Service definition and Mechanics
markdownContent:
**Definition** 

A Holding Account is where the money will be taken out of your bank account and placed in a separate account where it will wait until the merchant requests it. A merchant can request the money right away, but they can also wait for a period.

This is where M-PESA agent head Offices and B2C partners can deposit funds in a holding account.

M-PESA Agent head offices and Business to Customer (B2C) partners can deposit M-PESA funds using the code 333 followed by their short codes i.e. \[333\] \[M-PESA Short-code\] via.

National Commercial Bank of Africa (NCBA)

Kenya Commercial Bank (KCB)

Co-operative Bank

Equity Bank

Standard chartered

Safaricom will only process payments done via the new process for all deposits/transfers i.e. RTGS/EFT/Cheque/Cash deposit where the partner will no longer use a specified M-PESA Holding Account.

**Examples**

If M-PESA organization Short-code/Business number is 200200. When making M-PESA deposit the account number shall therefore be 333200200. If short code is 450450, the receiving account shall be 333450450 etc.

# **M-PESA Bulk Payment (B2C) Account Funding instructions**

**Option 1:** Funding B2C Organization short code using deposit slip (Cash/Cheque)

·       CBA Process

·       Account Name: MPESA Holding – CBA

·       Bank Name: Commercial Bank of Africa (CBA)

·       Branch Name: Upper hill

·       Account Currency: KES

·       Swift: CBAFKENX

·       Account Number: 0420448007 or 6518870012

# **KCB Process**

**Definition**

This is a fast, affordable and dedicated internet connection for small and medium sized businesses in areas with 4G coverage (LTE network).

**Features**

The new Fixed LTE products are volume-based bundle packages. Previously, used to be on speed-based packages.

Best effort packages do not have guaranteed speeds (Guaranteed Bit Rate). Therefore, depending on time and network loads, a customer may achieve different speeds.

Guaranteed access packages have guaranteed speeds as per customer speeds. These are offered on 3Mbps and 5Mbpsand will not have Fair Usage Policy (FUP) and Burstability.

Simplified the proposition - matching the prices to FTTH products. This is to create harmony of products offered across.

**Packages**

You can subscribe to the following packages on a post-pay plan. The packages are in two access plans for best effort speeds and guaranteed speeds:

Fixed LTE **best effort access** packages:

| 4G Packages | Data Volume | Best effort Speeds (Max) | Price (Incl. Tax) |

**Onboarding**

LTE service is offered all over Kenya in areas covered by the Safaricom 4G network.

To sign up, a customer needs A duly filled Business Connectivity application form provided by Sales agent or at a Safaricom shop.

Certificate of Incorporation/Registration or Business permit of the business

KRA Pin Certificate.

Identification of Contact Person.

A service deposit payment equivalent to one month’s payment during the service activation process for the post-pay plan. Customer will also need to pay for the LTE router at prevailing retail price.

LTE service if offered on either indoor or outdoor LTE routers. The outdoor router is fitted with an antenna and requires installation at customer premise. The indoor router is a plug and play and will not require installation.

**Mechanics**

**Will the Fixed Wireless Access** **Products have FUP limits?**

No. The new packages will not have any access limits per given time or bundle utilization. However, there is a possibility of exhausting allocated bundles for the best effort packages. In such a case, you can upgrade to a higher package or renew the bundle.

**How do I purchase another bundle if I exhaust the allocated one?**

You are allowed to purchase the same bundle you are subscribed to via M-Pesa, POS or other payment methods to avoid affecting credit limits. This payment is treated as a bill prepayment, so monthly bill remains the same.

**Will Fixed Wireless Access customers have guaranteed internet speeds?**

**For Customers on** **Best Effort Packages, No. They will not have guaranteed speeds**. Access will be on contention with other users on the LTE data network at the time and place.

**For Customers on Guaranteed Speed Packages, Yes. They will have guaranteed speeds**. Regardless of the place and time as per subscribed product – either 3Mbps or 5Mbps.

**Can I move with the** **Fixed Wireless Access indoor router to another location and use it well?**

No. Fixed Wireless usage conditions are restricted to network cells/locations to push required traffic on LTE. Moving with the router may affect the service experience if you move the device to an area without good signal strength. It is therefore recommended to continuously use the service at the area it was set. Optimal support service may only be guaranteed based on the network cells/locations mapped to push required traffic on LTE.

**What happens if I am currently subscribed to a Fixed LTE solution that is priced differently (old products)?**

Customers already subscribed on 3Mbps and 5Mbps products will remain on the same packages for now. Any future changes to those packages will be duly communicated

**Can I have more than one subscription?**

Yes, you can have more on subscription. Each is delivered on a different device and/or location as per your needs. Each is billed on its own. You will receive a bill for each subscription at end of each month.

**What happens I delay in paying a bill?**

A 2-week grace period is allowed before you are disconnected. Disconnections are done on 16th day of the next month. After the last day of the month, you are expected to make a payment to cover the full bill that has fallen due. If you will not have paid, 90 days after disconnection, your subscription will be terminated, and the service deposit used to offset the bill. Other credit collection and actions may be applied to recover any outstanding bill amounts after termination. The router that was in use may also be recovered in instances where it remains the property of Safaricom PLC.

**How do I come back if my subscription is terminated?**

You can always come back through a fresh sign up. Contact our sales and service teams in Safaricom Shops and dealers countrywide.

**Billing**

Bills shall be sent to customers via email at the end of the month for the postpaid service. Service billing starts from the date of subscription as the monthly bill anniversary. You will also need to pay a deposit equivalent to one month’s payment during the service activation.

The monthly invoice will have a breakdown of service charges and taxes as applicable.

Present cash, a check or pay via M-Pesa using the account number.

send email to [businesssupport@safaricom.co.ke](mailto:businesssupport@safaricom.co.ke)

# **Registration of a minor on M-PESA**

The minor account will be registered under the parent/guardian details as per their legally accepted documents (National ID, Passport, Military ID, Alien ID).

The DIY Channels available for parents to use in registering teens on M-PESA GO are M-PESA GO miniapp, Web portal.

Safaricom Shops& Caredesk and Select dealers will use the Partner APP to register M-PESA GO customers. (Release expected August 2025).

A maximum of 4 minor accounts\* will be allowed per parent/guardian identity (configurable).

Only minors between the age of 10- 18yrs will be registered to the service.

The parent/guardian must provide the correct KYC details of the minor - name of child, date of birth and birth certificate number, gender.

Only the parent/guardian will manage the teen account using their (parent’s) USSD (\*334#). Parent/Guardian may request for Ministatement, set daily transaction limits, check Junior Account list etc.

KYC for the child will be required – Valid Birth Certificate or valid Passport.

Using existing processes, M-PESA PIN will be set by the M-PESA GO customer, after a successful registration process.

Only a guardian/parent whose details are captured on M-PESA registration for the minor account can add the minor, manage, enable and disable services and set daily transaction limits.

The minor can receive money from any party as a P2P

# **Transactions**

The M-PESA GO customer may:

Send money.

Lipa na M-PESA - Paybill and Buy Goods.

Buy Airtime and Buy bundles.

Opt in, save, lock savings and invest on ZIIDI.

# **Restrictions**

M-PESA GO customers cannot withdraw funds at M-PESA Agents – as they lack a national ID.

No limit on no of times services can be enabled or disabled. Parent will freely do this

Services restricted by Safaricom will not be available to be used – e.g. Payments to betting companies, borrowing from FULIZA, Mshwari or KCB M-PESA.

Services disabled by parents will not be available to the minor unless enabled by the parent - e.g. where a parent restricts Lipa na M-PESA, or Send money, or Buy Airtime.

**NOTE:** Where a parent removes a child from their control, the child will automatically not be able to use their minor account.

# **M-PESA Limits and Charges**

Maximum M-PESA GO account balance at any one time is Ksh 100,000.

Current M-PESA transactional limits will apply for M-PESA GO customers. However, parents will be able to set a daily transaction limit.

M-PESA charges/tariff remain the same for minor’s accounts.

# **Customer Lifecycle Process**

Only a guardian/parent whose details are captured on GSM services will be able to swap the minor’s account. Existing vetting processes remain

The minor accounts will follow the current GSM lifecycle process e.g. top up, recycling as per existing rules.

In case of a recycled account,

Balances in M-PESA GO wallet below 18 years move to the parent account.

Balances in the M-PESA GO wallet above 18 years move to the archived fund account.

# **Change of ownership process**

The minor must have turned 18 years to request for a change of ownership.

A minor must have a national identity card to request for a change of ownership.

Existing change of ownership process remains. The owner of the account (in this case the parent/guardian), initiates the process.

The minor will visit any Safaricom retail shop/M-PESA agent by themselves to complete the change of ownership process – by filling a change of ownership form.

Where the minor has turned 18 and would like ownership of the line, they will initiate this process at any Safaricom retail centre/Caredesk.

Safaricom Shop Agent will update the 18-year old’s KYC on the mobile number.

# **M-PESA GO Allowed Services**

Send Money

Lipa Na M-PESA – Paybill & Buy Goods.

Buy Airtime.

Buy Bundles.

Receive cash from another customer/bank.

My Accounts services

# **M-PESA GO Restricted Services.**

Payments to betting companies.

Loans and Savings services (KCB M-PESA, Fuliza, M-SHWARI, Other loans apps.

Withdraw Cash.

Payments to political parties/ institutions.

# **Parental Controls**

\*334# > My Account > Manage Junior A/C Relationship>Add Junior Phone Number

**Add/Remove Child from Parent Profile.**

\*334# > My Account > Manage Junior A/C > Manage Junior A/C Relationship > Add/Vie6w/remove Junior A/C

\*334# > My Account > Manage Junior A/C > Manage Service > Enable/Disable Services.

**View M-PESA GO balance.**

334# > My Account > Manage Junior Account > View Junior A/C Info > View Balance > Select Child > M-PESA PIN.

**View Mini statement (last 5 transactions)**

334# > My Account > Manage Junior Account > View Junior A/C Info > View Mini Statement > Select Child > M-PESA PIN.

**Manage Limit (Daily Spend Limit)**

\*334# > My Account > Manage Junior A/C > Limit Spend and Usage > Add/Change/Check/Delete Daily Transaction Limits.

**GET PUK on View360 Portal.**

**Step-by-Step process:**

**1\. Search the Number**

- Agent logs in to **View360 portal**.
- Search for the **number requiring the PUK**.

**2\. Vet the Customer (Primary Vetting)**

- **On Account Overview, confirm:**

- Full Name
- ID Number
- Year of Birth

**Follow Saka vetting standards.**

**If Vetting is Successful:**

**3\. Get the PUK**

- **Click the “GET PUK”** icon under Quick actions on account overview page
- A pop-up appears with:

- ID Number
- Date of Birth
- Preferred Language
- Editable field: Number to send the PUK to
- PUK, PUK2, PIN2
- SIM Card Serial Number

**4\. Share the PUK**

- Read out the PUK

**5\. Educate the Customer**

- Explain how to unlock the SIM using the PUK.
- Push or send a DIY SMS for self-service in future.

**6\. Log Interactions**

- The system logs an Auto Interaction.
- Agent must also log in a Manual Interaction against the number requiring the PUK.

**Important: *Do not log the interaction against the calling number if different.***

**If Vetting Fails:**

**7\. Take Action**

- Advise the customer to:

- Reconfirm their details and call back, or
- Visit the nearest Retail Centre with original registration documents.

- **Create Manual Interaction clearly indicating the advice given to the customer.**

**Definition** 
Go Monthly Plus is a bundled mobile service available to both Prepaid and Postpay Safaricom customers. It offers data, voice, and text resources alongside screen insurance for your device. The plan is accessible by dialing \*544#, selecting “Go Monthly,” then choosing “Go Monthly Plus.”

**Eligibility** 
The service is open to both Prepaid and Postpay Safaricom users. However, it cannot be purchased for another individual subscriptions are tied to the customer’s own line.

**Subscription and Renewal** 
Customers can subscribe by dialing \*544# and navigating to the Go Monthly Plus menu. The plan comes with an auto-renewal feature that ensures continuous access to both mobile resources and screen insurance coverage. If the subscription does not renew after 30 days, the insurance policy becomes inactive.

**Cost and Validity** 
While the specific cost depends on the selected package, all bundles under Go Monthly Plus are valid for 30 days. Customers are allowed only one purchase per product per month, though additional Go Monthly products may be purchased if the customer already has an active screen insurance subscription.

# **Resource Management**

- **Expiry**: All bundled resources (data, voice, SMS) expire after 30 days.
- **Roll Over**: Unused resources do not roll over to the next period.
- **Sambaza & Sharing**: Customers can Sambaza (transfer) or share their data with others.

**Insurance Coverage** 
The screen insurance policy allows for a maximum of **two claims per device per year**. It is important to note that this benefit is not paid out in cash to the customer. Instead, Safaricom covers the repair or replacement cost and invoices Britam, the insurance partner, on a monthly basis following mutual reconciliation.

**Support** 
For any queries or issues related to the Go Monthly Plus plan or screen insurance, customers can contact Safaricom customer care by calling **100**, **200**, or **234**.

**Missed Call Alert Definition and Mechanics.**

# **Definition**

This is a service that allows subscribers to be notified by means of an SMS of people who tried to call them while they were either busy, had their phone off or were out of coverage.

The subscriber receives a message of ‘I tried calling you, how many times & the specific time’ once he/she is available.

**NOTE****:** Service is currently set to work when subscribers are not reachable only (Due to phone being off or are out of network coverage area.)

# **Cost**

The service is free of charge

Missed Call Alert Service Mechanics

It works in a similar way as voicemail.

Missed Call Alert delivers the messages via SMS and does not allow any further messages to be deposited by the calling party.

# **Message Retrieval**

By dialing 132.

A text message will be sent from 132 alerting the customer of any voice message left.

Message validity is 24hrs.

DIY Procedures for Missed Call Alert Service.

# **Activation Procedure** **Via USSD**

Dial \*\*62\*0722199199#ok

Activation Procedure Via Handset feature:

A customer can also divert using the handset feature by diverting calls to number 0722199199.

**NOTE****:** Note that you can only subscribe a customer to one call forwarding product at a time.

# **Deactivation Procedur****e Via USSD**

Dial ##62# ok

**Deactivation Procedure Via Handset feature****:**

A customer can also remove the divert using the handset feature under call diverts and remove.

**Missed Call Generator**

**Missed call Generator** is dynamic IVR IVR solution that offers immediate call completion to customers who initiate calls & have insufficient funds and is automatically enabled on the network.

**How it Works?**

All prepaid customers with insufficient funds will be presented with a call completion option depending on;

1. Okoa Eligible Customers: Customers on Okoa Chap Chap will be able to fulfill their call to party B and the customer will then be able to pay their okoa debt later. This option has been in existent & the customer needs to have opted into Okoa Chap Chap.
2. MCA/MCG: Customers who are not **Okoa eligible**. These could be blacklisted customers, new customers on the network or customer who have opted out of Okoa chap chap. The solution will deliver an automatic **Missed Call Alert SMS to party B** when they make a call with insufficient funds. Party B will then be able to call them back. 

**NB:** When you are deactivate Missed call alert this solution still remains active.

# **Bulk Data**

**Make Your Own Bulk Data**

This is an enhancement from the current Bulk Data where the purchases of Data are pre-defined on the platform. At the point of purchase, **Make Your Own Bulk Data** provides the Enterprise Customers with the flexibility and capability to define the End User Data volume they wish to distribute with the corresponding number of units they require for that purchase. *(Minimum Purchase Volume remains at 1TB)*

**Definition of Bulk Data**

Bulk Data is a solution that enables Enterprises to purchase Mobile Data resources in Bulk and at a subsidized rate and distribute to end customers, clients or staff, for various use cases such as reward,

loyalty, empowering staff to work on the go from one platform.

**How to purchase:**

articleTitle: Contact Support & Escalations - Care Center for MALI
markdownContent:
# **Contact Support & Escalation Process for MALI**

# **Failed Withdrawal Guidelines**

Where the customer is unable to withdraw from a MALI Investment Product and they contact Safaricom.

**CEE Action** **Required (Front Office)**

The CEE will check CRM to confirm the specific MALI product enrolment and statement and advise the customer on the correct product to withdraw from.

The CEE will check CRM to confirm funds availability and advise the customer accordingly.

Advise the customer they will only be able to withdraw from an investment product they have enrolled. The current M-PESA limits will apply.

Where the customer is unable to withdraw from a MALI investment product or funds have been debited but not credited to customer’s M-PESA account, the CEE will raise an SR (SLA is 48 Hours)

**Support Analyst Action Required** **(Back Office)**

RCSA/CCSA will pick the SR, confirm the availability of funds or if the investment account has actually been debited and escalate to Genghis-Capital via Remedy. And follow-up via email: [mali@genghis-capital.com](mailto:mali@genghis-capital.com "mailto:mali@genghis-capital.com") should there be any delays in closing the remedy ticket

Genghis-Capital support team will resolve the issue; process the withdrawal request advice the respective RCSA/CCSA on resolution and closure by updating the resolution notes on the remedy ticket and close the remedy.

The RCSA/CCSA will contact and advice the customer on resolution, update the SR notes.

# **Opt-Out Failure Guidelines**

Where the customer is unable to opt out from a MALI M-PESA Investment Product and they contact Safaricom.

**CEE Action Required** **(Front Office)**

The CEE will check CRM to confirm the specific MALI product registration and advise the customer on the correct product to opt out from.

The CEE will check CRM to confirm funds availability and advise the customer accordingly. The customer will only be able to opt out once they withdraw all the funds available on MALI. The current M-PESA limits will apply

Where the customer is unable to opt out of MALI, the CEE will raise an SR (SLA is 72 Hours)

**Support Analyst Action Required** **(Back Office)**

RCSA/CCSA will pick the SR, confirm the scanned documents and escalate to Genghis-Capital via Remedy. And follow-up via email:[mali@genghis-capital.com](mailto:mali@genghis-capital.com "mailto:mali@genghis-capital.com") should there be any delays in closing the remedy ticket.

Genghis-Capital support team will resolve the issue; process the request out and advice the respective RCSA/CCSA on resolution and closure by updating the resolution notes on the remedy ticket and close the remedy.

The RCSA/CCSA will contact and advice the customer on resolution, update the SR notes and close.

# **Contact Support & Escalations Retail-Center for MALI** 

**Change of Ownership Guidelines**

A Mali account is linked to an MSISDN and the customer must opt out before the change of ownership on CRM.

MALI account change of ownership must be accompanied by change of MSISDN ownership and thus the current process for MSISDN Change of ownership, Account Closure and Change of account details will apply.

All change of ownership requests will be done at the Safaricom Retail Centres and Care Desks.

**Retail Centre CEE Action Required** **(Front Office)**

During the change of MSISDN ownership at the Safaricom Shop/Care Desk the CEE will advise the customer to withdraw any funds available on the account and opt out of the service before proceeding to process the change of ownership on CRM.

Where the customer is unable to opt out of MALI, the Retail CEE will raise an SR attaching scanned copies of customer’s written change of ownership request, ID and KRA PIN.

**Retail Centre Analyst Action Required** **(Back Office)**

RCSA will pick the SR, confirm the scanned documents and escalate the attached documents to Genghis-Capital via Remedy. And follow-up via email: [mali@genghis-capital.com](mailto:mali@genghis-capital.com "mailto:mali@genghis-capital.com") should there be any delays in closing the remedy ticket

Genghis-Capital support team will resolve the issue, delink the MSISDN and advice the respective RCSA on resolution and closure by updating the resolution notes on the remedy ticket and close the remedy.

The RCSA will update the SR notes and close the SR

# **Number Recycling claim Process**

**Retail Centre CEE Action Required (Front Office)**

During the claim of funds for a recycled MSISDN, the Retail CEE will raise an SR (SLA is 72 Hours) attaching scanned copies of duly filled claim application form, ID and KRA PIN.

**Retail Centre Analyst Action Required** **(Back Office)**

RCSA will pick the SR, confirm the scanned documents and escalate the attached documents to Genghis-Capital via Remedy to confirm if customer had invested in MALI and the available fund balance

The RCSA will do a follow-up via email: [mali@genghis-capital.com](mailto:mali@genghis-capital.com "mailto:mali@genghis-capital.com") should there be any delays in closing the remedy ticket

Genghis-Capital support team will confirm if the customer had invested in a MALI Investment Product and the available fund balance.

Genghis-Capital will process payments to MSISDN nominated/provided by the customer and advice the respective RCSA on resolution and closure by updating the resolution notes on the remedy ticket and close the remedy.

The RCSA will update the SR notes and close the SR.

# **Next of Kin claim Process**

**Retail Centre CEE Action Required** **(Front Office)**

During the claim of funds by next of KIN, the Retail CEE will raise an SR (SLA is 72 Hours) attaching scanned copies of duly filled next of KIN claim application form, and copies of supporting documents as per the current process for Next of KIN claims

**Retail Centre Analyst Action Required** **(Back Office)**

RCSA will pick the SR, confirm the scanned documents and escalate the attached documents to Genghis-Capital via Remedy to confirm if the deceased had invested in Mali and the available fund balance. And follow-up via email:[mali@genghis-capital.com](mailto:mali@genghis-capital.com "mailto:mali@genghis-capital.com") should there be any delays in closing the remedy ticket

Genghis-Capital support team will confirm if the deceased had invested in a MALI Investment Product, the available fund balance and the next of KIN information.

Genghis-Capital will process payments to MSISDN nominated/provided by the Next of KIN and advice the respective RCSA on resolution and closure by updating the resolution notes on the remedy ticket and close the remedy.

The RCSA will update the SR notes and close the SR

articleTitle: ZIDISHA BIASHARA (LNM + GSM PILOT FOR MERCHANTS)
markdownContent:
This currently available **only** to whitelisted merchants with Business tills (tills making and receiving payments). 

No additional requirements/KYC will be required to subscribe to a Zidisha Biashara product. Existing KYC will be reused.

**Whitelisted Merchants**

The 10k whitelisted merchants will be communicated to via CVM messages & call-outs They will also be able to see the Zidisha Biashara option on their menu. 

**How to opt in**

Getting started with Zidisha Biashara is simple! 

i.         Dial \*234# on your nominated number, select option 2: M-PESA Business Till, then enter your Store number.   

ii.         Select Zidisha Biashara from the menu. 

iii.         Choose the Opt-In option. 

iv.         You will receive a message that you have successfully opted in to Zidisha Biashara. 

**After successful opt in:**

i.    You will receive a message that you have successfully opted in to Zidisha Biashara. 

ii.    You will also get regular updates of the various solutions and offers under the Zidisha Biashara. 

iii.    You will be able to access various Products and services at highly discounted rates. 

iv.    Purchase notifications will be sent to you immediately after a successful purchase. 

v.         You will also get access to 247 Support.

**How to make a purchase on Zidisha Biashara's offers and solutions**

i.    Once you've selected a product that suits your needs, begin the purchase process. You’ll be able to buy your preferred prepaid weekly or monthly plans through USSD \*234#, Option 2(M-PESA Business Till), You'll then be prompted to pay via Till, where you'll need to enter your Operator ID and PIN. 

ii.    Upon successful payment, your purchase will be completed, and you'll automatically receive the allocated resources. 

iii.    You will also receive a notification confirming your purchase. 

iv.    There are no limits on the number of purchases you can make in a month 

Zidisha Biashara free till transactions **only** applies to transactions paid into the till by customers (C2B). LNM Kadogo transactions (KSH 200 or less) will count towards the free LNM transaction during the pilot period.

***For example, if a merchant is awarded 10 free LNM transactions for the day, the first 10 C2B payments made to the till will not be charged, whether they are Kadogo or not.*** 

M-PESA Till is the only accepted payment method. 

**To check balance**

Dial \*234#, Option 2(M-PESA Business Till)

Enter store number

Select Zidisha Biashara,

Choose Check Balance.

Enter your operator ID and PIN

***You will receive a notification with a detailed breakdown of your resource balances.*** 

**Business Rules**

Reversal will not be possible once purchased.

There will be no rollover of resources for voice, data and M-PESA resources. They will expire 30 days after the purchase date for the monthly plan or 7 days for the weekly plan.  

When you deplete your resources, you can buy your preferred plan by dialing \*234#, select Option 2 (M-PESA Business Till) and follow the prompts.

The due date will be 30 days for the monthly plan or 7 days for the weekly plan from the purchase date. However, if you purchase different bundles, the

Bundles will be prioritized and utilized based on their expiry dates. A 7-day bundle will be utilized first. 

**LNM + GSM PILOT FOR MERCHANTS BENEFICIARY FEATURE**

This feature allows LNM merchants share voice and data bundles with their staff, friends, and family. It’s our way of making connectivity more flexible, more empowering, and more rewarding for business owners.

**Who is a beneficiary?** 

A beneficiary is an individual who receives resources provided by another person, referred to as the sponsor. The sponsor in this case directly purchases Zidisha resources to the beneficiary’s designated number. Anyone you trust, staff, friends, or family can be added as a beneficiary. 

**Merchants (aka Sponsors) can now:**

Add beneficiaries e.g. staff, family, and friends by simply entering their phone numbers

Buy voice and data bundles for them directly from \*234#

Remove beneficiaries just as easily, anytime

**With this new feature, merchants will be able to:**

Keep their teams connected and productive

Share affordable voice and data bundles with ease

Manage everything in one place, fast and hassle-free

Boost GSM & LNM adoption, helping grow our revenue

**How It Works**

Dial \*234#

Select Option 2 – M-PESA Business Till

Choose Zidisha Biashara

Add/remove beneficiary and buy bundles 

**Benefits**

**Convenience**: Merchants can buy airtime and bundles for their teams

**Flexibility**: Affordable voice and data bundles for different needs

**Simplicity**: Add beneficiaries and purchase in seconds via \*234#

**Productivity**: Keeps teams connected, boosting business performance

**Growth**: Drives LNM and GSM usage, supporting revenue uplift

For more information, refer to the attachment on **LNM ZIDISHA BENEFICIARY FAQs**

articleTitle: Registration Mechanics and DIY for Masoko
markdownContent:
**New user access DIY**

- To register as a user, please visit [www.masoko.com](http://www.masoko.com/) (Use Google Chrome and Mozilla Firefox browsers for the best experience)
- Go to the URL: [https://masoko.com](https://masoko.com/)
- Once the window opens, you will go to the Create an Account link to register.
- On clicking the Register, the customer shall be presented with a registration form with mandatory fields to be filled before the registration is successful.
- Customer should provide their name and contact number, create a username with their email address and a password. They will be requested to confirm password.
- After filling in the correct details, click on create account.
- The customer will receive an OTP message to verify registration before the process is complete.
- The Customer shall receive an email and SMS confirmation from Masoko on the registration.

**Existing user access DIY**

- If the customer has an active Masoko account, they will be presented with the log in page.

**Forgotten Password procedure**

- Please visit the login page and click on Forgot password
- Key in the details of the email address or mobile number that you used when you first registered your account and click reset password
- You will receive an OTP SMS to verify ownership then, you will be required to create a new password.
- If you are still unsuccessful in resetting your password, you may contact the Masoko Customer Support Team on WhatsApp chat 0722000888 or through email to masokohelp@safaricom.co.ke.

**Updating/Changing information on already created account**

A customer can edit their account information such as Shipping and Billing addresses; update email address and password by following the steps below:

- Log in to your account
- Click ‘My Account’ and then select ‘Account Information’.

**Checking your previous orders on already created account**

A customer can search for order details or order numbers for previous orders by logging into their Masoko account then go to

- Log in to your account

Click ‘My Account’ and then select ‘Account Information’

**Definition**

KCB M-PESA is a savings and loan service that enables M-PESA customers to save as little as Ksh. 1 and access credit from Ksh. 100 payable within a month.

**Eligibility**

- The customer will need to hold a Kenyan National ID and be registered using the same on M-PESA.
- A registered Safaricom M-PESA customer.
- Have an active Safaricom M-PESA account.

**Exemptions on Eligibility.**

- Customer registered using Passport numbers won’t be able to opt/activate KCB M-PESA as their IPRS check doesn’t query passport numbers.
- Such customers should visit the Retail Center with their original ID and passport so that the details of the ID are captured and amended from the passport details.
- KCB M-PESA will not allow multiple registrations using the same document ID.
- For customers who would wish to close KCB M-PESA A/C to allow a new activation on another number, such customers should visit either KCB Bank or Safaricom Retail Center with original ID for account recycling to be done.
- Customers who are not more than 6 months old on M-PESA, will be assigned a KCB M-PESA loan limit of zero.

**KCB-MPESA Offers.**

- Access loans at attractive interest rates @8.88%.
- Save for a fixed period (Fixed Deposit Account) or save a little at a time for a set period (Target Savings Account) and earn interest.
- Transfer money in and out of the KCB M-PESA Account for **FREE**.

**DIY Procedure & Activation**

Customers can access KCB M-PESA via the following channels:

- Via STK > Select M-PESA menu
- Via USSD \>Select **\*334#**

- Safaricom App > Select Loans and Savings > Select KCB M-PESA and Activate.

**How to deposit/withdraw & Query balance for KCB M-PESA**

Money in and out of the KCB M-PESA Account is **ONLY** available through M-PESA channel.

**KCB-MPESA Deposit**

To deposit from M-PESA

- Access the KCB M-PESA menu.
- Select Deposit from M-PESA.
- The M-PESA account will be deducted, and the KCB M-PESA Account credited with the amount.

**KCB-MPESA Withdraw**

To withdraw to M-PESA

- Access the KCB M-PESA menu.
- Select Withdraw to M-PESA.
- The KCB M-PESA Account will be deducted, and the M-PESA Account credited with the amount.

**Maximum amount allowed to withdraw KCB M-PESA to M-PESA**

- Customers are allowed to withdraw up- to Kshs.**150,000** per transaction from KCB M-PESA to M-PESA.
- Minimum amount to withdraw is Ksh **1.0.**
- The withdrawals are subject to MPESA allowable limits of holding a maximum of 500,000 in MPESA Wallet at any given time.

**Maximum amount KCB M-PESA can hold.**

The maximum amount KCB banked customers can on hold their KCB M-PESA account is 1 million while the maximum other customers can hold is KSh.500,000.

**KCB-MPESA Query balance.**

The customer will not be charged for checking KCB M-PESA balance. The procedure is as follows:

- Access M-PESA menu
- Loans and savings
- KCB M-PESA.
- Select My Account.
- Select check balance and confirm with M-PESA PIN.
- Customer receives an SMS notification with the balances for the account requested for.

**KCB M-PESA Loans & Mechanics**

The KCB M-PESA loan account is a micro-credit product which gives you access to a loan; may it be for an emergency, to fund a project or enterprise.

**Loan Qualifications**

- Be an M-PESA subscriber for 6 months.
- Save on KCB M-PESA.
- Actively use other Safaricom services such as voice, data and M-PESA.

**Loan limit.**

A customer can access loan limits from as low as Ksh.100 and up to Ksh.250,000 and Enjoy repayment period of one month.

**How to Grow Loan limit**

- Increase activity on your KCB M-PESA Account by moving money in and out of your Account.
- Increase savings on your KCB M-PESA Account.
- Increase usage of M-PESA services.

**KCB M-PESA Loan Settlement, Interest and Loan Lifecycle**

**Deductions for Loan settlement**

This is a feature that enables KCB to deduct cash automatically from customer’s KCB M-PESA account to repay overdue loan.

**How It Works**

- The deduction will be from the customer’s KCB M-PESA Account

**Cumulative Interest charged on Loans.**

The new cumulative interest rate on loans is 8.88%. This constitutes of interest charges and excise duty.

**Example:** 
If a customer takes a loan of Ksh 100, the full amount (Ksh 100) will be disbursed to their KCB M-PESA account and later transfer to their M-PESA account. The customer will be required to repay Ksh 108.88 within 30 days. The repayment includes an interest charge of **8.88%**, which is inclusive of excise duty.

As an incentive for early repayment, if the customer repays **within 9 days**, they will receive a **20% cashback on the interest charged**—meaning they’ll get back **Ksh 1.78**.

**KCB M-PESA Loan Lifecycle**

- Customers whose loans remain outstanding at day 31 are set to blacklist level 1 which is automatically removed if they repay by day 60.
- Customers whose loans are outstanding past day 60 are put on blacklist level 2 which means even if they repay, the Bank will have to manually remove the blacklist to enable them to borrow again.
- The second group must wait for 90 days (3 months) for the Bank to review the blacklist.

articleTitle: Network Issues Customer support and Escalation
markdownContent:
# **Network Issues Customer support and Escalation**

The complains may include but not limited to.

- No Network Coverage.
- Network Coverage Complaints.
- Network Echo Complaints.

The issues may be global affecting many customers/regions, or an individual complain from one customer.

Check on Siebel whether customer had reported of the problem and advise as per resolution.

Verify with the Call Center Folder whether there is a global/regional issue and advice the customer the issue is under resolution.

For individual issues, troubleshoot to find out if it’s the handset that has an issue and advise the customer accordingly.

# **Tips for Troubleshooting**

Confirm the error message the customer is getting on the handset. Errors may include.

- No Connection.
- No Access.
- No Network.
- Error in Connection.
- Network Busy.
- Limited Service.
- Call Ended.
- Confirm on HLR the network reception (MNRF) status.
- Confirm the error on SOC tool.
- Confirm network settings on the customers phone is either Automatic or manually selected as Safaricom.
- Confirm if customer has restarted the handset.
- Customer should try using a different handset.
- If handset is faulty, refer customer to a phone repair technician.
- Enquire whether other people in the said area are also experiencing the problem. If they are, it should be treated as a global issue.
- For any Network issues, the CEE should always raise an SR and advice the customer on the SLA.
- Advise the customer to always send a message to network hotline SMS 5555 with the issue being experienced. **(free of charge).**

**NOTE:** 

Do not send any email to NOC Escalations ([noescalation@safaricom.co.ke](mailto:noescalation@safaricom.co.ke) ) of an issue affecting a single customer.

For 5G network available for Safaricom customers in the selected locations I.e. Nairobi, Kisumu, Kisii and Kakamega.

# **Escalation for Network Issues**

For speedy resolution by the Support Team, ensure comprehensive info is captured on the SR as below:

# **Raising SR error on CEM**

- **Issue**: e.g. low signal / unable to call / unable to access internet / call drops, etc.
- **Is it Indoors or Outdoors**: - Is the experience both on Incoming or Outgoing Calls, or Both.
- **Period:** - For how long has the issue persisted.
- **Signal strength: -** How is are the Signal bars at the problematic area.
- **Location: -** i.e. County, Nearest Highway and Landmark; Indicate County, Sub-Location, Nearest Town, Nearest Major Road, nearest Primary/ Secondary Schools/ Market/ etc.
- A phone number that is in the problematic area at the moment.

**Example**

**Error on CEM:** No Paging Response.

**Issue:** Call drops and Mute calls in JCC Mlolongo while indoors for all calls.

**Duration:** For about 2 months now.

**Signal strength:** 2 bars.

**Location:** JCC is in Machakos County, near Gateway Mall, Opp KAPA oil at Mlolongo, along Mombasa Road, approx.17kms from Nairobi city.

**Customer/Number within the area:** 0722000000.

# **Summary of the codes used while closing network SMS after raising an SR**

| Area Codes | Issue Codes |
| --- | --- |
| ER: Eastern Region | CD: For Call Drops |

**Definition**

Masoko is a leading online marketplace by Safaricom that gives you a wide variety of phones, laptops, gaming and accessories which can be shopped from the comfort of your house, office or even on transit.  Items bought are delivered at your doorstep or picked up at any designated pick-up points countrywide. 

**Payment Options**

- M-PESA
- Bonga Points: Customer will find the Lipa with Bonga Points on checkout.

- Promotional Coupon Code
- Credit Card
- Credit/ Debit Card

 ***\*N/B: No cash payment or payment on delivery. For Card payments can we mention that a customer must be logged into their account or create an account before they can proceed***

**Security of the payment option**

- The utmost caution is taken to satisfy customers trust regarding their information and money.
- The payment service provider is PCI DSS level 1 compliant, and the payment pages use Extended Validation SSL with 256-bit encryption.

**After Sales Services**

- Items purchased through Masoko will come with a warranty cover. The warranty period is indicated on the description of every item.  (terms and conditions apply).
- In case a customer will need assistance, and the item is within warranty they can contact Masoko team via WhatsApp chat using 0722000888.
- Items bought are delivered at your doorstep within Nairobi, outside Nairobi we have designated pickup points across the country. Delivery charges are Kshs 250 Per order.
- A customer will be required to present their National ID for identification when picking their package.

**Time duration for Delivery**

The package will be delivered within Nairobi on the same day for orders made before 3pm, and next day for pickup orders outside Nairobi.

All orders made after 3pm are considered for next day delivery.

Delivery option is only available for Nairobi Orders. For out of Nairobi orders the orders can be collected at the designated pickup points across the country which are the Safaricom shops and G4s offices country wide.

**Sending 3RD Party to collect Package**

- A customer can send someone to pick the package on their behalf, but they must ensure that they notify us on email or chat with the name and ID of the person collecting so that we can facilitate the process.
- For more details on delivery click on this link https://www.masoko.com/delivery-information
- The person also needs to confirm the integrity of the delivery and the package condition.
- If not at home, you can leave someone to collect your order from the rider on your behalf. Please advise the designated person to review the condition of the package. Kindly review the terms and conditions of returns to get further information.

**Business rules for returns**

Customers wishing to replace items will be requested to initiate returns and then place fresh orders for the desired products by sending an email request to [Masokohelp@safaricom.co.ke](mailto:Masokohelp@safaricom.co.ke) or chatting on Masoko via WhatsApp.

- Refunds / Returns shall be managed via an approval process.
- Replacements will be done on a working day after merchant determination and approval. The whole return process takes a max of seven days.
- Store credits is the first refund option before a return of money is offered, however on basis refunds need will be applied. All refunds will be issued back via reversing the original payment or issuing store credit.

**Returns Terms and Conditions.**

**Return Process:**

- This process details the terms the business will allow for returns, exchanges and refunds.
- Before returns, exchanges and refunds are offered; each case will be evaluated separately based on the processes laid out.

**Conditions for returns apply as below: -**

- A return can only be initiated if the item has been delivered. If an order has not been shipped out for delivery the customer can cancel. If it is shipped and not delivered at the point of customer request, the customer will be asked to initiate the return when the item arrives.
- A customer will have 7 calendar days from the delivery date, to Raise a return request
- Customer will contact MASOKO team via email to; or WhatsApp chat to 0722000888, to request a return
- All requests for returns are subject to our Return Policy & Returns Policy Exemptions to check if the product is eligible for return.
- Shipping fees are not refundable in the case of a partial return.

**Acceptable Reasons for Returns**

Reasons for return of any item can be classified into the following scenarios: -

- Wrong product: – The product delivered is different from the product ordered.
- Damaged product: - The delivered product has been damaged in transit.
- Defective product: - Delivery of a non-functional product or one that doesn't perform as expected.
- Poor quality / condition: - Product whose quality is clearly sub-standard.
- Missing parts: - A product that is delivered with items missing from its packing box.
- Inconsistent with description online - A product whose description on Masoko is different from that of the physical product. This could be in size, color and other physical attributes described online

**Masoko Contact Support**

- WhatsApp chat 0722000888
- Email: [masokohelp@safaricom.co.ke](mailto:masokohelp@safaricom.co.ke)
- Twitter: @MasokoKe
- Facebook: Masoko Africa

articleTitle: Orders DIY Mechanics and Returns Customer Journey for Masoko
markdownContent:
**Orders DIY Mechanics on searching for a product on the site.**

Once logged on to [www.masoko.com](http://www.masoko.com)  search for items;

- Go to the URL: [https://masoko.com](https://masoko.com/)
- Once the window opens, you will go to the Sign In link and click to sign in and type in the details and click on sign in.
- Search for the products by keying the product on the ‘Search’ bar or shop by ‘Category’, ‘Top Brands’, ‘Safaricom Shop’ or what is in the ‘Super Deals ‘.
- Contacting Masoko Support Agents through the chat and request for the product(s) if you have a challenge in navigation

**Adding an item to the cart**

- Once you find the items, click the “Add to Cart” button.
- After adding the item to the cart, a popup on the side will appear, giving you the options either to continue shopping or to check out.
- You can also click on ‘My Cart’ to check out.
- When you click ‘Go to Cart’ on check out, you will get a summary of the items in your cart: The Item, the price, quantity and subtotal.
- You can also Update your shopping cart
- You can click on check out and you will be prompted to select a shipping address or key in a shipping address, delivery date, shipping method.
- You will be presented with payment options, if a customer selects M-PESA Express they shall be presented with STK Push option and if the customer does not have the STK Push, the customer is presented with the Paybill number and account number to pay.
- Other payments (Cards)- Key in the card number, expiry dates and the security code-usually the last 3 digits behind the card besides the signature
- You may also pay via Discount code by clicking on apply discount code or you can pay using store credit (if the customer has in their account). However for store credit the customer as to be logged into their account.
- One may also pay via Bonga points-

For full bonga payment: Key in the mobile number and the amount in KES will be populated on the amount tab, key in the number that has the bonga points then click redeem Bonga. You will receive a pop up on your phone. Key in the M-PESA pin and you will receive your order number.

- At this point, the customer can view the placed orders in their account and start tracking their orders.

**Placing an Order when not yet logged in**

- If you have an account and have not logged on, you will be prompted to ‘Sign In’ to your account or if you do not have an account, you will be required to ‘Register’ and create a new account if this is your first order.
- Enter a ‘Shipping Address, choose a shipping method, and enter your payment information.
- Review your order details. Be sure you have applied any Gift Cards or promotional codes you would like to use on your order.
- Click ‘Place your order’.
- Once payment has gone through you will then receive an email with the order details, and a text that the order has been confirmed.

**Incase you do not wish to sign in** 

A customer can also buy without logging in or creating an account. This is referred to as guest checkout.

On the checkout page select the option checkout as guest and proceed to make payments.

However, after the client has checked out as guest the orders made will not be included in their account history.

 **When to Place the Order**

- An order can be placed at any time.
- Deliveries however will be done as per the timelines noted on the checkout page.

**Product ordered is out of stock**

- Being a marketplace, sometimes, our sellers sell out very quickly on their stock. We put in our best effort to ensure that this does not happen.
- We commit to notifying our customers as soon as it happens and offer store credits or refunds in case there are no alternatives.

**Pre-order**

The product will be tagged pre-order on the website, and the expected time of delivery will be stated.

**Returns Customer Journey Process for Masoko**

Customers who wish to return a product / item are to follow the following procedure: -

- Initiate a request for a return online, via live chat or email Masokohelp@Safaricom.co.ke

Masoko support analysts will contact the customer to confirm the reason and if item is within the return policy.

o  For request through the chat or email, the agent will request for the following information: -

o   Order Number

o   Product that is to be returned

o   Payment method

o   Reason for return/Status of the item to be returned

·       If the product is not eligible for return, the customer will be informed within 1 business day.

·       The MASOKO CEE will approve / decline (with reason for the same) as per the return policy.

·       Where return is prohibited the MASOKO CEE will politely advice customer and give reason for the same as per defined terms and conditions.

- Where the item is within the return policy, the agent will log return request on Magento and raise an SR. The agent will advise the customer they will be contacted within 48 Hours.
- MASOKO CEE will clearly capture the order number, specific item, nature of defect, and customer details with a contact number / email on the SR.
- The MASOKO support team will within 48 hours check against the approval requests on magento and will engage the vendor and advise them on the return, detailing the reason for the return and seek consent /settle for return.
- The MASOKO support team will within 48 hours approve / decline the return and advice customer accordingly
- The MASOKO support analyst will initiate a return request on Magento by validating the number of items to be returned reason for return; item condition and resolution (authorize or deny approval).
- MASOKO support team will advise customer accordingly. Where return is approved, MASOKO support will update status to ‘authorized’ on magento.
- MASOKO support analyst will advise customer accordingly where resolution is reached and no need to book item(s) for return. The analyst will update the status on Magento and close SR.
- MASOKO support agent will engage the customer for a preferred collection point, where return is approved. If the product is eligible for return, the customer will be asked to: -

o   Specific Collection Location

o   Preferred Collection time

o   Package the items for collection

o   Hand the product to an authorized Masoko Delivery courier for return

- MASOKO support analyst will liaise with courier via email, detailing the collection address. The delivery partner will coordinate with the customer for collection of the product.
- The delivery partner will schedule a collection within 24 hours after the return request is verified. A maximum of 2 scheduled pick-ups will be attempted, failure to which the return request maybe cancelled without prejudice and inform the customer via email / call / SMS.
- Before accepting the product for return / exchange or refund, the delivery partner will inspect the product for any defects, and fill in a waybill in triplicate, and giving the customer their copy. The courier companies will action as per instructions given by the MASOKO team.

- Before accepting the product for return / exchange or refund, the delivery partner will inspect the product. During this check they will be checking the product for the following conditions: -

o   **Correct Product:** Conditions: IMEI/ name/ image/ brand/ serial number/ article number/ bar code should match and MRP tag should be undetached and clearly visible.

o   **Complete Product:** Conditions: All in-the-box accessories (like remote control, starter kits, instruction manuals, chargers, headphones, etc.), freebies and combos (if any) should be present.

o   **Undamaged Product:** Conditions: The product (including SIM trays/ charging port/ headphone port, back-panel etc.) should be undamaged and without any scratches, dents, tears or holes. Except: Products being returned for damage.

o   **Undamaged Packaging:** Product's original packaging/ box should be undamaged. Except: Products returned for being dead on arrival or wrong products whose packaging conceals type of product.

- If the product fails the inspection test, the delivery partner shall notify the customer that the return is not possible.
- If the product passes the inspection, it shall be received for return and sent back to the vendor / warehouse / hub, based on merchant agreement.
- Delivery costs for the replacement shall be borne by the customer in “Customer change of mind” scenarios. This will be paid directly by the customer to the delivery partner on site.
- Upon engagement of the storage and courier by the MASOKO support team, confirming receipt of the returned item, the team will update status on Magento to ‘return received’
- The MASOKO support team will engage vendor advising them the item is ready for collection / is available as a non-saleable item.
- MASOKO support analyst will engage the vendor within 48 hours and return / refund engagement will be concluded, based on engagement with the vendor and custom.

**Consignment return model**

- Where consignment model is in use, MASOKO support team will liaise with the Courier Company / customer to collect / drop the item at an agreed collection point or warehouse.
- The courier will deliver within 48 hours and have customer sign acknowledgement, where applicable.
- MASOKO support team will proceed to raise a store credit / refund on Magento close SR and advice customer accordingly.
- Magento support team will advise the vendor / merchant accordingly and the SKU’s will be adjusted accordingly as per the merchant process, where item is returned to the warehouse.
- Where a refund is requested, the same will go through approval process and the refund process will apply.

# **Background**

**SHA:** The Social Health Authority (SHA) pools contributions, contracts healthcare providers, and pays for healthcare services for registered beneficiaries. Contributions are collected through payroll for employed individuals, **direct payments from the self-employed**, and government subsidies for the indigent and vulnerable.

Self-employed individuals **must undertake means testing** (income assessment), to determine their **annual premium** based on income level.

Self-employed individuals are then  **required to make their annual payment upfront** to access health coverage. This lump-sum cost can be a financial burden, making it challenging for them to stay consistently covered and protected against health risks.

# **Definition**

LIPA SHA POLE POLE is a contribution plan that allows self-employed individuals to pay SHA premiums in manageable payments.

It gives a flexible payment schedule matching the earning patterns of your household. You can LIPA SHA POLE POLE daily, weekly or monthly.

LIPA SHA POLE POLE is a **contribution product, not a loan**. The customers will make direct payments towards their SHA premium contribution.

# **Eligibility**

You must meet all the following criteria to qualify:

1. Be registered with SHA (dial \*147#ok to register).

2. Be informally employed (not in formal employment).

3. Have completed means testing/income assessment and received a premium amount to pay - (dial \*147#ok then choose Calculate Contribution or go to: [https://afyayangu.go.ke/](https://afyayangu.go.ke/) then income assessment).

# **LIPA SHA POLE POLE Application Rules**

All eligible applicants for the LIPA POLE POLE service are required to adhere to the following rules during the enrolment process:

**Premium Arrears Clearance:** Customers must clear any outstanding SHA contribution arrears. If arrears exist, they will be required to repay them during the enrolment journey.

**Advance Payment:** New customers will need to make 4-months prepayments of their SHA contributions to successfully enroll into the LIPA POLE POLE program. 

Customers who have not contributed to SHA for at least 4 months or with arrears, will be required to pay the arrears or the 4 months contribution in full during the last step of the enrolment process. To make your payments, Dial \*147#, then follow through enrollment process.

**Hustler Fund & Bridge Loan Clearance:** Customers with Hustler (personal) loans overdue by more than 45 days or Bridge Loan older than 31 days will need to fully clear their loans before they can join the new LIPA SHA POLE POLE service.

**Standing Order Setup:** Set up an **M-PESA Ratiba standing order** with your preferred payment frequency—daily, weekly, or monthly—to ensure consistent contributions.

**Agreement & Authentication:** Accept the Terms and Conditions and enter your M-PESA PIN to complete enrolment securely.

# **Benefit of LIPA SHA POLE POLE**

**Flexible Payments:** Spread your SHA contributions over 24 months using daily, weekly, or monthly payments—whatever suits your income flow.

**No Interest, No Loan:** This is not a loan. You are simply making direct contributions toward your health cover with zero interest or debt.

**Immediate Health Cover Access:** Once your 4-month prepayment is made, you gain access to SHA health services, as long as your contributions remain up to date.

**Automatic Cover Continuity:** With a standing order via M-PESA Ratiba, your payments are automated—ensuring no missed contributions and uninterrupted coverage.

**Convenient & Secure:** Set up is easy, done via your phone, and secured with your M-PESA PIN authentication.

**Long-Term Protection:** Once enrolled, you're covered for two years, giving you peace of mind and stability for yourself and your family.

# **Opting Out and Standing Order Management.**

The service will run for the period of 2 years from the time of enrolment. After the period, customer will be automatically opted out of the service.

Customers can also opt out of LIPA SHA POLE POLE, however, they need to ensure that their SHA contributions are fully paid up for the current period to avoid interruption or loss of SHA cover. 

Customers can manage their M-PESA Ratiba standing order by dialling \*334# or through the Ratiba Mini App on the M-PESA App.

# **Access Channel**

1. **USSD**: Dial \*254#, select Hustler Fund, select LIPA POLE POLE, and follow the prompts.
2. **USSD**: Dial \*147#, select LIPA POLE POLE, and follow the prompts.

# **Escalation & Support**

Customers contact the SHA call center on 147 or Safaricom on 100, Taifa Care Service Center on: helpdesk@dha.go.ke or Safaricom Retail Centers, Twitter: @Safaricom\_Care, Facebook: Safaricom PLC, Instagram: safaricomplc\_ or Email: customercare@safaricom.co.ke

For unresolved issues, a Service Request (SR) is raised to 2nd line support teams under the SR Category: **LIPA SHA POLE POLE** on CRM, and select the relevant SR Type & Item.

Attached also the Escalation matrix

# **LNM B2C TRANSACTIONS AND REVERSALS**

**Definition**

Bank to Customer transactions(B2C) are transactions done by customers from their Bank accounts to Mobile wallets.

B2C transactions could either be:

**Mobile Banking Transactions-**These are transactions done by customers from their Bank accounts to Mobile wallets.

**Bulk disbursement Transactions-**These are transactions done by organizations to mobile wallets. They are done by users (Business Manager or Business Web Operator) created by the organization’s Administrators.

They do it using either:

a) G2 Organization portal ([https://org.ke.m-pesa.com](https://org.ke.m-pesa.com) /login. action).

b) M-PESA Business portal ([https://pay.m-pesaforbusiness.co.ke/](https://pay.m-pesaforbusiness.co.ke/) ).

Examples of Bulk disbursements are Salary Payments, Promotion Payment and Business Payment to Customer.

**B2C Reversals:**

**Mobile Banking Reversals**

These are done by Banks only. If a customer engages us requesting for a reversal for mobile Banking done to the wrong number, kindly refer him to their Bank for assistance.

The Bank will initiate and complete the reversal, then credit the customer’s Bank account based on their SLA.

If the Bank has a challenge performing the task, it will engage us via call on 2222(M-PESA Business) or via email to [M-pesabusiness@safaricom.co.ke](mailto:M-pesabusiness@safaricom.co.ke)

**Bulk disbursement Reversals**

Rarely would a customer call requesting for such a reversal, since the transactions are performed by organization’s users.

Organization’s users (Business Manager or Business Web Operator) have the capability to reverse if they realize they made a mistake.

However, if a customer engages us saying that the organization sent to the wrong number, kindly refer them back to the organization to reverse.

If the organization has a challenge performing the task, it will engage us via call on 2222(M-PESA Business) or via email to [M-pesabusiness@safaricom.co.ke](mailto:M-pesabusiness@safaricom.co.ke) In both cases, M-PESA business team will confirm that the request has been done by the Bank or Organization and assist.
