# **Definition:**

This is a service that enables one to give his/her callers the option to leave a message when they are unable to answer the calls.

It is a Divert to 0722122122 or 0722122

# **Cost:**

Voicemail service activation and retrieval is offered free of charge.

The caller is charged at normal rate to leave a voice message.

# **Business Rules:**

This is available for all Safaricom subscribers.

Subscribers will use these services if they are calling other subscribers within the network.

One will not be able to use it while Roaming & International calls.

# **Voicemail features**

Read receipt-knowing when the voicemail retriever has read the mail.

Blacklist /Unblack list.

Enable/Disable PIN.

Greetings can be set for all callers.

Customer is prompted to enter a Default 5-digit pin sent on creation and advised to change.

# **Voicemail Mechanics**

Voicemail is activated either when one is unreachable, unable to answer (no reply) or line is busy. One may opt to activate voicemail under all the conditions above.

The caller is prompted to leave a message if he/she so wish. To retrieve messages from voicemail, one normally dials 132.

Voicemail is also on USSD menu 100 and 200. It gives the procedure of how to activate voicemail when not reachable and how retrieve the messages by dialling 132.

# **Changing Voicemail PIN**

A customer will get SMS with a Pin upon Voicemail box creation and should they wish to change they can call 132.

Customer should NOT be given 1234 as a default voicemail pin as this is no longer applicable

For subsequent users, they dial 111 – select 6(PIN) – select new PIN – verify new PIN

# **Blocked Voicemail Pin**

The Voice Mail PIN unlocks itself within 10 minutes. This means the customer can use their previous voicemail PIN to access the services.

Retrieving Voicemail

A text message will be sent from 132 alerting customer of any voice message left.

Customer dials 132 and follow prompts to listen to the message.

# **VMS Retrieval hours**

Unread Message: Automatic is 48hrs and Corporate is 72hours

Read Message: Automatic is 24hrs and Corporate is 48hours

Saved Message: Automatic is 48hrs and Corporate is 72hours

# **DIY Procedures for Voicemail Service.**

**Activation of Voicemail Service Via USSD:**

\*\*62\*722122122# or \*\*62\*0722122#

**Activation of Voicemail Service Via Handset feature:**

A customer can also divert using the handset feature by diverting calls to number 0722122122 or 0722122.

**Deactivation of Voicemail Service Via USSD:**

To deactivate Dial #62#ok, #67#ok, #61#ok or #004#ok

Deactivation of Voicemail Service Via Handset feature:

A customer can also remove the divert using the handset feature under call diverts and remove

**Customer Care Service for Voicemail.**

**Handling Customer Complaint where Subscriber is Unable to retrieve Voicemail messages**

Verify in HLR and Siebel whether profile is appropriate.

Confirm whether customer is using correct PIN and assist.

Confirm whether there is any reported network fault.

Verify time the voicemail was deposited to determine whether it is within the voicemail retention

Confirm error, vet customer and raise SR (SLA 14hours) if still unable to retrieve message.

SR Categories: Value Added Services

Item: VMS

Type: Retrieval Issues

# **Voicemail Activation Via Siebel:**

Subscriber Portal

Select Supplementary services

Then Select the product to add and submit the request.

# **Deactivation Voicemail Service Via Siebel/****CRM:**

Query number on Siebel

Under Subscriber Portal>supplementary services>Uncheck the product to delete and submit the request.

The order will complete, and the product removed from the subscriber

# **Creating Voicemail Type** **on CRM**

MSISDN which is not created on Voicemail cannot retrieve voicemail messages.

When a subscriber dials 111 to retrieve voicemail messages, a triple tone is heard, and the call is ended.

Select the voicemail tab on the Subscriber Portal

Click "Create “From the drop down, one option will be available depending on the Tariff plan (Pre or Postpaid).

Select the appropriate option

Click “Save”.

# **Deleting wrongly created Voicemail Type**

For an MSISDN which is created on the wrong Voicemail Type e.g. Prepaid or Postpaid.

The CEE will be able to delete the Voicemail Type which is attached to the MSISDN and create the correct one.

# **Resetting Voicemail Pin Via Siebel / CRM**

If the customer cannot recall the PIN, he/she was using, then they will need to reset it.

It’s possible to reset the Voicemail PIN on Siebel.

Vet customer as per Procedure

Query number on Siebel

Select the voicemail tab on the Subscriber Portal

Click on "Reset PIN".

articleTitle: DIY Prepay Mechanics on Top Ups
markdownContent:
**How to Buy Airtime from M-PESA**

M-PESA menu/STK

My Safaricom App

Zuri Chat Bot.

**Via STK/MPESA Menu**

Go to M-PESA Menu

Select Buy airtime.

Select either on "My phone" or "Other number.”

Enter phone number if selected for other number.

Enter Amount and M-PESA PIN

Confirm the entry and send the request.

A confirmation message will be sent with transaction details and a recharge message from Safaricom.

**Via Safaricom App**

Open the Safaricom App.

Select buy airtime

Choose for this number or other number

Enter amount

Enter PIN

Confirm and send

A confirmation message will be sent with transaction details and a recharge message from Safaricom.

**Via Zuri chatbot**

Open Zuri chatbot.

Select Products and Services

Select airtime top up

Choose the M-PESA option.

Choose option for own number or other number.

Enter the amount.

An STK push will appear to enter M-PESA PIN

**How to reverse**

**VIA 456 Self-Reversal**

**Eligibility**

Prepay Customer who purchase airtime for their number only.

Post pay (Both Advantage and Hybrid) customers will not be able to use DIY option.

**How to Reverse**

Customers will forward the SMS received from M-PESA after buying airtime for self to 456.

Reversal request must be sent within 24 hours from time of transaction.

Request must be sent by the same MSISDN that did the M-PESA transaction.

Lines 31 days and older on the network.

If the requests meet the conditions above, the amount will be deducted from airtime then credited to M-PESA.

If the validations fail the customer will get an SMS with specific reason for failure.

**Scenario Notifications after Reversal Request**

**Reversal successful- enough airtime balance**

*NCC7GD6XXX confirmed. Reversal of transaction NCC7GD6XYZ has been successfully reversed on 22/3/19 at 9.30PM and Ksh XXXXX.XX is credited to your M-PESA account. New M-PESA account balance is Ksh XXXXX. XX.*

**Reversal declined -Insufficient balance on CBS**

*Dear Customer, your reversal request has declined due insufficient airtime balance. Top up the difference and resend the M-PESA SMS to 456. Thank you.*

**Reversal declined -Bought for 3rd Party (Not self)**

*Dear Customer, this reversal service is available for airtime bought for your number. For further assistance call or SMS 100. Thank you.*

**Reversal declined -Invalid transactions (LNM, Paybill etc.)**

*Dear Customer, this reversal service is available for person-to-person M-PESA*

*Transactions and airtime bought for self. Thank you.*

**Reversal declined -Third Party requests**

*Dear Customer, send the reversal request using the number that bought the airtime. Thank you.*

**Reversal declined - Reversing already completed transaction**

*Dear Customer, reversal request for <Amount> was completed successfully. Kindly check your M-PESA balance. Thank you.*

**Reversal declined Transaction done more than 24hrs ago.**

*Dear Customer, this service is only available for transactions done within 24 hours. For further assistance call or SMS 100. Thank you.*

**Reversal declined Balance will Exceed 100K**

*Dear Customer, we are unable to reverse transaction <Transaction ID> as your balance will exceed the maximum account limit of Kshs.100, 000. Kindly reduce your balance and try again. Thank you.*

**Reversal declined -Debit line on Post-pay (Hybrid).**

*Dear Customer, this service is only available to prepay customers. Kindly call or SMS 200 for assistance. Thank you*.

**Reversal declined -System error.**

*Dear Customer, we were unable to process your airtime reversal request for <Amount> at this time. Kindly try again within 5 minutes. Thank you.*

**How to Sambaza**

Dial \*140\* Amount\*Number you want to top up#, OK.

SMS to 140 in the format (Amount #Number you want to top up).

Select Safaricom Menu, choose Sambaza and enter Amount and Number you want to top up.

**Procedures for Direct Top Up**

Send an SMS with the Voucher Pin to 141.

Dial \*141\*Voucher Pin#

From Safaricom menu, select Top-Up my number and enter Voucher pin.

On the website [www.safaricom.com](http://www.safaricom.com/), choose Top up, my number and enter the Voucher Pin.

Via Safaricom App, go to menu, my account, choose Top up my number, enter the voucher pin and send.

Via Zuri Chat Bot, choose Product and Services, choose airtime Top-up, choose scratch cards and choose your number. You can top up single or multiple vouchers in the format 16digitpin#16digitpin#.

**Procedures to do a Third-Party Top-Up**

Send SMS to 141 with Voucher pin # Number to be topped up

Dial \*141\*Voucher Pin\* Number to be topped up# OK

From Safaricom menu, select Top-Up other number and enter voucher pin and number to be topped up

Via Safaricom App, go to menu, my account, choose Top up other number, and enter the number, the Voucher Pin and send.

On the website [www.safaricom.com](http://www.safaricom.com/), choose Top up, other number and enter the Voucher PIN.

**How the customer tops up the E-voucher**

The customer will dial \*141\*Scratch card pin received#. The Voucher will be successfully loaded.

articleTitle: DIY Mechanics on Top Ups for Dealers
markdownContent:
**How to Access Bamba Poa**

**Dealer:** Request for the functionality through Dealer management, then Finance will activate your account to access this service on both USSD and Web.

**DSA / Retailer:** by dialing \*180#, then select Bamba Poa Option.

**How to Register for Bamba Poa**

**DSA/ Branch**

These two will be registered by the Dealer HQ as follows

The Dealer Head Office or Branch will register/opt in the DSA within their network on the \*180# Platform. The DSA will then receive an OTP (One Time Pin) which requires to be changed immediately.

DSA’s will be registered by Dealer head office as follows;

Dealer head office registers/creates retailer/ DSA.

DSA/retailer created on \*180# platform.

DSA/dealer receives OTP and changes password.

DSA/retailer gets access to float and can now buy for subscriber or do E-top ups.

**Retailer**

Retailers will be registered by DSAs as follows.

Dialing \*180#

Select Bamba Poa

Select Register Retailer

Enter the retailer mobile number.

Enter Retailers ID number

Enter the Retailers first name

Enter the Retailers Last name

Enter Retailer email address (optional)

Confirm the information

Enter PIN

The retailer will successfully be registered; both the DSA and retailer will receive a confirmation SMS

**How to Change the DSA OTP (ONE-TIME PIN)**

Dial \*180# Select Bamba Poa Select Change PIN

Enter your old PIN

Enter your new PIN

Confirm the new PIN

PIN will be changed successfully.

The DSA will receive a confirmation SMS

**How to Transfer Float**

The dealer HQ or Dealer Branch are the only entity allowed to re-distribute float amongst DSAs.

A DSA cannot be able to transfer float to another DSA.

**Dealer to Branch**

The dealer will dial \*180#

Select transfer float to Branch.

Enter the Branch nominated mobile number.

Enter the float amount.

Confirm the transaction.

Enter the PIN.

Transaction successful: Both Dealer and the Dealer branch will receive confirmation message.

**Branch to DSA**

The dealer branch will dial \*180#.

Select Bamba Poa.

Select transfer float to DSA.

Enter the DSA nominated mobile number.

Enter the float amount.

Confirm the transaction.

Enter the PIN.

Transaction successful: Both DSA and the dealer branch will receive confirmation message.

**DSA to Retailer:**

The dealer branch will Dial \*180#

Select Bamba Poa.

Select Sell float to Retailer.

Enter the Retailer nominated mobile number.

Enter the float amount.

Confirm the transaction.

Enter the pin.

Transaction successful: Both DSA and the retailer will receive confirmation message.

**DSA/Retailer can Top up a Regular Safaricom Subscriber by:**

Dialing \*180#

Select Bamba Poa

Select Top up subscriber

Enter subscriber mobile number

Enter top up amount

confirm the transaction details

Enter the PIN

Confirmation messages are sent to the Retailer and Safaricom Subscriber

**To access the Bamba Poa balance, the DSA will**

**Dial \*180#**

Select Bamba Poa

Select Check Float Balance.

A message is sent to the user with their balance.

**How to sell E-Vouchers**

**The DSA will**

Dial \*180# from the nominated number.

Select Bamba Poa.

Select E- Voucher.

Enter subscriber mobile number.

Select the top up amount the customer requires.

Confirm the transaction details.

Enter the PIN.

Confirmation messages are sent to both the Retailer and Safaricom Subscriber

**NOTE:** The recipient (Retailer, Safaricom Subscriber) will receive both Serial and Scratch card pin on, SMS.

articleTitle: M-PESA Agent Withdrawal Reversal Request Guidelines
markdownContent:
**Agent Withdrawal Reversal Request Guidelines**

# **Reasons for Reversal**

Customer / Merchant Withdrawal at Wrong Agent Till

Customer withdrawing with No ID

Cash not given by the agent

Duplicated transactions

# **How to Request for the Reversal**

MPESA agent; Forward M-PESA message to 2530

Agent assisted via Contact centre

Visit retail shop

# **Customer Assisted Via Contact Center**

Search the number seeking assistance on CRM.

Check whether the line has key comment forbidding a withdrawal reversal if so, **Do not initiate a reversal.**

If the customer has more than 2 previous reversal disagreement SRs, **Do not initiate a reversal.** Advise the customer the decision was reached due to frequent disagreements**,** either go to the MPESA agent or report to the police.

Query the customer number on M-PESA G2 and confirm ownership of the line using the Customer Names as per M-PESA system. The CEE can accept if the customer gives 2 correct names.

The transaction to be reversed has been done within the last **30 days**. For all transactions older than **30 days** the CEE will advise the customer to go back to the agent or report to the police to resolve any dispute.

For cancelled transaction, drill down to the linked transaction where the same transaction has been cancelled before, confirm the reason for cancellation and advise the customer as per the reason given in the notes/comments field.

***DO NOT re-initiate a reversal for an already cancelled transaction.***

Initiate the reversal and advise on the 12 working hours SLA.

**NOTE:** For withdrawal reversals initiated between 6pm and Midnight, the reversal will be completed within 12 working hours from **9am** the next day. Those initiated between Midnight-8am, the reversal will be completed within 12 working hours from 9am, same day.

In case the reversal declines because of insufficient funds at the agent till, kindly raise an SR indicating the receipt number as below and advice the customer on the SLA of **72 hrs.**

**Category**: MPESA Services

**Type**: Reversal-No funds at Agent

**Item**: No funds at MPESA Agent dealer

# **New Withdrawal Journey with Store Number**

The Withdrawal journey with the request for Store number is available on all platforms.

Please ensure to **update the STK menu** for all the customers who call in or walk into a Retail Shop to request for a withdrawal reversal.

This can be done by following the attached steps.

If a customer has 1,000 Bytes and 1,024 Bytes SIM Sizes, please advise them to swap the SIM cards to get the SIM Card with 3,500 Bytes.

Find attached guide on how to push menu using G2.

**Reversal on till Suspended for Commission Arbitrage and Sanctioned for Six Months**

Agent to contact their respective Admins in case of further inquiries.

**If a customer call requesting for a reversal from such a till:**

Find out reason for reversal i.e., was it a withdrawal to the wrong agent, cash was not given, or customer did not have an ID.

If the customer did not have an ID or cash was not given, normal reversal process apply.

If it was withdrawal to the wrong agent, find out if customer entered agent number and store number.

If customer says yes, do not reverse. Decline the reversal request, inform customer that it is not possible to withdraw to a wrong agent after entering agent and store number and put a comment/interaction to alter the next CEE not to reverse transaction ID xxxxx as customer confirms to have entered both agent number and store number.

If customer says they only entered agent number and their menu does not have store number, update the customer’s SIM card through a menu push from M-PESA system and inform the customer.

Unsuspend the agent’s account with comments that you are unsuspending to initiate a reversal and capture the transaction ID that you want to reverse.

Initiate the reversal.

Reinstate the agency store to the previous suspended state with comments that you are reinstating the store to the previous suspended state before reversal. 

Do **NOT** send the agent to the shop for assistance.

#  **Call Center**

Query the transaction on MPESA G2

Refer to the notes captured when the reversal was cancelled.

Where the reversal was cancelled because the customer and agent were at the same location or agent insists that customer was given cash, advise the customer to report to police for follow up.

Confirm the status of the SR

i.         **Closed SR**; advise as per resolution.

ii.         **Within SLA**; advise customer on SLA

iii.         **Past SLA**; escalate via email to SR owner and CC ccsmpesa@Safaricom.co.ke

Educate the customer on Hakikisha.

# **Withdrawal Reversal Completion**

**Amounts below Ksh.1000.**

**First attempt**: Call the till, if not picked, call the administrator / the principal or the head office primary till to get consent. If you do not reach any of the parties. Send a message.

***Dear agent, we are trying to reach you regarding the reversal request for withdrawal transaction XXXXXXX. Kindly answer. Thank you.***

**Second Attempt**: Confirm whether the agent has transacted i.e., deposit transactions since the last SMS. If agent is transacting send a second SMS as below:

***Dear agent, we will finalize reversal transaction XXXXXXX within the next 1hr. Kindly answer calls to the till or contact customer care. Thank you.***

**Third Attempt**: Confirm if agent has transacted within that duration if call is still not picked **complete** the reversal.

For agents who have not transacted for several days, and both the head office principal and administrator are unreachable to give consent, it will be done manually.

**Amounts above 1000**

Call the till, if not picked, call the administrator / the principal or the head office primary till to get consent. If you do not reach any of the parties.

If the till is transacting i.e., doing deposit transactions within the day send the 1st SMS with the transaction ID to be completed.

“***Dear agent, we are trying to reach you regarding the reversal request for withdrawal transaction XXXXXXX. Kindly answer. Thank you.’’***

The call will be made again after two hours, if the call is not answered and the agent is still transacting (deposit), **FREEZE** the till.

**NOTE:** For agents calling with suspended/frozen till for not picking calls, please escalate via mail to [CCReversals@Safaricom.co.ke](mailto:CCReversals@Safaricom.co.ke) for the reversals team to get back to them indicating.

Subject; Till suspended/frozen for not picking calls.

Agent id

Agent number

Transaction id

Reason for suspension

# **Withdrawal Reversal Past SLA**

DO **NOT** raise an SR.

Assure the customer that we are making every effort to reach the wrong agent to give consent for the reversal to be actioned.

SMS notification will be sent as soon as the reversal is finalized.

**Definition**

**Daima-Keep Line Active** will enable customers to keep their numbers active for long periods of time **up to** 2 years with a single top up.

The service seeks to address the following challenges.

- Inactive lines for customers who may be travelling or living abroad for long periods.
- Students away at school
- Service men / women who are away at police or army training.
- Customers who have a change of ownership of line situation due to loss of a loved one
- For car tracking services / customers with multiple lines that they wish to keep active
- Reduce recreation requests for pooled line.

**Eligibility**

- This Service is only available to Individual Prepay customers on Uwezo Tariff (**Exempted****\- M-PESA tills & Corporates and Post Pay**).
- Prepay customers who have ported in can only activate Daima Bundles while on Uwezo Tariff and can be migrated to Uwezo Tariff at any Safaricom Retail Shop.
- A customer can only subscribe to one bundle at a time.
- The amount is deducted upfront, and the customer awarded the resources for the selected duration **at no extra cost.**

**How to Activate/Deactivate**

- Via DIY \*100\*4#, \*200#, \*444# & \*456# and App &
- Via App & Web
- Calling the contact center via the available channels using the number that needs activation/deactivation of Daima.
- By visiting Safaricom customer care/Care desk with their original document of registration (**Mandatory**).
- If a customer deactivates the service at any one point, there will be **No refunds** allowed.
- Activation of Daima can be done by the calling number and for third party via **buy for other option**.

**NB:** Third party deactivation requests are not allowed.

**How to purchase**

Customers will dial \*100\*4#, \*200#, \*444# & \*456# and App & Web([https://www.safaricom.co.ke/personal/value-added-services/other-services/daima-services](https://www.safaricom.co.ke/personal/value-added-services/other-services/daima-services) ) select Daima-Keep Line Active to purchase the product.

- A customer can purchase via Airtime, M-PESA and Bonga points on USSD and On Web & App.
- A customer can also purchase from their Fuliza limit.
- If a customer has an outstanding Okoa Jahazi, they will be prompted to pay the outstanding Okoa Jahazi debt first then proceed to purchase via M-PESA.
- Both Prepay & Post pay customers, can purchase Daima for another number via USSD \*100\*4# > Daima-Keep Line Active select **Buy for Other option**.
- A customer cannot purchase Daima for another number if the other number **(party B)** has an outstanding Okoa Jahazi debt.
- A customer can only subscribe to one Daima-Keep Line Active at a time.
- Daima purchases are not reversible

**How to activate/deactivate when roaming**

A customer can activate /deactivate Daima via DIY USSD \*100\*4#, \*200#, \*444# & \*456# and App & Web([https://www.safaricom.co.ke/personal/value-added-services/other-services/daima-services](https://www.safaricom.co.ke/personal/value-added-services/other-services/daima-services) ) while roaming and has sufficient airtime.

Where unable to activate/deactivate due to restrictions of the country they are in, the customer can request a third party to do the activation for them via the **Buy For Other option** on USSD, reach Customer care on; **Tel: +254722002100 /** Social media handles or send an email to customercare@safaricom.co.ke

**Packages for** **Daima-Keep Line Active are as below**

| Price | Resources | Recurring Period |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Kshs. 200 | 20 minutes and 20 SMS per month | 6 months |
| Kshs. 500 | 20 minutes and 20 SMS per month | 1 year |
| Kshs. 1000 | 20 minutes and 20 SMS per month | 2 years |

**Checking Daima-Keep Line Active Resources balance**

To check balance, customers will send the word BAL to 144.

**How the resources can be used**

The customer can use the resources to make both off-net & on-net calls /send off-net & on-net SMS but cannot sambaza the resources (Minutes and SMS).

**Resources rollover**

The resources do not roll over.

**Priority of usage**

Tunukiwa airtime and minutes or any other resources with a shorter validity period will take precedence over Daima resources.

**Accumulation of Bonga points**

The customer will earn Bonga when they Activate Daima according to the Bonga terms and condition.

**Accumulation of Storo Bonus**

A customer will accumulate Storo bonus once they purchase Daima.

**NB:** This applies only to customers who have subscribed into the service.

**Daima-Keep Line Active validity**

Expiry will be indicated on the offer name.

**Expiry of** **Daima-Keep Line Active**

Once Daima expires, the normal lifecycle rules which depend on the last voucher recharge validity will apply and can be deleted for top up failure.

**NB:** This applies only to customers who have subscribed into the service.

# **Definition**.

- This is a self - service that allows existing customers to reset their M-PESA PIN on demand. The customer will be required to answer preset questions    to verify ownership and reset their PIN.
- Resetting your M-PESA PIN is usually a fast process and can be done in just a few minutes after verifying your identity and choosing a new PIN while using the registered phone number that is linked to the M-PESA account for security purposes.

# **Availability.**

This service is available to all active M-PESA accounts.

# **How to set Up Security Questions and Answers.**

- Dial \*334#OK **>** Select My Account **\>** M-PESA PIN Manager **\>** M-PESA Forgot Pin **>** Enter ID/Passport **\>** Security Questions **>** Answers to Security Questions.
- This is a mandatory requirement. Customers who have not set up security questions will need to contact Call Center or visit Safaricom Shop for assistance.

# **How to reset M-PESA PIN.**

*On your phone/handset:*

- ***Dial*** *\*334#*
- ***Select*** *My Account*
- ***Selec****t* *M-PESA PIN Manager* 
- ***Select*** *M-PESA Forgot PIN* 
- ***Enter*** *your* *ID/Passport number.*
- ***Enter*** *answers to the security questions if already set.*
- ***Enter*** *New PIN* 
- *Confirm the Reset M-PESA PIN* 
- *Customer shall receive a notification message indicating that they have successfully reset their M-PESA PIN.*  

Please note that this procedure will work only where a customer had set the questions and answers before the rest is requested.

# **Mechanics.**

- A customer can attempt to reset their M-PESA PIN up to **three times** on \*334# per Day.
- After a successful SIM Swap, M-PESA PIN Reset cannot be used until after 7 days.
- Setting up security questions and answers is a mandatory requirement. Customers who have not set up security questions will need to contact Call Center or visit Safaricom Shop for assistance.
- If a customer is unable to reset their M-PESA PIN, check that they are following the correct process, entering the correct ID number and creating a new PIN. 
- If a customer forgets the set questions and answers, advise them to visit the Nearest Safaricom Shop with Original ID Card/Passport for assistance.

# **Support or more information**

- For any queries or support, reach out to Safaricom customer care:
- Call: 100 (Prepaid) or 200 (Postpaid)
- Email: customercare@safaricom.co.ke
- Social media: @SafaricomPLC on X and Facebook (Safaricom PLC)
- Safaricom Shop

**Step–By–Step procedure and requirements.**

## **Compensation Guidelines**

## This process outlines compensation procedures on the FTTH portfolio.

The compensation can either be done as a data bundle or cash back on below scenarios.

New connections delays.

Individual outage.

Global outage.

Try and Buy (5days)

## **New Connection delays compensation.**

For every newly registered / acquired customer, a remedy CRQ ticket is raised to the relevant contractor for installation works to commence.

Contractor will contact the customer within 24 hours for planning, and schedule installation, based on customers availability and preferred timings within 48 Hrs.

System will auto pick the remedy ticket timestamp and start a time count to ascertain timely connections and identify delayed SLA status.

Any CRQ past 48hrs SLA that is not yet connected is auto processed for 1GB bundle award via Tibco service every day.

The allocation will be done daily until customer is connected or for a maximum of three days.

Affected clients receive notifications upon every award.

Data Bundle award will be done to the customer who is the registered primary contact for the Fiber account.

Automated BI reports on award status are available on Qlik sense reports.

## **Individual LOS (Loss of Service) compensation.**  

This is applicable to compensation of individual reports of LOS, affected active customers are compensated with 5GB Wema bundles at the point of experiencing downtime and Cash back if the issue is not sorted within the 24hrs SLA.

## **Automated Bundle compensation.**

The SOC tool will automatically ticket, notify and compensate the customer when they experience an outage.

The Wema Compensation bundle awarded is 5GB valid for 24hrs.

Upon restoration the SOC tool will send an uptime notification to the customer.

When the ticket goes beyond the stipulated SLA the customer will received an additional 5GB Wema Bundle every 24hrs until the ticket is resolved and closed.

## **Manual Bundle compensation on CRM.**

Where a customer calls to report an individual LOS the L400 CEE will check on the SOC tool to confirm ticketing and bundle award has been done.

Where the bundle has been awarded the L400 CEE will advise the customer which number received the Wema bundle in the format 0711\*\*\*999 (masking the starred digits due to data protection policy).

The SOC tool will notify the customer on the 6th Minute and award the 5GB Wema bundle on the 15th Minute.

Where the downtime is past the 15th Minute and no ticket has been raised, L400 CEE will confirm that the customer is active in terms of payment.

L400 CEE shall raise an incident to the contractor handling the region where customer resides and advise the customer on the 24hrs SLA.

CEE shall proceed to award the customer 5GB Wema data bundle valid for 24hrs.

Where the ticket has automatically been raised but the customer has not been awarded Wema bundles the CEE shall proceed to award the customer 5GB Wema data bundle valid for 24hrs.

The bundle will be awarded to the customer’s registered primary contact for the Fiber account or to a number they will nominate.

The dispatch team shall contact the customer to agree on the site visit timelines based on best available time slots.

The technician shall visit the site for troubleshooting and issue resolution.

The technician shall advise customer, accordingly, confirm service is up and close ticket. SLA for resolution is within 24 Hrs.

Where LOS is not resolved within 48Hrs; customers shall be compensated with 5 GB Wema bundle valid for 24Hrs every day until closure of customer issue.

If a customer visits retail, the retail CEE shall confirm that the customer is active in terms of payment and escalate the issue to L400 team via email to [copsftth@safaricom.co.ke](mailto:copsftth@safaricom.co.ke)

The retail CEE will capture the customer’s FTTH account, contact and summary of customers issue, and advise customer on the 2hrs SLA.

## **Cash Back Compensation.**

This compensation applies to the customers’ whose LOS is not resolved within the agreed SLA of 24hrs.

CEE will capture the individual compensation request based on the resolution timelines on the incident ticket raised and escalate to the retention team for the cashback compensation to be done.

For any request logged to any touch point other than L400 in the call centre or retail, customer will be advised on the FTTH support and CEE will escalate to L400 team via an  email to [copsftth@safaricom.co.ke](mailto:copsftth@safaricom.co.ke).

Daily tracking & reconciliation will be done by Retention team within the customer operations, to monitor tickets are closed within SLA as promised to the customer.

Retention team will reference to data captured and verify the ticket was closed past SLA for compensation.

The Retention team will raise an incident and capture the below details for each customer.

Customer account no.

Amount to be compensated.

Hours of downtime

Customer’s package.

Incident No. for each customer on the list.

Customer will be compensated by the Fixed data strategy and governance team, for individual LOS at equivalent daily rate of package subscribed from time of logging complaint, until ticket is closed.

Customer compensation will be calculated based on current subscribed home Fiber package, exclusive of VAT & excise duty and credit to the affected customer’s account(s).

This will be done on CRM via bulk loading, as per Incident raised for the bulk compensation.

Customers will be notified of the cash back to their accounts via SMS, as soon as accounts are credited on CRM.

The customer will utilize the funds equivalent to days of service lost, as compensation on their next bill payment/ service renewal.

Weekly report for all compensated LOS, by date & technician will be generated every Monday by home retention team and shared with relevant stakeholders i.e., the home Technology Customer management team, Experience team and Sales team.

Service credit penalty will be applied by Home Technology for all delayed tickets past 24hrs, where no valid reasons / justification for delays are noted.

Data bundles will not be transferable and are valid for 24hrs.

## **Global reported Outages.** 

They involve outages affecting ports, OLTs, BNG’s and Planned Maintenance compensation.

## **Automated Bundle compensation.**

The SOC tool will automatically ticket, notify and compensate the customer when they experience an outage.

The Wema Compensation bundle awarded is 5GB valid for 24hrs.

Upon restoration the SOC tool will send an uptime notification to the customer.

When the ticket goes beyond the stipulated SLA the customer will received an additional 5GB Wema Bundle every 24hrs until the ticket is resolved and closed.

## **Bundle compensation.**

Where loss of service is noted, L400 CEE shall trouble shoot to confirm if the same is a global outage affecting many customers.

Customers contacting any touch points other than L400, will be advised on FTTH support channels and CEE will escalate to L400 team via email to copsftth@safaricom.co.ke.

Where issue is noted to be affecting many users or a global outage, CEE shall advise the Line 400 folder lead in Customer Operations on duty who will alert the SOC team to assist raise an incident on BMC.

SOC team will raise an incident to the contractor who will visit site for troubleshooting and resolution within 4 Hours SLA.

L400 Folder Lead will liaise with the SOC team, extract the affected customers from NMS and send notification via SMS to the affected customers if the automated notifications from OWS fail.

L400 folder team lead shall filter the affected active customers from NMS and award with 5GB Wema Bundles if the automated bundle award from SOC tool fails to be awarded.

On fault resolution, technician shall notify SOC, accordingly, confirm service is up and close ticket.

SOC shall advise L400 for subsequent communication of service restoration to affected customers on mail if its noted service resumption notification from SOC tool fail.

## **Cash back Compensation.**

**Outages affecting ports, OLTs, BNG’s and Planned Maintenance. (Global Outage)**

This is applicable for cash back compensation for global outages and will be considered for all faults not resolved within 4 hrs. SLA and will be considered as one day of lost service based on customer’s active package.

Daily tracking & reconciliation will be done by Retention team within the Fixed Data Tribe, to monitor that tickets are closed within SLA as promised to the customer.

The Home Retention team will raise an incident, capture details of the affected customers.

The Fixed Data Tribe will credit the funds calculated to the affected customer account(s) on CRM via bulk loading, as per Incident raised for the bulk compensation.

Customers will be notified of the cash back to their accounts via SMS, as soon as accounts are credited on CRM.

The customer will utilize the funds equivalent to days of service lost, as discount on their next bill payment/ Service renewal.

Weekly report for all compensations by date & contractor will be generated every Monday by home retention team and shared with relevant stakeholders i.e., the home Technology Customer management team, Experience team and Sales team.

Service credit penalty will be applied by Home Technology for all delayed tickets past 4hrs, where no valid reasons / justification for delays are noted.

## **Cash Back compensation rules and guidelines.**

Customers shall be compensated based on current rate for package they have subscribed to.

For Multiple port failures and / or Fiber cuts, customers will be compensated for outages that are longer than 4Hrs.  This will be considered as one day of lost service.

For LOS, customers will be compensated from time of incident raising till resolution& ticket is closed.

## **FTTH 5 Day Try and Buy compensation.**                  

This is compensation offer given out to customers who have dropped off or are inactive due to the following reasons.

Experience issues e.g., intermittent, slow speeds for troubleshooting where the customer is inactive.

Internal delays on payment via Cheque/EFT

## **Scenario 1- Line 400**

Customer will contact L400 to report any of the above experience issues.

Line 400 CEE will vet the customer report and validate persistent issue using various systems.

Upon verification of customer complaint L400 CEE will raise an SR detailing customer experience and request for 5 Day Try and Buy discount award. 

Line 400 CEE will inform the customer on escalation of their issue for resolution.

Line 400 folder lead doing SR will award customer the 5 Day Try and Buy discount offer and close SR.

Product will be allocated, and customer informed.

Where the L400 CEE cannot confirm the payment, the CEE will award the 5 Day Try and Buy discount offer, advice the customer on the discount and inform on the escalation to the point of payment to resolve the pending free month(s).

Customer will be informed to use USSD payment option for the next payment as opposed to other payment options.

## **Scenario 2- Retention Team.**

Retention team will establish a customer drop off or inactivity due to

Reported Experience issues e.g., Frequent downtimes, intermittent service, and slow speeds. The award will enable troubleshooting where the customer is inactive.

The manager upon reviewing escalated cases shall approve award of try and buy to enable troubleshooting.

Retention team will engage the customer through outbound calls and inform the customer of the 5 Day Try and Buy pending issue resolution and pick the customer’s issue for resolution.

Once the issue is resolved the Try and Buy is removed and customer advised to pay, if the issue persist the Try and buy will is not removed until issue is fully resolved.

Customer will be informed to use USSD or APP or POS payment option for the next payment upon expiry of the Try and Buy product as opposed to via M-PESA Paybill option since this has limitations to restoring customer to their previous package.

Product will be awarded, and a communication is done to the customer via SMS on the awarded discount.

Issue will be resolved, customer informed and confirms uptime, then Interaction will be raised detailing the discount.

## **Scenario 3- Fixed Customer Management Team**

Customer Management team will receive an escalation on customer intermittent experience issues with FTTH.

The team will vet the escalation and engage the customer to establish whether the issue is rampant and award 5 Day Try and Buy pending resolution of the issue.

Customer will be informed of the Try and Buy award as the team picks the issue for resolution.

Issue will be resolved; customer informed and confirms uptime.

## **Recurring LOS Experience Recovery Engagements.**

Every week, home retention team, will compile list of customers with recurring LOS who have been compensated.

This list will be followed up for conclusive resolution of affected customers to avoid attrition/ churn.

Customers adversely affected by recurrent LOS, whether as an individual or as residents with a specific area will qualify for an approved discount on their monthly bill as part of recovery initiative.

Trade teams &/or COPs &/or Segments &/or Home Tribe &/or Fixed Solutions will engage customers on-ground in recovery activities where an estate is adversely affected.

Service Clinics / Trade teams visits will kick in for such cases and these customers will be managed on hyper care until issue affecting them is conclusively resolved.

## **Reporting**

# Daily, weekly & monthly reports for 5GB Wema bundle, compensations and discounting will be shared by the home retention team. This will be done via email reports to relevant stakeholders.

# **Reports will be generated to include.** 

MSISDN’s registered per CI.

Date and time of service unavailability,

Restoration time.

Total GB amounts awarded for period of LOS.

Total Cash credited to customer account for period of LOS.

Total discount awarded for period of LOS (for experience recovery initiative).

## **Data Privacy/Information Protection**

**Categories of personal information collected.**

The scope of data to be processed for include:

Name of the customer

Customers MSIDNS

Account number

Estate and House Number

The data is collected from customer’s reporting.

No sensitive special categories of personal information are necessary for Safaricom to process e.g., religious beliefs, political affiliations, health, biometric (voice, facial recognition, or fingerprint), sexual orientation.

## **Lawful basis for processing**

| Use | Processing Required | Data to be processed | Evidence for Lawful basis |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| compensation of outage | Identification and calculation of the outage | Name of the customerCustomers MSIDNSAccount numberCustomer’s location | Customer accepted TCs.Public interestIt is Required by law |

**Systems/applications used and the storage limitation requirements.**

The data will be stored in CRM and M-PESA G2.

## **Data Sharing**

The data is purely for consumption within Safaricom and will only be shared with any third-party organizations or entities on need be basis.

## **Access control- who has access to this data.**

CEE, L400 team, Retention team, compensation team, Contractors

articleTitle: Calls and SMS Product Information & Mechanics
markdownContent:
# **DEFINITION**

Call and SMS with no Expiry is a product that allows all Safaricom customers to purchase SMS’s and call time that do not expire.

- The Customer is awarded extra airtime which is different from the normal airtime recharged and will not count when buying other Safaricom products. Instead, this airtime includes a 50% bonus and can only be used for making on-net and off-net calls or SMS at the normal rates.

# **KEY FEATURES**

- Call and SMS product have no Expiry On USSD but the EXPIRY product is available on APP and web.  
- Customer can buy once or select auto renew. 
- The awarded airtime will be an accumulation of the amount the customer entered and the 50% extra airtime. 
- Prevailing calling rates: The current prevailing rates will apply for the following activities.

 NB:- **Please note Calls and SMS No Expiry option will only be available on APP and Web**

**LOCAL CALL CHARGES** 
**Uwezo tariff allows Prepay subscribers to enjoy calls at:**

- Ksh 4.87/- per minute (8am-10pm on peak hours)
- Ksh 2.2/- per minute (10pm-8am off peak hours) for all Safaricom-to-Safaricom calls (ON-NET)
- Kshs. 4.87/- per minute for all calls to other local networks (OFF-NET), all day every day.

# **SMS CHARGES**

- Kshs.1.20/- Safaricom to Safaricom (ON-NET), and for Safaricom to other networks (OFF-NET) per SMS
- International SMS charges Kshs. 10/-

**Note:**

The customer will not use calls and SMS to make international calls or send international SMS.

# **ALLOCATION OF 50%- 100% EXTRA AIRTIME**

**Successful Allocation of Extra Airtime**

- The airtime is allocated once customer completes the purchase. The allocation is done as elaborated in the 2 examples below: 
- A customer who has 100/- airtime balance on their account and uses 50/- to purchase the Calls and SMS Airtime; will be awarded 50% of 50/- i.e., 25/- plus the 50/- as Calls and SMS Airtime. As a result, they will have 75/- for use for local calls and SMS and 50/- for use for the other activities. The 75/- will be available under Account Balance and the 50/- will be available on prepaid Balance on IN Data. 
- A customer who has 100/- airtime balance on their account and uses 100/- to purchase the Calls and SMS Airtime; will be awarded 50% of 100/- i.e., 150/- Calls and SMS Airtime. As a result, they will have 100/- for use for local calls and SMS and 50/- for use for the other activities. The 150/- will be available under Account Balance and the 0/- will be available on Prepaid Balance on IN Data.

**Failed Allocation of Extra Airtime**

In case a customer is not allocated the Extra Airtime after a purchase:

- The CEE will confirm if it is a global outage. 
- If not, escalate via SR (Service Request) to 2nd line support and give the **SLA 24hrs**.  
- The 2nd line support team will allocate the bundle and advise the customer.

# **RESOURCE USAGE INFORMATION**

**Usage Priority**

The Resource usage will follow the below prioritization depending on the resources the customer is subscribed to:

- Storo Bonus that expires at midnight 
- Tunukiwa minutes and airtime with an expiry date (24hrs,48hrs & 7 days) 
- Okoa airtime 
- All other resources with expiry dates 
- 50%-100% Extra airtime for Calls and SMS  
- Main account for airtime

**Applicable usage /Services offered**

Calls and SMS with no expiry can perform the below services:

- Make local on-net and off-net calls. 
- Send local on-net and off-net SMS. 
- To receive reverse calls 
- To make local VoLTE calls 
- Amount used to purchase the Calls and SMS will contribute to Storo bonus' daily count.

**Services not applicable/not** **offered**

The Call and SMS with no Expiry will not be able to offer below services:

- Will not be used for subscriptions like Skiza or PRS 
- Cannot be Transferred / Sambaza 
- The airtime cannot be used for out of bundle data browsing. 
- Cannot be used while roaming. 
- Cannot be used to make international calls and send SMS’s. 
- Will not be used to repay Okoa Airtime Debt 
- Cannot be used to buy E-Paper 
- The Extra airtime awarded for Calls and SMS with no expiry **will not accumulate to Storo Bonus.** But the Amount used to purchase the Calls and SMS will contribute to Storo bonus' daily count.

**Purchases with Pending ETU**

- If party A (sponsor) buys a bundle for party B (Recipient) and party B has an Okoa debt, there will be no deduction to repay Part B (recipient’s) debt from Part A (sponsor).
- If party A (sponsor) buys a bundle for party B (Recipient) and party A has an Okoa debt, there will be a deduction from Part A to repay Okoa debt. Okoa amount will show the actual Okoa debt.
- If party A is buying calls & SMS’s (No EXPIRY) bundle via M-PESA and has Okoa Debt, the deduction will be applied. Okoa amount will show the actual Okoa debt plus the bundle amount.

# **CALL AND SMS REVERSAL GUIDELINE**

**Applicable Conditions for Reversal**

- Wrong amount purchase 
- Wrong product purchased. 
- Multiple /Duplicate purchases

**Non-Applicable Conditions for Reversal**

- Third party reversals will **not** be reversed.  
- Partial reversal will **not** be applicable, advice the customer to top up the difference where airtime is partially utilized.

This process is applicable where the customer requests for their M-PESA account to be closed. 

i.         The current owner of the mobile number shall present himself/herself to any Safaricom shops.

ii.         Requests from a 3rd party shall not be accepted.   

iii.         The CEE shall confirm the account closure requests and shall vet the customer using their ID against the details on M-PESA G2 and CRM. 

iv.         Where the customer passes the vetting, the CEE shall:

Advise the customer shall fill in the M-PESA account closure form 

Confirm if the line is registered to any FSI accounts 

Advise the customer to pay any pending loans

v.         The CEE shall advise the customer to opt out of all FSIs and shall confirm that the customer has opted out.

iii.         CEE shall attach the scanned copies (both sides where the documents have 2 sides) of the stamped M-PESA Closure form and IDs on CRM at the account level, and file customer documents as per the filing procedure.

iv.         CEE shall advise the customer on the closure of the account. 

v.         CEE shall enter a detailed interaction on Siebel CRM. 

vi.         CEE shall engage subscriber to confirm satisfactory service has been offered, thanks the customer for the visit and closes the service. 

# **Where customer has M-Shwari and KCB M-PESA**

# **M-Shwari Only** 

i.         The CEE shall advise the customer to withdraw their funds/pay any pending loans.  

ii.         The CEE shall recycle the account on CRM.

iii.         CEE shall validate customer has no other FSI’s I.e. KCB M-PESA and shall recycled the M-PESA account after confirmation M-Shwari account is closed.

iv.         CEE shall perform a SIM-Swap for the customer. 

v.         CEE shall attach the scanned stamped copies of the presented documents (both sides where the documents have 2 sides) on CRM at the account level, and file customer documents as per the filing procedure. All the documents filled by the customer must be stamped with the respective outlet’s stamp.  

vi.         CEE shall enter a detailed interaction on Siebel CRM. 

vii.         CEE advice customer accordingly.

viii.         CEE shall engage subscriber to confirm satisfactory service has been offered, thanks the customer for the visit and closes the service. 

# **KCB M-PESA Only** 

i.         Where customer has KCB M-PESA the CEE shall not recycle M-PESA.

ii.         CEE shall validate customer has no other FSI’s.

iii.         The CEE shall advise the customer to withdraw their funds/pay any pending loans. 

iv.         The CEE shall do a SIM replacement for the new owner of the line but shall advise customer not to activate the M-PESA Account. The customer shall be advised once M-PESA account is recycled. 

v.         CEE shall raise an SR for the recycling of the M-PESA account and KCB Account, attach customers ID (both sides) and indicate the reason for recycling.

# **KCB M-PESA and M-SHWARI**

i.         Where account has both M-SHWARI and KCB the CEE shall; 

Close M-SHWARI 

Not recycle M-PESA

Raise an SR for KCB Closure and M-PESA Account recycling. 

ii.         CEE shall validate customer has no other FSI’s.

iii.         The CEE shall advise the customer to withdraw their funds/pay any pending loans. 

iv.         The CEE shall recycle the M-SHWARI account on CRM.

v.         The CEE shall do a SIM replacement for the new owner of the line but shall advise customer not to activate the M-PESA Account. The customer shall be advised once KCB M-PESA and M-PESA accounts are recycled. 

vi.         CEE shall raise an SR for the recycling of the M-PESA account and KCB Account, attach customers ID (both sides) and indicate the reason for recycling.cus

## **Bulk SMS Definition**

- This is a Value-Added Service (VAS) which allows corporates and SMEs to send high or low volumes of non-premium SMSs quickly and efficiently to staff and customers.
- This product addresses the customers’ need of sending mass communication to a large audience conveniently and effectively.
- These are one-way broadcasts.
- Clients buy SMSs in bulk at a minimum of 3,300 SMSs with no upper limit.

## **Eligibility**

This product is available to both Prepay and Post-pay customers.

## **How to Apply for Safaricom Bulk SMS Service**

You can **sign up** for Bulk SMS by:

- Contacting your assigned contact person in Safaricom.
- Sending an email to [**Corporatesales@safaricom.co.ke**](mailto:Corporatesales@safaricom.co.ke) for Corporate customers or [**Partnerships@safaricom.co.ke**](mailto:Partnerships@safaricom.co.ke) for SMEs.

New customers will be required to fill in a Bulk SMS application form as well as pass on the following documents to their assigned contact person at Safaricom Business.

- Business Permit/Trade license.
- Owner ID.

Customers will fill in a Bulk SMS application form, sign the Bulk SMS Terms & Conditions and deliver it to their contact person at Safaricom.

## **Features of Safaricom Bulk SMS Solution**

- You can send a message of up to 160 characters per SMS.
- You can send Bulk SMS to an unlimited contact list.
- You can send your Bulk SMS message with your Branded Sender ID
- It has the fastest time to market.
- Provides personalized messaging.
- It has instant delivery of messages.
- Safaricom Business provides detailed reporting of all sent messages.
- Has a validity period from 45 days.

## **How to Send Bulk SMS**

The customer will be given access to the Safaricom Bulk SMS portal, which will enable them to send out messages to their customers.

## **Charges**

- The messages are free of charge to the recipient.
- The cost is covered by the Corporate sending the SMS.
- For the corporate, it will depend on volume of SMS the organization requests to be sent out.

## **Current Bulk SMS Pricing Model**

| One-Off SMS Alphanumeric Code Set-up Fees per MNO | Kshs 6,300 incl. of Tax |

## **SMS Cost (volume based) as per table below:**

articleTitle: Voice SMS and Multimedia Messaging Service (MMS) definition and features
markdownContent:
# **Voice SMS**

# **Definition**

This is a service that allows customers to send audible messages to other **Safaricom subscribers only**.

Voice SMS gives you an alternative method to messaging and if you feel you have a message where it's better said, than typed, Voice SMS is the perfect solution.

# **How to Send Voice SMS**

To send a voice SMS add a 1 before the number. e.g. to send a voice SMS to 0722123456, dial **10722123456** and press the call button.

# **Charges**

A voice SMS costs Ksh.3.50 to send.

When retrieving for the first time, dial 211 for free.

In case you want to retrieve the message again, dial 311 at a cost of Ksh.2.

Customers will be notified by SMS once they’ve received a Voice SMS at no charge.

# **To Retrieve a new Voice SMS**

Dial 211.

1st Retrieval is FREE.

Subsequent retrievals for the same message are charged at Ksh.2 per message.

# **To retrieve an old voice SMS:**

Dial 311.

Kshs.2 per retrieval.

# **New voice SMS**

Unread voice SMS expire after 72 hours.

# **Old Voice SMS**

An already read Voice SMS has an expiry period of 15 days.

# **Eligibility**

- It is eligible to both Prepay and Post Pay.
- Applicable to **Safaricom network only**.

# **Customer is unable to send a Voice SMS**

Check to confirm:

- Customer is following the correct procedure.
- Has enough airtime.
- Is sending the voice SMS to a Safaricom number.
- Raise an SR in case of any challenges.

# **Customer is unable to retrieve a Voice SMS** 

Check to confirm:

- Customer is using the correct procedure for either an old SMS or new SMS.
- Customer has enough airtime for an old SMS.
- Raise an SR in case of any challenges.

**NB****:** Maximum Voice SMS capacity for each subscriber (inclusive of both new & read Voice SMS) is 5 minutes.

# **Multimedia Messaging Service (MMS)**

# **Definition**

This is a message service that allows a variety of message elements to be sent to a user across all networks.

# **Eligibility**

- It is eligible to all customers Prepay and Postpay.
- Customer should have a handset that is MMS enabled.

# **Sending an MMS**

- Open the item to send e.g. image.
- Select options.
- Select send via multimedia.
- Enter the number to send to.
- Select send.

# **Unable to Send or Open an Mms**

- Ensure customer has correct MMS settings on handset.
- Ensure the customer is using a handset that supports the service.
- If customer has met all the conditions raise an SR.

# **How the Service Works**

This is based on common Internet technologies currently supported on a variety of content types which would include:

Plain Text (applies also to long texts).

Animations, Photographs, pictures as GIF, JPEG, PNG.

Screensavers.

Greeting cards, business cards.

Maps.

Cartoons, sounds and in future streaming audio and video.

Users with MMS enabled phones can compose their own messages, receive rich content messages from content providers and forward them onto their own contacts.

A Multimedia Message can be sent to an email address.

It has many similarities to rich email content but delivered in a mobile friendly way.

In fact, MMS uses email technologies to underpin the technical capabilities.

Some aspects of MMS will exceed standard email capabilities e.g. true control over sequences which conventional email doesn't handle.

Compared to SMS the experience is far superior especially with devices with color displays, sound, text and picture sequences.

With content adaptation, MMS sent from one phone can be viewed on another phone without major picture distortion.

An MMS could parallel an email message - might normally appear near instantaneous but could be delayed by load on servers and by who's sending from where to where or by network outages. It is not however designed to be real time.

# **Examples of MMS**

- Taking a snapshot via a camera phone and sending to a friend.
- Receiving cartoon strips.
- Composing your own animated picture messages and sending to friends.
- Sending audio files.
- Sending pictures & audio files with simultaneous playback.
- Advertising.
- Music download & play.
- Storing pictures to an online album.
- Remote surveillance.

# **Charges**

| Size | Price On-Net (Kshs) | Price Off-Net (Kshs) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0-100 Kb | 3.5 | 8 |
| 101-200 Kb | 7 | 16 |
| 201-300 Kb | 10.5 | 24 |

#  **NB:**

- The MMS must be a maximum of 300 kb.
- Below SMS will appear if the phone does not support the functionality, you will need to access the internet to access the MMS. 
 **"MMS from 072xxxxxxx. Please browse http://mms.gprs.safaricom.com/mms with Multimedia ID: (specified in SMS) and Password: (specified in SMS)".**

# **Difference between MMS and EMS**

- EMS is delivered via SMS, and this means it can be very costly and is using limited control channel capacity in a GSM network.
- EMS also supports picture messaging/ animation, but MMS is much more capable of serving up multiple media together and you would not enjoy the experience of more complex media e.g. photographs, sound and video.

- **Predictable payment timelines:** Invoices will be issued on the 1st of the month, with payments due by the last day of the month.
- **Immediate pro-rated invoices** **for changes:** for scenarios like service upgrades, downgrades, or reactivation, prorated charges will be billed immediately instead of waiting for the next billing cycle.

**Scenarios You Need to Know:**

| Scenario: | Previous Billing Process | New Simplified Billing Process: |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Sign-upYou’ve signed up for the Business Fibre 15 plan at KES 3,000 on January 15, 2025. You are required to pay a service deposit PLUS your 1-month subscription fee. | An Invoice for KES 3,000, which includes:KES 3,000 for the 1st month | Subscription Invoice: issued the day after signup, due by January 31.1st Month’s Invoice: KES 3,000 on February 1, due by February 28.Recurring Invoice of KES 3,000 on the 1st of each month, payable by the last day of the month. |

| ResumptionYour subscription payment for the Business Fibre 15 plan at KES 3,000 is overdue and the link is suspended Assumption: A payment is received on 15th of January and the link automatically resumes connectivity. | A combined invoice on February 1 for KES 4,500 which includes: KES 1,500 the prorated amount for 16th to 31st January KES 3,000 for the month of February. | Receive an invoice on 16th January due on 31st January. KES 1,500 the prorated amount for 16th to 31st January |
| Service UpgradeYou decide to upgrade your service from the KES 3,000 Business Fibre 15 plan to the KES 5,000 Business Fibre 50 plan on January 15, 2025. | A combined invoice on February 1 for KES 6,500 which includes: KES 1,500 the prorated charges for the January 15–31 upgrade period.KES 5,000 for the full February cycle. | New Invoice: issued on January 16 with a net increase of KES 1,000 (Month’s usage of 1st-15th January Kes 1,500 and usage of 16th to 31st January Kes 2500 = Kes.4,000 less Kes 3,000) due by January 31st. 1st Month’s Invoice: KES 5,000 on February 1, due by February 28.Recurring Invoice of Kes 5,000 on the 1st of each month, payable by the last day of the month. |

**What Does This Mean for Customers?**

- **Simpler & transparent billing:** invoices will clearly separate prorated and recurring charges.
- **Predictable payments:** customers will have consistent invoice and payment timelines.
- **Timely invoicing:** changes like upgrades, downgrades, or reactivation will result in immediate prorated invoices.

articleTitle: Fraudulently registered lines and Escalation guideline on Subscriber registration at the retail centers / care desk and franchise stores
markdownContent:
# **Fraudulently registered lines and Escalation guideline on Subscriber registration at the retail centers / care desk and franchise stores**

Where customer reports fraudulent use of their ID for line registration, or where during trouble shooting CEE identifies a fraudulently registered line.

CEE will request the customer to present their original ID.

- CEE will query customer ID(s)on Partner App and will proceed to probe customer on lines registered under their name / ID.
- CEE will request customer to list all lines known to them.
- CEE will use available systems i.e., Parner App, CRM and MPESA G2 to identify any irregular registration and will assure customer action will be taken where any irregularity is noted.
- CEE will however not share with the customer any details of the lines registered using their ID’s, and not known to them.
- If the customer insists on knowing the numbers Advise them to use \*106# also explain to the customer on data privacy clauses
- CEE will proceed to suspend line on CRM and capture interaction, where any line is identified as fraudulently registered.
- Where line is registered on M-PESA, CEE will freeze the account at the account level after vetting and indicate clear notes on reason for action.
- Where account is/was actively used to transact, and funds are available. CEE will suspend M-PESA at the account level after effective vetting and add notes on reason for the same where customer fail vetting . CEE will not raise an SR for the same.
- No customer details will be disclosed to the registered user for lines unknown to them.
- CEE will confirm whether there’s any loan or where the customer reports that a disputed line has taken a loan with any lending company.
- CEE will raise an SR to the fraud team in the following categories and capture the details below.

**Category: Fraud Escalation**

**Type: Pick appropriate**

**Item: Pick appropriate**

**Comments: include the information below:**

Line that took the loan.

Period when loan was taken.

- Loan lending organization e.g., KCB M-PESA/Fuliza/ Timiza etc.
- Amount taken.
- CEE will capture interaction and detail the action taken and applicable vetting applied.

**CEE will enter key comments on CRM, where applicable.**

# **Unbarring of lines reported as irregularly registered at retail/ care desk and franchise****.**

Where the customer requests for unsuspension of a line, CEE will engage customer to present their ID. (Original document of registration)

CEE will vet customer using 2nd level vetting as below to validate ownership prior to resuming account.

CEE will Confirm the Customer’s name, ID number against Patner App and M-PESA, and at least 3 of the below details:

Three (3) frequently dialled numbers. (Mandatory if line has been in use)

M-PESA details (if customer is registered) i.e., M-PESA balance, date of registration, details of self-initiated transactions. (Mandatory if line has been in use)

The Service Interaction: Type and date of previous escalation request on the line (e.g., SIM swap, over scratched, unbarring line)

PIN / PUK Certificate.

Date (month or year) of registration.

Where CEE confirms ownership, they will proceed to unbar customer and advice accordingly.

Where applicable change of ownership process will apply i.e., in cases where customer registered line on behalf of someone else.

CEE will raise an interaction and will capture details of action taken and customer ID details.

For the unbarring of lines reported as registered fraudulently after vetting attach the ID on Siebel under account level then link it to the order that resumed the line

No customer details will be disclosed to the registered user for lines unknown to them.

# **Registration of special numbers/ golden numbers.**

- This is only applicable at retail outlets.
- Special numbers will be registered on the APP after pairing on Siebel/ CRM and subsequent payment on POS where applicable.
- Number management process will apply, for new and recreated lines.

# **How to change or delete primary notification number at retail centres during subscriber registration.**

This is applicable where customer requests for change of primary notification number or where there’s need to delete existing notification number.

# **Change of primary notification number****.**

This is viable for below reasons:

- Irregular registration.
- Change of number to a preferred number registered to the same customer. i.e., lost MSISDN, used by a minor, data line etc.
- Anomaly in the primary notification number. i.e., number not registered to the customer etc.

# **Action for Call Centre CEE****.**

Refer customer to Retail with their Original ID document of registration.

# **Action for Retail CEE****.**

Vet and confirm validity of customer request and Original ID/valid Passport/Military ID/Alien ID.

Where irregular registration is noted, CEE will suspend the line(s) as per the applicable irregular registration procedure.

CEEs will confirm ownership using the vetting parameters below and proceed to change the primary number.

# **Vetting details.**

At least 3 of the below details: -

- Three **(3)** frequently dialled numbers. Each number should be recorded as a mobile originating (MO) and must appear in three months. (Mandatory if line has been in use)
- M-PESA details where customer is registered. Either M-PESA balance, details of **2 self-initiated transactions**, FSI limits i.e., M-Shwari, Fuliza, KCB MPESA (Mandatory if line has been in use), date (month or year) of registration.
- Service Interaction, type, and date of previous successful escalation request on the line (e.g., SIM swap, over scratched, unbarring line).
- Airtime balance or data bundle balance or Bundle plan or account limits i.e., Storo bonus.
- Pin / PUK Certificate.
- Postal / Email Address or and credit limit – Applicable to post-paid customers only.

# **How to update the primary number.**

- Log onto the link [http://svdt3fraud03/primarynumber/Default.aspx](http://svdt3fraud03/primarynumber/Default.aspx) , using windows credentials.
- Call the number being removed from the primary number link to be 100% sure that the person making the request is not an impersonator. If the phone rings and it’s picked talk to the person to establish true ownership of line. If not picked or offline, then proceed and make the changes.
- Click on the change primary number tab.
- Input customer ID number on the ID number field.
- Input the new primary number (as per customer request) on the Primary Number field.
- Select the reason for the change on the reason field.
- Insert the interaction reference number and enter any relevant comment e.g., primary number lost, irregular registration on the Comment field.
- Attach the vetting documents provided as a pdf or jpeg image.
- Click on save the changes, to complete the update and advise the customer accordingly.
- Where any failure to update is noted, escalate to fraud team via email to NetworkFraudM-PESASection@Safaricom.co.ke for resolution, and advice customer accordingly once resolved.)

# **Deletion of primary notification number**

This is applicable where no alternative number is available to facilitate update of notification number.

**This is viable for below reasons:**

# **Irregular registration.**

Change of notification number. Applicable where no alternative number is available to facilitate update i.e., where customer doesn’t not wish to use an existing MSISDN registered to them, pooled / recycled numbers etc.

Anomaly in the primary notification number. i.e., number not registered to the customer etc.

# **Action for Call Centre CEE****.**

Refer customer to Retail with their Original ID/valid Passport/Military ID. (At the call Centre, CEE should specify to customer that Original ID is needed and not copy.

# **Action for** **Care Desk/ Retail CEE.**

Vet and confirm validity of customer request and Original ID document of registration.

Confirm number(s) registered to the customer.

Where irregular registration is noted, CEE will suspend the lines as per the applicable irregular registration procedure and delete the number once the customer passes the vetting.

# **Escalation guidelines on subscriber registration issues on aml.**

Open the Subscriber registration Escalations Link using Chrome Browser or from Regional Sales and Operations (add link : [https://svqoaintranet02/Intranet/Home/SubregEscalations](https://svqoaintranet02/Intranet/Home/SubregEscalations) )\-this takes you direct to escalation page)

Select Distribution Channel Links > open “Sub-Reg Escalations” under “Customer Experience” drop down menu.

The link lands you to the Dashboard homepage

From the Homepage, click on the Escalations Quick Link

Select issue category from the drop-down menu; this is a compulsory entry.

Select Document Type from the drop-down menu; this is a compulsory entry.

Enter the error received under the comment box.

Select the Shop Outlet from the drop-down menu; this is a compulsory entry.

Scan and save the subscriber identification document by its number and current date, e.g., 22153733-29-11-2018. Attach the identification document.

Submit Entry

Confirm submission status. Attachment of Doc ID is mandatory to allow submission. The link will not allow duplication of document numbers with pending entries.

# **Querying existing escalation****.**

From the Homepage, click on the Escalations Quick Link

Type the unique identifier (either Doc ID or MSISDN) under the “Search” text box to filter your search.

**NB**: Record comment can either be viewed when the form is opened or exported to excel.

articleTitle: Dynamic SIM card allocation Mechanics in Subscriber Registration
markdownContent:
# **Definition and mechanics of SIM card allocation**

This is an automated way of dynamically allocating MSISDNs through Safaricom Partner App.

Numbers will be availed in the system and dealers and agents will link the numbers with special YNC SIMEX serials known as Your Number Your Choice.

# **How it works**

- The agent will undertake the KYC process for the customer.
- Customers will select their preferred number from a pool of numbers provided on Safaricom Partner App.
- The agent will then pair the special DSA SIMEX with the number selected by the customer to trigger registration and activation.
- Normal registration documentation required do not change.

N.B. Multiple agents will not have access to the same numbers since the system will reserve selected numbers for a period of 10 min on USSD platform and 3 Min on the app.

These numbers will be returned to the pool if not registered during the reservation period.

# **Dynamic SIM Allocation support**

The Regional Teams (TDRs, ASMS) will offer first line support for the service. The

Dealer and Agent Management teams will offer back-office support to the regional teams.

# **Subscriber Registration Features and Queries**

**SIM Selling Outlet (SSO)**

This is a platform in which an agent, dealer, BA or a SIM selling agent can register a customer via Subscriber registration App, OTA, M-PESA tills and be able to earn commission on weekly basis based on the first top up amount. Find attached the SSO FAQs.

# **SIM Maximum number of lines that can be registered with same ID**

A dealer can handle registration of up to 5 lines.

For >5 the customer will be referred to the nearest retail shop.

Please find here attached the revised Subscriber Registration FAQs

IPRS check failure at the agent Dealer shop

The customer will be advised to visit our retail shop/care desk for assistance. The agent at the retail shop/care desk will escalate the issue via IPRS link.

Where a customer has multiple lines, which number will receive the notification?

The system will check and confirm the number under the ID which is the most active on the network or M-PESA.

# **Document validation**

The registration details will be validated as indicated in the registration document hence the dealer/agent must ensure they have entered as the document provided.

# **How to view date of birth on Partner App**

- Log into Partner App.
- Select appropriate registration document type, e.g. “National ID” under the Search by Menu.
