articleTitle: Reversal Requests guidelines for Fibre To The Home
markdownContent:
# **Reversal Requests guidelines for Fibre To The Home**

This is applicable for reversal process for customers who request and make payment for service, but their request is not done to completion for various reasons.

The reversals may be due to technical and non-technical reasons.

The below scenarios, but not limited to the same will be applicable / viable:

# **Technical:**

Outside coverage; where area is not Fibre ready.

Out of design / Scope; where customers reside in an area not on the route plan.

Capacity issue (Splitter full); due internal capacity constraints.

Additional material; Applicable where it will require more than the guidelines given for poles, cables etc., thus resulting to additional cost higher budget that cannot be accommodated by the business.

# **Non-technical:**

Client cancelling installation request and requesting refund i.e. due to delayed installation.

Denial of access during installation to clients premise.

Customer request i.e. due to client unavailability.

Route challenges.

Payment to a wrong account.

Wrong package allocation.

# **Reversal Requests – During onboarding / customer acquisition.**

The sales team will engage potential customer, where payment is done,

A CRQ is generated against the customer account and installation process will commence.

The central dispatch team will engage customer and schedule for installation.

They will then send the contractor technician to visit customer to access feasibility of installation.

Where the installation is viable, they will proceed with installation and activation and will confirm service availability.

Where the installation is not viable;

# **Reversals due to technical issues.**

Contractor will update the CRQ on remedy with the specific issue / reason. They will capture details as below:

**Out of design** – Include GPS co-ordinates for the customer location to allow for verification by sales agent. This will be done within the 48Hrs.

**Capacity Issues** – Indicate reasons clearly on the CRQ the exact issue e.g. Signal issues, FAT full, etc. This should be done within the 48Hrs.

**Additional Material** – indicate the exact reason and additional material required on the CRQ, this should be done within the 48Hrs

Where the contractor identifies request as not feasible as per the above scenarios, the contractor will attach the notes of the status/outcome on the CRQ.

Contractor will advise customer accordingly and will advise they will be contacted for refund.

Central dispatch will then advise customer on refund and proceed to close the CRQ which will then result in an SR to line 400.

For all verified reversals, Home technology solutions dispatchers will proceed to close the CRQ ticket with the reversal recommendation.

Once closed all such tickets will not progress provisioning of service automatically but will raise an SR assigned to Call Centre L400 FTTH team.

L400 team will on a daily basis consolidate all reversal requests and will share the consolidated list with the home sales team, who will validate the request is valid, within 48 Hrs.

Where team engages customer for win back and upon successful engagements will advice the team to cancel reversal and will proceed with the installation procedure.

Where reversal request is valid, team will advice L400 for reversal / refund to be completed.

Within 24 hrs. of SR creation, reversals will be initiated for all payments done via M-PESA.

# **M-PESA payments reversals due to technical issues.**

For reversal requests where payment is done via M-PESA, within 48Hrs of payment receipt. L400 will reverse transaction on CRM- Siebel.

CEE will initiate M-PESA reversal against the M-PESA TID payment for the customer on CRM by clicking on the tab reverse FTTH transaction.

L400 CEE will advise customer accordingly and close SR. CEE will capture notes on the SR stating reason for reversal.

Where payment is done via M-PESA and 48Hrs have elapsed since payment receipt, L400 CEE will create reversal activity on the SR.

CEE will create an activity to the team leader / manager for approval of the reversal as a manual adjustment.

Upon approval L400 CEE will initiate a reversal on M-PESA G2 on the FTTH Paybill.

Marker checker will apply, L400 CEE or call center reversal team will complete the reversal request on G2.

The L400 CEE completing the request will close SR once reversal is done.

Where request is completed by the reversal team, folder team will follow up for closure of SR.

CEE will advise customer accordingly and close SR. CEE will capture notes on the SR stating reason for reversal.

SLA is within 24 Hours of initiation of refund request.

Folder team will validate the pending SR’s on a daily basis to confirm completion of requests.

# **M-PESA Reversals due to non-technical reasons.**

Where request for reversal is done due to a non-technical issue.

# **Reversals due to customer request.**

For the scenario below;

Client cancelling installation request and requesting refund i.e. due to delayed installation.

Client unavailability, customer request due to unavailability or changes resulting to request i.e. location etc.

Where request is done within 48 Hrs of receipt of customer payment. CEE at retail or L400 call Centre, receiving this request will validate installation has not been done and will Initiate the reversal process against the M-PESA TID payment for the customer on CRM by clicking on the tab reverse FTTH transaction.

To allow further customer engagement and / or review the reason for cancellation, where request is due to delayed installation, CEE will send an email to the home retention team and technology teams via fiberSalesGroup@Safaricom.co.ke and

HomeCustomerManagement@Safaricom.co.ke .

CEE will close SR and will indicate email sent and resolution.

Reversal requests channeled via TDR and DSA ( Direct Sales Agents ) will be sent via an email to copsftth@safaricom.co.ke for reversal to be done and copied to fiberSalesGroup@Safaricom.co.ke and

HomeCustomerManagement@Safaricom.co.ke for review of cancellation and subsequent customer engagement for win back.

Customers contacting call center on any touch points other than L400, will escalate to L400 team via email to copsftth@safaricom.co.ke.

SLA for reversal is within 24 Hrs and response time of 2 Hrs.

For reversals due to delayed installations, home technology team will evaluate if the failure to close sale is within their responsibility.

Team will impose contractor penalty on failure to meet client’s request, if it is established to be within their liability.

SLA is within 48hrs.

# **Reversals due to inability to access customer premise.**

For scenarios below;Denial of access during installation to clients premise.

Route challenges.

Contractor will update the CRQ on remedy with the specific issue / reason.

Contractor will advise customer they will be contacted for refund.

Central dispatch will then advise customer on refund and proceed to close the CRQ which will then result in an SR to line 400.

L400 team will on a daily basis consolidate all reversal requests and will share the consolidated list with the home sales team, who will validate the request is valid, within 48 Hrs.

Where team engages customer for win back and upon successful engagements will advise the team to cancel reversal and will proceed with the installation procedure.

Where reversal request is valid, team will advise L400 for reversal / refund to be completed.

L400 will reverse transaction on CRM where transaction is within 48 Hrs and will raise an activity for approval of manual adjustment and subsequent completion of reversal on G2 portal where transaction is older than 48 Hrs.

# **Reversals due to activation of wrong package / account.**

For scenarios below:

Payment to a wrong account. i.e. due to customer payment on expired account (payment after the 14 days window period)

Wrong package during onboarding i.e. silver instead of gold etc.

Where customer payment results to payment into an existing active account.

L400 CEE will validate if the product has been renewed;

Where the product is not renewed, the funds will be available o IN on CRM.

Where payment is done within 48 Hrs, CEE will proceed to reverse on Siebel CRM.

Where payment is done after 48 Hrs, L400 team will initiate approval via activity, initiate reversal on G2 and follow-up for completion.

L400 CEE will provision service.

CEE will close SR and indicate notes on action taken.

Retail CEE’s will raise an SR for action by L400 FTTH team.

Where customer payment renews product on an active wrong account;

L400 CEE will delete the product on Siebel CRM.

If payment is done within 48 Hrs, CEE will proceed to reverse on Siebel CRM.

Where payment is done after 48 Hrs, L400 team will initiate approval via activity, initiate reversal on G2 and follow-up for completion.

L400 CEE will provision service.

CEE will close SR and indicate notes on action taken.

Retail CEE’s will raise an SR for action by L400 FTTH team.

# **POS payments reversals.**

This is applicable to both technical and non-technical issues during customer acquisition. Valid to reversals for payments done via POS at retail outlets.

All sales that cannot be connected should be reversed to the customer within four (4) working days from payment date and funds hitting customer account.

On a daily basis, L400 folder will consolidate reversal requests received.

L400 team will share the consolidated list via email to the home customer experience team;

Information to be captured for Safaricom Shop payments reversal requests will include;

Customer names.

FTTTH account.

MSISDN to receive payment.

Date of payment & Amount Paid.

Transaction ID. / receipt number.

Reason for reversal

Shop where payment was receipted.

Home experience team will share daily via email by 10 am, a list for all CRQ for refunds via email to the sales teams, i.e. via email to the RAM ( Regional Account Manager ) and fiberSalesGroup@Safaricom.co.ke to validate request and engage customer for win back where applicable.

Teams will review and share feedback on shared accounts within 48 Hrs.

Where applicable RAM’s will allocate accounts to sales agent , who will contact the customer, advise and apologize that connection will not be possible due to specified reasons on the ticket and that funds will be reversed.

They may cross sell 4G for Home if customer is in a 4G area.

Sales team shall maintain a database of all cancelled sales and use this as a guide for future roll out / capacity expansion based on demand.

Team will validate reversal, Where request is valid, refund process will commence, and installation will be progressed where successful engagements with customer(s) is noted.

Home experience team will share daily a list for all CRQ for refunds and retention team and technology teams via email to - HomeCustomerManagement@Safaricom.co.ke to validate request.

Teams will review and share feedback on shared accounts within 48 Hrs.

Where request is valid, refund process will commence, and installation will be progressed where successful engagements with customer(s) is noted.

Where applicable, technology team will evaluate if the failure to close sale is within their responsibility.

Team will impose contractor penalty on failure to meet client’s request, if it is established to be within their liability.

SLA is within 48hrs.

home experience team will validate requests and will compile accounts for refund by the credit control team.

# **Reversal Requests – InLife requests.** 

This is applicable for reversals process for customers make payment for service and request for reversal.

# **M-PESA Payments.** 

The below scenarios, but not limited to the same will be applicable / viable:

Wrong account / CI.

Wrong amount.

Wrong package.

Multiple payments.

Customer request i.e. change of mind.

Where customer contacts call center on other channels other than L400 i.e. L100/200, social media etc.

# GEO-LOCK

**Geo-Lock**

Geo-Lock is a Service That Will Ensure Agents Are Transacting in Their Known Business Location. The till will be geo-locked in the area it operates in and will be deactivated when relocated from its listed business location.

The Geo Lock radius will vary depending on the base station coverage distance.

**How it works/Mechanics. (Terms of service).**

1. The Geo-Locked services include Sim Registration, Sim Swap, Customer KYC Collection and Cash in Cash Out.
2. When a till is relocated from its location, the till will be deactivated however upon return to allowed area the till will be active again.
3. When a till is Geo Locked and agent tries to use it, the agent will get an error message as below

“Dear agent your deposit request has been declined due to relocation violation, kindly contact your TDR for assistance.”

4. When a till is Geo- Locked and a customer tries to use it, the customer will get an error message as below.

“Dear customer, your withdrawal request has been declined. Kindly visit another agent.”

5. A till can only relocate two times in a year (Relocation process on hold for now until Further Notice)
6. Inactive tills will be Geo-Locked in the last place they were most active.
7. Head offices will not be affected by Geo-Lock

**The Benefits of Geo Lock**

1. Identify the current number of tills with a view of increasing them
2. To unlock Sim Reg, Sim Swap and customer KYC collection
3. To comply with regulatory requirements
4. To reduce fraud incidences

**NOTE:** Affected agents should contact us through their Head Office. Agents should be reffered to their Head office should they contact us. Line 300 agents will handle the  cases sent through the head office and handle escalations as per the existing process.

2\. View Agent Info. Enter 1 then press send.

3\. Enter the Till Mobile No (07xxxxxxxx) then press send. (There should be no space in the number).

Agent will get a message showing the location of the till and whether it is compliant or not.

**To Get the Till MSISDN;**

check Mpesa Web or dial \*100\*4\*1# from the till.

The Head Office will have visibility of all their tills. An organization dials \*234\*14# from the Head Office till and follows the process indicated above. Each HO will only have visibility of their tills (both owned and aggregated). A HO cannot view tills of another organization.

Sub Agents will only view the location of the tills they are operating and not any other till.

articleTitle: M-PESA Agent Tills Suspension and Un-suspension, Freezing or unfreezing
markdownContent:
# **M-PESA Agent Tills Suspension and Un-suspension, Freezing & unfreezing**

# **Suspension of Agent tills**

Float account is suspended when: -

The agent does not pick his phone for Safaricom to confirm a reversal

The agent does not top up funds to enable Safaricom to complete a reversal.

The agent till received and utilized float / funds that had been erroneously sent

The person suspending / freezing the agent account must add in the comments section in G2 the reason for sanctioning the account. This includes the Transaction ID and amount, in relation to the action.

# **Un-suspension of Agent till**

The agent or agent head office could call the call Centre when they realize they are suspended.

# **Action point for the CEE**

Where agent was suspended for insufficient funds and has topped up: Initiate the reversal and UN-suspend the till.

Where agent was suspended for not picking calls to confirm a reversal

Forward via email the details of the calling agent, store number and withdrawal reversal transaction ID to \[Call Centre Reversals CCReversals@Safaricom.co.ke With Subject ‘TILL SUSPENDED AGENT NOT PICKING CALLS’

**Agent suspended for using funds meant for a different agency:**

Query this transaction ID, where you find that it’s a Business Deposit / Withdrawal of funds via API (as the first screenshot attached)

Confirm that the Agency has funds, if so, raise an SR, request for the reversal to be done and unsuspension of the account. However, where there is a pre-existing SR number quoted on the suspension notes, do not raise a duplicate SR. Send mail to the SR owner and copy the respective email folder.

Where the Agency doesn’t have funds, advise them on the reason for suspension, request them to credit the funds back to the account and advice the agency to contact us thereafter for the reversal.

Don’t change the status until the funds are recovered, if you unsuspend for another reversal, please return it to the original state.

# **Procedure of Freezing or unfreezing a Stolen Till on G2**

When an agent call requesting to bar or freeze a stolen till, proceed to vet the agent/caller as per agent vetting guidelines below;

Full names of the primary operator/operator

Agent ID of the primary operator/operator National ID number of the primary operator/operator After successfully scoring the agent, the CEE will follow the procedure below:

**The CEE will freeze** the G2 account and also **suspend** the till MSISDN on CRM with action reason **suspend stolen**. The suspension on CRM will ensure that the till cannot receive calls, hence no possibility of the fraudster authorizing the reversal.

ON G2, Select Take a Call

- Select Organization Operator
- Enter Till Number and Operator ID
- Click on Search Select the Operation icon
- Under Identity Status Click Edit
- An Edit Identity Status pop up window will appear
- Change the status (to Frozen) from the drop-down button
- Enter Reason for freezing,
- Click on Submit
- Confirm Identity Status Changes to **Frozen.**
- Capture the reason for freezing, details of the agent/caller and action accordingly to effect the changes.

**NOTE:** Even if the caller fails the vetting or is not a registered till operator on the system

Capture the details of the caller and go ahead and change the Identity status of the till to Frozen.

A follow-up email should be sent to the mpesaagentadmin@Safaricom.co.ke to authenticate the request from the head office.

Advice the caller/agent on the procedure below on how to facilitate unfreezing and SIM swap (in cases of lost SIM Card) via their Top Organization.

# **Unfreezing/ Swap of a stolen till:**

For unfreezing/swap of agent tills,

CEE will advise the agent to escalate the issue through their head office.

The head office administrator will be required to raise a Service Request on dealer portal.

SLA -48 working hours

# **Reversal requests from suspended/frozen tills, suspended due to low float levels, for flouting KYC requirements, prison site, where suspension logs have archived, etc****.**

**Initiating reversal**: CEE will unsuspend / unfreeze the till, initiate the reversal then return the till back to its old status. Do NOT raise an SR.

**Completing the reversal**: The reversal will be completed as usual with no further checks on status of the till.

**NO REVERSAL** will be initiated from a till frozen for theft. Instead, the caller will be advised to swap the line and activate first before any reversal can be done.

**Completing reversal:** Where there was a pending reversal as at the time of freezing the till (I.e. the reversal was initiated before the suspension of the till), the reversal completion team will seek consent to complete the reversal from the TILL ADMINISTRATOR and not the till itself and explain the circumstances. Action the reversal as per feedback from the administrator.

# **Un-suspension of Tills where the Audit Logs have archived, and / or where a Till was suspended for a reversal transaction which is over 30 days and / or the transaction has archived**

First Line will NOT raise an SR. The agent should be advised to liaise with their head office administrator. The head office will raise an un-suspension Service Request via Dealer Portal.

Admin will raise the SR under:

**Service request Category**: M-PESA services

**Request type**: M-PESA agent account.

**Request Item**: Unsuspension KYC/Low Float/Fr

# **Resolution:**

Safaricom partner support will raise BMC to query archived audit logs and action the un-suspension request as per the suspension reason.

Reversal / Reimbursement of archived transactions upon head office consent:

Safaricom partner support team will login to MPESA G1 Admin portal as per Esaka article **A0676:** **DEALER SUPPORT ARCHIVED M-PESA STATEMENTS REQUEST**

From the archived statement the Analyst will verify whether the archived transaction had already been reversed. If the transaction had been reversed, the Till will be un-suspended. Where the archived Customer Withdrawal transaction is still pending reversal, the Analyst will reimburse the funds to the Customer via a Deposit via Web transaction where the Reverse Button has greyed out.

# **Tills suspended/frozen by frauds/AML team**

The AML/fraud team will on regular basis monitor activities on M-PESA tills and may freeze/suspend the tills as need be. Comments will be put on G2 indicating the action taken.

**NO REVERSALS** will be initiated on tills suspended/frozen by fraud/AML team. Instead, the CEE will forward the request to the person who suspended/froze the till. The CEE will capture comments on G2 explaining the suspension and action point for the owner.

**NO REVERSALS** will be completed from tills suspended/frozen for fraud. Instead, the CEE completing the reversal will send the request via email to the person who suspended/froze the till.

articleTitle: Definitions, features and mechanics of Safaricom WIMAX
markdownContent:
# **Definition**

WIMAX means Worldwide Interoperability for Microwave Access and is a telecommunications technology that provides wireless transmission of data using a variety of transmission modes, from point-to-multipoint links to portable and fully mobile internet access.

The technology provides up to 10 Mbps broadband speed without the need for cables.

The technology is based on the IEE 802.16 standard (also called Broadband Wireless Access).

The name "WIMAX" was created by the WIMAX Forum, which was formed in June 2001 to promote conformity and interoperability of the standard. The forum describes WIMAX as "a standards-based technology enabling the delivery of last mile wireless broadband access as an alternative to cable and DSL".

Safaricom has the widest WIMAX coverage in the country offering a wide range of broadband solutions to corporates, residential houses, community broadband initiatives, government institutors, learning institutions, SMEs, and a multitude of other value-added applications.

# **WIMAX features**

The bandwidth and range of WIMAX make it suitable for the following potential applications:

1. Providing a wireless alternative to cable and DSL for "last mile" broadband access.
2. Providing data, telecommunications and IPTV services (triple play).
3. Providing a source of Internet connectivity as part of a business continuity plan. That is, if a business has both a fixed and a wireless Internet connection, especially from unrelated providers, they are unlikely to be affected by the same service outage.
4. Providing portable connectivity.
5. Connecting Wi-Fi hotspots to the Internet.

# **How WIMAX works**

### **A WiMAX system consists of two parts:**

1. **A WiMAX tower**\- similar in concept to a cell-phone tower.
2. **A WiMAX receiver**\- The receiver and antenna could be a small box or PCMCIA card, or they could be built into a laptop the way Wi-Fi access is today.

1. A WiMAX tower station can connect directly to the Internet using a high bandwidth, wired connection (for example, a T3 line).
2. It can also connect to another WiMAX tower using a line-of-sight microwave link. This connection to a second tower (often referred to as a backhaul) gives the ability of a single tower to cover up to 3,000 square miles.

# **Requirements for WIMAX Connection**

### Equipment

- A CPE (customer premises equipment)
- The Wimax radio unit for Wimax solutions
- A router (e.g. Cisco Linksys or Level One)

### **Base station**

(Line of sight refers to ability of a customer site to receive wireless signal from one of the Wimax base stations)

**N.B:** There **is no more sales of WiMAX connections to any customers**. All sales to be done on **Fiber or Fixed LTE**. This is **effective immediately**.

# **Benefits of using Wimax**

1. Wimax can satisfy a variety of access needs. Potential applications include extending broadband capabilities to bring them closer to subscribers, filling gaps in cable, DSL and T1 services, Wi-Fi and cellular backhaul, providing last-100 meter access from fibre to the curb and giving service providers another cost-effective option for supporting broadband services.
2. Wimax can support very high bandwidth solutions where large spectrum deployments (i.e. >10 MHz) are desired using existing infrastructure keeping costs down while delivering the bandwidth needed to support a full range of high-value, multimedia services.
3. Wimax can help service providers meet many of the challenges they face due to increasing customer demands without discarding their existing infrastructure investments because it has the ability to seamlessly interoperate across various network types.
4. Wimax can provide wide area coverage and quality of service capabilities for applications ranging from real-time delay-sensitive voice-over-IP (VoIP) to real-time streaming video and non-real-time downloads, ensuring that subscribers obtain the performance they expect for all types of communications.
5. Wimax ,which is an IP-based wireless broadband technology, can be integrated into both wide-area third-generation (3G) mobile and wireless and wireline networks, allowing it to become part of a seamless anytime, anywhere broadband access solution.

## 

# **The difference between Wimax and Wi-Fi**

WIMAX is similar to the wireless standard known as Wi-Fi, but on a much larger scale and at faster speeds. A nomadic version would keep WIMAX-enabled devices connected over large areas, much like today’s cell phones. We can compare it with Wi-Fi based on the following factors. 

| Item | Wi-Fi | Wimax |
| --- | --- | --- |
| IEEE Standards | Wi-Fi is based on IEEE 802.11 standard. | WIMAX is based on IEEE 802.16. |
| Range | Wi-Fi typically provides local network access for around a few hundred feet with speeds of up to 54 Mbps. | A single WIMAX antenna is expected to have a range of up to 40 miles with speeds of 70 Mbps or more. As such, WIMAX can bring the underlying Internet connection needed to service local Wi-Fi networks. |
| Scalability | Wi-Fi is intended for LAN applications, users scale from one to tens with one subscriber for each CPE device. Fixed channel sizes (20MHz). | WIMAX is designed to efficiently support from one to hundreds of Consumer premises equipment (CPEs), with unlimited subscribers behind each CPE. Flexible channel sizes from 1.5MHz to 20MHz. |
| Bit rate | Wi-Fi works at 2.7 bps/Hz and can peak up to 54 Mbps in 20 MHz channel. | WIMAX works at 5 bps/Hz and can peak up to 100 Mbps in a 20 MHz channel. |
| Quality of Service | Wi-Fi does not guarantee any QoS but WIMAX will provide your several level of QoS. | WIMAX can bring the underlying Internet connection needed to service local Wi-Fi networks. Wi-Fi does not provide ubiquitous broadband while WIMAX does. |

# **Tips on CRM order error management**

From time to time, you need to be checking on the orders you raised and have not completed. Kindly be checking pending orders and resubmitting them from time to time. Change the due date to current date on the order before resubmitting it.

# Below are steps to follow:

1. Log onto CRM

2.  Go to Orders tab as below.

 [Screenshot] 

**3, Go** to List:

List will display your orders on various statuses complete, pending manual action etc.

 [Screenshot] 

From all Sales orders You can also Query and specify the various statuses and Put **Created By** as your Username for CRM then **GO** as below, e.g your orders in **Pending** Status.

 [Screenshot] 

To submit a pending order that is older than the current date, change the **due** date on the right then click submit button on the left as below.

 [Screenshot] 

For orders in **manual actions required** (credit control approval or rejected) Click on **activities** to view if its approved or rejected. Done = approved, cancelled = rejected. To view the reason its rejected, click on **post vetting review** to see credit control comments then revise the order accordingly then submit. Once you revise the submit button will be active.

To view the error message for an order that is in **Backend error,** click on the arrows on the extreme right to expand.

# **Dealer Support Till Relocation Request**

Till relocation request is done when a till moves from one location to another

- The dealer will then indicate the proposed new location; town, exact physical location and select the proposed new location.

- Then attach copies of the following documents: national ID, Police Clearance certificate, business permit and a signed copy of the new subagent agreement.
- He will then click on request relocation to submit the request.
- Once submitted the request will be received on dealer portal by Safaricom partner support staff who will check to confirm all document have been attached and are valid. If all the required details have been provided the team will then approve the request.
- The request will then be received on dealer portal by the area sales manager of the proposed new location who will Audit the outlet before approving.
- Once the ASM has approved the request will then be assigned to M-PESA agent support team to effect relocation on MPESA System and close the request on dealer portal
- On M-PESA system the M-PESA support team will edit the organization name and organization friendly name to reflect the new location
- MPESA head office will be notified on dealer portal that the request has been completed. The request status on dealer portal will changes from pending to completed.
- SLA for the request is 7days.

**How to apply for Relocation**

Log into the Dealer Portal under Mpesa Section select Till Relocation > Till Origin > New Territory > Reason for Relocation > Enter Sub Agent Details.

**How many times can I relocate a till?**

2 times in a year.

**Can I relocate the till to any region?**

No. You can only relocate the till within the region it is currently operating from. Example, if it operates in Coast region, you can only move it within the different territories in Coast region.

**Will Geo- locking still apply?**

Yes, it will. A till will be geo locked in its new area of operation.

markdownContent:
# **Bamba Airtime Kwa M-PESA Agent**

# **Definition**

This is a new service that will allow agents to purchase airtime to Safaricom customers on behalf of the customer from their M-PESA float account.

# **Eligibility**

This Service is available to all M-PESA agents.

The functionality of “Buy Airtime for Customer” has been added on the M-PESA agent tills.

Agent will be required to update their M-PESA menu in order to access the Buy

Airtime menu For Customer option on their till. This will be possible for M-PESA agents with the ‘BIG SIM

# **Benefits**

The M-PESA agents will earn 5% commission on the value of airtime purchased for their customers.

No need to stock physical vouchers. c) The customer will have alternative channels to access airtime.

The commission rates.

The agents will be paid 5% on the value of airtime purchased for their customers.

The commission will be earned for each transaction of airtime sold.

Sample 1: For centrally owned stores, if an agent sells airtime of Ksh 100, the agent will receive Ksh on commission.

**Sample 2:** For an aggregated store, if an agent sells airtime of Ksh 100, the commission will be split as follows; the aggregator will receive Ksh 4.75, while the head office will receive Ksh. 0.25.

The commission will be rolled up on the last day of the month

The minimum amount is 5/- and the maximum amount is 10,000/- per transaction.

Adherence to the agent KYC rules of obtaining an identity card (ID) and requiring the customer to sign the logbook is a mandatory requirement

The agent can remotely top up a third-party number, however the agent and customer will have the responsibility to confirm the transaction.

Customer will they still earn Bonga points upon usage.

Incase customer has Okoa Jahazi, Once the airtime account is credited, the outstanding amount will be deducted automatically.

Bamba Airtime service is not available to postpaid and pooled numbers.

If the agent purchases airtime for a wrong number

The M-PESA agent will be required to forward the M -PESA confirmation message to 2530 for a reversal to be done.

The reversal request should be forwarded for transactions initiated from the same agent store

The reversal request should be sent within an hour.

The reversal will be successful if the airtime is intact and has not been utilized.

For an authorized transaction.

The Financial Services team will do a manual reconciliation.

However the CEE will be required to raise an SR, SLA is 72hrs.

# **Agent makes a direct deposit on a customer's account**

An agent should advise the agent calling, as per the M-PESA agent penalties policy.

If an agent facilitates customers' direct deposits to avoid charges/ or because customer is not registered, he/she will be penalized for non-compliance of the set

**M-PESA Agent procedural guidelines** 
Ask to speak to the customer and advise him/her that 'they should provide their own mobile number for the deposit request and not the recipient's mobile number as this is not the correct M-PESA procedure.

M-PESA agents have been fully empowered to initiate/ complete deposit reversals by forwarding the M-PESA transaction message to 2530.

For this reason, any M-PESA agent who calls with a deposit reversal should be advised to forward the message to short code 2530. **Do not initiate the reversal if agent does not have challenges.**

**Note:** The Agent to forward the message as is without editing to ensure the reversal success.

Please re-assure the affected Agent that this process is real time.

For any Agent with a challenge with the short code or transaction is older than 1 hour, kindly initiate the reversal. If the agent is not able to use the DIY Process kindly raise an SR indicating the store number (given by the admin) and the agent code.

Vet the agent on the below then proceed to reverse and advise on 2 hours SLA:

Agent number

Agent /assistant id

Agent name

Agent national id

On completion of the reversal the sender and recipient will get a notification via SMS.

# **SMS Content**

**Reversal Completed-to Sender**

'Jambo, the reversal transaction \*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\* has been completed and the money has been returned to your MPESA account. Please check your balance.'

Jambo, kurudisha pesa, nambari ya shughli \*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*, kumekamilishwa na pesa imerudi kwa akaunti yako ya MPESA tafadhali angalia salio lako.

**Reversal |Completed-to Recipient**

'Jambo, you received Ksh\*\*\*\* in error as per the MPESA transaction \*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*. We have returned the funds to the sender as per their request.

Jambo, umepokea Ksh\*\*\*\*\*\*\* kimakosa nambari ya shughli \*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*. Tumerudisha pesa hizo kwa aliyetuma kulingana na maagizo yake.

**Reversals Involving Agent**

For reversals involving the agent: Withdrawals the SLA will be 12 hours (to allow for time to contact the Agent)

The M-PESA reversal team will create an interaction under the MSISDN to allow one give progressive updates while on call to manage the customer experience.

The Agent deposit reversal process remains the same where you will initiate the reversal and the reversal team will complete the transaction within 2HRS.

**NOTE:** 

For agents with wrong agent details on M-PESA system, initiate a reversal, but advise as per the call guideline M-PESA agent with different assistant ID details on the system.

If M-PESA system is delaying in updating details, request the agent for the Transaction ID. This helps narrow down on the particular transaction being reversed.

If the money is already withdrawn, apologize to the agent and advise him to report to the police.

For reversals from head offices on behalf of their sub agent, verify the sub-Agent belongs to that head office under the 'browse organization' and initiate a reversal.

If it is the agent calling to report a direct deposit by a customer, initiate a reversal on the transaction; but do not enter the agent's details on the service request.

In case the reversal fails because of insufficient funds, check the available balance on the wrong recipient account and initiate a partial reversal.

If the money is already withdrawn, apologize to the agent and advise him to report to the police. Remember to educate the agent on Hakikisha.

# **Messages received by M-PESA Agent and Customer**

**for a successful deposit**

Normal deposit M-PESA notification will be sent accordingly.

**for an unsuccessful deposit**

**English**

’Failed. Please ensure that you have verified the customer’s document of

Registration before attempting to deposit.’’

**Swahili**

‘Imefeli. Hakikisha umethibitisha maelezo kwa hati ya kitambulisho kabla ya

kuweka pesa.’’

The customer will not receive any notification 

# **No Identification Document while withdrawing funds at an M-PESA Agent**

When a customer performs a withdrawal, and the agent realizes that the customer has no identification document.

Advise the agent calling, as per the M-PESA agent penalties policy;

Agents transacting on M-PESA without seeing the customer's identification document will be penalized for non-compliance of the set M-PESA agent procedural guidelines.

Ask to speak to the customer and advise him/her that 'they should provide their Identification document before transacting as this is the correct M-PESA procedure.' 
Initiate a reversal on the transaction.

**NOTE:** As per the M-PESA Agents training on the KYC procedures, ALL agents are required to ask for the customer's Identification document before performing any M-PESA transactions.

# **Becoming an M-PESA Agent Aggregator Organization**

An agent can only become an Aggregator after signing an aggregator contract with Safaricom Limited.

An agent is expected to declare all their Sub-Agent Stores within their network by filling in Sub-Agent Declaration Form.

The form should be forwarded to **mpesaagentadmin@safaricom.co.ke.**

An Aggregator contract will be prepared upon receipt of the Sub-Agent Declaration Form.

# **Benefits of becoming an M-PESA Agent Aggregator**

# **Definition**

An aggregator is an organization that has signed an aggregator contract and has sub-agent outlets within their network.

# **Benefits of becoming an Aggregator**

The organization will be allowed to recruit sub-agents within their network.

Please note, a non-aggregator organization is not allowed to apply for sub-agent store, if they do, the application will be failed.

Aggregator organizations will be considered first when Safaricom intends to do market activation.

All aggregated stores will be given access to line 2134.

If a contract for any agent is terminated by Safaricom, then their aggregated stores/sub-agent stores will be re-directed to only Aggregator organizations.

Only Aggregated organizations will be recommended to institutions which are our Utility Partners.

Aggregator organizations are also required to formalize their relationship with their sub-agents by signing a contract with them.

This can only be done once they have signed a contract with Safaricom.

# **Disclosure of information for another person’s M-PESA account request.**

If you get a call from an agent or customer requesting for information on another person's account; the M-PESA terms and conditions state as below:

***Safaricom employees who handle personal information are under an obligation to treat it confidentially and may not disclose it to unauthorized third parties.***

***Safaricom employees are also responsible for the internal security of the information.***

***Employees who violate Safaricom privacy policies are subject to a range of disciplinary actions.***

Please advise the agent/customer to report the matter to the police who will request for information from Safaricom if need be to facilitate their investigations.

Information on another person can only be released through the police for investigation purposes.

Issuing agent/customer's information to a third party goes against CCK guidelines (externally) and Information Security and Code of Conduct (internally) as customers should only be given their own information.

Suspending, and/or freezing of the agent/customer's account is not permitted.

articleTitle: M-PESA Agent Registration of Minors, Self-Reversal, Statement and Stolen Till
markdownContent:
# **M-PESA Registration of Minors**

M-PESA service only recognizes persons above the age of 18 years.

This is as per the M-PESA terms and conditions section 3.2 which states 'You must be at least 18 years old and of sound mind to use the M-PESA Service.'

# **Irregular Registration of Minor**

Minors transacting on M-PESA should be advised to register their line via M-PESA Go which is a product designed specifically for the underage (10 to 17) years.  Registration on M-PESA can be done via the M-PESA Go sub-website under the guidance of a parent/guardian.  Here is the link; [https://myaccount.safaricom.co.ke/mpesa-go](https://myaccount.safaricom.co.ke/mpesa-go)

If you receive information on an agent who has registered a minor kindly follow the steps below:

Escalate the name of the agent as shown on the MPESA system.

Who did the irregular registrations through the 'MPESA FEEDBACK’?

Link on the intranet for the agent team to action immediately. 
In the escalation include the mobile number of the minor.

#  **A Minor Sent Money by a Registered Subscriber**

If it's the minor calling, advise them that M-PESA policies are the same as other financial institutions.

Only persons over 18 years of age with identification documents can transact. 
Inform them that a reversal will be initiated, and the money sent back to the sender.

If it's the sender's call, advise them a reversal will be initiated and the money will be sent back to his/her account.

Advise them that the minor should seek assistance from a guardian/teacher or close relative, who will agree for the money to be sent to them to withdraw and deliver to the minor. 
**NOTE:** For the reversal request to be initiated change the status of the account on the M-PESA system and initiate a reversal.

# **M-PESA Agent Self Reversal -Agent User Guide**

# **How It Works**

Agent to dial \*234# from the handset, Processed within 10 seconds.

Agent to reply with option **3**. for **''M-PESA Agent Services”.**

Agent to reply with option **1.** for **''Reversal Request''**

Agent is requested to Enter the Transaction ID of the deposit transaction they want to reverse.

Request is sent and acknowledged by the USSD system.

The following USSD confirmation message is sent: -

‘Your reversal request has been received and will be processed shortly’.

The Reversal request is then processed within 10 seconds.

After the successful reversal of the deposit transaction, the customer/agent will get the following message from M-PESA service:

*“BZ54NR144 Confirmed. Transaction BZ54NL361 has been reversed. Your account balance is now KSh40.”*

The agent can also forward the confirmation text to 2530 to initiate and complete the reversal.

Reversal requests must be forwarded to 2530 within; 1hr from when the transaction was done for deposits transactions. 24 hrs. From when the transaction was done for withdrawal transactions. This is for both withdrawal and deposit transactions done at the till forwarding the text.

# **Agent Statement**

M-PESA Head Offices

All organizations offering Business to Consumer (B2C), Consumer to Business (C2B),

ATM Functionality, Aggregator Model, and Merchant Services

Will have access to the M-PESA system enabling them to generate their statements.

# **Stolen M-PESA Agent Till**

The agent should immediately contact customer care on 234 or 100 from their line to report the loss.

Can also get in touch with the M-PESA administration team through their Head Office.

# **Bonga Deals**

***Please note we shall discontinue the Bonga deals on the 20th May 2024, and these shall cease to be accessible on the Web, App or USSD.***

# **Definition.**

Bonga Deals are discounts with Safaricom partners that reward customers relevantly based on interests, location, behavior, and segment.

Safaricom partners will dial \*126\*4# and select the discounted offers attached to the preferred Merchant e.g discount at Bonfire Adventures, discount @Bella Travels, or discount @Eye Modes etc.

Customer dials \*126\*4# and select the discounted offers attached to the Preferred Merchant.

Customers on the Bonga Loyalty scheme get an added value of Bonga Deals for using their Bonga Points at different Lipa na MPESA merchant outlets.

# **Eligibility.**

All customers on the Bonga Loyalty scheme qualify for different deals based on their location and segment.

# **How it works/Mechanics. (*Terms of service).***

Customer will go to the channels available \*126#, MySafaricom App, Web and go to the Option Bonga Deals.

The customer will then get a voucher code that will be used to redeem the offer. The customer will then give the merchant the voucher code and enjoy the discount as they make their payment using Bonga points or part Bonga. 

The validity of the offer will be dependent on the partner and will vary based on the negotiated discount. 

# **Self service Options.**

Customer will go to the channels available \*126#, MySafaricom App, Web and go to the Option Bonga Deals. Customer will then choose the deal they would want to redeem and confirm redemption as below. 

Customer will.

Dial \*126#

Select Bonga deals

Select the available Preferred Options.

Redeem the discounts.

# **CRM ON VIEWS.**

ON CRM>Bonga Everywhere> Loyalty Aggregator.

Loyalty Deal: - Deals the customer is eligible for redemption

Offer Expiry; - When the offer will expire

Customer History: - View deals customer has subscribed to in-order to redeem at the merchant.

Resend SMS; - To resend the voucher SMS the customer has redeemed if they did not receive or deleted the Notification

Burn Date; - Shows the voucher has been redeemed at the specific Merchant

Subscription Expiry: - Once a customer redeems a deal they have 7 days to use the code or it will expire however they can still subscribe to the offer/deal again if its available.

# **Angaza Music Bundles**

# **What is the Angaza Music Bundle**

Angaza Music Bundle is a Safaricom data bundle that offers customers a daily, weekly or monthly subscription to access their favourite Gospel content on the newly launched Angaza Music Platform/APP.

This will be accessible to all Safaricom customers.

To subscribe customers will Dial \*544# and select “Angaza Music”. To unsubscribe will be able to do so by dialing \*544\*35#.

# **How it works**

Dial \*544# and select “Angaza Music”

- Choice either Daily, Weekly or Monthly subscription
- Pay either through Airtime or Mpesa
- Upon successful purchase, you’ll receive a confirmation SMS with a link. Click on the link to access the Angaza Music
- The bundle can only be used on Angaza Music Platforms (i.e. The web or the

App)

The Daily bundle will auto-renew daily.

# **Offerings**

| Cost | Data Offering | Validity |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ksh 10 | 50 MBs + Angaza Music Subscription | 24 Hours |
| Ksh 50 | 300 MB + Angaza Music Subscription | 7 days |
| Ksh 200 | 1500 MB + Angaza Music Subscription | 30 Days |

The daily Angaza bundle will auto renew daily and will only be purchased using airtime.

The weekly and monthly bundle can be purchased using both Airtime and Mpesa.

# **Eligibility**

Any Safaricom customer can buy the bundle.

# **How to unsubscribe**

You can unsubscribe by dialing \*544\*35#.

# **Usage**

You can only use the Angaza Music Bundle to access Angaza Music App or web portal [(http://www.angazamusic.co.ke/)](http://www.angazamusic.co.ke/)

# **Frequency of Purchase**

Yes, you will be allowed to purchase the Angaza Music Bundle as many times as you wish.

No, you will not be allowed to transfer the Angaza Music Bundle

Yes, the Angaza Music Bundle will roll-over if the customer purchases another bundle.

articleTitle: M-Shwari Services at the Retail Centre
markdownContent:
# Manual M-Shwari loan repayment

- The process applies in instances where an M-Shwari customer wants to pay for a loan and this is not possible via the M-PESA Menu.
- The instances include:

- - 3rd party loan repayment i.e. paying a loan on behalf of another customer i.e. for persons abroad.
 - Loan payment on a pooled line
 - Loan repayment on a recycled line

- Customer will visit a Safaricom Shop with original ID.
- They will then enroll to M-Shwari with a new line and deposit the funds (equal to outstanding loan amount) to the M-Shwari savings account.
- Fill in a loan repayment form.
- RC CEE will then log the request on SR for the RCSA to deal.
- The analyst will then escalate the request to NCBA via remedy incident.
- NCBA will process within a TAT of 2 working days from the day the form is received from Safaricom
- SLA is 72hrs
- Where customer is able to access their M-PESA account and menu, customer will be advised to initiate loan repayment from their end.
- NCBA will action deletion of recycled accounts as per existing process by receiving bulk files from FS requesting for closure of M-Shwari accounts.

## 

# M-Shwari Claim of Funds Next of Kin Requirements

Claims for funds held in deceased customers’ accounts are done at RC, by presenting the below requirements:

**For amounts less than Kshs.150, 000**

- Death Certificate
- Claimants ID
- Letter from County commissioner.

**For amounts Kshs.150, 001 to 499,999**

- Claimants ID
- Death certificate
- Letter from public trustee i.e. Attorney General’s office.

**For amounts equal to or greater than Kshs. 500,000**

- Claimants ID
- Death Certificate
- Letter of Administration

# 

# M-Shwari KYC IPRS Update and Resubmission Process

- This is applicable for customers whose IPRS status is PENDING or FAILED.
- This is done at any Safaricom Retail Center or Care Desk; customers will present their M-PESA Registration Document.
- The valid documents are;
 - Kenyan Id.
 - Kenyan Passports.
 - Foreign/Diplomatic Passports and Alien ID**.**

# **Kenyan Id**

- The Kenyan ID will pass IPRS checks if they are valid and updated on IPRS.
- Where the account does not pass the KYC validation the CEE will proceed to resubmit the customer’s details.
- The customer will provide their original registration/identification document used during M-PESA registration.
- The CEE will confirm that the document number and names on the presented original document provided is the same as the details captured in:
 - The M-PESA system.
 - The M-Shwari CRM Tab.
 - CRM for all individual customers.
- Where a discrepancy is noted on any of the systems, the CEE will update the details on M-PESA as per incorrect Registration Changes process and will proceed to update the details on the M-Shwari VBC Tab to match M-PESA.

# **Updating Procedure**

- The M-Shwari update will be done on the M-Shwari’s Admin Tab on CRM/Siebel.
- This will check the customer ID and names against the government IPRS and if validated the IPRS status will change to PASS, if it doesn’t pass validation the IPRS status will remain as FAILED.
- Where the details pass the CEE will advise the customer that their details have passed and advise them on the new IPRS status.
- Where the details fail, the CEE will scan the original registration document (ID /passport’s bio page), stamp it and raise an SR attaching the stamped copy of the ID.
- On receiving the SR, the RCSA will confirm all details have been correctly captured on CRM and M-PESA as per the attached copy of passport/ID/Registration document.
- The RCSA shall then go to M-Shwari in Siebel/CRM and enter the correct customer details as captured in the ID and submit, the action will check the customer ID against the government IPRS and if validated the IPRS status will change to PASS, if it doesn’t pass validation the IPRS status will remain as FAILED.
- Where the KYC status passes; the RCSA will update the customer and close the SR.
- Where the details do not pass, the RCSA on receiving the SR will raise a BMC ticket and will attach the scanned stamped copy of ID to NCBA for manual KYC validation.
- NCBA will advise on the status within 48 hours and the RCSA will update the customer accordingly and close the SR.
- The SR’s SLA is 72 hours.

# **Kenyan Passports**

- Local passports (both old and new) will pass IPRS checks if they are valid and updated on IPRS.
- However, currently this is failing due to an issue with the system. Kindly raise an SR attaching a stamped Bio Page for manual update of details.
- On receiving the SR, the RCSA will confirm all details have been correctly captured on CRM and M-PESA as per the attached copy of passport registration document.
- The RCSA shall then go to M-Shwari on Siebel/CRM and enter the correct customer details as captured in the ID and submit, the action will check the customer ID against the government IPRS and if validated the IPRS status will change to PASS, if it doesn’t pass validation the IPRS status will remain as FAILED.
- Where the KYC status passes; the RCSA will update the customer and close the SR.
- Where the details do not pass, on receiving the SR the RCSA will raise a BMC ticket and will attach the scanned stamped copy of passport to NCBA for manual KYC validation.
- NCBA will advise on the status within 48 hours and the RCSA will update the customer accordingly and close the SR.
- The SR’s SLA is 72 hours.

# **Foreign/Diplomatic Passports and Alien Id**

- Foreign nationals who registered for M-Shwari with their passports by default have a KYC IPRS status of “Failed”.
- Foreign nationals can request to have their IPRS status reviewed by visiting Safaricom Retail Centers and Care Desks.
- Foreigners that pass KYC do not qualify for a loan; they can only save.
- The customer will provide either of the documents below;

- - Alien ID.
 - Foreign Passport.
 - Diplomatic Passport.
 - Diplomatic IDs must be accompanied by a foreign/diplomatic Passport which will be subjected to the rules above.

- The CEE will confirm the details on the document against M-PESA and M-Shwari details i.e. vet as per the M-PESA vetting instructions.
- The CEE will raise an SR for the IPRS status to be passed and attach stamped copies of the passport pages containing:
 - Bio details (page with customer’s particulars).
 - Page with immigration stamp.
 - R Number.
 - Period of stay in Kenya.

- On receiving the SR, the RCSA shall confirm all details have been correctly captured and all the required information provided.
- The RCSA shall then create an incident capturing the SR details and assign it to NCBA for update.
- Once resolved by NCBA, the RCSA shall contact the customer, advise them on the resolution and close the SR.
- The SLA is 72 hours.

articleTitle: DIY procedures for My SMS Service/PRS and GET IT 411
markdownContent:
Customers can activate, use and deactivate PRS/ My SMS using different options:

# **My SMS services** **activation:**

1. **USSD****:** By dialing USSD codes \*100# and \*200# and checking under My Subscriptions or \*456\*20#> select Unsubscribe
2. **Call****:** Calling the voice-based number starting with 0900 for services. Customers are only charged during the call.
3. **SMS****:** Sending a message to the short code for activation and services.
4. **Online**: By sharing their contact information on websites offering PRS. e.g. “you have won an iPhone… click here to claim it”

**N.B.** For information for customer requests for a ringtone/wallpaper/video, find information on Premium Rate Service codes are briefly described by My SMS Services provider [here](https://cmintranet/index.php/component/content/article/495?start=2).

**Marketing messages/ Promotion SMS Deactivation**

Customers can stop any marketing messages for free via:

1. **USSD**

i. \*100# or \*200# > My subscriptions > Marketing Messages

ii.\*456# > Stop> Marketing messages (Free to the customer) for both Prepaid and Postpay customers.

By following prompts, customer gets to key in the name of the sender as it appears, and the messages will be stopped.

2. **Safaricom Zuri**

Send a message to Zuri via Whatsapp/Telegram/Blaze Facebook/Whatsapp with the word Unsubscribe and follow prompts to deactivate.

3. **MySafaricom App**

1. Launch the APP
2. Select Account
3. Go to My Subscriptions
4. Select Premium Services & Games
5. **Unsubscribe** from the unwanted channel

**SMS deactivation**

1. Send STOP SENDER ID to **40044,** e.g. STOP Safaricom
2. The Senders **NAME** must be sent in the same case reflecting on the received message, i.e. if sent from **SAFARICOM**, then send **STOP SAFARICOM**, and **NOT STOP** Safaricom, the latter would fail or deactivate the wrong service.

**N.B:** Customers can add back any Sender whose messages they wish to continue receiving under the same menu on “Check Stopped Marketing Messages”, select the specific "Sender Name" to reactivate.

# **How to subscribe to GET IT 411**

1. Dial \*411# ok and follow instructions
2. From Safaricom Kiosk in Phone Menu under Info Kiosk
3. Send SMS with ‘CHANNEL NAME ON’ to 411 or 21411

**To check name or service subscribed on GET IT 411**

Send an SMS with the word ‘LIST’ to 411 or 21411 for free.

# **Deactivating GET IT 411**

**Send an SMS to 21411 or 411 with the word ‘LIST’**

1. 21412 will return a list of all channels that are active on your phone.
2. Subscribers may then deactivate the channels one by one by adding OFF to the key word sent e.g. Breaking News OFF to 21411.

Under My subscriptions customer can deactivate the subscription. Deactivation is free.

**NB:**

**If a customer complains about marketing messages-with mobile number as a sender ID.-This should be treated as fraud and should be reported via 333.**

# **ACTIVATION OF JITAMBULISHE**

Activation is via IVR only, customer will follow the steps below:

- Dial 100/234/200/456 and select language.
- Select the “Jitambulishe “option.
- Select “enroll”
- Enter ID number.
- Record voice password by verbalizing the passphrase “*At Safaricom, my voice is my password*”, repeating it thrice as prompted. This enrolls customers to level 1 of Jitambulishe.
- Enter M-PESA Pin (STK PUSH) to complete enrollment. Customers that enter the correct M-PESA pin are *upgraded to level 2 of Jitambulishe.*

# **Deleting of Jitambulishe**

Customers may also delete their accounts via IVR, to delete, the customer will: -

- Dial 100/200/234/456 and select language.
- Select Jitambulishe on IVR.
- Select delete your vocal password.

Repeat passphrase to delete your vocal password.

articleTitle: How to handle FTTH Remote Router Login/Bridge Requests.
markdownContent:
# **How to handle FTTH** **Remote Router Login/Bridge** **Requests.**

- Bridge mode allows the customer to connect two routers without the risk of performance issues. Bridge mode is the configuration that disables the NAT feature and allows a router to function as a DHCP server without an IP Address conflict.
- Connecting multiple routers can extend the Wi-Fi coverage in your office/home. The L400 CEE will raise a request via an SR to Home Customer Support team with an SLA of 24 hours. The Home team will then validate the request and delete value added services on NCE /Nokia system: Value added services> Delete Value added services and Restore (the router) ONT and select Default restore to delete WAN interface.
- Under ONU Details> Current ONU: Uni Port Info click Modify. Select the active Ethernet (ETH) Either, (1-4) marked in green. Change Default VLAN ID from 1 to 10, they will not add configure Value Added Service.
- Share CI@gpon and unique PPOE password to the customer, they will then login to 192.168.100.1 & modify. The Home Customer Support team will then contact the customer and advise further.

# **Partner Support - SAFARICOM DEVICE FINANCING**

**Safaricom Device Financing**

- This is credit financing given to Safaricom dealers and M-PESA agent head offices to enable them stock devices.
- The credit facility is offered once every month. Repayment period is one month.
- The facility is offered at zero interest rate, has no access fee.
- Agents should opt in for the credit facility via email clearly indicating the smartphones they wish to purchase and their value each month.
- The credit limit is based on previous month commissions.
- Agents will not qualify for the facility if:
 - Are under suspension.
 - Have a history of late payment for the credit advanced.
 - Agents with Bank Guarantee Debt over 15 days

 **Device financing Blacklist**

- Late payment by 3 days; the agent will not be issued with Device financing for 1Month.
- Late payment after 5 days of the repayment week; the agent will not be issued with credit for 2 Months.
- If the repayment falls on the end of the month or agent fails to pay until the end of the month, Finance Team will recover the unpaid funds from the agents’ commissions.

**DEVICE ORDERING PROCESS**

**Ordering**

- To order devices on dealer portal, Agency head office/dealer needs to deposit funds on the portal.
- Dealer portal deposit can be done through.
 - Safaricom sales pay bill number 929200 and enter dealer portal code as the account number.
 - Through ABSA bank account 775044667 and capture dealer portal code on the deposit slip
 - Device credit financing
- After loading funds dealer will then login on dealer portal and select order initiation
- Select handset then Scroll to the specific handset and select make order.
- Dealer will then be prompted to specify the quantity of devices requested then select the warehouse/Ministore to collect from
- Enter order number and attach purchase order then proceed to validate order.
- The system will then generate order number.
- For failed ordering, the Safaricom support staff will inquire from the dealer the order number, or order date, or dealer code.
- The staff will then need to log into S-Hub > Dealer Enquiry > Search using the provided order number, or order date, or dealer code.
- Confirm the order status and if

Closed: The staff will access S-Hub > Dealer Enquiry > Click on View. On the pop-up window generated, select Safaricom Picklist. Another window will again pop-up and in the dialog, box enter the order number and select.

# **Definition.**

The Unclaimed Financial Assets Authority (UFAA) is an Authority created under the Unclaimed Financial Assets Act, No. 40 of 2011 to administer unclaimed financial assets. The primary mandate of the Authority is to receive unclaimed financial assets from the holders of such assets, safeguard, and re-unite the assets with their rightful owners.

These are assets that.

- Have been presumed abandoned and have become unclaimed assets under the provisions of sections 4 to 18 of UFA Act.
- Have been transferred to the Authority as unclaimed assets.
- Have been deemed under any other law to be unclaimed assets and payable to the Authority, and includes all income, dividend or interest thereon but excludes any lawful charges thereon.

#  **Unclaimed asset to UFAA submission by Safaricom** 

Safaricom submits all assets that have remained unclaimed for two years to the Unclaimed Financial Assets Authority.

The next ok kin will be required to visit Safaricom Shop with the death certificate of the account owner. The Customer Experience Executive will either print the holder letter or send it to their email. This will be presented to UFAA to claim the funds.

NB. UFAA will advise customer on their next of kin claim process.

The customer will be required to visit the financial institution (holder of the assets) to provide a holder letter to claim from UFAA. For KCB-M-PESA customer will visit KCB bank and visit NCBA bank for funds that were held on M-shwari.

Receive fixed data customers related issues as per the channel procedure.

Advise customer on the escalation progress and resolution and close the SR.

# **Step–By–Step procedure and requirements**

**Why are adjustments done**

Reasons for increments.

Customer charged connection fee erroneously

Bulk payments by new customers activates the highest package

Lack of proration after product is removed from the customer account.

Failed payment integration on CRM

POS Bulk payments (1 package at a time)

Payment made to wrong account

Managers/Retention discretion as compensation for bad experience.

4G for Home browsing out of bundle.

# **Payment made to wrong account**

The CEE will remove the product on the wrong account and raise SR with details indicating wrong CI and the correct CI, amount prorated on IN data. The CEE will then raise a decrement activity and inform the customer of SLA.

The line 400 Team Leader will approve the decrement activity and the funds will be removed from the wrong CI.

The CEE on the folder team will pick the SR and confirm that the funds have been removed from the wrong account and prepare the file to be uploaded on CBS

The Line 400 team leader will approve via email the file to be uploaded.

The CEE on the folder will the upload the approved increment file to CBS discount account.

The folder CEE will confirm that the account has been credited, customer will be contacted, and the SR will be closed after attaching Team leader approval and the file uploaded.

# **Bulk payments by new customers activates the highest package.**

The CEE will remove the wrong product that was activated, amount will be prorated. The CEE will raise a ticket with details of amount to be increased.

The Line 400 team leader will approve via email the file to be uploaded.

The CEE on the folder will the upload the approved increment file to CBS discount account to activate the correct product.

The folder CEE will confirm that the account has been credited, customer will be contacted, and the SR will be closed after attaching Team leader approval and the file uploaded.

# **Customer charged connection fee erroneously.**

The CEE will raise SR for increment with the amount to be credited that was charged as connection fees with details such as transaction ID and CI.

The CEE on the folder team will pick the SR and confirm that the customer is existing and should not have been charged connection fee, afterward prepare the upload file.

The Line 400 team leader will approve the file via email.

The CEE on the folder will then upload the approved increment file to CBS discount account

The folder CEE will confirm that the account has been credited, customer will be contacted, and the SR will be closed after attaching Team leader approval and the file uploaded.

# **When fund fails to prorate.**

The CEE will manually compute the amount that should have prorated after the product was removed. The CEE will raise SR for increment with the amount to be credited. The CEE on the folder team will pick the SR and confirm that the product was removed, and funds failed to prorate, The CEE will also confirm that the computation of the proration is correct, afterward prepare the upload file.

The Line 400 team leader will approve the file via email.

The CEE on the folder will the upload the approved increment file to CBS discount account

The folder CEE will confirm that the account has been credited, customer will be contacted, and the SR will be closed after attaching Team leader approval and the file uploaded.

The Team Leader will review the customer complain and establish if the customer was given a bad experience or there is justification for service recovery .The team leader will propose a form of compensation and the amount to be credited to the customers account.The experience will be discussed with the Manager Line 400 who will approve ,adjust or decline the amount proposed as a compensation.

The amount approved will be communicated to The Team Leader .

An SR will be raised with the amount agreed

The CEE on the folder team will pick the SR, afterward prepare the upload file.

# **Anti-Money Laundering Sanctions**

**International Money transfer Anti-money Laundering sanction screening FAQs**

**What is anti-money money laundering (AML) real time sanction screening**?

- This is a solution that ensures all International Money Transfer **(IMT)** transactions are screened against local and international sanctions list, before funds are credited or debited from a customer’s M-Pesa Wallet

**Why the change to real time sanction screening?**

- All IMT transactions are screened against international sanctions and local lists. Outbound IMT transactions are screened on a real time basis while Inbound IMT transactions are screened as a batch at the end of the day. However, Inbound IMT transactions present a higher sanctions risk as the sending party is not our customer.
- To adhere to regulatory requirement on screening of cross border payments and ensuring best practice in compliance to international regulations

**Which service is being impacted by the real time screening?**

- International money remittance inbound service

4. **Which partners will be Impacted by the real time screening?**

- All partners offering international money transfer Inbound service terminating to M-PESA; these include aggregators, local and International Money Transfer partners as per the attached list

5. **What are some of the reason’s transactions would be held/cancelled?**

- 2081 - The International Money transfer transaction has been cancelled due to failed Anti money laundering Screening.
- 2082 - The International money transfer transaction (request) has expired.
- 1005 - The element is invalid. The element or field is required and does not allow empty string.
- 1002 - Parameter missing or data type error. The Parameter is required in the request and does not allow empty string. (Nationality, Date of Birth, ID No. & type )

6. **What advise do you give to customers whose transactions have been cancelled as a result of failed Anti Money laundering screening**?

- Please contact the sender.

7. **What advise do you give to customers whose transactions have been held awaiting Anti Money laundering (AML) action/review**?

- Transaction delayed, processing is in progress

8. **How long will it take for the funds to be availed?**

- If the transaction was held because of Anti Money laundering screening, advise the customer that the transaction will be reviewed within the hour.
- Share the transaction details with the Anti Money laundering (AML) team, Erica Wakisha, Joel Mbandu or Selina Anyolo.
- Once the transaction is reviewed and noted to be a false match, the funds will be availed to the customer immediately on MPESA.
- If the transaction is noted to have a positive match, this will be cancelled, and a response will be sent to the partner who will provide information to the sending customer. Refer to response in Q6.

9. **What happens when a customer calls and there is no transaction ID on G2**?

- The transaction might not have been fully processed by the sending partner. Advise the MPESA customer to liaise with sender to confirm that the transaction was completed successfully by the sending partner.

# Definition and Benefits of Safaricom CCTV Back Up

### Definition

- This is a service that enables businesses/customers to store footage from their surveillance camera(s) in the Safaricom Cloud and access it from any internet-enabled device whenever required.
- An IP camera will record the video/image footage and the resulting content will be distributed over an IP (Internet protocol) network. IP Surveillance is a digitized and networked version of closed-circuit television (CCTV).

### Benefits

1. **Self Service/Self-help Customer Portal** \- Customers/Partners are able to view and manage video/images stored in the cloud through their smart walls/phones etc.
2. **Remote Access-**Secure log in and remote server access. Customers will use a web-based interface / application to view real-time & recorded footage on PCs, Macs, as well as on mobile devices such as the iPhone, iPad, and Android-based devices.
3. **Security and Safety**: Data back-up assurance for a period of one calendar month.
4. **Cost Efficiency:** Customers will not invest in hardware and or data centers.
5. **Extended Coverage:** Access to Safaricom’s extended infrastructure coverage from the cellular network to fixed services.

# Tariffs

1. Safaricom CCTV Back up is available to post pay customers and the proposition is on a minimum 1-year renewable contract.
2. Post pay customers will be required to pay a security deposit (equivalent to a month’s subscription fee) at the point of sign up as well as the first month subscription fee.
3. Safaricom will offer the attached tariffs. ie. 500/- for Bronze, 2000/- for Silver, 4000/- for Gold and 8000/- for Platinum. (see attached for tariff details)

**NOTE:**

1. Prices above are per camera, per month
2. Prices above are inclusive of all applicable taxes
3. Footage is stored in the cloud for up to 30 days

Safaricom CCTV Back up Tariff details

 [Screenshot] 

# Requirements for the Safaricom CCTV Back Up service and how it works

### Requirements

1. Dully filled form at Safaricom shop.
2. Valid business permit or trading license/certificate of incorporation.
3. Owner’s national ID number or passport/company’s Pin certificate.
4. A refundable equivalent to one month’s subscription to the respective package.
5. Pre-payments for your first month’s usage.

### 

### How Safaricom CCTV Back Up works

1. To get the service you need to have an IP enabled camera.
2. If you do not have one, contact the Safaricom authorized merchant **Spotted Anywhere** whose contacts are: cloud@spottedanywhere.com and 0799871485.
3. If not connected to Safaricom Fibre, we can offer you a dedicated SIM card connection to the internet enabling your cameras to transmit images to the Safaricom Cloud. These MSISDNS will have the CCTV APN on HLR and data bundle will be allocated once a month. Normal mobile/fixed data billing charges apply.
4. For MSISNDs missing APNs – CEE will raise and SR to CCSA/RCSA who will follow up with IPNOC for CCTV APN provisioning. Access your footage from anywhere at any time through a password protected online portal: [https://CCTV.Safaricom.co.ke](https://cctv.safaricom.co.ke/)

# Safaricom CCTV Backup Solution requirements

This solution is dependent on proper functioning of the following:

1. Camera/s installed at the customer premises/preferred locations.
2. Cloud storage space and proper allocation of storage partitions to customers - When the resources provisioned on the Safaricom cloud get exhausted the system will automatically begin over-writing earlier footage on a “First-in, first-out” (FIFO) basis.
3. Secure connectivity – Mobile or fixed. Provisions on mobile the MSISDNs must have data resources and correct APN on HLR Customers on Fixed the connection must work.
4. Archiving and backup of the stored footage – Data will only be stored for 30 days.

Billing - Integrations on billing/customer management systems. ie. CBS, CRM, BI and Milestone platform touch points. Customers should not have debts.

# Connectivity, Connected Camera and cloud storage/backup

### Connected Camera

1. Hardware including physical connection and associated cameras plus Staging box/gateways.

These will be:

1. **Single Location** – one surveillance site supporting one or several cameras
2. **Multiple Location** – unlimited surveillance sites in one or various locations

2. The camera will capture necessary information and physical metrics i.e. location, time stamp, status etc. from the connected asset.
3. Cameras will be connected to the Safaricom’s Cloud and the VMS/Self-help platforms
4. Customers subscribed to this service will use a device ie. Computer / tablet / phone / video wall to access their surveillance camera/s.
5. Customers subscribed to this service must have compatible camera/s before on boarding. Purchase request will be directed to the current authorized merchant ie. Spotted Anywhere whose contacts are: cloud@spottedanywhere.com and 0799871485

### Connectivity

1. Communication medium through which the video recordings are communicated to a storage server for processing.
2. These include cellular and fixed media.
3. Upload/Backup of the recordings to the Cloud heavily relies on connectivity of the on-premise storage/IP camera to the Cloud.

1. Safaricom will provision secure connectivity to ensure backup of the recording to the cloud remotely for customers on the Service.
2. Customer who pick Bronze and Gold must have existing Safaricom fixed connectivity for the solution to work.

# Cloud Storage/Backup

1. Data is stored on remote servers accessed from the Internet over IP, or "cloud." Safaricom will maintain, operate and manage storage servers that are built on virtualization techniques.
2. Safaricom will store data for a period of one calendar month (30 days). Data older than one calendar month will not be available for access or retrieval.
3. Customers will be able to access this data via the CCTV Back up portal.
4. Customers shall be provisioned for storage as per their contractual agreements/tariff.
5. Consumption of the storage space provisioned to the customer shall depend on:

1. Camera quality & by extension footage quality/resolution
2. Level of activity at the customer premises

6. When the resources provisioned on the Safaricom cloud get exhausted the system will automatically begin over-writing earlier footage on a “First-in, first-out” (FIFO) basis.
7. All customer footage saved on the Safaricom cloud platform will automatically be deleted following 3 continuous months of non-payment of bills as agreed in this commercial contract

# Application Enablement & Platform

Specialized software & tools that can convert asset’s raw video/data into useful information i.e. dashboards, smart walls, analytics and reporting.

The following are the requirements for appointment as a Safaricom Premium Rate Service (PRS) provider:

Apply for a PRS license from Communications Commission of Kenya (CCK). For more information visit [www.cck.go.ke](http://www.cck.go.ke/). 

#
