articleTitle: SMS Guidelines on Unfreezing Bonga and M-Shwari Loan Cycle
markdownContent:
.

# **SMS Guidelines on** **Unfreezing Bonga/ETU**

Subs Bonga/ETU account frozen but has already cleared their debts –**don’t vet**. Just unfreeze and advise the customer.

Sub’s Bonga/ETU account frozen but still has unpaid loan: Do Not request for vetting details, check fraudster trace and advise subs to repay their loan without divulging access to M-Shwari account and information.

**English Script** - Jambo, Your Bonga account may be frozen due to an unpaid M-Shwari loan. To check, go to M-PESA>Loan and savings>M-Shwari>Loan>Check loan limit. Thank you.

**Kiswahili Script** - Jambo, yawezekana akaunti yako ya bonga imefungwa sababu ya deni la M-Shwari. Kuangalia chagua MPESA>Loan and savings>M-Shwari>Loan>Check loan limit. Asante.

# **M-Shwari Loan Cycle**

| DAY 0 - 30 | DAY 31 - 60 | DAY 61 - 70 | DAY 71 - 80 | DAY 81 - 90 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| NORMAL | NORMAL | LOAN PENDING | LOAN RESTRICT | LOAN RESTRICT |
| The customer is actively transacting on M-Shwari and can get a loan. | The customer is actively transacting on M-Shwari and can get a loan. | LOAN PENDING is when it is past Day 60 and the customer still has a loan outstanding. | LOAN RESTICT STATUS is when a customer has paid off their loan past Day 60 but are within the 30-day restriction period. | LOAN RESTICT STATUS is when a customer has paid off their loan past Day 60 but are within the 30-day restriction period. |

**DAY 0-30: - (LOAN STATUS –NORMAL)**

- 1st day customer is sent an SMS with amount due and due date. Total amount payable is the principal amount plus facilitation fee 7.5%.
- The customer can pay even before 30 days.
- The SMS reminders are sent on 10 and 20 day.
- On 28th day the customer is advised on Rollover Fee and sanction on limit qualification/ increase if payment is late.

**NB;** when the loan status is normal and customer does not have a loan or any cancel posted loan amounts, but the Available Loan Limit amount is less than the Loan Limit Amount, kindly escalate to NCBA via an SR for the loan limit and available loan amount to be synchronized**.**

**DAY 31-60: - (LOAN STATUS –WATCH)**

- On 31st day any amount in customers M-Shwari account is taken to repay the loan and the customer is advised.
- If the loan is not fully settled on day 32 a roll over fee (7.5%) is added to any outstanding loan and a new due date given.
- On the same day all the saving into M-Shwari account are capped i.e. customer can deposit but cannot withdraw the amount equal to the amount of loan due.
- On day 35 and 40 the customer gets a SMS reminder with amount and due date.

**DAY 61-70 (LOAN STATUS – SUB STANDARD)**

**Day 61:** if the customer had made a deposit to their M-Shwari the amount is auto-debited deducted to repay the loan due. Also, the lock savings funds will be auto debited on day 61 of any overdue loan.

**Day 62:** Sends reminder notice advising the customer of sanctions to be applied by 6pm in the case of non-payment; e.g. - Denial of M-SHWARI Credit -Risk of being listed on CRB.

**Day 63:** The customer is restricted from accessing M-Shwari loan for 30 days after clearing the full amount pending. In Siebel appears as Customer Status: LOAN PD RESTRICT. **Limit reduction:**

Limit will reduce to 80% of the current limit or to the previous limit whichever is lower, with the minimum limit being Kes.100/-.

**DAY 71-80 (LOAN STATUS – DOUBTFUL)**

**Day 75:** Outbound calls to the customer advising of barring from Okoa Jahazi & Bonga points if M-SHWARI debt is unpaid by day 80 and of possible loss of credit limit.

**Day 80:** Block Okoa Jahazi and Bonga accumulation until the loan is paid in full.

- When a customer pays the loan, the process automatically unfreezes ETU and Bonga.
- This process is instantaneous/real-time. SMS notification is also sent to the customer advising unfreezing.
- In the event that the resumption of Bonga Points is not immediate, Activate from CBS/LMS Tab on CRM.

**DAY 81-90 (LOAN STATUS- LOSS)**

**On Day 85,** Notice shall inform customer of cancellation of credit limit on Day 90 and remaining notice period on CRB listing**.**

**On Day 90:** Issued with Formal 30-Day CRB Notice.

**DAY 91-120 (LOAN STATUS – LOSS)**

Reduce credit limit to zero.

**On Day 113-** customer is issued with a 7- Day CRB Reminder Notice

**Day 120-** customer is issued with Final CRB Reminder Notice; Follow CRB Listing Process.

**Note:**

Outbound calls will be made to the clients from day 70 to advise them on the need to clear the loans. This is done as agreed with clients hence continuous from Day 70.

# **Payments** **Portal BE Migration and Closure**

All the requests for BE account management must be done in writing. The request must:

Have the respective company letter head and bear the organization stamp/seal

Be signed by 2 official signatories (1 for companies with sole signatories)

Include the respective Short Code

Include the name of the BEs

Where the request is accompanied by creation of a new BE or M-PESA Organization the customer must fill in an onboarding form and will provide the current KYC.

#  **BE to BE Migration – Different Organizations**

This will apply where the current BE and the new BE belong to different organizations.

All M-PESA Organizations under BEs owned by different organizations will not be done without written consent and a signed/approved novation indicating the agreement to transfer ownership.

A change of name certificate will be presented where the organization name is affected.

On boarding of merchant to EBU will be effected as per existing process.

All changes will be effected on G2 first be accompanied by changes on M-PESA Business Payments Portal changes. i.e.

Closure of the M-PESA Organization on the current BE and addition of the M-PESA Organization on the new BE where available.

Where the new BE does not exist, the team will create a new BE and add the new M-PESA Organization.

Closure of the current BE if the same does not contain other M-PESA Organizations. The partner must be advised on this before closure of the BE

This will be effected by LNM Onboarding Team; all the other teams will raise and SR.

This will apply where the current BE (Business Enterprises) and the new BE belong to the same organization.

All M-PESA Organizations under BEs owned by the same organization will not be done without written consent.

All changes will be effected on G2 first be accompanied by changes on M-PESA Business Payments Portal changes. i.e.

articleTitle: Jitambulishe services at the Contact Centre
markdownContent:
# **VERIFICATION AND AUTHENTICATION OF JITAMBULISHE**

- Enrolled customers will be required to recite the passphrase: English: “*At Safaricom my voice is my password*” and Kiswahili “*Sauti yangu ndio kitambulisho changu*”
- A voice comparison with the original is done and a comparison threshold displayed on WDE as per below table.

| Threshold | Implication |
| --- | --- |
| Match | Enrolled owner calling |
| Partial Match | Owner could have tried more than once due to background interference |
| Mismatch | Not ownerOwner is within defined prison siteNumber not the VB verified numberToo much background noise |
| Undefined | Call not gone through VB verification (system maybe down) |
| Blank | Customer not enrolled |

- The authentication threshold shall be displayed on WDE and on CRM Voice Bio tab as well.
- CEE will vet customers calling the call center for services based on: -

- The threshold displayed
- Enrolment level.
- The service being sought by the customer.
- Customers on level 2 who attain full match threshold, shall not be vetted for services pertaining the verified number.
- The threshold displayed on WDE applies to the number that has been used to call and this may not be the number that needs assistance. CEE will confirm this before proceeding to assist.
- Regular vetting will be applied to all outbound calls done by CEE

**NOTE*:*** Jitambulishe does not replace fraud checks i.e., a sim swap request will require the CEE to still make an outbound call and perform all the necessary fraud checks.

# **JITAMBULISHE UPGRADE, SUSPENSION AND DELETION**

Contact center CEE will confirm the line has not been replaced within the last 24hrs, then proceed to vet.

| Prepaid Vetting | Postpaid Vetting |
| --- | --- |
| Name plus any two below M-PESA BalDOBAirtime Bal2 FDNs2 recent self-initiated M-PESA transactions | Name plus any two below Last paymentCredit limitPostal/email addressM-PESA Bal2 recent self-initiated M-PESA transactions |

- After successful vetting for an **upgrade**, CEE will: -

- Open "voice bio" tab on CRM
- Click on "view"
- Select "edit"
- Change the "agent vetted" drop-down menu from **Level 1** to **Level 2**
- Select "save" to finish the upgrade.
- After successfully vetting for **suspend/activate**, CEE will: -
- Open “voice bio” tab on CRM
- Click on “view”
- Click “edit”
- Change the VB status to suspended/activate
- Select “Save”

A VB account may be deleted due to: -

- Change of ownership
- Fraudulent or erroneous enrolment
- Recycled line
- If a customer shared details with fraudsters or where the line was swapped fraudulently

- Cee will go to “edit” from CRM after vetting as per above table and select “delete voice print”.
- Where customer fails vetting, CEE will advise customer to do a self-upgrade by:

- dialing \*456#
- Select jitambulishe
- Upgrade jitambulishe
- M-PESA pin
- The complete DIY process creates an interaction in Siebel.
- **Level 1** customers calling for the below services shall be upgraded without further vetting:
- Block/Unblock line
- M-PESA unlock account
- M-PESA pin
- Bonga pin/reset

However, this will not apply for lines that have been swapped within the last 24 hours.

- Once a customer has been upgraded on CRM, a message will be sent informing them of the services they can access at this level. CEE will not be required to repeat this.

# **ACCESS LEVELS**

- CEE can view each customer’s level on WDE and Siebel. On Siebel, CEE will go to “voice bio” then “agent vetted” tab.
- Different levels of enrollment allow access to specific self-services on IVR. CEE will use below table to confirm.

| Enrolment Levels | Enrolment status | Self-services Accessible on IVR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Not enrolled on VB | Not enrolled on VB | Fuliza balance. Limit and statement.KCB M-PESA limitETU requestM-PESA mini and full statementData bundle purchaseSkiza download, Skiza delete, PRS account status |
| Level 1 | Enrolled on IVR or via the Safaricom app | PUK retrievalBar lost or stolen lineM-PESA unlock accBonga pin set/resetM-PESA balanceRed card unbarBonga transfer |
| Level 2 | Vetted and upgraded by an agent or Upgraded on IVR after entering M-PESA pin | Sim replacementM-PESA start key requestsAccount mini statement |

- Enrolled customers may in some instances, achieve a low verification threshold. In this case, an update/re-enrollment can be done.
- To perform an update, customer will: -

- Dial 100/200/234/456 and select language
- Select Jitambulishe
- Select update your vocal password/re-enroll
- Repeat your passphrase to re-enroll or update your vocal password.

# **ESCALATION MATRIX**

- CEE needs to escalate any service-related issue that is not able to be resolved on call to support team via SR. e.g for enrollment failure:
- **Category**: Jitambulishe Service
- **Type**: Enrolment
- **Item**: IVR enrolment failed
- All system related issues shall be escalated via BMC under system outage link. Where the outage is global and is communicated, the CEE will not need to raise a BMC ticket.

articleTitle: Introduction and IP Surveillance Platform features
markdownContent:
# Definition and Benefits of Safaricom CCTV Back Up

### Definition

- This is a service that enables businesses/customers to store footage from their surveillance camera(s) in the Safaricom Cloud and access it from any internet-enabled device whenever required.
- An IP camera will record the video/image footage and the resulting content will be distributed over an IP (Internet protocol) network. IP Surveillance is a digitized and networked version of closed-circuit television (CCTV).

### Benefits

1. **Self Service/Self-help Customer Portal** \- Customers/Partners are able to view and manage video/images stored in the cloud through their smart walls/phones etc.
2. **Remote Access-**Secure log in and remote server access. Customers will use a web-based interface / application to view real-time & recorded footage on PCs, Macs, as well as on mobile devices such as the iPhone, iPad, and Android-based devices.
3. **Security and Safety**: Data back-up assurance for a period of one calendar month.
4. **Cost Efficiency:** Customers will not invest in hardware and or data centers.
5. **Extended Coverage:** Access to Safaricom’s extended infrastructure coverage from the cellular network to fixed services.

## Tariffs

1. Safaricom CCTV Back up is available to post pay customers and the proposition is on a minimum 1-year renewable contract.
2. Post pay customers will be required to pay a security deposit (equivalent to a month’s subscription fee) at the point of sign up as well as the first month subscription fee.
3. Safaricom will offer the attached tariffs. ie. 500/- for Bronze, 2000/- for Silver, 4000/- for Gold and 8000/- for Platinum. (see attached for tariff details)

**NOTE:**

1. Prices above are per camera, per month
2. Prices above are inclusive of all applicable taxes
3. Footage is stored in the cloud for up to 30 days

Safaricom CCTV Back up Tariff details

# Requirements for the Safaricom CCTV Back Up service and how it works

### Requirements

1. Dully filled form at Safaricom shop.
2. Valid business permit or trading license/certificate of incorporation.
3. Owner’s national ID number or passport/company’s Pin certificate.
4. A refundable equivalent to one month’s subscription to the respective package.
5. Pre-payments for your first month’s usage.

# How Safaricom CCTV Back Up works

1. To get the service you need to have an IP enabled camera.
2. If you do not have one, contact the Safaricom authorized merchant **Spotted Anywhere** whose contacts are: cloud@spottedanywhere.com and 0799871485.

These MSISDNS will have the CCTV APN on HLR and data bundle will be allocated once a month. Normal mobile/fixed data billing charges apply.
4. For MSISNDs missing APNs – CEE will raise and SR to CCSA/RCSA who will follow up with IPNOC for CCTV APN provisioning. Access your footage from anywhere at any time through a password protected online portal: [https://CCTV.Safaricom.co.ke](https://cctv.safaricom.co.ke/)

# Safaricom CCTV Backup Solution requirements

This solution is dependent on proper functioning of the following:

1. Camera/s installed at the customer premises/preferred locations.
2. Cloud storage space and proper allocation of storage partitions to customers - When the resources provisioned on the Safaricom cloud get exhausted the system will automatically begin over-writing earlier footage on a “First-in, first-out” (FIFO) basis.
3. Secure connectivity – Mobile or fixed. Provisions on mobile the MSISDNs must have data resources and correct APN on HLR Customers on Fixed the connection must work.
4. Archiving and backup of the stored footage – Data will only be stored for 30 days.

Billing - Integrations on billing/customer management systems. ie. CBS, CRM, BI and Milestone platform touch points. Customers should not have debts.

# Connectivity, Connected Camera and cloud storage/backup

### Connected Camera

1. Hardware including physical connection and associated cameras plus Staging box/gateways.

These will be:

1. **Single Location** – one surveillance site supporting one or several cameras
2. **Multiple Location** – unlimited surveillance sites in one or various locations

2. The camera will capture necessary information and physical metrics i.e. location, time stamp, status etc. from the connected asset.
3. Cameras will be connected to the Safaricom’s Cloud and the VMS/Self-help platforms
4. Customers subscribed to this service will use a device ie. Computer / tablet / phone / video wall to access their surveillance camera/s.
5. Customers subscribed to this service must have compatible camera/s before on boarding. Purchase request will be directed to the current authorized merchant ie. Spotted Anywhere whose contacts are: cloud@spottedanywhere.com and 0799871485

### Connectivity

3. Upload/Backup of the recordings to the Cloud heavily relies on connectivity of the on-premise storage/IP camera to the Cloud.

1. Safaricom will provision secure connectivity to ensure backup of the recording to the cloud remotely for customers on the Service.
2. Customer who pick Bronze and Gold must have existing Safaricom fixed connectivity for the solution to work.

### Cloud Storage/Backup

1. Data is stored on remote servers accessed from the Internet over IP, or "cloud." Safaricom will maintain, operate and manage storage servers that are built on virtualization techniques.
2. Safaricom will store data for a period of one calendar month (30 days). Data older than one calendar month will not be available for access or retrieval.
3. Customers will be able to access this data via the CCTV Back up portal.
4. Customers shall be provisioned for storage as per their contractual agreements/tariff.
5. Consumption of the storage space provisioned to the customer shall depend on:

1. Camera quality & by extension footage quality/resolution
2. Level of activity at the customer premises

6. When the resources provisioned on the Safaricom cloud get exhausted the system will automatically begin over-writing earlier footage on a “First-in, first-out” (FIFO) basis.
7. All customer footage saved on the Safaricom cloud platform will automatically be deleted following 3 continuous months of non-payment of bills as agreed in this commercial contract

# Application Enablement & Platform

# Installation SLA Safaricom CCTV Back Up service

articleTitle: Data Billing/ Discounts/Promotions; 4G for Home & FTTH
markdownContent:
**Data Billing/ Discounts/Promotions; 4G for Home & FTTH**

# **Data Usage Dispute.**

Where customer calls to enquire on their data bundle usage or dispute the data balances, the CEE will log into CRM-Siebel and query the 4G number to confirm subscription status, and troubleshoot customer account as applicable i.e.

Confirm on IN data, product plan and resource balances.

Confirm whether the customer has hit FUP, and speeds are throttled.

Confirm from the transaction history tab that the client is pushing traffic or Not.

CEE will select Usage transparency tab and will query the dates, select usage type as data, query customer account to populate usage history and volume of data used and will advise customer accordingly.

Where the customer is not satisfied with the resolution given the CEE will send a request via SR via SR to L400 and assign D\_FTTH\_USER for line 400 support team to action, and will advise the registered customer available channels i.e. email or call via L400. SLA is 24 Hrs.

For Billing issues, wrong resources allocated, customer notification mapping issues, post-pay billing issues, System Integration support issues, USSD system performance, change of APN, checking of APN profile, the L400 folder CEE will troubleshoot and escalate via BMC to the CBS team where applicable and advise on 2Hrs SLA.

# **Resolution process ; Discounts and promotions.**

Where discount is given to a customer and the same is not allocated on customer account.

Where the customer contacts other channels other than L400 within call center i.e. L200/100, social media etc., the CEE will send a request via SR to L400 and assign D\_FTTH\_USER for line 400 support team to action, and will advise the registered customer available channels i.e. email or call via L400. SLA is 24 Hrs.

L400 Folder CEE will raise manual adjustment of airtime equivalent to the discount on the customerâ€™s 4G account and will advise customer accordingly.

# **Definition**

This involves the guidelines to be used by analysts when communicating to customers mainly via emails.

# **I****ntroduction**

- **E-Mail purpose**

The subject of the email should clearly address the key subject therefore facilitating the customer's ability to identify the issue at a glance. Where a customer has sent an email without a subject, the analyst is expected to amend and indicate a subject in the reply email.

- **Addressing Customer/Contact**

There are customers who prefer being addressed by use of their titles or names. i.e. Dr. / Hon. Or when in doubt one can use Mr. /Ms. This applies to emails received in the advantage/customer care /mobile office folders. It is however appropriate to reply based on how the customer guides us following how he/she signs off his name in the email sent.

- **Acknowledgment/Reference statement of previous e-Mail sent/received.**

The email message should make reference to/acknowledge any previous mail sent/received on the same subject. There should be an appreciation for the mail sent by the customer.

# **Resolution & Response**

- The information provided to the customer should be in line with Safaricom Processes and Procedures. The analyst should ensure that the information provided is procedural and accurate.
- The analyst is also expected to make reference to any repeat emails, previous interactions or any existing correspondence related to the issue to provide the customer with an exhaustive resolution.
- Where an issue is resolved via a call to the customer, the analyst is still expected to send an email to the customer indicating the resolution given. This ensures visibility to all referring to the email. Examples of issues requiring call clarification are billing issues, postpaid issues.
- On resolving the issue, the analyst should send an SMS notification to the contact number prompting the customer to check their inbox. SMS must be sent from CRM and visible under activities. Script to be used is:

**“Dear customer, we have responded to your email. Please check your inbox. Thank you for choosing the Better Option.”**

- The analyst should ensure that all the required information is given to the customer resulting in a one-off resolution. The analyst should ensure that they use all the resources available and provide any alternatives applicable as well as DIY procedures where required e.g. USSD procedures and Web selfcare.
- All responses should be given within an appropriate time of receiving the e-Mail – **2 hrs**

# **Professional Communication.**

- The analyst should be able to communicate with either Kiswahili or English effectively and clearly.
- The choice of the language to opt for should be made by the customer.
- The preferred language choice will be based on the language used by the subscriber to communicate.
- The choice of words should project a warm and willing approach in resolving the issue/problem.
- The response should not be rude, abusive, pompous or condescending in tone and should reflect Safaricom image positively.
- The email should be short and precise with all necessary information included and conveyed in a systematic and easy to understand manner.
- The Grammar and Punctuation marks must be correctly used with no typographical errors.
- Where there is a need to include supporting information, these should be easy to scan bullet points or short paragraphs, including an easy to access document format. Use of appropriate Font type & size, Font colour, spacing, paragraphing, formatting etc. as outlined in the Safaricom Brand requirements.

# **Escalation & Closure .**

In the event of an escalation,

- The analyst will select the correct Categories/Type/item.

- Where a follow up/escalation is required, the analyst will raise an SR /Activity (where applicable i.e. number /account is provided/issue requires customer’s number) for tracking to the concerned team and advise the customer on SLA, as well as provide progressive feedback. This is especially so for issues escalated via email both external (advantage, customer care & Mobile office etc.) and internal folders.
- The analyst will respond with the SR number/Activity id as a reference to the customer and, also quote the SR number/ Activity Number in their email escalation to the relevant team.
- The analyst should appreciate and thank the customer while encouraging them to offer feedback.
- The analyst needs to associate the customer’s email address to a reachable subscriber voice contact where the contact is provided on the email.
- The analyst will include the staff member's full name and department/section/workstation and contacts when signing off the email.

# **Politeness & Respect.**

- The communication should always be polite and respectful way
- Instances of poor or rude behaviour on call shall be determined by:

1. Poor/inappropriate/belittling choice of words,
2. Patronizing or condescending behaviour or talking down to the customer,
3. Being argumentative, out rightly dismissing or ignoring the customer

articleTitle: Skiza Artists Registration, Content Providers and Portal Management
markdownContent:
**Registration with MCSK**

- MUSIC COPYRIGHT SOCIETY OF KENYA is registered under the Companies Act (Cap 486 of the law of Kenya) as a Company Limited by Guarantee.
- Applications are through their regional offices countrywide.
- Application forms can also be accessed from their website [www.mcsk.or.ke](http://www.mcsk.or.ke/) then presented to the office.
- After being vetted by the Regional Director and Regional committee members, a membership number is issued once approved.
- If the application is not successful, official communication is done via the provided mode of communication.

# **Contacting Content Providers**

- Safaricom works with appointed content providers e.g. IMS, Cellulant, Liberty Africa and Bern sof.
- Contact details for content providers partners can be found in the Premium Rate Services section via link: [https://www.safaricom.co.ke/personal/value-added-services/entertainment/skiza-tunes](https://www.safaricom.co.ke/personal/value-added-services/entertainment/skiza-tunes)
- The artists can also dial 191 to access Safaricom directory Service (Chargeable at 20shs per call).
- Content Providers will be responsible for sourcing, formatting and uploading digital content onto the Skiza system.

# **Skiza Artist Portal Registration and Management**

The artists can be able to register and access the portal by Dialing \*622# and then follow prompts or Go to [www.Skiza.com](http://www.skiza.com/)

**Credential Management**

To access the Artist Portal, customer requires to input the service PIN to be able to access their revenue statements. In case the Artists has forgotten the Service Pin they can use the below process to change

- Dial \*622#
- Select “Forgot PIN”
- Enter National ID
- Set your preferred PIN
- Conﬁrm new PIN
- SMS is sent to the customer conﬁrming PIN reset.

# **Statement view and Portal access**

- The Artists can view their Revenue statement Dial \*622# and select Query Skiza Revenue or Go to www.skiza.com and select report.
- The artists monthly revenue report detailing the number of Skiza tunes and revenue generated per song will be sent via email by the 5th day of every month.
- Accesses to the Artist Portal using SIM from another network will not be possible. Only artists who are Safaricom subscribers can access their Skiza revenue statements via USSD and SMS.
- Skiza artists can access the revenue report as many times as they wish.
- The Portal will be accessible to both pre-pay and post-pay subscribers.

**Skiza Forum** **for Artists**

For artists to attend the Skiza forums they will need to register using below process

1. Dial \*622#
2. Select region they want to attend.
3. Enter their personal details.
4. They will receive a conﬁrmation SMS

# **Downloading and Deleting Tunes at Contact Center**

**Download Tune**

To download a tune directly for customers who has a problem downloading,

1. Query the number on CRM
2. Click on RBT TAB where you can get RBTs Product menu where you will be able to add, Edit and Delete Skiza tunes.

**Delete Tune**

1. Click RBT tab on Siebel
2. Then delete the tune on CRM as requested by customer.

# **Skiza tune not playing**

- Enquire download/renewal date to ensure it is valid. (Confirmation can be done from Skiza system/portal). All Skiza tunes are valid for one day at Kshs. 1.50 or 1/- after which it is auto-renewed if customer has enough airtime balance at renewal time).
- Check on RBT setting to ensure tune is set as default, incase it’s not, proceed to set via Skiza system or advise sub to text DEFAULT to 811
- Setting SKIZA tune as my default tune by sending SMS with the word DEFAULT to 811 (1shs per SMS). All Skiza tunes are set as default to all callers once downloaded.
- Check on HLR to ensure that CRBT is activated. (NATSS05ACT)
- If active, raise SR. If not Go to Supplementary services in HLR and activate CRBT. Enter ‘verified customer line had not been set-up with SKIZA service’ under comments.

# **Skiza gifting error**

- “Invalid Phone Number” when gifting Skiza, it means sub used the wrong format when keying in the phone number.
- Solution: Advise the customer on the correct format of the Phone number required e.g. > 722123456 (0 should be excluded).

# **Unable to delete Skiza tune** **via DIY**

- Query the MSISDN on Siebel.
- Access the RBTs tab to confirm the active Skiza tune(s).
- Advise the customer on the active Skiza tunes and confirm if they would like all tunes deactivated. If consent is given, click on the RBT name and delete all the tunes one by one. If they would like to remain with a specific Skiza tune, go ahead and delete all the other tunes customer does not wish to keep except the requested tune.
- Capture an interaction with the action e.g “all Skiza tunes deleted as per customer request” or “all skiza tunes deleted as requested except 12345 as per customer request”
- Educate the customer on the self-service procedure in case they need to delete a tune in future using USSD \*811#, \*456#, \*100#ok and \*200#ok.
- Send an SMS via Siebel on how to delete Skiza tune in future
- For cases where both the customer and the CEE cannot delete Skiza tune using both the USSD and Siebel RBT, please raise an SR, capturing the error being experienced.

# **Error Message when using SMS Method**

- This is mostly caused when a customer leaves more than 1 space between the words SKIZA/DELETE and the code. It can also be caused when a customer puts full stop and/or commas.
- Advise on correct procedure - Send SMS with the word SKIZA (a space) CODE to 811 E.g. SKIZA 7010001 (1sh per SMS)
- Assist the customer directly using the SKIZA system - Advise on the charges.
- Give alternative procedure preferable \*811# or SMS> SEARCH/TAFUTA to 822. (These procedures do not require a code).

# **Skiza Recommendation Functionality and Customer Journey**

**Skiza Recommendation Functionality**

1. When a customer calls a Skiza subscriber or dials the Skiza IVR access code, the Ring back Tone (RBT) system will automatically send a promotion SMS after the call ends to advise users to download Skiza tunes or subscribe to the Skiza service.
2. The customers will be prompted to respond or reply to the service via 20811
3. Customers can opt out of the service by sending OFF to 20811.

**Customer journey for Skiza Recommendation**

1. Existing Skiza Subscribers - For the existing Skiza subscribers Safaricom shall recommend new Skiza tunes to these users, based on the genres they are already subscribed to. Push to them the most popular tunes so they can keep up with the trending Skiza tunes. Recommend the tunes that they haven’t subscribed to.
2. Non Skiza Subscribers - Safaricom will simply create product awareness on what Skiza is, the cost per tune, and how they can download the Skiza tunes. Then recommend the popular tones that they can download.

To deactivate the Skiza recommendation messages from 20811, a customer will need to reply the message with STOP.

**Dealer Reversal**

**Agent Self-reversal Via 2530**

1. M-PESA self-reversal is an automation that allows M-PESA Agents to reverse wrong customer deposits, customer withdrawals and Bamba airtime transactions done through the MPESA till.

2. To reverse a given transaction M-PESA Agent will forward the confirmation message to 2530 within one hour from the transaction time. The system will the prompt the agent to enter assistant till ID and MPESA pin.

3. If funds are still available reversal will be completed automatically, agent will receive a confirmation SMS on the till.

**Agent unable to use 2530**

1. Confirm reversal is being done within one hour from the time of transaction

2. Request agent calling to provide store number or agent number for the outlet then login to MPESA to get the till MSISDN.

3. To confirm whether the till is whitelisted login to dealer portal, select MPESA admins sub menu, then select reversal icon on the main page.

4. Enter till MSISDN and click on query.

5. If the till is whitelisted, the till details (store number, agent number and MSISDN) will populate as they appear on the whitelist.

6. In case the till is not whitelisted it will generate the following error message: “Record Not Found: The MSISDN is not whitelisted”

7. Assist agent to whitelist the till. Select whitelist MSISDN Icon and click on download agent self-reversal activation template.

8. Fill in till details in the template and save it in your computer. Then click on choose file to upload it and schedule bulk request.

9. Once whitelisted, a confirmation message will be sent via email to the partner support staff.

10. If a till is whitelisted but still unable to access self-reversal via 2530 the support staff should raise a ticket on BMC and send escalation on email quoting the ticket number to MPESA support team. The support staff should also assist initiate reversal

11. Reversal request for transaction done past one hour should be initiated on call

**Super-agent reversal**

These are reversal for super agency transactions – business deposit and business withdrawals. This also includes mobile banking float deposits from bank accounts. Currently, super-agent reversals **cannot** be done via 2530.

**Business Deposit reversal**

1. M-PESA agent head office should request for reversal through calling line 300 or email to mpesaagentadmin@safaricom.co.ke. The head office should provide the following details to facilitate reversal:

 - Transaction Amount

 - Transaction number if available

 - Super-Agent number/store number deposited from if available

 - Wrong store number

 - Date and time of transaction

2. To reverse the transaction login to M-PESA and access the wrong store number and confirm whether the funds are still available.

3. Reversal for business deposit is done in two steps. The 1st step is to transfer the funds from working account to float account of the wrong recipient. The 2nd step is to redistribute the float from wrong recipient back to the sender (super-agent/bank)

**Step1 - Transfer from working to float:**

- - login to M-PESA and access the wrong store number.

 - Click on initiate transaction. Transaction service select move funds. Transaction reason select organization transfer from MMF to float account.

 - Enter the amount to be reversed. for business deposit reversal amount should be less the original transaction charge.

 - Enter the reason for transaction and submit to initiate transaction. The transaction is marker checker and thus needs to be completed by someone else.

**Step 2 - Redistribution of float to the sender**

- - login to MPESA and access the wrong store number.

 - Click on initiate transaction, transaction service; select HO float management

 - Under receiver identifier enter the short code of the sender (super-agent/ bank short code) where the funds are to be reversed to.

 - Enter the amount to be reversed. for business deposit reversal amount should be less the original transaction charge

 - Enter the reason for transaction, include the original transaction number. Then submit to initiate transaction. The transaction is marker checker and thus needs to be completed by someone else.

**Business withdrawal reversal**

1. M-PESA agent head office should request for reversal through calling line 300 or email to mpesaagentadmin@safaricom.co.ke and provide following details to facilitate reversal: Transaction Amount, transaction number, wrong agent number/short code, date, and time of transaction

2. Login to M-PESA and access the wrong agent store number/ the wrong transaction and click on reverse.

3. Enter reason for reversal. Click on submit to initiate reversal

**Reversal where the wrong agent has insufficient funds:**

1. When reversal request has been received but the wrong agent has insufficient funds the Safaricom partner support staff should raise a service request on CRM to facilitate follow-up.

2. Select below service request category:

 - Category: MPESA services

 - request Type: Reversal- No funds at Agent

 - request item: no Funds at MPESA Agent dealer

3. The SLA for the service request is 72hrs.

**Dealer Portal Reversal**

- Dealer portal deposit is done through Safaricom sales pay bill number 929200, account number Dealer portal code. Dealer portal reversal is done when a dealer /M-PESA HO deposits funds to the wrong account (wrong dealer portal code).

- M-PESA agent head office/dealer should request for reversal through calling line 300 or email to mpesaagentadmin@safaricom.co.ke/ dealermanagement2@safaricom.co.ke .The head office should provide the following details to facilitate reversal:

 - Amount deposited to the wrong dealer portal code

 - Wrong dealer portal code

 - Correct dealer code

 - M-PESA transaction number

- An authorization consent should be sought from the wrongful dealer via email to go ahead with the reversal.

- On receiving reversal authorization, the escalation should be sent to Financial reversal team via Email Address FinanceReversalTeam@safaricom.co.ke and Dealer Management Team

- SLA for reversal 48hrs.

articleTitle: Lipa Parking na M-PESA Definition and Mechanics
markdownContent:
# Definition

Lipa Parking na M-PESA is a service that allows customers to gain access to a parking site and make payment for their parking with M-PESA 1TAP card.

How to sign up

M-PESA 1TAP cards are available in Safaricom retail centers. Customers will need to visit the nearest Safaricom shop to activate an M-PESA 1Tap card.

Customers will need to have an active M-PESA 1tap card and sufficient funds in their M-PESA account.

# Mechanics at entry

Customer drives into mall, taps their M-PESA 1tap card at the entry point station.

Card is verified, the barrier opens, and parking billing commences.

# Mechanics at Exit

Customer taps 1Tap Card on scan area on the exist scanner.

Payment is validated.

Vehicle is allowed to exit.

N.B. You will be required to make an extra payment for the parking charges incurred where one exceeds the allocated exit time. Dial \*486# to see the new charges and complete payment.

# Lipa parking na M-PESA Payment procedure

When customer is ready to leave:

1. Customer dials \*486# on their phone from anywhere within the parking site to confirm their parking charges.
2. The amount to be paid is presented on the customer’s phone with the ticket number, location and duration spent.
3. Customer selects option1 to Pay by M-PESA.
4. Customer gets a pop-up with a prompt to enter their M-PESA PIN.
5. Confirmation message from M-PESA and the parking provider is sent to the customer.

# Customer self-troubleshooting procedure

In case the customer experiences any challenges, they will contact the parking management office on site or call the contact center +254-732-146000 or 0732146000. The issues that customers may come across and need assistance on are:

1. Lost card after entry into the parking area
2. M-PESA system issues/ delays
3. M-PESA does not display the PIN request
4. Money is deducted from M-PESA and the bill is not cleared

In case a customer changes their MSISDN they will be required to activate an M-PESA 1Tap card for the new mobile number at the nearest Safaricom shop to access the service.

# Lipa Parking na M-PESA Escalation matrix

| Category | Type | Item |
| --- | --- | --- |
| M-PESA 1 Tap | Lipa parking | Delayed notifications |
| Lack of notifications | | |
| STK push issues | | |
| System errors | | |
| Transaction delay | | |
| USSD issues | | |

# **DOMAIN TERMINATION**

- This is when the domain and web hosting service is not paid for after being suspended for the specified duration.
- The customer’s domain name will be deleted from registry and the hosting services and files deleted from c-panel at this stage.
- For local domains, after the 90days expiry duration, the domain will be permanently deleted and available for purchase by any other customer.
- For international domains, after the 30days expiry duration customers will be given a further 30 days redemption period to reclaim the domain at a cost of KSHs. 12,000.
- If the customer does not recover the domain during the redemption period, the domain will permanently be deleted without further notice to the customer.

articleTitle: How to Purchase and check Tunukiwa balance
markdownContent:
# **How to Purchase and Check Tunukiwa Balance**

**Tunukiwa Purchase & Balances**

**Tunukiwa Purchase**

Via MySafaricom APP

- Launch MySafaricom APP
- From Home page, click on Tunukiwa Offers
- Choose between Deals, Internet and Minutes
- Click on Buy against your preferred bundle

Via USSD

To purchase the offers, dial \*444# every day to purchase your special bundle and select your preferred option.

**NB:**

- You can purchase multiple options at any given time throughout the day.
- Tunukiwa resources can be used across all local networks but cannot be used for roaming services
- Tunukiwa offers cannot be shared/transferred.

**Tunukiwa Balance Check**

Via MySafaricom APP

- Launch “**MySafaricom APP**”
- Click on the **My Account Balances** option
- Expand the **Data**, **Voice** or **SMS** drop-downs to view details of your available resources

via USSD

You can get your Tunukiwa balance by dialing:

a)\*444# > Balance

b)\*456# > Balances/ Top up> Tunukiwa

# **Tunukiwa Dynamic USSD**

This service displays customer’s most favorable segmented offer on the USSD landing page so as to shorten the customer journey’s and increase conversions.

How to Access: \*444#, Option 0.

**Interactions and SR’s:** Use the existing Interactions and SR’s under Tunukiwa.

Only Tunukiwa data bundles are reversable.

**NB:** Tunukiwa Minutes and SMS cannot be reversed.

# **Tunukiwa data bundles reversal scenarios**

- Purchase wrong resource type.
- Multiple purchase due to delayed system response or otherwise.
- Purchase of wrong resource value \[purchase 1000 rather than 100\]

# **Terms and Conditions** **for Tunukiwa data reversal**

- Emergency Top-up and resources purchased from it shall not be reversed.
- Bundles bought to 3rd parties shall not be reversed.
- Partially utilized Tunukiwa, hot-deal and Power bundles shall NOT be reversed.

# **Tunukiwa reversal procedure on Siebel**

- On Siebel, highlight for the Bundle Purchase CDR on Transaction History and Click on Reverse. This will automatically remove the awarded Data Bundles, SMS and Bonga Points from the customer’s account and trigger an automated interaction.
- Enter the Reversal details on the [Data Reversals Link](https://cmintranet/index.php?option=com_php&Itemid=1555) for Airtime to be refunded by the Folder CEE, Folder CEE will claw back appendant resources like Free WhatsApp Access. For Airtime purchased bundles, capture the reversal Interaction ID on the reversal link for ease of transaction reference by the completing team.
- Advise the customer they will be refunded via airtime in 15 Mins.

# **Tunukiwa Mpesa Purchase Reversal FAQs**

1\. After how long is reversal initiated if no award?

Reversal will be initiated within 5 minutes of purchase if no resource is awarded

articleTitle: M-PESA Real time settlement in MPESA Business
markdownContent:
**M-PESA Real time settlement in MPESA Business**

# **Definition**

M-PESA Real Time Settlement (RTS) is a service that gives M-PESA Merchants/Partners, the ability to withdraw funds from the M-PESA system to RTS enabled banks instantly.

# **Merchants banking with RTS enabled** **banks.**

Partner initiates the withdrawal.

The banks receive the M-PESA Float from the M-PESA organizations.

The bank pay partner into their bank accounts instantly.

SLA: Instant

# **Merchants banking with the non-RTS enabled bank**

Partner initiates withdrawal

Safaricom receiving the request for settlement from the M-PESA organization.

Processing payments through preparation of bank Mandates to CBA to make RTGS payments to the M-PESA organization bank account.

**SLA:** 24 hours (limited to working days)

# **Limits for Merchant Real Time Settlement (RTS) transactions**

The Limits for the RTS receiving banks Paybill accounts are:

Minimum value that the bank can receive is KES 1/=

The Bank’s Utility account can hold up to KES 1,000,000,000/= (ONE BILLION). However, the merchant is encouraged to proactively manage the float in the pay bill by recycling it into their B2C, Agency, Super Agency, ATM, FSI or conversion to Cash.

The minimum balance of the RTS Pay Bill is KES 0/=. This means that the merchant can withdraw all the funds collected through the Pay Bill and leave a ZERO balance.

The maximum amount an organization can send via RTS to a bank is KES 50,000,000/= (FIFTY MILLION) in a single transaction.

# **Benefits of the M-PESA Real Time Settlement service (RTS)**

**To M-PESA Partners**

Instant access to cash that is withdrawn from their collections account.

Funds withdrawn is received in partner’s bank account any time of day, night, weekend or on public holidays.

Faster access to cash at bank means that partners can process other banking transactions more efficiently as cash can be moved to bank in a few minutes.

# **Current Eligible Banks Connected to RTS**

# **Definition**

It is a service where customers will be provided a daily airtime usage target and will be awarded 100% bonus airtime on achievement of the set target.

# **Eligibility and Exemptions**

- It is open to **all** Safaricom Individual Prepay subscribers on the Uwezo tariff.
- All active Safaricom subscribers are eligible to participate immediately they activate the Storo Ibambe service via the activation procedure.
- A customer with an Okoa Jahazi debt will be able to receive the bonus airtime once they reach their target. However, the bonus airtime will not be used to clear their outstanding Okoa Jahazi debt.
- The 50% Extra airtime awarded for Calls and SMS with no expiry will not accumulate to Storo Bonus. But the Amount used to purchase the Calls and SMS will contribute to Storo bonus' daily count.
- Tunukiwa and Bonga Points Purchases are exempted from accumulations for Stori Ibambe

# **How It Works**

- Upon successful opt-in, the customer will be provided with a daily target and be awarded 100% bonus on achievement of the target via flash SMS which is also reviewed depending on a customer’s usage.
- Customer will also receive daily threshold notifications to notify them on usage patterns before finally achieving the daily target
- The bonus airtime awarded will be valid till midnight of the day awarded.
- Storo Bonus can be used to make local voice calls (both off-net & On-net), local SMS (both off net & On-net) and to purchase Storo bonus data.
- Priority of usage is based on the expiry date i.e. the resource with the shortest lifespan (expiry period) will be used first.
- It is a permanent service not a promotion one cannot sambaza the bonus airtime.
- One does not earn any Bonga points from the bonus airtime.
- Once the awarded bonus is depleted the customer is notified via flash SMS.

**Daily Airtime Bonus Awarding**

- When customer reaches the target for the day, they receive a congratulation message and awarded the bonus.
- If the bonus is not awarded, raise an SR and advise the customer on the 24hrs SLA.
- The support Analyst shall confirm if the customer qualifies and has hit the target and award the customer, advise the customer and close the SR

**Depletion of Daily Bonus Airtime**

Upon utilizing the bonus awarded completely, a flash message is received; “*The bonus awarded has been finished*”.

**Key Features**

- Storo Data Bundles will be available on \*544#, \*460# and on \*444#.
- The Bundles will be valid till midnight.
- The Bundle validity cannot be extended.
- The bundles can only be purchased using Storo Bonus, **not** the normal airtime.
- The bundle will only be available to customers who are eligible for Stori Ibambe.
- You can only purchase the Storo bundles if you have achieved your Daily Storo Target.
- Storo Bundle will only be available to customers with Storo Bonus Airtime.
- Customers cannot purchase the same data bundle twice e.g. purchase 20MB, finish then purchase 20MB again. They will however be allowed to purchase other bundle offerings on the menu.
- Storo Data Bundles is not available to roaming Safaricom customers.

**Determination of Storo Ibambe Target**

Targets are automatically determined by average daily usage and cannot be manually adjusted.

# **Earning Storo Bonus, Bonga Points when Party-A buys bundles for Party-B via M-PESA**

**Storo Bonus: Party B** earns the Storo Bonus since the airtime is credited to Party B (and or converted to Bundle in party B’s account) and Party B is the one who utilizes the bundle and/or airtime.

**ETU Limit:** **Party B** earns the ETU limit increase since the airtime is credited to Party B and/or converted to Bundle under Party B’s account. Party B is the one who utilizes, and ETU limit is computed based on Usage.

**Bonga Points: Party B** earns Bonga points as is the one who utilizes the airtime or bundle. Every 10 shillings spent on usage earns one Bonga point.

markdownContent:
# **DEFINITION**

- This is a product that allows all Safaricom customers to buy Safaricom data bundles with no expiry date.
- Customers will also be able to buy bundles for as low as 1shilling by selecting the amount they wish to spend.
- Customers will earn Bonga points for every data bundle purchase.
- Customers can purchase data bundles as many times as need be.
- In the event the customer exhausts the bundle, out of bundle defined rate shall apply.
- The usage priority will be the last after consumption of bundles with expiry, if customer has one.

# **ELIGIBILITY**

It is eligible to all Safaricom subscribers, Prepay, Post-pay and Hybrid customers.

# **CHARGES**

Below is the rate per MB for the New Data Bundles.

| Amount (Ksh) | Rate per MB |
| --- | --- |
| Ksh.1 to 10 | 0.50 |
| Ksh.11 to 50 | 0.285 |
| >= Ksh.51 | 0.20 |

**Example:**

Customer purchasing data worth **Ksh.5** will be awarded **10MB** that is **Ksh.5/ 0.50** (value rate) 
Customer purchasing data worth **Ksh.27** will be awarded **94MB** that is **Ksh.27/ 0.285** (value rate). 
Customer purchasing data worth **Ksh.1000** will be awarded **5000MB** that is **Ksh.1000/ 0.20** (value rate).

When a customer buys a bundle worth Ksh.11 and above, they will get **50 MBs** of **free WhatsApp bundle.**

Data bundles are used for internet connection on Safaricom network.

# **Priority of resource consumption.**

- Free resources (Data from Stori Ibambe bonus, any free data).
- Normal data bundles (all bundles with expiry date).
- New data bundles (with no expiry date).

- Data auto refill will only work on **airtime purchase**.

Lipa Na M-PESA Paybill no 150501

For non-eligible customers, the CEE will advise the customers accordingly

The CEE on the folder team will pick the SR and confirm that the customer is existing of the list of accounts with discount or offers, afterward prepare the upload file

The Line 400 team leader will approve the file via email

The CEE on the folder will upload the approved increment file to CBS discount account

The folder CEE will confirm that the account has been credited, contact the Customer to advice, and the SR will be closed after attaching Team leader approval and the file uploaded

# **Discount Feedback**

Customer will call or visit Retail shop and give feedback on relating to Home Fiber discounts.

If a customer complains of not getting a discount, the CEE shall capture the feedback via safaricomhomeretention@safaricom.co.ke detailing customer feedback for the discounting team to note.

Retention team shall capture all feedback shared and use it for future decision making and where need be, Retention team will call back the customer for more information and service recovery.

# **Step–****By–Step procedure and requirements**

# **Payment made to wrong account**

The CEE will remove the product on the wrong account and raise SR with details indicating wrong CI and the correct CI, amount prorated on IN data. The CEE will then raise a decrement activity and inform the customer of SLA.

The line 400 Team Leader will approve the decrement activity and the funds will be removed from the wrong CI.

The CEE on the folder team will pick the SR and confirm that the funds have been removed from the wrong account and prepare the file to be uploaded on CBS

The Line 400 team leader will approve via email the file to be uploaded.

The CEE on the folder will the upload the approved increment file to CBS discount account.

The folder CEE will confirm that the account has been credited, customer will be contacted, and the SR will be closed after attaching Team leader approval and the file uploaded.

# **Bulk payments by new customers activates the highest package.**

The CEE will remove the wrong product that was activated, amount will be prorated. The CEE will raise a ticket with details of amount to be increased.

The Line 400 team leader will approve via email the file to be uploaded.

The CEE on the folder will the upload the approved increment file to CBS discount account to activate the correct product.

The folder CEE will confirm that the account has been credited, customer will be contacted, and the SR will be closed after attaching Team leader approval and the file uploaded.

# **Customer charged connection fee erroneously.**

The CEE will raise SR for increment with the amount to be credited that was charged as connection fees with details such as transaction ID and CI.

The CEE on the folder team will pick the SR and confirm that the customer is existing and should not have been charged connection fee, afterward prepare the upload file.

The Line 400 team leader will approve the file via email.

The CEE on the folder will then upload the approved increment file to CBS discount account

The folder CEE will confirm that the account has been credited, customer will be contacted, and the SR will be closed after attaching Team leader approval and the file uploaded.

# **When fund fails to prorate.**

The CEE will manually compute the amount that should have prorated after the product was removed. The CEE will raise SR for increment with the amount to be credited. The CEE on the folder team will pick the SR and confirm that the product was removed, and funds failed to prorate, The CEE will also confirm that the computation of the proration is correct, afterward prepare the upload file.

The Line 400 team leader will approve the file via email.

The CEE on the folder will the upload the approved increment file to CBS discount account

The folder CEE will confirm that the account has been credited, customer will be contacted, and the SR will be closed after attaching Team leader approval and the file uploaded.

# **Win back Offers**

The CEE will confirm that the customer is on the list of customers whose account qualify for a discount. The CEE will raise SR for increment with the amount to be credited.

The CEE on the folder team will pick the SR and confirm that the customer is existing of the list of accounts with discount or offers, afterward prepare the upload file.

The Line 400 team leader will approve the file via email.

The CEE on the folder will the upload the approved increment file to CBS discount account

The folder CEE will confirm that the account has been credited, customer will be contacted, and the SR will be closed after attaching Team leader approval and the file uploaded.

# **Team Leader/Manager service recovery.**

The Team Leader will review the customer complain and establish if the customer was given a bad experience or there is justification for service recovery .The team leader will propose a form of compensation and the amount to be credited to the customers account.The experience will be discussed with the Manager Line 400 who will approve ,adjust or decline the amount proposed as a compensation.

The amount approved will be communicated to The Team Leader .

An SR will be raised with the amount agreed

The CEE on the folder team will pick the SR, afterward prepare the upload file.

The Line 400 team leader will approve the file via email.

The CEE on the folder will then upload the approved increment file to CBS discount account

The folder CEE will confirm that the account has been credited, customer will be contacted, and the SR will be closed after attaching Team leader approval and the file uploaded.

# **4G for Home browsing out of bundle.**

The CEE will compute the amount that the customer was charged out of bundle. The CEE will raise SR for increment with the amount to be credited.

The CEE on the folder team will pick the SR and confirm that the customer should not have been charged out of bundle, afterward prepare the upload file.

The Line 400 team leader will approve the file via email.

The CEE on the folder will the upload the approved increment file to CBS discount account

The folder CEE will confirm that the account has been credited, customer will be contacted, and the SR will be closed after attaching Team leader approval and the file uploaded.

# **4G for home line with PRS**

The CEE will confirm the amount that has been deducted by the PRS, CEE will remove the particular PRS on the line. The CEE will raise SR for increment with the amount to be credited that was charged by the PRS.

The CEE on the folder team will pick the SR and confirm that the customer should not have been charged by the PRS, afterward prepare the upload file.

The Line 400 team leader will approve the file via email.

The CEE on the folder will the upload the approved increment file to CBS discount account

The folder CEE will confirm that the account has been credited, customer will be contacted, and the SR will be closed after attaching Team leader approval and the file uploaded.

# **6 plus 1 amount payments:**

The CEE will confirm that the customer paid for 6 months at once and they have not been awarded the one month for free.

The CEE will raise SR with details of the amount paid and the transaction ID and indicate the amount to credited to the customer account.

The CEE on the folder team will pick the SR and confirm that the customer was not awarded the one month free, afterward prepare the upload file.

The Line 400 team leader will approve the file via email.

The CEE on the folder will the upload the approved increment file to CBS discount account

The folder CEE will confirm that the account has been credited, customer will be contacted, and the SR will be closed after attaching Team leader approval and the file uploaded.

# **Deleted Product:**

The CEE will confirm that the product has been deleted from the customer account. The CEE will raise SR and the folder team will confirm if the product was deleted by the customer or by the system by raising a ticket to CBS via BMC. If the deletion was by the customer, the customer will be advised to top up to the prorated amount to activate the product. If the deletion was by the system, the CEE will raise SR to credit the account. The CEE on the folder team will pick the SR afterward prepare the upload file.

The Line 400 team leader will approve the file via email.

The CEE on the folder will then upload the approved increment file to CBS discount account

The folder CEE will confirm that the account has been credited, customer will be contacted, and the SR will be closed after attaching Team leader approval and the file uploaded.

# **Home Plus resources allocated on the account number (CI):**

The CEE will confirm that the customer has paid for the correct home plus product and the GSM resources are allocated to the customer’s account (CI) number instead of the primary number.

The CEE will proceed to log in to the resource expiry link below to have the GSM resources allocated to the CI expired.[https://cxintranet.safaricom.net/cm2/A\_DataBundleReversal\_Insert.php](https://cxintranet.safaricom.net/cm2/A_DataBundleReversal_Insert.php)

The CEE will then proceed to delete the home plus product allocated on the customers CI for proration to occur.

The CEE will raise SR with details of the amount paid and the transaction ID and indicate the amount to be credited to the customer’s account after proration to bring it to full amount paid for by the customer.

The CEE on the folder team will pick the SR and prepare the upload file.

The Line 400 team leader will approve the file via email.

The CEE on the folder will then upload the approved increment file to CBS discount account

The folder CEE will confirm that the account has been credited, customer will be contacted, and the SR will be closed after attaching Team leader approval and the file uploaded.

The CEE will contact the customer and advise them to subscribe to the home plus product by dialing \*400#OK and select Home Plus.

For customers who call and advise that the Home plus resources have not been allocated to the primary number even after dialing \*400#OK, the CEE will proceed to manually allocate the Home plus resources to the intended customer number on CRM under the provisioning tab and create an interaction for the same.

articleTitle: 4G For Home Customer Onboarding and Support By Dealers.
markdownContent:
# **Definition**

This is the process used to manage and support FTTH 4G product and customers by our dealers.

# **4G for home product detail.**

A Customer will need to purchase a 4G Router at recommended retail price (RRP), available at all the Safaricom Shops and selected dealer shops.

The router is kitted with a 4G DSA Simex.

The Router only works in 4G covered areas and only on the supplied routers and provisioned on a 4G sim card.

4G for home is limited and has a cap on usage.

The speeds are reduced to 1mbs automatically once they reach the FUP.

The bundle validity is 30 days and any unutilized resources do not roll over upon expiry of the plan.

Customers can renew their account once they deplete their Limited Data via USSD \*400#.

Customers can upgrade / downgrade their plans before or after expiry of their current plan via USSD 400.

However, account balance must be below 50MB if the plan has not expired or;

Customer can browse at throttled speeds of 1Mbps once they reach the FUP.

Where customer renews their plan before 30 days, a new plan will be allocated and any remaining resources in the previous plan deleted.

Customers will have access to the daily and monthly plans.

The customers will be able to buy top up/renewal bundles via \*400#ok.

# **User Creation on 4G for Home onboarding portal**

The onboarded dealers will be required to have access to the dealer portal [https://dealerportal.safaricom.co.ke/dealers/login.php](https://dealerportal.safaricom.co.ke/dealers/login.php) [](https://dealerportal.safaricom.co.ke/dealers/login.php)for device requisition ,Device pick up and onboarding of customers.

Onboarding and activation to 4G for Home will be done solely by the designated dealers and at the retail centres.

The teams will have a Dealer admin role and DSA role.

# **Device Ordering Process**

The dealer will be responsible for device requisition and pick up from the selected mini store.

The dealer will log into the dealer portal using the login credentials shared. [https://dealerportal.safaricom.co.ke/dealers/login.php](https://dealerportal.safaricom.co.ke/dealers/login.php)

Once logged in the dealer will go to orders and select Handset.

Then the dealer will select **4G Home router Huawei B535-932 CPE OR Air Master 3300V 4G CPE.**

Then click on make an order.

Once order is complete, select nearest pick-up point to collect the devices.

# **Customer registration Process**

4G FOR Home registration will be done on the 4G sales portal [https://ftth.safaricom.co.ke:8000/sign](https://ftth.safaricom.co.ke:8000/sign-in)[\-](https://ftth.safaricom.co.ke:8000/sign-in)[in](https://ftth.safaricom.co.ke:8000/sign-in) [](https://ftth.safaricom.co.ke:8000/sign-in)by the dealer admin or the dealer sales agent.

Before customer registration process, the dealer admin needs to have uploaded the 4G For Home routers IMEIs on the portal.

Below is the process for login to the portal.

The dealer admin will Log in using an Email and password sent to them after successful creation by the zone leads.

They can create a new Password by using the **“forgot password”** feature. Password will expire after 45 days.

Screen will turn off/ log you out after 15 minutes of inactivity.

OTP is required for every login.

User view and functionalities will depend on the role assigned

# **Upload routers that will be used for registrations.**

After the successful login of the dealer admin, they will need to upload the 4G routers as illustrated below.

Administrator will click on the upload routers tab on the portal and select single upload or multiple uploads in cases where they are uploading more than one router.

In cases where the admin is uploading a single router, they will provide the router serial number and model in the respective fields and click on the upload button.

For multiple routers upload the admin will upload the router serial numbers in CSV format and click on the upload button.

The uploaded routers will be visible when registering the customer.

# **Customer Line Registration.**

At the dealer shop, customer will express interest on the product, DSA will engage customer and advice on applicable product mechanics and applicable charges.

The dealer admin or the DSA can be able to register the customer using the process below.

The user will log into the portal and select register customer.

They will be required to fill in all the required customer details i.e.

Customer Location Details

Select Region, Zone, and Estate from the provided lists.

Customer Information

Provide valid customer information including full names, the ID or Passport number and DOB.

Contact and Product Info.

Provide valid customer contact information including mobile number, Email address and preferred package.

Router and SIM details info.

Select the router serial number from the list of the uploaded.

routers and provide a valid DSA Simex serial.

***(The DSA Simex used should be clean and not containing any other customer information.)***

The user will confirm all the customers details are captured correctly and click on the submit icon to complete the registration process.

After successful customer line registration both the user and the customer will receive an SMS to confirm that the registration is successful as shown below.

(“Dear Customer, your 4G for home registration is successful. Your Account No. is 0xxxxxxxxx. Please dial \*400\*3# to subscribe to a 4G for home product. Feels good to be Home”)

The user will proceed to direct the customer to buy a plan of their choice.

The DSA will disable the pin on the 4G FOR HOME Sim card.

The DSA/Dealer Admin will finally set up the router for the customer and confirm connectivity of the device.

# **4G for Home renewal and Payment**

Payment can be done by either.

Dialling USSD \*400# and following the prompts to pay via MPESA.

Dialling USSD \*400# and following the prompts to pay with postpaid.

Renewal is available via DIY on USSD \*400#.

This is applicable as DIY by the customer via USSD \*400# for M-PESA and postpaid credit limits.

To renew 4G for Home Router, customer dials USSD \*400# and will follow the prompt.

Customer will receive notifications upon successful completion.

Where customer renews their plan before 30 days, a new plan will be allocated and any remaining resources in the previous plan deleted.

# **4G for Home upgrade / downgrade.**

Customers can upgrade / downgrade their plans before or after expiry of their current plan via USSD \*400#.

This is only applicable as DIY by the customer via USSD 400#.

Customer will dial USSD on the notification MSISDN and follow the prompts.

Account balance must be below 50MB if the plan has not expired.

# **4G For Home Dealer Support and Escalations.**

Our first line support will be the Safaricom Account Managers.

The dealer admin and DSAs will be escalating the issues experienced and not limited to the ones listed below to them via Email. The SLA for resolution is 2Hrs.

We propose creation of a resolution email folder manned by the zone leads between 8am 5pm.

The issues to be escalated by teams to the zone leads include:

Requests for user additions.

User management- enabling/ disabling users.

Router management – adding routers to be used by the dealers.

User account details update when created wrongly.

User account creation errors.

Device returns.

# **Second Level Support**

For issues that our first line support (account managers) are not able to resolve and require further escalation our second level support will be Digital Engineering support and the TIBCO/ Integration Support via Remedy tickets and the SLA set at **2Hrs**.

# **Digital Engineering support**

Escalations done via BMC tickets assigned to: digitalengineeringsupport@Safaricom.co.ke **Issues raised include****:**

Receive escalations from Level 1

Login issues / authentication issues

Sales records retrieval failures

Estate’s data management i.e., Addition, Update, enabling/disabling estates.

OTP failure to generate issues.

# **TIBCO/ Integration Support**

Escalations is done via BMC tickets to: Servicedev@Safaricom.co.ke

**Issues raised include****:**

DSA/ Line registration service failure.

Discount allocation failure.

# **Third Level Support**

- Our third level support will be responsible for resolving wide reaching issues affecting the entire portal.
- The escalations will be done by the second level support team.

**Issues raised include****:**

Wide reaching issues affecting the entire portal.

Authentication service failures e.g., failure to generate OTP.

DXL service failures e.g., sales record retrieval, router upload service, authentication

P1- 2 hours

P2- 4 hours

# **Definition**

- A virtual machine is a computer file, typically called an image, that behaves like an actual computer.
- If you get uch an issue gather the client details and escalate via a service request for the 2nd Level support. Select the appropriate Service request.

**Category**: Cloud IaaS

**Type**: Virtual Machine

**Item**: Inaccessible | Slow speed
