**FTTH Installation Link Reset & Password change Process**

**Purpose/****Objective**

Since inception of the Safaricom Home Fibre business, we have grown to 220K connections. This growth in connections has also led to Increase in demand for basic issues that affect the customer experience.

On average, we receive up-to 2,500 calls daily at the Contact Centre. Among the top caller reasons:

Password resets

Cannot push traffic

Slow speeds

Payment issues

As we continue to grow our base, we are fixing the basic foundational building blocks that will help us scale with the best possible experience for our customers, while giving more power and control to them to manage their inhouse Wi-Fi experience at the touch of a button without any further intervention required, To this end we have a acquired a Device manager tool that allows us to manage CPEs collectively which will include the ability to manage them remotely as well as troubleshoot the CPE remotely for the technology team as well as the call center team.

We have built a self-service module for customers that allows them to reset their link and reset their passwords, addressing two pain-points customers have.

The purpose of this document is to outline the support process for customer DIY on link reset and password change via USSD through the Device Manager. These will apply should the customer have an issue after they have tried to reset the link or password by themselves via USSD unsuccessfully or if they wish to learn more about the same.

articleTitle: M-PESA Business Till - Set New PIN
markdownContent:
Set new pin for Merchants and M-PESA business till Automation

# **The Change.**

- Set New PIN journey is shortened and is removed from Account services.
- Transactional menus will not be visible to merchants who have not set new PIN.

# **Highlights**

- The changes will apply only to merchants on Business Tills service who use the M-PESA Business Till USSD menu \*234\*2#
- It will apply to till operators who have received Operator ID and Start Key on their SMS, but they are yet to set a new operator PIN regardless of the channel they were acquired through e.g., self-onboarded, sales agent etc.
- The merchants who have not set the new PIN will be prompted to do so, and will not be presented with the transaction menus before setting a new PIN
- This change affects PIN for operators and does not prevent a till from receiving funds. Only the operators will not be able to access their funds until they activate and set PIN

# **Set New PIN Journey**

- Dial **\*234#**
- Select **M-PESA Business Till**
- Enter your **HO/Store Number**
- Select **Set New PIN**
- Enter **Operator ID**
- Enter **Old PIN**
- Enter **New PIN**
- Confirm **New PIN**

In an effort to offer improved experience to our merchants and grow activity on the M-PESA Business Till solution, we have **automated the opt-in process** to make it much easier for merchants to begin transacting and to access their funds in the till.

The new process will **apply only to tills onboarding via the self-onboarding portal** . All other tills acquired through the shops or sales teams will continue to use the old process below.

# Old Process

- Merchant applies for a till via the self-onboarding portal
- Merchant receives an SMS advising of successful till creation.
- Merchant dials \*234\*2# to accept the T&Cs, activate the till, then receives Operator ID and Start PIN
- Merchant dials \*234\*2# to change PIN

# **New Process**

- Merchant will apply for a Business till via the self-onboarding channel [https://m-pesaforbusiness.co.ke/](https://m-pesaforbusiness.co.ke/)
- Once the till is created (SLA 10 minutes), the merchant nominated number will receive an SMS with the till details such as Till/Store number, Operator ID and Start PIN. A departure from the old process, the merchant will not be required to activate the till manually.
- Merchant will ***dial*** \****234#*** > Select ***M-PESA*** ***Business Till*** > and then ***Set New PIN***.

# **Other Highlights of the New Process**

- The merchant will not be able to view the Business Till menus such as Withdraw , Sell Airtime and Make payments unless they have set a new PIN.
- Since the merchant had accepted the T&Cs at the point of application of the self-onboarding portal, they will not need to accept the T&Cs again on their USSD/App journey.

# SD WAN Customer Support & Escalations on CRM

# 

# SD WAN Service Onboarding

- Each customer onboarded shall be given access to call support line 2222 on their specified contact MSISDN.
- Once done the request will be forwarded to FD Billing Delivery Team for billing via SR on CRM and a completed BPM activity from TES PM.
- Once receipted and the service is activated the executive will close the SR and notify TES PM and the account manager of the same. SLA for allocation is 2hrs.

## 

# Suspend & Resume SD WAN Services

- Suspension and Resuming may arise from debt management by credit control or customer request.
- Fixed data credit and collection milestones will apply for service denial due to debt or arrears on connectivity and SDWAN service.
 - Credit and collection team will instruct ECS support to suspend service on the SD-WAN portal for SDWAN service.
 - Upon service suspension, ECS shall enter an Interaction on CRM with an appropriate comment.
 - Credit collection team will suspend billing on CBS if a customer does not make payment before next bill run.
 - Credit collection team shall instruct unsuspension of an SDWAN customer upon payment of the arrears.
 - In case of erroneous service reactivation, person liable for this is the person who performed the reactivation action.
 - The SDWAN service cannot run without the link service uptime unless it is on 3rd Party internet where only SDWAN Portal services will be enforced.

## 

# Customer Contact Support for SD WAN

- The agent receiving the query will probe the customer, determine possible diagnosis and resolve the issue raised.
- In a scenario the issue cannot be resolved, the same shall be escalated to a third level via BMC Remedy ticket. SLA 24hours.

# 

# Implementation of SD WAN Services

If approved, the order is receipted and proceeds to ECS for implementation on appropriate systems.

- These are SD-WAN service admin portal for SDWAN product and CBS for billing.
- ECS shall close the SR and advise the customer.
- SLA for FD Billing is 2hours while for credit control team is 4hours.
- Relocation requests shall be treated as new requests for SDWAN service.

# **Business Collaboration Bundles Definition, Eligibility and Features**

# **Definitions**

Safaricom Business Collaboration Bundles offer a range of mobile data bundles which allow staff to access collaboration tools at affordable rates. Businesses pay on behalf of their staff at the end of the month.

Businesses need a simple way to allow their staff to collaborate nearly anywhere, one that also helps to manage costs and meet the varied needs of different types of staff.

# **Eligibility**

The service is only for registered businesses.

The offer is open to all corporate customers on Post-pay or hybrid tariffs.

# **Features of Business Collaboration Bundles**

**SMEs**

Valid Business Permit or Trading License, Certificate of trading or Certificate of Incorporation depending on the nature of business or Business PIN

Owners National ID Number or Passport

**Corporate and SMEs Customers**

The service will be available to all corporate and SME customers.

**New Customers**

To ensure only businesses enroll to the Bundles, the customer is required to fill in an application form and provide below documentation (KYCs):

**Large Enterprises**

Valid Certificate of Incorporation (if a new customer)

Deposit depending on the customer’s credit status.

Onboarding for new SME customers will be through the SME Tool and will be factored in the AMDOCS platform product modelling.

The SME will be required to have a Safaricom registered mobile number.

# **Existing Customers**

Customers whitelisted to access any service via \*485# or having the SME profile will not be required to provide additional KYCs to use the service. However, they will be required to accept terms and conditions for the new service through USSD.

Sponsor can buy as many Collaboration Bundles as possible at a time either for self or for beneficiary.

Bundle consumption will be based on the time the bundle was purchased i.e. the bundle purchased at an earlier date/time will be consumed first.

Customers will be able to set renewal prompts during the Bundle purchase process.

Bonga points on usage- Sponsor numbers will earn Bonga points (under Safaricom’s Bonga Point Loyalty program), for any airtime top-up amount either for the sponsor or beneficiaries.

International voice calls will be charged at the prevailing market rates.

Roaming for both calls & data will be charged at the prevailing market rates.

Purchase of the Collaboration Bundles can be reversed on condition that the sponsor or beneficiary has not consumed any of the allocated fair usage data amount.

The service will offer have fair usage data allocations. Usage exceeding the fair usage policy data allocations will attract the prevailing data and roaming charges. The end user will receive notifications when they are about to reach the fair usage policy data allocation limits.

# **Attributes of Sponsor/Beneficiary Number**

**The Sponsor Number Will Carry the Following Attributes**.

Can be either Prepay, Post-pay or Hybrid lines.

Can access business support line 2222.

Can access the USSD \*485#, Collaboration Bundles

Can add beneficiaries. Beneficiaries are mobile numbers (SME’s employees/staff) and can receive Collaboration Bundles from the sponsors.

Can buy Collaboration Bundles

Can purchase Collaboration Bundles for up-to a maximum of 15 beneficiary numbers (including the sponsor’s number).

Can be a maximum of 3 in any single business entity. Any exceptions to this rule will require approval from the SME HOD and Product HOD.

Can query expiry dates for the beneficiaries.

Can query Collaboration Bundles balances assigned to the beneficiaries bought for at any time via \*485#ok.

# **Beneficiary Numbers Will Carry the Following Attributes.**

Can be either prepay or hybrid lines, on the Uwezo Tariff

Cannot access business support line 2222.

Cannot access the USSD \*485#, Collaboration Bundles option.

Can receive Collaboration Bundles from multiple sponsor numbers.

Cannot buy Collaboration Bundles

Cannot share or Sambaza Collaboration Bundles to other mobile numbers.

Receives usage & time-based SMS notifications to prompt them to engage their sponsor to renew their Bundles or adjust their usage accordingly.

Can check their expiry dates through \*485#ok.

Charges on SMS, USSD & Premium Rate Services- Usage on USSD & Premium Rate Services will be charged at prevailing USSD & Premium Rate Service rates and will not be deducted from the Bundle value.

Priority in consumption while browsing on the sponsored Apps / URLs – Priority will be as follows (number one with the highest priority)

Collaboration Bundles

Promotional bundles

Other Bundles with expiry period

No Expiry Data Bundles

No Expiry Airtime Top Ups

# **Benefits of Business Collaboration Bundles**

**Value for money** - The bundles are discounted and restricted to access only a set of business collaboration bundles which ensures staff only use the bundle for business purposes.

**Flexible** - Choose from bundled or monthly unlimited options.

**Convenience** - Choose the unlimited bundles and empower your staff with the peace of mind that they will continue accessing the collaboration tools for the month.

# **Bundle Prioritization**

Priority in consumption while browsing on the sponsored Apps / URLs – Priority will be as follows (number one with the highest priority)

Collaboration Bundles

CBU Post-pay Bundles

Promotional bundles

Other Bundles with expiry period

No Expiry Data Bundles

No Expiry Airtime Top Ups

# **Bundle Expiry**

The Bundles will have expiry dates.

Notifications will be sent to the customer via SMS upon reaching certain thresholds based on the actual usage for bundled options and fair usage policy data resource allocations for the unlimited package.

Bundle consumption will be based on the time the bundle was purchased i.e. the bundle purchased at an earlier date/time will be consumed first where multiple bundles.

Customers will be able to set renewal prompts during the bundle purchase process.

Customer receives threshold notifications, bundle about to be exhausted. If subscriber has other bundles, they shall be used. Then airtime shall be the last.

# **Collaboration Tools**

The service is restricted to a defined list of websites. The service currently supports the collaboration tools listed below:

**Microsoft**

Microsoft Teams

Microsoft Outlook

Yammer

Microsoft OneDrive

Cisco

#  **KODRIS AFRICA**

Kodris Africa is a platform established with the purpose of teaching children ages 7yrs to 16yrs how to code. The coding languages will include Python, C, C#, C++, Java, Perl, and PHP. Education technologies firm Kodris Africa has now partnered with Safaricom to promote the study of coding through the purchase of annual lessons on the M-PESA app.

Kodris Africa is the provider of Kenya’s first-ever government-approved programme for teaching coding which is now the most demanded skill in the world. It is classified as curriculum support material at KICD but is also applicable to students in all other modern education systems. The programme is also accredited internationally by Pearson which is the largest education institution in the world. Customer support will be offered by Kordis Africa, however below are the product mechanics in brief.

# **Kodris Africa contacts SMS:**

Dear customer, kindly contact Kodris Africa on 0795555999 or 0111047555 at normal rates, email info@kodrisafrica.com or visit [www.kodrisafrica.com](http://www.kodrisafrica.com/). Thank you.

**About KODRIS and Coding**

**What is Kodris Africa?**

Kodris Africa is an online learning platform created to teach coding to primary and secondary school students from Grade 1 to Grade 12 (CBC/International Curriculum) or Class One to Form Four (8-4-4).

**What is coding?**

Coding (Computer Programming) is the act of writing instructions to tell a computer what it should do. These instructions are written by a programmer using a computer programming language.

**Why should a learner study coding?**

Technology is a centerpiece of how we live and work and coding is one of the key foundations. It is crucial to understand how technology works through coding. It is projected that coding is one of the most demanded skills today and will continue to be to the end of this decade and beyond. In addition to the advanced computer skills, a coding learner also gains important 21st-century skills such as problem-solving, productivity, analytical thinking, algorithmic thinking as well as design thinking.

**Do I need to have prior knowledge of coding before using the platform?**

There is no requirement for one to have prior knowledge of coding before using the Kodris Africa platform. The platform along with its content have been simplified in such a manner that it suits an absolute beginner. Materials such as learner’s guides, teacher’s guides as well as the Kodris Africa coding curriculum materials to suit a school environment are available to aid an absolute beginner or teacher.

**Which age group is the Kodris Africa coding platform suitable for?**

It is suitable for primary, secondary, and high school students. Users of all ages can benefit from Kodris Africa in learning how to code. It is graduated per class or grade so that students take classes that match their class or stage in school.

**Do I need to install any applications to use the Kodris Africa platform?**

There is no need to install any applications; all you need is a **desktop computer, laptop, or tablet** with access to a stable internet connection to use the Kodris Africa platform. It has not been optimized for use on mobile phones because it requires a big screen from the size of a tablet onwards.

For a good experience, the devices listed have bigger screens.

**What specifications should be available on my computer to run Kodris Africa?**

It can be used with current versions of internet browsers such as Google Chrome for Windows users and Safari for Mac users.

**Can I run Kodris Africa on mobile platforms such as tablets?**

Our coding platform has been primarily designed for use on a computer screen; however, it can be used via internet browsers on tablets with a screen resolution of 1920x1080 and above.

**Which programming language will I learn with Kodris Africa?**

The Python programming language. Python is versatile and has a simpler syntax for better comprehension by learners.

markdownContent:
# **Definition and Eligibility**

#  

# **Definition**

This is a total communication suite that simplifies business communications by introducing fixed landline, internet, 24/7 single point of contact support, Single bill for business communication and dedicated account manager.

# **Eligibility**

The service is currently available for both SMEs and Corporates.

Cloud computing features

- Comes with a “Safaricom Landline” which is sold as Safaricom One Connect.
- Uses VOIP technologies.
- Services offered include Calls to and from GSM, SMS messaging, voice conferencing, video conferencing, Value added services (CRBT, voicemail etc.)
- Uses geographically distinct numbering ranges e.g. 020 for Nairobi and 041 for Mombasa etc.
- Packaged with Safaricom fixed data connection i.e. Fiber.
- You can import data from an accounting package master file for information such as Customers, Suppliers and Items but transaction history records cannot be imported.

# **Benefits of Cloud Computing**

- With Safaricom One Connect there's no need to invest in a separate fixed landline and internet. The product provides a one communication package that bundles Voice and Unlimited internet plus value added services that include:
- You will get a managed server backup and recovery operations without the capital expense and the internal IT resource requirements typically associated with data protection.
- You also get to take advantage of the latest hardware and software technology while relieving your IT department of the day-to-day administration to a partner with dedicated resources specially trained in the operation of this critical service.
- Accurately forecast your expense for data server backup and recovery with standard one-time licensing and monthly service fees. You also get a pay-as-you-grow server backup expansion capability without total technology change.
- Scalability is guaranteed by the ability to perform daily full, incremental, and differential options can.
- Be customized based upon the type of data and the frequency of changes in your environment, with the added capability to archive data from 2 weeks to 7+ years.
- Proactive monitoring and testing of backup and recovery processes, coupled with secure management of critical back up data with enhanced authentication and encryption, means your data is always secure.
- The same data can also be located on a server at your location or in our data center or both locations.
- Enables you to efficiently store, manage, and aggregate distributed big data across locations through a single pane of glass. Gain a common view and central management.
- Seamless scalability, making it possible to add capacity, applications, locations or tenants to your cloud with zero need to develop or reconfigure
- Reduce administration time and ensure availability. Storage-as-a-service capability allows enterprises and service providers to meter capacity, bandwidth, and usage across tenants.
- Enable users to self-manage and access storage. Easy storage access which provides flexible access across networks and platforms for traditional applications, web applications, Microsoft Windows, Linux, and mobile devices
- Allow users and applications instant access to data.

articleTitle: Corporate Advantage Plus Definition and Eligibility and Mechanics
markdownContent:
# **Definition**

- This is a bundled PostPay proposition that offers preferential rates on Voice, Data and SMS to corporate customers. It is an appendant product that rides on an existing tariff.
- The rates are identical to Advantage Plus only that Corporate Advantage Plus is tailored for business in terms of onboarding.

# 

# **Eligibility**

- Corporate Advantage Plus is available to either new or existing PostPay and Hybrid Corporate customers.
- Multiple bundle subscription is not allowed. Customers have to unsubscribe from their existing bundle to subscribe to a new one.

# 

# **Onboarding**

- Customers request by filling in the Corporate Voice and Data Application form and attaches relevant KYC. The forms are then shared with their Account Relationship Managers/Executives.
- Area Manager/ Relationship executive raises an SR to MSO (Order Fulfillment).
- Order fulfillment raises an order that goes for vetting by credit control.
- Credit control vet the documentation and revert with approval or disapproval or need for more requirements.
- If approved, the order fulfillment provisions the order and if not approved, they communicate to the sales channel.
- Once the order is provisioned order fulfillment alerts the salesperson for delivery of sim cards to client.
- Billing Commences upon activation.
- Customers on a Standard account are eligible subject to one month’s deposit, equal to the value of the bundle will be required.
- A customer should choose to be in any of the three categories listed below;

Hybrid (allows top up after exhaustion of the bundle.

Post-pay Tariff with zero credit limit (Customer line will be barred upon exhaustion of resources, and it cannot be unbarred until the following month’s resources are allocated).

Post-pay Tariff with a credit limit (Customer can exhaust bundle to the tune of the credit limit after which it will be barred. Note that once the bundle is exhausted, an out of bundle rate will apply).

Customers do not have to be on an aggregate account to enjoy these products.

# **SLAs For Activations**

- SLA will depend with the number of lines to be activated.
- For more than 10 lines, BULK provisioning/activation applies.

# **SLA for a single account**

| TYPE | ITEM | SLA |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Prepaid to Postpaid Migration | Pre2Pos Data Bundle. | 8 Hrs. |
| | Pre2Pos Corporate Voice. | 8 Hrs. |
| | Enterprise Bundles. | 8 Hrs. |

# **SLAs for bulk provisioning**

| TYPE | ITEM | SLA |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Bulk Order requests | Pre2PoS Data Bundle. | 48 Hrs. |
| Bonga Aggregation. | 48 Hrs. | |
| Pro2Pre Data Bundle. | 48 Hrs. | |
| Discounts. | 48 Hrs. | |
| Pre2Pos Corporate Voice. | 48 Hrs. | |
| Pro2Pre Corporate Voice. | 48 Hrs. | |
| Subscriber Identification. | 48 Hrs. | |
| Pos2Pos. | 48 Hrs. | |
| Supplementary services. | 48 Hrs. | |
| Tariff swap. | Hrs. | |

# **Key Features**

- Customers will be awarded Bonga Points equivalent to the value of the bundle upon bundle purchase and as per prevailing Bonga conversion rates.
- Sambaza of the bundle resources will not be allowed. However, Hybrid customers should be able to sambaza their Pre-Pay airtime, resources purchased out of bundle, and Bonga Points under the prevailing sambaza rules.
- Unutilized resources will not be rolled over to the following month.
- Prevailing Safaricom Post Pay out of bundle charges are applicable for all International Calls, International SMS and any Roaming usage.
- If on a Hybrid tariff, customer should be able to purchase resources on \*544#, after expiry of their resources or alternatively, go out of bundle.

# **Corporate Advantage Plus Charges**

- The resources will apply to all local networks calls.
- Calls to toll free numbers and international numbers cannot be made using the preferential voice bundle
- Rates are as shown in table below:

| POST PAY PLAN | Ksh. 2,999 | Ksh. 4,999 | Ksh. 9,999 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Local Minutes | 1,500 | 3,000 | 9,000 |
| Local SMS | 1,500 | 3,000 | 9,000 |
| Data | 3GB | 6GB | 18B |
| Bonga Points (on subscription & Renewal) | 299.9 | 499.9 | 999.9 |

# 

# ﻿**Autobar Services**

- This is a service where a maximum usage limit is set on customer’s line.
- On hitting the set limit, the line is automatically barred from making outgoing calls/SMS/data. This is to enable them to control their usage.
- On the PostPay application form indicate the desired/projected monthly usage, and this will be used as a benchmark for the credit limit.
- If a line is barred, a customer will need to pay both the billed and unbilled amounts in full. You can make payment against your usage to allow more usage.

**Domain & Hosting Service Information & Mechanics**

# **DOMAIN AND WEB HOSTING**

**Definition**

A domain is an internet web site address that identifies one or more IP addresses e.g. safaricom.co.ke, safaricom.com etc.

The service offers packages that combine domain registration, web hosting and mail hosting solutions along with many additional features to enhance the web experience as well as ensure your website and mail is secure.

To enjoy the domain registration and hosting service from Safaricom, customers need to register preferably online to have an account with Safaricom first.

Domain names registered through Safaricom currently are:.co.ke, .com, .net, .org, .biz, .info, or.ke, .info.ke, .ac.ke etc.

# **Benefits**

Business Continuity – having an effective online presence will ultimately keep businesses thriving.

Full Support – Safaricom’s qualified personnel will ensure that business does not stall due to interruptions.

Provides businesses with an effective Web and e-mail services.

Allows business to change to professional e-mail and maintain a professional outlook.

Allows business to change their own website with easy-to-use website builders for a professional outlook.

Markets businesses online with your own website.

The portal offers intelligent domain name suggestions, with real time availability of domain checking.

# **Domain Features**

Payment is made once annually, and client must pay upfront (in full) before they are activated on the service.

Minimum subscription period is 1 year and maximum 5 years. Renewal is also in similar periods (one to five years).

Domain and hosting package must be renewed once subscription period elapses for the client to continue using the service.

**Domain Extensions & Supporting Documents**

**Domain Extensions Locally Available in Kenya**

- co.ke - for everyone
- or.ke - for NGO's
- ne.ke - Network devices
- go.ke- Government Entities and Agencies. (Supporting documents will be required)
- ac.ke - Institutes of Higher Education. (Supporting documents will be required)
- sc.ke - lower and middle institutes of learning. (Supporting documents will be required)
- me.ke - for Personalized Emails and Sites
- mobi.ke - for Mobile Content
- info.ke - for Information
- .ke – for everyone

# **Supporting Documents Required for Domain Extension**

| Domain | Requirements |
| --- | --- |
| go.ke | This domain requires supporting documents from the Department of Government IT Services (GITS) at the Ministry of Finance. GITS should give an Authority Letter to show that the Entity is a valid Government institution or Agency and authorized to register the domain name. |
| ac.ke | This requires either a copy of the Certificate of Registration from the relevant Ministry, a copy of the College Charter or a copy of the Act of Parliament that was passed to establish the Institute. The document should classify the Entity as a Tertiary Institution: Polytechnic, Technical Institute, College or University. |
| sc.ke | This requires a copy of the Certificate of Registration from the Ministry of Education. The document MUST also bear the name of the Entity. The document should classify the Entity as a Kindergarten, Primary or Secondary School. |

 **Note:**

Customer will email us to business.support@safaricom.co.ke with attachments of the required documentation//certificates for the domains that require supporting documents. Our Business Support team will generate a ticket to KENIC Registry Services with the Supporting Documents within 24 working hours. Only when the Ticket is closed will the domain be published.

# **Domain Packages**

**The available domain packages.**

- All international domain KSH 999
- Local Domains for.co.ke KSH 1300 while .KE is KSH 7000

**Web Hosting Packages**

The available web hosting packages are bronze, silver gold, premium, enterprise and enterprise plus.

| WEBHOSTINGPACKAGES | BRONZE | SILVER | GOLD | PREMIUM | ENTERRISE | ENTERRISEPLUS |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PropositionFeatures perPackage | 500 MB space10 Email Accounts,5 Sub Domains,2 FTP Accounts. | 2 GB Space,50 Email Accounts,50 Sub Domains,5 FTP Accounts. | 10 GB Space,100 Email Accounts,100 Sub Domains,20 FTP Accounts. | 20 GB Space,200 Email Accounts,200 Sub Domains,30 FTP Accounts. | 50 GB Space,500 Email Accounts,400 Sub Domains,40 FTP Accounts. | 100 GB Space,1000 Email Accounts,600 Sub Domains,60 FTP Accounts. |
| Annual Charges LOCAL .KE ONLY | Ksh.1,300 | Ksh.1,300 | Ksh.1,300 | Ksh.1,300 | Ksh.1,300 | Ksh.1,300 |
| AnnualChargesHOSTING ONLY | Ksh.1,500 | Ksh.2,500 | Ksh.4,000 | Ksh.5,000 | Ksh.7,100 | Ksh.9,000 |
| PRICE (DOMAIN and HOSTING) | Ksh.2,8001 Year | Ksh.3,8001 Year | Ksh.5,3001 Year | Ksh.6,3001 Year | Ksh.8,4001 Year | Ksh.10,3001 Year |

# **The pricing will be dependent on**

**Proposition features i.e.**

- Cloud space.
- Number of email accounts a customer can create.
- Number of sub domains available for customer to create. This allows the customer to create child accounts / domains within the available specs availed. Thus, providing convenient management of customers who have an option to have different domains hosted together.
- FTP accounts: - The File Transfer Protocols, allows the organization to create separate log INS and administration of their website i.e. separated log INS for backend system managements i.e. uploading, deleting, and editing of content / database.

**Domain name**

This is defined by the domain extension. Can be a business name with an extension such as.co.ke; .com; .info.org; .org; .go.ke; .or.ke, net etc.). This allows website visitors to find and access information about that business on the web easily. (The pricing is as attached on the appendix)

Customer can: -

- Create a new domain from the portal.
- Transfer an existing domain registered from a different registrar. Transfer process applies.

Domain renewal offers an option to renew either annually, or after two / three / four / five years.

**Hosting charges**

These are dependent on business rules, will be reviewed as, and when need be by the business.

- This is optional for customers who wish to purchase domain only. Customer will continue at registration without selecting the hosting package.
- Customers who wish to be hosted will have to select the preferred package as per existing matrix at registration.
- Hosting packages offers an option to either renew annually, or after either 2 or three years.

# **Domain and Web Hosting Registration**

- All customers will be required to subscribe to a new domain package via Safaricom Domain Web portal. URL [https://domains.safaricom.co.ke](https://domains.safaricom.co.ke/)
- Customer will have the option of subscribing for a domain and a hosting package separately.
- When purchasing domain and hosting subscription, the customer will have the option to start by searching availability of the domain name or by selecting a hosting package.
- After accessing the web portal, customer will type in the domain name and choose an extension as per their preference e.g..co.ke .com etc.
- Customer will then search to check availability of the domain name, add it to shopping cart if available, and click check out.
- The customer will be redirected to the Domain Configuration page where a link to select a web hosting package will be presented.
- Customer will select the preferred hosting package from the list presented and proceed to check out.
- For customers who wish to purchase domain only, they will continue without selecting the hosting package.
- Alternatively, customers will be able to purchase a domain and hosting package by first selecting a hosting package.
- The customer will select the package on the homepage or by clicking ‘Hosting’ link then ‘Shared hosting’ and selecting the preferred package.
- This will be followed by a prompt to search a domain name availability and add the domain name to cart.
- The customer will click continue and will be redirected to the shopping cart.

Location Details

# **SD WAN Service Information & Mechanics**

#  

# **Definition, Eligibility** **& Key Features**

**Definition**

- SD-WAN is a service that enables businesses to quickly and securely transmit data between multiple business premises independent of the internet also known as Software Defined Wide Area Network
- It connects corporate networks, including branches and data centers, over long geographic distances to enable the sharing of resources that are centrally hosted e.g. software and databases.
- It’s an approach that implements Wide Area Network solutions, layer new services, improve security and obtain analytics from the network among other benefits.
- MPLS stands for Multi-Protocol Label Switching. Which is a mechanism for routing traffic within a telecommunications network, as data travels from one network node to the next. An example of MPLS at work is where a bank HQ, its branches and ATMs are all able to access and modify consumer bank accounts.
- SD-WAN and MPLS works similarly with switches and routers sitting between levels 2 and 3. (MPLS is sometimes considered a Layer 2.5.) Packet forwarding technology and labels are used to make data transmission decisions. The label is inserted between Layer 2 (data connection) and Layer 3 (network) headers.
- It is a service that is eligible to all existing and new customers from across both SME and Large enterprise segments of the market.

# **Eligibility**

- It’s a Postpaid service.
- Application can be done by filling out an application form provided by a sales executive.
- New customers will be required to provide the relevant KYC documentation which includes the following:

| Company Type | KYC Requirements | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Category A | Private/Public Companies.Saccos | Certified Copy of Certificate of IncorporationCertified Copy of Company PIN CertificateDully filled in & signed SDWAN Application FormCertificate of Registration |
| Category B | Government - agencies, ministries, parastatals.All tenders. | Certified copy of Certificate of RegistrationDully filled in & signed SDWAN Application FormLetter from an Authorised person in the agency/Ministry/ParastatalContract document |
| Category C | SMEsOther(Not possessing above documents) | Certified Copy of Certificate of IncorporationCertified Copy of Company PIN CertificateDully filled in & signed SDWAN Application Form |

# **Key Features**

- SD-WAN utilizes a centralized management function to route traffic safely and intelligently through the WAN
- It provides the flexibility to support hybrid WAN connectivity combining private (MPLS) with Internet connected sites.
- It supports both a hub-and-spoke and branch to branch Dynamic Multi-Path Optimization and VPN features.
- It securely connects users to any application, both in the data center and in the cloud, across all WAN transport services, including broadband Internet service.
- It has Dynamic Multi-Path Optimization which ensures that different WAN circuits have their performance and capacity optimally and automatically used to provide assured application performance.
- Dynamic Multi-Path Optimization includes three critical capabilities for assuring application performance.
- Continuous monitoring of link performance including packet loss, latency and jitter.
- It has a capacity that provides real-time information to protect against brownouts and blackouts
- Cloud-hosted Gateways provide security and ease of management benefits between enterprise sites directly to cloud destinations such as SaaS and IaaS.
- Safaricom uCPEs/CPEs can be installed at all sizes of branches, as well as in headquarter and data center locations. Appliances vary in throughput capacity as well as tunnel capacity especially important for CPEs provisioned at hub sites.
- We advise that customers to be on Safaricom connectivity, however, the service still works with 3rd party connection that Safaricom does not manage.

# **SD WAN Supportive Infrastructure**

For the service to work the customer need to have the following resources:

- A secure LAN connection with computers and servers.
- Firewalls, Routers, Switches and Cables.
- A Fast and reliable internet connection e.g. Fiber or Broadband connection.
- High-speed connectivity from branches to the headquarters/datacenter.
- Plug-and-play transparent installation and an advanced SD-WAN router gateway.
- It is critical to have a high-throughput IP tunnel that is reliable for this data connection.

# **SD WAN Service Packaging & Pricing**

The below are the Packages and Prices that will suffice per branch:

| Product Description | Long Product Description | 2 Core Thin vCPE | 2 Core vCPE with LTE | 4 Core uCPE | 8 Core uCPE |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Price KES. Incl. VAT | Price KES. Incl. VAT | Price KES. Incl. VAT | Price KES. Incl. VAT | | |
| Standard SD-WAN | Perpetual License for Standard SD-WAN with all the SD-WAN functions and advanced routing. | 7,091 | 7,616 | 7,496 | 8,533 |
| Advanced SD-WAN | Perpetual License for Advanced SD-WAN with all the Standard SD-WAN functions and advanced features. | N/A | N/A | 8,381 | 9,417 |
| Advanced SecureSD-WAN | Perpetual License for Advanced Secure SD-WAN with all the Advanced SD-WAN functions and security features. | N/A | N/A | 11,765 | 12,802 |
| SDWAN Services – AD HOC | Perpetual License for Advanced SD-WAN with the client choosing security features from a 3rd party VNFs. | N/A | N/A | ** | ** |

**NB**: Cost to be determined after scoping.

- A customer who subscribes to Advanced Secure SDWAN package will enjoy all the benefits offered by both Advanced SD-WAN and Standard SD-WAN.
- A customer that subscribes to Standard SD-WAN will not enjoy the benefits offered by both Advanced SD-WAN and Advanced Secure SD-WAN.

# **Service Change & Account Management**

Service change requests will come from customers during in-life phase of the customer journey via their respective account managers.

- For all other customers, they shall be required to fill a Change of Service Form.
- All service change requests will be processed as a new SDWAN requests.

- A Customer will be given a Termination form to fill specifying the Account Number and CIs to be terminated (for connectivity & SDWAN) and then returns it to the Account Manager.
- SDWAN being a secondary service, a customer can’t terminate a link and remain with SDWAN product, thus the Account Manager needs to exercise care to know other services are riding on a link before termination requests are executed.
- Failure to do so may lead to unintended repercussions, like erroneous terminations, poor customer experience, loss of revenue and churn. End of tenure and mid-tenure terminations will be done as per contract agreement.
- Where the customer decides to terminate the service mid-tenure the customer will do so on writing.

All-In-One bundle will Auto renew on 1st of the consecutive months unless they unsubscribe from auto renewal and they will be deducted Full Amount and Full resources.

For Pure Post-Pay customers, if they purchase an All-in-One auto renew bundle in the middle of the month (from 2nd onwards), they will receive Full resources at a Prorated Amount.

The resources purchased with pro-rated amount will expire at the end of the same month.

**Bundle less than 1000 (250 and 500*)*** do not have Auto renewal option.

# **M-PESA Renewal**

This is an enhancement on the All-in-One Monthly bundles that allows customers to renew their All-in-One Bundles via M-PESA.

# **Renewal Procedure**

Customer must have purchased All-In-One Auto-renew bundle via M-PESA.

On the 7th, 5th and 1 day to expiry customers will receive message notifications that will alert them that the bundle is about to expire.

A direct string to be availed in the notification messages on how to renew the bundle (\*544\*88#) via MPESA.

Once customer dials the direct string, STK push to be presented to the customer to enter their M-PESA PIN and renew the bundle.

Payment options available will be via airtime and M-PESA.

The plans will have a **32-day validity**.

# **DIY Opt-Out Auto Renewal**

- Dial \*544#
- Select Data Bundles with Expiry.
- Select option for MORE.
- Select stop Autorenewal.
- Confirm to complete

# **DIY How to Purchase All-in-One Bundles**

**Via USSD**

**(\*544#)**

Dial \*544#

Select Data Bundle with Expiry.

Select All-In-One Bundle.

Choose the amount to spend.

Select the bundle to buy.

Select payment method.

You will get a confirmation message

 **(\*100#)**

Dial \*100#

Select Buy.

Select Data Bundle with Expiry.

Select All-In-One Bundle.

Choose the amount to spend.

Select the bundle to buy.

Select payment method.

You will get a confirmation message.

**(\*200#)**

Dial \*200#

Select Buy Data Bundles.

Select Data Bundle with Expiry.

Select All-In-One Bundle.

Choose the amount to spend.

Select the bundle to buy.

Select payment method.

You will get a confirmation message.

# **Via ZURI BOT**

Access Zuri through available channels.

From main menu choose Products and Services.

Select Buy Bundles.

Select Bundle with Expiry.

Choose All-In-One Bundle option.

Choose the bundle of choice and confirm purchase.

# **Via MySafaricom APP**

Launch MySafaricom APP

Click on Data, Calls, SMS & Airtime

Click on Go Monthly

Click on All-In-One

Click Buy against the preferred Bundle

Select Own Number or Enter Other Number

Select Airtime or M-PESA Payment Method

Click Buy

For M-PESA, enter M-PESA PIN and Continue

# **Via ONLINE**

Go to [www.safaricom.com/Bundles.](http://www.safaricom.com/Bundles)

Select All-In-One Bundle buy now.

Select bundle of your choice and Buy**.**

# **DIY Purchase for Another Number**

Dial \*544#ok.

Select Data Bundle with Expiry.

Select option 10 Buy for other number.

Enter the other number:07XXXXXXXX.

Select All-In-One Monthly bundle.

A confirmation message will be sent with details.

# **DIY Checking Balance**

**Via MySafaricom APP**

Launch MySafaricom APP

Click **View My Balances**

Click on the drop-down icon against the preferred resource (Data, Voice or SMS) for details

**Via USSD**

Balance check on **USSD** **\*544#, \*544\*44#, \*144#** or **SMS 144** to show the balance of all the resources remaining (Data and Minutes).

articleTitle: Procedures and DIY of PostPay DIY Service
markdownContent:
# **OPT IN**

## **On My Safaricom APP**

- **On the My Safaricom app click on the banner.**
- **You will get a predefined credit limit and no deposit is required.**
- **Customers with no credit limit will be prompted to enter their preferred limit and make payment (deposit is required) via MPESA.**
- **Enter your email address for billing purposes.**
- **Select a PostPay bundle plan.**
- **Accept terms and conditions.**
- **You will receive a notification that your line has been moved to PostPay.**

**On USSD \*544#**

- Dial \*544# ,select Monthly bundle then join postpay or \*456# select the option to Activate/Join PostPay.

- You will get a predefined credit limit where no deposit is required.

- Customers with no credit limit will be prompted to enter their preferred limit and make payment (deposit is required) via MPESA.

- Enter your email address for billing

- purposes.

- Select a PostPay bundle plan.

- Accept terms and conditions.

- You will receive a notification that your line has been moved to PostPay.

# **With credit limit (No deposit is required)** 

After opting in the customer will be requested to set the desired limit after which they will make a payment.

The PostPay tariff on sign up allows you to **Set a Preferred monthly credit limit** with a minimum allowed limit of **1,050.**

Different customers will have different monthly limits based on their spend on Safaricom network.

# **Without credit limit**

- Customers who have less, or No monthly limits can always increase their limits by paying deposit via MPESA.
- Customers must buy a **PostPay Bundle** when joining by dialing \*200# (**Normal calling rates 4.87/- applies**)

# **Changing Credit Limit**

- Dial \*200#

- Select change credit limit either upward or downwards.

- Reducing Limit- Key in their preferred limit for a successful change

- Increasing Limit-The system will check;

- Customers current monthly limit,

- Deposit if any and the current score to establish whether the customer will pay for deposit or not.

- If the requested limit is less than the current limit score on the system customer will be allowed to migrate without paying for any deposit.

- If the requested limit is more than the current limit score on the system, customer will be required to pay the difference as deposit (i.e. New requested Limit – (Existing Limit + Existing deposit)

# **MAKING PAYMENTS**

**MPESA payment****.**

- Go to MPESA menu
- Select Lipa na MPESA paybill option
- Enter Paybill number 200200
- Enter the number customer is paying for as account number
- Enter amount and MPESA pin to complete.

**NB**; The system will auto reverse the amount if there is delay and MPESA account had already been deducted.

**Bonga payment**

- Dial #200#
- Bill payment
- Choose 98
- Proceed with payment using Bonga option
- Enter service pin to complete.

**Paying for another number via \*200#**

- Dial \*200#
- Bill payment
- Choose 98
- Choose to pay for another number
- Choose mode of payment
- Enter pin to confirm payment.

# **OPTING OUT**

- Dial \*200#

- Select Terminate and accept.

- You will be required to clear the bill in progress before termination.

- Choose to pay from MPESA, the Deposit or pay with both Deposit and MPESA to settle the Bill In progress.

#  **Changing Email address:**

The option is **only** available to the below credit categories.

- Postpaid Bundles
- PostPay DIY
- PostPay DIY Revamp
- Individual Autobar
- Express Autobar
- PostPaid LMM

Customers on any other category will get the error ***Sorry, change email is not available for your tariff. Kindly dial 200 to contact customer care.***The customer journey is below:

 [Screenshot] 

**NB**: Any refund to the customer will be done within 48 hours via the customer's MPESA account.

If a customer opts out of Postpay, the Customer will have to wait for 1 hour to be able to Onboard back to PostPay.

**NB:**

- FAQ: What happens if a customer is blacklisted on Okoa Jahazi?

 When a customer is opting in/onboarding/eligibility and has been blacklisted due to Okoa Jahazi will have to wait for the grace period to end and try to opt in.

- Customer can dial \*544# select Monthly bundle > Postpay FAQs or \*200# > account Management > Postpay FAQs to learn about post-pay DIY procedures.

**Halal Pesa**

***Halal Pesa is currently undergoing maintenance and new Opt In is not available.*** **Customers who had opted in and have existing facilities will still be able to pay for themselves or for other lines.*. To repay Halal Pesa, use Paybill 6059941 Account the borrowing phone number starting with 254..*** 

# **Defination**

Pesa is the first Shari’ah compliant based digital financing product that rides on the MPESA platform. Currently it is a financing product only, and does not have a saving functionality, which will be introduced later. The product is being offered under the partnership of Safaricom PLC and Gulf African Bank Ltd.

This product was designed to target our Muslim community who stay out of other lending products since they don’t adhere to Shari’ah law. Shari’ah law does not support/allow taking loans/borrowing money from banks or individuals where interest is charged.

# **Eligibility**

Halal pesa is available to **All M-pesa users**. 

# **Difference from other lenders**

Since Halal Pesa product is based on Shari’ah principles, it operates under Tawarruq model: which basically means that the customer is given a **facility** and not a **loan**. As we handle customers on Halal Pesa always **use the term facility** and **not Loan**. For customers who would like to verify the Shari’ah compliance of the product and inner workings refer them to (**website)www.gulfafricanbank.com**

# **Mechanics** 

***Halal Pesa is currently undergoing maintenance and new Opt In is not available till further notice******.***

Dial \*334**#** \> Loans and Savings > Halal Pesa

Select Register

Check T&C, read then Accept T&C

Enter the right MPESA PIN

#  **The Halal Pesa limit**

The Halal Pesa limit will be awarded during opt- in process and customer will be notified via SMS.

- Dial \*334#
- Go to Facility
- Select Check limit
- Enter right MPESA PIN

 Only one facility can be requested at a time

# **Minimum/Maximum facility**

The minimum allowed is Kshs 1000. One cannot request for an amount less than this.

Maximum = Kes.15,000 (first time customers) & Kes.20,000 (repeat customers) subject to customer’s qualifying limit

 A profit rate of 5%. is charged on the facility.

*Example: if the customer was given a facility of 1000sh, at profit rate of 5%, thus total due on day 30 will be 1000sh + 50sh = 1050sh.*

# **Repayment**

A customer may repay partially or in full

- Dial \*334#
- Go to Facility
- Select Pay Facility
- Select facility to be paid
- Select option to pay in full or partial.
- For full payment, enter the M-PESA PIN and confirm to pay
- For partial payment, enter the amount, M-PESA PIN and confirm to pay

# **Halal Pay for Other Number Option**

**Key Features**

Loan repayment for a recycled line

Loan repayment for an active line

Full loan amount Repayment

Partial loan amount Repayment

# **How It Works**

**Dial** \*334**#** \> Loans and Savings > Halal Pesa

**Select** Loans & Savings

**Select** Halal Pesa

**Select** Facility

**Select** Pay for Other

**Enter** Phone Number

**Select** loan to repay

**Enter** Amount

**Enter** MPESA Pin

**Repayment is completed** Customer receives confirmation sms from MPESA

# **Penalties** 

If the customer does not pay by day 31, the facility will be restructured to allow for another 30days at a 5% profit rate of the principal amount:

*Example: if the customer was given a facility of 1000sh, at profit rate of 5%, the total due on day 30 will be 1000sh + 50sh = 1050sh. If the customer is unable to pay by date 31 then the facility is restructured at a 5% profit rate again, where the customer will be expected to pay 1000sh+50sh+50sh = 1100sh by day 60. After day 60 no other charges will be applied on the facility.*

# **Limit Check**

Dial \*334**#** \> Loans and Savings > Halal Pesa

Go to Facility

Select Check Limit

Enter M-PESA PIN

# **Balance Check**

Dial \*334**#** \> Loans and Savings > Halal Pesa

Go to Check Balance

Enter right MPESA PIN 

# **Due Date Check**

- Dial \*334**#**  > Loans and Savings > Halal Pesa
- Go to Check balance
- Enter right MPESA PIN
- Expected result: Your Halal Pesa outstanding loan balance is Ksh 100 due on 09-05-2021.

# **Available Services on Halal Pesa**

- Opt In
- Request Facility
- Query Limit
- Query Balance
- Repay Facility
- Opt Out

# **Support**

Safaricom will offer all support services to the customers. All escalations will be done via the assigned Service Requests for support team to engage the bank where necessary.

For all Shari’ah compliance matters kindly refer the customer to GAB website www.gulfafricanbank.com

# **Language to use when addressing customers**

Please take note of words to use and what not to use when talking to the halal pesa customers.

| Correct Word | Wrong Word |
| --- | --- |
| Use FacilityUse Take facilityUse Request for facility | Don’t use Loan or CreditDon’t use Take loanDon’t use Borrow a loan or take credit |
| Use Financing | Don’t use Lending |
| Use Profit Rate | Done use Interest |

articleTitle: Bonga services offered via CRM/ Siebel
markdownContent:
# Bonga enrollment via CRM

For customers like Big box and car tracking numbers, SIM cards cannot be removed from the devices hence need for enrollment via CRM.

a) Guide the customer on how to use DIY \*100# ok to enroll with the exemption of the above-mentioned customers.

b) If you get a customer who is not enrolled for Bonga and requests to be assisted on call, the procedure below will be used to enroll the customer on Siebel.

NB: Ensure you also advise the customer on the DIY available options.

To enroll a customer on CRM:

1. On Siebel select CBS LMS

2. Select Enroll

3. Select commit enrolment

4. The customer will be awarded 10 Bonga points upon enrolment

# Setting or changing service  PIN

1. As a fraud control measure, please confirm with ‘Fraudster location tool' on HLR, if the line is in a fraud location.

2. If the caller is confirmed to be in a fraud hot site. First verify the tariff, if it indicates ‘**M-PESA agent tariff’**, ‘**SYJ tariff’**, ‘**Dealer** **tariff’**, please do not suspend or reset the Bonga  service PIN refer the agent to their head office.

3. If the tariff is not any on the one’s mentioned above suspend and refer to the nearest Retail center for further assistance.

4. If confirmed not to be in a prison site, proceed as below.

14. If there are any existing Key Comments captured or recent fraud interactions, follow instructions as advised.

5. Verify from Siebel orders if the customer has performed a SIM replacement on their line within the last 24 hours.

6. If the line has been swapped within the last 24 hours, advise the customer to visit the nearest Retail Center. In case of inaccessibility, customer can call us after 24 hours, from time of SIM replacement.

# Issuance of service PIN on Postpay

1. **All PostPay customers** had the Bonga points PIN auto generated and sent to via SMS during registration. Advise the customer to use this PIN if they can remember it.

2. **Individual PostPay customers** only can request for Bonga PIN reset on call.

3. **Corporate PostPay customers** need to bring a letter in a corporate letter head advising on Bonga PIN change to the Retail Center or email the scanned letter to advantage@safaricom.co.ke. Corporate customers are not enabled to transfer, transfer of Bonga Points is done via mail or visit the nearest retail shop. The letter should be stamped by the contact person, and in a corporate letter head.

4. **Internal Safaricom Staff** will send Name, Tel and EK to bonga-pin@safaricom.co.ke for assistance from their official email address. SLA is 2 hours.

**Note:** However, if the customer cannot remember the auto generated PIN, reset using the procedure below:

1. Vet the customer to verify ownership as per the CC Vetting Procedure and reset the Bonga PIN if details are correct.

2. If the customer does not have any or all the vetting requirements s/he will need to visit the Retail shops.

3. Advise on Bonga PIN change process, to a PIN of their choice and capture vetting under interaction.

**Please Note:**

1. An existing customer who passes all the vetting can have the PIN reset from the system and thereafter the customer can change the PIN to one of their choice. Enter the vetting details on Siebel interaction created under the MSISDN.

2. If the customer does not have any or all the vetting requirements i.e. s/he will visit the Retail shops who will reset the PIN using the provided interface after vetting.

3. ALL CCRs and Retail Agents have been given access to the Bonga PIN Reset Interface. Default password for all is “**Password01**”. Agents should change their PIN on initial log in for information security.

4. Once you are logged on, vet the customers, then enter their mobile number e.g. 0722xxxxxx, the interaction ID you created on Siebel and reset the Pin. The customer will receive an SMS notification with the new PIN and how to reset the PIN via USSD.

5. Customers whose National ID numbers were captured with leading or tracing zeros will have to input them as registered.

6. National ID numbers that have been captured with full stops, commas or any other characters on Siebel will not pass the authentication test. These characters will have to be deleted from SIEBEL, on escalation via SR.

7. M-PESA Tills and Dealer lines are able to Changa Na Bonga as well.

8. All other business rules remain as is.

# Bonga transfer

Note this will apply when the USSD process fails or when the customer is experiencing difficulties doing the transfer or for customers who are not enabled to transfer from their lines, i.e. for customers disabled from doing transfers from their lines via \*126# OK.

1. Mandatory fields are: Set/Transfer (number of points to be transferred) and Transfer points to (recipient number)

2. Call center staff will now be able to raise Bonga points’ transfer requests from CBS LMS VBC. This will raise an SR with an activity for approval to contact center support manager.

3. Once activity is approved, the deduction will be done from the donor line and adjusted to the recipient number automatically and the SR will close. If activity is cancelled, SR will also be cancelled, and the adjustment will not be done.

**Note:** 
You are advised to encourage customers to use self-service via USSD (\*126#), and only initiate these when a customer is having difficulties self-serving.

# Bonga points transfer from a corporate line

The customer can either visit the retail center with the following or have them scanned and sent to advantage@safaricom.co.ke for the points to be transferred and accumulated on one MSISDN (Mobile Number).

1. A written request, on company letter head signed by the contact person,

2. Identification details of the contact person.

# Guideline on how to enable and disable Bonga transfer

If a customer calls and is unable to transfer Bonga Point, follow the procedure below:

- Vet to ascertain ownership of the line

- Click on the CBS LMS button

- Check if the line is transfer enabled

- If the button is not enabled,

1. Click on the “Enable/Disable Transfers buttons

2. Confirm the Transfer Enabled button is checked.

- If the customer’s account is enabled for transfer and the customer cannot transfer points, perform the following checks on the customer’s MSISDN:

1. Confirm on the Bonga Matrix that tariff can transfer the points

2. Confirm the customer is transferring a minimum of 50 points and will remain with a minimum of 50 points

3. If the customer is experiencing USSD failures, advise the customer to use a different handset

4. Confirm sender and recipient do not have any ETU balance

5. Confirm the customer is using the correct procedure and has reset the Bonga PIN

- If all the above conditions have been met and the customer is still unable to transfer Bonga points, the CEE will raise a Service Request to the support team for resolution

- Advise the customer on the SLA and raise an interaction

NB: **Do not activate transfer functionality for corporate MSISDNs.**

# Bonga Escalation procedure on CRM

Use this guideline when a customer calls in claiming they are not earning Bonga points not accumulating Bonga points have reduced without their authority.

- Vet to ascertain ownership of the line. If vetting is not successful refer the caller to the Retail Centers for assistance.

- If successful, Check Siebel and LMS to ascertain that indeed there is an issue with Bonga accumulating or reducing.

- Check the Bulletin board and emails for updates on Bonga Points. If there is an email alerting staff to a Bonga Points problem causing a delay in accumulation of points, then advice the customer as instructed in the email.

- If there is no current relevant bulletin, then initiate an SR detailing the problem and escalate as required.

- Advise the customer of the SLA and reassure the customer that they will never lose Bonga points as we keep a record of all data on how they have used their airtime.

# Consolidation of corporate customer Bonga points to one number at a Retail Centre

- The customer will request for this by writing authorization letter on company letter head requesting the points to be consolidated on one number.

- The Company will also fill a Bonga Aggregation form to be presented to a Safaricom Shop for customers who are not mapped to an Account Manager or Relationship Executive.

- The Bonga Aggregation form will be signed and stamped and indicate the number to be loaded with the Bonga points.

- The letter must have the following details:

1. Have the respective company letterhead and bear the organization stamp/seal. In exceptional cases where company claims to have no stamp, CEE will verify by contacting the contact person as indicated on CRM

2. Be signed by 2 official signatories. One must be the CRM contact Person.

3. Must state that the bearer has been authorized to do a consolidation on behalf of the company, indicating in the letter their full name, and ID number. Where the same is not indicated, CEE must contact the signatories and use available contacts on Siebel to verify approval for Bonga redemption has been given.

4. Must state the number to be loaded with the Bonga points.

5. Must include the number the Bonga points will be consolidated from i.e. sponsor numbers

- Party sent must have original ID and have it scanned and attached on the letter.

- The CEE will:

1. Stamp the letter and the form with the Retail Shop rubber stamp showing the current date and capture the SR number on the letter.

2. Create an SR for the request and attached scanned copies of the letter and form.

3. File the physical documents.

# **Fresh Friday - Data Delight Bundle**

Data Delight Bundle  is aimed at giving all our data customers a delight every Friday between 8 a.m. and 12 p.m. Customers will buy the 1.5GB data bundle at Kshs. 50 and will be awarded 3GB valid for 3 hours. This will enable customers do more for the same price giving them a sense of value.

This is a delight data bundle which is available to all Safaricom customers every Friday between 8am and 12pm. The customer buys 1.5GB data bundle and gets 1.5GB More for only 50/-valid for 3 hours.The customer will receive 3GB as a lumpsum

# **Mechanics**

Dial \*544# select data deals option 5, 544 data deals through the direct string \*544\*12# and via only on Fridays between 8am and 12pm.

The bundle cannot be transferred and is only purchased via airtime or M-Pesa.

# Validity

The Bundle validity will not be extended by purchasing a bundle with a similar validity.

# **Tunukiwa on Zuri** 

ZURI users will now be able to purchase Tunukiwa offers via airtime by either 
typing the word "**Tunukiwa**" or accessing it directly from menu 4 "Tunukiwa'.

M-PESA & BONGA purchases will be added in the next phase. 

# **Tunukiwa Submenus On ZURI**

Hot Deals

Tunukiwa Internet

Tunukiwa Minutes

SMS

Tunukiwa FAQs

Other services that have been added include are:

Fuliza, M-SHWARI, KCB M-PESA (Loans & Services)

Jitambulishe Enrolment

ZURI is currently available in the following four channels.

Safaricom ZURI FB - Messenger [m.me/safaricomzuri](https://m.me/safaricomzuri)

Safaricom ZURI - Web [safaricom.com/help/zuri](http://www.safaricom.com/help/zuri)

Safaricom ZURI - WhatsApp [wa.me/254722000100](https://wa.me/254722000100)

Safaricom ZURI - Telegram [t.me/safaricomchatbot](https://t.me/safaricomchatbot)

# **Domain Refund Process**

**Refund Process**

Refund process will apply for all scenarios where a full reversal is not possible, and a partial refund done.

Such scenarios will include, but not limited to:

Erroneously purchased international domains.

Customer request to refund either domain (local) or host bought as a package.

**Reversal Requests**

**CEE will:**

Delete all the resources awarded to the customer from the different systems.

KENIC Registry System for Local domain

C-Panel for Host services

WHMCS for services created on the portal.

The CEE will then raise an SR capturing the below details:

Reason for refund

Confirmation of deletion of service from all relevant systems

**L2222 team leader will:**

Pick the SR, confirm reason of refund and make sure domain and host are deleted.

Fill in the domain refund justification.

Initiate the refund Justification sign-off on share point for approval by the EBU Care Support Manager and Senior Manager.

Copy credit control team to receive the notification once approval is complete.

Notification will be sent to Credit Control who will print the approved refund form for physical approvals by HoD as per credit control processes.

Credit control will continually confirm with Finance Teams, that reconciliation is done as per existing processes.

Once approved, a refund will be given to the customer within 2 Hours of the approval.

L2222 team leader will advise the customer on the refund and close the SR.

# **Scenarios for Reversal or Refunds**

**Wrong Paybill**

For the wrong Paybill number, M-PESA wrong Paybill reversal process will apply. CEE will advise the customer accordingly.

Wrong account number and double payment

For the wrong account and double payments, L2222 CEE will confirm the M-PESA transaction ID on WHMCS to verify no payments were validated against the respective transaction ID.

The CEE will initiate a reversal and clearly indicate service not offered for the specific payment.

The CEE will capture the request on an SR to have the transaction completed by a second CEE or team leader.

Customer request or change of mind.

Customers due to one reason or another may request for a domain refund for domains correctly purchased.

Some of the reason that may trigger a reversal/refund request where services were offered include;

Customer using a software version incompatible with our servers. Example, incompatible PHP version

Change of mind.

Where a full refund is eligible, the L2222 CEE will follow the reversal process while refund process for partial refund.

Wrong account number and double payment

For the wrong account and double payments, L2222 CEE will confirm the M-PESA transaction ID on WHMCS to verify no payments were validated against the respective transaction ID.

The CEE will initiate a reversal and clearly indicate service not offered for the specific payment.

The CEE will capture the request on an SR to have the transaction completed by a second CEE or team leader.

# **Customer request or change of mind**

Customers due to one reason or another may request for a domain refund for domains correctly purchased.

Some of the reason that may trigger a reversal/refund request where services was offered include;

Customer using a software version incompatible with our servers. Example, incompatible PHP version

Change of mind

Where a full refund is eligible, the L2222 CEE will follow the reversal process while refund process for partial refund.

International Domain payment done after 30 days while on expiry status

In cases where a customer makes a payment to an international domain in expiry status past 30 days, The L2222 CEE will confirm the domain has been in expiry for more than 30 day and not registered on Key System.

The CEE will advise the customer on the redemption fee.

If the customer is not willing to pay the redemption fee, the L2222 CEE will delete the domain, host service from WHMCS and C-Panel, and initiate the reversal process as defined above

# **Transfer in Domain that are locked by previous host**

In cases where customer makes payment to a transfer in domain that is locked by the current host. The L2222 will confirm the domain is locked from WHOIS and on WHMCS logs.

The CEE will advise the customer to contact the host for unlocking.

If the domain is unlocked, the CEE will resubmit the request for the transfer to be effected.

If for any reason the customer is unable to have the domain unlocked, the CEE will be deleted the domain name and hosting form WHMCS if already created and initiate the reversal process as defined above

**Wrong domain name purchase**

In cases where a customer’s makes an error on the domain name during subscription, a refund will be eligible based on the below criteria.

Local Domains

This process will apply for local domains (.ke) only.

The customer must make the request within 7 days of the domain purchase.

Customer will make the request of an erroneous domain purchased by email to Business.support@Safaricom.co.ke. or call to 2222

L2222 CEE will vet the customer to confirm ownership.

The vetting details will include;

Name as registered on WHMCS and KeNIC.

ID/Passport

Registered email address on C-Panel

Confirm payment transaction ID

L2222 CEE will delete the domain form KeNIC registry and C-Panel and initiate the reversal process.

# **International Domain**

All international domains will not be eligible for a refund. Customers will be required to purchase a new domain without refunding.

**Wrong hosting package purchase**

In cases where a customer’s makes an error on the hosting package during subscription, a refund will be eligible based on the below criteria.

The customer must make the request within 7 days of the hosting package purchase.

Check the status of the domain from the following web tools, [http://www.centralops.net](http://www.centralops.net)  or [http://www.dnsgoodies.com](http://www.dnsgoodies.com) . If the domain is suspended advise the customer to make payment and request for renewal.

If the domain is active, establish, the type of internet connection the customer is using.i.e. whether is Safaricom Fixed data, mobile or any other ISP.

Confirm the outgoing SMTP, for a customer using Safaricom fixed data use mail.safaricombusiness.co.ke as the SMTP; for a customer using Safaricom mobile data use mail.gprs.safaricom.com. If the customer is using any other ISP advice that he/she need to have the outgoing SMPT given by the respective ISP.

Ensure that the customer is connecting to the internet.

Find out if the customer has internal mail server (e.g. MS Exchange) - If Yes ask the customer to confirm that the server configuration is ok.

If the above 5 points are ok, and customer is still unable to send emails, ask the customer to give the error message they are getting and capture the issue on SR for second level support to deal.

**Inability to receive emails on a domain hosted by Safaricom**

Ensure that the customer is connecting to the internet successfully.

If the domain is active, confirm the ISP hosting the domain from the same web tools. If the ISP is not Safaricom, customer may need to have domain checked by the respective ISP.

If the domain is hosted by Safaricom, find out if the customer has their own mail server-If yes, request the customer to confirm that the server configuration is ok.

Confirm the incoming mail server; this should be given by the ISP hosting the domain. For domains hosted by Safaricom, incoming mail server is mail. domain name. If the above checks are ok, get the error message the customer is experiencing and capture the issue on SR highlighting the above checks for second level support to deal.

Ensure that you interrogate the accounts to confirm any action that may have been taken prior to the repeat call. This will prevent the generation of repeat calls. Do the following:

To avoid double ticketing, whenever possible and if parent account details are available, ensure escalation ticket is raised under parent account level, unless the issue is in relation to one specific child account, where the ticket will be capture under the affected child’s account view.

If the ticket was closed less than 7 days ago, re-open the ticket and send mail to the assigned ECS analyst. # **Hotspot and Tethering Definition and Services**

**Definition**

A Wi-Fi hotspot is a wireless access point that you can connect to use Internet connection. ... There are also mobile hotspots — you can share your cellular data from an iPhone or Android, just as if they were a wireless router, and others can connect to it to get online.

**Tethering:** the linking of a computer or other device to a smartphone in order to connect to the internet.

Tethering a phone means connecting the phone to another device (such as a laptop or tablet) so that the device can use the phone's internet connection to get online. However, tethering can in some cases also be done with a USB connection or via Bluetooth.

# **Safaricom Wi-Fi Zone**

articleTitle: Introduction and Mechanics of Mobile Internet
markdownContent:
# **Introduction and Mechanics of Mobile Internet**

## Definition

Mobile data gives customer an internet connection on a smartphone or tablet without the need for Wi-Fi, meaning a customer can get online anywhere. Usage is measured in megabytes (MB) and gigabytes (GB).

# **Types of Speeds**

There are a few different speeds of mobile data, but 3G and 4G are the most known.

# **4G/3G/2G Internet**

4G is the 4th Generation of mobile technology.

2G brought customers calls and texts.

3G brought customers mobile broadband data and 4G now brings to the customer increased data speeds, up to 10 times faster than standard 3G.

There is another name that is sometimes used for 4G which is "LTE”, (Long Term Evolution).

# 4G/LTE

### **Definition**

**LTE stands for Long Term Evolution –** it’s a technology that is set to deliver very high data speeds. LTE Advanced is an upgrade of LTE. It achieves higher internet browsing speeds as compared to those offered by LTE.

### **To enjoy the superior service, customers will need**

4G capable Devices (phone/tablet/modem).

4G enabled SIM card.

Be in an area covered by the 4G service.

# **4G Features**

Support interactive multimedia, voice, video, wireless internet and other broadband services.

Improved speeds, reduced latency, and crystal-clear voice calls.

Global mobility, service portability, scalable mobile networks.

4G is entirely IP based, which means it uses internet protocols even for voice data. Conforming to this one standard means it is less likely for data to become scrambled while traversing the various networks, meaning a more seamless experience for us users!

Reduced latency, which if you’re a mobile gamer is essential. With reduced latency, you’ll see a much quicker response to your commands.

Seamless switching, variety of services based on Quality of Service (QoS) requirements.

# **4G/LTE** Coverage Map

This is a map showing 4G covered areas. Open with Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox Browsers, by copy-pasting the full link below- [http://intranet.safaricom.co.ke/sites/Technology/maps/SitePages/4G%20Map.aspx](http://intranet.safaricom.co.ke/sites/Technology/maps/SitePages/4G%20Map.aspx%20)

# **How to Confirm 4G, GPRS,3G, EDGE** **Speeds**

This will depend on the terminal that the customers are using and the coverage area.

Some devices will show the actual technology being used i.e. it may display 4G, GPRS, EDGE, UMTS, HSDPA on the dashboard of the modem or GPRS/EDGE/3G on the handset.

### **Definition**

3G HSDPA is Third Generation High-Speed Downlink Packet Access - a 3G mobile telephony Protocol, which offers increased data transfer speeds and capacity of up to 1.8 Mbps on the downlink and up to 348Kbps on the uplink, under ideal conditions.

***3G*** is ***defined*** as the 3rd generation of mobile phone and data communication standards, featuring higher bandwidth for web-based applications and video.

# **Features**

The main feature of 3G technology is that it supports greater voice & data capacity and high data transmission at low-cost.

The security, 3G technology has greater security features than 2G like Network Access Security, Network Domain Security, User Domain Security & Application Security.

The data transfer rates are high & can support live TV channels over phone.

Online media is another exciting feature in 3G mobiles, 3G mobiles highly attract the music lovers as they can listen to the music & watch videos online and they can download huge files with a less time.

3G offers faster connectivity, faster internet access & music with improved quality.

3G technology offers greater bandwidth on the go, it allows mobile device users to access all the Internet and multimedia applications that they usually access on the desktop PC connected to the home network.

3G networks can utilize the packet-based Internet protocol connectivity.

3G technology uses IP connectivity which is packet based and rich multimedia services are available.

# **Managing handsets locked on 3G** **network**

Safaricom offers both 2G, 3G 4G network. While 3G is used mainly to access High Speed Data, voice services can be offered on both 2G, 3G and 4G.

Customers who unknowingly select 3G Only mode on their phones will restrict their phone to the 3G networks. The downside of this is that they may experience degraded voice quality if 3G coverage is degraded or unavailable.

This mainly affects the below mentioned Smart Phones:

Android

IOS (Apple)

Blackberry

Windows

# 2G

### **Definition**

2G is a digital mobile communications standard allowing for voice calls and limited data transmission.

2G (or 2-G) is short for second-generation cellular network. 2G cellular networks were commercially launched on the GSM standard in Finland by Radiolinja (now part of EGlisa Oyj) in 1991.

#  **Key** **features**

2G technology is more efficient.

2G network holds enough security for both the sender & the receiver, all text messages are digitally encrypted.

This digital encryption allows for the transfer of data in such a way that only the intended receiver can receive & read it.

These digital signals consume less battery.

2G cannot do video streaming Streaming on 2G Network.

# Excise and Import Tax Adjustment on SIM Card And Phone Pricing

The Government of Kenya has implemented a KSh. 50 excise tax on SIM cards and a 10% excise tax on imported phones as part of the Finance Act 2022. In addition, the East African Community has applied a 25% import duty on phones as part of the Common External Tariff.

Accordingly, **effective 15th July 2022**, we will be reviewing our SIM card pricing to **KSh. 100** to include the excise tax. Phone prices will be adjusted to include the 10% excise tax and 25% import duty as existing stock levels are replaced by new stock on which the new taxes apply.

# **Definition**

Marine Cargo Insurance is an existing service that protects an importer against losses incurred following loss and/or damage to the goods whilst on transit. It protects against risks associated with navigation of the sea, air, and land.

Safaricom has partnered with IRA and KRA to improve importer experience by extending availability of Marine Cargo Insurance through Coral mini-app found on M-PESA Super App. The mini-app will be used by both importers and clearing agents to settle insurance costs for the imported goods.
