- Marine Cargo Insurance is an existing requirement and is mandatory for all importers
- Usage of the Coral Mini-App will be limited only to M-PESA registered customers through the M-PESA Super App

# **Requirements to Use the Coral Mini-App**

- The importer or clearing agent must have a valid KRA PIN
- The Importer or clearing agent must be registered on M-PESA.
- The customer PIN used on the Coral mini-app is the M-PESA PIN
- Customer must have an active M-PESA account. All payments will be done via M-PESA if the importer chooses to use Coral min-app
- Clearing agent must have a valid company KRA PIN

# **Access Channels**

- Download the M-PESA App via Play Store or App Store
- Note: First-time download and sign-in require data, and the subsequent times when using the App, you can use Wi-Fi or Data.
- Under the services tab, select the Coral Mini-App, and proceed to opt-in.

# **Charges**

- Current C2B (Paybill) transaction charges will apply for the payments.

We are currently piloting with selected clearing agents before opening it up to the public. For this reason, only whitelisted MSISDNs are able to view this mini-app.

Find attached the Customer Journey, CRM View and FAQs.

# Fresh Friday - Data Delight Bundle

Data Delight Bundle  is aimed at giving all our data customers a delight every Friday between 8 a.m. and 12 p.m. Customers will buy the 1.5GB data bundle at Kshs. 50 and will be awarded 3GB valid for 3 hours. This will enable customers do more for the same price giving them a sense of value.

This is a delight data bundle which is available to all Safaricom customers every Friday between 8am and 12pm. The customer buys 1.5GB data bundle and gets 1.5GB More for only 50/-valid for 3 hours.The customer will receive 3GB as a lumpsum

# Mechanics

Dial \*544# select data deals option 5, 544 data deals through the direct string \*544\*12# and via only on Fridays between 8am and 12pm.

The bundle cannot be transferred and is only purchased via airtime or M-Pesa.

# Validity

The Bundle validity will not be extended by purchasing a bundle with a similar validity.

**PIN 1 (Personal Identification Number) is used to:**

- Secure SIM when switching ON the handset.
- Used for OTA SIM swaps. 
 **NB:** The vetting process does not require the PIN therefore customers need not give it to us.

**PIN 2 is used for Fixed Dialing services on handset features.**

- **PUK 1** (Personal Unblocking Key) is used to unblock PIN 1 on a Sim Card.
- **PUK 2** is used to unblock PIN2.
- **Blocked sim**: If a wrong PIN is entered thrice consecutively, it blocks to safeguard the SIM content. At this point, the phone will indicate;
- PIN 1 Blocked, enter PUK 1 or PIN 2 Blocked, enter PUK 2
- SIM Locked, Enter PUK

**N.B.** A customer can also intentionally block their PIN1 if they have forgotten it and us PUK1 to create a new PIN.

**SIM unblocking; To unblock Simcard, use the procedures below:**

1. PIN1 blocked - Enter PUK1>Ok>New PIN>ok > Repeat New PIN >ok
2. PIN2 blocked - Enter PUK2>Ok >New PIN>ok> Repeat New PIN >ok 
 **NB**: For the new PIN, one can retain their previous PIN or choose a new one.

**Permanently blocked SIM:**

If a wrong PUK is entered 10 times in a row, the Sim Card is permanently blocked. A permanently blocked Sim Card will display one of the following statuses and customer should be advised to replace the line.

1. SIM Disabled.
2. SIM Rejected.
3. PUK Blocked.

articleTitle: Mobile Internet Set Up, Router Guide and Escalation
markdownContent:
**Mobile Internet Set Up, Router Guide and Escalation**

# **Mobile Internet Set Up**

This is an over-ride feature on the network that automatically autocorrects settings when customers access internet. In case this over-ride does not take place, the customer should be advised on manual settings.

# **Trouble Shooting Guide**

Check if the MSISDN has Airtime/ Bundle.

Confirm if they were able to browse before.

Check if the MSISDN’s has GPRS barring on HLR.

Can the customer access some sites: Example via a browser or other application (Facebook, Twitter etc.)

Confirm which error message the customer gets.

Confirm the settings the customer has if they are as below, if not, give the customer the settings and ask them to try again.

# **Escalation**

Should the customer call back after putting the settings and still unable to browse, the CEE will raise a Service Request (SR) SLA 48hrs with the below details:

Phone type and if its 2G/3G/4G.

Error message when attempting to browse.

State if the customer was able to browse before

# **Basic Router Configurations**

Verify the type of router the customer is using. Commonly used routers especially by home users, cyber and SMEs are Linksys, D-Link, TP-Link and Level one routers.

Default gateway addresses for the above routers are 192.168.1.1 and 192.168.0.1 for D-Link.

Open the gateway address from any browser while the computer used is directly connected on the router's LAN port via an ethernet cable. Username and password used is admin.

Log into the router interface assign the static IP; Key entries are:

Internet IP: put the customer public IP e.g., 41.139.204.98

Subnet mask: 255.255.255.252

Default gateway: this is derived from customer public IP e.g., 41.139.204.97

Preferred DNS server: 41.203.208.18

Alternate DNS server: 41.203.208.19

# **Changing Wireless Network Password on Wimax Router**

Login into the router gateway via the address 192.168.1.1 or 192.168.0.1.

For most routers-username and password is admin and then under wireless security settings change the passkey (pre-shared key-PSK).

**Hotspot and Tethering DIY Mechanics and Procedures**

# **Creating WI-FI Hotspot on an Android phone**

**Older versions E.g. Android 1.0 G1 (2008), 1.5 Cupcake (2009), 1.6 Donut (2009) etc.**

Select Settings> More>Tethering & Portable Hotspot

Turn on Portable Wi-Fi hotspot

Click on Set up Wi-Fi hotspot and change

Set Network SSID:(This is the name displayed when you search the Wi-FI)

Set Password: This is the password to give you access to the Wi-Fi network.

Then Save.

**Newer versions e.g. Android 10.0, Android 11.0**

Go to Settings on Samsung phone. From the Home screen, press the Menu button, then tap Settings.

In the Settings screen, tap Wireless & networks. On a Samsung phone, tap Connections, then tap Mobile Hotspot and Tethering.

Turn on the Mobile Hotspot toggle switch. The phone becomes a wireless access point and displays a message in the notification bar when it’s activated.

**Creating WI-FI Hotspot on an iPhone**

Tap on the Settings icon on your home screen in iOS 6 or lower, tap on General, and then tap Network.

In iOS 7 or higher, the process is a bit simpler. After tapping Settings, simply tap Personal Hotspot.

If customer is running iOS 7, or have already used tethering on their device, they can skip this step.

Otherwise, about halfway down the screen, there is a button labeled Set up Personal Hotspot (it will only read this before customer sets one up the first time. Once they have done that, it will simply read Personal Hotspot). Tap it. Set the following settings.

APN: Safaricom

Username: saf

Password: data

In iOS 7 and higher, go to Settings -> Personal Hotspot and simply move the slider so the green is showing. Personal Hotspot will start up.

In iOS 6 and earlier, tap Settings -> Network -> Personal Hotspot. Move the Personal Hotspot slider to on.

By default, Personal Hotspot is set to allow connections over USB only. When a customer turns the feature on, they will see this pop-up asking if they like to turn on Wi-Fi and Bluetooth to allow for wireless connections to their phone. Tap Turn on Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.

When other devices want to connect to your Personal Hotspot via Wi-Fi, they'll use their standard methods of connecting to a new Wi-Fi network.

**Creating WI-FI Hotspot on a Windows phone**

Click on Menu>Settings and Enable Internet Sharing

Click Set Up and change the Broadcast Mode and Password and save.

# **Tethering via Bluetooth/USB in an Android Phone**

**Older versions**

Tap on settings

Tap on Tethering and Wi-Fi Hotspot

Check Bluetooth Sharing

Enable Bluetooth on your computer

Then go to control panel and select device and printers

Select device to add to the computer

**Newer versions**

Touch the "Settings" application.

Touch "Wireless & Networks" and select "Tethering & Portable Hotspot."

Tap the "Bluetooth Tethering" check box to enable Bluetooth Internet sharing on your Android device.

Pair the other Bluetooth device to your Android device.

# **Tethering via USB cable in Android phone or Tablet**

Connect the phone to the laptop via a USB cable.

Go to settings>more>Tethering and portable hotspot.

Check USB Tethering.

Drivers will be installed, and customer will now be able to connect.

**NOTE:** The USB tethering connection is described as a “Remote NDIS based Internet Sharing Device.” Use this adapter to connect to the Internet using the phone’s data connection. It should be used automatically if it’s disconnected from standard Wi-Fi and wired networks.

# **Definition**

This is an airtime sharing service that allows a customer to share their airtime with other numbers (registered with their ID) upon top up within the 30-day sharing window.

# **Eligibility**

The service is available to Prepaid and Hybrid customers only(Exempted- M-PESA tills & Corporates and Post Pay Advantage)

# **Opt In/Opt Out**

Customers can opt in and opt out of the service by via USSD \*100\*3# and select Jisambazie

**NB:** Customer can opt out of the service at any point.

# **How It Works**

- At opt in, the customer will set the amount to be shared per beneficiary.
- Minimum amount is Ksh.5 and Maximum is Ksh.1000.
- The sponsor can share their airtime with a maximum of 5 numbers.
- The sponsor can remove and add a number from the beneficiary list at any time.
- Jisambazie will be done on a prioritization. The first number will get airtime and the rest will follow as the customer tops up within the 30-day sharing window.
- When the sponsor opts out of the service, all beneficiaries will be automatically removed from the sponsor’s list.
- Only Active lines can share airtime.

# **Sponsor Sambaza Airtime**

Only direct top ups and recharge via M-PESA will be automatically shared to the beneficiaries.

# **Beneficiary Sambaza Airtime**

The beneficiary can sambaza the airtime received.

# **Checking Balance**

To check balance, customers will send the word BAL to 144.

# **Service Renewal**

The service will auto renew monthly on the activation anniversary day.

# **Okoa Jahazi & Other Renewable Subscriptions**

Where the customer has other renewable subscriptions and Okoa Jahazi? Okoa Jahazi and other renewable subscriptions will take precedence over airtime sharing.

# **Accumulation of Bonga points**

The sponsor will earn bonga upon subscription according to the Bonga terms and condition.

# **Validity of the Beneficiary Airtime**

The shared airtime will take the validity of the sponsor’s airtime.

# **Definition**

JazaMiti initiative is a National Landscape and Ecosystem Restoration Program which will see Kenya plant and grow 15 billion trees and achieve a 30% tree cover by 2032. The Ministry of Environment, Climate Change and Forestry, (Ministry) in partnership with Safaricom in coordinating the implementation of this National Landscape and Ecosystem Restoration program. To aid in this initiative and document the tree planting activities, the MoE CC &ICT have come up with an App dubbed “JazaMiti” available on Google play store and iOS.

# **JazaMiti App**

The JazaMiti App is a mobile app that facilitates and enhances tree planting programs by allowing users to users in selecting suitable tree species for planting based on their location, documenting, tracking, and monitoring the growth of documented trees over time to aid in Kenya’s vision of planting 15 billion trees in the coming 10 years to fight climate change.

# **Benefits of the JazaMiti App**

- It promotes citizen engagement in that people can interact through social feeds, share updates, and participate in group planting events.
- It encourages sustainable practices through tree planting, hence promoting environmental conservation.
- It is a hub of information on tree species i.e., species site matching, their growth requirements, benefits, and ecological significance.

# **How to download the JazaMiti App**

You can download the Jazamiti App for free from your device's app store (iOS App Store or Google Play Store).

Simply search for "Jaza Miti App," and then click the download/install button.

# **Requirements to use the JazaMiti App**

To use the app, you must be at least 13 years old. If you are under the age of 13, you must have parental or guardian consent to use the App.

# **Charges of using the JazaMiti App**

There are no charges incurred when using the app.

You need to have your WIFI or Data on when downloading the app from Play Store or App Store for the first time.

The App has an offline feature that enables you to access services.

# **Accessing JazaMiti App on M-PESA**

- You can download the M-PESA App from Play Store or App Store
- Log in to the App, and on the navigation bar, select the Service Tab.
- Select the Jaza Miti mini-app.
- Log in to the mini-app and follow the prompts.

# **Availability of the JazaMiti App**

YES. However, the tree planting to species site matching features will only be available in within Kenyan borders only.

# **Features of the JazaMiti App**

The JazaMiti App allows you to access to enjoy the following features.

- Tree planting events
- Tree species to site matching
- Documentation and tracking of tree planting activities (past and present)
- Know more about trees.
- Location of tree nurseries (coming soon)
- FAQs

# **How to participate in the tree planting program through the app**

- After downloading the app, create an account or sign in if you already have one.
- Navigate to the "Plant Trees" section, where you can choose the tree species you want to plant.
- Select a planting location and follow the instructions to plant the tree.
- You can also join organized tree planting events through the app's event calendar.

# **Tracking trees planted.**

Yes. The app features a "My Trees" section where you can see a list of all the trees you have planted. You will receive updates about their growth, and you can upload photos to document their progress over time.

# **Resources available about different tree species**

The app provides information about various tree species, including their growth requirements, benefits to the environment, and suitable planting locations.

# **How I can organize a tree planting event through the app**

You can create a tree planting create event through the app, set the date, time, and location, and invite other users to participate.

You can also provide any other details about the event and any specific requirements.

# **Other activities that i can I engage in within the app**

The JazaMiti app that enables you to connect with friends, family, or other participants.

You can share your planting achievements, photos, and updates on your profile or through the app's social feed.

# **Who can participate in the tree planting program within the app?**

The app is open to everyone. The app encourages schools, community groups, and organizations to participate. It offers features for group planting events, educational resources, and a leaderboard to track collective planting efforts.

# **How the app contributes to climate change**

The JazaMiti App contributes to climate change by encouraging individuals and groups to actively participate in tree planting to promote environmental conservation.

Trees play a crucial role in mitigating climate change, improving air quality, preventing soil erosion, and supporting biodiversity. By making tree planting accessible and engaging, the app helps promote sustainable environmental practices.

# **Support if I encounter issues with the app**

**Modem, Routers and MiFi services**

# **MODEM**

**Definition**

**A modem** is a device that sends information between the outside world or Wide Area Network (WAN), and customer’s home.

**Wingle Wi-Fi modem:** It is a modem that allows the customer to create his own hotspot and share internet with up to 5 people.

A modem turns customer’s inbound connection (coax cable, telephone line, fiber optic line, or other) into an Ethernet connection, which then allows a Wi-Fi router to connect to the Internet.

# **Currently Stocked Modems**

The customer should visit retail shop/visit masoko.com to find out about latest and available modems.

# 

# **ROUTERS**

**Definition**

A router is a networking device that forwards data packets between computer networks.

Routers perform the traffic directing functions on the Internet. Data sent through the internet, such as a web page or email, is in the form of data packets.

# **Types Of Routers**

The customer should visit retail shop/visit masoko.com to find out about latest and available Routers.

# **WiMAX routers**

WiMAX router transfers data wirelessly in a network.

The speed of the transfer of data with the help of WiMAX routers is much faster.

WiMAX routers are used to deliver wireless speeds which are equal to the speed of direct line cable.

It works with different devices like mobile phones, wireless TVs, and many Wi-Fi enabled devices.

# **Features**

**OFDM-based Physical Layer**: The WiMAX physical layer (PHY) is based on orthogonal frequency division multiplexing, a scheme that offers good resistance to multipath, and allows WiMAX to operate in NLOS conditions.

**Very High Peak Data Rates**: WiMAX can support very high peak data rates. In fact, the peak PHY data rate can be as high as 74Mbps when operating using a 20MHz wide spectrum.

**Scalable Bandwidth and Data Rate Support.**

**Adaptive Modulation and Coding (AMC).**

**Link-layer Retransmissions**: WiMAX supports automatic retransmission requests (ARQ) at the link layer for connections that require enhanced reliability.

# **Support for Advanced Antenna Techniques**

**WiMAX Uses OFDM**: Mobile WiMAX uses (Orthogonal frequency division multiple) access (OFDM) as a multiple-access technique, whereby different users can be allocated different subsets of the OFDM tones.

**Robust Security**: WiMAX supports strong encryption, using Advanced Encryption Standard (AES), and has a robust privacy and key-management protocol.

# **3G Router**

**Definition**

3G Router Mode enables a customer to plug in a 3G USB modem and share it wirelessly.

# **Basic connection settings for a 3G router**

Profile Name: Safaricom

Dial-up-Number: \*99#

Username: saf

Password: data

APN: Safaricom

# **LINKSYS ROUTER**

**Definition**

This is a popular brand of consumer wireless routers from Belkin, which acquired the line from Cisco in 2013. This router can be used to connect one computer, or multiple computers to the internet.

# **How to Log into a Linksys router**

Connect the router to a computer

On the browser address bar, enter 192.168.1.1 or 192.168.0.1 to access the router interface,

Default login credentials are admin (i.e. both username and password).

# **MIFI**

**Definition**

This is a brand name used to describe a wireless router that acts as mobile Wi-Fi hotspot.

A MiFi device can be connected to a cellular network and provide internet access for up to 16 Wi-Fi devices simultaneously, but for good experience, a maximum of 10 devices is recommended.

# **Features of MiFi**

MiFi hotspots can connect with multiple devices, so, they’re more useful than the others on the go internet solutions.

MiFi hotspot allows one to avoid the use of cell phone data, it can save cell phone’s battery.

It can safely tether to more than one device.

It can work for extended periods without losing the internet connection.

The MiFi device works on wireless signals and when it is connected to the mobile data (3G or 4G). The signal will be transmitted to various devices, this is useful for devices like the iPad that does not have a USB port.

The Mi-Fi dongle does not require any software to be downloaded, which increases the convenience and ease-of-use of the device.

# **Speeds**

MiFi can achieve speeds of up to 150Mbps.

# **Signal Colours Interpretation**

**Green, blinking twice every 2sec**: the USB stick is powered.

**Green, blinking once every 2sec**: the USB stick is registering with a 2G network.

**Blue, blinking once every 2sec**: the USB stick is registering with 3G/3G+ network.

**Green solid**: The USB stick is connected to a 2G network.

**Blue solid**: The USB stick is connected to a 3G network.

**Cyan (greenish blue) solid**: The USB stick is connected to a 3G+ network.

**Red**: connect to the charger

**OFF:** the USB stick is removed

**DIY Procedure for MALI & Service Management**

# **How to** **Opt In**

Customers can Opt In via USSD and My Safaricom App

**USSD**

Customers will dial the MALI USSD \*334#ok.

Select Mali

Select Register and follow the prompts to opt in.

# **How It Works**

The system will be validated M-PESA account status and date of registration.

The customer input KYC details will be validated against IPRS.

The customer will accept terms and conditions and accept data sharing with investment companies for every investment product.

The customers will validate opt in using their M-PESA PIN on the STK Push validation pop up.

Once opted in the customer will be able to invest in Unit Trusts Product.

# **Opt In Requirements**

Valid Email address (to receive statements).

Next of kin phone number.

**Via Safaricom App**

Development ongoing for customers’ registration via Safaricom APP

**NOTE:** A customer can register MALI on any of their active M-PESA registered numbers. Each line will be treated as a separate account under the same customer.

# **How to Opt-Out**

**USSD**

Customers will dial the USSD \*334#ok,

Select Mali,

Select My Account

Select Close Account,

Enter M-PESA Pin and follow the prompts to opt out.

# **How It Works**

The customer will select an investment product category already enrolled and/or invested in and wish to opt out from

If there is no available balance in the investment product category, the customer will be requested to confirm that they want to opt out of the product and be successfully opted out.

If the customer has a balance in their investment product category and they select opt out, they will be prompted to allow withdrawal of funds first before opting out of the service.

On accepting to withdraw funds, available balance will be displayed and prompted to accept withdrawal and opting out of the service.

The customer will validate the request by using their M-PESA PIN on the STK Push validation pop up.

If the customers have NIL balance, upon opt out, they will receive one inline notification informing them that the request has been accepted and being processed, and SMS notification confirming that they have successfully opted out of the investment product.

If the customers have balance, upon opt out, they will receive 3 SMS notifications; A withdrawal request has been received and is being processed; followed by normal B2C G2 Notification and one confirming that they have successfully opted out of the investment product.

# **Balance Check**

To check balance of a MALI M-PESA Investment Product the customer must have enrolled in an investment product they intended query balance.

Customers will dial the USSD \*334#ok,

Select Mali,

Select check balance.

Input M-PESA PIN and wait for M-PESA confirmation message.

**How It Works**

The customer will select an investment product category already enrolled in

The customers will validate the request by using their M-PESA PIN on the STK Push validation pop up.

Customer will receive a confirmation message with the closing balance of the preceding day of trade.

# **DIY Top-Up Investment Amount**

To top up a MALI investment product the customer must have invested in a product.

Where the customer will not have invested, they will be prompted to opt in and given the investment options.

A customer can top up their investment any time, using either of the following: 

**Via USSD:**

Customer dials \*334#,

Select: Invest

Enter Amount

Confirm Top Up details by selecting Yes.

Input M-PESA PIN and wait for M-PESA confirmation message.

**Via Paybill:**

Customer will go to M-PESA Menu on their phone.

Select Lipa Na M-PESA

Select Paybill Number

Enter Business number 859528,

Account number Enter customer ID.

Enter Amount,

Input M-PESA PIN and wait for M-PESA confirmation message.

# **Investment top up process**

The customer will put in the amount to invest which should be within the minimum and maximum range provided.

The amount to be invested will be debited from the customer’s M-PESA account.

The customers will validate the amount to invest using their M-PESA PIN on the STK Push validation pop up.

Once confirmed, the top up amount will be added to existing investment product balance and the customer will be able to earn the defined daily interest from the new balance.

Customer will receive 2 SMS notifications; Successful top up notification followed by normal C2B G2 Notification for the M-PESA account debit.

# **DIY MALI Investment Process**

**The USSD Mechanics**

Customers will dial the USSD \*334#ok

Select Invest

Enter Amount and follow the prompts to invest.

**How It Works**

The customer will put in the amount to invest which should be within the minimum and maximum range provided.

The amount to be invested will be debited from the customer’s M-PESA account.

The customers will validate the amount to invest using their M-PESA PIN on the STK Push validation pop up.

Once invested the customer will be able to earn the defined daily interest from the investment product.

Customer will receive 2 SMS notifications; Successful top up notification followed by normal C2B G2 Notification for the M-PESA account debit.

# **DIY Withdrawal Process**

**Withdrawal** **via USSD**

Customers will dial the USSD \*334#

Select Mali,

Select Withdraw

Enter Amount to Withdraw

Input M-PESA PIN and wait for M-PESA confirmation message.

**How It Works**

The customer will select an investment product category already enrolled and invested in and wish to withdraw from

The customer will specify the amount to withdraw (Min –KES 10 Max – KES 250,000 Daily limit is KES 500,000)

The customers will validate the request by using their M-PESA PIN on the STK Push validation pop up.

Customer will receive 2 SMS notifications; Successful withdrawal notification from the investment product, followed by normal B2C G2 Notification for the M-PESA account credit.

# **Partial withdrawal of funds**

A customer can withdraw part or all their funds at any time. The amount specified will be credited into their M-PESA wallet.

Withdrawal mechanics is as indicated below:

Dial \*334#ok,

Select Mali,

Select Withdraw

Enter the Amount

Confirm details and follow prompts.

A customer will get their investment amount instantly, credited into their M-PESA accounts.

Customer withdrawals are free.
